job.title: Senior Manager, Communications
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

The Senior Manager, Corporate Communications will lead day-to-day and proactive communications across Singapore, Malaysia and India.

Based in Singapore or Malaysia, the role will translate AirTrunk’s corporate communications strategy into market-level activity, building stakeholder confidence, strengthening executive visibility and supporting the company’s growth across the region.

The role will work across media, social and internal channels and partner closely with regional leadership, Corporate Affairs, development, operations, energy and sustainability, commercial and people teams.

This is a hands-on role for an experienced communications professional who can develop strategy, write high-quality content, manage issues and build trusted relationships with media, government, industry and community stakeholders.

Your Day to Day

  • Strategy and planning: Translate the global communications strategy into quarterly market plans, maintain the regional runway, identify emerging issues and opportunities, and align and repurpose communications across Singapore, Malaysia and India.
  • Corporate narrative and messaging: Adapt and maintain AirTrunk’s regional narrative, message house, Q&As, proof points and briefing materials, ensuring consistency across markets, spokespeople and channels as priorities evolve.
  • Executive and leadership communications

Support executive positioning across the region by identifying opportunities and preparing speeches, talking points, media briefs, interviews, LinkedIn content and training.

  • Media relations: Build priority media relationships, develop narrative-by-outlet plans, pursue proactive opportunities and manage pitches, briefings, outreach, embargoes, spokespeople and agency coordination.
  • Thought leadership, campaigns and content: Develop campaigns and high-quality content that explain AirTrunk’s role in digital infrastructure and demonstrate its contribution to local skills, suppliers, communities, energy infrastructure and economic growth.
  • Issues and crisis communications: Monitor emerging issues, prepare response materials and crisis scenarios, advise regional leaders on reputational risks and coordinate timely, factual and consistent responses.
  • Social and internal communications: Manage regional corporate and executive social calendars, develop content and case studies from across the business, and support internal communications that connect employees to regional priorities and AirTrunk’s reputation.

What success looks like

  • Regional executives are better prepared and more visible on priority issues and themes.
  • AirTrunk has stronger relationships with priority media and external stakeholders.
  • Communications activity is increasingly proactive, with campaigns, thought leadership and executive positioning complementing announcements and reactive work.
  • Emerging issues are identified early and managed with clear, consistent advice.
  • AirTrunk’s narrative is understood and consistently represented across markets and channels.
  • Communications demonstrate AirTrunk’s contribution to digital infrastructure, local economies, communities, skills and supply chains.
  • Regional activity delivers measurable improvements in reach, engagement, sentiment, share of voice and stakeholder confidence.

Requirements

  • 12+ corporate communications experience.
  • Experience working across Southeast Asia, ideally Singapore and Malaysia, with an understanding of the Indian market.
  • Strong writing and editing skills across media, executive, social and internal communications.
  • Experience advising senior executives and preparing them for media, speaking and stakeholder engagements.
  • Experience developing proactive campaigns and thought leadership, not only managing announcements.
  • Strong judgement in handling complex, sensitive or fast-moving issues.
  • Ability to understand complex technical, infrastructure, energy or policy issues and explain them clearly.
  • Experience managing agencies and working across a regional or matrixed organisation.
  • Strong stakeholder and relationship-building skills.
  • Cultural awareness and the ability to adapt communications to different markets.
  • A practical, collaborative and hands-on approach.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Senior Accountant - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a strong and experienced statutory accountant with a solid background in financial reporting, IFRS, local GAAP, external audit or technical accounting. The successful candidate will bring a strong accounting foundation, sound judgement and the ability to apply accounting principles across multiple legal entities and jurisdictions.

Previous experience in CAPEX accounting, fixed assets or project accounting is advantageous, but it is not essential. CAPEX accounting can be learned. More important is an analytical mindset, attention to detail and a natural curiosity to investigate issues, challenge unusual results and understand the drivers behind financial outcomes.

CAPEX and fixed asset accounting will become the successful candidate’s area of specialisation. The role will support the accounting, reporting and statutory compliance of capital expenditure, fixed assets and capital projects within a multinational environment that reports under US GAAP while also meeting local statutory reporting and financial statement filing requirements.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop specialised CAPEX expertise while applying and expanding strong statutory accounting and financial reporting skills within a dynamic global finance organisation.

Responsibilities

  • Support the accounting, reporting and statutory compliance of capital expenditure, fixed assets and capital projects
  • Prepare and review financial information, reconciliations and supporting schedules in accordance with applicable accounting standards and reporting requirements
  • Support the preparation of statutory financial statements and disclosures, ensuring compliance with local GAAP, IFRS and other relevant accounting frameworks
  • Analyse financial data, investigate variances and identify the root causes of accounting and reporting discrepancies
  • Partner with operational teams, project managers, procurement and other stakeholders to ensure the completeness and accuracy of financial information
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, reconciliations and technical accounting support
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives that strengthen controls, reporting quality and operational efficiency
  • Assist in the implementation and application of accounting policies within a multinational reporting environment, including exposure to US GAAP reporting requirements
  • Stay informed of developments in accounting standards and statutory reporting requirements across relevant jurisdictions
  • Support and collaborate with team members across finance and accounting functions to promote best practices and knowledge sharing

Qualifications

  • Qualified accountant (CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA or equivalent)
  • Strong experience in statutory accounting, financial reporting, general ledger accounting, technical accounting, external audit or a related finance function
  • Good knowledge of IFRS, local GAAP or other recognised accounting frameworks
  • Experience preparing, reviewing or supporting statutory financial statements and disclosures
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a demonstrated ability to investigate and resolve accounting issues
  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy
  • Ability to identify unusual trends, balances and variances and perform detailed analysis to determine underlying causes
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience working with ERP systems
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced international environment
  • Experience with fixed asset accounting, CAPEX accounting, project accounting or asset management processes
  • Exposure to US GAAP reporting requirements
  • Experience working within a multinational organisation, shared services environment or global finance function
  • Experience supporting multiple legal entities and jurisdictions
  • Knowledge of Oracle or other enterprise financial systems

What Will Make You Successful

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has a genuine affinity for numbers and financial analysis
  • Enjoys investigating discrepancies and understanding the story behind the numbers
  • Demonstrates strong professional curiosity and a willingness to challenge unusual outcomes
  • Takes ownership of issues and follows them through to resolution
  • Can balance technical accounting requirements with practical business realities
  • Thrives in a collaborative global environment and continuously seeks opportunities for improvement

Why Join Us

  • Opportunity to develop specialised CAPEX and fixed asset expertise within a global finance organisation
  • Exposure to US GAAP, IFRS and local statutory reporting requirements across multiple jurisdictions
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment with opportunities for professional growth and development
  • Ongoing training and coaching to build expertise in CAPEX accounting and related technical accounting topics
  • Meaningful involvement in statutory reporting, technical accounting and process improvement initiatives that drive business value

Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing [this form](https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=cbKtcscv_kql7p3mpZ9r-50RYwLmhPpKtmEYPKOcl8hURTBBN0xMTllDRVc0VkJUSEYxMEk1V0NJQS4u&origin=lprLink).

Equinix is an Equal Employment Opportunity and, in the U.S., an Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law.

We use artificial intelligence in our hiring process. Learn more [here](https://careers.equinix.com/equinix-ai-guidance-for-candidates).

job.title: Senior Network Engineer
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Key Responsibilities

Network Design & Implementation

  • Design, configure, deploy, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure.
  • Implement LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, VPN, and Internet connectivity solutions.
  • Perform network migrations, upgrades, and technology refresh projects.
  • Prepare low-level design (LLD), implementation plans, and rollback procedures.
  • Conduct proof-of-concept (POC) and solution validation.

Cisco Technologies

  • Configure and support Cisco Catalyst, Nexus, ISR, ASR, ACI, Catalyst Center and Catalyst 9000 series devices.
  • Implement routing protocols including OSPF, BGP and EIGRP.
  • Configure Layer 2 technologies such as VLANs, VXLAN STP, EtherChannel and VTP.
  • Configure Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers and Cisco Access Points.
  • Configure Cisco DNA Center, Cisco ISE, and Cisco SD-WAN.

Cisco Meraki

  • Configure Meraki MS Switches and MR Wireless Access Points.
  • Manage Meraki Dashboard, templates, firmware upgrades, and licensing.
  • Configure SD-WAN, VPN, Auto VPN, traffic shaping, and security policies.
  • Perform cloud-based monitoring and troubleshooting.

Aruba Technologies

  • Configure Aruba CX and ArubaOS switches.
  • Deploy and maintain Aruba Wireless Access Points and Mobility Controllers.
  • Configure Aruba Central and AirWave management platforms.
  • Implement Aruba ClearPass for Network Access Control (preferred).

Huawei Technologies

  • Configure Huawei switches and routers.
  • Deploy Huawei WLAN solutions and AC controllers.
  • Configure routing protocols, VLANs, ACLs, QoS, VRRP, and MSTP.
  • Manage Huawei eSight network management platform.
  • Perform firmware upgrades and troubleshooting.'

job.title: Demand Generation Manager
job.description:
About Us

There’s something special about working for a company like Macquarie Telecom. We’re not the biggest in the industry, where you’re just a number. We’re not tiny enough that you’ve never heard of us. We’re in that sweet spot where we’re strong enough to punch above our weight. And we definitely do! Because of this, you have the opportunity to make a difference.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a high-energy, impact-focused Demand Generation Manager to join our high-performing team during a period of strong growth and opportunity.

You will shape go-to-market activity, collaborating across sales, channel and product to bring campaigns to life and ensure they land with the right audience at the right time. You'll work closely with Sales to deliver revenue-focused campaigns, with the autonomy to introduce new ideas and leverage AI-powered marketing tools. This is a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact while accelerating your career growth.

The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience across demand and sales qualified lead generation within the technology industry with a clear focus on achieving business outcomes, not just marketing metrics. You are confident making decisions, unafraid to test and pivot, and driven by results.

You will be a key contributor to the success of our go-to-market engine, helping to translate strategy into real, measurable business results. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys driving campaigns from concept to impact, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and brings strong commercial instinct to everything they do.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a high-energy, impact-focused Demand Generation Manager to join our high-performing team during a period of strong growth and opportunity.

You will shape go-to-market activity, collaborating across sales, channel and product to bring campaigns to life and ensure they land with the right audience at the right time. You'll work closely with Sales to deliver revenue-focused campaigns, with the autonomy to introduce new ideas and leverage AI-powered marketing tools. This is a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact while accelerating your career growth.

The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience across demand and sales qualified lead generation within the technology industry with a clear focus on achieving business outcomes, not just marketing metrics. You are confident making decisions, unafraid to test and pivot, and driven by results.

You will be a key contributor to the success of our go-to-market engine, helping to translate strategy into real, measurable business results. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys driving campaigns from concept to impact, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and brings strong commercial instinct to everything they do.

What You'll Be Doing

Develop and execute demand generation strategies that support business growth, increase market visibility, and generate a consistent pipeline of qualified leads. Reporting directly to a Group Executive

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of multi-channel campaigns including ABM, events, thought leadership and digital focused on acquisition, engagement, and lead conversion.
  • Work closely with stakeholders from Sales, Channel, Product to build campaigns that are aligned to shared business objectives and priorities.
  • Actively participate in campaign kick-off meetings and go-to-market planning, bringing insights around timing, tactics, and audience segmentation.
  • Ensure seamless lead handoff and alignment with Sales teams, with clarity around lead qualification criteria and campaign intent.
  • Support the use of campaign tools and platforms (Salesforce) to ensure activity is tracked, attributed, and actionable by Sales.

  • Experience building and driving campaigns end-to-end from concept to execution.

  • Experience generating sales qualified leads not just marketing leads.
  • Experience in customer engagement, retention and/or lifecycle management roles.
  • Experience working with marketing automation platforms such as Pardot or Salesforce.

  • Self-starter with the ability to deal with multiple stakeholders and manage complex scenarios.
  • Experience with NPS program is desirable.

job.title: Regional Due Diligence Director, APAC
job.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Position Description

The Program Director is accountable for leading the front-end development lifecycle of new data center opportunities across APAC, progressing projects from initial site identification through land acquisition and execution readiness. Acting as the central coordinator across internal and external stakeholders, this role drives due diligence, investment decision-making, and governance processes to maximize site conversion and ensure development opportunities align with Vantage's strategic growth objectives.

The Program Director will oversee cross-functional due diligence programs spanning site evaluation, technical and infrastructure assessments, commercial analysis, and risk management. A key responsibility will be leading governance frameworks, stage-gate processes, and investment approval pathways to ensure opportunities meet defined criteria before advancing. The role will provide transparency across the APAC project pipeline, develop robust business cases, and lead the preparation and presentation of investment recommendations to the APAC Investment Council and other executive decision-making forums.

Success in this role requires strong collaboration across Leadership, Site Selection, Design & Engineering, Construction, Operations, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and other subject matter experts. Acting as a key integrator, the Program Director will align technical, commercial, operational, and strategic priorities, drive decision-making through effective governance, and ensure Vantage has the right capacity in the right markets at the right time to support customer demand and long-term growth across the APAC region.

Essential Job Functions

  • Lead the APAC Investment Council, driving strategic investment decisions, prioritization of development opportunities and portfolio growth initiatives across the region.
  • Lead and manage all aspects of technical and commercial due diligence and front-end planning for new development projects, including site assessments, feasibility studies, conceptual design, due diligence workstreams, power and fibre strategy development, entitlement, and permitting activities.
  • Provide strategic leadership, thought partnership, and executive-level guidance on key projects and initiatives, including budget management, schedule oversight, risk mitigation, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment between development, investment, operations, legal, finance, and commercial teams to ensure successful project execution and achievement of regional growth objectives.
  • Lead the definition and execution of due diligence programs for complex infrastructure development opportunities, ensuring key technical, commercial, regulatory, and delivery risks are identified, appropriately investigated, and assessed to support investment, acquisition, and development decision-making.

Duties

  • Lead the APAC Investment Council process, providing transparency across the regional development pipeline, developing robust business cases, and preparing and presenting investment recommendations to executive leadership and decision-making forums.
  • Serve as the primary owner of front-end development activities, driving opportunities from site identification through land acquisition by coordinating due diligence, risk management, stakeholder alignment, and investment approvals to improve conversion of site selection opportunities.
  • Lead all early-stage project development and due diligence activities, including site selection, feasibility assessments, conceptual design, utility strategy (power, water, and fiber), permitting pathways, commercial assessments, risk evaluations, and investment approval processes.
  • Interpret technical findings and provide development and commercial recommendations and risk mitigation strategies to support acquisitions.
  • Act as the central point of integration across internal and external stakeholders undertaking due diligence, ensuring alignment, accountability, and timely decision-making throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Provide executive oversight and portfolio governance across the APAC development pipeline, delivering regular updates to Executive Leadership on project progress, risks, schedules, budgets, quality, financial performance, cash flow, and critical decisions required to achieve business objectives.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration across Site Selection, Development, Operations, Finance, Legal, Commercial, Procurement, Design, Engineering and Construction, and Executive Leadership teams to define project requirements, resolve issues, manage risks, and support informed investment decisions.
  • Lead and manage relationships with external consultants, landowners, contractors, utilities, government authorities, regulatory agencies, and industry stakeholders to secure successful project outcomes and maintain development momentum.
  • Drive project outcomes from concept through execution readiness, establishing scope, schedule, budget, governance frameworks, consultant engagement strategies, and business case approvals while maintaining alignment with strategic objectives and investment criteria.
  • Oversee portfolio reporting and governance, ensuring leadership maintains full visibility of pipeline health, site conversion performance, project risks, costs, schedules, market dynamics, and capital deployment priorities.
  • Identify and mitigate development, permitting, commercial, infrastructure, and execution risks to support successful project advancement and informed investment decisions.
  • Lead contract governance, performance reporting, and financial management activities, ensuring robust controls, risk management, and informed decision-making across the portfolio.
  • Champion continuous improvement by incorporating lessons learned, market intelligence, industry trends, and best practices to enhance development processes, strengthen governance, and support Vantage's long-term growth strategy across APAC.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience

  • Proven experience managing complex development, infrastructure, construction, or real estate projects, ideally in a client-side environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities, work independently, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience across APAC markets, particularly Singapore, Malaysia, Japan, and Australia, is highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of site acquisition, due diligence, planning, permitting, and utility infrastructure (power and fibre).
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior leaders and external partners.
  • Degree in Engineering, Construction, Real Estate, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • Flexibility to travel regularly across APAC.
  • Adaptable, self-motivated, and comfortable working across multiple time zones, cultures, and remote environments.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage.

job.title: Senior Commissioning Manager (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary

The Senior Commissioning Manager will work as part of the STACK Data Centre Melbourne team and be responsible for the management of commissioning of mission critical equipment, start-up, and testing for projects in Melbourne.

Key responsibilities

  • Provide leadership for the execution of commissioning to meet STACK standards
  • Manage projects and Cx teams in progress and for future projects as directed, including all commissioning related design, contractual and financial aspects in consultation with STACK management
  • Look for opportunities to streamline the commissioning process without compromising on the quality required
  • Creation of CxA RFP proposal documentation as instructed
  • Participate in the procurement of CxA Consultants for projects including managing this process
  • Management of STACK internal commissioning staff assigned to your project
  • Overall management of CxA Consultants relating to specific projects under management
  • Conduct design review process with Engineering team as needed
  • Review all reports issued by CxA, including design reviews, Load-bank plans, IST intent, IST method statement, and IST interim and final reports
  • Ensure safe work practices are followed by all participants on the commissioning team at the customer site

About you

  • BS in a mechanical/electrical or engineering field or equivalent years' experience
  • 2 years leadership responsible for commissioning execution by region or leading a Cx business with responsibility for financial performance of projects
  • 3 years or more of experience in performing commissioning in a regulated industry, or facility engineering / facility management
  • Experience in Data Centre Construction / Commissioning or Data Centre Operations
  • Experience in use of Automated Commissioning Management System (ACxMS) systems for the management of commissioning
  • Ability to read and interpret MEP designs and schematics
  • Knowledge of mission critical design concepts
  • Experience in use of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Bluebeam, and Project software
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English
  • Travel may be required (0-25%)

Equal Opportunity Employer

job.title: Senior Critical Operations Technician (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Senior Critical Operations Technician is the senior on-shift technical role responsible for ensuring safe, stable and consistent operation of critical electrical, mechanical, cooling, controls and life-safety systems. The role provides elevated technical capability, supports first-response incident actions, verifies plant condition after maintenance or resets, and guides technicians in executing operational tasks with accuracy and discipline. This position supports STACK’s 100% uptime commitment through strong operational judgement, trend awareness, structured troubleshooting and the ability to stabilise plant conditions within authorised boundaries. The Senior Technician also enhances shift performance by coaching team members, refining documentation quality and maintaining a concierge-level customer service approach in all interactions with customers, visitors and stakeholders.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Critical Operations

  • Support STACK’s 100% uptime objective through disciplined operational control, proactive monitoring and accurate technical response.
  • Maintain real-time awareness of plant condition through BMS/EPMS, alarms and inspections, taking timely actions within authorised limits.
  • Provide senior technical support to shift technicians, assisting with prioritisation, procedural clarity and execution quality.
  • Operate and monitor critical electrical and/or mechanical systems, including UPS, PDUs, switchboards, generators, CRAC/CRAH, CDU/FWU, chilled water systems, pumps and associated plant, strictly within approved procedures and authorisations.
  • Perform structured diagnostics on abnormal conditions, apply permitted stabilisation actions and escalate with clear technical detail and recommended next steps.
  • Support operational event response, including immediate containment actions, technical communication and accurate event documentation.
  • Conduct enhanced rounds including thermal, capacity, vibration/noise, leak detection and set-point verification, ensuring findings are recorded and actioned.
  • Identify trends, weak signals and reliability concerns using BMS/EPMS data and provide recommendations to prevent recurrence.
  • Manage on-shift work execution with strict adherence to permit-to-work controls, isolations/LOTO, vendor access and operational handbacks.
  • Coordinate vendor activities during shift, ensuring safe execution, clear understanding of plant impacts and thorough return-to-service verification.
  • Validate operational readiness following maintenance, resets or configuration changes, confirming alarms, redundancy, load paths and expected operating conditions.
  • Review and improve the quality of shift logs, event notes, CMMS entries and handovers to ensure accuracy, clarity and traceability.
  • Raise and escalate recurring defects, reliability risks and improvement opportunities through appropriate channels.
  • Contribute to procedure reviews, readiness activities, drills and documentation improvements with practical, shift-based insights.
  • This role does not perform licensed electrical, mechanical or refrigeration work. All trade-restricted activities are completed by appropriately qualified and licensed personnel. The Senior Technician focuses on operational system management, first-response stabilisation, verification and coordination.

People

  • Set a high standard for safety behaviour, operational discipline and professional conduct across the shift.
  • Support technicians through on-the-job coaching, demonstrations and constructive feedback to improve capability and consistency.
  • Assist with onboarding and familiarisation of new team members, reinforcing authorised boundaries and operational expectations.
  • Strengthen team communication by ensuring clear handovers, accurate escalation details and calm coordination during events.
  • Participate actively in briefings, toolbox talks, training and operational discussions, offering practical observations and improvement ideas.
  • Build collaborative relationships with Security, Projects and vendor personnel to support safe, coordinated site operations.
  • Demonstrate a concierge-level customer service approach in all interactions with customers, visitors and stakeholders.

Competencies

  • Strong operational discipline and sound judgement in a critical facility environment.
  • High technical capability in electrical and/or mechanical systems within authorised boundaries.
  • Effective structured troubleshooting and stabilisation capability under pressure.
  • Ability to interpret alarms, telemetry, trends and technical documentation.
  • Proficiency with BMS/EPMS, CMMS and operational workflow tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication for shift documentation, incidents and customer updates.
  • Contractor coordination skills with strong permit-to-work and LOTO awareness.
  • Ability to coach others and improve team execution quality.
  • Calm, methodical approach during alarms and operational events.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with focus on reliability and operational quality.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience in critical environments such as data centres, hospitals, utilities, defence or industrial facilities.
  • Demonstrated capability operating and monitoring critical power and cooling systems, including UPS, generators, switchgear, PDUs/PMMs, ATS/STS, CRAC/CRAH, chilled water systems, pumps, controls and fire systems.
  • Hands-on experience conducting operational inspections and first-response stabilisation actions.
  • Experience using BMS/EPMS and CMMS/workflow tools for monitoring, work management and operational documentation.
  • Ability to read and interpret single-line diagrams, technical drawings and OEM documentation.
  • Familiarity with permit-to-work, isolations/LOTO and basic operational risk assessment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication suitable for logs, handovers and customer-facing updates.

Work Environment / Conditions

  • Role operates on a 24/7 rotating shift roster including nights, weekends and public holidays.

job.title: Assistant Manager - Projects - ATGL - PNG
job.description:
Responsibilities

PNG Projects Engineer - O3

Project Execution and Support:

  • Assist in the execution of PNG, including site preparation, equipment installation, and commissioning, ensuring all tasks are completed according to project plans and timelines.
  • Collaborate with the Projects Lead to ensure that all engineering activities meet design specifications, safety standards, and quality requirements.
  • Conduct on-site inspections and assessments to monitor progress, identify potential issues, and ensure that all work complies with technical specifications.
  • Prepare and update detailed engineering drawings, technical documents, and project plans, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards.
  • Coordinate with contractors, suppliers, and vendors to ensure the timely delivery of materials and services required for project completion.

Technical Support and Problem Solving:

  • Provide technical support to the project team, troubleshooting and resolving engineering issues that arise during the project lifecycle.
  • Analyze and interpret technical data, drawings, and specifications to support decision-making and ensure the successful completion of project tasks.
  • Implement engineering solutions to address on-site challenges, ensuring minimal disruption to project timelines and budget.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of engineering best practices, focusing on improving efficiency, safety, and quality in project execution.
  • Participate in technical meetings and reviews, providing input and recommendations to optimize project outcomes.

Quality Control and Assurance:

  • Monitor and enforce quality control measures throughout all phases of the project, ensuring that all work meets the required standards and specifications.
  • Conduct regular inspections and tests on materials, equipment, and systems to verify their compliance with project requirements and industry regulations.
  • Document and report any quality issues or non-conformities, working with the project team to implement corrective actions and prevent recurrence.
  • Assist in the development of quality assurance plans and procedures, ensuring that they are effectively implemented and adhered to during project execution.

Safety and Compliance:

  • Ensure that all engineering activities comply with local, regional, and national safety regulations and industry standards, minimizing the risk of accidents or incidents.
  • Participate in safety audits and inspections, identifying potential hazards and implementing measures to mitigate risks.
  • Provide input on safety protocols and procedures, ensuring that they are followed by all team members and contractors during project execution.
  • Assist in the preparation of safety documentation, including risk assessments, method statements, and safety plans, ensuring they are complete and accurate.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project documentation, including engineering drawings, technical specifications, progress reports, and inspection records.
  • Prepare regular project status reports for the Projects Lead, highlighting key achievements, challenges, and any areas requiring attention.
  • Assist in the preparation of as-built documentation upon project completion, ensuring that all records reflect the final state of the project.
  • Ensure that all documentation is properly filed and accessible, supporting future project reviews and audits.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with other engineers, project managers, and stakeholders to ensure smooth communication and coordination throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Participate in project meetings, providing updates on engineering activities and contributing to discussions on project planning and execution.
  • Liaise with contractors, suppliers, and vendors to resolve any technical issues and ensure alignment on project objectives and timelines.
  • Provide clear and concise technical information to non-engineering team members, ensuring they understand the requirements and constraints of the project.

Continuous Improvement and Learning:

  • Stay informed about the latest developments in engineering practices, technologies, and industry standards relevant to PNG or CNG projects.
  • Identify opportunities for improving engineering processes and practices, proposing and implementing changes that enhance project performance.
  • Participate in training and professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge, ensuring continued growth and contribution to the project team.
  • Share knowledge and insights with the project team, contributing to a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

KEY STAKEHOLDERS

Internal Stakeholders:

  • Regional office
  • Corporate office
  • TechnoCommercial Team
  • HSE Team
  • Operations & Maintenance

External Stakeholders:

  • Vendors
  • Contractors
  • Local authorities
  • Regulatory bodies
  • Consultants

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

Work Experience:

3+ years of experience, preferably in construction project management.

Proven experience in managing large-scale infrastructure projects from inception to completion.

Preferred Industry:

Experience in the gas distribution, oil and energy, or utilities sectors.

job.title: Associate Manager - Finance & Account
job.description:
Responsibilities

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organization in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

Adani Airports Holding Limited: Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state-of-the-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.

1. Capex Financial Management

  • Lead Project and Capex budgeting, financial planning, and controlling for all capex projects.
  • Prepare and review detailed financial projections, Financial KPI IRR/NPV analysis, and sensitivity assessments for capital projects.
  • Develop, monitor, and control project cash flows, ensuring alignment with approved budgets and funding plans.
  • Oversee billing, payouts, milestone-based disbursements, and ensure adherence to financial controls and compliance requirements.
  • Ensure timely and accurate MIS reporting on capex performance, cash flows, and budget variances.

2. Procurement & Financial Prudence

  • Establish and enforce financial discipline, governance frameworks, and prudence for all large‑scale capex procurement decisions.
  • Actively participate in procurement decisions for projects above ₹10 crore, jointly with the Technical and Commercial (TC) teams.
  • Review business cases, cost estimates, and commercial terms to ensure value for money and risk mitigation.
  • Provide financial oversight and advisory support for smaller capex projects in consultation with the respective BU.

3. Project Oversight & Performance Audit

  • Support Business Units in financial close‑out of capex projects, ensuring timely completion of all financial actions and reports.
  • Conduct post‑implementation and performance audits of capex projects to assess efficiency, cost control, and value realization.
  • Identify cost optimization opportunities and lead or support commercial and financial negotiations with vendors and contractors.
  • Ensure lessons learned from completed projects are institutionalized into future capex governance frameworks.

4. Stakeholder Management & Collaboration

  • Work closely with CFOs, CPOs, Group Finance, and Procurement teams to align capex strategies across business units.
  • Partner with Business Unit Heads and Project Teams to ensure capex objectives are achieved in line with approved financial KPIs.
  • Act as a key finance interface for senior management, providing clear, data‑driven insights on capex performance and risks.

5. Reporting, Governance & Accountability

  • Ensure accurate, transparent, and timely reporting of capex financial performance to the CFO, CEO and CHMO.
  • Maintain high standards of governance, audit readiness, and accountability across all capex‑related financial decisions.
  • Monitor performance against approved financial KPIs and initiate corrective actions where deviations are identified.
  • Strengthening internal controls and compliance mechanisms for capex planning, execution, and closure.

Qualifications

Qualifications & Experience

  • Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory.
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or related discipline.
  • 5–8 years of relevant experience in financial management, with strong exposure to:

Large scale capex project finance

  • Procurement finance and commercial negotiations
  • Financial controls, audits, and governance

Proven experience in managing financial oversight for capex intensive industries (infrastructure, manufacturing, energy, logistics, etc.). Strong expertise in financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow management, Presentation. Enabler of automation with group, Power BI, MIS

job.title: Manager - ETP
job.description:
Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities of Role

Manager - ETP – Copper

Production Planning and Execution:

  • Oversee and coordinate daily ETP activities, ensuring efficient and smooth operations during the shift.
  • Plan and oversee ETP operations during the shift to ensure optimal treatment of effluent water.
  • Prevent overflow and manage the discharge process in compliance with operational targets.
  • Ensure efficient handling of reject water, effluent overflow, and treated water within the shift time frame.

Process Optimization and Continuous Improvement:

  • Monitor and optimize ETP processes to ensure efficiency and minimum environmental impact.
  • Identify and implement process improvements during the shift to enhance throughput and reduce waste.
  • Lead continuous improvement efforts to improve reject handling and spillage prevention.

Quality Assurance and Control:

  • Ensure that all treated water and by-products meet the required quality standards.
  • Supervise reject water handling and hazardous cake management, ensuring zero spillage during operations.
  • Conduct inspections and enforce quality control protocols for all treated outputs.

Equipment Monitoring and Troubleshooting:

  • Monitor the operational performance of ETP equipment and address any malfunctions.
  • Conduct preventive maintenance checks and troubleshoot equipment issues to minimize downtime.
  • Collaborate with maintenance teams to ensure timely repairs and equipment readiness.
  • Supervise reject water handling and ensure the proper disposal of waste products.
  • Prevent overflow of reject water and take immediate corrective actions in case of any deviations.

HSE and Regulatory Compliance:

  • Ensure that all operations within the shift comply with health, safety, and environmental (HSE) regulations.
  • Lead safety audits and inspections, addressing any potential hazards within the shift.
  • Ensure reject handling complies with environmental and regulatory standards.
  • Liaise with government bodies during inspections to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

Cost Management and Budgeting:

  • Monitor chemical consumption, energy usage, and other cost-related factors during the shift.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce operational costs while maintaining process efficiency.
  • Work within the allocated budget for shift operations and suggest cost-saving measures.

Resource and Workforce Management:

  • Lead and supervise a team of operators and technicians to ensure efficient shift operations.
  • Allocate resources effectively to meet operational demands during the shift.
  • Conduct regular training sessions for shift employees on ETP processes, safety, and regulatory compliance.

Reporting and Data Analytics:

  • Prepare and submit daily shift reports on ETP performance, compliance, and maintenance activities.
  • Analyze data from shift operations to identify trends, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement.
  • Ensure accurate record-keeping of plant operations and maintenance tasks.

Digitization and Tech Adoption:

  • Use digital tools and monitoring systems to track ETP processes in real-time.
  • Leverage technology for process optimization, equipment monitoring, and report generation.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Plant Operations Manager
  • Maintenance Department
  • Quality Assurance Team

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • Government Regulatory Bodies
  • Equipment Vendors
  • Service Providers

Qualifications

Education Qualification:

BE in Chemical Engineering or M.Sc Chemistry

Work Experience (Range of years):

6-15 years of experience in the Effluent Treatment Plant industry

job.title: Security Operations Lead
job.description:
Asset Protection and Loss Reduction:

Ensure the implementation of effective security measures to protect assets and minimize losses across plant operations.

Collaborate with the Head Office team to build security capabilities and enhance operational efficiency.

Implement and monitor adherence to approved budgets for manpower deployment, ensuring resource optimization.

Ensure no additional security manpower deployment at existing O&M sites after completion of physical security measures.

Develop security parameters and implement them at the site in consultation with Cluster Security Head.

Crisis Management and Safety Initiatives:

Develop and maintain a comprehensive crisis management plan, ensuring readiness for potential security incidents.

Ensure 100% Security compliance at the main gate of all sites, conducting regular training sessions and mock drills to prepare personnel for emergency situations.

Ensure no accidents or incidents occur at the site while adhering to Security requirements.

Financial Performance Management:

Strive for a 5% reduction in security operational expenditure through effective resource management and proactive risk mitigation strategies.

Monitor vendor performance, ensuring timely submission of invoices and payments while adhering to approved budgets.

Ensure retention of key talent among operational management personnel (OMPs) while providing additional responsibilities.

Training and Capability Building:

Ensure all OMPs receive an average of three days of training annually to enhance their security awareness and response capabilities.(Training Calender of OMPs share to VSH Office)

Conduct security awareness sessions & Briefings to improve the effectiveness of newly joined OMPs and monitor their efficiency.

Implement a minimum of one technology initiative at the sites (Budgetory support from Business) to enhance security measures.

Performance Monitoring and Reporting:

Maintain oversight of security operations, ensuring 100% compliance with established Security and operational protocols.

Prepare and present performance reports to senior management, highlighting achievements, challenges, and areas for improvement.

Regularly liaise with police and civil authorities for smooth functioning of Site and ensure compliance with audit points.

I&V Development:

Drive a performance driven culture by implementing effective I&V mechanism for reduction of theft cases.

Strategic Planning and Implementation:

Create a long-term strategy for security, focusing on technology initiatives, analytics, and business processes.

Ensure continuous optimization drives at sites to balance operational efficiency and loss reduction, targeting a 5% optimization of OPEX in FY.

Coordinate with project teams to ensure timely completion of automation projects and the development of basic security infrastructure at sites.

job.title: Site Operations Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1 billion in committed capital.

Our mission is to bridge the digital divide across Asia Pacific by building the sustainable digital ecosystems of the future. Through building and operating state-of-the-art, energy efficient data centers rich with connectivity options, we bring new colocation and interconnect options to the Asian market, making digital infrastructure deployment in the region easy, efficient and economical.

Founded in 2020 the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across China, India, Indonesia, Japan, Korea, and the Philippines.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We optimize for success.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

  • *

Reporting to the Data Centre Operations Director, this role will perform the fundamental function to keep operational readiness of Digital Edge Data Centre environment during 24/7 daily operation shift. This role will be based in Digha, Navi Mumbai site office.

Key responsibilities

  • Maintain 100% uptime of the datacenter.
  • Ensure service delivery as per agreed SLA with Customer.
  • Governance on vendor management.
  • Responsible for 100% Safety compliance.
  • Responsible for DC physical security.
  • Preparation and Implementation of SOP, EOP, MOP for all types of work.
  • Supervise and Support installation for Racks and stacks customer equipment
  • Build, assess and continually improve internal and externally facing controlled documentation
  • Finishes the assigned task and training in a timely manner.
  • Responsible for monitoring customer applications and Digital Edge’s operational architecture
  • Respond to alarms in accordance with Digital Edge procedures. Incident reporting and route cause analysis.
  • Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinating with DC Director to ensure the All-Statutory forms were followed for the disposal of hazardous waste at the site level.(ex: DG used oil, batteries & E-Waste}.
  • Day to day maintenance activities related to electrical/ Mechanical equipment. Ensure 100% PPM compliance. Attend all breakdown calls.
  • Operation and maintenance of transformer, DG sets and electrical panels, UPS Systems, Server room, WTP, STP & Firefighting, HVAC systems like water cooled AC & Air cooled air conditions.
  • Monitoring and operating the Equipment’s through BMS / SCADA.
  • Ability to interact with customer and own staff.
  • Coordinating with customers internal/ External Audit with respect to ISO and Technical.
  • Spare management tracking with customers, weekly updates and follow—up with vendors for timely delivery of required critical spares.
  • MOP, PTW & Risk Assessment preparing with Shift manager for Offline Pm Activity & Critical Activities and planning and implementation of Site Energy Savings.
  • Responsible to maintain datacenter neat and clean.
  • Strong in customer engagement having good understanding of customer expectations and meeting the requirement with decided path. Maintain transparency in communication with customer.
  • Customer interaction and handling of incident, RCAs, SLA compliance and Space & Power Management.
  • Work closely with PMO Team for effective new projects handover and takeover.

The successful candidate:

**

  • Diploma / Degree in Electrical, engineering
  • 15+ years’ experience in DC site operations
  • Experience in customer service, operation centers or data centers
  • Experience of copper / fiber cabling techniques (Installation, Termination & Testing)
  • Basic knowledge of network.

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

job.title: Hardship Customer Support Executive
job.description:
Melbourne, Australia

Company

Singtel Group

Every day, millions of Australians connect, work, stream, and stay in touch on the Optus network. When it works seamlessly, it’s easy to take for granted. But behind it is a team making thousands of decisions every day - decisions that keep people, businesses and communities connected.

Right now, Optus is focused on getting the fundamentals right - simplifying how we work, lifting standards, and building a more reliable, resilient experience for our customers.

It’s not about surface-level change. It’s about how we make decisions, how we work together, and how we deliver.

As a Hardships Customer Support Executive, you will be responsible for safeguarding the interests of Optus while supporting financially vulnerable customers and collaborating closely with Financial Counsellors. Daily liaison and communication with Financial Counsellors is the core responsibility of this role. You will develop trusted working relationships, respond to referrals and enquiries, and work closely with Financial Counsellors to progress matters and achieve positive outcomes for customers. Financial Counsellors provide customers with essential information, resources and access to emergency relief during periods of financial uncertainty.

This role will be challenging and requires resilience, as customer and community expectations are high. The successful candidate will embrace these challenges while contributing to a proactive, highly engaged and supportive team culture. They will be empowered to advocate for customers, provide excellent service, support vulnerable customers in achieving positive outcomes, and help reduce internal and Telecommunications Industry Ombudsman (TIO) complaints.

The Day to Day

  • Assess customers’ financial circumstances and capacity to pay, delivering tailored solutions that support positive financial outcomes.
  • Manage hardship cases end-to-end, including assessment, negotiation, implementation, review, escalation and resolution.
  • Liaise and communicate with Financial Counsellors every day, responding to referrals, enquiries and requests for support, and providing clear guidance on hardship processes, available options, documentation and next steps.
  • Build effective working relationships with financial counselling organisations and community support services to ensure matters are progressed promptly and customers receive consistent, well-coordinated support.
  • Resolve customer enquiries and minimise complaints through empathetic communication, effective problem-solving and strong customer advocacy.
  • Identify and manage risks relating to family violence, financial abuse, privacy, safety and customer wellbeing, ensuring compliance with relevant legislation and industry codes.
  • Identify recurring themes, process gaps and customer or Financial Counsellor feedback, escalating systemic issues and contributing to improvements in hardship processes, procedures and stakeholder experiences.
  • Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders while maintaining accurate records and contributing to exceptional customer outcomes and team performance.

**

What You Bring

  • Experience in collections, customer service, financial hardship, or related fields, with knowledge of privacy, credit and regulatory requirements.
  • Previous experience in financial counselling is highly desirable, with an understanding of how Financial Counselling teams support customers experiencing financial difficulty, vulnerability or hardship.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to manage hardship enquiries, liaise with financial counselling authorities across Australia, and resolve complex customer matters.
  • The ability to communicate confidently and build constructive relationships with Financial Counsellors on a daily basis is essential.
  • Ability to assess customer circumstances, identify appropriate support pathways, and balance customer needs with business objectives while delivering positive customer outcomes.
  • Highly organised and adaptable, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage high-volume customer enquiries and hardship casework in a regulated environment.
  • Proven relationship-building skills, resilience and sound judgement, with a customer-focused approach and commitment to meeting regulatory obligations and delivering exceptional service.

job.title: Technical Specialist, Fixed Voice
job.description:
Macquarie Park, Australia

Company

Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

As the Technical Specialist, Fixed Voice, you’ll be accountable for the operation, maintenance, technical support and continual improvement of Optus’ Fixed Voice network infrastructure. You’ll work across Ribbon voice switching and SBC platforms to maintain network availability, performance, resilience and operational compliance, while helping modernise our Network Operations tooling through improved observability, trusted data, OSS integration and automation.

**

What You’ll Do

  • Operate and maintain Ribbon Fixed Voice nodes, including DMS300, CS2000 (CS2K), C20, SBC, PSX, IN and associated sub-elements.
  • Provide Level 2 fault management, incident resolution and technical support for Fixed Voice platform outages, service degradations and complex operational issues in line with ITIL best practices.
  • Manage escalated and complex customer-related faults across Enterprise and Wholesale environments.
  • Perform structured fault diagnosis and root-cause analysis, identifying corrective actions and validating the effectiveness of permanent remediation.
  • Configure and manage C20 elements, including GWC, SP2K, G9, MAS, SST, SSL/SESM/A2, CBM, CMT, IEMS, MG15K and NDM.
  • Manage SIP trunking, routing and policy rules through Ribbon NMS, including SIP/TDM interworking and service validation.
  • Investigate voice network faults using SIP, INAP, Diameter, RTP and C7/ISUP protocols, together with OSIX and Wireshark.
  • Execute software upgrades, patch management and planned maintenance on Ribbon platforms, including implementation, testing, rollback and post-change verification.
  • Monitor Fixed Voice network KPIs using Grafana and Kalix, proactively addressing degradation trends affecting call completion, ASR, NER and MOS.
  • Develop, review and maintain Methods of Procedure, implementation plans, risk assessments, technical change records, network documentation and knowledge articles.
  • Collaborate with Network Operations, Engineering, Service Management, NOC, Network Enablement & AI Ops, vendors and suppliers to restore services, improve reliability and support the transformation and rationalisation of Network Operations tooling.

**

What You Bring

  • 15+ years of wireline or Fixed Voice telecommunications experience, with hands-on operational experience across Ribbon or GENBAND platforms.
  • Deep technical expertise in CS2000 (CS2K), C20 and SBC platforms, including call control, provisioning, trunk management, signalling configuration and fault resolution.
  • Strong operational knowledge of Ribbon Fixed Voice architectures and SBC platforms, including SIP trunking, media policy and SIP/TDM interworking.
  • Advanced knowledge of SIP, SS7/ISUP, SIGTRAN, TDM E1/PRI, RTP/RTCP, G.711/G.729, DTMF, LNP/ENUM and IPv4/IPv6.
  • Practical experience with Grafana, Kalix/OSIX, Wireshark, Ribbon EMS/RAMP, ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms, and Unix/Linux command-line tools.
  • Ability to interpret Fixed Voice KPIs, including call completion rate, ASR, NER and MOS, and act on emerging degradation trends.
  • Proven experience in incident management, root-cause analysis, planned maintenance, software upgrades, patching, MOP development, change governance and vendor TAC engagement.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Computer Science or equivalent experience. Ribbon certifications, CCNA/CCNP Voice and ITIL v4 Foundation are preferred.
  • Knowledge of observability, operational analytics, automation and safe AI-assisted operations is desirable.
  • Strong technical ownership, accountability and a disciplined approach to operational risk, with the ability to communicate complex issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders in high-pressure incident, outage and escalation environments.

**

The good stuff…

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • Free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon.

job.title: Consulting Architect
job.description:
Macquarie Park, Australia

Company

Singtel Group

Every day, millions of Australians connect, work, stream, and stay in touch on the Optus network. When it works seamlessly, it’s easy to take for granted. But behind it is a team making thousands of decisions every day - decisions that keep people, businesses and communities connected.

Right now, Optus is focused on getting the fundamentals right - simplifying how we work, lifting standards, and building a more reliable, resilient experience for our customers.

It’s not about surface-level change. It’s about how we make decisions, how we work together, and how we deliver.

As a Consulting Architect, you will partner with senior leaders across the banking, insurance, and government sectors to design and deliver enterprise-wide technology strategies that drive business transformation. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will translate complex business challenges into innovative, commercially sound technology solutions, leveraging expertise across ICT, cloud, applications, security, and digital transformation.

You will lead major customer engagements, shaping solution roadmaps, influencing C-suite stakeholders, and developing compelling business cases that align technology investment with strategic objectives. Working across multidisciplinary teams, you will drive large-scale bids and transformation initiatives while building trusted executive relationships and delivering measurable business outcomes for customers.

The Day to Day

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, including C-suite executives, across strategic customer accounts within the banking, insurance, and government sectors, acting as a trusted advisor on technology strategy and business transformation.
  • Lead the development of enterprise-wide technology strategies, roadmaps, and transformation programs, translating complex business challenges into innovative, commercially viable solutions across ICT, cloud, applications, security, and managed services.
  • Own end-to-end solution design and major customer engagements, coordinating multidisciplinary teams to develop complex proposals, bids, tenders, and tailored solutions that deliver measurable business and customer outcomes.
  • Drive thought leadership through market insights, competitive analysis, and emerging technology trends, partnering with customers, vendors, product teams, and engineering stakeholders to shape strategic technology direction and future opportunities.
  • Act as the primary link between sales, product, engineering, and delivery teams, ensuring solutions are technically robust, commercially sound, and successfully implemented while contributing to revenue growth, customer retention, and strategic business objectives.

What You Bring

Strategic & Business Acumen:

  • Extensive experience in ICT and telecommunications, providing high-level technical consulting and architectural support to enterprise customers, with demonstrated expertise in the Financial Services and/or Telecommunications sectors.
  • Proven capability in developing long-term customer relationships, strategic account planning, and creating technology roadmaps and strategies that align with enterprise business objectives.
  • Advanced commercial and contract understanding, with experience developing commercial artifacts including Preliminary Statements of Work (PSOW), Work Orders, pricing models, and financial justifications including ROI analysis.
  • Strong track record leading bid responses (RFPs, RFIs, RFTs), including technical design, solution articulation, and cross-functional team coordination.

Technical Expertise (Core Required):

  • Contact Centre platforms – hands-on experience designing and implementing enterprise contact centre solutions (NiCE CXone and Cognigy highly desirable; additional experience with Genesys Cloud/PureCloud, Microsoft Dynamics 365, AWS Connect, Avaya, or Verint considered a strong advantage).
  • Enterprise Networking – deep knowledge of LAN switching, wireless networks, and campus infrastructure (Cisco, Meraki, Aruba), including design, implementation, and optimization.
  • Security & SASE – proven experience with modern security architectures, Zero Trust frameworks, and Secure Access Service Edge solutions (Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler).
  • WAN & SD-WAN – comprehensive understanding of wide area networking including SD-WAN, MPLS, dedicated fibre, and hybrid connectivity models (Palo Alto Prisma/Viptela, Meraki SD-WAN, or equivalent platforms).
  • Cloud Architecture – general knowledge of cloud platform architecture and cloud-native services (AWS, Azure, GCP), including hybrid and multi-cloud strategies.

Frameworks & Qualifications:

  • Degree or formal qualification in Telecommunications or Information Technology, supported by relevant industry/vendor certifications (e.g., Cisco CCNA/CCNP/CCIE, Palo Alto Networks certifications, ITIL, TOGAF, or equivalent).
  • Strong background in enterprise-wide ICT architecture, with proficiency in service management and architectural frameworks such as ITIL and TOGAF.

Communication & Leadership:

  • Exceptional ability to translate complex technical concepts and architectures into clear business value propositions, with proven experience presenting and influencing at multiple organizational levels from technical teams to C-suite executives.
  • Advanced communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to articulate multi-domain solutions (networking, security, contact centre, cloud) in an integrated, customer-centric manner.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, and technology proficiency, with advanced skills across productivity tools, architecture modelling tools, and technical documentation.
