job.title: Senior Procurement Analyst
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Senior Procurement Analyst is accountable for the procurement, implementation, management, and day-to-day execution of the Construction Services and/or Owner Furnished Contractor Installed (OFCI) equipment program supporting regional data center construction. Construction Services can include General Contractors, Architect/ Engineers, Commissioning, Controls, and related 3rd Party support services. The OFCI Program can include critical mechanical, electrical and power systems, ensuring quality, on-time, and on-budget delivery to construction projects worldwide. The Supply Chain Manager represents the Supply Chain organization and actively engages with the project team on all project strategy and project delivery activities to ensure supply chain strategies are aligned and meet all project build schedules, cost, design and capacity targets. This role requires an understanding of both construction project delivery and capital supply chain management in mission-critical environment.

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities

  • Lead supplier relationship management and own the supply chain lifecycle for the respective Category, including sourcing, qualifying, RFx, evaluation, commercial negotiations, contract negotiations, award, change management support, management escalation, supplier business reviews, closeout, and claims mitigation/ management.
  • Plan, implement, and manage all project specific supply chain construction services and/ or OFCI equipment logistic activities and procedures including, but not limited to, multi-year project forecasts, sourcing, production planning, negotiations, procurement, logistics, quality, distribution, and heavy communication/ alignment with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ensure all construction services and/or OFCI equipment orders are made on time to meet schedule, actively mitigate late performance and deliveries and ensure high rate of on time execution.
  • Partner with project controls and finance to share procurement status, budget utilization, construction/ installation progress, ensuring transparency and cost accountability.
  • Manage impact of project specific design changes with suppliers and ensure fair and reasonable construction services and/or equipment pricing as a core business function
  • Anticipate issues in advance to prevent potential impacts, internally and externally to drive business decisions. This includes an in-depth understanding of the market environment and current events.
  • Monitor and populate key performance indicators (KPI’s) in support of the respective Category being managed. Measure performance against these KPIs and collaborate with stakeholders to evaluate supplier performance and drive continuous improvement.
  • Employ an analytics-based approach to support executive briefings and decision making along with capturing complex project data into program dashboard outputs.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify demand, qualify, and execute selection of suppliers to deliver equipment and services to construction portfolio; support development of supplier allocation methodologies and regular business reviews with vendors to provide feedback and continuously improve supplier performance.
  • Be the first level escalation for all project construction and/or OFCI concerns including vendor or overall supply chain issues (change orders, late deliveries, disputes, invoice accuracy, etc.); investigate, respond, and bring closure to suppliers, buyer’s agent, or other internal stakeholders.
  • Team with Critical Facilities Engineering and Operations groups to communicate extending lead times and obsolescence of components within supply chain activities. Be in the loop and ahead of upcoming or pending design changes which will impact OFCI equipment.
  • Support internal team(s) to renegotiate, extend options, renew, and discontinue supplier framework agreements as required and issue equipment orders under those framework agreements.
  • Ensure suppliers’ readiness and capability for all commissioning schedule and quality requirements.
  • Ensure supplier clarity, alignment, and ability to deliver on all project deliverables

Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:

  • Experience working in fast-paced, high-value capital projects.
  • Familiarity with international contracting standards and cross-border procurement.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree in relevant field of required qualification.
  • LEAN/Six Sigma Certification
  • PMP (Project Management Professional)
  • CPSM (Certified Professional in Supply Management)
  • Knowledge of FIDIC contracts

Required Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, engineering, business administration, or relevant field.
  • Minimum of ten years of procurement and supply chain management required, preferably in a product/ category/ construction, and program management level.
  • Demonstrated success managing multimillion-dollar projects.

job.title: Engine Field Service Technician - Level III
job.description:
Job Summary

The Skilled Technician - Level III performs advanced manufacturing and maintenance activities that support production and operational excellence. The role is responsible for operating, troubleshooting, maintaining, and improving manufacturing equipment while ensuring compliance with safety, quality, delivery, and productivity standards. Working with a high degree of proficiency, the technician supports continuous improvement initiatives, coaches team members, and collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to achieve business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE)

  • Promote a safe working environment by complying with all Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE) policies, procedures, and regulations.
  • Stop work immediately and report unsafe conditions, hazards, incidents, injuries, or environmental risks.
  • Use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) and follow safe work practices when working with electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and other industrial systems.
  • Identify and eliminate hazards within area of responsibility and actively participate in HSE training and safety improvement initiatives.

Quality

  • Perform manufacturing, maintenance, and inspection activities with high standards of workmanship and craftsmanship.
  • Execute work in accordance with engineering drawings, operation manuals, technical specifications, and process documentation.
  • Perform quality inspections and identify opportunities to reduce quality risks and manufacturing defects.
  • Support equipment uptime through preventive, predictive, corrective, and emergency maintenance activities.
  • Provide feedback to preventive maintenance systems and contribute to equipment reliability improvements.

Production & Operations

  • Perform skilled manufacturing and maintenance activities using appropriate tools, machinery, measuring instruments, and specialty equipment.
  • Support daily production targets while maintaining safety, quality, cost, delivery, and productivity objectives.
  • Monitor equipment performance, troubleshoot issues, and participate in downtime and failure analysis.
  • Maintain clean, organized, and safe work areas, including routine housekeeping and machine cleaning.
  • Identify manufacturing constraints, solve operational problems, and support process improvement initiatives.
  • Participate in Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) and continuous improvement activities to enhance manufacturing performance.

Team Leadership & Collaboration

  • Provide guidance, coaching, and technical support to team members with less experience.
  • Coordinate effectively with production teams, maintenance, quality, engineering, and other support functions.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to achieve operational goals.
  • Support workforce engagement and effectively collaborate within a unionized manufacturing environment where applicable.
  • Contribute to employee development through knowledge sharing and on-the-job coaching.

Administrative & Systems

  • Maintain accurate maintenance, production, and quality documentation.
  • Utilize manufacturing and enterprise systems such as Oracle, QSOL, Ariba, or equivalent platforms to support operational activities.
  • Complete assigned training and continuously develop technical and professional capabilities.

Competencies:

  • Communicates Effectively
  • Collaborates
  • Customer Focus
  • Decision Quality
  • Demonstrates Self-Awareness
  • Drives Results
  • Ensures Accountability
  • Manages Complexity
  • Nimble Learning

  • Health and Safety Fundamentals
  • Controls Safety
  • Manufacturing Knowledge
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Equipment Maintenance & Troubleshooting
  • Team Leadership and Coaching
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Problem Solving

Qualifications

  • Diploma in Mechanical Engineering (preferred).
  • High school diploma or equivalent may be considered where permitted by applicable regulations and supported by relevant experience.
  • Export control or regulatory licensing may be required depending on business and country requirements.

Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in a manufacturing, production, maintenance, or industrial environment.
  • Strong knowledge of diesel engine systems, components, and their operation.
  • Experience performing preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance.
  • Good understanding of manufacturing processes, equipment, and quality standards.
  • Proficiency in using manufacturing systems such as Oracle, QSOL, Ariba, or similar ERP and operational platforms.
  • Experience leading shop-floor teams and driving Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and Morale (SQDCM) performance.

The Customer Quality Analyst will support the business to advocate for internal and external customers in resolving product quality, supply chain quality and process quality related issues.

Key Responsibilities

Develops understanding of customer expectations and requirements for quality with the support of senior quality members. Contributes and supports closing action plans for customer quality issues including product, supply chain or process related. Uses Customer Centric metrics to prioritize customer quality issues. With supervision, develops external relationships and supports developing external quality communications. Contributes to process improvement efforts. Supports the identification of problems, prioritization of actions and may lead Six Sigma projects or continuous improvement actions. Supports the implementation of the vision and strategy for the Customer Quality organization.

Competencies:

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

job.title: Engine Field Service Technician - Level III
job.description:
Job Summary

The Engine Field Service Technician – Level III is the primary technical specialist and customer support contact responsible for diagnosing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining Cummins engine products at customer sites. This role independently performs complex repairs, preventive maintenance, and advanced diagnostics while ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction, safety, quality, and operational excellence. The technician serves as a technical mentor, supports critical customer accounts, drives issue resolution through cross-functional collaboration, and contributes to continuous improvement by sharing technical expertise and best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Service & Field Support

  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and execute complex mechanical and electrical repairs on Cummins engine products and related systems using specialized diagnostic tools and established service procedures.
  • Perform scheduled preventive maintenance and inspections in accordance with Cummins service standards.
  • Interpret customer concerns, develop troubleshooting plans, validate repairs, and ensure successful restoration of equipment performance.
  • Escalate complex technical issues to product specialists or engineering support while maintaining complete troubleshooting documentation.

Customer Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships by providing professional, responsive, and technically sound service.
  • Act as the primary technical contact for assigned customer accounts, providing regular service updates and ensuring timely resolution of maintenance and breakdown activities.
  • Identify additional service, maintenance, and aftermarket opportunities that enhance customer value and equipment reliability.
  • Support customer satisfaction by proactively communicating repair progress, parts availability, and service status.

Technical Leadership & Knowledge Sharing

  • Coach, mentor, and provide technical guidance to technicians and apprentices to develop technical capability and service excellence.
  • Review repair plans, parts requirements, and technical approaches to ensure quality and efficiency.
  • Share technical knowledge, field learnings, and best practices to support continuous improvement across the service organization.
  • Facilitate regular technical discussions and cross-functional reviews to improve visibility of open service issues and drive timely resolution.

Service Coordination & Documentation

  • Complete service documentation, including service worksheets, inspection reports, warranty claims, quality records, and timesheets using Cummins business systems.
  • Prepare technical summaries, service reports, and presentations for critical issue reviews and customer updates.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to track open service cases, parts availability, and project status to ensure effective service delivery.
  • Maintain accurate service history and documentation to support warranty administration, compliance, and future maintenance planning.

Health, Safety & Compliance

  • Demonstrate leadership in Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) practices by conducting job safety assessments (JSA) before commencing work and promoting a strong safety culture.
  • Ensure compliance with Cummins safety standards, environmental policies, regulatory requirements, and customer site procedures.
  • Report hazards, incidents, and unsafe conditions promptly while implementing appropriate corrective actions.
  • Maintain service vehicles, tools, diagnostic equipment, and work areas in a clean, safe, and operational condition.

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing recurring technical issues and recommending corrective actions.
  • Participate in technical training to maintain expertise in Cummins products, emerging technologies, and service practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve service quality, response times, and operational efficiency.
  • Contribute to project reviews and critical issue resolution activities by providing technical expertise and performance insights.

  • Customer Focus
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Develops Talent
  • Manages Complexity
  • Manages Conflict
  • Self-Development
  • Values Differences
  • Health and Safety Fundamentals
  • Diagnostics Application

  • Engine Systems Interactions
  • Product Repair and Maintenance
  • Service Documentation
  • Technical Escalation
  • Problem Solving
  • Technical Leadership
  • Collaboration
  • Continuous Improvement

Qualifications

  • Vocational Diploma, ITI, or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Automobile Engineering, Diesel Mechanics, or a related technical discipline.
  • Apprentice Trained Engine Technician certification preferred.
  • Valid local driving license required.
  • Additional certifications in diesel engine diagnostics, power generation, or heavy equipment service are advantageous.
  • May require licensing or eligibility to comply with export controls or sanctions regulations where applicable.

Skills

  • Advanced engine diagnostics and troubleshooting
  • Mechanical and electrical repair of diesel engines and power systems
  • Preventive maintenance and field service operations
  • Electronic diagnostic and service tool proficiency
  • Engine systems analysis and fault isolation
  • Technical documentation and warranty administration
  • Customer relationship management

job.title: IAM Operations Manager
job.description:
Job Summary

Responsible for leading the organization’s cybersecurity operations team, with a primary focus on incident response, threat monitoring, and the execution of cybersecurity strategies, policies, and risk management practices to safeguard the organization’s systems, data, and infrastructure. The manager serves as a coach and mentor to security professionals, builds operational processes aligned with best practices and industry standards, and partners with engineering, IT, and business to protect critical systems, infrastructure, and data from evolving threats. Serves as an accountable leader for the people, processes, and technologies that prevent, detect, investigate, and contain cyber threats across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments. Owns SecOps outcomes (24×7 monitoring & incident response), the detection engineering program (use-case lifecycle, signal quality, automation), and the threat hunting program

Key Responsibilities

Leads the execution of complex responses to computer security incidents in alignment with organizational policies and industry best practices. Coordinates and communicates with multiple business units during incidents, providing updates and actionable recommendations. Oversees root cause analysis and ensures that lessons learned are integrated into improved processes and protections. Leads teams in assessing severity, developing mitigation strategies, and prioritizing risk reduction activities. Monitors security-related intelligence sources (e.g., SANS, BugTraq) to maintain situational awareness of current attacks and trends. Collaborates with Cybersecurity Engineering teams and business to communicate risks and recommend security enhancements. Ensures that security technologies employed by the operations and incident response teams support and enhance operational processes. Identifies opportunities to improve operational efficiency, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks. Leads the application of recognized cybersecurity and IT frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO, ITIL, COBIT) in alignment with organizational processes and controls. Manages, coaches, and mentors cybersecurity operations staff, fostering a culture of learning, accountability, and continuous improvement. Defines team objectives, evaluates performance, and supports professional growth through training and development. Participates in industry task forces and working groups to stay informed on evolving threats and best practices, and fosters a culture of continuous improvement in cybersecurity practices and awareness. Contributes to organizational situational awareness by managing and leveraging cybersecurity data sources.

  • Competencies: Process Management and Optimization - Designs, refines, and automates IT operations processes to improve efficiency, consistency, service quality, security, and cost effectiveness across diverse environments.
  • Service Quality and Reliability - Ensures IT services consistently meet performance, availability, and user satisfaction expectations by proactively maintaining service integrity, minimizing disruptions, and driving continuous improvement through collaboration, cost-effective practices, and operational excellence.
  • Risk Management - Proactively identifies, assesses, and mitigates risks to IT services, data, and operations by applying structured controls and communication strategies to strengthen resilience, ensure compliance, and reduce business impact through structured controls, cost-aware decision-making, and communication strategies.
  • Incident and Problem Management - Responds to disruptions and recurring issues by restoring service quickly, identifying root causes, and applying structured methods to reduce risk, improve reliability, and prevent recurrence.
  • Standardization and Documentation - Creates and maintains clear, accessible documentation and standardized procedures to ensure consistent practices, traceability, and knowledge sharing across IT environments.
  • Technical Passion and Drive - Models curiosity and excitement for technology by self-initiating continuous development, experimenting with emerging technologies, and identifying insertion opportunities that accelerate business performance.
  • Security and Compliance - Applies standards, tools, and best practices to embed security, privacy, and compliance into the design/build/test/operate lifecycle for products, services, apps, systems, software, and configurations—balancing protection, efficiency, and cost.
  • Driving Effective Outcomes - Takes ownership, acts with urgency, and initiates action to turn goals into clear plans, decisions, guardrails, and cadences while navigating ambiguity and change to drive momentum and deliver consistent results.
  • Engaging with Impact - Communicates with clarity and purpose to align stakeholders, foster collaboration, build trust, and influence coordinated action across teams and functions to accelerate outcomes.
  • Values Differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  • Ensuring Customer Success - Embraces a customer-first mindset to deliver outcomes by linking customer needs and business priorities to aligned solutions, delivery, adoption, satisfaction, and realized value through sustained engagement that builds partnership and trust.
  • Managing People and Teams - Builds inclusive teams that empower ownership, deepen capabilities, and ensure fair, timely performance accountability, creating an environment where people can deliver their best work and top performance.
  • Directs Work - Creates conditions for team success with clear goals, priorities, work plans, standards, effective processes, resourcing, and governance to enable fast, empowered, accountable, and quality execution.

Education, Licenses, Certifications: College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) Security Essentials Certification, GIAC Security Leadership Certification, Information Systems Audit and Control Association (ISACA) Certified Information Security Manager, Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer: Security, or Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) certification preferred. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations. Experience: Understanding of the capabilities and configuration of industrial cybersecurity controls and solutions across multiple facets; for example: asset management, vulnerability management, anomaly detection, identity and access management, network security, endpoint security, application security, IDS/IPS, deep packet inspection, SIEM, data analytics, security and/or risk management and product development.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage budgets, and build organizational capability.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence policy and advocate for cybersecurity best practices.
  • Proven experience in cybersecurity management or equivalent leadership role.

Primary Function : The IAM Operations Manager is responsible for leading the organization’s IAM operations team across all IAM functions, with a primary focus on incident and problem response, general administration, monitoring, system availability, and compliance tasks. This role will also be responsible for execution of IAM strategies, policies, and risk management practices to safeguard the organization’s systems, data, and infrastructure. Key duties include managing team workflows, enforcing service-level agreements, and running security tools like Saviynt, MS Entra, CyberArk etc.

Core Responsibilities

  • Manage ongoing IAM operations and lead internal and multiple supplier teams in assessing severity, developing mitigation strategies, and prioritizing risk reduction activities
  • Oversee maintenance and specific problem resolution. Anticipate, identify, track and resolve technical issues. Oversee delivery assurance, quality, and architectural governance
  • Coordinate and communicate with multiple business units and various stakeholders at all levels during incidents. Provide updates and actionable recommendations
  • Oversee root cause analysis and ensure that lessons learned are integrated into improved processes and protection
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks. Create and maintain clear, accessible documentation and standardized procedures to ensure consistent practices, traceability, and knowledge sharing across IAM functions
  • Establish policies for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), and Access Management (AM).
  • Integrate IAM solutions with enterprise applications, cloud platforms, and hybrid IT infrastructures
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and business leaders to translate identity requirements into scalable, compliant solutions that are clearly understood
  • Work across functions to improve IAM solutions to enhance compliance requirements and best practices
  • Manage, coach, and mentor IAM operations staff, fostering a culture of learning, accountability, and continuous improvement
  • Define team objectives, evaluate performance, and support professional growth through training and development

Identifies additional sales and service opportunities with customer. Completes training in line with skill and business requirements. Maintains service vehicle and tools for cleanliness and proper operation. Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to site management and to their supervisor.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

Customer service experience

Strong knowledge on Cummins service SDP process and able to demonstrate through Optimus.

  • Product Problem Solving : Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

In-depth understanding of thermodynamics, combustion, air–fuel management, and gas engine operation. Knowledge of engine fuel systems, ignition systems, air–fuel mixers, regulators, valves, turbochargers, aftercoolers, and exhaust systems. Expertise in genset controllers and control systems (Power Command, Woodward, Deep Sea, ECU mapping and calibration).Strong understanding of mechanical systems including valve settings, cylinder heads, pistons, liners, compression ratios, and lubrication systems.

job.description:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Do you have the business savvy and the technical background necessary to help establish Amazon as a key technology platform provider? Amazon Web Services India Pvt Ltd is leading the next paradigm shift in computing and is looking for world-class candidates to join our–FSI Fintech business.

As a Fintech Account Leader for AWS India, your responsibilities will include building and driving the strategy to increase adoption, and market penetration in large Fintech accounts to build long-term business and marketing opportunities. The ideal candidate will possess a business development/sales background that enables them to engage at all levels of a customer and partner organization, including C-levels of the business and Tech. You should be a self-starter who is prepared to develop and execute against a coverage plan business objectives. This is a high visibility role needing to engage CXOs of Fintechs as well as leverage internal executives to drive transformational outcomes for large Fintechs in the long term.

Key job responsibilities

  • Develop long-term strategic relationships with the C-levels of Business & Tech for the given Accounts.
  • Work closely with the Channels team to ensure that AWS India is the partner's preferred cloud computing platform across all service lines.
  • Maintain an accurate forecast and various business reports.
  • Create & articulate compelling value propositions around AWS Cloud Offerings and AI offerings
  • Possess the technical ability to explain (not implement) Cloud Computing, GenAI and Agentic AI, Infrastructure solutions (Server, Storage, DC Services) & Internet architectures (firewalls, load balancers, etc)
  • Prepare and give business reviews to the senior management team.
  • Ensure customer satisfaction

A day in the life Research on the FSI Fintech domain and preparation for the day’s customers meetings and calls. Collaborate with Cross functional teams on pitches and solution demos for,

Customer meeting(s) and customer cadence calls Stakeholder mapping Ensure high standards and maintain SFDC hygiene Ensure timely communication with External and Internal stakeholders

About the team This team is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from enterprise-level FSI customers. The team interacts with leading FSI and Fintech companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. job.title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, Just Walk Out Technology , Physical Store 3P (Just Walk Out Technology)
job.description:
As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Are you interested in re-inventing the physical store Experience? Just Walk Out (JWO) enables shopping in retail stores with no lines and no checkout. You simply use a credit card to enter the store, take what you want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grab and go essentials, and leave the store. This checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by the Just Walk Out (JWO) Technology, which automatically detects whether products are taken or returned, and enables shoppers to grab and go from stores ranging from stadiums, small airport kiosks to massive university stores.

The Senior Product Manager will be responsible for working with software, design, operations, and other teams to expand the magic of JWO technology to a wide array of new selection offered in Amazon's physical stores. You will need to be equally at home understanding and championing the needs of your customers as you are with diving deep on the technology and operational implications of the products you build. You must have a strong track record of successfully launching products.

As a tenured Product Manager, you are familiar with the product development lifecycle. You exhibit high proficiency and efficacy in core product management disciplines such as defining user stories, priorities, success metrics, presenting vision that works backwards from customers, and are comfortable driving clarity across multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment. A successful candidate will combine an ability to Think Big with keen attention to detail. We are looking for a passionate, data-driven decision maker who likes building from scratch, experimenting, and setting high standards. You have a high degree of ownership, and are an excellent written and verbal communicator, who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment.

Key job responsibilities

  • Define and evangelize the long-term vision for launch tools and associated platform, developing strategic roadmaps that align with Just Walk Out's broader business strategy and market opportunities
  • Own and drive the launch application platform strategy across internal and external customers, including platform architecture decisions that enable scalability, extensibility, and future innovation
  • Define and execute platform adoption strategy, including onboarding processes, system integration patterns, and data sharing capabilities to enable multi-location retailers
  • Drive authentication and security strategy, including federated login systems, account management, and compliance standards in partnership with security teams
  • Partner with engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable platform services while making technical decisions that balance merchant needs, engineering constraints, and business goals
  • Build and maintain relationships with key merchant stakeholders and cross-functional teams to understand requirements, gather feedback, and ensure platform capabilities meet current and future needs
  • Define and track key platform metrics including adoption, usage, and merchant satisfaction to drive continuous improvement and inform product decisions

A day in the life Inclusive Team Culture Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work/Life Balance Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign opportunities based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded contributor.

About the team Just Walk Out (JWO) enables shopping in retail stores with no lines and no checkout. You simply use a credit card to enter the store, take what you want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grab and go essentials, and leave the store. This checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by the Just Walk Out (JWO) Technology, which automatically detects whether products are taken or returned, and enables shoppers to grab and go from stores ranging from stadiums, small airport kiosks to massive university stores.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
  • Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
  • Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
  • Experience managing technical products or online services
  • Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
  • 6+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
  • Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

job.title: Manager I, Data Center Operations, SIN InfraOps
job.description:
Are you ready to lead a team that keeps the backbone of cloud computing running? Amazon is looking for a motivated and collaborative Manager I, Data Center Operations to oversee daily operations within one of our data center facilities. In this role, you will directly manage a team of technicians, guiding them through structured workflows while ensuring operational excellence and service reliability. You will play a key part in maintaining the high standards our customers depend on, while growing your own leadership skills in a fast-paced, mission-critical environment. If you are a hands-on leader who thrives on solving problems, developing people, and driving results, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities -Management of the team of Data Center Technicians; this includes all aspect of people/performance/rotation management.

  • Ensuring effective and efficient management of day to day 24x7 Datacenter Operations.
  • Manage/Improve the workflows and throughput for data Centers Operations.
  • Become a subject master in Data Center Operations.
  • Ensure all operational KPIs and Metrics are being measured and met inside his/her Data Centers(s).
  • Play a key part in innovation and driving automation within Data Center Operations.
  • Be passionate about the quality and quantity of services being provided by the Data Center Operations team and continuously strive to improve our Customer Experience.
  • Management of large scale events in the Datacenter(s).
  • Part of an on-call rotation for Datacenter Issue escalations.
  • Vendor management/monitoring vendor performance.
  • Ensuring his/her Data Center is compliant with all relevant security policies and procedures.

A day in the life You will start your day reviewing operational dashboards and work queues to prioritize tasks for your team. Throughout your shift, you will walk the data center floor, checking in with technicians, troubleshooting equipment issues, and ensuring maintenance activities stay on track. You will hold team huddles to share updates, recognize achievements, and address any blockers. Between floor time, you will conduct one-on-one meetings focused on coaching, performance feedback, and development planning. You will also collaborate with peer managers and stakeholders to align on priorities and share lessons learned.

About the team Our Data Center Operations team is responsible for keeping Amazon's infrastructure reliable, secure, and available around the clock. We operate in a collaborative environment where every team member's contributions directly impact the services millions of customers rely on. We are focused on continuous improvement and building an inclusive culture where new ideas are welcomed. As we continue to grow, this is an exciting time to join a team that values both operational rigor and the professional development of its people.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of direct people management, including performance management and employee development experience
  • 3+ years of project management, including resource planning, managing schedules, reporting project status and prioritizing tasks experience
  • Experience in Linux OS and network troubleshooting, or experience deploying, managing, and optimizing Microsoft Windows Server and experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
  • Experience in Incident Management, Threat Management, Corporate Investigations, Law Enforcement, Security Operations, Crisis Management or a related field
  • Experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service, or experience in web security and experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of work in large-scale networking environments experience
  • Experience in networking, storage systems, operating systems and hands-on systems engineering
  • industry standard certification (CompTIA, CCENT, or Network+), or experience working in a colocation data center facility

As a Retail Consultant, you will provide frontline support by assisting customers with product selection, service activation, and troubleshooting basic issues. You will create positive experiences through effective communication and adherence to retail standards. This role demonstrates foundational autonomy and contributes to customer satisfaction and store performance.

Job Description

Ready to Make a Difference? Join Our Iconic Team at Telstra!

At Telstra, we’re more than just a leading telecommunications company—we’re where passion meets purpose. As a Retail Customer Service & Sales Consultant, you’ll have the opportunity to work for an iconic Aussie brand that’s been connecting Australians for generations. You won’t just be a friendly face in-store—you’ll be the trusted expert who helps customers find tech solutions that enhance their lives. This is your chance to make a meaningful impact by bringing our purpose to life: to build a connected future so everyone can thrive.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Deliver Exceptional Customer Experiences: Help customers find the right products and services to suit their needs, ensuring their time at Telstra is a memorable one.
  • Be the Go-To Tech Expert: Stay up-to-date with the latest gadgets and services, offering informed guidance and solutions.
  • Achieve and Excel: Use your consultative selling skills to meet and exceed sales targets and KPIs, while keeping customers connected.
  • Collaborate and Contribute: Work closely with your team to create a welcoming environment where everyone is supported to achieve store goals.

Salary and Benefits:

  • Hourly Rate: $33.33 per hour

*Junior rates apply for those under 20 years of age.

*Penalty rates are as follows: Additional 25% for weekday hours worked after 6 PM, 25% for hours worked on Saturday, 100% for hours worked on Sunday and 150% for hours worked on public holidays.

  • Plus 12% Superannuation
  • Generous Discounts: Enjoy 30% off Telstra services and exclusive offers with over 240 brands and partners.
  • Leave Options: Take advantage of 16 weeks of paid parental leave, the Telstra Extra Day Off, gender affirmation leave, Cultural Leave, Blood Donor Leave, and the ability to purchase up to 4 weeks of additional leave.
  • Training & Career Growth Opportunities: Access over 17,000 learning programs through LinkedIn Learning and take advantage of a range of development opportunities designed to build your skills and support your career growth, helping you prepare for your next step.
  • Flexibility: We offer flexible working hours and a supportive approach to parental leave—do it your way!
  • Recognition & Rewards: Benefit from performance rewards and a range of recognition programs to celebrate your success.
  • Inclusive Culture: Join a diverse and inclusive team where everyone’s unique perspective is valued and respected.

Is It You We’re Looking For?

  • Great Communication Skills: You’re a natural at connecting with people and making their day better.
  • Solution-Oriented Approach: You enjoy thinking on your feet and tailoring solutions for each customer.
  • Sales Drive: You’re motivated to achieve (and exceed!) sales targets and KPIs.
  • Passion for Learning: You’re eager to grow and develop your skills in a dynamic environment.
  • Resilience and Positivity: You have a can-do attitude, even when things get busy.

Job Summary

As a Senior Software Engineer, you thrive on understanding and translating customer needs into new products and capability. You apply deep technical expertise and experience in software application layer solutions, to develop and deliver scalable design blueprints across the end-to-end software development life cycle. Your continuous learning and improvement mindset, collaboration and influencing skills are critical to success in this role.

Job Description

Who We Are

We're an iconic Aussie brand with a global footprint. Our purpose is to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. We're all about providing the best experience and delivering the best tech on the best network.

This includes making Telstra the place you want to work. For you, that means a having career that grows with you and working with a team powered by human connection that prioritises wellbeing and choice.

What We Offer

  • Access to thousands of learning programs so you can level-up
  • Global presence across 22 countries; opportunities to work where we do business.
  • Purchased annual leave scheme
  • Additional Telstra day off
  • Additional 30% off Telstra products and services
  • Toolkit provided (laptop + mobile phone + plan paid for)

What You’ll Do

Product & Technology - Software Engineering & IT develops and maintains Telstra's software and IT systems, working on some really cutting-edge technologies.

As the Senior Software Engineer, you will use your advanced software engineering knowledge to deliver complex application capabilities and improve the health of Telstra's many digital assets. You will translate customer and business needs into maintainable technical solutions, contributes to architectural decisions, champion quality and security, and supports software across the full development lifecycle. Working in a team that works directly on the Telstra Self Service App and many other B2B customer applications, you will identify areas of improvement while being forward thinking demonstrating your ability to identify improvement areas and facilitate solutions.

Responsibilities include:

  • Design, build and maintain scalable backend services, APIs and event-driven solutions using modern engineering practices and Domain-Driven Design principles.
  • Deliver secure, reliable and high-quality software through automated testing, CI/CD, observability and performance-focused engineering standards.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex production, integration and performance issues using logging, tracing, metrics and debugging tools.
  • Own solutions end-to-end, from technical design and development through to deployment, production support and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Security and Platform teams to deliver business outcomes and influence technical direction.
  • Provide technical leadership through mentoring, stakeholder engagement, knowledge sharing and driving engineering excellence across teams.

About You

You have strong Full-Stack Software development technology experience with a priority focus on Backend delivery. Combined with excellent stakeholder management, engagement and presentation skills, you thrive in a role that is autonomous yet collaborative while working in an Agile team embedded in CI/CD best practice. You understand customer needs and use this knowledge to advise development teams and product Managers on best engineering solutions in line with Tech capabilities and ability to manage multiple sprint priorities as required.

Essential Skills ant Technologies:

  • Advanced backend engineering expertise across Java, Kotlin, Node.js, REST APIs, microservices and Domain-Driven Design, with the ability to build scalable, resilient and high-performing solutions.
  • Strong experience designing cloud-native architectures using AWS, Azure, Docker and Kubernetes, with end-to-end ownership of services in production environments.
  • Deep knowledge of event-driven architecture, including Kafka, Redis Streams, enterprise messaging patterns and asynchronous processing at scale.
  • Secure, reliable and quality-focused delivery through automated testing, CI/CD, observability, performance tuning and modern software engineering practices.
  • Proven use of AI-assisted engineering tools, including GitHub Copilot, to accelerate development while maintaining strong security, governance and engineering standards.
  • Technical leadership, sound engineering judgement and strong communication skills, with experience mentoring engineers, influencing stakeholders and driving continuous improvement across teams.

Nice to have

  • Cloud, security, API, AI or Agile certifications with a commitment to continuous learning.
  • Experience developing frontend applications using React.js or similar frameworks
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless platforms, modern backend frameworks and enterprise API management tools.
  • Strong understanding of AI model selection, token optimisation and cost-effective AI solution design.
  • Experience building AI agents, leveraging GitHub Copilot and applying emerging AI technologies, including RAG and agentic patterns.

Job Title

Telstra Retail: Full Time Customer Service & Sales Consultant MODBURY

Job Summary

As a Retail Consultant, you will provide frontline support by assisting customers with product selection, service activation, and troubleshooting basic issues. You will create positive experiences through effective communication and adherence to retail standards. This role demonstrates foundational autonomy and contributes to customer satisfaction and store performance.

Job Description

Ready to Make a Difference? Join Our Iconic Team at Telstra!

At Telstra, we’re more than just a leading telecommunications company—we’re where passion meets purpose. As a Retail Customer Service & Sales Consultant, you’ll have the opportunity to work for an iconic Aussie brand that’s been connecting Australians for generations. You won’t just be a friendly face in-store—you’ll be the trusted expert who helps customers find tech solutions that enhance their lives. This is your chance to make a meaningful impact by bringing our purpose to life: to build a connected future so everyone can thrive.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Deliver Exceptional Customer Experiences: Help customers find the right products and services to suit their needs, ensuring their time at Telstra is a memorable one.
  • Be the Go-To Tech Expert: Stay up-to-date with the latest gadgets and services, offering informed guidance and solutions.
  • Achieve and Excel: Use your consultative selling skills to meet and exceed sales targets and KPIs, while keeping customers connected.
  • Collaborate and Contribute: Work closely with your team to create a welcoming environment where everyone is supported to achieve store goals.

Salary and Benefits:

  • Annual Fixed Remuneration: $71,330 per year*

*Junior Rates apply for those under 20 years of age.

Penalty rates are as follows: Additional 25% for weekday hours worked after 6 PM, 25% for hours worked on Saturday, 100% for hours worked on Sunday and 150% for hours worked on public holidays.12% superannuation included

  • Plus 12% Superannuation
  • Generous Discounts: Enjoy 30% off Telstra services and exclusive offers with over 240 brands and partners.
  • Leave Options: Take advantage of 16 weeks of paid parental leave, the Telstra Extra Day Off, gender affirmation leave, Cultural Leave, Blood Donor Leave, and the ability to purchase up to 4 weeks of additional leave.
  • Training & Career Growth Opportunities: Access over 17,000 learning programs through LinkedIn Learning and take advantage of a range of development opportunities designed to build your skills and support your career growth, helping you prepare for your next step.
  • Flexibility: We offer flexible working hours and a supportive approach to parental leave—do it your way!
  • Recognition & Rewards: Benefit from performance rewards and a range of recognition programs to celebrate your success.
  • Inclusive Culture: Join a diverse and inclusive team where everyone’s unique perspective is valued and respected.

Is it You We’re Looking For?

  • Great Communication Skills: You’re a natural at connecting with people and making their day better.
  • Solution-Oriented Approach: You enjoy thinking on your feet and tailoring solutions for each customer.
  • Sales Drive: You’re motivated to achieve (and exceed!) sales targets and KPIs.
  • Passion for Learning: You’re eager to grow and develop your skills in a dynamic environment.
  • Resilience and Positivity: You have a can-do attitude, even when things get busy.

You’ll build trusted relationships, uncover new opportunities and lead strategic sales conversations that help customers modernise and transform their network environments. job.title: Field Installer Repairer - AU Nationwide
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

29 Oct 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Field Installer Repairer - AU Nationwide

Job Summary

Job Description

Seeking expressions of interest for skilled candidates Australia wide.

We’re seeking expressions of interest from skilled technicians across Australia for Field Service opportunities available nationally. If you’re looking for meaningful work in the field, with the support, tools and training to grow your career, we’d like to hear from you.

About the role

As a Field Service Technician, you will work without immediate supervision or direction to provide our customers with a great experience by activating and assuring telecommunications / technology products and services, in the home and/or business.

You will actively participate in a diverse team environment to deliver the optimum customer and commercial outcomes aligned to the corporate strategy.

We have several positions available around the country. The expectation is to reside in the targeted area or be willing to relocate.

What you’ll do on the job:

  • Deliver seamless fault rectification, service assurance and product installations to meet customer needs.
  • Install, maintain and troubleshoot telecommunications infrastructure across fibre, copper and emerging network technologies.
  • Support fibre networks, core telecommunications platforms and data connectivity services.
  • Install and maintain customer-premises technology solutions for residential and business customers.
  • Diagnose and resolve service faults across fixed access networks, with a primary focus on fibre and digital technologies.
  • Perform network commissioning, restoration and maintenance activities in urban, regional and remote environments.

**

About you

To be successful in this role, you will be required to hold and maintain the relevant and applicable licenses and qualifications, as deemed mandatory by regulatory and legal authorities and must also maintain a current driver’s license.

  • Open cabling license with relevant endorsements
  • An industry white card
  • Traffic management qualifications (desirable)
  • Working With Children Check (willing to obtain)

Telstra can support you through offering training on Traffic management, Working With Children Check and white card certificates. Successful applicants will be required to obtain and maintain a valid Working With Children Check (WWCC).

**

What We Offer

  • Everything from head to toe. From the vehicle, tools, and equipment through to the full uniform, we provide it all.
  • Pay for performance. We recognise outstanding contributions through our competitive incentive programs.
  • 8-hour shifts, Mon-Fri. Overtime when required.
  • Parental Leave. A gender-equal policy for all parent/s so you can choose how and when you take your leave (16 weeks full pay or 32 weeks half pay). Receive superannuation contributions on paid and unpaid parental leave.
  • Industry recognised training & unlimited learning. Unlimited access to 17000 learning programs – something for everyone!
  • Extra perks. Receive 30% off Telstra products and services, plus unlock exclusive discounts from over 240 brands and partners.
  • Plus so much more!

A bit about us

We’re an iconic Aussie brand with a global footprint, driven by a purpose to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. With world-class tech, the best network, and a focus on experience, Telstra is where you can Define Your Possible - because we’re as committed to our people as we are to our customers.

What’s next?

When you’re ready to define your possible, all you need to do next is submit your expression of interest application. Once completed you’ll be considered for relevant roles based on your location and experience.

  • If you successfully match for an opportunity, you’ll hear from one of our recruiters to find out a bit more about you.
  • If you’re a match, we’ll invite you to an interview with the recruiter and hiring manager, this is your chance to bring your perspective and showcase your skills.

If you’re looking for a place to grow, feel supported and do your best work, Telstra is where you can define what’s next. With opportunities to stretch your skills, bring your perspective and thrive with flexibility, this is your chance to make a real impact. You don’t need to tick every box to apply. If you're excited by the opportunity, we encourage you to put yourself forward.

**

When you join our team, you become part of a welcoming and inclusive community where everyone is respected, valued and celebrated. We strongly encourage First Nations peoples, people with disability, and individuals of all genders, backgrounds and ethnicities to apply. Your unique perspectives and lived experiences are important to us and help shape the meaningful work we do. When you apply, you can share your pronouns and / or any reasonable adjustments needed to take part equitably during the recruitment process.

If this opportunity sounds like a perfect fit for you, we'd encourage you to apply!

job.title: Technical Analyst
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

26 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Technical Analyst

Job Summary

As a Technical Analyst, you will work with pioneering, cutting edge technologies and enjoy working in a fast-paced, agile and collaborative environment.

Your role will involve providing high-level technical service and assisting in the development of solutions and support to the networks, infrastructure, products and services supplied and operated by Telstra.

You will be given a high degree of autonomy and have the opportunity to work on initiatives to improve the performance and integration of systems, making a positive impact on customer experience.

Job Description

Who We Are

We're an iconic Aussie brand with a global footprint. Our purpose is to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. We're all about providing the best experience and delivering the best tech on the best network.

This includes making Telstra the place you want to work. For you, that means a having career that grows with you and working with a team powered by human connection that prioritises wellbeing and choice.

Focus of the role

The Technical Expert will be responsible for the operation, maintenance, and ongoing support of Telstra’s PSTN and Access Networks. The role will provide specialist technical support for complex network faults, particularly across Ericsson AXE and associated access technologies, while driving incidents through to resolution within agreed service levels.

The role operates primarily during business hours, with after-hours recall support when required, and contributes to service improvement, network integrity, and customer experience.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Monitor, investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex faults across PSTN and Access Network platforms.
  • Apply structured incident management practices to restore services within agreed KPIs, OLAs, and service levels.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of network incidents and drive them through to resolution.
  • Coordinate multiple incidents across different severity levels in a high-pressure, real-time operational environment.
  • Perform jeopardy management by identifying risks to incident resolution and engaging relevant stakeholders.
  • Work closely with Level 3 support, DevOps, Engineering, Major Incident Management, vendor management, and other specialist teams.
  • Provide specialist technical input into post-incident investigations and service improvement activities.
  • Analyse KPI and OLA performance and contribute to operational reporting.
  • Identify technical or process deficiencies and develop appropriate resolution or improvement strategies.
  • Develop and maintain technical, operational, and administrative network documentation.
  • Mentor team members and support the development of their technical and leadership capabilities.
  • Maintain a strong focus on customer experience, network integrity, safety, compliance, and respectful workplace practices.

Essential Skills

  • Hands-on experience supporting Ericsson AXE PSTN Networks.
  • Detailed understanding of PSTN networks, platforms, access technologies, systems, and operational support tools.
  • Strong knowledge of ITIL practices, particularly Incident Management.
  • Experience using network monitoring, fault investigation, and troubleshooting tools.
  • Ability to investigate and resolve complex network incidents within operational service levels.
  • Strong incident coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple incidents across varying severity levels.

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there..

  • Electrical or Electronic Engineering qualification
  • Sound knowledge of industrial control systems
  • Generation (hydro, thermal, geothermal), oil & gas downstream processing, pulp & paper industries are an advantage.

  • Sound implementation and maintenance knowledge of Virtual Server environment; including VMWare and ESXi are an advantage.
  • Experience with fieldbus communication protocols, such as: ProfiBus, ModBusTCP/IP, and ModbusRTU.
  • Experience with OPC SMNP
  • Tertiary qualification in Electrical Engineering; within an interest in instrumentation, control engineering, or software programming.
  • Advanced computer skills including MS Office & MS Project, Outlook, AutoCAD..

ABB's Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. job.title: Head of Engineering - Data Centres
job.description:
As Australia's digital economy continues to accelerate, Siemens is playing a critical role in enabling the next generation of data centre infrastructure. Through our Electrification & Automation business, we deliver innovative power distribution, automation, digitalisation and energy solutions that help hyperscale, colocation and enterprise customers build resilient, sustainable and high-performing facilities.

Siemens are looking for a highly experienced Head of Engineering to lead the technical direction and engineering excellence of our Data Centre business across Australia. Sitting within Siemens' Electrification & Automation business, you'll own the integrity of integrated power solutions spanning Power Train Units (PTUs), Low Voltage (LV) and Medium Voltage (MV) switchgear, and Busway systems — ensuring these systems are engineered, integrated and delivered to the standards mission-critical infrastructure demands. This is not a single-product specialist role — it's a leadership position for someone who can see across the full system and take ownership of how it all comes together. The successful candidate will be responsible for:

Key responsibilities

  • Leading and growing a multidisciplinary engineering team, building capability across MV, LV, PTU, and Busway design disciplines to support Australia's rapidly growing data centre pipeline
  • Acting as the technical authority for integrated power solutions, with particular focus on protection, control & automation (PC&A) — including relay protection schemes, interlocking, and SCADA/EPMS integration
  • Reviewing, supervising, and formally approving engineering design documentation — single line diagrams, protection studies, relay setting reports, and general arrangement drawings — under Registered Engineer authority
  • Leading development of productised, standardised, and scalable design solutions for data centre applications to reduce engineering lead time and improve delivery consistency
  • Engaging directly with consulting engineers and design houses to influence and support specification of Siemens equipment and solutions ahead of tender
  • Partnering with tendering, delivery, and solution architecture teams to embed engineering expertise across every stage of the project and bid lifecycle
  • Championing a zero-harm safety culture and ensuring full compliance with Siemens and Australian regulatory standards, including AS/NZS 61439, AS/NZS 3000 and relevant IEC standards

You'll have proven experience in engineering leadership within the data centre, utilities, or mission-critical infrastructure sector, with deep technical grounding in MV/LV electrical systems, PTUs, switchgear, protection, and control. You hold Registered Engineer status (CPEng/NER or equivalent state registration), enabling you to take formal design authority and sign-off responsibility. You're experienced translating complex system integration requirements into clear engineering direction, and you understand how to balance rigorous technical governance with the pace of a fast-growing business. A tertiary qualification in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline is required.

You take ownership of engineering quality and integration risk across every phase of the project lifecycle, and you thrive on solving problems that sit at the boundary between disciplines rather than within a single one. You bring teams together, mentor emerging engineers, and communicate technical concepts with confidence to commercial, delivery, and customer audiences alike. You hold yourself to uncompromising standards in safety, design integrity, and engineering excellence.

A strong network across the Australian data centre ecosystem — including consulting engineers, design houses, hyperscale providers, and Tier 1 contractors — will be a significant advantage in this role.

Siemens are committed to ensuring our workplace reflects the communities in which we operate, that everyone has access to the same opportunities and is treated fairly, and that we actively empower the voices of every individual voice.

We strive to provide a safe working environment for each member of our diverse team and commit to continuously develop our ways of working on this journey. From our Innovate Reconciliation Action Plan to our diverse cultural celebrations, LGBTQIA+ education and support to our gender equity initiatives, we strive to make our workplace an inclusive environment where every individual feels empowered and heard. You can learn more about Siemens' commitment to diversity and sustainability in Australia and New Zealand here.

job.title: Senior Network Developer
job.description:
Job Description

The AI2NO Org strives to be global leaders in the RDMA cluster networking domain and enable seamless, accelerated High-Performance Compute (HPC), Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning advancements. We envision a future where artificial intelligence and machine learning revolutionize industries, reshape societies, and unlock limitless possibilities. Our vision is to be a pioneering force, driving the development and design of state-of-the-art RDMA clusters tailored specifically for AI, ML, HPC workloads. We strive to be the go-to experts in RDMA cluster architecture, leveraging our deep understanding of the unique demands of AI/ML and HPC applications. By staying at the forefront of technological advancements, we aim to redefine the boundaries of what is possible, pushing the envelope of computational capabilities and unlocking unprecedented performance. Supports the design, deployment, and operations of a large-scale global Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Primarily focused on the development and support of network fabric and systems through a combination of a deep level understanding of networking at the protocol level coupled with programming skills. As OCI is a cloud-based network with a global footprint, this support will include hundreds of thousands of network devices supporting millions of servers, connected over a mix of dedicated backbone infrastructure, CLos Network, and the Internet.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with program/project managers to develop milestones and deliverables.
  • Will primarily use existing procedures and tools to develop and safely execute network change. However, may have to develop new procedures from time to time.
  • Develop solutions to enable front line support teams to act on network failure conditions.
  • Mentor junior engineers.
  • Participates in network solution and architecture design process and contribute to the roadmaps development.
  • Participate in operational rotations as either primary or secondary.
  • Provide break-fix support for events. Serve as the escalation point for event remediation. Lead post-event root cause analysis.
  • Frequently develops scripts to automate routine tasks for team and business units.
  • Coordinate with networking automation services for the development and integration of support tooling.
  • Coordinate with network monitoring to gather telemetry and create alerts rules using them.
  • Build dashboards to represent data at various network layers and device roles that help identify network issues, anomalies.
  • Serves as SME on software development projects for network automation and network monitoring.
  • Collaborate with network vendor technical account team and internal Quality Assurance team to drive bug resolution and assist in the qualification of new firmware and/or operating systems.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in CS or related engineering field with 5+ years of Network Engineering experience or master’s with 3+ years of Network Engineering experience.
  • Experience working in a large ISP or cloud provider environment. Experience in RDMA Networking is a plus.
  • Experience working in a network operations role.
  • Folks with strong knowledge of protocols such as MPLS, BGP/OSPF/IS-IS, TCP, IPv4, IPv6, DNS, and DHCP. Also, VxLAN and EVPN will be an added advantage.
  • Extensive experience with scripting or automation and data center design – Python preferred but must demonstrate expertise in scripting or compiled language.
  • Experience with networking protocols such as TCP/IP, VPN, DNS, DHCP, and SSL.
  • Experience with network monitoring and telemetry solutions.
  • Experience with network modeling and programming – YANG, OpenConfig, NETCONF.
  • Ability to use professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways. Capable of working under limited supervision.
  • Excellent organizational, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Excellent judgment in influencing product roadmap direction, features, and priorities.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation.

Required Skills

  • Border Gateway Protocol Routing
  • Data Center Operations
  • MPBGP
  • Network Automation
  • Network Routing
  • OSPF
  • Python
  • VXLAN-EVPN

job.description:
Job Description

Oracle is seeking an experienced Project Management Officer (PMO) to lead the planning, delivery and operational transition of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Region (OCIR) initiatives, supporting regulated, critical-infrastructure and government workloads in Singapore.

This role is suited to a highly organised project leader with experience delivering large-scale IT or cloud programmes in Secured or Military environments. You will work across technical, operational, business, and global teams to deliver secure, high-quality outcomes aligned with programme objectives

Responsibilities

Oracle is seeking an experienced Project Management Officer (PMO) to lead the planning, delivery and operational transition of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Region (OCIR) initiatives, supporting regulated, critical-infrastructure and government workloads in Singapore.

This role is suited to a highly organized project leader with experience delivering large-scale IT or cloud programs in Secured or Military environments. You will work across technical, operational, business, and global teams to deliver secure, high-quality outcomes aligned with program objectives.

Responsibilities

Project Planning and Delivery

  • Develop and execute end-to-end project plans for OCIR build, enhancement, and operational initiatives.
  • Define project scope, objectives, milestones, deliverables, resource requirements, and budgets with senior stakeholders.
  • Manage schedules, dependencies, priorities, and delivery risks to ensure projects are completed on time and to the required standard.
  • Coordinate developers, architects, security teams, IT operations, business teams, and external vendors.

Stakeholder Engagement and Reporting

  • Build strong relationships with key program stakeholders and gather requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Facilitate clear communication between technical teams, business units, senior management, and external partners.
  • Prepare and present regular project status reports, including progress, risks, issues, decisions, and financial updates.

Risk, Quality, and Governance

  • Identify project risks and issues early, develop mitigation plans, and drive timely resolution.
  • Ensure deliverables meet agreed quality, security, compliance, and governance requirements.
  • Conduct regular project reviews and audits to maintain alignment with scope, objectives, and Oracle best practices.

Operational Excellence

Team Leadership

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience delivering cloud infrastructure, platform, or operational projects; Oracle Cloud Infrastructure experience is strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex stakeholder groups, competing priorities, budgets, schedules, and dependencies.

  • Strong problem-solving ability, attention to detail, and confidence operating under pressure.

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all.
