job.title: Corporate Finance Manager
job.description:
About us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia’s leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities.

Headquartered in Canberra with multiple facilities in the ACT, NSW, VIC and New Zealand, including an expansion into WA, CDC’s diversified operations provide secure data centre configurations that support co-location, containerised and hyperscale compute environments with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team.

Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the Role

The corporate finance manager is responsible for providing financial and commercial leadership underpinning CDC's growth strategy. The role plays a significant role in assessing and executing new data centre developments, expansion into new markets and strategic growth initiatives. This role provides critical commercial insights and financial analysis that supports capital allocation, investment decisions and long-term value creation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead investment analysis and business case development for new data centre developments, expansions, and major capital projects, providing financial modelling, feasibility assessments, and recommendations to support investment decisions.
  • Drive strategic growth initiatives by evaluating mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, market expansion opportunities, and strategic partnerships through detailed financial analysis and commercial insights.
  • Own and maintain the corporate financial model, assessing business performance, growth opportunities, funding requirements, risks, and value drivers to support executive, Board, and shareholder decision-making.
  • Provide commercial and analytical support for customer contracting, energy infrastructure strategies, and major commercial negotiations, helping optimise business outcomes and shareholder value.
  • Support capital allocation and funding activities by partnering with Treasury to analyse cash flow, capital expenditure, financing requirements, and debt raising opportunities to ensure sustainable growth and capital management.

What’s in it for you

CDC offers the following to support your wellbeing, growth and success:

  • CDC Academy – Make your mark by enhancing your professional development through specialised learning and training
  • CDC Day – An additional paid day of leave dedicated to your health and wellbeing
  • Parental Leave – Inclusive and progressive parental leave to support your family at every stage
  • Volunteer Leave – Two paid days per year to support causes or charities that matter to you
  • Employee Assistance Program – Confidential support for you and your family
  • CDC Social Events – Inclusive events that bring our people and families together through BBQs, picnics and community activities

About You

Experience

  • 6-10 Years working in investment banking/M&A, funds management, corporate development/strategy, or corporate advisory
  • Experience within the infrastructure or energy sectors is highly beneficial.
  • Strong ability to develop, review and analyse fully integrated three-way financial models, with a deep understanding of the relationships between the income statement, balance sheet and cash flow statement.
  • Demonstrated experience of independently leading workstreams, managing stakeholders, and implementing commercial judgement in decision making.
  • Deeply curious, with a genuine desire to develop a deep understanding of CDC's business, with the ability to translate complex data and ambiguity into meaningful commercial insights.

Essential: Australian Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a NV1 Security Clearance.

How to Apply:

If you are excited by the opportunity to shape the future of People operations in a leading sovereign data centre organisation, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking here.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

job.title: Commercial Admin - Procurement & Cost Control
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital with investors including some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Digital Edge’s vision is to be the leading provider of sustainable, next generation digital infrastructure in Asia. Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering populations they serve.

Founded in 2020, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across Japan, South Korea, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia and China. The Company now owns and operates 21 data centers with over 500 MW of critical IT load in service and under construction and development, with another 300 MW held for future development,

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

Job Purpose

**

To provide administrative and operational support for procurement and cost control activities, ensuring that purchasing processes, commercial documentation, cost records, and reporting are properly maintained, accurate, and aligned with company policies and project requirements.

Key Responsibilities

**

  • Procurement Administration
  • Support the end-to-end procurement administration process, including purchase requisitions, requests for quotation, purchase orders, and related documentation.
  • Coordinate with internal departments and vendors to obtain quotations, supporting documents, and required information.
  • Maintain and update the vendor and procurement database.
  • Prepare and organize procurement documentation for proper record keeping and audit purposes.
  • Monitor the status of purchase requests and purchase orders to ensure timely processing.
  • Assist in comparing vendor quotations and preparing procurement summaries for review.
  • Follow up with vendors regarding order status, delivery schedules, and outstanding documentation.
  • Cost Control & Monitoring
  • Maintain accurate records of procurement costs, purchase orders, invoices, and other commercial transactions.
  • Monitor actual procurement expenditures against approved budgets and cost allocations.
  • Assist in preparing cost tracking reports and variance analysis.
  • Identify discrepancies between purchase orders, quotations, invoices, and approved budgets and escalate them to the relevant stakeholders.
  • Support periodic review of project or operational costs to ensure spending remains within approved limits.
  • Maintain updated cost control trackers and supporting documentation.
  • Commercial Administration
  • Prepare and maintain commercial documents, trackers, reports, and correspondence related to procurement and cost control activities.
  • Assist in monitoring contract, purchase order, and vendor documentation.
  • Ensure commercial records are complete, accurate, and properly filed.
  • Support the preparation of monthly or periodic commercial reports.
  • Coordinate with Finance, Procurement, Operations, and other relevant departments regarding purchasing and payment-related matters.
  • Assist in resolving administrative issues related to procurement documentation and vendor transactions.
  • Reporting & Data Management
  • Compile procurement and cost data for management reporting and decision-making.
  • Prepare regular reports covering procurement status, expenditure, outstanding purchase orders, and cost variances.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date spreadsheets, databases, and procurement trackers.
  • Ensure consistency and accuracy of data across procurement and cost control records.
  • Provide supporting data and documentation for internal and external audits when required.
  • Compliance & Process Support
  • Ensure procurement administration activities comply with company policies, procedures, approval matrices, and applicable requirements.
  • Support the implementation and improvement of procurement and cost control procedures.
  • Maintain proper documentation and audit trails for procurement and commercial activities.
  • Assist in identifying administrative or process gaps and recommend improvements where appropriate.

Requirements

**

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Accounting, Finance, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
  • 1–3 years of experience in commercial administration, procurement administration, cost control, purchasing, or a related role.
  • Good understanding of procurement processes, purchasing documentation, and basic cost control principles.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
  • Strong administrative, organizational, and documentation skills.
  • Detail-oriented with good numerical and analytical abilities.
  • Good communication and coordination skills.
  • Able to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and stakeholders effectively.
  • Experience in project-based, construction, engineering, infrastructure, or similar industries would be an advantage.

If you’re ready to help shape the next phase of a fast‑growing digital infrastructure platform, we’d like to hear from you.”

job.description:

  • To have good working knowledge of AI, in particular various LLM and A2A protocols.
  • To have the aptitude and attitude to continuously upgrade and refresh the knowledge in networking technologies.
  • Good inter-personal, organizational, problem solving and teamwork skills.
  • Proactive nature and ability to coordinate process designs across multiple groups

job.title: Lead AI Platform Engineer #AIDA

job.title: Lead Data Scientist #AIDA
job.description:
Role Summary

As a Lead Data Scientist within the AI & Data Analytics (AIDA) business unit, you will play a strategic and hands-on role in shaping advanced analytics and AI/ML capabilities that anticipate market shifts and their impact on Singtel’s business. You will help drive high-impact, data-informed decisions across the organization by uncovering deep customer insights, improving operational performance, and enabling new revenue opportunities.

In this role, you will lead and scale key AI initiatives that enhance the personalization and delivery of telco products and services. You will design and deploy predictive models across areas such as customer eligibility, purchase propensity, and cross-sell optimization. You will also partner closely with business stakeholders and external collaborators to architect and deliver end-to-end AI/ML solutions that translate data into measurable business value.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Lead and Scale Data Science Initiatives: Own and drive large-scale AI and ML programs that deliver measurable business impact for Singtel SG. Lead a team of data scientists to translate strategic priorities into actionable roadmaps, define high-value problem statements, and architect end-to-end solutions, including the use of Generative AI and LLMs where relevant. Ensure alignment with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and partner expectations while maintaining clear accountability for outcomes, timelines, and value realization.
  • Model Strategy, Development and Operationalization: Set the technical direction for model design, development, and productionization across customer journeys. Oversee the integration of models into decision engines and enterprise systems, ensuring robustness, scalability, explainability, and governance at scale. Establish best practices for model lifecycle management, monitoring, and continuous improvement while guiding the team to deliver production-ready solutions that meet enterprise standards.
  • Customer Behavior & Lifecycle Analysis: Leverage customer behavioral data across Singtel’s Mobile, Broadband, and entertainment services to uncover actionable insights related to life stage, affluence, and lifestyle preferences. Maintain and enhance analytical models that inform segmentation, product targeting, and value-based engagement strategies. Enable data exploration, insight discovery, and controlled experimentation (e.g., A/B testing, uplift modeling) to support lifecycle marketing and campaign optimization.
  • Data Exploration & Experimentation: Enable robust data exploration, insight discovery, and experimentation for lifecycle marketing campaigns. Devise and execute rigorous A/B tests, segmentations, and optimization strategies to continuously improve business outcomes.
  • Technical Leadership and Team Development: Provide strong technical leadership across the data science team. Mentor and coach team members to raise the bar on modeling depth, engineering rigor, and problem-solving capability. Establish high standards for code quality, reproducibility, documentation, and collaboration, while fostering knowledge sharing and professional growth.
  • Executive Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders. Communicate complex analytical concepts and business implications clearly and persuasively to technical and non-technical audiences. Influence strategic decisions through data-backed recommendations and ensure alignment between analytics initiatives and enterprise priorities.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor or Postgraduate degree in computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a related field, with at least 8 years of relevant working experience.
  • Deep technical and data science expertise, demonstrating proficiency in:
  • Machine Learning & Statistical Modelling: Including linear regression, GLMs, time series forecasting, supervised learning (e.g., gradient boosted trees, neural networks), segmentation, clustering, design of experiments, and causal inference.
  • LLMs & Generative AI: Fine-tuning and evaluation of large language models (e.g., GPT, LLaMA), prompt engineering, red-teaming, and performance monitoring
  • Efficient data manipulation (with skills in SQL, Python, Spark, Hadoop/Hive, and Databricks) and data visualization (using tools like Power BI).
  • Familiar with software engineering best practices, including modular code design, reproducibility, and testing. Proficient with version control tools such as GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., Azure AWS, GCP) and ML lifecycle tools (e.g., MLflow, Airflow)
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and solve complex business problems through data analysis.
  • A team player with a customer-focused mindset, able to work well in a team and passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences.
  • Excellent data visualization and communication skills, with the ability to present insights and findings in a clear, concise, and compelling manner, both in written and verbal form.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

**

The role reports into the Senior Director – Group Strategy, Engineering, and Innovation (GSEI) / Network Services Development (NSD). It plays a pivotal role in shaping Singtel Group’s AI-driven network, Autonomous Networks (AN), OSS and CPaaS architecture strategy.

The role defines and governs the Group Network AI and AN architecture, framework, and roadmap, while guiding OpCos on AI/AN use cases and aligning OpCo roadmaps with Group strategy and AN maturity targets.

The role focuses on enabling the transition from traditional network operations to AI-enabled and autonomous operating models, spanning network, OSS and IT domains, while ensuring architectural consistency, scalability, and long-term sustainability across the Group.

Make an Impact by

**

Network AI / AN Strategy and Architecture

  • Define the Group Network AI and Autonomous Networks (AN) architecture, framework, and roadmap aligned to Singtel28 and TM Forum AN maturity models (L3/L4).
  • Develop and maintain AN reference architectures, architectural guardrails, and best practices to guide OpCo implementations.
  • Work with network domain experts to align AI/AN adoption across RAN, Mobile Core, Transport, Fixed Access, OSS, and Network Operations.

OpCo Engagement and Alignment

  • Partner with OpCos to identify AN use cases, assess architectural readiness, and identify gaps across network, OSS, and IT layers.
  • Provide architectural advisory support to OpCos to guide roadmap definition and prioritisation toward AN maturity targets.
  • Ensure alignment of OpCo AN initiatives with Group architecture and strategy

OSS Strategy & Transformation

  • Provide architectural leadership and guidance on OSS transformation initiatives, including platform strategy, AI enablement, and alignment with AN L4 objectives.
  • Support and align Group and OpCo OSS-related decisions, including tender evaluations, vendor assessments, and strategic direction (e.g. agentic AI on existing OSS platforms versus platform replacement).
  • Work with OpCos and vendors to ensure OSS solutions support AI-driven service assurance, closed-loop automation, and future AN L4 evolution.
  • Engage stakeholders during tender specifications, vendor clarification workshops, and solution evaluations to ensure alignment with Group AN architecture and roadmap.

CPaaS Architecture & Enablement

  • Provide Group-level architectural guidance for CPaaS initiatives, ensuring alignment with Network architecture, and digital service exposure strategies.
  • Work with OpCos to align CPaaS architectures, API exposure models, and integration patterns with Group standards.
  • Support CPaaS tender specifications, vendor evaluations, and clarification workshops, ensuring scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions.

Technical Leadership and Governance

  • Provide technical leadership on AI, automation, closed-loop control, intent-based operations, A2A-T, MCP and agentic AI within network environments.
  • Engage vendors and partners to evaluate AI/AN, OSS, and CPaaS solution architectures, influencing product direction and roadmap alignment.
  • Support architecture governance forums to drive consistency, reuse, and scalability across the Group.
  • Contribute to industry engagement and standards activities related to Autonomous Networks, AI, and network automation where applicable.

Skills for Success

**

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 15+ years of experience in telecommunications with deep expertise across network, OSS, and IT architecture, including large-scale transformation initiatives in complex telco environments.
  • Proven track record in defining and governing network and IT architectures, translating strategy into executable technical roadmaps across regional operating companies.
  • Hands-on experience designing and governing end-to-end Network AI and Autonomous Network architectures, including telemetry ingestion, AI/ML inferencing, automation, orchestration, and closed-loop control.

job.title: Assistant Store Manager, Wynnum
job.description:
Wynnum, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

As one of Australia’s top telecommunications providers, Optus connects more than 11 million customers daily across mobile, broadband and digital products.

We’re looking to bring on board a supportive, driven and people focused Assistant Store Manager / 2IC to join our Wynnum team. If you love developing others, energising a team, delivering outstanding customer experiences and stepping into a challenge of leadership with confidence, then take the next step in your career with us.

At Optus, we collaborate with purpose, support one another, take accountability, act with integrity and celebrate our wins as one team. Together, we learn, grow, overcome challenges and build genuine connections, both with our customers and with each other. As a Second in Charge, you’ll play a key role in helping to develop the store’s culture, driving performance outcomes and contributing to its overall success.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead by example, supporting your Store Manager to create a positive, high-performance culture where your team feels motivated, included and confident to shine.
  • Support the store manager to coach, mentor and develop team members through clear guidance, meaningful feedback and day to day support, helping them deliver exceptional customer experiences.
  • Help to maintain an energised, customer first environment that feels warm, welcoming and inspiring for both customers and your team.
  • Support smooth daily operations, from team coordination to service delivery, while finding opportunities to uplift performance, efficiency and customer experience.
  • Handle escalated customer enquiries with calm professionalism, modelling effective de‑escalation techniques and guiding the team through various situations.
  • Help to drive team engagement by celebrating wins, supporting goal setting, encouraging continuous learning and strengthening collaboration.

What you bring:

  • Supportive Leadership: You empower others through your actions, integrity and encouragement, helping people to perform at their best.
  • Customer First Coaching: You lead by example, coaching and supporting the team to deliver memorable experiences and always keep customers at the heart of their actions.
  • Calm Under Pressure: You stay composed during reactive or complex situations, modelling effective de‑escalation and helping your peers to manage challenges with care.
  • Operational & Business Awareness: You have a strong grasp of retail operations, know what drives performance, and showcase balanced step up to leadership with store efficiencies.
  • Team Culture & Adaptability: You support to build an inclusive team environment and stay flexible and solutions focused when priorities shift or customer needs change.

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and exclusive access to unique discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and special shopping discounts with our retail and corporate partners.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ day to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 14 weeks.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Yarn First Nations, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, available 24/7 across multiple channels.

Not sure you meet every requirement? Don’t let that hold you back. We value potential just as much as experience, and this role might be exactly where your next chapter begins.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. We are seeking an experienced and innovative Senior Software Engineer with strong expertise in Sitecore and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to join our Enterprise IT team. In this role, you will lead the architecture, development, and optimization of our enterprise digital experience platform, leveraging Sitecore and AI technologies to deliver scalable, secure, and intelligent solutions. You will also play a key role in integrating modern headless architectures and AI-driven capabilities to create exceptional digital experiences.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Platform Architecture & Development: Lead the end-to-end design, development, and implementation of enterprise Sitecore solutions. Translate complex business requirements into scalable, maintainable, and high-performing applications while leveraging AI tools and AI-assisted development practices to accelerate delivery and improve code quality.
  • AI Innovation: Evaluate, implement, and optimize AI technologies that enhance development productivity, content management, personalization, search, automation, and customer experiences. Design and develop AI-powered solutions where appropriate.
  • Headless & Composable Development: Design and implement modern headless architectures using Sitecore XM Cloud, GraphQL, and JavaScript frameworks such as React and Next.js to build flexible, high-performance digital experiences.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, UX/UI Designers, DevOps engineers, Digital Marketing teams, and business stakeholders to deliver integrated solutions aligned with business objectives.
  • Engineering Excellence: Promote software engineering best practices through architecture reviews, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, performance optimization, and technical mentoring.
  • Security & Compliance: Ensure all solutions adhere to enterprise security standards, data privacy requirements, accessibility guidelines, and governance policies.

What You'll Bring

The ideal candidate will have:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience building enterprise Content Management System (CMS) solutions.
  • Strong expertise in Sitecore XP/XM (including Sitecore 10+), Sitecore Experience Accelerator (SXA), Sitecore XM Cloud, .NET Core, C#, GraphQL, and modern headless/composable architectures using React or Next.js.
  • Strong proficiency with AI tools and hands-on experience designing, developing, and integrating AI-powered solutions into enterprise applications. Experience with AI-assisted development tools (such as GitHub Copilot or similar platforms), large language models (LLMs), AI APIs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or AI agent development is highly desirable.
  • Proven experience designing scalable architectures, developing APIs, troubleshooting complex production issues, optimizing website performance, and mentoring developers within Agile teams.
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software engineering methodologies.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.

Education/Certification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Sitecore Developer Certification is highly desirable.

job.title: Network Engineer, Foundation & Support
job.description:
Meta is seeking a Network Engineer, Foundation & Support to join our Edge and Network Services (ENS) Foundation NetOps team. In this role, you will utilize your knowledge in hyperscale data center structured cabling, fiber connectivity solutions, and IP networking to support the delivery of field repair services. You will work closely with internal business teams, external vendors, network design/engineering, and other cross-functional teams to develop strategies for integrating new technologies and better supporting existing technologies across our operational fleet. Your objective will be to understand technical drivers for the business and organize strategies to ensure operational supportability meets those needs. Additionally, you will help represent ENS across various stakeholder groups to help achieve critical projects. Our team is dedicated to improving the operational efficiency and reliability of one of the world's most dynamic and fast-paced networks.

Responsibilities

  • Incident Response: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, managed service providers, and third-party vendor partners to investigate complex technical and process issues during major incidents/site events (SEVs) on edge, caching, and network infrastructure. Work closely with team members to understand the root cause of incidents and contribute to their resolution
  • Change Management: Identify security & business continuity issues affecting the network and infrastructure at Meta and work with the team to implement effective changes. Provide feedback on existing tools, processes, and policies to help scale with the rapid expansion of the Meta platform and customer base
  • Operations: Drive operations by identifying improvement opportunities across policies, processes, and procedures to improve efficiency and quality of activities. Ensure standards compliance across the network and optimize service delivery
  • Collaboration and Partnership: Work closely with internal customers to address their needs and issues, and influence future iterations of data center and network designs for seamless integration of new infrastructure and scalability
  • Team Leadership: Work with cross-functional teams within and outside the organization to deliver business outcomes predictability across global sites. Analyze operational datasets to detect and prioritize problems and create aligned team projects, programs, and roadmaps
  • Risk Management: Collaborate with partner teams to design and implement aligned processes that identify and manage data and asset protection risks, as well as operations continuity issues across the network
  • Information and Data Assurance: Ensure relevant operational process, procedure, and policy documentation is effectively managed, and the data required to support operations is complete and accurate in systems
  • Automation: Collaborate with the team to analyze operational events to identify new automation opportunities and achieve our goals of all Tier-1 faults in the network being fully remediated by software. Help others understand our requirements and drive their roadmaps, and in some cases, directly implement lightweight solutions in code
  • Data Measurement: Drive quality into the metrics we report, measuring and analyzing escalation issues, fault/event trends, infrastructure capacity, and vendor performance failures. Formulate appropriate metrics and definitions of success to drive quality, efficiency, cost, and timeliness, evolving these over time to match changes to the infrastructure and business requirements
  • Communication: Provide clear and effective communication around personal and team goals, progress, outcomes, and lessons learned across assigned scope
  • Travel: International and domestic travel may be required up to 25% of the time, depending on the needs of the business

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta
  • 7+ years of experience operating, deploying, and designing large-scale network, optical, and/or physical layer infrastructure
  • 7+ years of network operations experience while supporting large-scale service provider, data center, and/or enterprise network infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience with various optical/network communication equipment such as network/fiber/copper test gear, and other WDM equipment, as well as associated tools and test equipment
  • Communication skills with a demonstrated ability to engage effectively with hardware vendors, service providers, and colocation facility vendors globally, and translate performance issues into actionable technical requirements
  • Experience analyzing tactical situations, troubleshooting, root causing systems and tools, and problem solving via tasks or larger cross functional projects
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to external vendors to direct repair actions
  • Working knowledge of Network Services, including topology, traffic analysis, hardware platform, and architectures
  • Familiarity with Enterprise and Service Provider network hardware platforms and architectures, including Cisco and Juniper routers/switches and Nexus data center switching hardware platforms
  • Knowledge of physical data center design: rack elevations, cabling, fiber optics, power/cooling, and facility infrastructure
  • Experience with network hardware platforms and architectures including Cisco, Juniper, Arista, Ciena, Infinera, Nokia, Arista, Cisco WDM Equipment
  • Ability to move technical or engineering programs and products from inception to delivery, and articulate their impact using metrics

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in partnering with infrastructure engineers within varied infrastructure environments, such as data center facilities or leased facilities
  • Direct experience within global Network Operations Center (NOC) environments and managing SLAs (service level agreements) and continuous improvement against metrics at scale
  • Project management experience
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

The ideal candidate will have a background in intelligence analysis, experience conducting various forms of data analysis on large networks of nefarious actors, as well as experience in deriving strategic-level insights from quantitative datasets.

This role is highly cross-functional and will be expected to work with teams across the company to identify key trends in the law enforcement space that can make the platform safer.

With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

  • The Senior Contracts Manager will serve as the senior contracting advisor for the development, construction, procurement, and delivery of NTT Global Data Centers projects across APAC, including India, Malaysia, Singapore, Japan, and other assigned markets.
  • Reporting to the Director, Global Contracts, this role will be the region's primary contracting advisor and a strategic partner to Supply Chain, Construction, Development, Engineering, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders.
  • The role will lead complex contract negotiations, advise on commercial risk, and help develop scalable contracting structures across multiple projects, entities, and jurisdictions. As the most senior contracting voice in the region, the role is expected to exercise independent judgment and to be the first call for regional and country leadership on commercial risk.
  • Successful candidates will demonstrate strong ownership, judgment, commercial awareness, practicality, collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset. The strongest candidates are builders: comfortable with ambiguity, willing to create structure where none yet exists, and energized rather than frustrated by scope that is still being defined.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead drafting, review, negotiation, and execution of construction, EPC/EPCM, design, professional services, equipment procurement, framework, master services, and project-specific agreements.
  • Negotiate key commercial terms including liability, indemnity, insurance, warranties, schedule, delay, liquidated damages, payment, performance security, termination, and dispute resolution.
  • Partner with Supply Chain and Category Management to determine the appropriate contracting strategy, including regional frameworks, country riders, local agreements, purchase orders, and statements of work.
  • Support appropriate use of NTT contracting entities and coordinate with Legal, Tax, Finance, Risk, and other specialists on country-specific requirements.
  • Anticipate contracting needs based on project pipeline, procurement strategy, critical equipment, and construction schedules.
  • Identify opportunities to create scalable contracting structures across projects, suppliers, campuses, and countries.
  • Act as the trusted advisor to regional and country leadership on contracting strategy, escalations, and commercial risk decisions.
  • Translate contractual issues into practical commercial guidance for business stakeholders.
  • Support contract interpretation, change management, performance issues, and claims avoidance during project execution.
  • Promote consistent use of approved templates, playbooks, fallback positions, and contracting procedures.
  • Capture recurring negotiation issues and supplier precedents and recommend improvements to contracting standards and processes.

Knowledge & Attributes:

  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead sophisticated contract negotiations.
  • Strong understanding of commercial risk allocation and contract strategy.

Academic Qualifications & Certifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience required.
  • JD, LLB, law degree, or equivalent legal or commercial contracting qualification preferred.

Required Experience:

  • Ten or more years of experience negotiating complex commercial contracts in data centers, construction, infrastructure, engineering, technology, or another capital-intensive industry
  • Experience working across multiple jurisdictions and with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Excellent drafting, negotiation, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex matters with limited supervision.

Preferred:

  • Experience with data centers, mission-critical infrastructure, or large-scale construction.
  • Experience with EPC, EPCM, FIDIC, design-build, professional services, and major equipment procurement agreements.
  • Experience with APAC markets, regional frameworks, country riders, and multi-entity contracting structures
  • In-house contracting or commercial experience at a hyperscale, major technology company, or other organization operating at global scale, combined with an appetite for a less mature, faster-moving environment.
  • Experience developing templates, playbooks, clause libraries, or contracting governance programs.
  • Working proficiency in a regional language in addition to English and demonstrated effectiveness working with local supplier and stakeholder norms across Asian markets.

Physical Requirements

  • Regularly moves equipment and other hardware up to ## lbs.
  • Frequently move about inside and outside of data center / facility
  • Remain stationary for long periods of time.
  • Ascend / Descend a ladder and perform duties atop a raised platform
  • Position self in small spaces.
  • Operate computer, peripherals, and other office equipment.
  • Perform work during US business hours and time zones.

Work Conditions & Other Requirements

  • Regular travel to project sites and country teams across the region is expected, approximately 10% of the time
  • The role works closely with a globally distributed contracts team and requires flexibility across time zones.
  • Perform work from a remote location with stable internet connection.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.description:
Job Summary

Technical specialist and primary customer support contact to diagnose and execute complex repairs to generators and components at the customer’s site.

Key Responsibilities

stablishes and continually develops productive customer relations and ensures prompt and efficient attention to customer needs

Applies the use of specialized tools and follows documented procedures and policies to diagnose and complete complex repairs at customer site.

Performs preventative maintenance activities as per documented schedules and standards on power generation products in the field

Escalates unresolved issues to product specialists / Supervisor

Coaches and develops technicians and/or apprentices and transfers knowledge and experience to others; may provide work direction; may review of repair plans, parts lists, etc

Completes required documentation, such as service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens.

Completes training in line with skill and business requirements

Maintains service vehicle and tools for cleanliness and proper operation

Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to site management and to their supervisor

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Power Generation Systems Knowledge - Demonstrates knowledge of Cummins and industry standards by complying with all safe work procedures including Personal Protective Equipment to create a safe work environment; interprets and analyzes Power Generation system operation and integration (switch gear, power system controls, uninterruptable power supply, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Power Generation Systems Knowledge - Demonstrates knowledge of Cummins and industry standards by complying with all safe work procedures including Personal Protective Equipment to create a safe work environment; interprets and analyzes Power Generation system operation and integration (switch gear, power system controls, uninterruptable power supply, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.

job.description:
Do you have the business savvy and the technical background necessary to help establish Amazon as a key technology platform provider? Amazon Web Services India Private Limited is leading the next paradigm shift in computing and is looking for world-class candidates to join our enterprise business.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. As a GCC Account Manager for AWS India, your responsibilities will include building and driving the strategy to increase AWS adoption and market penetration across Global Capability Centers (GCCs) operating in India. You will be responsible for carrying out global account strategy locally and building long-term business and technology partnerships with these strategic engineering and innovation hubs that shape global cloud architecture.

  • The candidate would drive A/ Internal Digital Transformation B/ Cloud Migration & Platform Modernization C/ Data-driven Innovation and D/ Generative AI conversations, sales plays and adoption across GCC operations.
  • The candidate would drive regular and deeper executive engagement between GCC India leadership, global parent organization stakeholders, and AWS teams to ensure "Top to Top" connect from both sides.
  • The candidate would have the charter of driving regular, strategic, business transformation & roadmap oriented conversations with GCC Heads, Engineering Leaders, and Center of Excellence (CoE) owners with regards to cloud architecture decisions, workload migrations, and innovation initiatives.
  • The candidate would have the charter of engaging with GCC Engineering Heads, Product Development leaders, and Horizontal leaders to drive success of their Migration/Modernization strategy.
  • He/she should be able to provide guidance & leadership to the extended teams and drive execution excellence behind the success of projects and Pilots.
  • The candidate will lead collaboration initiatives including hackathons, immersion days, and tech days to showcase AWS capabilities, build technical mindshare, and accelerate adoption.
  • The candidate would be able to evangelize with GCC CTO/CIO offices and replicate successful cloud adoption patterns across different Lines of Business (LOBs) and geographies. Also, interface with Product Engineering & Innovation teams to influence global product and platform transformation decisions.
  • The candidate would work closely with GSIs and ISVs that support GCC operations and ensure alignment with global account teams to convert local initiatives into global-scale consumption.
  • The candidate would ensure all local operations and cloud implementations follow Indian data sovereignty, privacy, and regulatory requirements while maintaining global architecture standards.
  • The ideal candidate will possess a key account management or business development background that enables them to engage at all levels of a GCC organization, including C-levels, Engineering Heads, and technical architects of both the India operations and global parent organization.
  • The candidate will demonstrate a strong technical competency focused on cloud computing, modern application development, and the evolving GCC landscape in India.

job.title: WW Specialist Solutions Architect In-Memory, WWSO Data
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are technologists with deep domain-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs. As part of the AWS sales organization, SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert-level knowledge to solve. SSAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or designing entirely new cloud-based systems. Do you enjoy solving novel and unique technical challenges for customers? Become an AWS Specialist SA!

The Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. We work backwards from our customer's most complex and business critical problems to build and execute go-to-market (GTM) plans that turn AWS ideas into multi-billion-dollar businesses. WWSO teams include business development, specialist and technical solutions architecture. As part of WWSO, you'll provide expertise across the entire life cycle of an AWS customer initiative, from developing ideas for new services to accelerating the adoption of established businesses. We pride ourselves on thinking big, delivering exceptional results for our customers, and working across AWS as #OneTeam.

Within WWSO, this position is part of the Worldwide Specialist Team, where you will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for in-memory and caching architectures on AWS - Amazon ElastiCache and Valkey. This is a developer-facing role: your primary mission is to drive ElastiCache and Valkey adoption through the developer community, meeting builders where they are and making it effortless for them to adopt the right caching strategy. Modern applications - and increasingly agentic AI workloads, where low-latency caching is central to token optimization and cost control - depend on getting the data and caching layer right. You will help developers apply proven caching patterns (cache-aside, write-through, rate limiting, session and semantic caching, and more) and position in-memory data stores within the broader NoSQL, purpose-built database strategy that underpins production-scale AI.

You will work closely with the Database Services team, Business Development, and Sales to enable large-scale customer use cases and drive adoption and revenue for AWS. You will build with developers - writing sample code, reference implementations, and demos - and produce whitepapers, blogs, reference architectures, and conference talks that scale your impact across the developer community. You will also create field enablement materials for the broader SA population, helping other SAs understand when and how to integrate AWS caching services into customer architectures. As a trusted advisor with hands-on technical depth in in-memory / NoSQL systems, you will share recommendations around performance, cost, reliability, security, and operational efficiency to accelerate how customers build data-intensive and AI-powered applications on AWS.

Key job responsibilities

  • Drive ElastiCache and Valkey adoption across the developer community - through hands-on content, sample code, workshops, hackathons, open-source contributions, and developer events.
  • Be the go-to technical expert on caching strategy and in-memory data patterns, helping developers and customers choose and implement the right approach for latency, scale, and cost - including caching for agentic AI and GenAI workloads.
  • Accelerate the caching layer for agentic AI; help developers use ElastiCache/Valkey for agent token optimization, semantic caching, session/short-term memory, and rate limiting, positioning in-memory data stores as core infrastructure in the pilot-to-production journey for GenAI and agentic workloads.
  • Represent the voice of the developer and customer; bring feedback to product teams to influence ElastiCache/Valkey feature development and the future roadmap.
  • Provide advanced technical knowledge to your domain-aligned GTM teams to unblock our customers' largest and most critical business challenges.
  • Act as a thought leader, sharing best practices through AWS blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures, and public-speaking events such as AWS Summit and AWS re:Invent.
  • Partner with Business Development teams to define the technical components of best-in-class GTM concepts, solutions, and initiatives.
  • Develop and support an AWS internal community of technical subject matter experts worldwide.
  • Create field enablement materials for the broader SA population, to help them integrate AWS caching services into customer architectures.

About the team

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.   • 5+ years design and implementation experience with NoSQL technologies and Key-value stores such as ElastiCache, Aerospike, Redis, Memcached, including NoSQL data modeling.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
  • AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
  • History of successful technical consulting and/or architecture engagements with large-scale customers or enterprises.
  • Deep knowledge of and experience with Redis.
  • Hands-on experience with services related to databases highly desirable, particularly Amazon Aurora, Lambda, Amazon Elasticache, Amazon OpenSearch, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon S3, Amazon EC2 Container Service, Amazon Kinesis, etc.

  • Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
  • AWS experience preferred, with proficiency in a wide range of AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC, CloudFormation).
  • AWS Professional level certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional) preferred.
  • Experience with automation and scripting (e.g., Terraform, Python)
  • Knowledge of security and compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR)
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

job.title: Account Manager - Melbourne City
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

30 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Account Manager - Melbourne City

Job Summary

Job Description

What is the focus of the role?

As an Account Manager, you will be the trusted advisor for a portfolio of Business Plus customers, helping them achieve their goals through telecommunications, ICT and cyber security solutions. By combining exceptional communication, strong commercial capability and a passion for customer success, you will deliver outstanding customer experiences, drive sustainable portfolio growth and contribute to the continued success of the Telstra Business Technology Centre.

Who we are

At Telstra Business Technology Centres (TBTC), we partner with business customers to help them achieve their goals through innovative telecommunications, ICT and cyber security solutions. We combine local expertise with the strength of Australia's leading telecommunications and technology provider to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

We are seeking a motivated and customer-focused Account Manager to manage and grow a defined portfolio of Business Plus customers. This role is critical to maintaining strong customer relationships that drive revenue growth, customer advocacy and long-term business success for both our customers and Telstra.

Role Location: TBTC Melbourne City - 80 Dorcas Street, Southbank, Victoria, 3006 (in-centre)

About the role

  • Customer Satisfaction & Customer Success

Develop trusted relationships with business owners and decisionmakers.

  • Gain a deep understanding of each customer’s business, objectives and challenges.
  • Conduct proactive account reviews and customer engagement activities.
  • Deliver exceptional customer experiences that drive satisfaction, loyalty and advocacy.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for customer enquiries, service requests and escalations.
  • Partner with customers to help them make informed technology decisions.
  • Collaborate with technical specialists, project delivery teams and support functions to deliver seamless outcomes.
  • Sales & Portfolio Growth

Manage and grow a portfolio of Business Plus customers.

  • Identify opportunities across telecommunications, mobility, internet, networking, cloud, collaboration, managed services and cyber security solutions.
  • Conduct business needs analysis to uncover customer challenges and priorities.
  • Develop and maintain account plans that support customer retention and growth.
  • Generate, qualify and progress opportunities through the full sales lifecycle.
  • Meet individual sales, revenue and performance targets.
  • Operational Excellence

Maintain accurate customer records, account plans and pipeline management activities.

  • Ensure customer interactions and opportunities are documented accurately.
  • Deliver high-quality portfolio management and customer governance.
  • Meet customer contact and activity expectations.

About you

  • Experience in Business-to-Business (B2B) sales, account management or business development.

  • Proven experience managing customer relationships and achieving sales targets.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organisational, planning and time management capability.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust and credibility with customers and stakeholders.
  • Strong commercial acumen and customer-focused mindset.

job.description:

Permanent

Closing Date

27 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

AI Senior Security Capability Engineer

Job Summary

Job Description

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced AI Senior Security Capability Engineer to help shape and strengthen AI security across a diverse range of AI-enabled initiatives. This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, working independently, and partnering with stakeholders to optimize AI solutions from a security perspective.

Our Perks & Benefits:

  • Work-life integration - we understand life happens when you're busy making other plans, so we offer flexibility around where, and when you work
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave for primary and secondary carers
  • Professional development program
  • An epic (free) Telstra mobile phone plan
  • Laptop/Device allowance renewed every 2 years
  • Purchased Annual Leave scheme
  • Discounted Telstra products and services

What You'll Do

  • Assess and enhance the security of AI-enabled applications and solutions.
  • Work closely with a variety of teams to ensure AI technologies are secure, effective, and aligned with security requirements.
  • Identify risks, including potential information exposure and security gaps within AI implementations.
  • Optimize existing AI capabilities rather than building applications from scratch.
  • Conduct technology evaluations, security assessments, and proof-of-concept activities where required.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design practical and scalable security solutions.
  • Support AI security initiatives across different business areas, adapting to diverse technologies and use cases.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong knowledge of AI security principles and practices.
  • Experience working with AI technologies and related capabilities, including prompt engineering and AI solution optimization.
  • Understanding of technologies such as RAG, MCP, APIs, and AI integrations.
  • Knowledge of cloud technologies and application security practices.
  • Ability to assess architecture, security risks, and technical solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • A proactive, self-directed approach with excellent problem-solving abilities.
  • Comfortable working independently and learning new technologies as required.

Ideal Candidate

You are someone who:

  • Thrives in ambiguous and fast-moving environments.
  • Takes initiative rather than waiting for direction.
  • Enjoys engaging with a wide range of stakeholders and teams.
  • Can balance technical depth with practical business outcomes.
  • Is curious, adaptable, and motivated by continuous learning.
  • Brings a consultant-like mindset, helping teams improve and optimize their AI capabilities.

Why Join Us?

This role offers exposure to a broad range of AI security challenges across multiple teams and initiatives. Rather than focusing on a single platform or project, you'll have the opportunity to work on diverse problems, influence outcomes, and help shape secure AI adoption across the organization. If you enjoy variety, autonomy, and meaningful impact, this role is for you.

Diversity is more than a policy – it’s how we thrive

We know diverse teams deliver better outcomes, and we’re committed to creating an environment where everyone feels safe, respected, and supported — regardless of gender, background, or ability.

We strongly encourage women and gender-diverse people to apply and are happy to discuss flexible working arrangements or adjustments to the recruitment process.

27 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Senior Security Engineer - Cloud & Application Security

Job Summary

Job Description

About the Opportunity

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Security Engineer to join the Application and Cloud Security team.

As we continue to modernise our cloud and application security capabilities, this role will play a key part in delivering several strategic initiatives, including the rollout of GitLab, Wiz, Wiz Code, and broader DevSecOps capabilities across Telstra.

This position is ideal for an engineer who is passionate about cloud security, secure software delivery, automation, and technical leadership. **

Essential Experience

  • Deep expertise in Cloud Security and platform security engineering.

Leadership Capability

  • Ability to provide technical leadership across multiple initiatives.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic, outcome-focused approach.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to influence the future of Telstra's cloud and application security landscape while working on cutting-edge security technologies and engineering practices. You will help shape the adoption of modern DevSecOps capabilities, improve security outcomes for engineering teams, and contribute to initiatives that deliver meaningful impact across the organisation.

job.title: Project Manager Senior Lead
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

30 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Project Manager Senior Lead

Job Summary

Job Description

We're Australia's leading telecommunications and technology company. With a global presence in more than 22 countries, we have a strong global footprint. Our purpose is to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. We're all about providing the best experience and delivering the best tech on the best network.

We are committed to making Telstra the best place to work and creating a diverse and inclusive workplace that works for everyone.**

What We Offer

Performance-related pay Access to thousands of learning programs so you can level-up Global presence across 22 countries; opportunities to work where we do business.

#

Focus of the Role

As a Project Manager Senior Lead, you play an integral role in planning and managing projects and programs ranging from small to complex. You are responsible for successful end-to-end delivery, including developing delivery roadmaps, improving processes to accelerate delivery, coordinating interconnected workstreams, and initiating appropriate interventions when gaps, risks, or issues are identified.

Our team leads complex, enterprise-wide initiatives that connect strategy with delivery across Telstra. We partner with product, technology, customer and delivery teams to create clear roadmaps, strengthen governance and deliver sustainable business and customer outcomes.

As Project Manager Senior Lead, you will shape and deliver high-impact projects and programs involving multiple product, technology, customer and delivery teams. You will set multi-year roadmaps and investment priorities, manage complex dependencies and create the clarity, momentum and governance needed to turn strategy into measurable outcomes.

You will take ownership of delivery from planning through to benefit realisation—leading governance, financial management, resourcing, risk management and executive reporting. Working with senior leaders, sponsors and cross-functional teams, you will influence decisions, remove barriers and continuously improve how complex work is delivered.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead complex projects and programs from concept to completion, whether as standalone initiatives or as part of a broader portfolio.
  • Create and maintain multi-year delivery roadmaps that connect strategy, investment, milestones, dependencies and accountabilities.
  • Own delivery performance across scope, schedule, budget, quality and benefit realisation.
  • Establish effective governance and lead sponsor and Steering Committee forums with clear reporting, escalation and decision support.
  • Build alignment across senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, resolving competing priorities, risks and dependencies.
  • Manage budgets, forecasts, resources and delivery capacity to support sustainable outcomes.
  • Anticipate and manage risks, issues, dependencies and change, taking timely action to keep delivery on track.
  • Improve delivery methodologies, governance practices and ways of working based on evidence and lessons learned.
  • Coach and mentor delivery professionals, sharing practical expertise and strengthening capability across the community.

About You

  • Extensive experience leading complex projects or programs end-to-end in large, fast-moving organisations.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including hands-on responsibility for budgets, forecasts and financial performance.
  • A track record of influencing senior leaders, sponsors and governance forums to achieve timely decisions and shared outcomes.
  • Confident leadership in matrixed, cross-functional environments, with the ability to bring clarity to ambiguity.
  • Excellent communication, governance and reporting skills, including the ability to translate complex information into clear executive insights.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments. Qualifications such as PMP, PRINCE2 or Agile certifications will be highly regarded.
  • Background in telecommunications, technology or another complex service environment a definite advantage

If you are energised by complex challenges, enjoy bringing people together and want to see your leadership translate into meaningful business and customer outcomes, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and help shape the future of delivery with us!

  • *

When you join our team, you become part of a welcoming and inclusive community where everyone is respected, valued and celebrated. We actively seek individuals from various backgrounds, ethnicities, genders and disabilities because we know that diversity not only strengthens our team but also enriches our work. We have zero tolerance for harassment of any kind, and we prioritise creating a workplace culture where everyone is safe and can thrive.

job.title: Intelligence Analyst
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

29 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Intelligence Analyst

Job Summary

The Opportunity

Sitting within Telstra's Cyber Security Threat Research and Intelligence Group, this role offers the opportunity to contribute across a range of intelligence and security functions. You will work across teams including Threat Labs, OSINT and Cybercrime, and operational support. The role combines intelligence analysis, technical capability, research, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication to strengthen Telstra's information security posture and support effective security outcomes.

Job Description

##

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute cyber security intelligence activities to identify threats across Telstra and its business units.
  • Use specialised toolsets to gather, analyse, and evaluate information from professional threat feeds, internal systems, and publicly available sources.
  • Collate and assess information to produce quality intelligence that supports the anticipation and prevention of potential threats.
  • Conduct research and analysis across cybercrime, OSINT, technical security, and the current threat environment.
  • Produce clear, accurate, and consistent intelligence reports and communications for operational, technical, and business audiences.
  • Contribute to Threat Labs activities through the analysis of technical data and the application of knowledge across networks, platform configuration, and scripting.
  • Support security operations with timely intelligence, research, technical analysis, and communications.
  • Rapidly assess information security risks and develop a strong working knowledge of telecommunications and information security.
  • Engage effectively with stakeholders across Telstra and communicate intelligence findings with clarity and influence.
  • Identify and execute creative and effective solutions to analytical, technical, and operational issues.
  • Work collaboratively across the broader Threat Research and Intelligence Group to support shared priorities and security outcomes.
  • Contribute to the improvement of intelligence methods, processes, documentation, data sources, and tooling.
  • Operate with professionalism, discretion, and sound judgement when handling sensitive security information.

About You

You are an intelligence or cyber security professional with strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities, sound technical skills, and the communication capability to engage effectively across a range of audiences.

You bring:

  • Knowledge of the role cyber security intelligence plays in identifying and managing threats.
  • Demonstrated analytical and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to rapidly grasp information security risks within the current threat environment.
  • Strong technical skills, including an understanding of networks, platform configuration, and scripting.
  • Exceptional written communication skills, with demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and with influence using a variety of media.
  • Strong verbal communication and stakeholder-engagement skills across management, operational teams, vendors, and external organisations.
  • The ability to gather, assess, and evaluate information from varied technical, commercial, internal, and publicly available sources.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and execute creative and effective solutions.
  • The ability to work collaboratively across multiple teams while taking ownership of assigned issues and deliverables.
  • The ability to develop and apply strong working knowledge of telecommunications, information security, cybercrime, OSINT, and intelligence operations.
  • High levels of professionalism, adaptability, integrity, and care when working with sensitive information.

Highly desirable:

  • An understanding of information security within a telecommunications environment.
  • Experience in intelligence analysis, cyber security research, technical security operations, or incident support.
  • Experience using analytical, research, scripting, or security toolsets.
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications, industry training, or certification.

job.description:
