job.title: QA Software Engineer
job.description:
Legrand has an exciting opportunity for a QA Software Engineer to join the Power and Thermal Management Division in Bengaluru, Karnataka/India. As a QA Software Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our software products through manual and automated testing. You will create and maintain test plans, test cases, automation scripts, and defect reports, while collaborating closely with Software Engineering, Product Management, and other QA team members throughout the development lifecycle.

You will also contribute to test automation strategy, analyze automated test results, troubleshoot failures, and participate in technical and architecture discussions. AI-assisted engineering tools will be an important part of the role, supporting activities such as test design, automation development, debugging, defect investigation, and continuous improvement of QA processes.

Responsibilities

  • Design, maintain, and execute test plans, test cases, and test scenarios.
  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Identify opportunities to increase automation coverage and reduce repetitive manual testing.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory, negative, boundary, compatibility, and system testing.
  • Identify, reproduce, document, and track software defects throughout their lifecycle.
  • Analyze automated test results, logs, and failures to identify product, automation, or environment issues.
  • Debug and troubleshoot network protocols, APIs, services, and system behavior.
  • Maintain clear and accurate QA documentation.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineering, Product Management, and QA teams throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Participate in technical, design, architecture, and code review discussions from a quality and testability perspective.
  • Integrate and maintain automated tests within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Use AI-assisted tools to support test case generation, automation development, debugging, log analysis, defect investigation, and technical documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve test efficiency, coverage, reliability, and overall QA productivity.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes, tools, automation frameworks, and engineering practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience in Software QA, Software Testing, or a related engineering role.
  • Strong understanding of Software QA methodologies, testing techniques, and Agile software development practices.
  • Experience creating and executing both manual and automated test cases.
  • Experience with functional, regression, integration, negative, boundary, compatibility, and concurrency testing.
  • Experience developing, maintaining, or contributing to automated test frameworks.
  • Experience working with CI/CD environments and automated test execution pipelines.
  • Experience troubleshooting software defects, analyzing logs, and identifying potential root causes.
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar technologies for testing, automation, debugging, or technical analysis.

Skills/Knowledge/Abilities:

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong experience with test automation tools and frameworks such as Robot Framework, Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar technologies.
  • Experience developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting automated test suites.
  • Ability to identify suitable automation candidates and improve regression and end-to-end test coverage.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools and practices, such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with Git, GitLab, GitHub, and standard code review workflows.
  • Strong scripting or programming skills in Python are required. Experience with Golang or Java is a plus.
  • Basic knowledge of networking, APIs, web services, and distributed systems.
  • Practical knowledge of Generative AI and AI-assisted software engineering tools.
  • Ability to use AI effectively for test generation, automation development, test data creation, debugging, log analysis, and defect investigation.
  • Ability to critically review and validate AI-generated code, scripts, test cases, and technical recommendations.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering and providing appropriate technical context to AI tools.
  • Interest in applying AI to areas such as automation maintenance, failure analysis, test optimization, and defect classification.
  • Experience testing AI-enabled applications or features is considered a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to clearly document test results, defects, and technical findings.
  • Strong interest in continuously improving QA practices, automation coverage, engineering efficiency, and software quality.

job.title: Lead Parts Product Analyst-Authoriz
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

When you work at Caterpillar as an Inventory Analyst (Lead Parts Product Analyst - Authorizations), you have the opportunity to analyze engineering release and change notices, determine serviceability, create master records, identify and categorize critical parts, determine anticipated demand worldwide and place initial stocking requirements to balance parts inventory levels against months of supply for the first 36 months after release. Process, order, allocate, and manage worldwide parts inventory levels for successful New Product Launch (NPI) and continue parts availability for NPI parts.

What You Will Do

  • The Inventory Analyst will manage and analyze engineering drawing notices (EDNs) released for NPI, CPI, and major product updates prior to target release date. (EDNs are notifications of the original release of engineering drawings and subsequent changes to them.)
  • This includes analyzing engineering drawing notices for quality, completeness, and when necessary, resolving issues with engineering.
  • The Inventory Analyst will also utilize systems, their own product knowledge, and EDN information to determine application/product specific serviceability of parts i.e. can the part be serviced and at what level piece part, assembly, group, etc.
  • The Inventory Analyst will create master parts records (an all-inclusive record for an item), validate critical part description indicators, issue cancellations, and submit changes to Numerical Parts Record (NPR).

Inventory Analyst will establish initial worldwide inventory levels by analyzing distribution plans, sales and forecast information, product knowledge, and product group information. Incumbent will establish and maintain a business balance between parts availability and months of supply. Various NPI and CPI reports and tools are used to adjust stocking levels in the correct market regions. Each analyst will manage 1M to $5M worth of inventory as they process an average of 6000 to 8000 EDNs and 15 NPIs annually. The Inventory Analyst partners with Procurement and Global Parts Supply teams to ensure Aftermarket parts readiness for successful launch of new products. He/she will also partner with business units in improving NPI parts availability for the first 36 months.

The incumbent will communicate with internal and external business partners to resolve complex issues that will impact quality of service and customer satisfaction. The Inventory Analyst participates in the development of new IT tools to specifically manage overall NPI process and contribute to enterprise transformation initiatives that continue to refine, enhance, and create process improvement to support the NPI business. Inventory Analyst should have full functional knowledge of NPI Authorizations process and work on various Product Group workload. He/she should take lead in training and mentoring new team members joining the group.

Additional Information:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering / Maths / Science / Commerce
  • 4 - 6 years’ experience with strong parts experience preferably with parts product structure, procurement, inventory planning and parts distribution practices
  • Should possess good product knowledge, familiarity with parts inventory procedure, practices, and policies
  • Must have excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Strong technical skills in SAS and MS Office – Excel
  • Good oral and written communication skills
  • Strong customer focus and ability to work effectively with a wide variety of people
  • Must be flexible to work in different shift timings.

What You Have Business Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Comments on the organization's business model and financial goals.
  • Communicates key considerations for business decision making process.
  • Cites examples of types of information needed to make sound business decisions.
  • Participates in business task to get things done in own unit or area.
  • Caters to key stakeholders and their priorities.

Standard Operating Procedures: Knowledge of established standard operating procedures (SOP); ability to design, implement and evaluate standard operating procedures affecting daily and strategic business operations in order to increase operational efficiency. Level Basic Understanding:

  • Compiles current research relevant to standard operating procedures.
  • Explains usage of standard operating procedures in business operations.
  • Describes main issues and considerations when using standard operating procedures.
  • Identifies key features and functions of standard operating procedures.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.

job.description:

Role Definition

Provides support in general labor relations issues and maintains positive communication between managers and unions.

Responsibilities

  • Advising management on changes to existing policies to ensure compliance with new or proposed regulations.
  • Representing the organization in general legal hearings on federal, state and local regulations pertaining to labor issues.
  • Participating in implementing and administering management-labor relations to help maintain positive relations with unions.
  • Assisting in union contract negotiations, contract agreements, and other labor relations issues.
  • Contract Labour and Apprentice program management
  • Strong Compliance governance
  • Liaison with Government authorities

Degree Requirement

MSW/MLS/MBA HR

Required Experience- 12-15 Years

Skill Descriptors

Conflict Management: Knowledge of managing conflicts; ability to anticipate, recognize, and deal effectively with existing or potential conflicts at the individual, group, or situation level.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Mediates and resolves conflicts among individuals, groups, and departments.
  • Practices positive collaboration and converts difficult interactions into productive ones.
  • Guides participants in a conflict to rethink their current views.
  • Demonstrates good judgment in deciding when to involve a third party.
  • Makes parties aware of case studies of constructive and destructive conflicts.
  • Surfaces disagreements in early stages.

Influencing: Knowledge of effective influencing tactics and strategies; ability to impact decisions within and outside own organization.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Achieves influence and impact even when holding a position contrary to the majority.
  • Discards examples of persuasive arguments lacking substance or impact.
  • Leads and presents collaborative assessments that persuasively influence decision makers.
  • Advises on techniques to build rapport and commitment to common purpose.
  • Determines and leverages the decision-making style of the individual or group being influenced.
  • Delivers well-received presentations of cost, benefits, risks, and other considerations.

Interpersonal Relationships: Knowledge of the techniques and the ability to work with a variety of individuals and groups in a constructive and collaborative manner.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Seeks out what's common in conflicting points of view.
  • Influences key individuals inside and outside own group and earns their respect.
  • Resolves potentially harmful differences between individuals and groups of people.
  • Contributes as a member on a variety of teams.
  • Establishes and maintains productive working relationships within and outside of own area.
  • Establishes and maintains credibility with clients and teammates.

Negotiating: Knowledge of successful negotiation concepts and techniques; ability to negotiate successfully across the organization and with external vendors and clients in a constructive and collaborative manner.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Works to achieve win-win in negotiations, rather than taking a win-lose approach.
  • Focuses on issues rather than personalities.
  • Uses active listening and probing techniques to surface problems, issues, and interests.
  • Demonstrates a willingness to examine own position.
  • Presents own position and listens attentively to position of others.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
  • Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
  • Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
  • Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
  • Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Industrial Relations: Knowledge of the concept, theories, and approaches of industrial relations; ability to maintain harmonious relations between employers and employees.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Addresses routine problems or disciplinary issues related to industrial relations.
  • Assists in reaching collective bargaining deals between union and management.
  • Conducts monthly labor-management meetings and documents labor relations assignments.
  • Explains organizational policies, procedures, and processes for dealing with industrial relations issues.
  • Interprets and communicates industrial relations policies and procedures.

HR Legal and Regulatory Environment: Knowledge of HR legal and regulatory environment; ability to advise on laws and regulations affecting HR practices.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Assesses situations or conditions with potential legal implications.
  • Explains a specific HR policy or practice and relates it to a specific law or regulation.
  • Follows locally relevant laws and policies governing HR issues.
  • Answers queries on work-related aspects not covered by legislation.
  • Implements and ensures adherence to a specific aspect of legislation.

HR: Policies, Standards and Procedures: Knowledge of human resource function; ability to uphold the organization's and industry's standards, procedures and policies regarding human resources management.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Analyzes policy and standards documentation and ensures organizational compliance.
  • Maintains a specific set of standards and associated HR procedures.
  • Communicates and refers potential exceptions upward for review and approval.
  • Assists in the development and implementation of specific procedures.
  • Provides feedback for the improvement of HR procedures.

job.title: Field Representative Development – Marketing & Sales Operations
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

About the Position

As a Pre-field Rep – Marketing & Sales Operations Representative (MSOR), you will join a structured 18–24 month Field Rep development program designed to accelerate your career at Caterpillar.

Through a combination of hands-on rotations, training, and global exposure, you will build the skills needed for a future field-based role supporting dealers and customers. You will learn directly from senior leaders and subject matter experts while gaining practical experience across the business.

What Marketing & Sales Means at Caterpillar

At Caterpillar, Marketing & Sales focuses on helping dealers optimise marketing and sales operations to improve customer outcomes, and business performance.

While this role supports Marketing & Sales functions, it is not a traditional sales representative or marketing specialist role. The focus of this position is to collaborate with Cat dealers to build capability, drive process improvement, and execute Marketing and Sales Operations related strategies.

What the Field Rep Program Offers

  • A 12-week intensive onboarding and training experience
  • International exposure, including travel across Asia and Europe on learning trips
  • Rotational assignments across key business functions
  • Mentorship from experienced leaders and subject matter experts

What you will learn in the program:

  • Build foundational knowledge of Caterpillar's products, customers, industries, and dealer network
  • Develop commercial, analytical, consulting, and professional skills
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across dealer management, marketing, sales, product, and strategic business functions
  • Gain exposure to business planning, customer experience, growth strategies, process improvement, and operational excellence practices
  • Rotational Assignments through various Caterpillar Divisions to (i) develop industry and product application knowledge, (ii) build a strong understanding of the Cat dealer network and (iii) strengthen your capabilities for future roles within the organisation

Your Future Role

Upon successful completion of the program, you will have the opportunity to move into a field role, where you will:

  • Partner with Cat dealers to strengthen marketing and sales operations and improve business performance
  • Build dealer capability and support strategic growth and process improvement initiatives
  • Champion customer experience and support initiatives that improve market coverage and customer engagement
  • Use data and insights to identify opportunities and develop solutions that improve customer outcomes and commercial performance
  • Act as a trusted advisor to dealers, helping them improve performance and deliver exceptional customer experience
  • We’re looking for candidates who:
  • Hold a degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, Project Management, Operations Management, or a related discipline
  • Have experience managing or supporting projects, process improvement initiatives, business development activities, or operational improvements
  • Are strong communicators and relationship builders
  • Enjoy solving problems and working with data
  • Demonstrate commercial curiosity, a growth mindset, and adaptability
  • Are open to travel (up to 30%) and relocation within Australia
  • You may also have up to 3 years of experience in marketing, business, analytics, project management, operations, sales support or change management.

Additional Information**

Whilst applicants will be considered from across Australia, you may be required to relocate upon completion of your developmental period. Company support is provided with relocation.

Must have full Australian working rights

Testimonials from Field Rep Program Graduates

“It was one of the best early‑career experiences I’ve had. You get to travel through Asia and Europe, spend time in world‑class facilities, and build real technical and leadership skills - all while working for a global industry leader”

  • Program Graduate, Marketing & Sales

"Being a part of this program was a once in a lifetime opportunity for me, and it provided me with immense growth both professionally and personally." - Program Graduate, Marketing & Sales

“The program has been a valuable part of my development. It has broadened my understanding of Caterpillar products, systems, and dealer operations, enabling me to provide more effective support to Cat dealers and customers and deliver greater value in my role every day.”

  • Program Graduate, Product Support

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

September 23, 2026 - October 15, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Business Orientation: Understands NBFC operations, finance, accounting, credit, collections, regulatory reporting and control environments; applies audit work in a commercial and regulatory context.

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Performs testing with appropriate sampling, evidence retention and documentation discipline; reviews work papers for completeness, consistency, traceability and support for conclusions reached.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Applies professional judgement while evaluating audit evidence, exceptions and compensating controls; distinguishes between design gaps, operating failures, process inefficiencies and documentation gaps.

Effective Communication: Writes clear audit work papers, issue summaries, management comments and status updates; communicates audit requirements, observations and remediation expectations professionally with stakeholders.

Problem Solving: Identifies root causes, recommends proportionate remediation actions, understands escalation practices and validates action closure based on appropriate evidence.

Data Gathering and Reporting: Identifies reliable sources of audit evidence, applies basic data analysis to identify trends and exceptions, and prepares accurate audit status updates, testing summaries and exception reports.

Regulatory, SOX and ICFR Orientation: Understands the importance of RBI compliance, Companies Act requirements, Ind AS financial reporting and internal control over financial reporting; supports SOX and ICFR testing aligned to group and local statutory reporting expectations.

Posting Dates:

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Inventory Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

Research, develop, implement and monitor inventory concepts and reconciliation procedures for worldwide parts inventory management.

What You Will Do

  • Lead and coordinate workload for support staff and process partners
  • Approve Statistical Test Counts and high dollar inventory adjustments
  • Liaison between warehouse personnel, Quality and Business Resources to resolve issues with inventory accuracy
  • Analyse current and historical part data from multiple systems and process inventory adjustments and/or other required actions to correct discrepant stock record on hands
  • Complete analysis for supply chain improvement projects
  • Lead Reconciliation PID’s for warehouse personnel

Degree Requirement Degree or equivalent experience desired

What You Have Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. Level Basic Understanding:

  • Names specific tools or techniques that can be used to support the analytical thinking process.
  • Describes specific software applications or products used for business analytics.
  • Gives examples of how analytical thinking has been used to resolve problems.
  • Helps others research and learn more about business analytics tools and applications.

Capacity Planning & Management - MFG: Knowledge of tools, approaches and practices for determining production demand and ability to manage resources needed to provide satisfactory levels of service. Level Basic Understanding:

  • Names several capacity-related measurements and installed tools.
  • Identifies common capacity constraints and seasonal trends.
  • Locates internal and external informative sources or proprietary materials about capacity planning & management.
  • Describes the roles and responsibilities of capacity planners.

Data Gathering & Analysis: Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Participates in gathering and analyzing an organization's data based on requirements.
  • Follows proper data gathering and analysis processes and policies.
  • Utilizes basic data collection and evaluation tools and techniques.
  • Reports problems that arise in the data collection process.
  • Documents data from various sources and in various formats.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment. Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains characteristics and steps in an effective decision-making process.
  • Identifies issues and communicates with others when a decision needs to be made.
  • Names decision makers in own environment and cites examples of past decisions.
  • Describes types of decisions incumbent may and may not make in own job or function.

Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP): Knowledge of the process, issues and considerations for systematically managing distribution of inventory for multiple plants or warehouses; ability to apply related knowledge and experience in real practice. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Works with real-time inventory software, moving supplies to where needed, when needed.
  • Interprets the impact of bottlenecks and delays on operating costs.
  • Follows processes and applies technologies for items and inventory management.
  • Assists in solving issues related to distribution to meet orders or inventory replenishment requirements.
  • Works with basic distribution requirements planning (DRP) processes and operations.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviours. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviours without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Inventory Management - MFG: Knowledge of processes and methods of inventory management; ability to effectively manage local or distributed inventories of raw materials, work-in-progress and finished goods. Level Basic Understanding:

  • Identifies basic tools and approaches for inventory management.
  • Describes basic functions and reports needed for inventory management.
  • Cites examples of seasonal considerations and adjustments to planned versus actual inventory.
  • Describes basic benchmarks for inventory management.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
  • Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
  • Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
  • Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
  • Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Additional Info

  • This position requires to work in 6PM – 3AM shift.

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of India which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers).

What You Will Get:Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world. Here you earn more than just wage, because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day one benefits along with the potential of a variable bonus. Additional benefits include paid annual leave, flexi leave, medical and insurance (prorated based upon hire date).

Final Details:Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status.

If you are interested in joining our team, please apply using an English version of your CV. We look forward to meeting you! job.title: Senior Client Acquisition Manager (Public Sector)
job.description:
Responsibilities

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Challenger Sales Representative to join our team. As a Challenger, you will play a key role in driving sales growth by challenging customers' thinking, providing valuable insights, and guiding them toward innovative solutions. The ideal candidate is assertive, confident, and excels in complex sales environments.

  • Challenge customer assumptions by proactively engage customers in thought-provoking conversations to challenge their assumptions and broaden their perspective.
  • Provide new insights and industry knowledge that position our products/services as innovative solutions.
  • Lead sales discussions with confidence and take control of the conversation to guide customers through the decision-making process.
  • Conduct in-depth research to understand the customer's business, needs, and challenges.
  • Tailor solutions to address specific customer pain points and demonstrate a deep understanding of their unique requirements.
  • Act as an educator by teaching customers something new about their industry, market trends, or potential areas for improvement.
  • Provide valuable insights that position our offerings as strategic assets.
  • Build and maintain long-term partnerships and develop trusted advisor relationships with key executives and stakeholders at all levels of an organization.
  • Holds ownership of bigger sized portfolio revenue and account matrix.
  • Develop new business with existing clients and/or identify areas of new opportunities, present, negotiate and close to meet sales quotas.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional internal departments to ensure that clients requirements are understood and met.
  • Assist with challenging client request or issue escalation as needed.

Requirements

  • At least Diploma in any discipline with preference for technology related discipline and minimum 6 years’ sales experience in telco and solutions selling
  • In-depth knowledge of telco & system integrator environment will be preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to challenge customer thinking and provide unique insights tailored to the specific needs and challenges of enterprise and government clients.
  • Strong understanding of complex sales cycles and the ability to navigate procurement processes within enterprise and government organizations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and establish trust at the executive level.
  • Confidence in leading sales conversations and taking control of the sales process, especially in engagements with enterprise or government decision-makers.
  • Proven success in meeting or exceeding sales targets in a service-oriented and solution-based sales environment.

job.title: Service Delivery Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Service Delivery Manager is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end delivery of services to clients, ensuring high-quality performance, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement. This role combines client and stakeholder engagement, operational excellence, and financial oversight to drive service success and business growth.

Job Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management a. Build and maintain strong client relationships as the primary point of contact for service-related matters. b. Manage client expectations, inquiries and escalations effectively. c. Collaborate with clients to understand their needs, gather feedback and ensure satisfaction and retention.

Service Improvement d. Continuously evaluate service delivery processes to identify improvement opportunities e. Drive initiatives to enhance service quality and improve customer satisfaction. f. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices to implement

Sales Support g. Partner with the sales team to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts h. Support the development of proposals and presentations to demonstrate service value. i. Provide insights from client interactions to help refine sales strategies.

Financial Management j. Manage service delivery budgets, ensuring cost-effectiveness and optimal resource allocation. k. Monitor financial performance, analyze variances, and implement corrective actions where necessary.

Risk Management l. Identify potential risks and issues related to service delivery and implement mitigation plans. m. Ensure compliance with relevant regulations, standards and organizational policies.

Reporting & Documentation n. Prepare and deliver regular service performance reports to clients and management. o. Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation, including service processes, policies and operational manuals.

Qualifications

i. Minimum 8 years proven Service Delivery experience in the IT industry in similar capacity. ii. Experience managing client relationships and service performance. iii. Proven experience in Service Delivery, Operations and Account Management roles. iv. IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL) certified and experience in application of the framework. (required) v. Certification in Customer Success Management will have added advantage.

job.title: ICT Engineer (Loyang)
job.description:
About the Role

As CBRE Information & Communications Technology Service Delivery Technician, you will provide on-site support for the ICT and Engineering services within the Data Center environment.

This job is part of the Critical and Technical Services job function. They are responsible for technical maintenance services in critical client environments.

What You’ll Do:

  • Receive, review, and complete IT equipment installation, relocation and decommission requests within timeframes and to industry standards.
  • Provide problem-solving support. This includes server reboots, backups, visual inspections, etc.
  • Escort third-party engineers and ensure their compliance with the site standards.
  • Receive, respond, and assign break and fix tickets within the agreed timeframe or escalate if they cannot be resolved.
  • Ensure that on-site documentation including work-related standard operating procedures are created, reviewed & updated whenever there is an instruction or process change.
  • Receive, assess, and complete patching and de-patching requests.
  • Develop a good working relationship with all members of staff and client representatives.
  • Provision and fault diagnosis and rectification of network channel connectivity, installation, relocation & decommissioning of IT equipment, and general engineering maintenance & housekeeping of the critical services.
  • Ensure a safe and healthy working environment while maintaining a professional image.
  • Use existing procedures to solve straightforward problems.
  • Impact through clearly defined duties, and methods and tasks are described in detail.
  • Deliver own output by following defined procedures / processes under close supervision and guidance.

What You’ll Need:

  • Training in a Technical discipline having served an apprenticeship or equivalent with 1-2 years of job-related experience. In lieu of a diploma, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
  • Must meet the physical requirements of this role.
  • Ability to follow basic work routines and standards in the application of work.
  • Communication skills to exchange straightforward information.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
  • Strong organizational skills with an inquisitive mindset.
  • Basic math skills. Ability to calculate simple figures such as percentages, discounts, and markups.

job.title: Cyber Security Engineer
job.description:
About us

We’re growing, not slowing, here at Macquarie Technology Group because we’re passionate about doing things differently. We want to challenge the industry and look for better ways of doing things. As a team, Macquarie Government are hardworking, results and success focused. We also take the time to celebrate our success and make sure our people are doing work that makes a difference.

We believe that collaboration & team connection is key for success. This role will be based in Canberra on-site with one of our clients.

We require security clearance for this role you must be an Australian citizen to be eligible to obtain a security clearance or ideally already hold NV1 security clearance.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Security Engineer to join our growing cyber security team in Canberra. This opportunity is ideal for someone with around 18 months to 4 years' experience in a SOC or cyber security environment who has hands-on experience with Splunk log onboarding, use case development, detection engineering and security monitoring.

You'll play a key role in onboarding and normalising log sources, building and tuning detections, investigating alerts, and supporting incident triage and response activities across customer environments. We're looking for someone who understands how security data flows into a SIEM, can work through detection logic, and enjoys improving visibility and security outcomes through well-designed use cases and analytics.

Working alongside experienced cyber professionals, you'll continue to develop your skills across Splunk, detection engineering, threat monitoring and incident response while supporting environments that genuinely matter. If you're curious, proactive, and eager to grow your technical capability in a high-performing team, this could be a great next step in your cyber security career.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Security Engineer to join our growing cyber security team in Canberra. This opportunity is ideal for someone with around 18 months to 4 years' experience in a SOC or cyber security environment who has hands-on experience with Splunk log onboarding, use case development, detection engineering and security monitoring.

You'll play a key role in onboarding and normalising log sources, building and tuning detections, investigating alerts, and supporting incident triage and response activities across customer environments. We're looking for someone who understands how security data flows into a SIEM, can work through detection logic, and enjoys improving visibility and security outcomes through well-designed use cases and analytics.

Working alongside experienced cyber professionals, you'll continue to develop your skills across Splunk, detection engineering, threat monitoring and incident response while supporting environments that genuinely matter. If you're curious, proactive, and eager to grow your technical capability in a high-performing team, this could be a great next step in your cyber security career.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Monitoring, triaging, investigating, and responding to security alerts and incidents within our Security Operations Centre (SOC)
  • Onboarding and integrating new log sources into Splunk, including writing and tuning data inputs, parsing configurations, field extractions, and validating data quality
  • Developing, refining, and optimising Splunk searches, dashboards, alerts, and detection logic to improve threat detection capability
  • Investigating security events, identifying patterns, determining severity, and escalating incidents in line with established playbooks and procedures
  • Contributing to the continuous improvement and uplift of SOC processes, runbooks, and detection logic
  • Collaborating with internal cloud, network, endpoint, and engineering teams to improve log coverage and security monitoring across environments
  • Keeping up with the evolving threat landscape and bringing practical ideas to improve the team’s capability

About You

  • A degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
  • 18 months to 4 years of hands-on SOC experience, including practical experience onboarding, validating, and tuning log sources in Splunk
  • Strong working knowledge of common attack techniques, threat indicators, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework, with the ability to apply this knowledge during investigations
  • Experience working with security technologies such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, endpoint detection tools, cloud security platforms, and related monitoring tools
  • Confident analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex security events and make sound escalation decisions
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain incidents, risks, and findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Nice To Have

  • Splunk certifications (e.g., Splunk Core Certified User or Power User)
  • Exposure to SOAR platforms or security automation
  • Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Relevant industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, or equivalent

If this role excites you Apply Now!

job.title: Senior Director, Projects & Programs, APAC
job.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Position Overview

The Senior Director, Projects & Programs plays a critical role in helping APAC deliver its most important business priorities. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, President’s Office this leader is responsible for overseeing the successful delivery of strategic programs and initiatives across the region while leading the APAC Program Management Office (PMO).

This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, partnering closely with senior leaders across the business to ensure initiatives are appropriately planned, governed and delivered. The successful candidate will help bring structure, visibility and accountability to key programs, enabling teams to execute effectively and achieve meaningful business outcomes.

The ideal candidate is an experienced program leader who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and has a proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives across multiple countries and stakeholder groups.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Program Delivery

  • Lead the execution of APAC's highest-priority strategic initiatives and scale M&A
  • Partner with business leaders to define program objectives, delivery plans, timelines and success measures
  • Establish clear milestones, accountability and reporting mechanisms to ensure successful delivery
  • Monitor program progress and proactively address risks, dependencies and potential roadblocks
  • Support leaders in driving initiatives from planning through implementation and realization of business outcomes
  • Report progress of strategic programs to management and board

APAC Program Management Office (PMO)

  • Lead and evolve the APAC PMO, establishing consistent standards, tools and methodologies across the region
  • Develop best practices for project and program delivery that enable scalability and transparency
  • Drive effective governance, reporting and decision-making processes across the program portfolio
  • Foster a culture of strong program management discipline, accountability and continuous improvement
  • Facilitate alignment across multiple stakeholders, teams and workstreams
  • Build strong working relationships that enable collaboration and effective decision-making
  • Support resolution of issues that require coordination across functional boundaries

Executive Reporting & Business Insights

  • Develop high-quality executive updates, dashboards and program reporting materials

job.title: Senior Director, Testing & Commissioning (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

About the role

This role is to support our development of Data Center projects in Australia. They will work as part of the STACK Data Centre Australia team and be responsible for the management of commissioning of mission critical equipment, start-up, and testing, as well as managing our staff and CxA consultants for all our projects in Australia.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide leadership for the execution of commissioning to meet our standards.
  • Manage projects and Cx teams in progress and future projects as directed. This will include all commissioning related design, contractual and financial aspects in consultation with STACK management.
  • Look for opportunities to streamline the commissioning process without compromising on the quality required.
  • Participate in the procurement of CxA Consultants for our projects including managing this process.
  • Management of STACK commissioning staff in Australia. Creation of CxA RFP proposal documentation as instructed.
  • Overall management of CxA Consultants with your STACK Cx staff.
  • Review of CVs and recommend employment of new staff. Staff removal will need to be done in conjunction with the VP of commissioning.
  • Manage training of staff in the execution of their duties. Ensuring commissioning delivery is correct.
  • Conduct regular reviews of STACK staff at minimum every quarter.
  • Create operational standards and practices for staff to follow in line with STACK requirements.
  • Conduct design review process with our Engineering team.
  • Provide support with the review of the Cx schedule with GC, CxA and STACK internal stakeholders. Comment on the schedule where required.
  • Provide support for the development and review of equipment and system test scripts as needed.
  • Provide support for the development, review and approval of Cx L4 and 5 test scripts.
  • Review all reports issued by our CxA. These include all design reviews, Load-bank plans, IST intent, IST method statement, IST interim and final reports ETC.
  • Conduct planning for upcoming projects on the commissioning strategy and how this is to be implemented. Resources and Cx equipment to be outlined in any strategy creation.
  • Participate in the procurement of LLE equipment, skid and containerized solutions. for our projects alongside our procurement team.
  • LLE Vendor coordination and management during procurement, including technical analysis of the commissioning scope.
  • Identify scope gaps in procurement of LLE equipment, skid and containerized product with Procurement/Delivery team.
  • Participate in our off-site skid integration.
  • Participate in our off-site containerized solutions.
  • Create off-site commissioning procedures.
  • Endeavor to seek prefabricated solutions for electrical/mechanical systems to encourage building and commissioning with speed for our projects.
  • Management and attendance to factory witness testing as required in consultation with VP of commissioning.
  • Ligase with the Operations team to gain a good understanding of their requirements at handover.
  • Support design specification review, manufacturer submittals, single line drawing sets, and project schedule documentation.
  • Look to improve Cx Alloy system for STACK use.
  • Manage the STACK commissioning equipment that includes load-banks, load-bank cabling, PQA and data loggers.
  • When required look to procure additional commissioning equipment.
  • Ensure safe work practices are followed by all participants on the commissioning team at the customer site.
  • Engage with STACK customers to ensure positive experience, goal achievement, schedule adherence and questions answered.
  • Manage the STACK customer CxV Consultant with your STACK Cx staff.
  • Attend PCG meetings as required.
  • Provide support to other regional projects as instructed.**

job.title: Manager - Cell Maintenance
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Ensure that all maintenance procedures for PERC technology comply with safety standards and protocols, focusing on handling and processing sensitive components like passivation layers.

Innovation:

  • Driving continuous improvement by leading R&D efforts to develop advanced solar technologies and identifying market trends to maintain a competitive edge.

Digitalization/Data-Driven Decision Making:

  • Overseeing the implementation of digital tools and smart technologies to optimize manufacturing processes and enhance data-driven decision-making across the organization.

  • Leading effective change management strategies to guide the organization through transitions, ensuring smooth adoption of new processes and technologies.

People Development:

  • Leading from the front & being accountable for the professional growth of your teams. Developing/conducting/promoting training & learning initiatives to enhance skills & empowering them to take ownership of key processes and decisions.

PERC Technology Management:

  • Oversee maintenance operations specifically for PERC (Passivated Emitter and Rear Cell) solar cells, focusing on the unique aspects of this technology, such as passivation layers and rear surface treatment.

Issue Diagnosis and Repair:

  • Address and resolve issues related to PERC cell performance, including troubleshooting problems with passivation layers, rear surface contact, and overall cell efficiency.

Preventive Maintenance:

  • Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules tailored to the specific needs of PERC cells, such as ensuring the integrity of the passivation layer and rear contacts.

Quality Assurance:

  • Ensure that maintenance practices uphold the high standards required for PERC cells. Perform detailed inspections to verify the condition of passivation layers and rear surface contacts..

CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions):

  • Identify and address specific issues affecting PERC cells, such as degradation of passivation layers or rear contact problems, and implement corrective and preventive measures to enhance cell performance.

Team Leadership:

  • Lead and coordinate the maintenance team in handling PERC cells, providing specific guidance on handling and maintaining passivation and rear contact systems.

Performance Monitoring:

  • Track performance indicators specific to PERC cells, such as efficiency metrics and degradation rates of passivation layers, to optimize maintenance strategies and improve cell longevity.

  • 12-14 Years of experience in cell maintenance, with specific experience in PERC technology.

job.title: Senior Manager

job.title: Senior Legal Counsel
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading provider of sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure across Asia Pacific. Backed by Stonepeak, a global alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has over US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital from some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Since our founding in 2020, we have rapidly scaled across key Asia markets, operating 31 data centers with over 1.8GW of secured IT power. We operate as a regional platform delivering consistent global standards, combining scale with strong local execution across every market.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

About the role

  • *

Reporting to the General Counsel, the Lawyer will serve as a trusted legal advisor supporting Digital Edge's growth across Asia Pacific. The role will be responsible for leading and advising on complex strategic transactions, including mergers and acquisitions, project financing, joint ventures and corporate development initiatives, while providing practical legal support to business leaders across multiple jurisdictions.

The Lawyer will operate as a business-oriented partner, balancing legal risk with commercial objectives in a fast-paced and evolving environment. The successful candidate will work closely with senior executives, finance, development, investment, commercial and operations teams, as well as external counsel and key stakeholders throughout the region.

This role will be based in Singapore and will support transactions and projects across Asia Pacific, with a particular focus on Japanese-speaking counterparties and stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

Mergers & Acquisitions and Strategic Transactions

  • Lead legal support for acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures, investments and broader corporate development activities across Asia Pacific.
  • Manage transaction execution including legal due diligence, structuring, negotiation, documentation and completion processes.
  • Partner closely with internal stakeholders and external advisors to identify risks, propose solutions and facilitate successful execution of strategic transactions.
  • Support post-acquisition integration activities and ongoing governance matters.

Project Financing and Development

  • Advise on complex project financing transactions, including debt financing, security arrangements, intercreditor agreements and related financing documentation.
  • Support the development and expansion of Digital Edge's data center portfolio by providing legal guidance on investment, construction and infrastructure-related matters.
  • Work closely with finance and development teams to structure transactions that support growth objectives while appropriately managing legal and commercial risk.

Commercial and Corporate Legal Support

  • Draft, negotiate and advise on a wide range of commercial agreements, including customer contracts, supplier arrangements, technology agreements, confidentiality agreements and strategic partnerships.
  • Provide legal advice on corporate governance, regulatory compliance and general commercial matters across the region.
  • Monitor legal and regulatory developments that may impact Digital Edge's business and provide practical recommendations to stakeholders.

**

Stakeholder Management and Business Partnership

  • Build strong relationships with business leaders and become a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders.
  • Coordinate and manage external counsel to ensure high-quality, cost-effective legal support.
  • Deliver clear, concise and commercially practical advice to support efficient decision-making.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of legal processes, templates and governance frameworks that support a rapidly growing organization.

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate:

Experience

  • Approximately 8 years of post-qualification legal experience gained from a leading law firm and/or multinational organization.
  • Strong experience advising on cross-border mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures and other strategic corporate transactions.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex project financing and infrastructure-related transactions.
  • Prior in-house legal experience within a multinational corporation, infrastructure platform, real asset business or similarly complex environment.
  • Experience in data centers, infrastructure, energy, telecommunications or private equity-backed businesses would be advantageous but is not essential.
  • Candidates with prior in-house experience within a keiretsu-equivalent organization, such as a large, group-affiliated conglomerate, are preferred.

Communication and Languages

  • Fluent Japanese and English language skills, with the ability to negotiate, draft and communicate effectively with Japanese and international stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal issues in a clear and practical manner to non-legal audiences.

Personal Attributes

  • Commercially minded with strong business judgement and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.
  • Highly organized and capable of managing multiple priorities and transactions simultaneously.
  • Confident operating independently while collaborating effectively across functions and geographies.
  • Resilient, adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Strong integrity, professional judgement and attention to detail.

Education

  • Bachelor of Laws (LLB), Juris Doctor (JD) or equivalent legal qualification.
  • Qualified to practice law in a recognised jurisdiction.
  • Additional qualifications in finance, business or related disciplines would be advantageous.

Key responsibilities

**

  • Develop and implement procurement strategies that are aligned with organizational goals and ensure cost-effectiveness, quality, and timely delivery.
  • Lead the procurement team in sourcing goods and services, consultants, long-lead equipment, general contractors, and specialist contractors incl. contract negotiations, and supplier performance management.

The successful candidate:

  • Bachelor’s degree of Engineering in Electrical/Mechanical.

  • Strong negotiation, analytical, and contract management skills.

job.title: Principal Technical Specialist, Telco IP Core
job.description:
What You'll Do

  • Develop, maintain and drive adoption of architectural guidelines and technical standards for the Telco IP Core network.
  • Chair the Solutions Review Board – IP Core, Technical Review Board – IP Modernisation, and Change Review Panel – IP Core, ensuring solution and change decisions align with architecture principles, risk requirements and operational impact.

What makes you perfect for the role?

  • Many years’ experience in IP network engineering, including at least 5 years in a leadership role and experience delivering complex engineering solutions and large projects.
  • Deep understanding of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS and routing and switching technologies, with strong experience in Telco IP Core architecture design and governance.
  • Proven ability to develop and enforce architectural standards and guidelines, with a strong understanding of Internet governance, standards bodies and industry forums.
  • Familiarity with emergency services network requirements, including E000, and experience working with regulatory, legislative and contractual obligations.
  • Strategic communication, executive reporting, influencing and conflict-management skills, with the ability to work autonomously and build collaborative relationships across a matrix environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field. A Master’s degree, network certification such as CCNP/CCIE, or experience with automation frameworks such as Netconf/YANG or Ansible is desirable.

job.title: Solution Architect
job.description:
What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end solution architecture across the automation and observability platform, from initial problem framing through to design sign-off and delivery oversight.
  • Define how our platform integrates with vendor systems (Cisco, Nokia, Juniper), cloud providers, and internal OSS/BSS, establishing API integration patterns and standards that scale across the platform.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, run proof-of-concept initiatives, and make clear recommendations on technology selection, vendor capability, and build vs. buy decisions.
  • Translate complex network operational requirements into coherent, maintainable platform architectures, ensuring solutions address performance, reliability, security, and operational coverage.
  • Work across Optus teams and external partners to align architectural decisions with business strategy, network roadmaps, and engineering standards (TM Forum, TOGAF, IETF).
  • Provide architectural governance: review designs from the engineering team, set integration standards, and ensure consistency across the platform.
  • Mentor engineers on architecture practice and platform thinking, and represent the team in cross-functional design forums and vendor engagements.

What You Bring

  • Tertiary qualifications in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years in solutions architecture, enterprise architecture, or senior platform engineering, with meaningful experience in a telco, network, or large-scale infrastructure environment.
  • Strong grasp of telco system integration, including OSS/BSS platforms, network management systems, and how vendor products connect into operational workflows via RESTful and event-driven APIs.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture principles: API design, microservices, service decomposition, and how to structure systems that are maintainable at scale.
  • Familiarity with network automation concepts and southbound integration with network devices (NETCONF, gNMI, model-driven programmability) sufficient to evaluate and govern solutions without implementing them directly.
  • Experience evaluating and integrating cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) into network or operational technology stacks.
  • Working knowledge of IP networking: routing protocols (BGP, IS-IS, OSPF), MPLS, segment routing, and transport network design.
  • Exposure to AI/ML in operational contexts (intent-based automation, anomaly detection, closed-loop assurance) and an ability to assess where it adds genuine value.
  • Architecture standards experience: TOGAF, TM Forum eTOM/Open APIs, or equivalent.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills; able to present architectural trade-offs clearly to engineering teams, senior leadership, and external vendors alike.

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration, plus $80 monthly credit, 25% off Optus products and exclusive shopping discounts with our retail partners — making everyday life a little more affordable.

job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Singtel’s Group Cybersecurity team is looking for a motivated cybersecurity professional to support the planning, architecture review, governance and delivery of key cybersecurity platforms across the enterprise.

In this role, you will support cybersecurity platform refresh and deployment initiatives, working closely with internal Business Units, technology teams, procurement, finance and external vendors. You will help ensure that cybersecurity solutions are designed, delivered and transitioned into operations in line with security, compliance and business requirements.

The role is suited for someone with strong cybersecurity fundamentals, good project coordination skills, and the ability to work across technical and non-technical stakeholders in a complex enterprise environment.

Make an Impact by

Cybersecurity Engineering & Architecture

  • Support cybersecurity planning, architecture, engineering and governance across security platforms and services.
  • Review solution designs, technical proposals and implementation plans against security, infrastructure and operational requirements.
  • Support the design and integration of security infrastructure, systems, networks and supporting technologies.
  • Identify opportunities to standardise, integrate and automate cybersecurity capabilities and processes.
  • Maintain technical documentation, architecture standards and operational handover requirements.

**

Security Platform & Project Delivery

  • Support cybersecurity initiatives including vulnerability management, privileged access, secure remote access, host and network security, and other security platforms.
  • Coordinate platform refreshes, deployments, migrations, testing and operational handover with Business Units and vendors.
  • Support platform lifecycle activities including upgrades, capacity, resilience, maintenance and technical-risk remediation.
  • Track project milestones, dependencies, risks, issues and key technical decisions.

**

Infrastructure & Network Security

  • Support security engineering across servers, operating systems, virtual infrastructure and network environments.
  • Support network-security capabilities including firewalls, segmentation, secure connectivity and remote access.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, system, network and security-platform integration issues.
  • Support secure configuration, vulnerability remediation and security hardening activities.

**

Vendor, Tender & Financial Management

  • Support RFP/RFQ and tender activities including requirements development, technical evaluation, vendor clarification and proposal assessment.
  • Work with vendors to manage technical deliverables, implementation activities and service commitments.
  • Support budget planning, expenditure tracking and financial governance for cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Manage technology lifecycle considerations including licensing, maintenance, support renewals and capacity requirements.

**

Skills for Success

  • Experience in cybersecurity, infrastructure, systems or network security.
  • Good understanding of servers, operating systems, networking, firewalls, VPNs, routing, switching and segmentation.
  • Experience supporting cybersecurity platforms, infrastructure deployments or technology refreshes.
  • Ability to review technical designs and troubleshoot system, network and integration issues.
  • Experience working with vendors and supporting technology procurement, tender or commercial activities.
  • Good project coordination, stakeholder management, analytical and communication skills.

Good to Have

  • Experience with vulnerability management, privileged access, endpoint security, network security or other enterprise cybersecurity platforms.
  • Experience with Linux/Windows administration, virtualisation or data-centre infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with scripting, APIs or infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with RFP/RFQ, budgeting, licensing and vendor management.
  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCNA/CCNP, ITIL, PMP or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance requirements in large enterprise or critical-infrastructure environments.

job.title: Product Quality Engineer, Hardware Infrastructure
job.description:
Meta is seeking a Product Quality Engineer responsible for developing and implementing robust manufacturing and quality processes for the next generation of disruptive AI hardware products. As the technical owner, you will take primary responsibility for specifying manufacturing and test requirements for Advanced Compute, Accelerator and GPU platforms. You will oversee end-to-end manufacturing readiness for New Product Introduction (NPI), guiding projects from prototype phase through to high-volume Mass Production (MP) launch. Working closely with external manufacturing partners and internal cross-functional groups like Design Engineering, you will define standards to ensure line readiness, facilitate smooth NPI builds, and enable scalable execution. Furthermore, you will hold responsibility for meeting core manufacturing metrics, conducting failure analysis, and executing corrective actions to maintain high efficiency and quality. This is a full time position and reports to the Manager of Product and Quality Engineering as part of the Hardware Quality Engineering team.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement manufacturing processes for Meta open compute hardware technologies by applying knowledge of product design, fabrication, assembly and testing
  • Ensure product and process quality targets are met by designing test methods, establishing standards and driving continuous improvement projects with Meta manufacturing partners and key commodity suppliers
  • Spearhead cross-functional troubleshooting across rack and system-level hardware, maintaining ownership of the Major Issue List. Execute rigorous Failure Analysis and Corrective Actions (FACA) to solve underlying technical problems and achieve quality yield goals
  • Early engagement with Meta Engineering teams to implement robust DFx requirements and ensure products meet cycle-time, cost, quality and yield targets
  • Drive the continuous evaluation and advancement of test coverage, methodologies, and infrastructure to maximize hardware reliability, performance, and scalability across the product lifecycle
  • Conduct First Article and Source Inspections reviews on Meta hardware components and assemblies
  • Create BOMs, engineering change notifications, and manufacturing process changes through product lifecycle management tools

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS in Electrical, Mechanical, Material Science or equivalent
  • 10+ years of experience in manufacturing and test for Compute, Storage or Network Hardware products
  • Deep technical understanding of hardware architecture, with proven expertise in defining requirements, testing, and validating high-performance compute and GPU systems
  • Experience with manufacturing test solutions for Server & Storage hardware products
  • Experience with new product introduction and manufacturing operations
  • Knowledge of quality methodologies and tools
  • Problem solving and communication skills
  • Ability to travel internationally as required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Scripting skills in Bash, Perl, or Python
  • Knowledge of Server & Storage Hardware technologies, experience on HW AI products

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

job.title: Facilities Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

Assists with the maintenance and repairs of plant equipment, buildings and grounds.

Key Responsibilities

Monitors the functioning of building systems including electrical, Heating, Ventilation, and Air Condition (HVAC), structural, mechanical, fire/life safety, etc. Leads project management and oversees contractors for moderately complex facilities renovation projects entailing mechanical, structural, Heating, Ventilation, and Air Condition (HVAC), electrical, production floor arrangement, etc. Documents repairs and maintenance completed. Advises technicians and line workers on basic repairs and maintenance requirements.

Competencies:

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
