job.title: Incident & SLA Governance Manager
job.description:
Macquarie Park, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband, and digital solutions.

As Incident and SLA Governance Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in how we run service performance across our enterprise and government customer landscape. You’ll be the liaison for ITSM technology, delivery, vendor, and customers—governing critical service management processes to ensure alignment, accuracy, and impact.

You’ll guide the integration of Information Technology Service Management (ITSM) platforms such as ServiceNow, uphold ITIL standard processes, and lead all aspects of the Incident and SLA lifecycle across Optus Enterprise. Your insights will help craft seamless service experiences, champion a culture of continuous improvement, and keep teams performing at their best.

**

**

What you’ll do:

**

  • Lead and govern incident and SLA processes across internal teams, vendors, and customer environments
  • Act as the SME for all things Incident and SLA—process design, platform integration, reporting, and optimisation
  • Deliver and improve service management architecture and tooling to meet diverse enterprise and government client needs
  • Drive alignment to ITIL frameworks and champion continuous improvement initiatives
  • Build strong relationships across technical, delivery, and vendor governance teams
  • Translate service data into actionable insights through automated reporting
  • Handle and resolve service disruptions and escalate business-critical issues when needed

Your skills

**

  • Deep expertise in ITIL, Incident and SLA management, and enterprise service design
  • Skilled at influencing and aligning diverse stakeholders through a customer focussed lens
  • You thrive in complexity, bringing clarity and consistency to high-impact operational processes

  • Hands-on experience in incident and SLA governance in complex ICT environments
  • Solid understanding of vendor governance and ITSM integration
  • ITIL certification (Foundation or higher)
  • Experience working in or alongside outsourcing environments
  • Good communication, documentation, and relationship-building skills
  • High emotional intelligence and problem-solving capability
  • Experience turning contracts into operational workflows
  • Demonstrable experience in leading change and change management
  • Australian Citizenship
  • Baseline Federal Government clearance (desirable)

**

What’s in it for you?

**

  • Competitive remuneration and colleague discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and outstanding shopping discounts with our retail partners
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home

job.title: Finance Operations Manager
job.description:
Meta is seeking an experienced Finance Operations Manager within the APAC Revenue Operations team. You will serve as a strategic partner and subject matter expert across Order-to-Cash (OTC), revenue risk and controls, and financial governance for the APAC region. You will be expected to think critically and creatively, problem-solve, drive high-impact initiatives end-to-end, and influence global process design and tooling as a regional advocate.

Responsibilities

  • Revenue Risk & Strategy: Identify, assess, and mitigate revenue-related risks across APAC markets; provide strategic recommendations on credit and collections policies and operational controls
  • Portfolio Management & Regional Oversight: Own and manage a defined portfolio of APAC markets and/or business lines end-to-end — including revenue operations performance, credit exposure, collections health, and client risk profiles. Proactively monitor portfolio KPIs, surface emerging risks and opportunities, and drive data-informed decisions to optimize working capital outcomes. Serve as the single point of accountability for your portfolio's financial health, coordinating across billing, credit, collections, and cash application to ensure seamless OTC execution and escalation management
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Foster cross-functional partnerships with sales, legal, policy, tax, and controllership teams to drive solutions on revenue, billing, credit, collections, and emerging compliance challenges
  • Operational Excellence & Automation: Champion Meta's broader strategy to drive operational efficiencies and support business growth through technological advancements, and to encourage the implementation of new systems and tools, such as predictive dashboards and digital finance technologies like analytics, machine learning, and robotic process automation
  • Change Management & Compliance: Lead change initiatives for new regulatory requirements across APAC, partnering with internal and external stakeholders to maintain compliance in a dynamic landscape in the APAC region

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of significant and relevant experience in two or more of the following: Order-to-Cash operations, revenue accounting, financial controls, risk management, or controllership — within large, fast-growing, multinational companies
  • Expert-level understanding of OTC processes (credit, collections, billing, cash application) with demonstrated breadth in at least one adjacent area: revenue risk and controls, governance, internal audit, or revenue accounting

job.description:

In this role, you will drive the end-to-end deployment of subsea network services across Meta's wide-area network, ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of the systems that connect Meta's data centers and edge sites worldwide. You will work at the intersection of network engineering and large-scale infrastructure operations, translating complex network requirements into deployed, production-ready solutions.

You are expected to operate as a recognized domain expert across the organization, shape the team's long-term strategy, lead programs with VP-level visibility and company-wide impact, and define multi-year roadmaps with full autonomy.

As a Data Engineer at Meta, you will shape the future of people-facing and business-facing products we build across our entire family of applications (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Reality Labs, Threads). Your technical skills and analytical mindset will be utilized designing and building some of the world's most extensive data sets, helping to craft experiences for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses worldwide.

In this role, you will collaborate with software engineering, data science, and product management teams to design/build scalable data solutions across Meta to optimize growth, strategy, and user experience for our 3 billion plus users, as well as our internal employee community.

You will be at the forefront of identifying and solving some of the most interesting data challenges at a scale few companies can match. By joining Meta, you will become part of a data engineering community dedicated to skill development and career growth in data engineering and beyond.

Data Engineering: You will guide teams by building optimal data artifacts (including datasets and visualizations) to address key questions. You will refine our systems, design logging solutions, and create scalable data models. Ensuring data security and quality, and with a focus on efficiency, you will suggest architecture and development approaches and data management standards to address complex analytical problems.

Product leadership: You will use data to shape product development, identify new opportunities, and tackle upcoming challenges. You'll ensure our products add value for users and businesses, by prioritizing projects, and driving innovative solutions to respond to challenges or opportunities.

Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will convince and influence your partners using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.

Responsibilities

  • Conceptualize and own the data architecture for multiple large-scale projects, while evaluating design and operational cost-benefit tradeoffs within systems
  • Create and contribute to frameworks that improve the efficacy of logging data, while working with data infrastructure to triage issues and resolve
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and data scientists to understand data needs, representing key data insights visually in a meaningful way
  • Define and manage Service Level Agreements for all data sets in allocated areas of ownership
  • Determine and implement the security model based on privacy requirements, confirm safeguards are followed, address data quality issues, and evolve governance processes within allocated areas of ownership
  • Design, build, and launch collections of sophisticated data models and visualizations that support multiple use cases across different products or domains
  • Solve our most challenging data integration problems, utilizing optimal Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) patterns, frameworks, query techniques, sourcing from structured and unstructured data sources
  • Assist in owning existing processes running in production, optimizing complex code through advanced algorithmic concepts
  • Optimize pipelines, dashboards, frameworks, and systems to facilitate easier development of data artifacts
  • Influence product and cross-functional teams to identify data opportunities to drive impact
  • Mentor team members by giving/receiving actionable feedback

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent
  • 7+ years of experience where the primary responsibility involves working with data. This could include roles such as data analyst, data scientist, data engineer, or similar positions
  • 7+ years of experience with SQL, ETL, data modeling, and at least one programming language (e.g., Python, C++, C#, Scala or others.)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Master's or Ph.D degree in a STEM field
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

job.title: Director, Facilities Security
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Director, Facilities Security is a leadership role, responsible for owning the safety, security, and compliance of the Data Centre physical infrastructure, equipment, and employees.

This role ensures that security measures are in place and functioning properly at an assigned data center location and also contributes to the development of security processes and policies and enforces adherence thereof across the team.

This role is accountable for the monitoring and maintaining access control systems, alarms, and surveillance platforms, as well as planning and coordinating extra protection and security for executive employees and or other high-risk individuals that visit a data center location.

Additionally, this role is responsible for fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture across the team(s) within their remit.

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities

  • Oversees daily operations for a team of Security Officers; includes regular duties such as planning, scheduling, submitting timesheets, organising, and directing execution of routine and special project work delegated by Security leadership.
  • Identifying and attracting prime talent by participating in the recruitment process, assessing qualifications, interviewing candidates, and hiring individuals to join the team.
  • Oversees the development, implementation, and enforcement of security protocols, policies, and procedures to protect the data centre, assets, and personnel.

Oversees Security teams by modelling professional conduct and adhering to security policies and safety regulations at the assigned work sites

  • Oversees the team members on how to fulfil the special / unique requirements for NTT GDC clients, and ensures requirements are met; includes maintaining a positive and professional demeanour, proper engagement, and establishing client relationships.
  • Manages the security operations team to ensure data centre and surrounding property is secure and not accessed by unauthorized personnel, or open to sabotage, vandalism or theft.
  • Manages compliance, security, and records integrity by shift and data centre for client shipping and logistics by performing regular audits and supporting Shipping and Receiving personnel.
  • Oversees the coordination of Security vendor onboarding indoctrination training in partnership with Deployment Services and Critical Facilities Operations.
  • Drives the operation of all security related systems on shift, such as access control, CCTV, digital video recording, photo badging, etc.
  • Gives input to the review utilisation and maintenance of security equipment.
  • Drives the preparation and review of periodic security reports to clients and internal leadership.
  • Organises and conducts predefined actions in emergency situations and renders first aid, in events ranging from fire, work accidents, to illness.
  • Accountable for overseeing documenting procedures and policies to ensure achievement of key responsibilities.
  • Accountable for the development and establishment processes and policies and enforcing adherence thereof.
  • Oversees the procurement of essential equipment spares and office supplies for designated staff and shift; this includes maintaining inventory levels and resources are readily available to support the team’s effective performance and daily operations.
  • Gives input to recommending improvements to recordkeeping software to capture accurate security officer activities.
  • Works across multiple areas to ensure that Security Guards are on shift meet all NTT GDC Grooming and Uniform Standards.
  • Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:

Familiarity with security management, preferably in a data centre or critical infrastructure environment Excellent knowledge of physical security systems, access control, surveillance technologies, and incident response procedures Recognition of leadership skills with the ability to learn to motivate and manage a team effectively Analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and mitigate security risks and vulnerabilities Excellent communicator (written and verbal), with ability to interact with stakeholders at all levels Functional in stressful situations, remaining calm while making critical decisions Able to navigate security technologies and computer systems, including access control systems, CCTV, and incident management software Familiar with occupational hazards and safety rules Excellent ability to coach and mentor a team of Security Guards Excellent ability to interact effectively with a variety of internal and external stakeholders by using their good collaboration and engagement skills Excellent ability to balance and plan the short-term and long-term actions of the team The excellent ability to manage time effectively while setting the tone of the team through modelling and leadership excellent customer service focus Excellent ability to work in a fast paced and deadline driven environment

Academic Qualifications and Certifications: Bachelor's degree or equivalent type of qualidation, or equivalent combination of work experience and occupational training / certifications Certifications such as Certified Protection Professional (CPP), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), or Physical Security Professional (PSP) are preferred CPR/First Aid Certification Occupational Health and Safety Act (OSHA) certification preferred Required Experience: Significant Law-Enforcement and/or Military Schooling, a plus Significant relevant experience in law enforcement, industrial, commercial, or governmental Significant relevant experience using security systems and tools, for example access control systems, CCTV etc. Significant experience developing experience in managing a team of Security Guards

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Specialist - Data Center Operations
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The role of Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance Engineer is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for working with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.

This role designs, plans, installs, and / or maintains mechanical, electrical, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability data center environments.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities

  • Designs, plans, installs, and/or maintains mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.
  • Works with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.
  • Ensures proficient understanding of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Analyzes current operating conditions and recommends new preventative and proactive methods for maintaining and monitoring facilities systems.
  • Evaluates facility standards and practices to improve maintenance procedures and ensure optimal operational efficiency.
  • Complies with organizational and governmental safety standards and coordinates response to emergency situations and ensures that corrective measures are rapid and thorough.
  • Participates in the planning and installation of new facility systems and may work with multiple components including HVAC systems, air or liquid cooling systems, CRAC/CRAH units, power distribution units, fire systems, life safety systems, etc.
  • Repairs all systems and monitoring and troubleshooting systems as problems arise.
  • Coordinates with building administration to ensure common area services are properly provided to client and list services.
  • Manages the feedback, response and corrective action (if any) process to address any client feedback and concerns on all facility matters.
  • Assists in ensuring facility assets and installations are accounted for and monitored within the relevant policies and reporting procedures.
  • Completes work order requests accurately and on time and within budget.
  • May be required to order parts and supplies for maintenance and repairs.
  • Assist in scheduling and supervising vendors/subcontractors during equipment / systems maintenance and service.
  • Provides recommendation of improvements to the operations and maintenance program on an on-going basis.
  • Provides any other engineering activities as required by the Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance management team.
  • Knowledge and Attributes:
  • Seasoned understanding of safe work practices, which are set by safety regulations and legislation.
  • Seasoned proficiency of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Seasoned knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite - Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Seasoned knowledge of CMMS systems.
  • Seasoned knowledge of critical facilities operations and maintenance.
  • Seasoned knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and life safety monitoring and control systems typically used in critical environments.
  • Ability to maintain a positive and professional working relationship with cross functional teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrates good analytical skills, having an ability to analyze, refine, summarize, and clearly present data and information.
  • Possesses passion for service, self-motivated, proactive by going beyond the call of duty and has an ability to handle multiple tasks.
  • Ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines and is comfortable working in a fast-paced and constantly evolving environment.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering or related field Trade Certification or state license in Electrical or Mechanical (HVAC) Professional affiliations (7x24 Exchange, IFMA, Data Center Pulse, etc.)

  • Experience required:
  • Seasoned experience working in a similar engineering role, preferably a data center environment.
  • Seasoned experience in electrical, HVAC, mechanical, controls, or other technical engineering and maintenance field.
  • Seasoned experience interpreting blueprints/CAD drawings.
  • Seasoned experience in facilities / building maintenance.
  • Seasoned experience in designing, planning, installing and / or maintaining mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.description:

Key participant in the testing process through test review and analysis, test witnessing and certification of software.

Develop software solutions by studying information needs; conferring with users; studying systems flow, data usage and work processes; investigating problem areas; following the software development lifecycle; Document and demonstrate solutions; Develops flow charts, layouts and documentation Determine feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, solution development and proposed solutions; Understand business needs and know how to create the tools to manage them Prepare and install solutions by determining and designing system specifications, standards and programming Recommend state-of-the-art development tools, programming techniques and computing equipment; participate in educational opportunities; read professional publications; maintain personal networks; participate in professional organizations; remain passionate about great technologies, especially open source Provide information by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing development and issues while protecting IT assets by keeping information confidential; Improve applications by conducting systems analysis recommending changes in policies and procedures Define applications and their interfaces, allocate responsibilities to applications, understand solution deployment, and communicate requirements for interactions with solution context, define Nonfunctional Requirements (NFRs) Understands multiple architectures and how to apply architecture to solutions; understands programming and testing standards; understands industry standards for traditional and agile development Provide oversight and foster Built-In Quality and Team and Technical Agility; Adopt new mindsets and habits in how people approach their work while supporting decentralized decision making.

  • Competencies: Security & Compliance Principles - Applies standards, tools, and best practices to embed security, privacy, and compliance into the design/build/test/operate lifecycle for products, services, apps, systems, software, and configurations—balancing protection, efficiency, and cost.
  • Programming Principles - Applies programming languages, frameworks, and patterns to design, write, configure, test, and maintain software/solutions/systems that are efficient, secure, scalable, and reliable.
  • Data Principles - Governs, models, secures, implements, and observes data flows to ensure integrity, quality, and compliance—enabling trusted, scalable, cost-conscious data use.

  • Fundamental IT technical skill sets;

Role Summary: The AI Engineer will design, build, validate, and deploy AI-enabled solutions that help Cummins teams convert complex operating, product, engineering, and business data into practical recommendations and intelligent workflows. This role will work closely with product owners, data scientists, data engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to deliver reusable AI capabilities across the Analytics and AI portfolio.

Skills

  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to design AI solutions for complex business and technical challenges.
  • Ability to bridge software engineering fundamentals with modern AI/GenAI technologies to deliver production-ready solutions.
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to explain AI concepts, architecture decisions, and technical recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Customer-focused mindset with the ability to understand business problems and translate them into scalable AI applications.
  • Strong technical leadership, mentoring, and decision-making capabilities in fast-paced and evolving technology environments.

  • Strong experience building, deploying, and maintaining AI-powered applications and intelligent agents.

  • Experience developing agentic AI workflows, multi-agent systems, and AI orchestration frameworks.

job.title: Migration Modernization Architect, Professional Services
job.description:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

Are you an experienced Cloud architect/developer who can assist our customers in Application modernization, Design and development of cloud native applications and/or re-engineering applications that can fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like to work on a variety of game changing projects, at the forefront of application development and cloud technology adoption? This role is open for Delhi/NCR. As an architect you would champion applications to be cloud optimized by making them well-architected ,enabling them to reap the benefits of elasticity, horizontal scalability, automation and high availability. You should have a knack of GenAI tooling to driving application modernization at scale with GenAI tools.

On the AWS platform services such as Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancing, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Amazon Elastic Container Services to name just a few, provide opportunities to design and build cloud ready applications.

AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands on technical architects to help accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. This is an opportunity to join Amazon’s world class technical teams, working with some of the brightest engineers while also developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies.

Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for internal customers and partners, providing collective experience from across the AWS customer base and are obsessed about success for the internal customers. Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to bring access to product and service teams, to get the right solution delivered and drive feature innovation based upon customer needs.

Amazon aims to be the most customer centric company on earth. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers critical applications for hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.

Key job responsibilities We are looking for hands on Mig and Mod (MM) Architects with:

  • Strong Consulting, client-facing (CXO) level communication driving cloud solutioning and leading technical workshops
  • Ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders into implementable solution adhering to well architected framework.
  • Problem-solving and analytical thinking driving envisioning , presales and be a thought leader in the domain driving Application discovery , Risk mitigation strategies, Performance testing and validation, Migration and Post-migration optimization
  • Deep expertise in large scale cloud migrations, and AWS infrastructure to drive complex cloud transformation journey from Onprem successfully modernizing them to help realize true value from cloud
  • Deep expertise in VMware technologies having worked on vSphere administration, vCenter management, NSX networking, vSAN storage, HCX for migrations, VMware Cloud on AWS
  • Ability to drive Migration discovery to Mobilize to lead and drive Migration and Modernization end to end.
  • Strong experience on Cloud Infra, network, Security and cloud resiliency (DR)
  • Ability to modernize application in .Net, Java, Python and get them out of legacy framework to realize true potential of cloud
  • hand-on experience in designing and developing web applications, APIs, microservices, and data integrations for cloud native applications
  • Knowledge of cloud-native design patterns, including microservices architecture and event-driven systems.
  • Demonstrated experience building scalable and highly available applications on AWS, leveraging services such as Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, etc.
  • Preferred experience in optimizing cloud-based architectures for scalability, security, and high performance.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments, with a strong focus on iterative delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to advise on and implement AWS best practices across application development, deployment, and monitoring

Additional Desired Skills:

  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
  • Scripting (Python, PowerShell)
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Programming Skill with Java, .Net
  • Container technologies
  • Database migrations
  • Knowledge of compliance frameworks
  • Multi-cloud experience

job.title: Technical Training Specialist, DCO, AWS Infra Operations
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Technical Training Specialist (DCO), you will be responsible for delivering technical training programs focused on IT infrastructure, server hardware, networking equipment, and break-fix operations for Data Center Operations teams. You will manage and conduct initial technical training programs for new hires, ensuring they are properly equipped with the knowledge and skills needed to operate, troubleshoot, and maintain AWS's sophisticated IT infrastructure within the data center environment.

Key job responsibilities Training Program Management

  • Design and deliver engaging instructor-led training sessions covering IT infrastructure operations, server hardware, networking equipment, and break-fix procedures
  • Manage all logistics of Initial Training programs, including scheduling, classroom coordination, and lab space utilization
  • Conduct hands-on training on server deployment, rack operations, hardware diagnostics, and component-level troubleshooting
  • Maintain and certify instructor qualifications and perform certification observations
  • Monitor trainee progress and address any behavioral or policy issues
  • Process training completions and maintain accurate training records

Learning Lab Management

  • Serve as Subject Matter Expert for all IT lab equipment and training facilities
  • Maintain and optimize training spaces, server racks, networking gear, and break-fix workstations
  • Develop and implement SOPs for lab equipment operation including servers, switches, routers, and cabling systems
  • Create practical training scenarios that simulate real-world IT hardware failures and break-fix situations
  • Support setup and commissioning of new training labs
  • Prepare lab equipment and spaces for upcoming training sessions

Program Development & Improvement

  • Collaborate with SMEs to develop/update training materials for IT operations
  • Identify and implement improvements to training content and delivery methods
  • Create training resources for hardware break-fix, network troubleshooting, and server operations
  • Stay current with latest technologies and practices

Job Title

Telstra Retail: Customer Service & Sales Consultant (Expression of Interest)

As a Retail Sales Consultant, you are passionate about delighting Telstra’s customers through outstanding customer service. You achieve this by providing an exceptional in-store customer journey, and through your collaborative approach you empower customers by identifying the products and services they need to transform their telecommunications experience.

Job Description

Ready to Make a Difference? Join Our Iconic Team at Telstra!

At Telstra, we’re more than just a leading telecommunications company—we’re where passion meets purpose. As a Retail Customer Service & Sales Consultant, you’ll have the opportunity to work for an iconic Aussie brand  that’s been connecting Australians for generations. You won’t just be a friendly face in-store—you’ll be the trusted expert who helps customers find tech solutions that enhance their lives. This is your chance to make a meaningful impact by bringing our purpose to life: to build a connected future so everyone can thrive.

Opportunities available across these locations:

  • ECHUCA
  • MILDURA
  • BROKEN HILL
  • SHEPPARTON
  • SHEPPARTON MARKET PLACE
  • SWAN HILL
  • ALBURY
  • WANGARATTA
  • WODONGA

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Deliver Exceptional Customer Experiences: Help customers find the right products and services to suit their needs, ensuring their time at Telstra is a memorable one.
  • Be the Go-To Tech Expert: Stay up-to-date with the latest gadgets and services, offering informed guidance and solutions.
  • Achieve and Excel: Use your consultative selling skills to meet and exceed sales targets and KPIs, while keeping customers connected.
  • Collaborate and Contribute: Work closely with your team to create a welcoming environment where everyone is supported to achieve store goals.

Salary and Benefits:

  • Generous Discounts: Enjoy 30% off Telstra services and exclusive offers with over 240 brands and partners.
  • Leave Options: Take advantage of 16 weeks of paid parental leave, the Telstra Extra Day Off, gender affirmation leave, Cultural Leave, Blood Donor Leave, and the ability to purchase up to 4 weeks of additional leave.
  • Training & Career Growth Opportunities: Access over 17,000 learning programs with LinkedIn Learning, and take advantage of a range of development opportunities designed to build your skills and support your career growth, helping you prepare for your next step.
  • Flexibility: We offer flexible working hours and a supportive approach to parental leave—do it your way!
  • Recognition & Rewards: Benefit from monthly performance rewards and a range of recognition programs to celebrate your success.
  • Inclusive Culture: Join a diverse and inclusive team where everyone’s unique perspective is valued and respected.

Is it You We’re Looking For?

  • Great Communication Skills: You’re a natural at connecting with people and making their day better.
  • Solution-Oriented Approach: You enjoy thinking on your feet and tailoring solutions for each customer.
  • Sales Drive: You’re motivated to achieve (and exceed!) sales targets and KPIs.

Job Summary

The Business Information Security Advisor (BISA) serves as an embedded cross business security leader driving security risk reduction and remediation outcomes across the organisation, focused on learning from incidents and addressing structural security debt.

Product, Network & Technology - Security & Operations is responsible for Telstra's security and operations, protecting Telstra's assets and infrastructure.

About you

You have experience translating security risks, incidents or control failures into practical remediation plans and driving sustainable improvements across large organisations. You are comfortable operating at executive levels, influencing decisions, and creating accountability for security outcomes that strengthen organisational resilience.

To be successful in the role, you must have:

  • Security leadership experience
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Influencing Skills
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Effective communication
  • Experience leading or coordinating post-incident remediation, security uplift or risk reduction initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive the remediation of significant security risks, control weaknesses and incident findings, ensuring clear ownership, accountability and timely resolution.
  • Partner with Security Operations and Cyber Defence teams to ensure incident learnings are translated into practical improvements that reduce the likelihood of recurrence.
  • Identify recurring security issues, systemic control gaps and patterns of risk across the function, and develop targeted prevention and uplift initiatives.
  • Facilitate collaboration between business, engineering and security teams to remove barriers to remediation and accelerate risk reduction outcomes.
  • Provide visibility of outstanding security issues, remediation progress and risk treatment decisions to functional executives and security leadership.
  • Champion a culture of continuous security improvement by converting security reviews, incidents, audit findings and assurance outcomes into actionable plans that strengthen resilience.
  • Drive prioritisation of security debt, legacy risks and control uplift activities that improve the organisation's long-term security posture.
  • Drive continuous security improvement by gathering stakeholder feedback on technology, process, and interactions – creating a feedback mechanism and shared understanding between Cyber Security, Security Engineering and the function.
  • Maintain awareness of industry advances in Cyber Security technology and changes in the Global Cyber Security Threat Landscape to provide contextual thought leadership to the function on potential risks and opportunities
  • Provide feedback on areas of opportunity to improve the Group's Cyber Security, Security Engineering, and Physical Security posture.
  • Reinforce a ‘Security first’ culture and mindset across the function's leadership team and drive a robust relationship between the Security Advisor and delivery teams.
  • Provide guidance and context on strategic Security (Cyber Security, Security Engineering & Physical Security) decisions.

job.title: Dynamics 365 Technical Architect
job.description:
Hello Visionary!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent handled company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. The Information Technology (IT) department has the global responsibility for the internal IT of Siemens Mobility. Its goal is to provide a robust and efficient IT landscape derived from business and market demands. Your personality and individuality make the difference. In our team, we increase business performance and point the way into the digital age. Is that exactly your thing? Then live your passion in a cross-location team in which you can actively craft the future of our company. You open up new possibilities for our customers with your competence. ALM and DevOps

Production Support

  • Troubleshoot critical issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis.
  • Drive performance, stability, and reliability improvements.

Technical Development

  • C# and.NET

Architecture and Design

  • Solution architecture and technical design

Integrations

  • REST APIs
  • Azure Functions
  • Azure Logic Apps
  • Azure Service Bus
  • Integration with enterprise applications

DevOps and ALM

  • Azure DevOps and Git

  • Release management and environment strategy

Leadership

  • Technical design reviews
  • Team mentoring
  • Stakeholder communication
  • Requirement analysis and estimation

Good-to-Have Skills

Microsoft Ecosystem

  • Copilot Studio

Enterprise Integration

  • ServiceNow integration

Architecture and Governance

  • Enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF
  • Power Platform Center of Excellence
  • Security governance

Industry Experience

  • Manufacturing
  • Mobility
  • Engineering
  • Professional services

Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert
  • Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
At Siemens, we’re continuing to grow - and we’re looking for an ambitious and customer-focused Territory Sales Manager to help us take our Medium Voltage business to the next level across Newcastle and the broader NSW market.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a global technology leader and play a key role in growing our presence across some of Australia’s most important and rapidly evolving industries, including Renewables, Water, Transportation, Data Centres and Resources.

You’ll take ownership of a high-potential territory, combining new business development with strategic account management to identify opportunities, build trusted customer relationships and deliver sustainable revenue growth.

You’ll represent Siemens’ market-leading Medium Voltage portfolio, including primary and secondary switchgear, ring main units up to 33kV, protection relays, Fusesaver, CMR overhead reclosing products and packaged electrical solutions.

Why Siemens?

At Siemens, we believe our people are at the heart of our success.

You’ll join a supportive, collaborative and rewarding environment where you’re encouraged to bring your ideas, develop your strengths and build a career that goes beyond your current role.

We place a strong focus on employee wellbeing, professional development and creating an environment where people can thrive. You’ll have access to training and development opportunities, exposure to a global organisation and the opportunity to work alongside talented people across different areas of the business.

Whether you want to deepen your industry expertise, broaden your commercial capabilities or progress into future leadership opportunities, we’ll support you in developing your career.

What you’ll do

  • Build and nurture long-term relationships with customers, consultants, EPCs and contractors, balancing new business acquisition with strategic account growth.
  • Identify and pursue new opportunities across Renewables, Water, Data Centres, Transportation and Resources.
  • Develop and maintain a strong sales pipeline, driving opportunities from initial engagement through to successful conversion.
  • Develop and execute 3–5 year strategic growth plans to expand Siemens’ market presence and pipeline across the territory.
  • Understand customer needs and develop tailored Siemens solutions across our Medium Voltage product and service portfolio.
  • Lead commercial and contract negotiations and work collaboratively with internal teams to deliver the right outcomes for customers.
  • Become a trusted point of contact for key customers, proactively addressing challenges and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across the infrastructure and industrial ecosystem.
  • Represent Siemens at industry events, seminars and roadshows, showcasing our technology and solutions.
  • Conduct face-to-face customer meetings, presentations and discussions to identify opportunities and drive adoption of Siemens solutions.
  • Provide market intelligence and regular updates to senior leadership on emerging opportunities, customer needs and competitive activity.

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for a commercially minded sales professional who is confident building relationships, opening doors and turning opportunities into results.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • 5+ years’ local sales experience within the Medium Voltage, electrical infrastructure or related industrial sector.
  • A strong understanding of the NSW industrial and infrastructure market. Experience across renewables, water, data centres, resources or major projects would be highly regarded.
  • Demonstrated success in business development, new customer acquisition and account management.
  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to develop trusted, long-term partnerships with customers and industry stakeholders.
  • Experience with contract, commercial and tendering processes.
  • Strong negotiation, presentation and communication skills, with the confidence to engage stakeholders at all levels.
  • An understanding of relevant Australian Standards and statutory requirements within the electrical industry.
  • A proactive, results-driven approach and the ability to work collaboratively across a diverse organisation.

What we offer

At Siemens, your career and wellbeing matter.

You’ll enjoy:

  • Competitive salary and bonus scheme
  • A supportive, inclusive and collaborative workplace culture
  • Genuine opportunities for career development and progression
  • Comprehensive training and development programs supporting both professional and personal growth
  • Opportunities to work with global teams and industry-leading technology
  • A strong focus on employee wellbeing
  • Volunteer days to give back to the community
  • The opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to projects shaping Australia’s future infrastructure

Diversity & Inclusion

At Siemens, we believe that diversity makes us stronger.

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can bring their authentic self to work, feel valued and have the opportunity to succeed. Our recruitment process is based on fair and balanced selection criteria, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require any reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process, please let us know.

job.title: Sales Manager Fire Suppression - Pan India
job.description:
We're enhancing the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings and industries!!

Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place - where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered reliably and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components and systems to connected, cloud-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solution.

Job Role -

Sales Manager – Fire Suppression will be responsible for driving the growth of the Fire Suppression business across India. The role will focus on Gas Suppression and High-Pressure Water Mist (HPWM) solutions across key market segments.

Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve Order Intake, Revenue and business growth targets.

Build strong relationships with key End Users, particularly in Data Centers and Industrial verticals.

Develop and maintain strong engagement with Consultants, EPCs, PMCs and System Integrators.

Leverage relationships with State Fire Departments and other key stakeholders.

Provide technical and application expertise on Fire Suppression systems, designs and relevant standards.

Identify new market opportunities, strategic projects and applications to expand the business geographically.

Develop partners and strengthen the Fire Suppression ecosystem across India.

The ideal candidate should be a go-getter with 15+ years of relevant experience, strong market relationships and a proven track record of building and growing project-based Fire Suppression business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Growth & Sales

o Develop and execute the national sales strategy for the Fire Suppression portfolio to achieve Order Intake and Revenue targets.

o Identify new market opportunities, applications and verticals to expand the Fire Suppression business.

o Develop a healthy sales funnel and ensure effective conversion of opportunities into orders.

o Drive business growth through direct engagement with end users, consultants, EPCs, system integrators and strategic partners.

o Identify and develop large projects in Data Centers, Industrial, Infrastructure, Transportation, Energy and other high-value segments.

  • End-User & Key Account Management

o Build and maintain strong relationships with key end users, especially in the Data Center and Industrial sectors.

o Develop strategic account plans for major customers and identify opportunities for specification and standardization of Siemens Fire Suppression solutions.

o Engage with decision makers at CXO, technical, project and procurement levels to create business opportunities.

  • Consultant & Stakeholder Engagement

o Establish strong relationships with Fire & Life Safety consultants, MEP consultants, EPCs and project management consultants.

o Drive product and system specifications with consultants and key influencers.

o Conduct technical presentations, solution workshops and product demonstrations.

o Develop relationships with government and infrastructure stakeholders including State Fire Departments to create opportunities and support project approvals/specifications.

  • Technical & Solution Knowledge

o Develop in-depth understanding of Fire Suppression systems, applications, design requirements and relevant codes/standards.

o Demonstrate strong technical knowledge of Gas Suppression systems and High-Pressure Water Mist solutions.

o Understand system architecture, hydraulic/design considerations, application suitability, equipment selection and project execution requirements.

o Work closely with Pre-Sales, Engineering, Product Management and HQ teams to develop technically and commercially competitive solutions.

  • Market & Competition

o Continuously monitor market trends, customer requirements, competitor activities and pricing dynamics.

o Develop strategies to improve Siemens' competitiveness and market penetration.

o Identify portfolio gaps and communicate market requirements to Product Management and HQ.

o Develop a clear understanding of competitors and their offerings in Gas Suppression and Water Mist markets.

  • Partner & Channel Development

o Identify, onboard and develop suitable Fire Suppression partners/System Integrators across key regions.

o Build partner capability through technical training, product training and joint customer engagement.

o Develop a scalable partner ecosystem to support national business growth.

o Monitor partner performance and develop corrective actions where required.

  • Project & Opportunity Management

o Drive strategic opportunities from lead generation through specification, tendering, negotiation and closure.

o Develop project strategies covering key stakeholders, competition, commercial positioning and win strategy.

o Ensure accurate opportunity management and funnel hygiene in Siemens Sales systems.

o Coordinate with internal stakeholders for pricing, technical support, approvals and project execution.

  • Business Development & Market Expansion

o Identify emerging applications for Fire Suppression, including Data Centers, BESS, Industrial facilities, tunnels, transportation, critical infrastructure and other high-risk applications.

o Expand the geographical footprint of the business by developing new customers, consultants and partners.

o Generate new business opportunities beyond the existing customer base and create a sustainable long-term growth pipeline.

  • Internal Collaboration

o Work closely with Regional Sales teams to drive execution of the national Fire Suppression strategy.

o Coordinate with Pre-Sales, Engineering, Operations, SCM, Finance, Product Management and HQ teams.

o Provide regular market intelligence, sales forecasts, funnel reviews and business updates to management.

Candidate Profile

  • Experience: 15 years of relevant experience in Fire Suppression / Fire & Life Safety / Building Safety solutions.
  • Strong experience in Gas Suppression and/or High-Pressure Water Mist systems; exposure to both portfolios will be preferred.
  • Strong technical understanding of Fire Suppression systems, design principles, applications, codes and standards.
  • Proven experience in selling complex project-based Fire Suppression solutions.
  • Strong existing network with Data Center and Industrial end users.
  • Experience working with consultants, EPCs, PMCs and system integrators.
  • Experience and established connect with relevant government/infrastructure stakeholders such as State Fire Departments will be highly valuable.
  • Strong commercial understanding, negotiation skills and ability to manage large strategic opportunities.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across India.

Key Competencies

  • Strong hunter / business development mindset
  • Go-getter with a strong ownership mentality
  • Strategic account development
  • Consultative and solution selling
  • Technical & application knowledge
  • Strong networking and stakeholder management
  • Commercial and negotiation skills
  • Ability to influence consultants and end users
  • Strong execution orientation
  • Ability to work independently and build a business from the ground up Success Measures

The role will be measured on:

  • Fire Suppression Order Intake and Revenue growth
  • New customer and end-user acquisition
  • Data Center and Industrial business development
  • Strategic project wins
  • Sales funnel creation and conversion
  • Consultant/specification development
  • Partner development and productivity
  • Geographic expansion
  • Growth of Gas Suppression and HPWM businesses
  • Market share and competitive positioning

This role is based in Mumbai/ Gurgaon/ Thane where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries - and the shape of things to come.

Make your mark in our exciting world of Siemens

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in across Gender, LGBTQ+, Abilities & Ethnicity. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow.

  • Healthcare
  • Pharmaceutical

  • Set clear objectives and priorities for team members and monitor performance.
  • Develop the team's sales, technical and business development capabilities.
  • Demonstrate strong leadership during challenging business situations and provide direction to the team.

  • Develop strategic plans to address market gaps and improve Siemens' competitive position.
  • Monitor competitor activities, pricing strategies, channel movements and market dynamics.
  • Develop long-term strategies for geographical and vertical expansion.
  • Translate market intelligence into actionable business initiatives.
  • Opportunity & Sales Governance
  • Ensure disciplined opportunity management and accurate sales forecasting.
  • Review regional sales funnel, pipeline coverage, order intake and revenue performance.
  • Drive timely closure of key opportunities and remove execution bottlenecks.
  • Maintain high-quality sales data and ensure compliance with Siemens sales processes and governance requirements.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with the sales team and channel partners.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be a high-energy sales leader with a strong track record of business growth and team leadership.

Experience

  • Minimum 15+ years of relevant experience in Fire & Life Safety, Building Technologies, Building Automation, Electrical/MEP, Industrial Automation or a related industry.
  • Strong experience in selling Fire Alarm Systems and/or Fire Suppression solutions.
  • Proven experience in managing Channel Partners, Distributors, System Integrators and Solution Partners.
  • Prior experience managing and leading a team of approximately 4–5 sales professionals.
  • Experience in developing large project businesses and strategic accounts is highly desirable.

Market & Customer Network

  • Strong established relationships with MEP Consultants, Architects, PMCs, EPCs, Developers and Key Customers.
  • Good understanding of the Fire Safety market, competitive landscape and channel ecosystem.
  • Strong network across key accounts and growth verticals such as Data Centers, Healthcare, Pharma, Industries and Transportation.

  • Business Development & Market Expansion
  • Channel & Partner Management
  • Strategic Account Management
  • Customer & Consultant Relationship Management
  • People Leadership & Team Development
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Problem Solving & Decision Making
  • Negotiation & Influencing Skills
  • Strong Execution Orientation
  • Commercial Acumen
  • Resilience and Leadership in Challenging Situations

Leadership Expectations

The successful candidate should be someone who:

  • Has a demonstrated track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.
  • Is passionate about driving sales, business growth and market development.
  • Takes ownership and demonstrates a strong bias for action and execution.
  • Can navigate complex and challenging business situations with maturity and confidence.
  • Acts as a problem solver, bringing practical and commercially viable solutions.
  • Can think strategically while maintaining strong focus on execution.

job.title: Critical Environment Technician Intern
job.description:
Overview

Join Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team – the engine behind our global cloud services. As a Critical Environment Technician Intern, you’ll play a vital role in supporting the infrastructure that powers products like Microsoft Azure, Office 365, Xbox, and OneDrive.

At Microsoft, we live our values by fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. This internship offers hands-on experience, professional growth opportunities, and access to training programs.

Our global network includes hundreds of datacenters and millions of servers serving over 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in more than 90 countries. Sustainability and operational excellence are at the heart of everything we do, and we’re looking for passionate individuals to help us deliver world-class cloud solutions.

Ready to make an impact? Join us and be part of the team that empowers billions worldwide.

Responsibilities

As a CET Intern, you will:

  • Work onsite at our datacenters in Melbourne.
  • Carry out basic operational tasks such as site rounds, recording observations, and taking measurements under supervision.
  • Learn to operate critical systems safely and professionally, with the opportunity to earn your Microsoft CET Level 1 certification.
  • Monitor and inspect facility equipment (HVAC, electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety systems) and report abnormal conditions.
  • Use our Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to track assets and manage work orders.
  • Assist with emergency monitoring and response following established procedures.
  • Support incident investigations by gathering data and contributing to root-cause analysis.
  • Participate in planned, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities, including preparing materials and administrative tasks.
  • Collaborate with senior technicians to troubleshoot complex systems.
  • Document maintenance and troubleshooting activities and escalate issues as needed.
  • Contribute to developing Methods of Procedure (MOPs) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for safe operations.
  • Conduct technical research on relevant topics to enhance your knowledge.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • Basic knowledge of electrical and/or mechanical systems
  • You need to be an Australian National or, have residency and you must be eligible to work in Australia.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Completed or studying towards a qualification in Facilities Management, Mechanical, Electrical engineering or related qualification.
  • Electrical or mechanical engineer diploma level 2
  • Ability to support frequent standing, walking, lifting, and working at heights with or without equipment assistance.
  • Able to communicate effectively with multiple stakeholders.
  • Proficient in written and oral English communication to support regional and global teams.
  • Desire to learn, grow, and develop new technical skills.
  • Flexibility to work non-standard business hours that may include weekends and/or holidays.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

job.description:
Overview

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a Critical Environment Program Manager

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a Critical Environment Program Manager you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 100 datacenters and 1 million servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Do you want to empower billions across the world? Come and join us in CO+I and be at the forefront of the action!

Service Delivery

Ownership

Qualifications

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

Who we are

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

You will lead a team of marketers across multiple countries and serve as a strategic partner to business, commercial, and sales leaders. How you will do it:

  • Serve as the regional champion for digitally enabled marketing programs, including SEO, paid media, marketing automation, social media, webinars, events, account-based marketing, and lead nurturing.
  • Partner with regional general managers, commercial leaders, in-country leaders to deliver impactful campaigns that deliver results along all stages of the customer lifecycle and drive demand across all channels to market including build and execute integrated go-to-market plans that drive awareness, pipeline, revenue growth, and customer retention.
  • Develop localized campaigns that translate global value propositions into market-relevant programs aligned to business, customer, and industry priorities.
  • Lead and develop a team of APAC-based marketing professionals.
  • Build and execute marketing programs that support the full customer lifecycle, including demand creation, lead generation, lead conversion, customer expansion, and account growth.
  • Collaborate with direct sales teams and channel partners to improve lead quality, lead management, pipeline progression, and revenue conversion.
  • Drive account-based marketing strategies for strategic accounts and priority customer segments.
  • Define and execute regional event strategies including virtual events, webinars, tradeshows, partner events, proprietary events, and networking activities.
  • Partner with channel leaders to develop partner marketing, co-marketing, and enablement programs that accelerate demand generation and business growth through distributors, resellers and other channel partners.

Preferred:

  • Experience with channel marketing, partner ecosystem development, and account-based marketing in a B2B environment.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package

job.title: Labour Compliance Executive
job.description:
Labour Compliance Executive (Contractual)

Johnson Controls is looking for a Labour Compliance Executive to support project compliance and subcontractor compliance activities across customer assignments. In this role, you will help prepare, submit, track, and close compliance documentation while working closely with customers, subcontractors, and internal teams.

Role Overview

You will be responsible for managing statutory and project-related compliance documentation end to end. The role combines customer coordination, subcontractor guidance, document control, audit support, and follow-up on remarks and approvals to help ensure compliance requirements are completed accurately and on time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Arrange initial calls or meetings with customers to understand their compliance process requirements and gather information on document submissions.
  • Prepare and provide compliance documents as per customer requests.
  • Ensure timely preparation, submission, and maintenance of all required compliance documents, both online and offline, in line with regulatory guidelines and internal policies.
  • Track customer remarks on submitted compliance documents and coordinate the required corrections or responses.
  • Obtain audit reports related to compliance submissions from the customer site and maintain the related records.
  • Conduct introductory calls with subcontractors to explain the billing process and compliance expectations.
  • Guide subcontractors in accordance with JCI HR SOP and customer requirements.
  • Review subcontractor compliance documents against the checklist and identify gaps or non-compliance.
  • Coordinate with the JCI Project Team, SCM Team, and subcontractors to address non-compliance and drive closure.
  • Obtain Compliance Manager approval for reviewed compliance documents and share the approved status with the subcontractor.
  • Support BOCW, CLRA, and ISMW related licenses and returns.
  • Maintain knowledge of minimum wages, labour laws, PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, and related compliance requirements.
  • Support implementation of the new wage code for subcontractors and vendors.

How You Will Do It

  • Take ownership from intake to closure, keeping every compliance case accurate, traceable, and submitted on time.
  • Stay close to the work by clarifying requirements directly with customers and subcontractors before issues become delays.
  • Work with discipline and attention to detail when handling checklists, registers, remarks, approvals, and audit records.
  • Use candor and problem-solving to flag gaps early, resolve non-compliance quickly, and improve the process over time.
  • Collaborate as one team with project, SCM, HR, and compliance stakeholders while still working independently and managing priorities effectively.

Qualifications

  • 3 to 7 years of experience in labour compliance, statutory compliance, project compliance, or subcontractor compliance.
  • Graduate degree in HR, Commerce, Business Administration, Social Work, or equivalent experience.
  • Good communication skills, with local language proficiency mandatory.
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, manage tasks effectively, and meet deadlines.
  • Good working knowledge of MS Office, especially Word and Excel.
  • Working knowledge of BOCW, CLRA, ISMW, PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, minimum wages, and labour law compliance.
  • Understanding of customer-facing compliance documentation, audit follow-up, and internal control requirements.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting project compliance and subcontractor compliance in a customer-facing environment.
  • Exposure to compliance checklists, audit reports, and remark closure workflows.
  • Familiarity with third-party or contractual project environments.
  • Experience with new wage code implementation for subcontractors and vendors.

If this sounds like the right fit for your background, we’d like to hear from you.

At Johnson Controls, we're shaping the future of smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. You'll be supported by a highly experienced engineering and technical team, gain exposure to diverse customer environments, and have genuine opportunities to progress into senior technical, engineering, project delivery, or leadership positions.

  • Access to specialist local and global engineering support

About the Role

Due to continued growth across Victoria, we're seeking a skilled BMS Technician to join our Melbourne Service Team.

This role will see you working across a portfolio of commercial buildings, healthcare facilities, critical infrastructure, industrial sites, and other complex customer environments. You'll be responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, optimising, and supporting Building Management Systems that play a critical role in our customers' operations.

You'll enjoy a high level of autonomy while being backed by one of the strongest technical support networks in the industry.

Key Responsibilities

  • Service, maintain and troubleshoot Building Management Systems (BMS) and HVAC control systems
  • Deliver small/medium projects
  • Diagnose and resolve system, network and communication faults
  • Deliver preventive maintenance and reactive service activities
  • Optimise system performance and identify improvement opportunities
  • Support minor upgrades, retrofits and enhancement projects
  • Commission and validate control system modifications
  • Develop trusted customer relationships through exceptional technical service
  • Adhere to all safety, quality and compliance requirements

What We're Looking For

We're interested in hearing from technicians who have experience working within Building Automation, Building Controls, HVAC Controls, Electrical Controls, or related industries.

Ideally You Will Have

  • Minimum 3 years' experience in Building Management Systems or Building Automation
  • Experience with BMS platforms such as Metasys, Siemens, Schneider Electric, Delta Controls, Alerton, Tridium Niagara, Honeywell, Distech, Schneider EcoStruxure or similar systems
  • Strong understanding of commercial HVAC systems and mechanical services
  • Electrical Disconnect/Reconnect Licence (or equivalent)
  • Experience with IP networking, communications protocols, and system integration
  • Strong troubleshooting and fault-finding skills
  • Excellent customer engagement and communication skills
  • Commitment to safety and continuous improvement
  • Current Australian Driver's Licence

Build a Long-Term Career with Johnson Controls

Many of our leaders, engineers, and technical specialists started their careers in field service. We actively promote from within and provide clear pathways for career progression.

If you're looking for more complex systems, better career opportunities, stronger technical support, and the backing of a global organisation that values its people, this is an excellent opportunity to take the next step in your career.

Only applicants with Australian working rights will be considered.

Pre-employment checks, including reference checks, medical assessments, criminal history checks, and drug and alcohol screening, form part of our recruitment process.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Johnson Controls, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and better outcomes. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to succeed.
