job.title: Engineering Manager
job.description:
Title:Engineering Manager

Overview: Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to lead the design, development, delivery, and ongoing support of a .NET-based web application. This role will provide both people leadership and technical direction for a team of software engineers, partnering closely with Product Owners, Architects, QA, UX, DevOps, security, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, high-quality digital capabilities. The Engineering Manager will be accountable for team performance, engineering execution, technical standards, delivery commitments, and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, RESTful APIs, Azure platforms, modern web application architecture, Agile delivery, and a proven ability to mentor engineers, manage priorities, resolve technical risks, and align engineering outcomes with business goals.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing engineering team responsible for building, enhancing, and supporting the application.
  • Own engineering execution across the software development lifecycle, including solution design, development, code quality, testing, release readiness, deployment, support, and production stability.
  • Provide technical direction for application architecture, development, RESTful APIs, integrations, database design, security, scalability, reliability, and performance.
  • Partner with Product Owners, Architects, QA, UX, DevOps, security, operations, and business stakeholders to translate business priorities into clear technical plans and delivery milestones.
  • Drive engineering best practices, including clean code, design patterns, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, source control, observability, documentation, and secure development standards.
  • Manage delivery commitments, sprint or release planning, dependency resolution, risk mitigation, resource allocation, and workload balancing for the engineering team.
  • Review technical designs and implementation approaches to ensure solutions are maintainable, extensible, performant, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
  • Support troubleshooting of complex application issues, production incidents, performance bottlenecks, integration failures, and quality defects.
  • Coach engineers through regular feedback, career development conversations, goal setting, performance reviews, skills development, and succession planning.
  • Participate in hiring, onboarding, team planning, vendor coordination, and capability building to ensure the team has the right skills and capacity to meet delivery objectives.
  • Promote a collaborative, accountable, inclusive, and continuous improvement-oriented engineering culture focused on customer value and operational excellence.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, including hands-on development of enterprise web applications using Microsoft technologies.
  • 3+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing software engineering teams, including performance management, delivery ownership, and technical guidance.
  • Strong proficiency with .NET framework and Azure platform, RESTful services, object-oriented programming, design patterns, and asynchronous programming.
  • Experience designing, developing, and operating scalable, secure, maintainable web applications and backend services in a modern enterprise environment.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL Server or other relational databases, including data modeling, query optimization, stored procedures, and application data access patterns.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, including services such as App Services, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, storage, identity, monitoring, or related platform capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Git-based source control, branching strategies, automated testing, build and release practices, DevOps tooling, and application monitoring.
  • Ability to review architecture and code, guide technical decision-making, address technical debt, and ensure engineering standards are consistently applied.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with Product Owners, Architects, QA, UX, DevOps, security, operations, vendors, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, problem-solving, coaching, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • Preferred qualifications include Microsoft Azure or .NET certifications, experience with microservices, containerization, frontend frameworks such as Angular, React, or Blazor, and ecommerce or B2B web application experience.

job.title: O&M - Wind - Performance/Diagnostics
job.description:
Performance Monitoring & Analytics

  • Monitor WTG Availability, Fleet Availability, Generation Performance, and Productivity KPIs against targets.
  • Perform daily, weekly, and monthly fleet performance analysis using SCADA and operational data.
  • Identify generation losses due to turbine faults, deration, yaw misalignment, blade degradation, pitch issues, and operational inefficiencies.
  • Monitor underperforming WTGs and recommend corrective actions.
  • Develop performance dashboards, reports, and management MIS for fleet review.
  • Benchmark fleet, turbine models, sites, and OEM performance.

Diagnostics & Failure Analysis

  • Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major failures and repetitive breakdowns.
  • Analyze turbine alarms, fault logs, event histories, and SCADA trends.
  • Review blade, gearbox, generator, pitch, yaw, converter, hydraulic, and main bearing performance data.
  • Identify early warning signs of equipment deterioration and failure.
  • Support closure and validation of OEM diagnostic findings.
  • Develop diagnostic frameworks and standard methodologies for fleet-wide application.

Reliability & Condition Monitoring

  • Monitor condition monitoring systems (CMS) and health indicators.
  • Track equipment reliability KPIs including MTBF, MTTR, failure frequency, and recurring defects.
  • Identify bad actors and reliability concerns across the fleet.
  • Support predictive maintenance and condition-based maintenance initiatives.
  • Maintain failure databases and reliability performance records.

Fleet Improvement Initiatives

  • Drive generation enhancement and availability improvement programs.
  • Identify and quantify performance loss opportunities.
  • Support implementation of engineering modifications and retrofit recommendations.
  • Track effectiveness of corrective actions and improvements implemented across the fleet.
  • Facilitate knowledge sharing and replication of best practices across sites.

Technology & Data Analytics

  • Drive implementation of advanced analytics and digital diagnostic tools.
  • Develop automated dashboards and visualization tools using Power BI and analytics platforms.
  • Support AI/ML based predictive maintenance initiatives.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy, and integrity across SCADA and monitoring systems.
  • Evaluate new technologies and proof-of-concepts related to turbine diagnostics and performance improvement.

Audits & Governance

  • Support fleet performance audits and technical assessments.
  • Track closure of performance-related observations and action items.
  • Maintain documentation of RCAs, diagnostic reports, and performance studies.
  • Ensure adherence to internal performance monitoring and reporting standards

Qualifications

Education Qualification:

B.E./B.Tech/Diploma - Electrical or Electronics or relevant to Energy Sector

MBA - Advantageous

Work Experience:

6-8 years of experience ( If Diploma holder: additional 2-3 Y Exp. req.)

job.title: ICT Support Specialist
job.description:
About us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia's leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities.

Headquartered in Canberra with multiple facilities in the ACT, NSW, VIC and New Zealand, CDC's diversified operations provide secure data centre configurations that support co-location, containerised and hyperscale compute environments with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone's unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world's best data centre team.

Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the role

The ICT Support Specialist works across a broad range of technologies, providing advanced technical support to end users while contributing to the administration and maintenance of CDC ICT environment. The role combines senior service desk responsibilities with systems administration capability, ensuring incidents are resolved efficiently while supporting the ongoing reliability, security and performance of the organisation's IT infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide advanced IT support for hardware, software, network, application, and end-user issues, including managing escalations and ensuring excellent customer service.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex incidents and service requests while maintaining accurate ticketing, documentation, and communication.
  • Administer and support core infrastructure, including Windows Server, Active Directory/Entra ID, Group Policy, DNS, networking, file services, and endpoint management.
  • Manage and support corporate ICT assets, including laptops, desktops, printers, mobile devices, MDM solutions, and business applications such as Microsoft Office.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to deliver projects, upgrades, migrations, technical documentation, and continuous service improvements.
  • Provide leadership and mentoring within the ICT team, supporting junior staff, sharing technical knowledge, and contributing to a positive team culture.

About you

  • Minimum five years' experience in senior Service Desk, ICT Support or Systems Administration role
  • Strong experience with Microsoft 365, Entra IS (Azure AD), Exchange Online, SharePoint, Intune and supporting Windows 10/11 desktop environments
  • Sound understanding of networking fundamentals (LAN, WAN, DNS and TCP/IP)
  • Experience managing ICT assets and endpoint devices, participating in infrastructure projects and technology implementations.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving capabilities

Essential:

Australian Citizenship and ability to obtain an NV1 Security Clearance. This role is a fully onsite role.

What's in it for you:

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy -Mark your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC's offers staff and their family's inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

How to Apply:

If you are looking for an opportunity to play a vital role in a fast-growing Australian Technology company and be part of our amazing team, please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

job.title: Intern, Corporate Social Responsibility (Jan - Jun 2027)
job.description:
About Us

CapitaLand Group (CapitaLand) is one of Asia’s largest diversified real estate groups. Headquartered in Singapore, CapitaLand’s portfolio focuses on real estate investment management and real estate development, and spans across more than 270 cities in over 45 countries.

Job Description

About Us

At CapitaLand, we believe in making a positive impact by building resilience through enriching lives and uplifting communities where we operate. CapitaLand Hope Foundation (CHF), the philanthropic arm of CapitaLand Group, was established in 2005 to deepen the company’s community development commitment and contribute towards education, health and well-being initiatives targeting children, youth and seniors. Going beyond donations, the company also advocates volunteerism as an integral part of building a caring and inclusive community. We actively leverage our resources and networks to galvanise our staff, business partners and tenants to build an ecosystem of doing good together, amplifying the direct impact of our contributions to the communities.

About the internship

The Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Intern will be part of the Group CSR Team to work with like-minded individuals to drive social impact across CapitaLand Group of businesses as part of our global efforts to be an advocate for the social causes that we are passionate about.

What You Will Get to Do

  • Assist in the in the planning and execution of CSR/CHF initiatives in Singapore, including the coordination with internal stakeholders, community partners and volunteers in programme design, ensuring alignment with funding focus areas, and tracking programme outcomes during implementation
  • Assist in the implementation of business improvement initiatives including digitalisation of business processes, data cleaning and management
  • Assist in the content development, design and management of CSR/CHF communications materials such as videos, website, intranet, promotional literature, EDMs and presentation slides, as well as support the collection of impact stories to drive social awareness and support for the causes
  • Assist in volunteer recruitment, coordination and management of CSR/CHF projects in Singapore
  • Assist with CSR/CHF report preparation including data collection and analysis
  • Any duties assigned

What We Are Looking For

  • Team player with good communication, interpersonal and organisation skills
  • Curious, resourceful and meticulous with good analytical skills and ability to multitask and manage multiple timelines independently
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with good command of English. Knowledge of Chinese language will be advantageous when liaising with stakeholders in China if required
  • Good digital media and IT knowledge and skills such as basic design tool and MS Office – Word, Excel and Powerpoint, and able to create good presentation content for reporting and storytelling
  • Great project and event management experience and skills will be useful
  • Strong interest in CSR and community development with some community service experience will be beneficial
  • Able to commit for at least 6 months for the internship will be preferred

Closing Statement:

At CapitaLand, we advocate fair employment practices, and recruit talents based on merit and fit with our Corporate values. We provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and build an inclusive workplace regardless of race, gender, age, religious belief or nationality.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: Data Center Technician (Shift pattern)
job.description:
Overview

Location: Schiphol

This role involves working a 6 day shift rotation covering shifts 06:00-14:30, 14:30-12:00(midnight) and 12:00(midnight) - 06:00.

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will develop an understanding of standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning equipment under the guidance of more experienced Data Center colleagues. This opportunity will allow you to develop an understanding of our Data Center environment, familiarize yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process. Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services.

As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

  • Contributes to issue tracking through escalations, asking questions, and seeking guidance on timely resolution of issues from more experienced technicians.
  • Participates in daily safety briefings, completes required training aligned to the role and workload including safety training, and complies with safety procedures (e.g., equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use).
  • Completes assigned tickets efficiently and in alignment with Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) while meeting established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with guidance from other technicians.
  • Complies with security and data management procedures and policies with guidance from other technicians and completes the required security training.
  • Maintains a strong client focus to understand the impact of their work when completing tickets and assigned tasks.
  • Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work.
  • Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and ownership of the data centre facilities.
  • Embodies our culture and values.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Completed High/Secondary School, GED, an apprenticeship/vocational qualification, or equivalent experience, with basic knowledge of computer hardware and components.
  • Work Schedule: Ability to work shifts, including evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Transportation: Valid driver’s licence and access to a personal vehicle for travel to client sites and company locations as part of shift responsibilities._*This role requires you to be on-site and the location has limited public transport. Your own form of transport is advised._

Background Check Requirements

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is mandatory for this role. These include, but are not limited to:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: Must be passed upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
  • Applicable certifications such as:
  • CompTIA: A+, Server+, Network+
  • Basic Structure Cabling (BSC)

Data Center Technicians ATR-B - The typical base pay range for this role across Netherlands is € 42,600.00 - € 55,000.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.

job.title: Officer - Tool Room
job.description:
To ensure maximum availability, reliability, and performance of plastic injection moulds by effectively managing preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, spare parts planning, mould life monitoring, and technical improvements. The role will provide dedicated toolroom support for critical projects and ensure timely resolution of mould-related issues to minimize production downtime and improve tooling life.

Responsibilities

  • Perform timely preventive and corrective maintenance on plastic injection molds.
  • Prioritize and attend to mold breakdowns, coordinating with internal and external resources to minimize downtime.
  • Conduct systematic troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for repetitive mold failures.
  • Maintain accurate records of mold history, maintenance, breakdowns, and life data, adhering to ISO documentation standards.
  • Monitor mold life and cavity condition, preparing renewal or refurbishment plans as needed.
  • Plan and manage critical mold spare parts to ensure quick availability during breakdowns and maintenance.
  • Coordinate with external toolrooms and vendors for mold repairs, modifications, and technical improvements.
  • Review and assess the technical feasibility of mold modifications in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Support mold trials after repairs or modifications, ensuring successful handover for production.
  • Develop contingency plans for critical molds to maintain production continuity during major breakdowns.

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in the plastic injection molding industry.
  • Strong knowledge of mold systems, including cores, cavities, sliders, lifters, and hydraulic components.
  • Proficiency in reading and interpreting 2D mold drawings, assembly drawings, and component drawings.
  • Familiarity with basic toolroom manufacturing processes such as grinding, milling, drilling, and EDM.
  • Understanding of ISO systems, maintenance standards, and safety requirements.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  • Effective communication and coordination skills to collaborate with internal and external teams.
  • Ability to work independently and manage time effectively, prioritizing tasks to meet deadlines.
  • Willingness to support emergency and off-shift activities to ensure production continuity.
  • A proactive approach to continuous improvement and a commitment to maintaining high toolroom standards.

Certifications such as:

The Disaster Recovery Operations Analyst II is responsible for developing, maintaining, and testing disaster recovery capabilities that enable recovery of critical business services following outages, cyber incidents, infrastructure failures, or other disruptive events. Industry certifications such as:

job.title: Project Executive - Cloud - Products
job.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Product Program Manager to drive and manage key initiatives around Lead-to-Cash (L2C) process simplification, Order Management system enhancements, and data migration.

The role will work closely with Product, Business, Technology, Operations, Sales, Finance, and Service Delivery teams to identify improvement opportunities, drive system development, manage cross-functional dependencies, and ensure successful adoption of new ordering capabilities.

A key responsibility will be end-to-end ownership of data migration and data readiness required for new ordering journeys and system enhancements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Program manage Lead-to-Cash simplification and Order Management transformation initiatives from planning through implementation.
  • Identify process gaps, manual interventions, and improvement opportunities across the L2C and ordering journey.
  • Coordinate with Business and Technology teams to define requirements and drive PRD development for system enhancements.
  • Own the overall program plan, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and stakeholder communication.
  • Drive execution of multiple cross-functional initiatives and ensure timely delivery of committed outcomes.
  • Own end-to-end data migration activities, including data assessment, mapping, cleansing, data building, validation, reconciliation, and migration to target systems.
  • Coordinate with business and technology teams to ensure data readiness for new products, customers, services, and ordering journeys.
  • Drive UAT, rollout, production readiness, and post-deployment stabilisation.
  • Track adoption of new system capabilities and drive resolution of process, system, and data-related gaps.
  • Prepare regular program dashboards, status reports, management updates, and risk/issue tracking.
  • Ensure successful transition from legacy/manual processes to new digital ordering journeys.

Key Skills & Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in Program Management, Product Management, Business Analysis, or Digital Transformation.
  • Strong experience managing cross-functional technology/business programs.
  • Good understanding of Lead-to-Cash / Order-to-Cash and Order Management processes.
  • Hands-on experience in data migration, data mapping, data validation, reconciliation, and data readiness.
  • Experience creating PRDs, business requirements, user stories, and functional requirements.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Experience working with Agile/technology teams and enterprise applications.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, planning, and execution skills.

Preferred

  • Experience in Telecom, Cloud, Managed Services, or IT Services.
  • Exposure to CRM, Order Management, Provisioning, Billing, or Service Management platforms.
  • Experience managing large-scale system transformation and migration programs.
  • Exposure to data analysis and enterprise data management.

Required Skills

  • cloud
  • project implementation
  • project lifecycle management
  • order management
  • order management system
  • data migration
  • data readiness
  • product management
  • lead to cash
  • order to cash

job.title: 24/7 Data Centre Technician (Industrial Electrical/HVAC) - Relocate to Melbourne
job.description:
Make your mark in this exciting opportunity to work at Australia and New Zealand's leading data centres.

With CDC continuing to grow across Australia, we're expanding our search to New Zealand and are keen to connect with trade-qualified candidates who are actively looking to relocate to Melbourne, Australia.

We're seeking qualified Electricians and HVAC/Refrigeration Mechanics with experience in commercial or industrial environments. Experience working in critical infrastructure, mission-critical facilities, or data centres will be highly regarded.

We also have a growing footprint in Auckland, New Zealand. While we are not actively recruiting for these positions in Auckland at this stage, we're always keen to connect with strong candidates and build our talent pipeline for future opportunities.

Please note, due to security restrictions we can only pursue applicants who hold current New Zealand Citizenship.

  • Relocation assistance will be provided for successful applicants.
  • Tailored CDC Learning Academy and hands-on training provided
  • 24/7 Shift Roster over 8 days - 2 days, 2 nights- 4 days off (Hours are 6-6)
  • Location: Laverton in Melbourne's Western Suburbs**

About Us

CDC Data Centres is Australasia’s leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities. Headquartered in Canberra with multiple facilities across ACT, NSW, VIC, WA and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide secure data centre configurations that support co-location, containerised and hyperscale compute environments with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team. Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the Role

At CDC, our Service Technicians work in live data centre environments, supporting the operation of mission‑critical infrastructure.

If you’ve spent time in electrical, HVAC, or industrial environments, a lot of this will feel familiar. Working to procedures, taking safety seriously, and understanding the impact of your work is critical. A data centre applies those same principles to power, cooling, fire systems and monitoring, all operating continuously. The difference is the environment, the scale, and the opportunity to apply your skills in a stable, growing industry.

We welcome people from a range of technical backgrounds and provide training and support to help you apply your existing skills in a more operational, monitoring‑focused environment.

What you’ll be doing day‑to‑day:

  • Monitoring and responding to alarms and alerts across power, cooling, and fire systems
  • Performing physical inspections to ensure equipment and infrastructure are operating within defined parameters
  • Responding to faults and incidents, prioritising actions, and determining when escalation or contractor support is required
  • Carrying out operational switching and control activities to prevent unplanned outages
  • Supporting planned maintenance and monitoring contractors on site, ensuring strict adherence to safety procedures and approved methods of operation
  • Documenting incidents, maintenance activities, and observations to support continuous improvement

This role works on a rotating 24/7 shift roster (2 days, 2 nights, 4 off) and suits individuals who are comfortable making decisions, following defined processes, and working calmly in high‑reliability environments.** Benefits, Training and Offerings:**

Our training program provides tailored content through our CDC Academy, specifically designed for individuals starting out in this role. You'll learn hands-on by shadowing and working alongside our experienced Service Technicians, gaining essential knowledge to develop your skillset.

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy -Make your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.**

About You

We're looking for individuals who are in a position to move to Australia as soon as possible, or ideally before the end of the year.

Ideally, you'll be a qualified Electrician or Refrigeration Mechanic with proven experience in large-scale industrial or technical environments. Experience working in critical infrastructure is highly regarded and will be a strong advantage.

Desirable experience:

  • A trade or technical background in Electrical, Refrigeration/HVAC, Mechanical, or a related field (highly desirable)
  • Experience working in critical or high‑availability environments with strong safety and compliance requirements
  • Exposure to monitoring or control systems such as BMS, EMS, or SCADA‑type platforms
  • Familiarity with complex infrastructure or plant equipment (e.g. HVAC systems, power systems, generators, fire systems)
  • Strong fault‑finding, problem‑solving, and situational awareness skills
  • The ability to produce clear documentation, logs, and post‑incident reports

Essential:

New Zealand Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a NZ Security Clearance.** How to Apply:**

If you're looking to be part of Australia and New Zealand's leading large-scale data centre innovator, submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.** Closing Date:** Applications close on Sunday, 4th October 2026. Please note: We will be reviewing applications as they come through and actioning suitable candidates before this date.

job.title: Connectivity Engineer
job.description:
Make your mark in this exciting opportunity to work at Australia and New Zealand's leading data centres.

  • Grow your career in fibre cabling and network infrastructure maintenance
  • Hands-on and ongoing training provided
  • Site Based Role | Free on-site Parking

About us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia and New Zealand's leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities.

Headquartered in Canberra with multiple facilities in the ACT, NSW, VIC and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide secure data centre configurations that support co-location, containerised and hyperscale compute environments with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team.

Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the role

Joining our Networks Operations team, this role is responsible for the installation and maintenance of network and optical equipment, while managing day-to-day fibre patching to ensure consistent and high-quality service delivery.

You’ll support carrier partners in establishing and maintaining their presence within our facilities, contributing to reliable connectivity and strong stakeholder relationships.

Other responsibilities include:

  • Maintain and monitor fibre optic and network equipment, responding to alarms and alerts using monitoring tools.
  • Provide expert connectivity advice and support to internal and external stakeholders, including fault finding assistance.
  • Perform preventative maintenance and act as a Subject Matter Expert across data centre operations.
  • Manage and update network topology, asset records, and configuration data for all networking equipment.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with carriers, vendors, and service providers.
  • Work independently and collaboratively across regions, occasionally outside normal business hours.
  • Represent the company professionally in meetings, committees, and stakeholder engagements.

What’s in it for you:

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy -Make your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

About you

You’ll bring at least 2–3 years’ experience working within a Data Centre environment or with a commercial carrier, along with hands-on fibre cabling experience. You have a strong understanding of networking and communications infrastructure and are confident configuring, maintaining and troubleshooting a range of technologies.

You’re highly organised, with strong documentation and compliance skills, and understand the importance of following processes in a critical environment. Experience working within ITIL frameworks is highly regarded, and industry-recognised networking or cabling certifications will be viewed favourably.

Most importantly, you’re a proactive problem solver who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, takes pride in delivering high-quality work, and is committed to maintaining reliable and resilient infrastructure.

Essential:

New Zealand Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a NZ Security Clearance.

How to Apply:

If you're looking to be part of Australia and New Zealand's leading large-scale data centre innovator, submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success and a culture of trust and care. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. At CDC we’ve got your back. We’re dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work, giving you the confidence to achieve more.

job.title: TA Operations - HR
job.description:
Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

1. Background Verification (BGV) Operations

  • Manage end-to-end background verification processes for all new hires across business verticals.
  • Coordinate with empaneled BGV vendors for timely initiation, tracking, escalation management, and closure.
  • Ensure verification of education, employment, address, criminal checks, identity validation, and reference checks as per company policy.
  • Monitor BGV turnaround time (TAT), discrepancies, red-flag cases, and exception approvals.
  • Drive governance and compliance standards aligned with internal audit and legal requirements.
  • Prepare periodic MIS dashboards and analytics on BGV status, aging, vendor performance, and risk indicators.
  • Handle confidential and sensitive employee information with high integrity and data privacy compliance.

2. Pre-Medical Health Checkup (PMHC) Management

  • Lead the operational management of pre-employment medical examinations for candidates.
  • Coordinate with hospitals, diagnostic centers, and occupational health partners.
  • Ensure medical appointments are scheduled within defined timelines for smooth onboarding.
  • Monitor medical fitness reports, escalations, and special case handling in consultation with HR and medical teams.
  • Maintain compliance with occupational health, safety, and company medical standards.
  • Track PMHC completion metrics and improve candidate experience through process efficiency.

3. Onboarding Operations

  • Manage end-to-end onboarding activities from offer acceptance to Day-1 joining.
  • Ensure timely documentation, system updates, joining formalities, and induction coordination.
  • Collaborate with HRBP, TA, IT, Admin, Payroll, Compliance, and Business stakeholders for seamless onboarding.
  • Ensure all onboarding documentation complies with company policies and statutory requirements.
  • Drive automation and process improvements in onboarding workflows and employee lifecycle management.
  • Maintain onboarding SLAs and improve joining experience for new hires.

4. Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders and external service providers.
  • Conduct regular governance reviews with BGV and medical vendors.
  • Negotiate service standards, monitor vendor KPIs, and ensure operational efficiency.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition teams to support high-volume and critical hiring initiatives.

5. Process Excellence & Compliance

  • Develop SOPs, operational controls, and process documentation.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, automation, and digitization of onboarding operations.
  • Ensure compliance with labor laws, data privacy, information security, and audit requirements.
  • Support internal and external audits related to onboarding, BGV, and medical compliance.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of Background Verification and onboarding operations
  • Expertise in pre-employment medical processes and compliance
  • Vendor management and stakeholder coordination
  • Process governance and operational excellence
  • HRMS / ATS / onboarding platform knowledge
  • Analytical and MIS reporting capabilities
  • Strong communication and escalation management skills
  • High attention to detail and confidentiality handling
  • Ability to manage high-volume operations and tight timelines

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • BGV completion TAT
  • PMHC completion timelines
  • Joining success rate
  • Candidate onboarding experience score
  • Vendor SLA adherence
  • Compliance and audit closure rate
  • Documentation accuracy and process efficiency

Preferred Attributes

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, matrix organization
  • Strong problem-solving and operational leadership skills
  • Process automation and transformation mindset
  • High ownership and execution orientation
  • Experience in GCC/shared services environment preferred

Qualifications

Educational Qualification

  • MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent
  • Additional certifications in HR Operations / Compliance preferred

Experience

  • 10–15 years of experience in HR Operations, Talent Acquisition Operations, or Employee Lifecycle Management
  • Minimum 5+ years managing BGV, onboarding, or shared services operations in a large organization/GCC environment
  • Experience handling high-volume hiring operations preferred

job.title: Officer, Sales Operations Analyst
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital with investors including some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Digital Edge’s vision is to be the leading provider of sustainable, next generation digital infrastructure in Asia. Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering populations they serve.

Founded in 2020, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across Japan, South Korea, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand and China. The Company now owns and operates 21 data centers with over 500 MW of critical IT load in service and under construction and development, with another 300 MW held for future development,

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

  • The Sales Operations Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day operational support of the Indonesia commercial organisation, covering CRM data integrity, quotation and service order administration, contract documentation, and sales pipeline and booking reporting. The role serves as the central point of coordination between the Sales team and internal Finance, Operations, Customer Care, and Legal stakeholders for the activities that turn a commercial opportunity into a signed, delivered, and billable service.
  • The Sales Operations Analyst safeguards the accuracy and timeliness of commercial data and documentation, ensuring that accounts, opportunities, and orders recorded in the system reflect the true position of the business, that management reporting can be relied upon for decision-making, and that commercial approvals and documentation are completed in line with company policy.
  • Additionally, the position supports continuous improvement across sales operations processes and systems, including sales systems migration activity and the standardisation of templates, trackers, and reporting packs. This is an individual contributor role within the Sales team, with no direct reports.

Key responsibilities

  • Maintain the integrity of commercial data in the CRM, including accounts, contacts, opportunities, pricing, and pipeline stages, ensuring records are complete, accurate, and updated in a timely manner.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges, building modern AI capabilities, and mentoring others while remaining deeply involved in delivery.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and deploy AI-enabled automation solutions, including agentic workflows, AI assistants, intelligent automation capabilities, and reusable engineering assets.
  • Build and maintain Graph RAG, semantic search, knowledge retrieval, and knowledge management capabilities that support trusted enterprise AI outcomes.
  • Lead proof-of-concepts, pilots, and production implementations while establishing best practices across AI engineering, evaluation, testing, observability, governance, and operational controls.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring to engineers, automation specialists, and delivery teams while collaborating with architecture, security, data, and platform stakeholders.

What You Bring

  • Hands-on experience delivering AI automation, software engineering, integration, data engineering, or technology solutions within complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong technical expertise across APIs, workflow orchestration, CI/CD, event-driven architectures, prompt engineering, LLM integrations, and agentic workflows.
  • Experience with Graph RAG, vector databases, knowledge retrieval, semantic search, metadata management, and modern AI engineering practices, ideally within AWS and Amazon Bedrock environments.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence, mentor, and lead technical teams while remaining actively involved in solution design, development, testing, and deployment.

The good stuff….

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

**

The Associate Director, PropTech Innovation & Strategic Partnerships will support Singtel Group Property to shape and drive its property technology innovation programme and strategic partnerships, and co-create new Enterprise and Consumer solutions and business opportunities.

The role leads the development of technology-enabled innovations and solutions, commercial models and ecosystem partnerships, with a flagship mandate under the Workplace28 technology programme and the new Comcentre HQ as a lighthouse for innovation.

Technology and data are leveraged as enablers to enhance workplace, people and tenant experience, and improve asset performance - not as ends in themselves. The role will connect Singtel’s built environments with its operating businesses and people, using Singtel’s properties and workplaces as real-world platforms to co-create, test and validate new solutions, and translate proven solutions into customer propositions and commercial opportunities.

The incumbent will manage opportunities from discovery and business case through partnership, funding, validation and operationalisation, and scale successful solutions across Singtel’s wider property portfolio. Working across Group Property, Workplace, Consumer, Enterprise, IT, Digital, other business units and ecosystem partners, the role will establish a disciplined Innovation Framework and Partnership Ecosystem to prioritise, develop and scale opportunities that deliver meaningful people, customer, operational and commercial value.

Make An Impact By

Workplace28 Technology & Property Innovation

**

  • Lead the technology innovation agenda for the Workplace28 programme and new Comcentre HQ.
  • Translate Workplace28 user experience ambitions into prioritised use cases and innovation workstreams, working with Workplace, IT, Tech, AI and Robotics specialists to develop appropriate solutions.
  • Use existing Singtel commercial sites and workplaces as real-world innovation platforms to co-create, pilot and validate solutions for customers and future tenants of One Comcentre.
  • Identify opportunities to extend the innovation approach and deploy successful solutions across Singtel’s wider property portfolio.

Innovation Strategy, Framework & Portfolio

**

  • Shape and manage Group Property’s innovation strategy, framework and portfolio, aligned with business, workplace and customer priorities.
  • Establish a structured approach from opportunity discovery and prioritisation through business case, experimentation, validation, operationalisation and scale.
  • Assess opportunities based on customer/user value, business impact, strategic relevance, scalability and commercial potential, working with technical teams to assess feasibility.
  • Establish clear governance, stage-gates and go / no-go criteria, and track innovation investment, progress and realised benefits.
  • Drive strong idea-to-pilot, pilot-to-scale discipline, progressing successful initiatives while stopping or redirecting those that do not demonstrate sufficient value.

Customer Solutions & Use-Case Development

**

  • Ensure innovation starts with a real customer or business problem, rather than with the technology.
  • Identify and understand the needs of our customers - employees, businesses and future tenants, translating them into high-value use cases and solution opportunities.
  • Develop customer journeys, solution concepts, value propositions, business requirements and measurable outcomes.
  • Work across Workplace, Group Property, Consumer and Enterprise to identify opportunities that improve customer experience and asset performance.
  • Validate propositions with users and stakeholders before significant investment or deployment

New Technology Discovery & Ecosystem Development

**

  • Identify technologies and ecosystem partners that can address defined customer or business needs, working with technical specialists to assess feasibility.
  • Explore how Singtel’s in-house solutions, deep capabilities and broad ecosystem can complement externally sourced technologies to create differentiated customer solutions.
  • Maintain visibility of emerging technologies and market developments relevant to Property, Workplace and customer experience.
  • Build an innovation ecosystem across technology companies, start-ups, OEMs, research institutions, government agencies and strategic partners.
  • Facilitate co-creation, prototypes and pilot initiatives with ecosystem partners.
  • Connect external innovation with relevant Singtel capabilities and business opportunities.

Strategic & Commercial Partnerships

**

  • Identify, develop and manage strategic innovation and commercial partnerships that accelerate Singtel’s innovation and business agenda.
  • Lead the development of MOUs, collaboration agreements, co-innovation and partnership arrangements, working with Legal, Procurement and relevant stakeholders.
  • Develop partnership models spanning co-creation, co-development, co-investment and go-to-market collaboration.
  • Structure partnerships around clear customer, strategic and commercial outcomes, rather than conventional buyer-vendor relationships.
  • Build long-term ecosystem relationships that provide access to new capabilities, innovation and business opportunities.

Customer Solutions & New Business Development

**

  • Identify opportunities to translate Property and Workplace innovations into scalable customer and business solutions.
  • Partner with Consumer and Enterprise to identify customer needs, market opportunities and differentiated propositions.
  • Develop customer-led solutions, value propositions, business and operating models, and routes to market.
  • Use Singtel’s physical environments as real-world platforms to validate solutions and demonstrate customer value.
  • Identify opportunities to create new value through enterprise adoption, external customer solutions and new business models.

Business Cases, Commercial Models & Innovation Funding

**

  • Develop robust business cases covering customer value, investment, business impact, scalability and commercial potential.
  • Develop commercial and partnership models that enable viable deployment and scale, including co-investment, fee-based, subscription, revenue-sharing and platform models where relevant.
  • Identify and develop innovation funding opportunities, including internal investment, partner co-funding, grants and other funding sources.
  • Evaluate and recommend where Singtel should invest, partner, pilot, scale, commercialise or stop.
  • Track innovation investment and realised benefits, ensuring continued funding is supported by measurable outcomes and evidence of scalability.

Innovation Delivery, Scale & Commercialisation

**

  • Drive innovation from business case and pilot through implementation, adoption, scale and commercialisation.
  • Structure pilots around clear customer needs, business outcomes and measurable success criteria.
  • Orchestrate business, Property, Workplace, IT and ecosystem partners to translate concepts into operational solutions.
  • Develop the business and operating readiness required to move successful pilots into production, working with technology specialists on technical readiness.
  • Identify pathways to replicate and scale proven solutions across Singtel’s property portfolio and into Consumer and Enterprise opportunities.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on innovation, customer solutions, partnerships and new business opportunities.

Skills for Success

  • Degree in Business, Economics, Real Estate, Technology, Innovation or related discipline**
  • 12–15+ years of relevant experience in real estate, commercial strategy, innovation, customer solutions, business development.
  • Strong experience working across real estate, digital solutions, property technology and partnership management.
  • Domain knowledge in Property with experience in real estate functions such as asset management, marketing, leasing or operations.
  • Track record developing new businesses, products, platforms or technology-enabled solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience taking opportunities from business case and concept through implementation, scale and commercialisation

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Senior Security Platform Engineer - Data and Edge Security
job.description:
Brisbane, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

*We are open to applicants from: Sydney, Melnourne, Brisbane & Adelaide

At Optus, our role is to connect millions of Australians daily and securing that connection starts by maintaining the integrity of our security platforms. We're looking for a Senior Security Platform Engineer to lead the configuration standards, enforcement policy, and platform engineering decisions that underpin our proxy, endpoint, and email threat prevention systems.

This is not a platform administration role. This is an engineering-first position where you define the standard, drive the governance, and hold accountability for the security outcome while partnering with Technology and Infrastructure teams who lead day-to-day implementation.

You'll sit at the intersection of governance and technical depth, representing platform engineering at the Traffic Governance Board, translating complex governance decisions into detailed engineering requirements, and ensuring our enforcement platforms are configured to the highest standard across a multi-platform, SOCI-regulated environment.

Your day to day will consist of:

  • Own and define configuration standards across our network filtering, endpoint protection, and email security solutions, setting the bar delivery teams implement against
  • Serve as a platform engineering liaison at the Traffic Governance Board, transforming governance decisions into detailed engineering requirements and change specifications
  • Define DLP enforcement requirements at the proxy and email layers, specifying how sensitivity labels flow from data protection governance into operational controls
  • Own the full MDM/MAM policy framework across Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android including compliance baselines, enrolment standards, and conditional access requirements
  • Produce production-grade runbooks, configuration standards, and platform documentation fit for both TI operational teams and ELT governance audiences and maintain audit-ready records to meet SOCI obligations

**

What makes you perfect for the role?

  • 5+ years of hands-on security platform engineering experience with direct ownership (not exposure) across gateway, endpoint protection, and email filtering security areas
  • Consistent track record of defining configuration standards and translating governance decisions into engineering requirements this role focuses on policy ownership instead of platform administration
  • Deep proxy expertise: URL filtering, SSL inspection, CASB integration, and DLP enforcement carried out on the proxy layer including how sensitivity labels flow into enforcement policy
  • Direct experience owning EDR configuration standards for Windows and macOS. Also responsible for MDM/MAM policies and DMARC enforcement across a multi-domain estate. Preferably in a SOCI-obligated or regulated environment.
  • Ability to operate credibly at governance forums, communicate clearly across technical and executive audiences, and maintain audit-ready configuration records

**

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity

job.title: Commercial Manager Contracts
job.description:
Sydney, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Every day, millions of Australians connect, work, stream, and stay in touch on the Optus network. When it works seamlessly, it’s easy to take for granted. But behind it is a team making thousands of decisions every day - decisions that keep people, businesses and communities connected.

Right now, Optus is focused on getting the fundamentals right - simplifying how we work, lifting standards, and building a more reliable, resilient experience for our customers.

It’s not about surface-level change. It’s about how we make decisions, how we work together, and how we deliver.

As a Commercial Contracts Manager, you will be responsible for contract drafting, reviews and negotiations, as well as supporting the Optus Wholesale Division in various legal and commercial customer contract aspects.

You will manage, coordinate, and oversee the contractual pre-signing aspects of the customer relationship. You will play an integral role in the Optus Wholesale Division by providing key support to all members of the that Division in respect of drafting of contracts and other legal documentation, ensuring legal risk management and compliance with internal policies and relevant legislation, and commercially sensitive matters affecting the business.

The Day to Day

  • Contracts preparation & negotiation– Drafting and negotiation of all customer contracts, including standard and bespoke agreements, variation agreements, promotion letters, notices, novation agreements, settlement agreements and termination agreements.
  • Compliance – Drafting and negotiating contracts to align with the applicable Sale Contracts Policy and applicable legal and regulatory frameworks.
  • Legal support – Working closely with the Legal team, the Commercial Contracts Manager provides the first level of legal support and guidance to the Optus Wholesale Division.
  • Credit and legal risk control – Ensuring commercial contracts minimise Optus’ exposure to operational, legal, financial and credit risks.
  • Regulatory engagement – Interface with Optus’ regulatory team on key regulatory issues affecting Optus involving strategic, operational, technical and legal compliance issues.
  • Leadership – Being a trusted advisor and partner to the Optus Wholesale Division, providing legal and commercial guidance to support sound decision-making and risk mitigation (working with the Legal team).
  • Process improvement – Implementing and continually improving the contract governance process which tracks contracts end-to-end from contract draft request to signing.

What You Bring

  • Legal drafting experience and a legal academic background, such as a law degree or equivalent qualifications.
  • Extensive years of relevant work experience in contract drafting, negotiation, legal risk management, compliance, and governance. Some prior experience as a lawyer in private practice or as an inhouse legal counsel is very strongly preferred, given how important drafting skills are to the role.
  • Ability to draft bespoke legal and commercial terms without precedents.
  • Attention to detail, excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to meet deadlines with minimal supervision or assistance.
  • Commercial foundations and business acumen.
  • Understanding of telecommunications operations and/or a wholesale environment is desirable.

**

The good stuff:

  • Competitive remuneration, plus $80 monthly credit, 25% off Optus products and exclusive shopping discounts with our retail partners — making everyday life a little more affordable. Genuine Flexibility - work three days in the office, two days from wherever works best for you.
  • An office campus that has it all - cafes chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre. It’s designed for real life.
  • Great leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever matters most to you.
  • Inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks, because family comes first.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Your wellbeing matters, so we offer with free counselling and support services, available 24/7 in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • A free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon. Or, heaps of onsite parking. Plus, end of trip facilities with lockers, showers, irons and hair dryers**

Not every box ticked? Apply anyway. We believe the right mindset matter more than a perfect CV. We’ll back you to grow from there.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

job.title: Platform Lead
job.description:
Sydney, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

As a Platform Lead within OSS Delivery, you will own and drive the evolution of critical operational platforms that underpin service activation, fulfilment, number management, and core telecommunications capabilities. Acting as the bridge between architecture, delivery, and operations teams, you will translate business and technical requirements into practical, scalable solutions while ensuring platform stability, performance, security, and long-term strategic alignment. This is an excellent opportunity for a technology leader who enjoys combining solution design, stakeholder engagement, platform ownership, and roadmap planning within a complex enterprise environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with architects, engineers, business stakeholders, vendors, and delivery teams to define platform direction, manage dependencies, and drive successful project outcomes.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for assigned platforms, providing technical leadership, managing platform risks and vulnerabilities, and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and future innovation.

  • Strong knowledge of OSS fulfilment platforms, system integration, application architecture, and end-to-end technology delivery, with the ability to balance strategic direction and operational requirements.
  • Proven stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience collaborating across architecture, operations, project delivery, vendors, and senior business leaders.

job.title: Associate Director – Data Center Controls (BMS) - BDx Data Centers
job.description:
Role Summary

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, programming, installing, and troubleshooting HVAC Controls and Electrical SCADA systems.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop BMS and power management projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
  • Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS improvement projects in BDx data centers.
  • Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.
  • Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
  • Conduct engineering analysis and research designs and methods of data center equipment and facilities.
  • Ensure designs and installations meet requirements (e.g., predicted cooling, structural, operational concerns, etc.
  • Develop data center vulnerability remediation playbooks for control system designs in conjunction with IT teams.

Experience

Experience of 10+ years in designing, configuring, programming, installing, troubleshooting or servicing HVAC Controls and Electrical SCADA systems application specific controllers, Building Management System (BMS) Controls software and networks.

Qualification and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • Excellent understanding of industry-standard electrical and mechanical systems used in data centers, as well as controls/monitoring systems.
  • Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
  • Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
  • Project coordination experience with multiple teams or vendors to meet project requirements for data centers.
  • TCP/IP, MQTT, BACnet and/or MODBUS communication protocol experience.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite and project management software.

At BDx, we believe that our success lies in the hands of our talented and dedicated employees. Together, we are shaping the future of the data center industry and making a positive impact on the world.
