job.title: IT Operations Lead - BDx Data Centers
job.description:
Role Summary

The Senior IT Operations Lead will provide technical leadership and operational ownership of the organization's internal IT infrastructure and OT technology environment supporting Data Center operations. This is a senior hands-on individual contributor role within a captive Data Center organization, responsible for the reliability, security, availability, governance, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of the organization's own technology environment.

Duties and Responsibilities

1. IT Infrastructure Operations & Reliability

  • Provide technical and operational leadership for the organization's enterprise IT infrastructure supporting corporate and Data Center operations.
  • Ensure the availability, reliability, performance, and security of infrastructure operating on a 24x7x365 basis.
  • Oversee networking, servers and compute, virtualization, storage, backup, firewalls, security infrastructure, wireless, telephony, collaboration systems, end-user computing, and monitoring platforms.
  • Drive proactive monitoring, capacity planning, performance optimization, technology lifecycle management, and operational KPI tracking.

2. OT Security & Data Center Technology Environment

  • Support and govern IT and OT security procedures relevant to Data Center operations.
  • Work closely with Data Center Operations, Engineering, Security, Automation, and Technology teams to ensure appropriate protection and segregation of IT and OT environments.
  • Develop and maintain procedures for secure access, privileged access, remote connectivity, patching, vulnerability management, and system hardening.
  • Support security assessments, audits, vulnerability remediation, risk mitigation, incident response, and root cause analysis involving IT and OT-related systems.

3. IT Service Management & Operational Governance

  • Lead and continuously improve Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Configuration, and Asset Management processes.
  • Analyse recurring incidents and operational trends and implement preventive and corrective actions.
  • Drive service reviews, KPI reporting, risk tracking, root cause analysis, and continual service improvement.

4. Infrastructure Architecture & Technology Lifecycle

  • Participate in infrastructure reviews and assess the impact of new systems, technology changes, and infrastructure enhancements.
  • Provide recommendations for scalability, resilience, security, operational supportability, and risk mitigation.
  • Support infrastructure modernization including cloud, hybrid infrastructure, software-defined networking, automation, and Infrastructure-as-a-Service models.

5. SDLC, Change & Release Governance

  • Demonstrate strong awareness of SDLC and its impact on infrastructure and production environments.
  • Work with application, automation, engineering, and technology teams to ensure infrastructure readiness for development, testing, deployment, and production releases.
  • Ensure appropriate testing, documentation, rollback plans, approvals, risk assessments, and operational readiness before production implementation.

6. Information Security, Compliance & Documentation

  • Support compliance with ISO 27001 and ISO 20000 requirements and maintain relevant operational documentation and evidence.
  • Maintain infrastructure standards, procedures, architecture diagrams, Configuration Items (CIs), CMDB records, and IT asset documentation.
  • Support internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings and compliance actions.

7. Security, Monitoring & Critical Incident Management

  • Provide technical oversight for routers, switches, Layer 2/3 networks, firewalls, IPS/IDS, VPN, WAN, Wi-Fi, and connectivity infrastructure.
  • Improve monitoring coverage, alert quality, operational visibility, and proactive issue detection.
  • Lead technical investigations for major incidents, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning.

8. Vendor & Internal Stakeholder Management

  • Manage technical relationships and escalations with infrastructure, security, telecommunications, and technology vendors.
  • Partner with internal Data Center Operations, Engineering, Information Security, Automation, Applications, Corporate IT, Facilities, and business stakeholders.
  • Communicate technical risks, operational performance, improvement initiatives, and infrastructure status to senior stakeholders.

9. Individual Contributor Technical Leadership

  • Act as a senior technical owner and subject matter expert, leading through technical expertise, governance, influence, and operational ownership.
  • Work independently on complex technical and operational issues and mentor engineers where required.
  • This is primarily a hands-on senior individual contributor role and is not intended to be a traditional service delivery, customer account management, or managed services role.

Experience

15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, infrastructure operations, or IT operations leadership.

  • Experience supporting business-critical, highly available, 24x7x365 infrastructure environments.
  • Strong experience operating internal enterprise or captive technology environments; experience should not be limited to external customer managed services delivery.
  • Strong technical experience across enterprise networking, Layer 2/3 infrastructure, routers, switches, firewalls, WAN, VPN, Wi-Fi, servers, virtualization, monitoring, infrastructure security, backup, and configuration management.
  • Strong experience in Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Root Cause Analysis, KPI reporting, trend analysis, and continual service improvement.
  • Practical understanding of IT and OT security principles, access management, vulnerability remediation, patching, infrastructure hardening, and operational security procedures.
  • Strong awareness of SDLC, production change governance, release management, testing, risk assessment, rollback planning, and operational readiness.
  • Experience with monitoring platforms such as Zabbix, Nagios, SolarWinds, Cacti, or similar tools.
  • Experience conducting infrastructure architecture reviews and developing mitigation plans for technical and operational risks.
  • Strong vendor management, stakeholder management, analytical, problem-solving, documentation, written, and verbal communication skills.

Qualification and Experience

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience working in a Data Center operator or other mission-critical infrastructure environment.
  • Exposure to OT environments supporting critical infrastructure, including Data Center automation, BMS, DCIM, SCADA, or similar operational technologies.
  • Knowledge of OT/ICS security principles and industrial cybersecurity practices.
  • Experience with public cloud, hybrid cloud, software-defined networking, infrastructure automation, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, or DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience with Zero Trust, SIEM, SOC, EDR, vulnerability management, or security monitoring platforms.
  • Experience with disaster recovery and business continuity planning.

Preferred Certifications

  • CCNP or equivalent Cisco certification.
  • CISSP, CISM, or equivalent information security certification.
  • ITIL certification.
  • Microsoft infrastructure, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), OT/ICS security, or Six Sigma/process improvement certifications.

job.title: Consultant, IT Application support (Siebel Admin)
job.description:
What you will do

Key Reponsibilities are:

  • Administer and maintain Siebel environments across DEV, SIT/UAT and Production.
  • Manage Siebel Gateway, Siebel Servers, Application Object Managers and related components.
  • Ensure Production availability, stability, performance and overall platform health.
  • Execute and manage Siebel deployments, including repository, SRF and non-repository changes, across environments.
  • Perform Siebel patching, upgrades, configuration and technical maintenance.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot Siebel servers, components, logs, crashes and performance issues.
  • Support high availability, load balancing, backup/restore and disaster recovery activities.
  • Coordinate with Oracle DBA, Unix/Linux, Windows, Network, Infrastructure, Security and Middleware teams on platform-related issues.
  • Manage technical activities related to LDAP/external authentication and infrastructure integrations.
  • Automate repetitive administration and deployment activities using scripting where applicable.
  • Manage Production changes through established change, release, security and compliance controls.
  • Participate in 24×7/on-call support for critical Production incidents and planned deployments.
  • Maintain technical runbooks, SOPs, environment documentation and audit evidence.

What we're looking for

Required Experience & Skills

  • 8+ years of hands-on Oracle Siebel Administration / Platform Support experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Siebel architecture, installation, configuration and administration.
  • Hands-on experience with Siebel deployments, repository/SRF and non-repository migration.
  • Experience with Siebel upgrades, patching, performance tuning and troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience in Production environment management and technical incident resolution.
  • Working knowledge of Unix/Linux, Windows, Oracle Database and SQL/PLSQL.
  • Experience with HA, DR, backup/restore and load balancing.
  • Knowledge of LDAP/external authentication is an advantage.
  • Scripting/automation experience, preferably Shell.
  • Experience working in large-scale 24×7 enterprise environments.
  • Good understanding of ITIL, Change and Release Management, security and compliance.

What we offer you:

Looking to make a mark?

At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.

Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.

Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.

We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.

Diversity and inclusion

  • Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.

Most recently we have:

  • Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
  • Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
  • Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our [DEI pages](https://www.colt.net/about/inclusion-diversity/).

Benefits

Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
  • Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
  • Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
  • Global Family Leave Policy.
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.

A global network

  • When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

job.title: JSM 2 Controls
job.description:
Job Summary

The Electrical Maintenance & Automation Technician is responsible for troubleshooting, installing, maintaining, testing, and optimizing electrical and automation systems to ensure manufacturing equipment availability, reliability, and operational efficiency. This role supports preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance activities while working with PLCs, HMIs, SCADA, MES integration, vision systems, and advanced automation technologies. The position contributes to improving equipment performance, reducing downtime, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and maintaining compliance with Cummins' Health, Safety, Environmental (HSE), Quality, and operational standards. The role may also provide technical guidance and mentoring to less experienced team members.

Key Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot, repair, install, test, and maintain electrical systems, industrial automation equipment, and manufacturing machinery to maximize equipment uptime and reliability.
  • Perform preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance activities on manufacturing equipment and electrical control systems.
  • Diagnose and resolve faults related to PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems, drives, sensors, industrial controls, and electrical components.
  • Configure, troubleshoot, and optimize Siemens TIA Portal applications, PLC programs, HMIs, vision systems, and automation equipment.
  • Support MES integration and smart manufacturing technologies to improve operational efficiency and equipment performance.
  • Perform machine programming modifications, electrical system upgrades, and automation improvements to enhance productivity and reliability.
  • Read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, machine drawings, and technical documentation to execute maintenance activities effectively.
  • Ensure electrical systems comply with applicable electrical codes, safety standards, and manufacturing requirements.
  • Conduct equipment downtime analysis, root cause investigations, and corrective actions to eliminate recurring failures.
  • Maintain preventive maintenance schedules, equipment history, maintenance records, and technical documentation.
  • Coordinate maintenance activities with production schedules to minimize equipment downtime and production interruptions.
  • Participate in Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, quality, maintenance, and support teams to improve equipment reliability, productivity, and manufacturing performance.
  • Maintain a safe, clean, and organized work environment by adhering to Cummins Health, Safety, Environmental (HSE), and Quality standards.
  • Coach and provide technical guidance to technicians and team members, supporting skill development and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, ITI, Diploma, or equivalent technical qualification in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation, or a related technical discipline.
  • Additional certifications in PLC programming, Siemens automation technologies, industrial automation, or electrical maintenance are preferred.
  • This position may require licensing for compliance with export control or sanctions regulations.

Skills

Technical Skills

  • Electrical maintenance of industrial and manufacturing equipment
  • Preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance
  • PLC programming and troubleshooting, preferably using Siemens TIA Portal
  • HMI, SCADA, MES integration, and industrial automation systems
  • Vision systems and smart manufacturing technologies
  • Machine programming and automation optimization
  • Electrical system troubleshooting and fault diagnosis
  • Industrial control systems, motors, drives, sensors, and instrumentation
  • Reading and interpreting electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and structured problem-solving methodologies
  • Preventive maintenance planning and maintenance documentation
  • Basic understanding of hydraulic and pneumatic control systems
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications

Professional Competencies

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Effective communication and cross-functional collaboration
  • Customer focus and results orientation
  • Sound decision-making and problem-solving capability
  • Continuous improvement mindset
  • Ability to mentor and coach team members
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn emerging automation technologies
  • Strong commitment to safety, quality, and operational excellence
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams

Experience

  • 5–8 years of relevant experience in electrical maintenance, industrial automation, or manufacturing maintenance within a high-volume manufacturing environment.
  • Hands-on experience with Siemens TIA Portal , PLC programming, HMIs, SCADA systems, and industrial automation.
  • Experience with vision systems , MES integration, and factory automation technologies.
  • Experience supporting high-volume assembly line maintenance and improving equipment reliability and uptime.
  • Proven experience in electrical troubleshooting, machine programming, preventive maintenance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Working knowledge of TPM, Lean Manufacturing, 5S, and manufacturing process optimization is preferred.
  • Experience mentoring technicians or supporting team capability development is an added advantage.

The internship with the Cummins Quality Assurance department will provide the intern exposure to real business operations regarding quality systems, compliance standards, process improvement, and continuous improvement initiatives in maintaining operational excellence and product quality. The intern will be given hands-on opportunities to understand, analyze, and improve current operational and quality-related processes while supporting cross-functional teams in achieving quality objectives.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with operations functional managers and team leaders on process and system improvements related to quality assurance, operational efficiency, and compliance standards.
  • Support quality inspection activities, process monitoring, and documentation review to ensure compliance with company quality requirements and procedures.
  • Assist in compiling, analyzing, and maintaining quality-related metrics, reports, and dashboard tracking to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop and update quality dashboards and visual reports to support data-driven decision-making and operational monitoring.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives such as process optimization, waste reduction, and standardization activities.

job.title: Senior Technical Site Due Diligence Manager
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

NTT GDC APAC - Global Infrastructure Development is looking to recruit a Senior Technical Site Due Diligence Manager. The role will support data centre expansion and construction projects across specific regions.

You will play a key role in the site selection and development stage with accountability for the technical due diligence process & master planning for new and existing NTT GDC regions. Alongside Test Fits, this role will involve inputting into the permitting strategy and compiling and analysing site information to identify any impact / risks on development costs & schedule or present a risk to the operation of the data center. You will be expected to engage, instruct, direct, and manage internal resource alongside external consultants, contractors, and experts to ensure technical due diligence & master planning is complete, whilst compiling & mitigating risks and reporting these to the NTT GDC stakeholders.

You will have a strong track record of program management, a demonstrated ability to deliver multiple high priority projects simultaneously and the ability to drive alignment across teams with competing priorities.

You will help develop and promote adoption of best practice process and procedures for site due diligence in the design and engineering, and wider construction and expansion teams.

What we are looking for

Key Role and Responsibilities:

Site Selection and Technical Due Diligence:

  • Present a regional progress report on all projects
  • Lead the Technical Due Diligence process, collaborating with internal stakeholders to guide the expansion of NTT GDC facilities in new and existing regions, by conducting site selection risk analysis and due diligence assessments.
  • Utilize technical expertise to assess and validate the suitability of potential sites, considering factors such as infrastructure, environmental impact, and regulatory compliance.
  • Engage with internal resources and external consultants on power requirements for the sites and ensuring that a clear demonstratable timeline for power is developed as part of the TDD report.
  • Ensure that the constraints of each site are identified with documentary evidence for any limiting factors such as zoning plans and planning requirements.
  • Create and Manage TDD criteria/checklists to enable, and be accountable for, Go/No Go recommendations and decisions.
  • Work with the construction teams and the consultants to create project specific permitting strategies.
  • Develop the project timeline with an explanatory note against each timeline duration giving the next team in the development lifecycle an understanding of assumptions made.
  • Write scope of works for consultants to execute technical assessments and reports.
  • Assess proposals and evaluate them for completeness and manage all correspondence and invoices.
  • Brief consultants on the sites and the requirements to be executed for a red flag report.
  • Hold a site safety briefing ahead of site walks to ensure risks are discussed and protocols understood.
  • Accountable for coordinating site visits, specialist reviews and associated reports and debriefs.
  • Act as the primary contact for external consultants and vendors as well as internal stakeholders, involved in technical due diligence processes.
  • Assess and draw conclusions from a wide range of real estate, engineering, construction, policy, planning, and business development considerations.
  • Responsible for production of compliant test-fits for new sites using Sketchup, also use of CAD and other software to scale and dimension drawings for stage one test fit development.
  • Be proficient in power point to develop presentations to communicate to external stakeholders potential solutions.
  • Brief consultants on 3D flythroughs and drone footage requirements
  • Collaborate with the internal global reference design team and the regional design managers to ensure specific regional inputs are made to make test fits work.
  • Work in conjunction with the associated Site Acquisition Manager (owner of the purchase deal) and Development Manager (owner of pre-construction development) for each site to ensure TDD delivery is progressing in line with the agreed budget and programme.
  • Ensure regular reporting of progress against agreed plans to senior members of Design and Engineering, Delivery and the associated Expansion managers.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance, quality and value for money received through third party appointments.
  • Ensure that NDA’s are executed and consultants are briefed on the confidential nature of projects.
  • Technical & Process Improvement
  • Ability to use technical drawings and scale drawings to develop test fit library for the global team.
  • Contribute to the development of tools, processes, and procedures to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the site selection, test fits and due diligence functions.
  • Develop and manage long term relationships with internal stakeholders, key consultants and external subject matter experts to ensure optimal performance.
  • Interface with peers in other departments within the region and with peers in site selection teams globally.
  • Reporting & Quality Control:
  • Develop and maintain a dashboard which represents all projects in region and update the status weekly
  • Ensure that collaboration between all due diligence staff in region is aligned with the global standards
  • Review all consultant reports and work before presenting to internal and external stakeholders
  • Work with site acquisition managers, development manager and construction teams to define and track critical metrics that measure progress towards strategic goals on sites.
  • Analyse data from the seller's data rooms to ensure concise and informative reports are produced by the team.
  • Present findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders, including senior leadership members, and investors when required.
  • Build relationships and a network in region of consultants and trusted advisors that contribute to successful due diligence outcomes.
  • Proactively investigate and address any significant deviations from the global reference design
  • Streamline reporting procedures to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
  • Implement data visualization tools to improve the clarity and impact of reports.
  • Leverage automation to reduce manual data entry and improve reporting frequency.
  • Establish and maintain robust data quality controls to ensure the accuracy and reliability of all reported information.
  • Conduct regular data audits and implement corrective actions as needed.

Knowledge and Key Attributes:

  • You will have a broad understanding of normal and abnormal concepts associated with data centre site development at scale.
  • You will have a solid understanding of cost and time drivers associated with site development e.g., Remediation, Cut and Fill, Utilities connections etc.
  • You will be able to evaluate and assess initial vendor or real estate agent information packs and identify gaps against a prescribed schedule of technical site selection due diligence activities.
  • You will be able to write scope of works for consultants to execute their engineering assessments of land and buildings.
  • You will possess a high-level knowledge of the planning and permitting issues associated with large format industrial buildings such as height restrictions, boundary setbacks, perimeter security, vehicle reticulation analysis, requirements for stormwater attenuation, easements, power routing etc.
  • Able to procure and build a database of exemplar scoping documents for technical site selection studies e.g., topographical assessments, ground condition, environmental risk assessments, etc.
  • Possess familiarity with the concept of progressive de-risk and able to compile, update and maintain RAG reports individually and or on a consolidated basis.
  • Hold a University Degree in Construction, Architecture, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Engineering or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated experience in technical due diligence for mission critical and/or similar hi-tech content M&E led industries (e.g., Pharmaceutical, Food and Drink manufacturing, Oil and Gas, Energy, etc.)
  • Experience working within site acquisition teams, preferably in a leading role on the buy side.
  • International experience and outlook both in type of company (multi-national Consultant/Operator) and project experience
  • Clear and concise written and oral communication skills in English.
  • Demonstrate self-management by supporting and developing teams, fostering a positive team atmosphere, overcoming obstacles, and embracing challenges confidently.
  • Exhibit rounded thinking, self-awareness, and a collaborative approach.
  • Possess organizational skills with a can-do/will-do attitude and a consistent ability to translate ideas into impactful actions.
  • Able and happy to travel within region and internationally up to 35% of working time.

job.title: Assistant Manager, Marketing and Leasing (Based
job.description:
The Role

This position will be leading and managing the leasing team to maximise occupancy for the assigned portfolio.

Job Responsibilities

  • Formulating and implementing strategies to maximise rental and occupancy of the properties within the Company’s commercial portfolio.
  • Securing new tenancies, identifying market segments and prospects, managing lease renewals with existing clients, and liaising with property agents.
  • Conducting market research of competitors and market benchmarks of rentals and occupancy cost.
  • Managing tenancy related issues, compiling occupancy and rental reports and other related lease management functions including but not limited to budgeting.
  • Carrying out substantive business development work to secure new tenancies prospects; identify market segments and provide lease management support.
  • Support Manager in preparing annual rental budget, rental forecast as well as monthly management reporting.

Job Requirements

  • At least 4 to 6 years of relevant experiences in marketing and leasing in the same industry.
  • Sound understanding of the real estate industry with an extensive network of contacts.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation and effective interpersonal skills.

job.title: Finance Executive, Accountant (AP) (Based
job.description:

This position will be responsible for the full spectrum of Accounts Payable function in the Finance department.

Job Responsibilities

  • Mature, responsible, meticulous, good team player and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Candidates from the Big 4 audit firms are welcome to apply.

job.title: Associate Solutions Architect, Startup (Vietnamese Speaking), APJ ECT SA
job.description:
Are you interested in cloud computing and helping customers build on AWS? We have a role you might find interesting.

The AWS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to working with customers as they build and grow their businesses on AWS. We're here to make sure they can deploy the best, most scalable, and most secure architectures possible — and that they spend as little time and money as possible doing so.

Key job responsibilities We are looking for technical builders who love the idea of working with customers to help them succeed. In this role, you'll work directly with a variety of interesting customers and help them make the best (and sometimes the most pragmatic) technical decisions along the way. You'll have a chance to build enduring relationships with these companies and establish yourself as a trusted advisor.

As well as spending time working directly with customers, you'll also get plenty of time to "sharpen the saw" and keep your skills fresh. We have more than 175 services across a range of different categories, and it's important that we can help customers take advantage of the right ones. You'll also play an important role as an advocate with our product teams to make sure we are building the right products for the customers you work with. And for the customers you don't get to work with on a 1:1 basis, you'll get the chance to share your knowledge more broadly by working on technical content and presenting at events.

A day in the life Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the fastest-growing companies to Global 500 enterprises trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

About the team AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest-growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience with one of the following programming languages: Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C++
  • Experience with two or more of the following: networking fundamentals, security, storage or databases (relational or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, or Windows)
  • 2+ years of Information Technology (IT) experience
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in Vietnamesse

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing a cloud-based technology solution
  • Experience in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, Data Engineering or DevOps

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

17 Oct 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Telstra: Part Time Customer Service & Sales Consultant MIRRABOOKA

Job Summary

As a Retail Consultant, you will provide frontline support by assisting customers with product selection, service activation, and troubleshooting basic issues. You will create positive experiences through effective communication and adherence to retail standards. This role demonstrates foundational autonomy and contributes to customer satisfaction and store performance.

Job Description

Ready to Make a Difference? Join Our Iconic Team at Telstra!

At Telstra, we’re more than just a leading telecommunications company—we’re where passion meets purpose. As a Retail Customer Service & Sales Consultant, you’ll have the opportunity to work for an iconic Aussie brand that’s been connecting Australians for generations. You won’t just be a friendly face in-store—you’ll be the trusted expert who helps customers find tech solutions that enhance their lives. This is your chance to make a meaningful impact by bringing our purpose to life: to build a connected future so everyone can thrive.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Deliver Exceptional Customer Experiences: Help customers find the right products and services to suit their needs, ensuring their time at Telstra is a memorable one.
  • Be the Go-To Tech Expert: Stay up-to-date with the latest gadgets and services, offering informed guidance and solutions.
  • Achieve and Excel: Use your consultative selling skills to meet and exceed sales targets and KPIs, while keeping customers connected.
  • Collaborate and Contribute: Work closely with your team to create a welcoming environment where everyone is supported to achieve store goals.

Salary and Benefits:

  • Hourly Rate: $33.33 per hour

*Junior rates apply for those under 20 years of age.

Penalty rates are as follows: Additional 25% for weekday hours worked after 6 PM, 25% for hours worked on Saturday, 100% for hours worked on Sunday and 150% for hours worked on public holidays.*

  • Plus 12% Superannuation
  • Generous Discounts: Enjoy 30% off Telstra services and exclusive offers with over 240 brands and partners.
  • Leave Options: Take advantage of 16 weeks of paid parental leave, the Telstra Extra Day Off, gender affirmation leave, Cultural Leave, Blood Donor Leave, and the ability to purchase up to 4 weeks of additional leave.
  • Training & Career Growth Opportunities: Access over 17,000 learning programs through LinkedIn Learning and take advantage of a range of development opportunities designed to build your skills and support your career growth, helping you prepare for your next step.
  • Flexibility: We offer flexible working hours and a supportive approach to parental leave—do it your way!
  • Recognition & Rewards: Benefit from performance rewards and a range of recognition programs to celebrate your success.
  • Inclusive Culture: Join a diverse and inclusive team where everyone’s unique perspective is valued and respected.

Is it You We’re Looking For?

  • Great Communication Skills: You’re a natural at connecting with people and making their day better.
  • Solution-Oriented Approach: You enjoy thinking on your feet and tailoring solutions for each customer.
  • Sales Drive: You’re motivated to achieve (and exceed!) sales targets and KPIs.
  • Passion for Learning: You’re eager to grow and develop your skills in a dynamic environment.
  • Resilience and Positivity: You have a can-do attitude, even when things get busy.
  • Customer-Facing Experience: Previous experience is a plus but not required—bring your enthusiasm and we’ll teach you the rest!

How to Apply:

Ready to kickstart your journey with us? Click "Apply Now" to submit your application! After applying, keep an eye out for an email from our partner, HireVue, to complete the next step in our assessment process.

job.title: TE - Senior Security Sales Architect
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

25 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

TE - Senior Security Sales Architect

Job Summary

Job Description

Senior Network and Security Sales Architect

**

**

About the job

Who We Are

We're an iconic Aussie brand with a global footprint. Our purpose is to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. We're all about providing the best experience and delivering the best tech on the best network.

This includes making Telstra the place you want to work. For you, that means a having career that grows with you and working with a team powered by human connection that prioritises wellbeing and choice.

**Focus of the Role **As a Senior Network and Security Sales Architect, you are a trusted technology advisor and customer advocate who thrives on developing comprehensive, tailored technology solutions for our customers.

  • You understand Telstra's customer needs intimately, applying your deep knowledge of our solutions and services and key relationships (e.g. Account & Sales Team) to influence their technology strategy.
  • Your ability to articulate how technology can transform businesses, and your entrepreneurial spirit is what makes you exceptional at your job, you're focused on developing end-to-end technology solutions.
  • You communicate with influence, thrive off collaborating with a diverse range of stakeholders, and apply your technical acumen to be successful in this role.

What We Offer

  • Flex appeal: choose where, when and how you work
  • Performance-related pay
  • Access to thousands of learning programs so you can level-up
  • Global presence across 22 countries; opportunities to work where we do business.
  • Purchased annual leave scheme
  • Additional Telstra day off
  • Additional 30% off Telstra products and services
  • Toolkit provided (laptop + mobile phone + plan paid for)

What You'll Do

Telstra Enterprise - Business & Enterprise Sales Chapter Area helps businesses of all sizes meet their technology needs. As a Senior Network and Security Sales Architect, you combine your deep knowledge of Telstra's solutions and products with business insight to deliver the following responsibilities:

  • Make a strong contribution to sales and revenue growth through developing and maintaining a strong qualified pipeline of incremental opportunities in relation to Data and Strategic solutions sets, including developing customer technology strategies, roadmaps and business plans to support sales opportunity identification.
  • Leverage substantial expertise in technology solutions and sales to manage sales opportunities from identification and qualification to closing, supporting sales teams to develop and implement effective sales plans and strategies. This includes providing input and support when sought out to orchestrate domain/multi-domain solution concepts and resources.
  • Recognised as a technical sales expert and trusted technology advisor to key senior stakeholders (external and internal), producing deep technical and business insights that articulate how Telstra's solutions (that consider partner's, vendors and alliances) can be used to transform our customer's business, and influence technology strategy.
  • Authentically engage with and effectively influence a diverse, multi-stakeholder client (including C-Suite) and internal landscape (Account Executives, Deep Domain Solution Architects, Pricing Specialists, client team members) to establish and negotiate a balanced technology solution that meets commercial and customer requirements.
  • Apply your deep technical and professional expertise in complex, strategic technology solutions (e.g. Data, IP, Video Conferencing, IP Telephony, Collaboration, Cloud, Security) with your knowledge of emerging product/technology trends to produce robust, implementable sales solutions that exceed customer's expectations.
  • Significantly contribute to and role model continuous learning by maintaining a very high level of currency in technology solutions, emerging technologies and industry trends. Leverage your knowledge to coach and develop cross-functional team members (e.g. Solution Sales peers, Account Managers) on the latest products, pricing and solutions.

About You

  • Key Skills & Technical Expertise:

o Technical understanding of multiple network and security solutions, including (not limited to SDWAN, WAN/LAN, SASE/SSE, Firewalls, Cloud and Cyber Security

o Demonstrated experience in leading & winning complex network and security services

o Demonstrated technical network and security relationships with large enterprise customers

o Demonstrated experience developing network and security services & solutions to be delivered in market

o Demonstrated experience in market leading network and security vendors, including Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Zscaler, Netskope,Checkpoint, Crowdstrike, Microsoft, Illumio.

  • Soft Skills

o Business Acumen

o Collaboration

o Communication

o Complex solution design

o Critical Thinking

o Customer Obsession

o Designing complex systems

o End-to-End Solution Design

o Problem Solving

o Requirements Gathering

job.title: Technical Team Leader - DevOps Platforms
job.description:
##

Hello Eager Tech Expert,

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like You'd make a great addition to our vibrant international team.

We are looking for: Technical Team Leader - DevOps Platforms

You’ll make an impact by:

  • Leading, mentoring, and managing a team of DevOps Platform SRE engineers.
  • Oversee and manage all day-to-day IT operations and application of IT systems, within a team assigned.
  • Acting as the primary technical authority for DevOps platforms and SRE practices.
  • Define and govern reference architectures, engineering standards, and platform blueprints.
  • Drive innovation through adoption of modern DevOps, SRE, and platform engineering practices (IDP, GitOps).
  • Establish and lead a culture of Operational Perfection (OpEx) across teams.
  • Own end-to-end service operations lifecycle: Incident management & partner concern, Problem management & root cause analysis, Change and release governance.
  • Implement proactive reliability practices like Observability (logs, metrics, traces), Chaos engineering, Resilience testing.
  • Ensure platform and operations align with SOC 1 & SOC 2 controls (security, availability, confidentiality),ISO standards (ISO 27001, ISO 20000, ISO 22301).
  • Crafting cloud-native solutions, APIs, integrations using major cloud services, Kubernetes, and containerization for resilient, business-critical platforms.
  • Enabling self-service platform capabilities that help development teams deliver faster with fewer operational dependencies.
  • Optimizing platform performance and resource utilization by resolving bottlenecks and driving continuous improvement.
  • Ensuring platforms meet security standard processes and compliance requirements across delivery and operations.
  • Implement and govern FinOps practices for cost visibility and optimization.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and product leadership, Enterprise architecture, Security, audit, and compliance teams.
  • Communicate Platform performance and KPIs, Operational risks and mitigation, Compliance posture and audit readiness.

You’re excited to build on your existing expertise, including:

  • Bringing 20+ years of experience in IT, with 10+ years of relevant experience in DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering leadership roles.
  • Build and scale Internal Developer Platforms (IDP) and lead enterprise-scale platform transformations.
  • Apply deep cloud expertise across AWS, Azure, or GCP, covering compute, storage, networking, and serverless services.
  • Use Power BI dashboards and operational KPIs to drive data-informed decisions and continuous improvement.
  • Implement ITIL-based service management practices and support audits, controls, and risk frameworks.
  • Strengthen platform consistency using infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
  • Develop CI/CD pipelines and automation using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Azure DevOps, and observability tools.

Join us and be yourself!

This role is based in Bangalore / Pune, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries - and the shape of things to come.

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.**

job.title: Project Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Senior Engineering Manager ###

Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to act as a design authority for an engineering discipline with low to medium complexity. Each day, you will complete assignments on small projects or portions of larger projects in a cost-effective manner. You will also showcase your expertise by applying basic design thinking/design for excellence concepts in projects.

This role is contributing to the Electrification business Distribution Solutions division in Hyderabad, India

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Design, develop, and implement Substation Automation Systems, including SCADA, PLC, and RTU-based control, monitoring, and communication systems, ensuring reliable, efficient, and secure operation of electrical power networks.
  • Develop, modify, test, and troubleshoot PLC programs (ABB AC500 and Emerson PAC System) for electrification and substation automation applications.
  • Design and configure HMI using ABB CP600 and Emerson Quick Panel. Design and configure SCADA systems using ZENON and ZEE600 platforms for monitoring, control, alarm management, and system visualization.
  • Prepare and maintain project engineering documentation, including System Architecture Diagrams, I/O Lists, Functional Design Specifications (FDS), IP Address Lists, Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) documents, Site Acceptance Test (SAT) documents, and other project deliverables.
  • Select and specify appropriate hardware components, including PLCs, RTUs, communication equipment, networking devices, HMIs, and associated control system components, based on project requirements.
  • Provide remote technical support for testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and system integration activities, ensuring successful project execution and customer satisfaction.

Qualifications for the role:

  • B.E or Diploma in Electrical with 8+ years experience, Proficient in electrical distribution and automation, power systems, and substation automation.
  • PLC programming in accordance with the IEC 61131-3 standard, preferably on Emerson PAC system PLC (PAC Machine Edition) and ABB AC500 PLC (Automation Builder) platform.
  • HMI designing using Emerson Quick Panel and ABB Panel Builder.
  • SCADA development on GE Cimplicity, Copadata ZENON and ABB ZEE600 Platform.
  • LV and / or MV switchgear knowledge and knowledge of Communication and Network Architecture designing.

More about us:

ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium-voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear for the ANSI standard markets.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Warehouse Specialist
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Warehouse Manager ###

Your role and responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced Warehouse Specialist with experience in warehouse operations, inventory management, logistics coordination, and team supervision. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring efficient warehouse operations, maintaining inventory accuracy, optimizing storage utilization, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives while adhering to safety and quality standards.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Motion business for High Power division based in Vadodara, India

Key Responsibilities

Warehouse Operations

  • Manage day-to-day warehouse activities including receiving, storage, picking, packing, and dispatch operations.
  • Ensure timely and accurate processing of inbound and outbound shipments.
  • Ensure timely GRN and Issuance.
  • Ensure timely dispatch of Subcon
  • Monitor warehouse productivity and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency.
  • Optimize warehouse space utilization and material flow.

Inventory Management

  • Maintain inventory accuracy through cycle counts, stock audits, and reconciliation activities.
  • Ensure proper inventory control practices including FIFO implementation.
  • Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies.
  • Monitor stock levels and coordinate replenishment activities.

System & Documentation

  • Perform inventory transactions in ERP/WMS systems (SAP, Oracle, JDE, Dynamics, etc.).
  • Generate inventory, shipment, and KPI reports.
  • Maintain accurate warehouse documentation and records.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies and audit requirements.

Team Coordination

  • Guide and support warehouse operators and material handlers.
  • Coordinate with procurement, production, planning and transport for job work material.
  • Provide on-the-job training to new warehouse personnel.
  • Monitor workforce productivity and adherence to procedures.

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with warehouse safety regulations and company standards.
  • Promote 6S and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Conduct safety inspections and identify potential risks.
  • Ensure proper handling of materials and warehouse equipment.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s in Electrical / Mechanical engineering field.
  • 7–8 years of experience in warehouse operations, inventory control, and logistics management.
  • Strong experience with SAP systems and Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).
  • knowledge of inventory management and warehouse best practices.
  • Good understanding of warehouse KPIs and operational reporting.

Required Skills

  • Warehouse Operations Management, Inventory Control & Accuracy Management, SAP / ERP / WMS Systems
  • Cycle Counting & Stock Reconciliation, Team Leadership & Coordination, Logistics & Distribution Management
  • Root Cause Analysis, Data Analysis & Reporting
  • Microsoft Excel (Advanced), Problem Solving & Decision Making, Communication & Stakeholder Management

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Inventory Accuracy ≥ 99%
  • Warehouse Productivity Targets
  • Cycle Count Completion Rate
  • Reduction in Inventory Variance
  • Safety Compliance & Incident Reduction
  • Warehouse Space Utilization Efficiency

More about us

ABB Motion provides pioneering technology, products, solutions and related services to industrial customers to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and maintain precise control over processes. job.title: Solution Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Digital Solution Engineering Manager ###

What we believe in

ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner. We are an international pioneering technology leader writing the future of industrial digitalization. At the forefront is our Software Development Center, which provides industry-leading software and deep domain expertise to help the world's most asset-intensive industries solve their biggest challenges. We offer a broad range of automation, electrification, and digital solutions for process, hybrid, and maritime industries, including industry-specific integrated control systems, software, measurement, analytics, and services.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, we are looking for software professionals to join our Industrial Automation Digital Organization. The role requires being part of a team with experience in a DevOps environment, focused on software lifecycle automation, build and release management, and CI/CD. You will primarily focus on engineering modern and agile environments using various DevOps and automation tools to support Application Lifecycle Management, while contributing to the development of enterprise platforms and solutions on on-premise and cloud platforms such as Azure.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Establish and maintain suitable DevOps channels, CI/CD pipelines, and continuous build environments across platforms to accelerate software development and deployment processes.
  • Develop and maintain test automation frameworks (PyTest, Unittest), covering UI automation (Selenium, Playwright), API testing, regression, smoke testing, and database validation using Python.
  • Collaborate with the ABB project team in requirement gatherings, design discussions, documentation, and reviews, reporting daily activities, expected deliverables, and progress to the technical lead or manager.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and generative AI platforms to improve engineering productivity, code quality, and intelligent automation workflows.

Qualifications for the role

  • Strong Python programming skills including Flask, metadata management, PL/SQL scripting, database packages, procedures, functions, triggers, views, and materialized views, with solid experience in data-driven and keyword-driven testing frameworks (PyTest, Unittest).
  • Proven experience in Web UI automation (Selenium, Playwright), API test automation, test case design and execution, automated regression and smoke testing, and test reporting and logging.
  • Solid experience with database systems (SQL/NoSQL) including MS SQL, Oracle, MongoDB, and Realtime DB, with capabilities in DB processing (partitioning, indexes), database validation, SQL testing, data quality tests, and basic UNIX scripting.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD integration (Jenkins, Azure DevOps), source control management (Git), and establishing DevOps channels and continuous build environments across platforms.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Azure, cloud platform concepts, and application containerization tools (Docker, Docker Swarm, Kubernetes), along with familiarity with dashboards, language, database, and test technologies.
  • AI/ML integration experience, including working with GitHub Copilot, AI-powered code generation, automated testing, log analysis, and observability platforms to enhance development productivity and software quality.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills in English, with good customer-facing and coordination abilities, adherence to software development methodologies, and a proven track record of delivering solutions in complex customer system landscapes within predictable timelines and quality standards.

More about us

ABB is a leading global technology company that energizes the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future. The Process Automation (PA) business area (>$6B revenue in 2021, 22,000 employees) automates, electrifies, and digitalizes some of the most complex industrial infrastructures on this planet. Through its five divisions, we serve customers in the energy, process, and hybrid industries – from hydrocarbons, chemicals, water, mining, minerals, pulp & paper to marine and ports, and many more. PA stands at the heart of some of the most important shifts in society, helping energy-intense industries achieve safer, smarter, and more sustainable operations to enable a prosperous, low-carbon society.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.description:

This Position reports to:

Sales Support Manager ###

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the assigned Sales organization (division and market) and customers during the proposal process. Each day, you will serve as a key technical resource in the assigned area. You will also showcase your expertise by preparing technical descriptions of the products and technology, determining costs, and preparing final documentation.

The work model for the role is: #LI Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Process Automation Business of Measurement and Analytics Division for Bangalore.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Support the local sales and and system integration units’ organization/customers in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions, preparing demanding offers, and providing technical support during the meeting.
  • Prepare/support the preparation of technical/commercial offers based on customer specification requirements, local business unit/feeder factory indications, and sales organization directives. Participate in the kick-off meeting organized by the project team.
  • Analyse customer needs and competitor offers through general market information and information provided by the sales organization.
  • Perform lost proposal analysis, identify the potential causes, and recommend future actions in cooperation with the sales/local business unit to obtain better future results.

Qualification for the role :

  • Deep knowledge of Analytical products and system design.
  • Experience in product selection and configuration, quotation preparation, technical document compliance, vendor coordination, full-cost model calculation, and technical query clarification.
  • Good understanding of business types (products, services, projects).
  • Experience in working in an international business environment.
  • Knowledge of sales operations tools – Salesforce Opportunity Management, Reports, and Dashboards.
  • Exposure and understanding of the industrial processes - Power Plant, Water, Metals & Minerals, Oil & Gas, Pulp Paper.
  • Must have 7+ years of experience in quotation management including preparation of quotations based on complex project RfQs.
  • B.E/ B. Tech in Instrumentation/Electronics/Mechanical/Chemical

More about us :

The Measurement & Analytics Division is among the world’s leading manufacturers and suppliers of smart instrumentation and analysers, working at the heart of industrial digital transformation. The Measurement & Analytics Division’s portfolio consists of analysers measuring compositions of gases and liquids; instrumentation measuring process variables such as temperature, pressure, flow, and level; force measurement solutions measuring parameters such as flatness, thickness, and tension; and advanced digital solutions for device management, device health check and predictive maintenance. The Measurement & Analytics Division serves key industries such as oil and gas, chemical, water and wastewater, power, hydrogen, batteries, as well as the marine industry. The Division enables the optimization of industrial processes by providing and analysing data collected from sensing and smart measurement devices. Parameters such as emission levels and production inputs are measured by providing ‘before’ and ‘after’ values, enabling efficient operations and environmental sustainability through measurement.

Communications Manager and Local Spokesperson__

You will gain practical experience taking content from an initial idea through stakeholder coordination, production, approval, and publication. Exposure to communications across ABB's key business areas — Electrification, Automation, and Motion — complemented by hands-on experience spanning industry communications, leadership messaging, employer branding, employee engagement, community partnerships, and events management.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Managing and maintaining ABB Singapore’s content calendar, identifying local storytelling opportunities, campaigns, events, and publishing priorities in collaboration with business divisions.
  • Adapting to global and business-area content for Singapore audiences by adding relevant local context, insights, proof points, and stakeholder perspectives.
  • Creating engaging content for social media, Viva Engage, employee communications, leadership communications, employer branding, and community partnership initiatives.
  • Planning, capturing, and editing photography and video content from leadership visits, customer engagements, employee activities, and industry events.
  • Transforming footage, interviews, and existing assets into short-form videos and digital content, while supporting visual storytelling and asset management.
  • Supporting the planning and execution of employee engagement activities, employer-branding programs, community partnerships, and customer/stakeholder events, including logistics, vendors, timelines, and communications.

  • Clear written English, with the ability to produce concise captions, event communications and supporting copy for different audiences.
  • Able to capture usable photography and video in event or other live environments using a camera or mobile device.
  • Hands-on experience creating social and digital content in Canva and editing short-form videos in CapCut. Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, Adobe Premiere Pro or equivalent tools would be an advantage.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage deadlines, follow up on actions and flag issues early.
