job.title: People and Workplace Coordinator
job.description:
About Goodman

At Goodman, your career is more than just a job – it’s about growth, innovation, and making a lasting impact. Whether you’re building your career in property, data centres, finance, legal, or beyond, we value diverse perspectives and seek individuals who are passionate about driving our business forward.

As providers of essential infrastructure for the digital economy, Goodman has been developing its data centre capability since 2005. Since then, we have grown to become a large owner of powered sites globally. Our global power bank of 5.0GW includes completed facilities, secured power and potential data centre projects across 13 major international cities. This has been built up over time through our expertise in securing land, planning and power in highly sought after locations in major global cities.

We are seeking a highly organised and service-focused People and Workplace Coordinator to support the day-to-day operation of our Melbourne office and help deliver a positive employee and workplace experience.

The Opportunity

This is a broad and varied role that plays a central part in creating a workplace that is professional, welcoming and easy to work from.

As the local face of the Melbourne office, you will coordinate office operations, workplace services, employee onboarding, recruitment logistics, supplier relationships, events and administrative activities. You'll work closely with employees, leaders, building management and service providers to ensure the office operates smoothly and efficiently.

This role would suit someone who enjoys variety, takes pride in delivering exceptional service and is proactive in identifying and resolving issues before they arise.

Key Responsibilities

Workplace and Office Operations

  • Coordinate the day-to-day operation of the Melbourne office.
  • Act as a key point of contact for workplace-related requests and support.
  • Maintain office standards to ensure the workplace is organised, professional and welcoming.
  • Manage office administration, documentation and workplace processes.

Facilities and Supplier Coordination

  • Coordinate building services, maintenance, security, cleaning and workplace contractors.
  • Manage office supplies, kitchen consumables, stationery and workplace amenities.
  • Support workplace health, safety and wellbeing activities.
  • Assist with workplace improvements, upgrades and office projects.

Employee Experience and Recruitment Support

  • Coordinate onboarding logistics for new employees, including workspace setup, office orientation and access arrangements.
  • Liaise with People & Culture, IT and hiring managers to support a seamless onboarding experience.
  • Coordinate interview logistics, candidate visits and recruitment events.
  • Support employee movements, seating plans, office records and workplace communications.

Events and Hospitality

  • Coordinate meetings, catering, visitor management and room readiness.
  • Support team events, wellbeing initiatives, celebrations and corporate functions.
  • Assist with property tours, customer events and internal activities.

Administration and Financial Support

  • Coordinate purchase orders, invoices, expense coding and supplier administration.
  • Support travel bookings and related administration.
  • Assist with office budgets, reporting and approval processes.
  • Maintain accurate records and handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.

About You

You are an organised and proactive coordinator who enjoys supporting people and creating great workplace experiences.

You will bring:

  • Experience in office coordination, workplace operations, people operations or corporate administration.
  • Experience supporting a professional corporate office environment.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience coordinating suppliers, facilities, events and workplace services.
  • Confidence using Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with invoicing, purchase orders and administrative processes.
  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach and a strong attention to detail.
  • High levels of professionalism, discretion and customer service.

The Benefits

At Goodman we know that our people are integral to our company success. That’s why we have implemented some fantastic benefits for all to experience, these include:

  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Study assistance for postgraduate and undergraduate courses
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Eligibility to participate in Goodman’s share scheme
  • Wellness program that focuses on the health and wellbeing, including exercise classes, meditation, yoga, social events, exclusive discounts, cooking classes, financial wellbeing seminars and more.

About Goodman

Goodman is a provider of essential infrastructure. We own, develop and manage high quality, sustainable logistics properties and data centres in major global cities, that are critical to the digital economy.

We’re a collaborative team with a shared vision to make the world a better place for our customers, our investors, our people, and the communities we operate in. We value innovation, integrity, determination, and sustainability, and [our purpose](https://au.goodman.com/about-goodman/our-purpose) is simple: to make space for greatness in everything we do.

Goodman encourages innovation at every level. We seek individuals who are eager to challenge conventional thinking, drive change, and develop new ideas that contribute to a sustainable and successful business. Your creativity and forward-thinking approach can make a tangible difference today and long into the future.

job.title: Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Mentors teams and leads the architecture of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems. Identifies and removes performance/scalability bottlenecks for hyper‑scale workloads; defines scalability requirements with stakeholders; and designs elastic, high‑impact systems while advancing innovation in data plane platforms. Engineers and oversees fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable designs; optimizes resilience mechanisms (load‑shedding, throttling, rate‑limiting); and sets SLO‑aligned durability and availability standards across dependent services. Establishes KPIs and advanced telemetry; applies formal verification for complex features; and develops robust replication/synchronization strategies. Advises and leads resolution of complex production issues, sets operational readiness and SOP standards, and directs incident response and RCAs. Architects advanced security controls, drives remediation and compliance, and delivers enterprise‑level automation (IaC) and change strategies enabling safe, automated patching, updates, and rollbacks.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Mentor the team in the architecture and design of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems, ensuring horizontal and vertical scalability and overall performance, including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Lead the identification of performance and scalability bottlenecks and recommend solutions to optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to improve performance for hyper-scale systems.

–Lead collaboration with stakeholders to define system scalability requirements, ensuring the defined requirements meet customer expectations.

–Leverage deep expertise to design high-impact, interdependent systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).

–Drive innovation in the use of data plane platforms.

–Evaluate whether systems are meeting nonfunctional scalability requirements, and proactively anticipate growing business needs within the business unit.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Design and oversee the implementation of fault-tolerant, interdependent systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing sophisticated redundancy, replication, and automatic failover capabilities.

–Lead the design and implementation of systems that effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.

–Guide the optimization of advanced mechanisms to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.

–Design interdependent systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), driving standards for availability and durability of other computing services within the organization

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify risks, gaps, or cyclical dependencies in running, interdependent systems.

–Drive the creation and customization of highly complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms, proactively ensuring system health and reliability.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:

–Maintain expertise in industry standards for verifying correctness and apply existing techniques to interdependent systems.

–Formally verify complex features (e.g., via TLA+) to ensure system design correctness for various interdependent systems.

–Develop advanced strategies for data replication and synchronization, ensuring robust data integrity and availability

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:

–Advise on efforts to diagnose, debug, and resolve complex issues in active, interdependent systems to support ongoing operation.

–Develop and implement comprehensive strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.

–Maintain expertise in dependencies, dependents, and owned systems to drive effective troubleshooting and performance.

–Set standards for operational readiness and standard operating procedures within the department, and hold third-party partners accountable for meeting those standards.

–Oversee operational support rotations, providing expert guidance in incident response and leading root cause investigations to prevent future occurrences.

Compliance & Security:

–Architect advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, and lead initiatives to enhance data and application protection.

–Guide the execution of comprehensive remediation plans to address identified security vulnerabilities.

–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations, and guide documentation efforts across projects.

Automation & Change Management:

–Develop enterprise-level automation tools and strategies (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) and oversee their implementation.

–Drive alignment of change management plans and organizational initiatives for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and design interdependent systems to allow for automation of these processes.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

–Manages and provides direction on timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable for critical high-impact projects or initiatives that impact the line of business, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements. Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

–Influences cross-functional leaders and external stakeholders to gain alignment on strategic objectives. Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long-term organizational success. Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Problem Solving:

–Leads specialized, advanced problem-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for complex issues. Guides others to leverage innovative data-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and drives the implementation of solutions that prevent future issues.

Continuous Learning:

–Leverages deep industry knowledge and expertise to serve as a thought leader within the organization. Contributes to the advancement of the field or industry through thought leadership (e.g., conference presentations, white papers, research contributions). Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices. Champions continuous learning and knowledge sharing, promoting professional development across teams. Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same.

Continuous Improvement:

–Develops innovative solutions and drives the implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the organization. Evaluates effectiveness of updated approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals. Designs and develops metrics to measure success of improvement initiatives.

Performance and Development:

–Serves as a subject matter expert regarding talent needs and organizational talent strategy. Imparts leadership and expert knowledge throughout the talent development pipeline including candidate interviews, candidate assessment, and hiring decisions, ensuring alignment with organizational talent strategy.

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. job.title: Data Center Logistics Technician
job.description:
Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician (DIAT), you will perform cycle audits, execute incoming/outgoing deliveries, coordinate security escorts for third-party vendors, and document inbound and outbound deliveries. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your knowledge of inventory management principles, warranty process management, data bearing device destruction and advance your career in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DIAT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

  • Perform assigned tasks and escalate issues during high-volume work activity or escalation-based situations.
  • Coordinate with suppliers to initiate warranty claim and process failed vendor hardware devices. This includes information processing, packaging, shipment, and receipt of return for Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) devices following all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) related to RMA warranty process.
  • Leverage process knowledge and best judgment to complete tasks with minimal direct supervision.
  • Maintains a strong focus to understand the impact of their work when completing tickets and assigned Inventory and Asset Management (IAM) tasks.
  • Maintains and steward up-to-date and accurate logical information within various inventory management systems (e.g., configuration management databases, asset management repositories).
  • Ensures detailed physical inventory tracking and staging.
  • Help to reconcile and report inventory discrepancies.
  • Performs destruction of data bearing devices (DBD) following all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Microsoft policies as necessary.
  • Notifies management about ordering stock shortages. Escalates any issues to management.
  • Comply with security and data management policies.
  • Embody our[culture](https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/culture)and[values](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/about/corporate-values).

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma AND experience warehouse/supply chain in an information technology (IT) environment, inventory management, retail, warehouse management, or a related field.
  • OR equivalent experience.
  • Ability to work shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends, and/or holidays
  • You will be required to travel between sites as part of this role so a valid drivers's license will be required.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

While not required, we also look for the following_Preferred_ Qualifications:

  • Experience in warehouse/supply chain in an information technology (IT) environment, IT, and/or logistics, operating heavy-load movement equipment (e.g., forklift, pallet jacks, chassis lifts) for a large corporation
  • OR equivalent experience.

job.title: Territory Manager- Sales (Trade)
job.description:
Legrand India is looking for a dynamic, results-driven Territory Manager – Trade Sales to join our growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for accelerating revenue growth by managing and expanding our retail and distribution network. You will drive primary, secondary, and tertiary sales within your assigned territory, ensuring Legrand remains the preferred brand for dealers, retailers, and electrical contractors. If you have a passion for channel sales and a proven track record in the building materials or electrical industry, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Drive Territory Sales: Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales volume and revenue targets for the assigned product lines.
  • Manage Channel Partners: Onboard, support, and maintain strong relationships with Authorized Distributors (ADs), retail dealers, and sub-dealers.
  • Expand Retail Footprint: Increase counter share and market penetration by identifying and appointing new retail outlets.
  • Engage the Influencer Community: Conduct regular painter/electrician/contractor meets to build brand loyalty and drive product recommendations.
  • Ensure Visual Merchandising: Monitor and improve in-shop branding, product displays, and POS material placement across retail counters.
  • Track Market Intelligence: Monitor competitor activities, pricing structures, and promotional schemes to provide actionable feedback to leadership.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration (BBA/MBA), Marketing, or a Diploma/B.Tech in Electrical/Electronics Engineering.
  • Experience: 3 to 6 years of proven experience in channel sales, general trade, or dealer-distributor management.
  • Industry Background: Prior experience in Electrical (FMEG/Switchgear), Lighting industry is highly preferred.
  • Core Skills: Strong negotiation, relationship management, communication, and market analysis skills.

job.title: Senior Service Engineer
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Perform service, preventive maintenance, and corrective actions on Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, including screw, scroll, and centrifugal systems.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control-related issues in chiller and HVAC systems.
  • Conduct chiller start-up, commissioning, performance testing, and system optimization.
  • Manage site execution for data center cooling projects, including planning, installation oversight, and coordination with contractors and OEM teams.
  • Support upgrades, retrofits, and energy‑efficiency improvements in existing data centre cooling infrastructure.
  • Review technical drawings, submittals, and project documents for accuracy and compliance.
  • Maintain detailed service reports, performance logs, and documentation for all equipment.
  • Ensure strict adherence to safety standards, regulatory requirements, and customer operational protocols.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
  • Interface with customers regularly to provide updates, clarify technical issues, and ensure completion of service and project tasks.
  • Participate in root‑cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues.
  • Coordinate with internal teams (sales, project management, engineering) for seamless service and project delivery.
  • Timely submission of Root cause analysis & 8D reports to customers
  • Willing to work in Shift available to work on Holidays & public holidays to meet agreed SLA
  • Monthly MOR, Quarterly QBR meetings required to be attended with DC customers

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or relevant technical field.
  • 5–10 years of hands-on experience servicing Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, preferably in data centre applications.
  • Strong knowledge of refrigeration cycles, HVAC controls, BMS/EMS integration, and cooling redundancy concepts.
  • Experience in project execution, installation supervision, and commissioning of HVAC equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and equipment manuals.
  • Proficient in diagnosing mechanical, electrical, and control faults using service tools and diagnostic software.
  • Strong customer communication skills and ability to work in critical data centre environments.
  • Familiarity with safety standards and industry best practices.
  • Good problem‑solving skills and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with mission‑critical data centres or large industrial cooling systems.
  • OEM-specific chiller training or certifications (e.g., Trane, Carrier, Daikin).
  • Knowledge of energy‑efficiency programs, retrofits, and system performance optimization.
  • Project management experience or certification is a plus.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

job.title: Senior Associate - IT SOX Compliance
job.description:
What you will do

  • Drive and executes IT SOX 404 assessments, including risk assessment, walkthroughs, and testing of IT General Controls (viz. Access Management, Logical Security Settings, Change Management, and Computer Operations)
  • Work in a collaborative team environment and contribute to the successful delivery of IT SOX Compliance and Internal Controls review engagements, including preparing high-quality, accurate, well-supported documentation, and reports.

. Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of ITGC’s controls. Maintain up-to-date documentation, IT SOX Narratives, and process flowcharts.

  • Drive and execute the IT General control testing around inscope Servers and Databases around Privilege User Access Review, Logical Security Settings, Back-up scheduling and Monitoring, Back-up Integrity, etc.

. Contribute and support the IT Automated Control testing, assess the completeness and accuracy of Annual User Access review at Enterprise level

  • Perform thorough reviews to analyze the adequacy of IT controls, internal controls over financial reporting, compliance with corporate standards, policies, and regulatory requirements (e.g., SOX, SOC 1/2, ISO, NIST).
  • Prioritize and assign tasks to ensure effective use of team resources and completion of work according to schedules and engagement objectives.
  • Assist in the evaluation of system implementations/upgrades by performing the System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) reviews.
  • Evaluate the IT control environments of the newly acquired entities to ensure adequate controls are in place to support the complete and accurate financial reporting.
  • Present findings to management at the conclusion of engagements, discuss deficiencies, and recommend remediation actions and opportunities for improvement.
  • Consult with IT clients to redesign/re-engineer processes; identify opportunities for optimizing operational efficiencies, strengthening internal controls, and reducing overall IT and Non-IT risk.
  • Opine on the adequacy of remedial actions taken to correct deficiencies and assist with issue closure processes.
  • Maintain adequate and current technical knowledge in areas such as IT general controls, business process controls, cybersecurity, and other areas as required.
  • Communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Respond to complex, escalated inquiries and ensure outstanding IT Audit & SOX issues are cleared.
  • Collaborate with other functions of global Assurance & Advisory Services and support ad-hoc activities and engagements as needed.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Chartered Accountant, or related IT graduates
  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) certification preferred.
  • Minimum of 6 years’ combined experience in IT SOX Compliances, with strong exposure to SOX compliance framework, internal controls review, IT risk and governance.
  • Knowledge of relevant IT domains including automated controls testing, system development lifecycle, SOC-1 report review, and identity and access management at Application and Operating System level (i.e., Servers and Databases).
  • Demonstrated ability for independent thinking and multi-tasking under aggressive deadlines with a high degree of accuracy in a complex “matrix” environment.
  • Proven ability to plan proactively, anticipate issues, and have excellent problem resolution records with little or no input or assistance.
  • Proficiency in computer applications including MS Word, MS Excel, and MS Outlook.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Human Resources Operations Coordinator to join our team who will have the opportunity to champion our IND-India HR Service Center

The incumbent would be providing customer support through various communication methods to Caterpillar employees, Managers, the HR community, In-Country teams and Centres of Expertise on human resource related issues. This is the first Customer Services assignment followed by a position with more Human Resource exposure. The Incumbent should be comfortable working in shifts.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Whitefield Office, Bangalore, India

What you will do

Job Roles and Responsibilities

  • Serves as initial point of contact for customers by receiving incoming requests via multiple methods for human resource related information.
  • Verifies each request for completeness based on agreed SLAs, tracking and documenting requests and resolving requests through various communication methods.
  • Resolves customer requests by use of knowledge, FAQ database, scripts, tools, computer systems and necessary resources.
  • Reviews and research and follow up requests identifying complex or problematic requests and directing appropriate issues to appropriate HR groups i.e. In-Country/BU HR etc.
  • Meets established quality and volume goals (SLAs) by gathering complete information, providing accurate information, entering accurate data into required systems, and maintaining prompt response rates.
  • Must posses knowledge in Workday and Service Now tool.
  • Participates in continuous improvement activities identifying areas for process simplification and efficiency. Ensures every customer interaction is positive by providing consistent information in a courteous, friendly demeanour.

What you will have

  • The position manages the completion of its own work assignments and coordinates work with others.
  • Support in the development of Standard Work documentation
  • Advanced proficiency in MS Word, Excel and Power Point Presentation.
  • Working experience in HR Shared Service is mandatory with minimum 2 years (mandatory)
  • Should be willing to Work from Office
  • Experience in developing standard work process documentation
  • 5 Days work from office

Desired: Candidates must possess interest in learning one international language.

  • Language capability: German or Spanish
  • Experience in Power BI

Skills desired:

Business Process Improvement: Knowledge of business process improvement best practices and ability to use methods for identifying, evaluating, introducing and implementing more efficient approaches to performing business related activities. Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains the rationale for using BPI methodology.
  • Identifies the main steps in a BPI project such as defining the existing structure.
  • Describes BPI key considerations such as establishing process owners.
  • States the major roles involved in business process management.

Information Capture: Knowledge of the methods, channels and processes to obtain needed information; ability to identify, capture and document relevant business information in an auditable, organized, understandable and easily retrievable manner. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Follows defined procedures to document all routine information.
  • Identifies relevant established standards, policies and practices.
  • Fulfills routine information capture needs in own area.
  • Uses automated tools to capture, organize and archive relevant information.
  • Cites examples of different types of relevant information that need to be captured.

Service Excellence: Knowledge of customer service concepts and techniques; ability to meet or exceed customer needs and expectations and provide excellent service in a direct or indirect manner. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Provides a quality of service that customers describe as excellent.
  • Resolves common customer problems.
  • Responds to unexpected customer requests with a sense of urgency and positive action.
  • Provides direct service to internal or external customers.
  • Documents customer complaints in a timely manner.

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Accurately gauges the impact and cost of errors, omissions, and oversights.
  • Utilizes specific approaches and tools for checking and cross-checking outputs.
  • Processes limited amounts of detailed information with good accuracy.
  • Learns from mistakes and applies lessons learned.
  • Develops and uses checklists to ensure that information goes out error-free.

HR: Policies, Standards and Procedures: Knowledge of human resource function; ability to uphold the organization's and industry's standards, procedures and policies regarding human resources management. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Analyzes policy and standards documentation and ensures organizational compliance.
  • Maintains a specific set of standards and associated HR procedures.
  • Communicates and refers potential exceptions upward for review and approval.
  • Assists in the development and implementation of specific procedures.
  • Provides feedback for the improvement of HR procedures.

Human Resources Operations: Knowledge of human resources (HR) policies, operational processes and considerations; ability to implement HR related tasks, processes, and projects to ensure that day-to-day operations run smoothly. Level Basic Understanding:

  • Compiles a list of major services provided by HR professionals.
  • Identifies key policy compliance issues in HR operations.
  • Discusses HR processing procedures and administration principles.
  • Describes key responsibilities and scopes of the HR operations function.

What you will get:

  • Work Life Harmony
  • Earned and medical leave.
  • Relocation assistance

Holistic Development

  • Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe
  • Career developments opportunities with global prospects

Health and Wellness

  • Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage
  • Employee mental wellness assistance program

Financial Wellness

  • Employee investment plan
  • Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan.

Additional Information:

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers)

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

  • Identify and lead process improvements that increase team efficiency, quality, and velocity while providing technical guidance to service engineering teams on complex issue resolution and product support tools.
  • Stay abreast of industry, technology, and market developments and support evolving customer and distributor needs.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking:

  • Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
  • Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.

Effective Communications:

job.title: Assistant Growth Manager, MVNO
job.description:
Job Description

Role Overview

We are seeking a driven and entrepreneurial Growth Manager to join our MVNO team. This role will be responsible for accelerating subscriber growth and revenue performance through strategic engagement with existing partners and the development of new partnerships. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, you will take a data-driven and experimental approach to unlock growth opportunities, collaborating closely across brand, product, and operations. We are looking for someone with a strong challenger mindset—curious, bold, and always willing to test new ideas and bring fresh thinking to the team.

Key Responsibilities

1. Growth Strategy & Performance

  • Develop and execute strategies to drive subscriber acquisition, retention, and ARPU growth.
  • Own and report on key growth metrics including partner acquisition, customer base expansion, and revenue KPIs.
  • Monitor performance dashboards and continuously optimize the business model through experimentation and iteration.
  • Lead competitive benchmarking and market analysis to identify emerging opportunities.

2. Product & Commercial Optimization

  • Collaborate with product managers to refine pricing, packaging, and value propositions.
  • Work with MVNOs and wholesale partners to test and iterate on offers, bundles, and promotions to improve conversion and upsell.
  • Identify opportunities to create new revenue streams through innovative products, alternative business models, and strategic partnerships.

3. Partnership Development & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Pitch wholesale offers to potential MVNO and wholesale partners, tailoring proposals to diverse market segments.
  • Negotiate business model and commercial terms for new partner onboarding.
  • Build long-term relationships with ecosystem players including MNOs, device manufacturers, fintechs, and digital service providers.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Proven experience with P&L ownership in telecommunications, digital, or tech-driven businesses.
  • Strong track record in growth management, with measurable results in subscriber acquisition and revenue scaling.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, agile environment with cross-functional collaboration.
  • Data-driven with strong analytical, financial modelling, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in digital-first or challenger brand environments.
  • Familiarity with subscription-based or telecom business models.
  • Experience in partnership development with MNOs, MVNOs, or digital ecosystem players.
  • Exposure to international markets and regulatory frameworks in telecom.
  • Ability to lead cross-border projects and manage multicultural teams.

Skills & Competencies

Decision Making

Collaboration

Customer Orientation

Learning Agility

Developing People

Transdisciplinary Thinking

job.title: Associate Network Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

The role is responsible for IT/network warehouse operations, asset tracking, equipment staging, dispatch/collection, RMA/vendor coordination, and Level 1 support for basic network checks, connectivity troubleshooting, and deployment assistance across enterprise networking and security equipment.

LOGISTICS & ASSET MANAGEMENT

  • Receive, inspect, asset-tag, label, store, issue, dispatch, and track network hardware and accessories.
  • Maintain inventory records for models, serial numbers, asset tags, warranty/support status, site location, stock movement, and project assignment.
  • Manage spare units, replacement devices, SFPs, cables, modules, power supplies, and related network accessories.
  • Coordinate delivery, collection, and equipment movement between warehouse, office, vendor, and customer sites.
  • Prepare equipment for deployment, including packing, labeling, staging, base records, and handover documentation.
  • Manage RMA, faulty unit replacement, warranty claims, repair tracking, return-to-vendor, and vendor follow-up.
  • Maintain delivery notes, collection forms, stock reports, inventory trackers, and audit-ready warehouse records.

LEVEL 1 NETWORK SUPPORT

  • Perform basic checks for power, cabling, LED status, link status, port status, SFP status, and physical connectivity.
  • Assist with device staging, rack-and-stack, patching, labeling, hardware replacement, and site deployment activities.
  • Support basic troubleshooting for LAN, WAN, WLAN, firewall, and connectivity incidents or service requests.
  • Collect hostnames, IP addresses, serial numbers, models, firmware versions, interface status, screenshots, and basic logs.
  • Perform simple ping, traceroute, cable checks, link verification, and post-replacement connectivity testing.
  • Update network documentation including port maps, rack layouts, deployment trackers, and inventory records.
  • Escalate complex configuration, routing, firewall, wireless, or security issues to Level 2/3 engineers with clear diagnostics.

Qualifications

  • At least Higher Nitec in IT / Engineering related field with at least 3 years of related experience. Fresh ITE graduates are welcome to apply.
  • Experience in logistics, warehouse operations, inventory control, IT asset management, or network equipment handling.
  • Able to identify switches, routers, firewalls, access points, SFPs, modules, cables, power supplies, and rack/patching components.
  • Basic knowledge of LAN, WAN, WLAN, IP addressing, VLANs, cabling, rack layout, and first-level connectivity checks.
  • Strong coordination with vendors, couriers, suppliers, field engineers, project managers, and technical teams.
  • Good documentation using spreadsheets, ticketing tools, inventory systems, asset trackers, and handover records.
  • Willing to support site rollout, hardware refresh, equipment replacement, and maintenance windows when required.

job.title: Network Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

ROLE SUMMARY

Network Engineer is responsible for stable, secure, and efficient network operations for enterprise customers through proactive Day 2 support and Level 2 technical expertise. The role focuses on timely incident resolution, maintaining high service availability, supporting changes and maintenance activities, and strengthening operational capability across Huawei NCE Campus and other supported network and security platforms.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide Level 2 support for Huawei NCE Campus network infrastructure and other supported enterprise networking platforms.
  • Ensure timely incident resolution and service restoration for customer environments, with clear diagnostics and escalation where required.
  • Perform root-cause analysis, implement corrective actions, and recommend preventive measures to reduce recurrence.
  • Maintain accurate network configurations, operational records, and technical documentation.
  • Collaborate with Day 1, cybersecurity, service management, and project teams to ensure seamless service delivery and effective handovers.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve network incidents involving switching, routing, wireless, access control, and firewall environments.
  • Perform configuration updates, firmware upgrades, and planned maintenance activities in accordance with approved procedures and change controls.
  • Conduct periodic health checks, monitoring, and performance analysis to identify and address potential service disruptions.
  • Support integration and interoperability testing with additional network platforms and products where required.
  • Provide technical reports, update service tickets, maintain operational records, and contribute to service reviews and operational meetings.

Qualifications

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • At least 5 years of experience in network operations, managed services, or medium-sized campus / enterprise network environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of Huawei NCE Campus, with practical experience supporting network incidents, changes, and day-to-day operations.
  • Working knowledge of LAN, WAN, WLAN, IP addressing, VLANs, switching, routing, network access control, and enterprise connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on exposure to one or more of Aruba, Cisco Meraki, Palo Alto, and Fortinet environments is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to perform structured troubleshooting, log and evidence collection, root-cause analysis, and effective escalation to vendors or higher-level engineering teams.
  • Experience with firmware upgrades, configuration changes, preventive maintenance, and operational change procedures.
  • Comfortable working with ticketing systems, monitoring tools, network documentation, and service management processes.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work cross-functionally with engineers, service management, project teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders.

job.title: Manager - Cloud & Security Customer Service Operations
job.description:
Broad outline of the Role

  • Responsible for providing L3 operational support for customer network services and solutions delivered across the data centre environment, including Cisco ACI, Nexus switches, routing, switching, and associated network services.
  • Responsible for diagnosing and resolving complex network incidents, performing root cause analysis, and providing appropriate technical solutions within agreed service levels.
  • Acts as a conduit between customers and internal teams such as Network Engineering, Architecture, Security, Systems, and Operations for effective issue resolution.
  • This is an operational role responsible for maintaining the availability, performance, and reliability of data centre network infrastructure, while providing technical guidance to L1/L2 support teams and reviewing the quality of technical work undertaken by these teams.

Minimum Qualifications & Experience

  • Graduate with 7–12 years of relevant network engineering experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience in data centre networking.
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco ACI and Cisco Nexus environments.
  • Experience working in an L3 network support/engineering role in a 24x7 operational environment.

Other Knowledge & Skills

  • Good knowledge of Cisco ACI, Nexus switching, routing and switching, VLAN, VRF, BGP, OSPF, vPC, LACP, TCP/IP, and network troubleshooting.
  • Working knowledge of ACI concepts such as Spine/Leaf architecture, APIC, EPGs, Bridge Domains, Contracts, and L3Out.
  • Experience in troubleshooting complex network connectivity, routing, switching, and data centre infrastructure issues.
  • Good understanding of integration with firewalls, load balancers, WAN, servers, and other infrastructure components.
  • Good understanding of incident, problem, change, and service management processes.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills.
  • Maintains awareness of the latest technologies and developments in data centre networking and Cisco ACI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide L3 technical administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and support to ensure efficient functionality and availability of data centre network infrastructure.
  • Perform incident validation, incident analysis, root cause analysis, and solution recommendation for complex network and ACI-related issues.
  • Troubleshoot Cisco ACI, Nexus, routing, switching, connectivity, VLAN/VRF, BGP, OSPF, vPC, and related network issues.
  • Act as a point of escalation for Level-1 and Level-2 network support teams, providing technical guidance and assistance in resolving complex incidents.
  • Coordinate with Network Engineering, Architecture, Security, Systems, Cloud, Application, and Operations teams on escalations, performance issues, outages, and service-impacting incidents.
  • Coordinate with Cisco TAC and other technology vendors for complex issues requiring vendor-level investigation and resolution.
  • Assist with the development, revision, and maintenance of Standard Operating Procedures, Working Instructions, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
  • Participate in network upgrades, ACI maintenance, migrations, implementation activities, and infrastructure refresh projects, including pre- and post-change validation.
  • Monitor network and ACI infrastructure performance and provide recommendations for tuning, optimization, capacity management, and service improvement.
  • Perform regular health checks and proactively identify potential network availability, performance, capacity, and connectivity issues.
  • Maintain accurate documentation relating to network configurations, ACI environment, topology, IP addressing, incident resolutions, and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Prepare and maintain weekly and monthly operational reports covering incidents, network performance, availability, outages, and service-related activities.
  • Provide recommendations for improving network operations, processes, procedures, standards, and support practices.
  • Maintain an inventory of operational procedures used by the network operations team and regularly review and update these procedures based on technology changes, incidents, and operational requirements.
  • Support Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major and recurring incidents and drive corrective and preventive actions to minimize repeat issues.
  • Participate in 24x7 support, on-call, and shift-based operations as required.
  • Ensure all activities are performed in accordance with established security, compliance, change-management, and operational standards.

Certifications

  • CCNP Enterprise or CCNP Data Center preferred.
  • Other equivalent networking certifications are an advantage.

job.description:
Primary Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, engineers, and product owners to define enterprise data architecture and information management strategies.
  • Design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models that support business, operational, analytical, and regulatory requirements.
  • Develop and govern enterprise data models, standards, and information architectures across multiple platforms and domains.
  • Lead data modelling reviews to ensure consistency, scalability, performance, and adherence to architectural standards.
  • Define and manage metadata, data lineage, reference data, and master data management frameworks.
  • Establish and maintain enterprise data governance processes, stewardship models, and data ownership structures.
  • Design API-driven information services and integration patterns to enable secure and efficient data exchange between systems.
  • Provide guidance on data quality management, information lifecycle management, and data integrity practices.
  • Work closely with development and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.
  • Produce and maintain architecture artefacts, data dictionaries, modelling standards, and technical documentation.

Secondary Responsibilities:

  • Support strategic planning activities through capability modelling, roadmap development, and future-state architecture definition.
  • Assess and recommend improvements to information architecture, data management processes, and platform capabilities.
  • Participate in architecture review boards, governance forums, and design authority activities.
  • Provide expertise in data migration, transformation, and modernisation initiatives.
  • Contribute to enterprise-wide data and information management policies, standards, and procedures.
  • Support compliance, audit, privacy, security, and risk management requirements through effective information architecture practices.
  • Mentor junior architects, analysts, data engineers, and modellers in data architecture and modelling disciplines.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve operational efficiency and business outcomes through data-driven solutions.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Extensive experience in enterprise data architecture, information management, and data modelling within large and complex organisations.
  • Expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling techniques and methodologies.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, metadata management, data lineage, and stewardship frameworks.
  • Experience designing enterprise information architectures supporting operational, analytical, and reporting requirements.
  • Proficiency in data integration architecture, API design concepts, and information exchange patterns.
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases, data warehousing, and information lifecycle management principles.
  • Experience facilitating stakeholder workshops, requirements analysis, and solution design activities.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused recommendations and outcomes.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in cyber security data domains, governance, and compliance reporting.
  • Knowledge of telecommunications, network inventory, asset management, or operational support systems.
  • Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks and capability modelling techniques.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native data platforms, data engineering practices, and modern data ecosystems.
  • Experience leading large-scale data transformation, modernisation, and information management initiatives.

Required Skills

  • api development
  • data architecture
  • data governance
  • data warehousing
  • data modelling
  • cyber security
  • network inventory
  • asset management
  • operational support systems
  • telecommunications

job.title: Sr Manager - Software & Application Development
job.description:
As a Platform Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our infrastructure to ensure scalability, reliability, and security. You will have hands-on experience in infrastructure hardening, storage solutions, containerization technologies, observability tools, and application security practices.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and manage infrastructure hardening processes to enhance the security posture of our cloud-based platforms.
  • Configure NetApp S3 storage solutions to suit project requirements – Administration and provisioning data containers and ACL’s.
  • Manage Docker and Kubernetes clusters to orchestrate containerized applications effectively.
  • Administer Kafka clusters, including configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting, to support high-throughput, distributed data streaming.
  • Implement and maintain observability solutions using Grafana and Prometheus, enabling comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and visualization of system metrics and logs.
  • Configure and manage Node-RED instances for IoT integration and workflow automation.
  • Implement MQTT protocols for lightweight messaging between IoT devices and backend systems.
  • Conduct application hardening activities, including secure coding practices, vulnerability assessments, and patch management.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize application performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Participate in on-call rotation and respond to incidents promptly, ensuring minimal downtime and maximum availability.
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry best practices, continually improving our infrastructure and processes.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Platform Engineer or similar role, with a focus on cloud-native infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure hardening techniques, including network security, access control, and vulnerability management.
  • Proficiency in deploying and managing NetApp S3 storage solutions or similar cloud storage platforms.
  • Strong expertise in Docker and Kubernetes, including containerization, orchestration, and cluster management.
  • Experience in administering Kafka clusters, with knowledge of configuration, replication, and performance tuning.
  • Familiarity with observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, and Puma for monitoring, logging, and tracing.
  • Experience configuring and managing Node-RED instances for IoT integration.
  • Knowledge of MQTT protocols for lightweight messaging and IoT communication.
  • Experience with application hardening practices, including secure coding, vulnerability assessments, and patch management.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex issues in a production environment.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

Required Skills

  • software development
  • application development
  • cloud security
  • infrastructure hardening
  • s3 storage
  • platform engineering
  • cloud native infrastructure
  • kafka
  • application security
  • application hardening

job.description:
Job Description

Network Operations & Support - DDI & Load Balancer (IP Services)

Experience: 8-10 Years

Location: Chennai/Bangalore

Role Summary

The Manager – IP Services role provides technical leadership and governance for enterprise IP services and application delivery platforms. The role is accountable for end-to-end solution delivery, stakeholder management, and strategic evolution of IP services across complex environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overall accountability for delivery and stability of IP Services platforms
  • Architect, review, and govern solutions based on F5, Infoblox, and NGINX technologies
  • Act as subject matter expert for application delivery, DNS, DHCP, and IPAM services
  • Lead design and adoption of scalable, secure, and automated IP services architectures

  • Extensive expertise in F5, Infoblox, and NGINX platforms
  • Proven leadership in large-scale enterprise environments
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills
  • Strong ownership mindset, integrity, and decision-making capability

Any degree or relevant education is must. This role requires working at customer locations based on business needs.

job.title: Operations Technical Officer
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

  • Support the Shift Engineer to operate the plant to achieve 100% availability with 24 hrs. continuous dispatch of treated water complying with the WPA and O&M procedure meeting dispatch quantity, quality and energy target.
  • Perform O&M work in strict compliance with safety, environment pollution control and housekeeping.
  • Perform quality monitoring and operational works in the control room, coordinating with Operation Technicians onsite to operate the plant.
  • Report and record any operations abnormalities to the Supervisor and carry out rectification plan promptly to restore both dispatched water quality and quantity
  • Coordinate with Maintenance Team on daily maintenance requirements and activities.
  • Liaise with PUB WSCC to fulfill operational requirements.
  • Prepare and maintain daily and monthly operations records.
  • Monitor daily chemical consumption.
  • Comply with environment, health and safety regulation for all works carry out in the plant
  • Prepare operation report and assist operation managers in plant operation management such as chemicals stock monitoring etc.
  • Accept ad hoc assignment given by managers
  • Accept multi-tasking; willing to take on extra responsibilities to support O&M of the plant

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Possess ITE or Diploma in Science, Environmental, Chemical Engineering or other engineering-related field
  • Min 2 years’ experience in desalination plant Control Room operation
  • Positive attitude and a good team-player
  • Willing to work on shift
  • Willing to work beyond normal working hours due to operational needs of the Desalination Plant
  • Ability to work as part of a specialist shift team and liaise with numerous personnel during critical plant outage periods.
  • Willing to work at multiple sites
  • Possession of Forklift License preferred

BUSINESS SEGMENT

Infrastructure

PLATFORM

Operating Division

job.title: Executive Assistant & Office Manager, APAC
job.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Position Overview

The Executive Assistant & Office Manager, APAC is a senior strategic support role providing trusted partnership to Asia Pacific leaders, combining executive assistance with regional office management oversight across Sydney.

This role sits at the heart of the organization and interacts with employees at all levels, as well as external stakeholders. The successful candidate is highly organized, adaptable, service-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. They bring a strong “can-do” mindset, excellent judgment, and a proven track record supporting senior leadership while managing office operations effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Executive & Administrative Support

  • Manage complex calendars for Executives, including meetings across time zones
  • Proactively manage email, correspondence, call screening, and follow-ups on behalf of leaders
  • Provide end-to-end administrative support, including records management and confidential documentation
  • Prepare meeting agendas, attend meetings, capture minutes, and track action items to completion
  • Serve as a key point of contact between Executives, internal teams, clients, and external partners
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel and manage expenses
  • Anticipate executive needs, manage competing priorities, and support effective time management

Office Management & Operations

  • Oversee daily office operations, space management, access cards, and office supplies
  • Partner with facilities on maintenance, repairs, and workplace improvements
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and service quality
  • Implement and support health, safety, and workplace compliance initiatives

Communication, Collaboration & Events

  • Act as a liaison to ensure clear, timely communication across stakeholders and departments
  • Partner with teams to support business initiatives and cross-functional collaboration
  • Support planning and execution of company events, town halls, and special projects
  • Build strong, trusted relationships with internal and external partners

Qualifications & Experience Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant supporting C-level Executives and/or VPs
  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in an Office Manager or Office Administrator role
  • Experience working with diverse, multicultural stakeholders across multiple time zones
  • Proven ability to handle highly confidential information with discretion
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (formal and informal)
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively
  • High proficiency with Microsoft tools, including Outlook calendaring
  • Energetic, adaptable, solutions oriented, and quick to learn

Preferred

  • Experience using SharePoint
  • Experience with global travel platforms

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage.

job.title: Engineer - Asset Commissioning
job.description:
Commissioning Plan Formulation and Project Coordination:

Develops and implements detailed commissioning plans for wind, solar, and hybrid projects, ensuring alignment with engineering specifications and regulatory standards.

Coordinates with project stakeholders to address all necessary technical aspects and comply with project requirements.

Gathers information related to connectivity, LTA/GNA, and project commissioning for efficient execution of upcoming renewable energy projects.

System Testing and Performance Validation:

Executes rigorous system testing and validation protocols to confirm that all systems meet performance specifications and function correctly under operational conditions.

Conducts power performance analysis for wind turbines and ensures the commissioning of turbines as handed over by the project team.

Ensures 100% turbine healthiness for continuous operation and addresses any discrepancies to maintain optimal performance.

Technical Issue Identification and Rectification:

Diagnoses and resolves technical issues encountered during the commissioning phase, applying advanced troubleshooting methods and collaborating with engineering teams to address root causes.

Develops and implements effective solutions to technical problems, ensuring all issues are resolved promptly to prevent disruptions.

Provides technical training to team members and supports in resolving error fault breakdowns for turbines.

Regulatory Compliance and Safety Assurance:

Ensures that all commissioning activities adhere to established industry regulations, safety standards, and project specifications, maintaining high levels of quality and compliance throughout the process.

Develops a safety culture at sites by ensuring workplace safety and adherence to SOPs, targeting zero accidents and Lost Time Injuries (LTIs).

Verifies compliance with safety protocols during construction and operation of EHV and 33KV lines.

Documentation and Reporting:

Prepares comprehensive documentation and reports on commissioning activities, including test results, performance data, and compliance verification.

Maintains detailed records of all commissioning activities, providing essential documentation for ongoing monitoring and regulatory compliance.

Prepares and submits site-wise budgets for operational and capital expenditure as per the project timeline.

Collaboration and Business Performance Monitoring:

Works closely with engineering teams to coordinate commissioning activities and address technical issues that arise, ensuring effective collaboration and problem resolution.

Monitors business performance against goals and identifies cost optimization opportunities in running projects.

Ensures timely closure of audit points and compliance with management systems, contributing to organizational transformation and change management.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Direct Supervisors & other Department Leaders

Project Manager

Engineering Head

Procurement Team

Finance Team

Legal Team

Quality Control

Safety Officer

IT Department

External Stakeholders

Equipment Suppliers

Government Regulatory Bodies

Grid Authority

Consultants

Testing Laboratories

Certification Bodies

Industry Associations

Contractors

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering is required.

Strong academic foundation in power systems, electrical machines, control systems, and instrumentation. Proficiency in commissioning procedures and testing methodologies.

Work Experience:

3-4 years of experience in commissioning of power plants or industrial equipment.

Hands-on experience in equipment installation, testing, and commissioning. Knowledge of safety protocols, quality standards.

job.title: Team Member - FP&A
job.description:

job.title: Lead - Physical Security
job.description:
Responsibilities

Project Management: Lead and manage security projects within data centres, ensuring they meet industry standards and regulatory requirements.

Security Strategy : Develop and implement security strategies and plans to address potential risks and vulnerabilities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security solutions into the project lifecycle, ensuring seamless implementation and operational efficiency.

Security Assessments: Conduct comprehensive security assessments to identify vulnerabilities, risks, and gaps in security measures, and provide recommendations for improvement.

Security Audits: Lead security audits to ensure compliance with industry standards, internal policies, and regulatory requirements, identifying areas for remediation.

Risk Management: Develop and implement risk management strategies to mitigate security threats, continuously assessing and addressing potential security risks across projects.

Liaison with Government Bodies: Collaborate and liaise with government bodies and regulatory authorities to ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements related to security.

Vigilance: Establish and maintain vigilance protocols to detect and prevent unauthorized access or security breaches, ensuring proactive monitoring of critical assets.

Incident Reporting: Oversee the incident reporting process, ensuring timely documentation, investigation, and communication of security incidents to relevant stakeholders.

Technology Trends: Stay informed about emerging security technologies and trends, recommending innovative solutions to enhance the organization's security posture.

Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert on security-related issues, offering insights and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

Stakeholder Communication: Communicate effectively with stakeholders, ensuring alignment on security objectives, project goals, and initiatives.

Brand Positioning: Ensure Adani's brand values are shown in all interactions. Strengthen relationships to boost the organization's brand and trust within the market and company.

Team Development: Build a high-performing team. Set clear KPIs, track progress, and implement strategies for continuous improvement. Promote a respectful and safe workplace, lead collaborative and productive teams, and mentor for growth and success. Tracks and reports on key performance indicators (KPIs) for digital business success.

Digital mindset: Champions a digital mindset within the organization to drive innovation and competitiveness. Keep up with digital and AI advancements to enhance business and maintain competitiveness.

Project Manager

Internal teams

Contractors

Government authorities

job.title: Finance Controller - IFF
job.description:

job.title: Head – ICT Projects & Digital Infrastructure
job.description:
IT Project Management:

  • Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of IT projects focused on construction, such as Building Information Modeling (BIM) integration, project management software (e.g., SAP or Oracle), and real-time data analytics tools.
  • Coordinate the implementation of IT systems for construction project monitoring, scheduling, resource allocation, and cost tracking.
  • Develop and manage detailed project plans, ensuring alignment with construction timelines, safety standards, and airport regulations.

Construction IT Systems:

  • Ensure that technology solutions, such as BIM, are effectively integrated with airport construction activities to enhance project collaboration and improve efficiency.
  • Oversee the deployment of IT systems that support digital twins, GIS mapping, construction automation tools, data centers, network architecture, communication systems and compliance with aviation and construction standards.
  • Manage the installation of network infrastructure, including fiber optics, IoT sensors, and wireless systems to support real-time project tracking and remote monitoring.
  • Collaborate with airport operations to provide operational support for critical 24/7 airport functions related to construction projects.

Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Collaborate with the construction and IT teams, contractors, suppliers, and regulatory bodies to deliver IT projects that support the airport's construction activities.
  • Act as a liaison between the IT department and construction stakeholders to ensure technology meets project requirements and adheres to regulatory compliance.

Risk Management & Compliance:

  • Identify potential IT risks related to construction projects and develop mitigation strategies.
  • Ensure that all IT systems used in construction meet industry standards and aviation regulations (e.g., ICAO, IATA) and comply with cybersecurity and data protection protocols.
  • Address health and safety concerns by ensuring that IT systems are designed to support safe construction practices.

Budget and Financial Oversight:

  • Oversee the IT project budget specific to construction, ensuring cost-effective use of resources and technology investments.
  • Provide financial forecasts and reports on project IT expenditures to senior management.

Vendor and Contract Management:

  • Negotiate and manage relationships with IT vendors, ensuring the delivery of quality services and adherence to contractual obligations.
  • Oversee the procurement of IT systems and services, ensuring alignment with the airport's long-term technology roadmap.

Digital Mindset:

  • Drive the adoption of innovative digital technologies like BIM, IoT, and data analytics to enhance efficiency in construction projects.
  • Stay updated with emerging construction technologies to improve efficiency and ensure airport infrastructure is built using advanced IT solutions.

Team Leadership and Development:

  • Lead and mentor team members by providing constructive feedback, helping them develop their technical and project management skills.

job.title: Associate Lead - Solution Architect
job.description:
About Business:

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

Data Centre: Adani Data Centre has rapidly transformed from a nascent initiative to a leading innovator in the data infrastructure ecosystem. In just a few years, we have established ourselves as a key player in the data centre landscape, offering state-of-the-art solutions in areas such as colocation services, cloud integration, and data security. Our commitment to reliability, scalability, and technological excellence has positioned us as a trusted partner for businesses navigating the digital age with confidence.

The individual will work closely with cross-functional teams, providing technical leadership, guiding the development of architecture strategies, and ensuring alignment with both business goals and best industry practices.

Design & Implementation:

Collaborate with senior architects to design and implement scalable and secure solutions for data center and cloud environments.

Architectural Strategy:

Deployment of architecture strategies and frameworks that meet business needs while adhering to industry standards and best practices.

Stakeholder Collaboration:

Technology Trends:

Issue Resolution:

Provide technical expertise to resolve complex architectural or system-related issues, ensuring timely and effective resolution.

Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives related to architecture processes, tools, standards, and methodologies.

Digital mindset:

Champions a digital mindset within the organization to drive innovation and competitiveness. Keep up with digital and AI advancements to enhance business and maintain competitiveness.

Internal teams,

Direct reportees

Cross Functional Teams

Customers,

Vendors
