job.title: Facility Engineer (Electrical)
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital with investors including some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Digital Edge’s vision is to be the leading provider of sustainable, next generation digital infrastructure in Asia. Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering populations they serve.

Founded in late 2019, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across Japan, South Korea, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand and China. The Company now owns and operates 21 data centers with over 500 MW of critical IT load in service and under construction and development, with another 300 MW held for future development,

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

Roles Open for This Intake:

**

We are hiring 3 job families and roles across our Jakarta site. All roles are shift-based and site-based. Full job descriptions will be shared with registered candidates ahead of the event, but the high-level summary are provided below.

  • Facility Technician

Hands-on operation and maintenance of critical electrical, mechanical, and HVAC systems in a 24/7 data center environment.

What you'll do

  • Monitor and maintain power, cooling, and control systems
  • Carry out preventive maintenance and routine inspections
  • Responding to incidents, alarms, and equipment anomalies
  • Coordinate with vendors during planned and unplanned work

What we're looking for

  • 1–2 years' experience in mechanical, electrical, or HVAC systems (data center, telecom, or other critical environments preferred)
  • Vocational diploma (SMK) or higher in a relevant technical field
  • Willing to work rotating shifts, including nights and weekends
  • Physically capable of equipment handling in operational conditions
  • Customer Care Assistant, Site Operations

First point of contact for customer inquiries, incident handling, and service coordination on site. This is a customer-facing operations role, not an engineering role.

**

What you'll do

  • Manage customer tickets and service requests end-to-end
  • Coordinate with internal technical teams to resolve incidents within SLA
  • Maintain accurate documentation and reporting
  • Contribute to process improvements across the customer journey

What we're looking for

  • Prior customer service experience, ideally in data center, telco, or tech environments
  • Diploma or degree (business, operations, or related fields preferred)
  • Basic understanding of data center operations (advantage, not required)
  • Strong written and verbal communication in Bahasa Indonesia and English
  • Team Lead, Facility Operations

Leads a team of Facility Technicians across shifts, with day-to-day ownership of site operations, incident response, and maintenance execution.

**

What you'll do

  • Supervise and develop a team of technicians across rotating shifts
  • Own incident response, escalation, and root-cause follow-through
  • Ensure compliance with safety, operational, and vendor standards
  • Partner with the Facility Manager on planning, reporting, and continuous improvement

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in data center, mission-critical facilities, or industrial operations, with at least 2 years leading a team
  • Strong technical grounding in electrical and/or mechanical systems
  • Proven track record managing incidents in a 24/7 environment
  • Diploma or degree in engineering or a related technical discipline

Why Digital Edge:

**

  • Work on infrastructure that matters: you'll operate the facilities powering Indonesia's largest digital platforms
  • Regional scale, local ownership: part of a 30+ site platform across Asia, with decisions made close to the ground in Jakarta
  • Backed for the long term: Stonepeak-funded with over US$1.6B in committed capital
  • Clear technical career paths in one of the fastest-growing data center markets in the region

Career Day Format:

**

  • Confirmation of invites will be sent to shortlisted candidates only.
  • Full day session with option for AM/PM sessions including role briefing, technical conversation, and meeting with hiring managers.
  • Same day outcomes
  • Venue shared only after registration is confirmed.
  • Registration window: 3rd July to 28th July

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

job.title: Customer Marketing Manager
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll help create meaningful engagements with enterprise customers and senior decision-makers, turning conversations, insights and relationships into opportunities for deeper partnership and business growth.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

As the Customer Marketing Manager, you will translate Singtel Enterprise’s marketing priorities into high-impact customer engagement programmes that strengthen strategic relationships, generate customer insights, support pipeline progression and build customer advocacy.

You will connect account-level customer activation with senior-leader platforms such as the Customer Advisory Council (CAC), executive roundtables, industry forums and CE/CXO engagements. Working closely with Sales, Business Development, Client Solution & Transformation (CST), Enterprise Product and senior leadership, you will ensure every engagement is purposeful, coordinated and followed through to measurable business outcomes.

How You will Make An Impact:

Customer Engagement Strategy & Programme Management

  • Develop and execute integrated customer engagement plans aligned to Enterprise growth priorities, strategic accounts, vertical programmes and the annual marketing calendar.
  • Translate Enterprise marketing priorities into targeted programmes across priority accounts, customer segments and growth sectors.
  • Develop annual and quarterly activation plans covering executive engagements, customer events, workshops, forums, roundtables, exhibitions and account-based sessions.
  • Design engagements around clear business objectives, target personas, account priorities and intended customer outcomes.
  • Apply the Connect–Converse–Convert–Champion framework to support relationship development, opportunity progression and customer advocacy.
  • Maintain an integrated calendar across customer engagements, senior-leader platforms and strategic industry touchpoints.

CE/CXO & Senior-Leader Engagement

  • Identify opportunities to engage priority customers through CAC sessions, executive roundtables, industry forums, leadership dinners and other CE/CXO platforms.
  • Partner with senior leaders, Sales and account teams to define customer agendas, objectives and follow-up plans.
  • Curate executive engagement journeys combining thought leadership, customer challenges, Singtel capabilities, industry perspectives and peer interaction.
  • Coordinate senior-management participation, executive hosting, briefing requirements and customer protocols.
  • Prepare executive briefs, customer profiles, account context, talking points and run-of-show documents.
  • Track relationships and opportunities arising from senior-leader engagements and ensure disciplined account-level follow-through.

Customer Events & Engagement Execution

  • Lead end-to-end planning and delivery of customer events, executive forums, workshops, roundtables, exhibitions, networking sessions and appreciation programmes.
  • Develop detailed project plans, timelines, budgets, responsibility matrices, checklists and contingency plans.
  • Manage venues, agencies, vendors, speakers, event production, branding, technical requirements, hospitality and on-site operations.
  • Manage internal approvals, procurement, purchase orders, contracts, invoicing and governance requirements.
  • Conduct post-event reviews covering customer feedback, lead outcomes, stakeholder observations and improvement actions.
  • Ensure customer experiences meet the standards expected for senior executives, strategic customers and VIP guests.

Customer Insights & Business Outcomes

  • Capture Voice of Customer insights from events, senior-leader platforms, surveys and stakeholder feedback.
  • Monitor customer trends, industry developments, competitor activity and emerging executive topics.
  • Translate customer insights into actionable recommendations for GTM messaging, customer engagement, solution positioning and future programmes.
  • Strengthen governance and follow-through of marketing-generated leads and customer actions.
  • Maintain dashboards and trackers covering account engagement, leads, follow-up progress and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Sales to support the progression of customer engagement into qualified conversations and opportunities.
  • Monitor MQL-to-SQL conversion, pipeline influence and account progression where attributable.

Stakeholder, Vendor & Governance Management

  • Work independently across Sales, Enterprise Product, CST, Business Development, Marketing, senior management and external partners.
  • Manage agencies, vendors, speakers, facilitators and ecosystem partners against agreed scopes and service standards.
  • Maintain accurate programme documentation, budgets, customer records, trackers and approvals.
  • Ensure programmes comply with brand, legal, procurement, finance, data-protection and internal governance requirements.
  • Proactively identify risks, dependencies and operational issues and drive them through to resolution.

##

Skills for Success:

  • Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related discipline.
  • At least 6–9 years of relevant experience in B2B customer marketing, executive engagement, events, corporate communications or stakeholder management.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex customer programmes from concept through execution and post-event follow-up.
  • Experience supporting senior-executive, C-suite or VIP engagements.
  • Experience partnering with Sales and business teams on account-based customer engagement.
  • Strong programme and project management capabilities.
  • Proven ability to manage agencies, vendors, budgets and multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong written communication and executive-briefing skills.
  • Able to maintain structured trackers, dashboards, budgets and reports, including leveraging AI tools and capabilities.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, marketing automation, event platforms and customer-data tools.
  • Able to interpret customer engagement, lead and pipeline-performance metrics.
  • Highly organised, resourceful and able to work independently.
  • Strong ownership with the ability to influence without formal authority.
  • Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced environment.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

job.title: Data Enablement Lead
job.description:
Sydney, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Every day, millions of Australians connect, work, stream, and stay in touch on the Optus network. When it works seamlessly, it’s easy to take for granted. But behind it is a team making thousands of decisions every day - decisions that keep people, businesses and communities connected.

Right now, Optus is focused on getting the fundamentals right - simplifying how we work, lifting standards, and building a more reliable, resilient experience for our customers.

It’s not about surface-level change. It’s about how we make decisions, how we work together, and how we deliver.

As a Data Enablement Lead, you will leverage your expertise in data management, analytics, governance, and stakeholder engagement to deliver trusted, high-quality data solutions that support strategic business outcomes. Working closely with stakeholders across Billing & Credit and the wider organisation, this role will drive data maturity, manage data risk and control frameworks, lead remediation initiatives, and ensure best-practice delivery of data services. The successful candidate will champion a strong data culture by improving secure data accessibility, developing robust data pipelines and single sources of truth, and enabling informed decision-making that enhances operational performance, customer outcomes, collections effectiveness, and business growth.

**

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the design and delivery of enterprise data solutions, including data integration, data modelling, and pipeline development, ensuring accurate, trusted, and accessible data supports informed business decision-making and strategic outcomes.
  • Drive data governance, quality, and risk management practices by establishing robust controls, managing data access, maintaining compliance documentation, leading data quality initiatives, and partnering with stakeholders to align with broader organisational data strategies.
  • Develop and enhance scalable reporting and analytics capabilities through the maintenance of single sources of truth, optimisation of reporting assets, automation of data processes, and the creation of analytical models that improve business performance and operational efficiency.
  • Champion a data-driven culture across the organisation by providing technical leadership, supporting self-service analytics and data democratisation, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and coaching analysts to deliver innovative, best-practice data solutions.

**

What You Bring

  • Strong data engineering and analytics expertise, supported by relevant tertiary qualifications and industry certifications.
  • Extensive experience delivering cloud-based data solutions, including data warehousing, ETL, big data frameworks, pipeline orchestration, SQL, and programming languages such as Python and Java.
  • Proven leadership in data governance, risk management, reporting, and analytics, with the ability to drive data quality, best practices, and business outcomes.
  • Exceptional stakeholder engagement, communication, and problem-solving skills, with a track record of leading teams, influencing decisions, and delivering results in complex environments. By empowering one another, backing bold ideas and helping you own your impact, we’ve designed a workplace that gives you the freedom to grow, the support to thrive, and the chance to be part of something bigger – a team that’s shaping a more connected, inclusive and inspired Australia.

**

The good stuff:

  • Competitive remuneration, plus $80 monthly credit, 25% off Optus products and exclusive shopping discounts with our retail partners — making everyday life a little more affordable. Genuine Flexibility - work three days in the office, two days from wherever works best for you.
  • An office campus that has it all - cafes chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre. It’s designed for real life.
  • Great leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever matters most to you.
  • Inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks, because family comes first.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Your wellbeing matters, so we offer with free counselling and support services, available 24/7 in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • A free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon. Or, heaps of onsite parking. Plus, end of trip facilities with lockers, showers, irons and hair dryers**

Not every box ticked? Apply anyway. We believe the right mindset matter more than a perfect CV. We’ll back you to grow from there.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit [https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity](https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity)

job.title: Lead AI Portfolio Management & Commercialization #AIDA
job.description:
About the Role

This is a highly visible role at the centre of Singtel’s enterprise AI transformation. The AI Portfolio Management & Commercialization Lead will own integrated portfolio performance across more than eight value pools and over 50 AI use cases, ensuring investments are strategically prioritised, delivery risks are actively addressed and the strongest capabilities are positioned for enterprise scale and commercialization.

A defining requirement of the role is the ability to convert complex portfolio performance, technology and business information into clear, compelling executive narratives. The role will support the Chief AI Officer and senior leadership forums with decision-ready insights, strategic recommendations and a credible view of progress, value, risks and trade-offs.

Success requires an uncommon combination of strategic thinking, structured problem solving, portfolio leadership, commercial acumen and exceptional communication. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating in ambiguity, navigating a complex stakeholder environment and influencing senior leaders without relying on formal authority.

Make an Impact By:

  • Enterprise AI Portfolio Leadership
  • Lead the integrated management of Singtel’s enterprise AI portfolio connecting strategy, investment, delivery, adoption and value realization.
  • Drive portfolio prioritisation, sequencing and governance, balancing strategic impact, execution readiness, risk, dependencies and resource constraints.
  • Establish a clear, decision-ready view of portfolio health and identify systemic issues, trade-offs and interventions required to protect outcomes.
  • Orchestrate senior cross-functional interventions across business, product, technology, data, finance, legal and risk teams, acting as the escalation point for material portfolio issues.
  • Strengthen portfolio disciplines, decision rights, management information and operating cadence as AIDA scales.
  • Executive Portfolio Narrative & Strategic Influence
  • Translate complex portfolio performance, value realization, technology developments and strategic risks into concise, compelling narratives for Executive/ Senior leadership forums.
  • Develop high-impact executive read-outs, strategic reviews, investment cases and decision papers that clearly frame progress, implications, trade-offs and recommended actions.
  • Synthesize multiple value pools and workstreams into a coherent enterprise story, ensuring leadership has the right level of insight.
  • Use structured problem solving and fact-based analysis to challenge assumptions, sharpen recommendations and accelerate executive alignment and decision-making.
  • Shape the broader narrative of Singtel’s AI transformation for selected internal and external engagements.
  • Commercialization
  • Identify selected AI and Agentic AI assets with potential for broader productisation or external commercialization.
  • Shape commercialization pathways and business cases, including market opportunity, customer need, value proposition, packaging, go-to-market options and commercial model considerations.
  • Partner with Enterprise, Consumer, Product, Commercial, Technology, Finance, Legal and Risk stakeholders to assess opportunity attractiveness and commercialization readiness.
  • Develop and nurture a qualified pipeline of opportunities, moving promising concepts from initial exploration toward structured validation and accountable ownership.
  • Engage strategic customers and ecosystem partners, including hyperscalers, startups and industry participants, where partnerships can accelerate capability development, adoption or market reach.

Skills for Success

Experience

  • At least 10 years of experience in strategy, management consulting, enterprise transformation, portfolio management, digital or technology strategy, or comparable leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional portfolios and influencing senior executives in a matrixed organisation.
  • Strong track record of structuring ambiguous problems, developing actionable recommendations and driving outcomes without direct line authority.
  • Experience developing executive-level narratives, presentations and decision materials for C-suite or senior leadership audiences.
  • Experience in commercialization, business-case development, productisation, partnerships or go-to-market strategy.

Professional Capabilities

  • Enterprise portfolio strategy, prioritisation, governance and performance management.
  • Consulting-calibre structured problem solving, synthesis and strategic judgement.
  • Exceptional written communication, narrative development and executive presentation skills.
  • Commercial acumen and the ability to connect AI investments to business value, customer outcomes and growth opportunities.
  • Working understanding of AI, data and technology transformation, with the ability to translate technical complexity into business implications.

Preferred

job.title: Lead Specialist, Customer Data Platform
job.description:
Sydney, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

Are you passionate about turning complex customer data into meaningful, personalised customer experiences? We're looking for a Lead Specialist - Customer Data Platform to join our Customer Data Platform team and play a key role in shaping how customer data is onboarded, unified, and activated across the organisation.

In this hands-on specialist role, you'll work at the intersection of data engineering, customer platforms, and activation, partnering with enterprise data teams and business stakeholders to deliver trusted, high-quality customer data through Salesforce Data Cloud.

What You’ll Do

As a Lead Specialist, you'll be responsible for designing, building, testing, and deploying Salesforce Data Cloud solutions that enable customer personalisation at scale. You'll collaborate with data engineers, architects, platform owners, and activation teams to ensure customer data is effective, trusted, and ready for use across multiple channels.

  • Design and configure Data Model Objects (DMOs), Data Stream Objects (DSOs), Data Lake Object mappings, and ingestion frameworks within Salesforce Data Cloud.
  • Build and maintain Identity Resolution rules and unified customer profiles.
  • Lead end-to-end customer data onboarding initiatives across development, testing, and production environments.
  • Establish data quality controls, validation processes, and implementation standards to ensure trusted customer data.
  • Partner with enterprise data platform teams to ensure curated datasets meet Data Cloud requirements and governance standards.
  • Collaborate with decisioning, activation, and analytics teams to deliver data solutions that enable customer engagement and personalisation.

What makes you perfect for the role?

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, including data modelling, ingestion, and identity resolution.
  • Strong understanding of Databricks, data lakes, or enterprise data platforms, with advanced SQL skills and experience using Python or similar scripting languages.
  • Experience delivering customer data solutions in a complex enterprise environment.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.
  • Salesforce certifications and experience working within Agile delivery environments are highly regarded.

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Direct your own development and build future-ready skills with Optus U’s industry-focused micro-credentials, developed with La Trobe and Macquarie Universities.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • Free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon.

job.title: Manager, Talent Acquisition
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Talent Acquisition & Business Partnership

  • Partner Hiring Managers and HR stakeholders to understand business strategy, workforce priorities and emerging capability requirements to translate business needs into practical and forward-looking talent acquisition strategies.
  • Advise stakeholders on talent availability, market conditions, compensation expectations, competitor activity and realistic hiring timelines.
  • Challenge hiring requirements constructively and help Hiring Managers differentiate between critical skills, trainable capabilities and traditional credential requirements.
  • Translate business strategy, technology transformation and purpose into compelling talent narratives.

2. End-to-End Recruitment Excellence

  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from intake and sourcing through assessment, offer and onboarding.
  • Develop differentiated sourcing strategies for specialist, niche and high-volume requirements.
  • Drive strong recruitment discipline including timely feedback, pipeline management and closure of aged vacancies.
  • Ensure recruitment practices remain compliant with applicable employment legislation, internal policies and fair hiring principles.

3. AI, Automation & Digital Recruitment

  • Champion the adoption of AI and automation across Talent Acquisition to improve speed, quality and recruiter productivity.
  • Use AI-enabled tools to support areas such as talent sourcing, CV screening, job description development, candidate engagement and interview preparation.
  • Identify repetitive recruitment activities that can be automated or redesigned.
  • Maintain appropriate human oversight and responsible use of AI in hiring decisions.

4. Talent Intelligence & Proactive Sourcing

  • Build talent pipelines before vacancies arise, particularly for critical and emerging skills.
  • Conduct external talent mapping and competitor intelligence to identify where key capabilities reside.
  • Develop talent communities for recurring and difficult-to-hire skill areas, and utilise market intelligence to advise the business on talent scarcity, location strategy, skills adjacency and alternative talent pools.
  • Convert sourcing insights into actionable recommendations for business and workforce planning.
  • Provide Hiring Managers and leadership with clear insights on recruitment performance and talent-market conditions.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Approximately 6–10 years of Talent Acquisition or recruitment experience, preferably within a complex, fast-moving organisation.
  • Strong end-to-end recruitment and direct sourcing capability for evolving, specialist or difficult-to-hire capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders and influence Hiring Managers.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret recruitment data and translate insights into action.
  • Familiarity with ATS platforms, sourcing technologies, recruitment analytics and utility of AI-enabled recruitment tools.
  • Good understanding of fair and responsible hiring practices.
  • Experienced in talent mapping, workforce planning, employer branding and TA transformation work.

job.title: Network Operations Manager - Fed Gov
job.description:
Macquarie Park, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

The Manager Network Operations, Federal Government is a senior leadership role responsible for the delivery, performance, and continuous improvement of Managed Network Services for Federal Government customers. Leading a team of Tier 2 and Tier 3 Network Engineers, the role drives the transition to proactive, intelligence-led, and automation-first operations, ensuring high levels of service reliability, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction.

As the senior technical and operational escalation point, the role works closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and technology partners to improve service performance, accelerate issue resolution, and strengthen customer experience. The position is accountable for building operational capability across network engineering, service management, security, and automation while delivering measurable business and customer outcomes.

**

This role requires you to be an Australian citizen and hold, or be eligible to obtain and maintain, an NV1 security clearance.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of Tier 2 and Tier 3 Network Engineers, driving technical excellence, capability uplift, and a culture of accountability across Federal Government network operations.
  • Own the delivery and service assurance of Managed Network Services, ensuring proactive monitoring, rapid incident resolution, strong operational governance, and achievement of customer SLAs and performance targets.
  • Drive the transformation to intelligence-led, automation-first operations, leveraging automation, AI, and observability capabilities to improve service reliability, reduce manual effort, and accelerate resolution times.
  • Act as the senior technical escalation authority for critical customer incidents, complex network issues, and major service events, providing leadership and clear communication to customers and stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain a secure, compliant, and scalable Federal Government operations capability, ensuring engineering standards, security obligations, and service requirements are consistently met.
  • Influence strategic roadmaps and stakeholder outcomes by partnering with Product, Network, Security, Client Delivery, and vendor teams to enhance service performance, improve customer experience, and drive continuous innovation.

What You Bring

  • NV1/NV2 Federal Government security clearance, or eligibility to obtain and maintain the required security clearance, combined with strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build high-performing teams, drive capability uplift, and deliver strategic outcomes.
  • Minimum 12 years’ technical specialist or engineering experience within large-scale, ITIL aligned managed services or network operations environments, with a strong track record of delivering operational excellence and service outcomes.
  • Extensive leadership experience leading large, multi-disciplinary technical teams, including senior engineers and team leaders, within complex enterprise environments.
  • Deep technical expertise across network engineering, service assurance, incident management, observability, and operational service delivery.
  • Demonstrated success driving operational transformation through automation, AI-led operations, proactive monitoring, and intelligent event management to improve service performance and customer outcomes.
  • Experience working within Federal Government or highly regulated environments, with a strong understanding of security, compliance, and governance requirements.

The good stuff….

job.title: Staff Engineer- I&C Scada (BESS)
job.description:
Job Summary

Black & Veatch is seeking a SCADA engineering professional with a strong focus on Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) to support the design, integration, and commissioning of utility-scale energy storage projects.

This role emphasizes end-to-end SCADA engineering for BESS facilities, including integration with Energy Management Systems (EMS), Battery Management Systems (BMS), Power Conversion Systems (PCS), and utility communication systems. The candidate will support conceptual and detailed engineering activities including controls architecture, network design, communications, telemetry, data mapping, and system integration across the full project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop engineering design documents and deliverables for SCADA systems supporting BESS projects.
  • Design and coordinate SCADA system architecture integrating BMS, EMS, PCS, and PPC systems.
  • Develop control narratives, data mapping, alarms, and monitoring strategies.
  • Lead and participate in design reviews (30%, 60%, 90%, IFC).
  • Coordinate SCADA scope with utility interconnection and grid compliance requirements.
  • Support vendor selection, specifications, and design reviews.
  • Provide leadership and mentorship to junior engineers.
  • Support FAT, SAT, and commissioning activities.
  • Perform testing, validation, and troubleshooting during commissioning.
  • Provide field and remote support to construction teams and clients

Management Responsibilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with utility-scale BESS projects.
  • Familiarity with EMS, BMS, PCS, and PPC systems.
  • Experience with SEL RTAC and related hardware.
  • Knowledge of DNP3, Modbus TCP/IP, IEC 61850.
  • Knowledge of NERC CIP, PRC-028, IEEE 2800 standards.
  • Experience with SCADA network and fiber systems.
  • Experience with commissioning multi-vendor systems.
  • Experience with HMI platforms such as Ignition or AVEVA.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 5+ years SCADA engineering experience.
  • 3+ years experience with utility-scale BESS projects.
  • Experience with SCADA design and commissioning activities.

Minimum Qualifications

Requires a bachelor's degree in engineering from either a recognized accredited program in their home country or the country in which the professional is practicing. Minimum of 5 years related work experience. job.title: Software Engineer, Recommendation Systems
job.description:
Meta is seeking a Software Engineer to join our Recommendation Systems team, where you will build and advance the machine learning infrastructure and ranking systems that power personalized experiences across Meta's family of apps — including Facebook Feed, Reels, Marketplace, and more. In this role, you will design and optimize large-scale recommendation and retrieval systems that serve billions of users, working at the intersection of machine learning, data engineering, and product impact. You will collaborate closely with machine learning engineers, product managers, and data scientists to define the technical direction of recommendation pipelines and deliver measurable improvements to user engagement and relevance.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize large-scale recommendation and ranking systems that personalize content across Meta's core products
  • Develop and improve retrieval, candidate generation, and multi-stage ranking pipelines to enhance relevance and user engagement
  • Instrument recommendation systems with telemetry, dashboards, and alerting to maintain reliability and surface regressions early
  • Lead the technical design of recommendation infrastructure components, evaluating trade-offs across latency, throughput, and model quality
  • Run and analyze A/B experiments to validate ranking and retrieval hypotheses, translating results into data-informed product decisions
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in recommendation serving stacks using profiling and instrumentation
  • Drive engineering excellence by establishing coding standards, improving test coverage, and leading code reviews for recommendation system components
  • Collaborate with machine learning engineers and data scientists to integrate new model architectures into production ranking pipelines
  • Mentor other engineers on recommendation systems best practices, system design, and experiment methodology
  • Proactively identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve the scalability and maintainability of recommendation infrastructure

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, with a focus on building and scaling recommendation, ranking, or retrieval systems
  • Experience designing and implementing large-scale distributed systems with low-latency serving requirements
  • Experience with machine learning model integration in production environments, including feature engineering, model serving, and pipeline development
  • Experience running A/B experiments and using experimental outcomes to drive product and engineering decisions
  • Experience with performance profiling, debugging complex production issues, and establishing reliability practices such as service level objectives and monitoring

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with real-time feature pipelines and online learning systems for recommendation use cases
  • Track record of driving cross-functional technical initiatives that delivered measurable improvements to recommendation quality or system efficiency
  • Experience with multi-stage ranking architectures, including candidate retrieval, scoring, and re-ranking at internet scale
  • Proficiency in machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, and experience with embedding-based retrieval or approximate nearest neighbor search

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

job.title: AI Research Scientist
job.description:
At Meta, we’re building the future of human connection and the technology that enables it. This means continuously inventing and developing technologies for the next generation of experiences. To continue our efforts in the path to AGI, and as we move closer to a future with intelligent robots and advanced AI models, we're hiring talent across a broad range of disciplines from robotics hardware to system software and artificial intelligence. These crucial projects and initiatives taken on by this team have never been done before, so you have a rare opportunity to help us create new ways people connect around the world.

We’re seeking Research Scientists ready to use their skills in system design and modeling and with a knowledge of a wide variety of components and technologies. These roles will require research and problem-solving skills, as well as fabrication and prototyping to design, develop, and construct novel prototypes and architectures. These roles will work in a focused incubation team and collaborate with a large and wide-ranging set of scientists and engineers in the greater organization.

Responsibilities

  • Perform fundamental and applied research to push the scientific and technological frontiers of embodied artificial intelligence
  • Invent/improve novel data-driven paradigms for robotics, leveraging a variety of modalities (images, video, text, audio, tactile, etc)
  • Investigate paradigms that can deliver a spectrum of embodied behaviors - from simulated characters to real robots, and from short-horizon, low-level to long-horizon, high-level intelligence
  • Develop algorithms based on state-of-the-art machine learning and neural network methodologies
  • Define, build and benchmark new functionalities needed for the next generation of AI
  • Conduct research towards long-term product goals while identifying intermediate milestones
  • Lead, plan, and execute novel research based on long-term objectives of the organization

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience with any of the following research areas: robotics, motion planning, embodied AI, human-robot interaction, sim-to-real transfer, learning from demonstration, reinforcement learning, dexterous manipulation, digital agents, vision language models, computer vision, egocentric perception, and/or LLMs

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience solving complex problems and comparing alternative solutions, trade offs, and varied points of view to determine a path forward
  • Demonstrated experience in building large scale recommendation systems
  • Experience working and communicating cross-functionally in a team environment
  • Proven track record of achieving significant results as demonstrated by grants, fellowships, patents, as well as first-authored publications at leading workshops or conferences such as RecSys, CVPR, ICCV/ECCV, ICLR, ICML or NEURIPS

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

job.title: Financial Accountant
job.description:
Job Summary

Responsible for performing highly specialized accounting work required to maintain the department’s general ledger. Performs detailed financial analysis of the department’s chart of accounts and financial statements by identifying and analyzing unusual variances.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyzes, records and reports accounting transactions in a timely manner.
  • Prepares general ledger entries and account reconciliations. Prepares balance sheet and profit and loss statements, consolidated financial statements, and other accounting schedules and reports.
  • Responds to inquiries received from management, internal and external auditors, Sarbanes-Oxley audit group and others regarding financial results, special reporting requests, etc.
  • Reviews existing internal controls on a regular basis and develops new internal controls as necessary.
  • Analyzes current procedures and recommends changes to develop and implement best practice accounting procedures.
  • Protects organization's value by keeping information confidential.

Power your career with a global leader

At Cummins, we power the world's progress. For more than a century, we have developed the technologies that keep industries and communities moving. Today, we are helping lead the transition to a zero-emissions future through innovative power solutions, from advanced engines to battery-electric and hydrogen technologies.

Join a global organisation where you can make a meaningful impact while helping build a more sustainable future.

Join a Finance team without borders

This is an opportunity to join a highly connected South Pacific Finance team that partners across the business and collaborates with colleagues around the globe. You will work closely with stakeholders across Operations, Sales and Finance, contributing to decisions that support Cummins' performance across the region.

As part of a global organisation, you will gain exposure to diverse markets, share expertise across teams, and build relationships beyond your local business.

It is also an exciting time to join Cummins. The Finance function is currently undergoing significant transformation as we transition from legacy ERP systems to a global SAP platform. While supporting core accounting and reporting activities, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to initiatives that strengthen processes, controls, and reporting capabilities as part of this SAP transformation program.

Make a real impact

We are seeking an experienced Financial Accountant to join our Finance team based at our Scoresby office on a 12-month fixed-term contract .

This is an exciting opportunity to deliver trusted financial outcomes while partnering with key operational and Finance stakeholders across the business.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

Financial Reporting

  • Prepare and review general ledger entries, account reconciliations, and accounting schedules to support management reporting, business performance reviews, and decision-making.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities, maintaining the integrity and reliability of financial information for management reporting and business decision-making.

Providing financial insight and business partnering

  • Conduct financial and variance analysis to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, providing insights that support informed business decisions and operational performance.
  • Partner with stakeholders across Finance, Operations and Sales to provide financial guidance, support reporting and compliance requirements, investigate issues, and drive continuous improvement in financial processes and business performance.

Strengthening controls and audit readiness

  • Maintain strong financial controls and governance practices by supporting internal and external audit requirements, ensuring compliance with SOX controls and company policies, and maintaining accurate process documentation to support an effective and compliant control environment.
  • Drive process and control improvements that strengthen governance, compliance, and risk management.

Knowledge Management & Training

  • Maintain process documentation and support the training and development of new team members to ensure consistency and continuity across finance activities.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, with CPA, CA, or equivalent professional qualification.
  • Experience in manufacturing, engineering, industrial, or service environments.
  • Strong technical accounting knowledge, including US GAAP, internal controls, and financial compliance requirements.
  • Exposure to SAP S/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), Oracle Business Intelligence, Oracle Financials/ERP is preferred.
  • Ability to analyse financial data, investigate variances, and communicate insights effectively to both Finance and non-finance stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting process improvements, strengthening controls, and contributing to business transformation initiatives.
  • An inquisitive, detail-oriented, and can-do attitude, with the ability to work independently, adapt to change, and manage competing priorities.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive salary plus superannuation.
  • Hybrid working arrangements that support flexibility and work-life balance.
  • Exposure to SAP transformation activities, and regional Finance processes within a global organisation.
  • Health and wellbeing support, including Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and annual flu vaccinations.

Ready to power your potential?

This 12-month fixed-term opportunity is ideal for a finance professional looking to expand their expertise in financial accounting while gaining exposure to a large-scale business transformation within a global leader in sustainable power solutions.

Join Cummins and help build the future of energy, technology, and sustainable progress.

job.description:
Job Description

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You are part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

Location: Kallang

About the Role (Mission)

The Senior Global Pursuit Leader has overall responsibility for assigned pursuits and the executive relationship with the client. The Pursuit Leader sets the strategic objectives and winning strategy for strategic pursuits and must leverage GMP team and processes to increase win probability and eventually win the pursuit.

It is the responsibility of the Pursuit Leader to build and collaborate the team to win the pursuit both at global and regional levels -  regional leadership team and sales teams covering customers at various locations to develop sales strategy, customer mapping, decision making process, timelines and  mobilize internal resources to win strategic sales pursuits.

What will you do?

  • Develop and maintain positive relationships with clients/potential clients, particularly at the executive C-suite level
  • Utilize business and financial knowledge to create value propositions
  • Build commercial strategy for the long-term pursuit, coordinate deal crafting and positioning
  • Execute highly-developed, proven competitive sales tactics to win business
  • Involved in early phases of prospects with the coordinated sales team, qualify opportunities and fine-tune investment price to win
  • Get internal sponsorship and anticipate escalation to win the project
  • Work closely with the Sales Leaders and Client Sales Executive, join customer meetings as required to ensure all elements of the order are addressed and documented
  • Develops a detailed pursuit milestone plan and manages it daily to ensure all tasks and activities are on track for completion by their assigned due dates
  • Works with the regional tendering teams to generate technical and commercial proposals in support of assigned opportunities including scope development, costing, pricing and terms, conditions negotiation/resolution, execution plans and creative solutions
  • Interface with clients, suppliers/partners, affiliates, and other Schneider Electric functional personnel, as needed to ensure the delivery of a thorough, professional proposal to the client
  • Arranges all projects reviews and ensures meeting materials are ready for review, and that all meeting attendees are on notice to attend these reviews as scheduled
  • Manage all Technical and Commercial Clarifications with team, ensuring all information are well documented
  • Provide regular updates to management on pursuit status and lead contract negotiation with the customer and legal

What qualifications will make you successful?

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred in Engineering, Business, Finance, or Economics. MBA preferred.
  • Minimum 15 years of proven success in system sales
  • Past experience in closing deals of $5-50 Million in contract value
  • Ability to establish CXO level relationships and relate to C-suite executives in a consultative way, serving as a trusted partner

  • Significant experience and proven ability in one or more of the following fields: Proven experience driving major sales pursuits within a sales organization at a major services organization and/or strategic sales, relationship, and account management experience at a major services organization, preferably on a global basis

job.title: Sr. Mechanical Design Engineer, APAC Mech DE
job.description:
Be part of a team that’s responsible for designing and delivering capacity for the world’s best data centre services across the globe. You’ll have the opportunity to work with a constant stream of new technologies and products, and experience opportunities to learn and grow while being surrounded by a motivated and diverse team.

In this role you will drive Mechanical Engineering services design, construction and implementation of enterprise data centers, which meet quality and performance levels across the globe. You will work directly with our Design Engineering Stakeholders, Construction, Operations, and Commissioning teams within your assigned region in APAC. You will be the Mechanical Engineering representative on behalf of the Data Center Engineering Team responsible for the successful delivery of projects. You will assist in Data Center site selection, planning, development. You will maintain the highest performance standards and utilize innovation to reduce PUE, water consumption, CAPEX and increase efficiency. As an experienced Mechanical Engineer you will evaluate different cooling systems and make a data driven decision about a suitable solution based on our guidelines. You will be an integral part of our work to change the world through technology.

Responsibilities

  • - Participate in site selection reviews, work with local utilities to understand and define site utility requirements, and work with internal teams to understand user requirements.
  • Design and collaborate with other disciplines to create a construction document set.
  • Create designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements and fall within our budgetary requirements.
  • Work with regional vendors and manufacturers to specify the appropriate mechanical equipment including Air Handling Units, Computer Room Air Handling Units, Chillers, Cooling Towers, Sequence of Operations & Controls systems, Fire Detection/Suppression systems
  • Review and approve equipment submittals.
  • Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during construction phases.
  • Work with commissioning teams to properly test and validate installation, operation, and performance of mechanical systems.
  • Travel to sites for site review and work with onsite field engineers and Operations. This position will involve 20% travel within APAC region and occasionally globally.

About the team The Data Center Design Engineering team at Amazon Web Services consists of Architects, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Fire Protection and Controls Engineers working to design the next generation of Data Centres. The team is committed to achieving a world-class uptime for our customers and strives to develop a fleet of buildings emphasizing security, safety, and efficiency, while finding new ways to meet our growing demand. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make directly to AWS leadership and work hard to drive continuous advancements in our designs. As an integral member of the team, you will have the opportunity to directly impact our business and create positive change.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
  • Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Engineering or Architectural License
  • Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region
  • Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
  • Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents

job.title: Data Center Strategic Negotiator (Real Estate), AWS Infrastructure - Data Center Supply Solutions (APAC)
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Do you have the business savvy and the technical background necessary to help establish Amazon as a key technology platform provider?

In this role you will be part of a team that drives AWS's data center contract negotiations, with a focus on colocation projects. You will play a crucial part in expanding our data center footprint while optimizing costs, keeping apace with evolving data center design, and ensuring operational excellence. The position encompasses comprehensive ownership of both new and existing colocation agreements, including pricing structures, terms, and service level agreements, while developing and implementing market expansion strategies across existing and new markets.

The role focuses on structuring deals and serves as the primary contact with colocation providers. The position requires strong market analysis capabilities to evaluate conditions, pricing trends, and competitive landscapes, along with the ability to create and present compelling business cases to senior leadership. Success demands excellence in relationship building, stakeholder management, and driving complex multi-million dollar negotiations while maintaining AWS's competitive advantage in the global cloud infrastructure market. You will work closely with Legal, Finance, Engineering, Operations, and Project Management teams. The role requires a self-starter who is a team player and is not afraid to keep learning.

Key job responsibilities

  • Serve as a key member of the team in driving data center deals and overall infrastructure strategy for target regions
  • Understand the supplier base (both Colocation providers and Real Estate developers), develop a strong understanding of market dynamics and activity, and develop long-term strategic partnerships in support of our key markets
  • Set business development plans in-line with the larger organization strategic direction
  • Negotiate and close multi-million dollar contracts to support capacity expansion
  • Understand the technical requirements of our engineering teams and negotiate solutions that meet technical requirements as well as the business objectives
  • Ownership of business case creation and presentation to leadership (including commercial, technical and risk profile)
  • Prepare and give project reviews to the senior management team regarding progress and deal execution roadblocks
  • Ability to work in a high-pressure environment and pivot on the fly to changing requirements to manage competing priorities simultaneously
  • Continue to build a culture of speed, flexibility and frugality with all business partners
  • Develop and implement new mechanisms to improve our customer experience
  • Business Travel: 10-20%

About the team About AWS Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business, management, real estate, or another related field
  • Experience in large complex deal negotiations with a successful track record
  • Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of data center infrastructure design, operations, or delivery
  • Experience directly related to the design or construction of large data center facilities, either colocation or client owned/operated
  • 13+ years of transactional accounting field experience
  • Experience delivering results and generating transformational growth

job.title: Sr.Database Sales Specialist
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Database Sales Specialist to lead strategic database adoption and migration initiatives across India's Public Sector segment. As a member of the India WWSO Specialists team, you will be responsible for driving significant revenue growth by helping the largest and most complex public sector and enterprise customers migrate from legacy commercial databases to AWS purpose-built database services.

This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strategic thinking, executive relationship management, and the ability to orchestrate complex, multi-stakeholder deals. You will shape the India database GTM strategy, mentor junior specialists, and serve as the voice of the India database business to global specialist leadership.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own and exceed AWS Database services revenue and pipeline targets for strategic India Public Sector accounts.
  • Develop and execute a territory strategy that maximizes database migration and modernization revenue across the India PS segment.
  • Lead complex, multi-quarter enterprise deals involving large-scale Oracle and SQL Server migrations, engaging C-suite and IT leadership.
  • Build and present executive-level business cases including TCO analysis, risk mitigation, and modernization roadmaps.
  • Influence India-level GTM strategy for database services - defining campaigns, target account lists, and partner motions.
  • Partner with Database Specialist SAs, ProServe, and Partner teams to orchestrate comprehensive migration programs.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point and executive sponsor for strategic database opportunities in the territory.
  • Collaborate with global Database GTM leadership to align India priorities with worldwide programs and investments.
  • Provide actionable voice-of-customer feedback to product teams on pricing, feature gaps, and competitive dynamics.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or experience in technology related sales, business development or equivalent
  • 8+ years of technology sales, or 5+ years of technology sales experience
  • Experience reaching and exceeding sales revenue goals
  • Knowledge of Data modeling, advanced SQL with Oracle, MySQL, and Columnar Databases at an advanced level
  • Experience engaging with and influencing C-level executives
  • Experience working with, presenting to, and negotiating with C-level executives, IT, lines of business, procurement, finance, legal and internal stakeholders for sizeable commercial/enterprise deals
  • Experience selling into India Public Sector or large regulated enterprises.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience and demonstrated industry leadership in the fields of database or data warehousing, data sciences and big data processing
  • Knowledge of about AWS integration and usage
  • Experience hiring and developing sales management teams
  • Bachelor's degree, or MBA in business, data science, public administration, finance, engineering, human resources or related field
  • AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Associate's degree or above
  • Deep familiarity with AWS Database portfolio: Aurora, RDS, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, Neptune, ElastiCache, MemoryDB, Keyspaces, QLDB.
  • - Experience with Oracle ULA/license optimization conversations and competitive displacement strategies.

job.title: Gas Turbine: Turbine Airfoils Casting Simulations Engineer
job.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

Turbine Airfoils Casting simulation engineer plays a pivotal role in transforming how we design and manufacture complex turbine hardware design. You will lead the development and validation of conventional cast & cutting-edge DS (directionally solidified) process modeling, core breakage prediction, and foundry process modeling capabilities. Working at the intersection of design, simulation, and manufacturing, you will focus on upstream design simulation to embed manufacturability early in the development cycle, significantly reducing defects, lead times, and costs while improving component reliability.

Job requires regular interaction with global teams hence engineer should have persuasive communication skills and cross-cultural knowledge.

How You'll Make an Impact (Gas Turbine, R& D, India)

  • Develop and validate advanced DS process modeling methodologies with a strong emphasis on core breakage prediction and mitigation.
  • Practice Siemens Energy high fidelity, extensively validated, and equiaxed casting simulation modeling methodology to provide expert foundry process modeling support to ensure robust, high-yield casting designs.
  • Drive upstream design simulation initiatives that integrate manufacturability directly into the turbine component design process.
  • Develop new cooling technologies within the constraints of manufacturability, balancing performance, thermal management, and casting feasibility.
  • Collaborate closely with design, materials, and manufacturing teams to create and implement new simulation-driven design-for-manufacturing (DFM) workflows.
  • Identify and resolve critical casting challenges through innovative modeling techniques, data analysis, and real-world validation.
  • Contribute to methodology development that pushes the boundaries of casting simulation accuracy and speed.
  • Be a point of contact, speaking partner and provide expertise regarding hot gas path heat transfer related topics in a project.
  • Developing new concepts and building CAD models using NX, design internal cooling and perform Conjugate Heat Transfer analysis of Turbine Airfoils and Heat Shields using CFX & Star CCM+, performing Casting Simulation using ProCAST.
  • Understanding of fundamental concepts in fluid mechanics (pressure drop) & heat transfer discipline (using non-dimensional correlations).
  • Able to understand physics, apply relevant assumptions, interpret and post process results.
  • Collaborating with project leads in understanding the project requirements, finding solutions to design challenges, and delivering results within agreed timeline & quality.
  • A fraction of time will be dedicated to advancing the technical expertise of other team members and mentoring.

What You Bring

  • Mechanical engineer with an MTech in Mechanical engineering (major in Metallurgy and Foundry, Material Science, Fluid & Thermal Science) and demonstrated expertise in the field of Casting, Solidification physics, heat transfer and fluid mechanics.
  • 5 years of experience with parametric CAD modeling in NX.
  • Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in thermal analysis and design of internal cooled gas turbine components.
  • Ability to generate thermal boundary conditions and perform Flow & Heat Transfer engineering calculations under steady state, transient heat transfer (involving all modes i.e. conduction, convection and radiation) and multi-phase CFD/CHT simulations using Star CCM+. (minimum 4 years of experience).
  • Understanding Investment Casting & Solidification physics and experience of running casting simulations using ProCAST and experience of working in foundry would be an advantage. (minimum 2 years of experience).
  • Good knowledge of Design for Manufacturability (DFM) for gas turbine airfoils.
  • Basic knowledge of Finite element analysis & ability to review the results. Good Familiarity with FE codes like Sim center 3D, ANSYS or general-purpose FEA tool.
  • Basic knowledge of Turbomachinery Aerodynamics, Mechanical Integrity (Fatigue, Creep, Fracture).
  • Exposure to SAP and Teamcenter PLM.
  • Programming skills like Python and NX Open.
  • A balance between scientific rigor and engineering judgement.
  • An attitude of curiosity, perseverance in the face of uncertainty, and a desire for engineering excellence as well as patience.

Personality

  • Strong interpersonal skills i.e., collaborator, quick learner, energetic, imaginative, innovative, ability to adapt quickly & effectively etc.
  • Willing to collaborate & work with colleagues located in multiple time zones (Europe & the US).
  • Self-driven in work tasks with a willingness to learn and try new methods to solve a problem.
  • Align with Organization Purpose, Values & Behavior & adhere to business compliance guidelines.
  • Effective communicator both verbal and non-verbal.
  • Ability to write clear and descriptive reports in English.

This is a rare opportunity to work on high-visibility, high-impact programs where your technical contributions will directly influence turbine performance, production efficiency, and long-term competitiveness. You will have the autonomy to innovate, the resources to validate your methods, and the chance to see your work move from simulation to actual hardware in some of the most advanced gas turbines in the world. If you are passionate about simulation, manufacturability, and solving complex engineering problems that matter, this is the role where you can make a lasting technical impact.

About the Team (Power Generation)

In the large steam and gas turbine domain, we offer services and solutions for gas turbines, large steam turbines, large generators, and associated control technology. Our portfolio serves customers such as power utilities, Independent Power Producers (IPPs), Engineering Procurement and Construction (EPC) firms, and industrial clients. We provide a comprehensive range of offerings including maintenance, operation, digital services, modernization and upgradation, plant flexibilization, as well as control and digitalization solutions (digital control systems, field instruments, and equipment) and professional consulting.

Our power generation portfolio also includes industrial steam turbines (ranging from 10 kW to 250 MW), condensers, and service offerings designed to extend the lifespan and efficiency of industrial steam turbines through heat recovery solutions. We cater to a wide range of process industries—including oil and gas, chemicals, petrochemicals, paper & pulp, sugar & ethanol, and marine—helping customers reduce energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions. A key focus area is delivering integrated industrial decarbonization solutions built on electrification, automation, and digitalization, while supporting sustainability through carbon-optimized energy systems and hydrogen generation.

Who is Siemens Energy India?

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most-valued energy technology company. Our large footprint spread across the entire region (India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldives) with state-of-the-art facilities and customers installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping the countries navigate their energy transition and achieve its net zero targets.

SEIL is a pure play energy technology company, oﬀering a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services designed to support our customers along the entire energy value chain to go through their energy transition journey and achieve their net zero targets. Our portfolio oﬀering includes low to zero emissions power generation, power transmission and storage, and decarbonization of the industry. More information on: www.siemens-energy-india.com

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by #TeamPurpleIndia. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
