job.title: Expert- Product Configuration and Data Management
job.description:
Key Expert- Product Configuration and Data Management: HV Switchgear Products

What this role offers:

This role is responsible for ensuring robust product configuration and data management across the HV Switchgears product portfolio (AIS and GIS), enabling accuracy, consistency, and compliance throughout the product lifecycle. The position closely interfaces with PLM, R&D/ Engineering, Offer Management, Finance and IT systems to maintain configuration rules, product structures, and master data integrity.

Key responsibilities include driving configuration accuracy, managing product data updates aligned with design and regulatory changes, and supporting digital tools for efficient product selection and offer generation. The role also involves identifying opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and automation within configuration and data management frameworks.

In addition, the role contributes to the development and maintenance of a centralized Knowledge Center, ensuring structured documentation, best practice sharing, and capability enhancement across teams. This supports organizational efficiency, reduces dependency risks, and strengthens overall product and process governance.

Key Responsibilities

A) Product Configuration and Data Management:

  • Development of Product Configuration system by establishing a robust knowledge base.
  • Ensure accurate and robust product configuration aligned with technical specifications, business rules, and customer requirements.
  • Maintain and govern product master data, configuration logic, and documentation across systems, ensuring integrity and consistency.
  • Support the adoption and integration of self-learning and self-improving AI technologies to enhance configuration accuracy, speed, and decision-making. The configurator platform should be progressively enhanced based on number of configurations created and customized.
  • Enable precise product costing within configurations, ensuring alignment with the latest cost structures and commercial frameworks.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, PLM, Offer/Order Management, and IT teams for seamless integration of product data and lifecycle updates.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable business rules, technical standards, and regulatory requirements within configuration systems.

B) Process enhancement and Digitalization:

  • Drive process improvements focused on efficiency, standardization, and reduced response time to customer enquiries.
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities within configuration and data management processes.
  • Develop and maintain a structured database for cost monitoring, analysis, and benchmarking across products and variants.
  • Provide insights to support cost optimization, competitive positioning, and strategic decision-making.

C) Knowledge Center:

  • Lead a ‘Knowledge Center’ subfunction to support Offer and Order Management teams with technical expertise and structured documentation.
  • Provide technical support for complex product configurations, bid preparation, and customer requirements.
  • Support development of AI based self-learning and self-improving query management system, with self-answering and expert involvement decision making.

Hands-on experience with feature importance/driver analysis and model explain ability techniques (SHAP analysis or equivalent).

job.title: Graduate Engineer (Gordon Brothers)
job.description:
Launch Your Engineering Career with Australia's Industrial Refrigeration Leader

Gordon Brothers Industries (GBI), part of the Johnson Controls (JCI) family, is Australia's largest industrial refrigeration company and a trusted partner to some of the nation's most critical industries.

With over 100 years of engineering excellence and offices all across Australia, GBI specialises in the design, construction, commissioning, service, and maintenance of complex industrial refrigeration systems.

Supporting industries including food and beverage manufacturing, cold storage, pharmaceutical production, healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and distribution, GBI delivers innovative solutions that improve safety, reliability, efficiency, and sustainability.

As part of Johnson Controls, a global leader in industrial cooling, energy efficiency, and decarbonisation solutions, GBI combines local expertise with access to world-class technologies, resources, and innovation. Together, we help customers optimise operations, reduce environmental impact, and meet the demands of an increasingly sustainable future.

Why Join Gordon Brothers Industries?

This is more than a graduate role. It's an opportunity to develop into a well-rounded engineer while working alongside industry experts on large-scale industrial refrigeration and engineering projects.

You'll gain hands-on exposure to:

  • Industrial refrigeration system design and engineering
  • Project management and project delivery
  • Manufacturing and construction environments
  • Client engagement and technical consulting
  • Site commissioning and operational support
  • Safety, compliance, and risk management
  • Emerging sustainability and energy-efficiency technologies

Whether your long-term goal is technical leadership, project management, design engineering, or consulting, this role provides a strong foundation for a successful engineering career.

What We Offer

  • Exposure to diverse engineering disciplines and projects
  • Structured training and professional development
  • Mentorship from highly experienced engineers and industry specialists
  • Competitive salary package
  • Career progression opportunities within GBI and the broader Johnson Controls network
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment

About the Role

Due to continued business growth, we are seeking a motivated Graduate Engineer to join our Brunswick-based team.

Working closely with experienced Engineers, Project Managers, and Service Teams, you'll play an important role in supporting the design, delivery, and ongoing optimisation of industrial refrigeration solutions for leading Australian businesses.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist with engineering calculations and refrigeration system design.
  • Support the preparation of estimates, tenders, and project proposals.
  • Evaluate existing refrigeration systems and identify improvement opportunities for clients.
  • Participate in project management activities, including procurement, scheduling, stakeholder coordination, and project administration.
  • Assist with cost control and successful project delivery.
  • Contribute to risk assessments, safety planning, and compliance activities.
  • Develop knowledge of Australian and international engineering standards and ensure adherence across projects.
  • Prepare engineering drawings and documentation using AutoCAD and other drafting tools.
  • Conduct site inspections, engineering audits, and technical assessments.
  • Prepare clear and professional client reports.
  • Support commissioning activities for new refrigeration installations.
  • Collaborate with the Service team to deliver technical support and engineering solutions.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across engineering and project management processes.
  • Build strong relationships with clients, contractors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.

About You

We are looking for an enthusiastic graduate who is eager to learn, technically curious, and excited by the opportunity to work in a specialised and highly regarded engineering sector.

Essential Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Process, or Chemical Engineering
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong understanding of thermodynamics and heat transfer principles
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical documentation
  • Current Australian driver's licence
  • Full working rights within Australia

Desirable

  • Experience using AutoCAD or similar design software
  • Exposure to refrigeration, energy, manufacturing, or process industries
  • Previous engineering internship or industry placement experience

Build Your Future with GBI

This is an outstanding opportunity to join an industry leader and gain exposure to the full engineering project lifecycle, from concept and design through to commissioning and operational support.

If you're looking to kick-start your engineering career with a company that invests in its people, values innovation, and offers genuine long-term career opportunities, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn more about Gordon Brothers Industries, visit: [www.gordonbrothers.com.au](http://www.gordonbrothers.com.au)

Only applicants with current Australian work rights will be considered.

Please note that pre-employment checks, including reference checks, medical assessments, criminal history checks, and drug & alcohol testing, will form part of the recruitment process.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Do you have experience designing multi-media learning solutions to drive business outcomes? Are you adept at project management? If that’s the case, Johnson Controls Inc (JCI) has an amazing opportunity for you!

We are harnessing the power of the cloud, the Internet of Things, and user-design thinking to deliver intelligent buildings and smart cities that connect communities in ways that make people’s lives – and the world – better. Your challenge, if you wish to accept it, will be to create innovative and effective enablement materials that support Johnson Controls’ sellers to understand customer needs throughout a building’s lifecycle , communicate value, and position our broader building systems and services portfolio with confidence. You will do this by working collaboratively with colleagues and business leaders, immersing yourself in the fascinating business, bringing creativity and hard work to every project you do, and being open to learning new skills and technologies every single day. Requirements include a strong learner-focused mindset, business acumen, a willingness to act amid ambiguity, strong project management skills, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Does this sound like you? If so, keep reading!

job.title: Servicenow Platform Architect
job.description:
Job Title: ServiceNow Architect

About the Role

We are looking for a ServiceNow Architect to lead the overall design, architecture, and governance of the ServiceNow platform. This role requires deep hands‑on experience across multiple ServiceNow products, strong understanding of platform architecture, and the ability to guide development teams while working closely with process owners, business leaders, and technical stakeholders. You will define standards, design scalable solutions, and ensure the platform supports long‑term business needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end‑to‑end architecture of the ServiceNow platform across ITSM, CMDB, and at least one additional product such as ITOM, ITAM (SAM/HAM), HRSD, SecOps.
  • Design scalable, maintainable solutions aligned with platform best practices and organizational standards.
  • Translate business requirements into technical designs, data models, workflows, and integrations.
  • Lead technical design sessions, solution reviews, and architecture discussions with developers and stakeholders.
  • Oversee complex configurations: Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, and Flow Designer logic.
  • Guide integration design using Scripted REST APIs, IntegrationHub, and external systems.
  • Ensure CMDB structure, relationships, and data quality support service mapping and operational processes.
  • Support platform upgrades, patching, regression testing, and long‑term platform roadmap planning.
  • Troubleshoot high‑impact issues, perform root‑cause analysis, and recommend permanent fixes.
  • Provide technical leadership to developers and administrators; review code and ensure adherence to standards.
  • Define governance, naming conventions, documentation practices, and development guidelines.
  • Partner with security, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure compliance and platform stability.
  • Drive automation, workflow optimization, and platform performance improvements.
  • Maintain clear documentation for designs, integrations, data models, and architectural decisions.

Core Technical Skills

  • Deep understanding of ServiceNow architecture, data models, tables, ACLs, and role‑based access.
  • knowledge of Data Fabric and Creator Pro addon.
  • Strong expertise in ITSM, ITAM and ITOM (required).
  • Hands‑on experience with at least two additional modules: ITOM, ITAM (SAM/HAM), HRSD, SecOps, SPM, or ATF.
  • Advanced scripting skills: JavaScript (server and client), Glide APIs, Script Includes, and UI scripting.
  • Strong knowledge of Flow Designer, Workflow Editor, and process automation.
  • Experience designing and maintaining Scripted REST APIs, integrations, and data exchange patterns.
  • Solid understanding of CMDB relationships, discovery patterns, service mapping, and data governance.
  • Familiarity with Service Portal, widgets, and UI customization.
  • Understanding of ATF for automated testing.
  • Strong grasp of ITIL processes and how they map to ServiceNow modules.
  • Experience with Scoped Apps, custom tables, and application lifecycle management.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of hands‑on ServiceNow experience, including development and administration.
  • Proven experience designing enterprise‑level ServiceNow solutions.
  • Strong understanding of platform best practices, architecture principles, and governance.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments.
  • ServiceNow certifications such as CSA, CAD, CIS (ITSM/CMDB/HRSD), or CTA are preferred.
  • Ability to mentor developers and admins and lead technical discussions.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical and business stakeholders.

JCI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any protected categories.

job.title: Oracle Apps DBA & Fusion Middleware Administrator
job.description:
Job Description

Oracle Apps DBA & Fusion Middleware Administrator

Location: Mumbai

Experience & Qualifications

  • Minimum 5–6 years of relevant hands-on experience in Oracle Applications, Database and/or Fusion Middleware administration.
  • Strong experience in infrastructure installation, configuration, administration and production support, with emphasis on Oracle Fusion Middleware/WebLogic and Oracle Applications environments.
  • Candidates should have a combination of Apps DBA and Fusion Middleware skills, with strong expertise in at least one area and good working knowledge of the other.
  • BE/MCA or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Strong communication, coordination, troubleshooting and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in customer-facing, mission-critical environments.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Open to working in 24x7 shifts and weekends as required.
  • OCI certification is an added advantage.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and support Oracle Database, Oracle Applications and Fusion Middleware/WebLogic environments.
  • Implement and coordinate changes across Infrastructure, Database, Middleware and Application layers.
  • Install, configure, administer, patch and upgrade Oracle WebLogic and Fusion Middleware in standalone and clustered environments.
  • Strong understanding of Oracle WebLogic architecture, including vertical/horizontal clustering, load balancing and high availability.
  • Support and maintain highly available Oracle environments spanning multiple data centers, including RAC, Active Data Guard, Physical/Snapshot Standby, switchover and failover.
  • Support multi-node application environments, including Web and Forms nodes, load balancing, DNS/network configuration, servlets, distributed processing and shared application-tier file systems.
  • Experience with Oracle Applications 11i/R12, including administration, refreshes, cloning, patching and maintenance of multi-node environments.
  • Experience with Oracle Database upgrades to 19c and application/middleware platform upgrades.
  • Hands-on experience with Fusion Middleware products including WebLogic, SOA and OBIEE.
  • Knowledge of Identity Management and OAM.
  • Configure and administer JDBC connection pools, Data Sources, JMS Queues, Topics, Distributed Destinations, Foreign JMS Providers and Message Bridges.
  • Configure and troubleshoot one-way and two-way SSL.
  • Deploy and migrate WAR, EJB and EAR applications across development, test, QA and production environments using WebLogic Console, deployment utilities and WLST.
  • Experience implementing and supporting Disaster Recovery solutions, including synchronization using RSYNC.
  • Hands-on experience with WebLogic patching, performance optimization and troubleshooting.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python and shell scripting, with experience automating operational activities and reducing incidents and manual effort.
  • Simplify server and service management through automation, standardization and proactive problem management.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux/Unix administration.
  • Expertise in cloud platforms and migration of on-premises Oracle environments to OCI.
  • Experience provisioning and maintaining environments on OCI, Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
  • Working knowledge of Docker containers and orchestration technologies.
  • Manage planned downtime and restore services following unplanned outages within committed SLAs.
  • Perform capacity management, performance analysis, proactive recommendations and implementation support.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and provide preventive and proactive support for mission-critical environments.

job.title: Senior Security Engineer, Enterprise SaaS Security - Singapore
job.description:
About the job

There's no such thing as a "safe system" - only safer systems. Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. As a Security Engineer, you help protect network boundaries, keep computer systems and network devices hardened against attacks and provide security services to protect highly sensitive data like passwords and customer information. Security Engineers work directly with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. You also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

You use your industry experience to own and drive the resolution of complex security incidents, policy questions and technical security issues.

As a Senior Security Engineer on this team, you will act as a technical leader and mentor. You will be responsible for securing Google’s enterprise usage of third-party Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platforms. You will help scale our capacity for incoming security vulnerabilities, build automated tooling to reduce manual workloads using AI, and drive risk insights and remediations. You will ensure all new SaaS launches are secure by performing security assessments and ensure the adoption of required security controls. You will mentor and guide other engineers, fostering a collaborative environment to achieve collective goals. With your technical foundation and exceptional cross-functional collaboration skills, you will manage complex security issues and operations. You will have a breadth of application security experience such as SaaS or cloud security, API security, authentication and access control, threat modeling, conducting security assessments, etc.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end security strategy for high-risk third-party SaaS platforms, identifying and driving solutions for complex, ambiguous security issues.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers, guiding the development of scalable security controls and fostering a culture of engineering excellence.
  • Architect and engineer advanced SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) solutions, leveraging AI/ML automation to reduce manual toil and improve operational visibility.
  • Lead complex, cross-functional security assessments to derive actionable risk insights, ensuring Google's enterprise usage of SaaS remains resilient against evolving threats.
  • Influence the broader SaaS security roadmap by collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to define policies and drive the adoption of required security controls.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Mobile Software Engineer, Google Pay, Client Infrastructure
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, you will help to scale Google Pay India to 400M users and beyond by building a high performing, secure, and robust client foundation. You will take end-to-end ownership of the core architecture, release systems, and developer ecosystem that power our entire Flutter application.

Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Design core application architectures, optimize critical app health metrics (such as Application-Not-Responding, startup latency, app size, memory usage, and frame rates), and build secure platform integration layers.
  • Build and maintain release pipelines, automated testing infrastructure, and developer tools, leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered solutions to automate diagnostics, optimize workflows, and boost overall developer velocity.
  • Collaborate with executive engineers, Product Managers, User Experience (UX), and other teams (like Photos and Gmail intelligence teams) to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
  • Work with technologies such as Dart, Flutter, Android, iOS, Java/Kotlin, Objective-C/Swift, and build/automation tools.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Head of Global Network Acquisition, South Asia
job.description:
About the job

Google's infrastructure needs go far beyond server computers. As Google's products and services scale the globe, the Strategic Negotiation team works behind the scenes to secure infrastructure for Google's future -- everything from underwater cables to physical data center space. As a Strategic Negotiator, you combine your deep market knowledge of a given sector with tech industry savvy to negotiate cost-effective solutions to support Google's infrastructure growth. You'll work with specific project teams on negotiating agreements, managing vendor and partner relationships and presenting agreement recommendations to our Tech leadership. Your successful negotiations have the potential to save Google millions of dollars in operating costs and impact every part of the business.

As the Head of Global Network Acquisition (GNA), South Asia Region and Oceania Strategic Negotiators, you'll be a pivotal leader, driving Google's network infrastructure strategy in a critical growth market. You'll lead a team of expert negotiators, empowering them to secure essential network infrastructure, including managed optical services, dark fiber, colocation, and submarine cable infrastructure. Your strategic goal and negotiation experience will directly impact Google's bottom line, potentially saving millions in operational costs, and unlocking new market opportunities.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and mentor the GNA-South Asia and Oceania Strategic Negotiators, overseeing commercial negotiations and vendor relationships.
  • Develop and execute strategic plans for network infrastructure acquisition, ensuring alignment with Google's growth objectives.
  • Negotiate complex agreements for managed optical services, dark fiber, colocation space, and submarine cable infrastructure.
  • Cultivate partnerships with government and regulatory bodies to advance Google's network infrastructure goals.
  • Present recommendations and updates to Google leadership.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Data Center Technicians Manager
job.description:
Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT) Manager, you will lead a team of technicians, providing expert guidance on performing hardware deployments, diagnostics on equipment, and hardware decommissions. You will support technician performance, prioritizing technician tasks while monitoring Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). This opportunity will allow you to model leadership principles, provide training to technicians, and accelerate your career growth in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 data centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

  • Delivering success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring while promoting a positive and effective team culture.
  • Accountable for overall data center service compliance and quality.
  • Provide guidance on and holds team accountable for compliance with Data Center Services (DCS) business unit and service-level policies, procedures, deadlines, and service-change policies.
  • Ensures technicians are trained on procedures for installation, deployment, replacement, and post-execution quality check processes.
  • Verify post-execution quality checks have been performed appropriately by technicians and takes corrective action as needed.
  • Escalate issues through appropriate channels and follow up on issue resolution, sharing knowledge related to issue resolution with appropriate teams.
  • Review process changes to evaluate impact on service execution and share relevant information about change with stakeholders across functions and disciplines.
  • Lead team and triage meetings, prioritizing work across your team, and rebalance priorities to respond to changes.
  • Complete required safety training, conduct daily safety briefings, and participate in on-site safety committees.
  • Ensure technicians and vendor resources comply with all safety procedures (e.g., Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) usage, equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use).
  • Promote a culture of safety and empower technicians to take action, speak up, and report safety concerns and/or incidents.
  • Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and resulting customer experience, displaying accountability and ownership of the data center facilities.
  • Embody our [culture](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/culture) and [values](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/about/corporate-values).

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution AND 5+ years’ experience supporting IT equipment or related technology or related experience working with technical teams.
  • 2+ year(s) experience directing, supervising, or managing others.

While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate degree in Computer Science or related field and/or equivalent work experience.
  • 4+ years’ experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
  • 3+ years’ experience working in a production, mission-critical 24x7x365 data center environment.
  • Applicable certifications: Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation, ASICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC), Certified Data Center Professional (CDCP), Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP), Six Sigma Green Belt).
  • 2+ years’ experience leading diverse, technical, or IT workforce of up to ten employees.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. job.title: Logistics Technician Intern
job.description:
Overview

Come build community, explore your passions and do your best work at Microsoft with thousands of University interns from every corner of the world. This opportunity will allow you to bring your aspirations, talent, potential—and excitement for the journey ahead.

Join Microsoft South Africa as a Data Center Operations Management Intern and be part of a dynamic team that ensures the smooth operation of our data centers. This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in managing data center operations, working with cutting-edge technology, and collaborating with teams across the globe.

At Microsoft, Interns work on real-world projects in collaboration with teams across the world, while having fun along the way. You’ll be empowered to build community, explore your passions and achieve your goals. This is your chance to bring your solutions and ideas to life while working on cutting-edge technology.

Responsibilities

  • Work onsite at our datacenters in Sydney.
  • Perform assigned tasks and escalate issues during high-volume work activity.
  • Analyzes causes of service implementation policy faults or degradation and recommends improvement plans.
  • Implements service implementation policy plan improvements as directed for Data Center business unit(s).
  • Coordinate with suppliers to initiate warranty claims and process failed vendor hardware devices.
  • Maintain up-to-date and accurate information within various inventory management systems.
  • Ensure detailed physical inventory tracking and staging.
  • Help reconcile and report inventory discrepancies.
  • Perform destruction of data-bearing devices following all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Microsoft policies.
  • Comply with security and data management policies.

Qualifications

Eligibility

  • High School Diploma, or equivalent.
  • Basic knowledge of Asset/Inventory/Logistics/Supply Chain.
  • Currently studying towards a qualification in Warehousing, Logistics, or Supply Chain Management.
  • You need to be an Australian National or residency with eligibility to work in Australia.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Applicable certifications (Logistics or Supply Chain or Asset Management).
  • Ability to support frequent standing, walking, lifting, and working at heights with or without equipment assistance.
  • Able to communicate effectively with multiple stakeholders.
  • Proficient in written and oral English communication to support regional and global teams.
  • Desire to learn, grow, and develop new technical skills.
  • Flexibility to work non-standard business hours that may include weekends and/or holidays.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a Datacenter IT Operations Manager (ITOM) on the U.S. Government Airgap team, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft’s dedicated online services supporting the U.S. Government. While our U.S. Government dedicated datacenter operations team has a sharp focus on serving our U.S. Government customers and helping them achieve federal missions, together, all of Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 100 datacenters and 1 million servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. job.title: Territory Manager - Sales
job.description:
As a Territory Manager, you will play a crucial role in our sales strategy, focusing on channel sales and retail operations. Your primary objective is to develop and maintain strong relationships with our primary and secondary distributors, ensuring effective product distribution and market penetration. You will be working closely with our retail partners to understand their needs and provide excellent support.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and develop sales territories, focusing on channel sales and retail partnerships.
  • Build and maintain relationships with primary and secondary distributors, ensuring effective product distribution.
  • Expand our numeric reach and market presence by identifying new sales opportunities.
  • Track and analyze sales data, providing regular reports and insights to the sales team.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to develop and execute sales campaigns and promotions.
  • Provide excellent customer service and support to our retail partners and end-users.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and competitor activities, offering insights to the team.
  • Attend industry events, trade shows, and conferences to represent NEDS and build our brand presence.
  • Work closely with the product team to understand product features and benefits, ensuring effective communication to distributors and customers.

Qualifications

  • A proven track record in sales, with experience in channel sales and retail operations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret sales data and market trends.
  • Knowledge of primary and secondary distribution channels and their dynamics.
  • Familiarity with collection tracking and management processes.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple territories effectively.
  • Proficiency in using sales and CRM tools for data tracking and analysis.
  • A proactive and results-driven approach to sales and territory management.
  • Willingness to travel within the assigned territories as required.
  • A positive and collaborative attitude, with a passion for sales and customer satisfaction.

job.title: Senior Analyst - R2R
job.description:
The RTR Analyst will lead the end-to-end Record to Report workstream, ensuring the absolute accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of financial data and reporting.

This role involves managing general ledger accounting, running the month-end and year-end close processes, enforcing internal controls, and steering digital automation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Close & GL Management

  • Oversee the end-to-end month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing timelines to ensure accurate financial reporting.
  • Ensure accuracy across the General Ledger (GL), subsidiary ledgers, and fixed asset accounting operations.
  • Produce and review consolidated financial statements, including Profit & Loss (P&L), Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow statements.
  • Reconciliations & Quality Assurance
  • Drive timely investigation and resolution of any open, aged, or anomalous line items.
  • Review and sign off on crucial balance sheet account reconciliations (e.g., GL, Bank, Fixed Assets etc)
  • Validate revenue recognition provisions, and inventory evaluations

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Perform comprehensive monthly variance analysis to explain operational performance trends to relevant stakeholders (CFO, Controllership, Operation Finance)
  • Ensure absolute adherence to applicable accounting standards such as US GAAP, IFRS, or Local GAAP.
  • Implement various digital tool which will help in day to day accounting operation.
  • Capable of monitoring control systems designed to preserve company assets and report accurate financials.

Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the core point of contact for internal and external auditors, delivering necessary documentation and mitigating risks.
  • Manage expectations at the leadership level through routine financial governance reporting.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Professional qualifications such as CA or CMA or Any Finance Degree are highly desirable, Minimum experience of 3-5 years of corporate accounting experience
  • Professional with a record of success working with large teams, to work in sync with set parameters to achieve business goals.
  • Proven experience steering complex financial close cycles and handling multi-entity configurations
  • Advanced proficiency with prominent enterprise ERP systems like SAP, S4 HANA
  • Direct experience using automated reconciliation platforms such as BlackLine is a significant advantage
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skill.

job.title: Principal Software Engineer - Java
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and contribute to strategic modernization initiatives across Helios platforms, including transformation of legacy Java/J2EE applications to cloud-native(AWS) and scalable architectures
  • Guide implementation approach for modernization initiatives, ensuring alignment between architecture intent and delivery execution
  • Define and guide target architecture patterns and design principles for modernization efforts
  • Drive experiments and proof-of-concepts (POCs) to evaluate new technologies, frameworks, and architectural patterns, enabling data-driven technology decisions
  • Translate successful POCs into scalable, production-ready solutions and drive adoption across teams
  • Influence engineering practices, standards, and architectural decisions across the broader Helios development community
  • Lead architecture and design reviews, and code reviews, enforcing coding standards, best practices, and maintainable design patterns
  • Mentor and coach engineers on low-level design, object-oriented design, and modern software engineering practices, elevating overall engineering capability
  • Deep-dive into complex legacy modules, identifying constraints, and proposing optimal modernization or refactoring strategies
  • Partner with DevOps and platform teams to ensure build, release, deployment readiness, and adoption of modern CI/CD and containerization practices
  • Identify and drive opportunities to embed AI and automation into engineering workflows, improving developer productivity, quality, and delivery speed

Required Skills & Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, including strong hands-on development and technical leadership experience
  • Proven experience in Java/J2EE-based application development, including leading design and delivery of scalable services
  • Strong expertise in software architecture, design patterns, object-oriented design, and low-level design principles
  • Experience modernizing legacy enterprise applications and transitioning to microservices-based architectures
  • Hands-on experience with Spring frameworks, REST/JSON APIs, and distributed system design
  • Comprehensive knowledge of database technologies, including Postgres, SQL, and NoSQL, with proven ability to design, optimize, and troubleshoot data solutions.
  • Strong experience with data access technologies (JPA/Hibernate/JDBC)
  • Experience with testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit) and building high-quality, testable software
  • Proficiency with Git (branching, merging, tagging), Maven or equivalent build tools, and strong debugging skills
  • Experience leading or contributing to POCs, innovation initiatives, or modernization programs
  • Strong experience working with cross-functional and global teams, influencing without direct authority
  • Excellent technical communication, mentoring, and stakeholder engagement skills
  • ​Experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and working with DevOps/CI-CD pipelines
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes for orchestration of containerized applications
  • Experience working with software systems in autonomous vehicles, mining, construction, or similar industrial domains
  • Understanding of onboard (machine) and offboard (cloud/office) system architectures and their integration in distributed autonomy platforms
  • Familiarity with communication protocols and networking concepts used in distributed systems (e.g., TCP/IP, messaging systems, telemetry pipelines)
  • Experience designing or integrating systems involving machine-to-cloud or edge-to-cloud communication

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Relocation is available for this position.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

September 16, 2026 - September 29, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed to and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Software Engineer (Senior .NET Developer) to joinour Applications Development & Intelligence Automation -CAT IT Division

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore PSN Office, KA-India

What you will do

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise applications using .NET technologies
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders and product teams to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Contribute to application design and integration across systems
  • Develop APIs, services, and user interfaces for scalable applications
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure quality and performance
  • Work with cross-functional teams to build and enhance solutions
  • Support system performance tuning, troubleshooting, and optimization
  • Contribute to reusable components, common frameworks, and development standards
  • Participate in Agile development processes (Scrum) including sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives

Assist in modernizing legacy applications and supporting migration efforts

What you will have

  • 6–10 years of hands-on experience in enterprise application development
  • Strong experience with .NET technologies (.NET Core, ASP.NET, MVC, C#)
  • Experience working with REST APIs and web services (SOAP/REST)
  • Proficiency in front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
  • Familiarity with JavaScript frameworks (Angular 8+, Razor or React is a plus)
  • Experience with databases (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL)
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming and design principles
  • Experience working in Agile (Scrum) environments
  • Familiarity with Git, Azure DevOps, or similar tools
  • Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines
  • Exposure to Azure cloud services is a plus
  • Experience with SSRS/RDLC reporting is a plus
  • Knowledge of multi-tier application architecture
  • This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office.
  • Shift Timing :01:00Noon -10:00PM IST

Skills desired:

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.
  • Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
  • Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
  • Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
  • Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Software Development: Knowledge of software development tools and activities; ability to produce software products or systems in line with product requirements. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Describes common tools for component-based, object-oriented development.
  • Describes the objectives, activities and results of unit testing.
  • Has developed programs in a specific language and for a specific platform.
  • Interprets functional and technical blueprints; participates in structuring technical components.
  • Participates in technical and code reviews.

Software Development Life Cycle: Knowledge of software development life cycle; ability to use a structured methodology for delivering and managing new or enhanced software products to the marketplace. Level Basic Understanding:

  • Summarizes the overall process for developing new software for the company product line.
  • Differentiates respective roles and responsibilities of software engineering and other functions.
  • Identifies common issues and considerations for bringing a new product to marketplace.
  • Describes major phases, checkpoints and deliverables.

Software Integration Engineering: Knowledge of software integration processes and functions; ability to design, develop and maintain interfaces and linkage to alternative platforms and software packages. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Has experience with designing data exchange interfaces to and from software product.
  • Describes tools and techniques for extraction, transformation and loading of electronic data.
  • Cites examples of common linkage requirements for software products and vendors.
  • Works with integrating software into the customer or partner framework and infrastructure.
  • Participates in the development of technology interfaces and bridges.

Software Product Design/Architecture: Knowledge of software product design; ability to convert market requirements into the software product design. Level Basic Understanding:

  • Identifies basic design methods and design tools.
  • Identifies major components of functional and technical design.
  • Cites examples of good and bad designs.
  • Describes tasks, activities, deliverables and key concerns of technical design.

Software Product Technical Knowledge: Knowledge of technical aspects of a software products; ability to design, configure and integrate technical aspects of software products. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Maintains and utilizes data related to install base configurations and environments.
  • Solicits customer feedback; reports and monitors bugs and implementation issues.
  • Participates in defining and conducting technical acceptance tests.
  • Participates in creating technical requirements for software development and deployment.
  • Explains basic environment and product configuration options.

Software Product Testing: Knowledge of software product testing; ability to design, plan, and execute testing strategies and tactics to ensure software product quality and adherence to stated requirements. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Participates in test readiness reviews, functional, volume, and load testing.
  • Describes key features and aspects of a specific testing discipline or methodology.
  • Tests software components for compliance with functional requirements and design specifications.
  • Explains procedures for documenting test activities and results (e.g. errors, non-conformance, etc.)
  • Conducts functional and performance testing on aspects of assigned products.

  • Earned and medical leave.
  • Relocation assistance

  • Career developments opportunities with global prospects

  • Employee mental wellness assistance program

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

About EPD:

Caterpillar's Electric Power Division (EPD) offers integrated solutions, parts, and services to meet the needs of our various commercial and industrial electric power customers. EPD supports a wide range of customer applications across the globe, including providing back-up power to hospitals, providing emergency power when natural disasters strike, and supporting critical infrastructure for data centers, municipalities, and more. With a rich history of more than 95 years in the electric power business, our team has world-class expertise and a proven ability to adapt to changing demands. We’re committed to providing sustainable and reliable solutions to our customers. Join our team to help build a better, more sustainable world for future generations!

Job Summary

Members of the Large Electric Power Application Engineering team provide front line technical support to our dealers and sales teams with a focus on packaged genset products. This role would be of interest for those with good technical knowledge and a desire to be closely involved with high profile projects for key account customers. This role helps to deliver sales results while also engaging and better understanding the needs of our global account data center customers and the dealers that support them.

What you will do

  • Act as a liaison to the Global Account Managers to better understand the needs of their customers and provide focused support to the data center market.
  • Respond to customer and dealer technical inquiries for the data center market from the conceptual project phase through commissioning. This includes development of Design to Order (DTO) quotations for custom products not offered in the standard price list.
  • Consultation with both the dealer & sales organizations on product offerings and how to best apply them. This will include project specific technical guidance along with being an interface to core engineering teams while investigating alternative solutions.
  • Feedback to engineering and product definition teams in order to drive and improve future product development allowing Caterpillar to better meet our customer needs.
  • Identification & delivery of product application training along with creating independent materials and white papers to assist with frequently requested topics.
  • This role includes supporting the pre-production role out of new Large Electric Power technology to global account customers.

What you will have:

Customer Focus: Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Facilitates creation of the 'right' products and services to resolve customer business issues.
  • Fosters strong customer relationships via delivery on commitments, open communication, and on-going feedback/improvement.
  • Advises others on creating customer focused environments in various scenarios.
  • Anticipates customer needs, focusing efforts to proactively meet needs and exceed customer expectations.
  • Measures and observes customer satisfaction levels to ascertain and implement service improvement alternatives.
  • Communicates and models the criticality of customer focus as an organizational strategy.

Industry Knowledge: Knowledge of the organization's industry group, trends, directions, major issues, regulatory considerations, and trendsetters; ability to apply industry knowledge appropriately to diverse situations. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Discusses industry-specific flagship products and services.
  • Demonstrates current knowledge of the regulatory environment for industry segment.
  • Describes the contribution of own function as it relates to the industry segment.
  • Participates in major industry professional associations; subscribes to industry-specific publications.
  • Currently works with a major industry segment and associated functions and features.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.
  • Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
  • Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
  • Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
  • Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Relationship Management: Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Alerts own team to problems in client satisfaction.
  • Differentiates the roles and responsibilities in a business relationship.
  • Works with clients to address critical issues and resolve major problems.

Top Candidates Will Also Have:

  • 4 year bachelor's degree, preferably in Engineering or technologist or equivalent experience.
  • 5 years experience in Energy and Transportation, preferably Electric Power.
  • Deep product and/or industry expertise in Electric Power in Large diesel generator sets.
  • Familiarity with various Caterpillar systems (TMI, EOMP/ISA, CSQ, EDDC and other technical, drawing and operations system).
  • Previous dealer interaction and / or product group experience.
  • Good human relations and communication skills are required to develop a cooperative work relationship with others inside the department and especially global field sales organizations, dealers and customers.

Additional Information:

job.title: Digital Designer
job.description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

The Digital Designer is a hands-on production-focused designer responsible for executing high-volume digital campaign assets across performance marketing and automated ad workflows. Responsible for product image processing and preparing all digital assets for automated ad generation through our automation platform. The role requires strong layout, typography, and compositional skills, with the ability to work efficiently and accurately under fast-paced production timelines. The ideal candidate is highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working within structured design systems while maintaining strong visual quality and brand consistency at scale.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Interpret campaign production briefs and execute digital creatives across approved template systems and format families
  • Populate dynamic creative templates with campaign content including copy, pricing, product imagery, and CTA elements
  • Generate digital ad variants across all required placements using the ad automation platform, understanding template logic and catching layout anomalies proactively
  • Adapt and optimise assets for platform-specific specifications using Adobe Creative Suite
  • Ensure layout accuracy, brand consistency, copy integrity, and technical compliance across all outputs
  • Export and package final deliverables across required formats including static and animated assets
  • Maintain organised asset management, naming conventions, version control, and production file structures
  • Identify layout inconsistencies, formatting issues, or outputs outside approved templates and escalate when necessary
  • Support scalable production workflows and contribute to operational efficiency improvements
  • Undertake other duties, responsibilities, and projects as assigned by the supervisor or management, in line with evolving business and operational needs

Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of experience in digital production, graphic design, advertising production, or performance marketing creative environments
  • Portfolio demonstrating strong digital campaign execution and high-volume production capability
  • Experience working in fast-paced agency, in-house, or commercially driven production environments
  • Experience producing creatives for sales campaigns, festive campaigns, product launches, and promotional events
  • Strong understanding of layout, typography, composition, and visual hierarchy
  • Experience adapting digital creatives across multiple placements and format requirements
  • Able to work accurately within established template systems and brand guidelines
  • Strong attention to detail and self-review discipline before final submission
  • Experience handling multiple deliverables and timelines within fast-moving production environments
  • Able to work independently while maintaining consistency and production accuracy

REQUIREMENTS

  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator
  • Familiarity with ad automation and dynamic creative workflows is advantageous
  • Basic motion or After Effects skills is advantageous
  • Basic proficiency in AI-assisted creative tools is advantageous
  • Solid understanding of digital ad specifications across social and display platforms
  • Strong file management and version control discipline

job.title: EHS Specialist
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

The EHS Specialist supports the EHS Manager in the governance and assurance of General Contractor (GC) EHS performance across DayOne Data Centre operations and construction projects. The role is execution-focused: it drives the day-to-day processes that keep GC governance running — onboarding and qualification support, compliance tracking, field data management, audit and inspection support, and site observation tracking — so that risks are identified early, controls are verified in work-as-done, and EHS performance is reported accurately and on time.

The Specialist works closely with the EHS Manager, GC site teams, and the wider EHS function, providing the analytical and administrative backbone that enables consistent, data-driven EHS oversight across projects and regions. The role influences EHS outcomes through diligence, presence, and clear reporting rather than through direct authority.

Key Responsibilities

1. GC Onboarding & Qualification Support

  • Support the EHS Manager in administering the GC EHS onboarding and pre-qualification process from initial engagement through to site mobilization.
  • Perform first-pass review of GC EHS management systems, plans, risk assessments, method statements, and emergency preparedness documentation, flagging gaps and inconsistencies for the EHS Manager’s decision.
  • Assess GC submissions against DayOne EHS Minimum Requirements and project-specific criteria, and maintain a clear record of qualification status for each GC.
  • Develop and consolidate project-specific EHS risk and compliance requirements at the global stage, aligning them with DayOne standards and local regulatory obligations; communicate these to GC and internal stakeholders and follow up to confirm understanding and closure.
  • Track identified capability or documentation gaps through to closure, escalating stalled or high-risk items to the EHS Manager.

2. Compliance Process & Documentation Governance

  • Maintain and administer the GC EHS compliance framework, ensuring required documents, permits, certifications, and statutory records are current, complete, and correctly filed.
  • Operate document control for EHS governance materials — version control, distribution, and retrieval — so the EHS Manager and site teams work from a single source of truth.
  • Monitor compliance status against DayOne standards and local regulatory obligations, and prepare compliance status summaries and reminders ahead of expiry or renewal dates.
  • Support the translation of DayOne EHS Minimum Requirements into clear, workable site-level checklists and process artefacts.

3. Site EHS Data Management & Analysis

  • Collect, consolidate, and quality-check EHS data from project sites — leading and lagging indicators, inspection findings, permits, training records, and incident/near-miss data.
  • Maintain EHS data trackers, dashboards, and registers, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of submissions from GC site teams.
  • Analyse data to surface recurring risk conditions, behavioural or cultural patterns, and capability gaps across sites and regions, and highlight these to the EHS Manager.
  • Safeguard data integrity and confidentiality, and drive continuous improvement in how site data is captured and reported.

4. Audit & Inspection Support

  • Support the planning, scheduling, and logistics of EHS audits and inspections aligned with DayOne standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Assist during audits and inspections — evidence gathering, note-taking, and documentation — and help draft clear, factual audit and inspection reports.
  • Maintain the corrective and preventive action (CAPA) register, tracking actions to effective closure and following up with GC teams on overdue items.
  • Help verify that corrective actions address root causes rather than symptoms, escalating recurring or systemic issues to the EHS Manager.

5. Site Observation & Field Assurance Tracking

  • Administer the site observation and field engagement programme — logging, categorising, and trending safety observations, stop-work events, and field findings.
  • Maintain the observation tracking system so that trends in high-risk and high-energy activities, and the effectiveness of critical controls, are visible and reportable.
  • Participate in site walkthroughs and field observations alongside the EHS Manager to understand real work conditions and reinforce a supportive stop-work culture.
  • Ensure observation data feeds cleanly into performance reporting and continuous improvement reviews.

6. EHS Performance Reporting

  • Prepare periodic and ad-hoc EHS performance reports, packs, and dashboards for the EHS Manager, presenting risks, trends, and priority actions clearly and concisely.
  • Consolidate cross-site and cross-regional performance data into a coherent view of GC EHS performance.
  • Ensure reporting is timely, accurate, and decision-ready, with underlying data traceable and auditable.

7. Continuous Improvement & Learning Support

  • Support learning-focused reviews of incidents and near misses, capturing system- and condition-based factors and maintaining the lessons-learned repository.
  • Help share lessons learned and good practices across DayOne projects and regions.
  • Contribute to the ongoing improvement of DayOne’s GC EHS governance processes, tools, templates, and trackers.

Qualifications & Experience Essential

  • Degree or diploma in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 3–5 years’ EHS experience in construction, project, or industrial environments.
  • Sound working knowledge of EHS management systems, regulatory requirements, and contractor/GC EHS processes.
  • Strong data management, tracking, and reporting skills, with high attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheets, dashboards, and document control tools.

Highly Desirable

  • ISO 45001 / 14001 Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor qualification.
  • NEBOSH Certificate (or equivalent) or working towards NEBOSH Diploma.
  • Nationally recognised safety competency relevant to the base location (e.g. WSQ / WSHO for Singapore; DOSH-registered Safety & Health Officer (SHO) / CIDB Green Card for Malaysia).
  • Exposure to data centre, mission-critical, or large-scale construction environments.
  • Experience supporting audits, compliance programmes, or EHS data/reporting systems.
  • Experience developing ISO-compliant safety procedures and documentation.
  • Hands-on experience setting up a safety management system, including its procedures, communications, and audit compliance.

Key Competencies

  • Strong organisational discipline — reliable tracking, follow-up, and closure of actions.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to turn raw site data into clear trends and insights.
  • Accurate, factual, and concise written reporting.
  • Practical, field-focused EHS approach; comfortable engaging on site and with GC teams.
  • Cross-cultural awareness and adaptability across regional and site contexts.
  • Collaborative, dependable, and able to work with limited supervision within a defined framework.
  • Integrity in handling EHS data and confidential information.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Legal Counsel, Capital Projects
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As the Legal Counsel, Capital Projects, you will report to Senior Director, Capital Projects, and work closely with various teams and leadership across the Asia Pacific region, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • You will work closely with the AirTrunk Legal, Site Selection and Development teams and other key business stakeholders, applying your broad expertise and knowledge to lead and drive key site selection, property, planning, leasing and acquisition workstreams across the APJ region.
  • You will advise on new, significant and unique initiatives, strategies and processes being developed across the site selection, property, planning, land acquisition space to enable the rapid expansion of AirTrunk data centre developments across APJ, utilising your conceptual thinking to understand advanced issues and implications and convey them appropriately.
  • You will be able to hone new skills and expertise in related workstreams as required, such as energy, construction, development and procurement, applying an in-depth knowledge of AirTrunk’s business, operations, technologies and services and providing legal support on AirTrunk’s strategic initiatives.

Your Day to Day

  • Review and negotiate legal contracts, and provide practical and commercial legal advice on a range of property and planning workstreams across APJ, and clearly convey advanced information concisely and commercially.
  • Support the Site Selection team to implement new, or improve on existing, commercial arrangements and contractual frameworks and policies to support the rapid expansion of data centre developments through APJ.
  • Monitor and identify emerging property, foreign investment, planning issues and developments from a legal or regulatory perspective, drive initiatives to ensure awareness, and compliance and improve processes within AirTrunk, including through training and development of new policies and procedures.
  • Advise the Site Selection team as needed to monitor, manage, and resolve claims and/or disputes.

Requirements

  • Law degree from an accredited law school.
  • Minimum of 8 years in real property experience gained from a reputable law firm and/or within an in-house environment, experience in planning a plus.
  • Experience in advising across a broad range of property-related areas, across APJ markets.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply sound judgement and commercial acumen to a range of negotiations, whilst delivering practical legal advice that manages risk.
  • Ability to autonomously and efficiently manage multiple workstreams, priorities and stakeholders.
  • Excellent negotiation, relationship building and stakeholder management skills.
  • Enjoys being challenged, has a “can do” attitude, is prepared to go above and beyond and is eager to learn and develop an in-depth knowledge of AirTrunk’s business and operations.
  • Thrives in a fun, team-oriented, fast-paced working environment.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Assistant Manager - Cybersecurity Operations
job.description:
Perimeter WAF Security Engineer - L2

Job Description

  • The leading security organization, Tata Communications Limited, has an immediate job opportunity for Perimeter Security Engineer and the position is required for one of its important customers.

. The WAF capabilities should comprise ASM module, and a basic understanding of LTM module is required. Implement project/change and troubleshoot incidents on WAF solutions such as F5.
