job.title: Applications Engineer II
job.description:
At a Glance

Legrand has an exciting opportunity for a Aplications Engineer (Design) - APAC to join the Data, Power & Control - Starline Team in Tuas, Singapore (Remote). The Applications Engineer provides high-level engineering expertise, technical design and commercial support on the application of Starline high amperage busduct products to specific projects and customers. The Engineer has the task of overseeing the activities aimed at defining and consequently drafting the offers for the products. The role is also responsible for identifying and providing reliable solutions for all technical issues related to design and field install to assure complete customer satisfaction through all stages of the project. The role establishes and maintains strong relationships throughout the project life cycle.

Responsibilities

What Will You Do?

  • Maintain High-level expertise of product knowledge and application.
  • Complete System Layouts: design layouts of busduct systems based on site
  • Audit & Surveys, Customer drawings, Project tenders and Field input.
  • Utilize AutoDesk Suite to assess understand customer requirements
  • Experienced in 3D design such as AutoCAD, Revit, Inventor & BIM360
  • Create product technical system layouts from engineered drawings (catalog sheets, FAQ’s, Tech Briefs, Reports, instructions, etc.)
  • Provide technical and commercial support to sales and to customers onsite or remotely as required on topics including but not limited to product estimation, RFQ support, ratings, compliance with local regulations and Standards, safety, functionality, Product hands on training, customization, troubleshooting and pricing.
  • Attend customer facing meetings which may include providing customer presentations for product solutions and project updates.
  • Drafting offers related to bus duct products, verifies the technical aspects of the application (based on the technical needs expressed by the customer, drawings of the installation layout.)
  • Verifying the technical characteristics (operating temperature, power, installation, material, quantity, etc.)
  • Supports the management of the customer’s project through the entire project life cycle
  • Work with internal departments such as Purchasing, R&D, Test, Product Engineering, 3rd party assembly providers, for assembly designs, resolve customer & Field technical design issues.

Additional Duties

  • Onsite troubleshooting and rework.
  • Technical liaison to the sales team
  • Training on busduct products and design tools to Sales network
  • Provides Service Group through helping to project manage installations.

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Aptitude for electrical product design and application in power distribution and busduct products.
  • Experienced user of AutoDESK programs – AutoCAD, Revit, Inventor
  • Experience using BIM360
  • Familiarity with the IEC standards and various IEC certifications
  • Persuasive and articulate, with an ability to communicate and influence people at all levels, verbally, in writing and by presentation.
  • Stable, loyal and reliable, with a customer focused personality.
  • Self-reliant, flexible and resourceful.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering.
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in the Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering field.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office.
  • Familiar with project management tools such as Prince2
  • Proficient in technical writing and communication.
  • Prior experience with Busduct products is preferred
  • Ability to travel up to 15% on a regular basis and 20% occasionally, mainly in APAC, other locations as required.

Working Conditions / Physical Requirements

  • The performance of this position may occasionally require exposure to the manufacturing and construction areas where, under certain areas, the use of personal protective equipment such as safety glasses and mandatory hearing protection are required. Also exposed to certain high working areas like high ceiling or floor level.
  • Ability to sit for prolonged periods of time
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 23kg occasionally

Note: The above Job Description is representative of the responsibilities and qualifications necessary to be successful in this role. It does not encompass every job duty or responsibility; other tasks may be assigned as necessary. Further the job

description does not alter the at-will nature of employment with Legrand and does not create a contract of employment.

job.description:
What will you do:

As a Senior Service Engineer, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality service, maintenance, commissioning, and technical support for chiller systems in mission‑critical data center environments. You will:

  • Perform service, preventive maintenance, and corrective actions on Air-Cooled and Water-Cooled Chillers, including screw, scroll, and centrifugal systems.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control‑related issues in chiller and HVAC systems.
  • Conduct chiller start‑up, commissioning, performance testing, and system optimization.
  • Lead site execution for data center cooling projects, including planning, installation oversight, and coordination with contractors and OEM teams.
  • Support upgrades, retrofits, and energy‑efficiency improvements in existing cooling infrastructure.
  • Review technical drawings, submittals, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and project documents for accuracy and compliance.
  • Maintain detailed service reports, performance logs, and documentation for all serviced equipment.
  • Ensure strict adherence to safety standards, regulatory requirements, and customer data center protocols.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
  • Interface with customers to provide updates, clarify technical issues, and ensure timely execution of service tasks.
  • Participate in root‑cause analysis activities and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Coordinate with internal teams—including sales, project management, and engineering—to ensure seamless project and service delivery.
  • Ensure timely submission of RCA and 8D reports to customers.
  • Attend Monthly MOR and Quarterly QBR review meetings with data center customers.

What you will bring: (Skills & Competencies):

  • Deep technical expertise in Air-Cooled and Water-Cooled Chillers, preferably within mission‑critical data center environments.
  • Strong understanding of refrigeration cycles, HVAC controls, BMS/EMS integration, and cooling redundancy concepts.
  • Ability to diagnose mechanical, electrical, and controls issues using advanced tools and diagnostic software.
  • Experience in project execution, installation supervision, and commissioning of HVAC systems.
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings, equipment manuals, wiring diagrams, and P&IDs.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work confidently in critical environments.
  • Familiarity with industry safety standards and best practices.
  • Strong problem‑solving capability and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Experience with mission‑critical data centers or large industrial cooling systems.
  • OEM‑specific training or certifications (Trane, Carrier, Daikin) preferred.
  • Knowledge of energy‑efficiency programs, retrofits, and system optimization.
  • Project management experience or certification is an added advantage.

Qualification:

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5–10 years of direct experience servicing chillers, preferably in data centers.
  • Strong analytical abilities and a structured approach to problem solving and documentation.
  • Ability to collaborate with internal teams and maintain strong customer relationships.
  • Willingness to travel as per project and service requirements.

Role: Manager, AI & Data Engineering

Location: Bangalore

Full/ Part-time: Full time

About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit [corporate.carrier.com](https://www.carrier.com/) or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

  • About the role:

Designs, builds, and evolves enterprise data and AI capabilities that enable reliable, secure, and scalable digital solutions across the organization. Oversees data platforms, pipelines, analytics, and intelligent technologies to ensure high-quality, accessible, and well-governed data that supports operational and strategic decision-making. Applies advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and automation to improve efficiency, accuracy, and business performance while enabling scalable and data-driven ways of working. Establishes and enforces governance frameworks, standards, and responsible AI practices to maintain data integrity, compliance, consistency, and trusted use of enterprise technologies. Partners closely with business and technology teams to translate evolving business needs into robust data and AI solutions that drive innovation, operational maturity, and long-term enterprise value.

JOB RESPONSIBILITY

  • Platform Architecture & Technical Ownership
  • Own the overall architecture of the enterprise data platform based on a Lakehouse paradigm, covering storage, compute, metadata, governance, and observability.
  • Define and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and architectural standards applicable across AWS and GCP.
  • Act as the final technical authority for platform‑level architectural decisions, trade‑offs, and exceptions.
  • Ensure architectural choices support scalability, resilience, security, cost efficiency, and operational excellence.
  • Lakehouse & Open‑Standards Strategy
  • Design the platform around open data standards to ensure portability and long‑term flexibility.
  • Standardize on open table formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg or equivalent) and open file formats (e.g., Parquet) as the foundation of the Lakehouse.
  • Enforce separation of storage and compute, enabling multiple analytics and processing engines without vendor lock‑in.
  • Define principles for schema evolution, ACID guarantees, time travel, and multi‑engine interoperability.
  • Multi‑Cloud Platform Design (AWS & GCP)
  • Architect the Lakehouse platform to run on AWS and GCP, with cloud‑specific implementations mapped to a common logical architecture.
  • Define standards and patterns for:
  • Cloud‑native storage and processing services
  • Environment isolation (dev / test / prod)
  • Networking and identity models
  • Security, encryption, and access controls
  • Establish cloud‑agnostic abstractions and guardrails so data products behave consistently across clouds.
  • Ensure platform design aligns with enterprise security, compliance, and cost‑management requirements.
  • Platform Development & Engineering Enablement
  • Partner with Platform Engineers and Data Engineers to translate architecture into reusable platform capabilities, frameworks, and templates.
  • Define configuration‑driven and template‑based approaches to accelerate onboarding and reduce bespoke development.
  • Review and guide detailed solution designs to ensure alignment with architectural standards.
  • Enable self‑service platform usage while preserving governance and operational controls.
  • Governance, Metadata & Lineage Architecture
  • Define the governance architecture for the Lakehouse, including metadata management, lineage, access control, and auditability.
  • Ensure support for open metadata and lineage standards (e.g., OpenLineage‑style event models).
  • Embed data quality, ownership, discoverability, and compliance as first‑class architectural concerns.
  • Align platform design with enterprise data governance and regulatory expectations.
  • Operational Excellence & Non‑Functional Architecture
  • Architect for high availability, observability, and operational simplicity.
  • Define platform‑level SLAs, SLOs, and operational readiness criteria.
  • Incorporate FinOps principles into architectural decisions to optimize performance and cost.
  • Ensure the platform supports Day‑2 operations, incident management, and continuous improvement.
  • Stakeholder Leadership & Architecture Governance
  • Serve as the primary architecture interface between engineering teams, security, governance, and business stakeholders.
  • Clearly communicate architectural vision and decisions through architecture documents, standards, and review forums.
  • Lead architecture reviews, roadmap planning, and technology evaluations.
  • Mentor senior engineers and architects, raising overall platform and architecture maturity.

Required Qualifications

  • 16+ years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, or data architecture roles.
  • Proven experience architecting enterprise‑scale data platforms.
  • Strong experience designing and governing Lakehouse architectures.
  • Hands‑on architectural experience with AWS and/or GCP, with the ability to design for both.
  • Deep understanding of open data standards, including open table formats, file formats, metadata, and lineage.
  • Experience defining reference architectures, guardrails, and engineering standards.
  • Strong ability to balance long‑term architectural vision with near‑term delivery needs.

Preferred / Optional Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure data and analytics services (optional, not required).
  • Experience designing multi‑cloud or cloud‑agnostic data platforms.
  • Familiarity with multiple analytics and query engines across cloud ecosystems.
  • Experience with enterprise data governance frameworks and metadata platforms.
  • Exposure to AI/ML platform integration on Lakehouse architectures.
  • Prior experience leading large‑scale platform modernization or migration initiatives

job.title: Senior AI Engineer, Bangalore
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Build the Digital Backbone of Modern Manufacturing

We’re assembling a dynamic team to develop and scale our Manufacturing & Supply Digital Platform—a next-generation software framework that transforms how manufacturing and supply operations connect, collaborate, and optimize.

This platform is not an ERP system. It’s a purpose-built digital layer that integrates data, processes, and resources across the entire manufacturing lifecycle—from design and engineering to production and distribution.

This initiative is powered by NVIDIA technologies, including the Omniverse platform and AI computing capabilities, enabling immersive digital twins, accelerated simulation, and intelligent automation. You’ll be part of a team that’s not just building software—but shaping the future of how manufacturing works through AI-driven, collaborative, and scalable digital solutions.

As part of this initiative, you’ll contribute to:

  • System Integration: Seamlessly connecting diverse manufacturing and supply systems, data sources, and workflows into a unified digital ecosystem.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Harnessing real-time data collection, analysis, and visualization to deliver actionable insights and operational intelligence.
  • Automation & Optimization: Driving efficiency through intelligent scheduling, predictive maintenance, and quality control—without replacing core transactional systems.
  • Enhanced Collaboration: Enabling transparent communication and coordination across teams, functions, and geographies.

If you're passionate about digital platforms, industrial innovation, and working with cutting-edge technologies—this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead architectural design and development of generative/optimization models for process simulation, process scheduling, and predictive analytics in manufacturing.
  • Orchestrate pipelines integrating synthetic data generation, model training, validation, and deployment.
  • Implement advanced optimization: multi-objective, non-linear, evolutionary, and constraint-based approaches for process efficiency (e.g., scheduling, logistics, yield predictions).
  • Guide the integration of embedded AI & Gen AI solutions with real-time industrial data streams, ensuring high-throughput, high-availability, and low-latency deployment.
  • Mentor teams in coding best practices, simulation-modelling, and deployment workflows using latest industrial AI stacks.

Required Skills

  • Strong experience with Generative AI models. Hands-on experience with Amazon bedrock and AWS AI-ML services
  • Proficiency in building and managing Agentic AI systems using frameworks like LangChain, AutoGen or similar.
  • Expertise on cloud-native architecture, LLMOps and MLOps tools.
  • Familiarity with security, cost and governance best practices for Gen AI on cloud environments.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Previous leadership in deploying ML pipelines and automation (CI/CD, containerization) at scale.
  • Knowledge of quantization-aware training, model pruning, and NVIDIA-specific deployment tools (TensorRT, DeepStream SDK).
  • Working knowledge of OpenUSD scene graphs, data schemas, and extension development for Omniverse Kit/Composer.
  • Published research, open-source contributions, or patents in simulation-driven manufacturing AI or optimization.
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA’s AI stack— RAPIDS, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT, cuOpt (or similar)
  • Applied industrial AI expertise: root-cause analysis, predictive maintenance, digital twin calibration.

Educational Background: Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree, preferably in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, mathematics, or a similar field with quantitative coursework, and 7-10 years of professional experience in associated field is required, a Master’s degree and 4-6 years of experience, or a PhD and 1-3 years of experience in relevant field.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

OData

  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Lean Manufacturing: Knowledge of the philosophy, principles and implementation approaches of lean manufacturing; ability to integrate and implement lean manufacturing philosophy into existing production and management processes. Level Basic Understanding:

  • Cites examples of benefits and risks associated with implementing lean principles.
  • Describes basic tools for observing existing processes and identifying waste.
  • Cites industry or company examples of successful and unsuccessful lean implementations.
  • Identifies key lean principles and highlights of the lean manufacturing process.

Performance Management: Knowledge of successful performance management techniques; ability to apply organization's performance management system, practices, and tools to developing and improving individual, team, and organizational performance. Level Basic Understanding:

  • Demonstrates an understanding of performance management concepts.
  • Describes organization's performance management process.
  • Explains organization's core performance factors and ratings.
  • Participates in own performance review or performance checkpoint session.

Planning and Organizing: Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way. Level Basic Understanding:

  • Seeks help to modify priorities as new information surfaces or conditions change.
  • Demonstrates the ability to estimate the time and resources required to complete tasks.
  • Identifies own key assignments, schedules, and process steps.
  • Applies the concept of 'critical path' in order to complete work in a timely manner and keep larger tasks on track.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains the value of a disciplined approach to problem solving.
  • Describes problem reporting and escalation practices.
  • Utilizes accepted procedures for problem analysis and resolution.
  • Identifies key aspects of problem-solving techniques used in own area.

Quality Management System (QMS): Knowledge of Quality Management System's (QMS) functions, features, and capabilities; ability to design, implement, test, and maintain Quality Management Systems to consistently meet customer requirements and regulatory compliances. Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains the main features, functions, and capabilities of QMS.
  • Lists the major market players/vendors of QMS.
  • Outlines the benefits of using automated and manual QMS.
  • Understands the role of QMS in implementing a formalized system for documenting manufacturing processes and procedures to meet customer requirements and regulatory compliances.

Title: Software Developer - D365 CE JD

Management Level: Individual Contributor

Job Summary

We are seeking a Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE/CRM) Developer with strong hands‑on expertise in CRM customization, configuration, and integrations. The successful candidate will contribute to end‑to‑end implementations, system enhancements, and technical delivery across Sales, Service, and Marketing modules. This role involves plugin development, workflows, Power Automate flows, JavaScript, C#, .NET, and integration engineering. The developer will collaborate with consultants, business analysts, and QA teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high‑quality CRM solutions.

What You Will Do

Technical Delivery & Development

  • Develop and customize Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE/CRM solutions using plugins, workflows, JavaScript, C#, and .NET.
  • Configure CRM entities, forms, views, dashboards, and security roles.
  • Participate in requirement analysis, fit/gap workshops, and technical reviews with peers and stakeholders.

Integration & Data Management

Collaboration & Communication

Continuous Learning & Improvement

  • Research and evaluate new tools and technologies to drive innovation.
  • Implement best practices, conduct code reviews, and contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Stay current with Microsoft technologies, Power Platform tools, and CRM industry trends.

What You Will Have

Technical Expertise

  • Hands‑on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE modules (Sales, Service, Marketing).
  • Skilled in plugin development, workflows, Power Automate flows, JavaScript, C#, and .NET.
  • Familiarity with Dataverse, SQL Server, and data management within CE.
  • Basic knowledge of system integrations using APIs, web services, and Azure Logic Apps.
  • Exposure to Power Platform tools (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate).
  • Understanding of security roles, user management, and compliance standards in Dynamics 365.
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve Dynamics 365 CE issues, ensuring system stability and optimized performance.

Tools & Frameworks

  • Experience with DevOps practices (CI/CD pipelines, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Exposure to global rollouts and multi‑entity implementations is a plus.

Considerations for Top Candidates

  • Customization & Configuration Proficiency – Strong ability to design, configure, and troubleshoot CRM entities, forms, dashboards, and security roles.
  • Development Skills – Knowledge and hands‑on experience with plugins, workflows, Power Automate, JavaScript, C#, and .NET.
  • Integration Knowledge – Familiarity with APIs, web services, and Azure Logic Apps to support system integrations and real‑time data exchange.
  • Performance Optimization – Ability to debug, profile, and optimize CRM customizations and queries to ensure system stability and efficiency.
  • DevOps & CI/CD Exposure – Practical experience with Git, Azure DevOps pipelines, and environment management across Dev/UAT/Prod.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance – Experience with unit testing, debugging, and contributing to automated test scripts to validate customizations and integrations.
  • Cross‑Module Understanding – Exposure to Sales, Service, and Marketing modules, with the ability to extend functionality across multiple areas.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Sharing – Ability to prepare clear technical documentation, maintain knowledge base articles, and contribute to reusable developer guides.
  • Agile/Scrum Collaboration – Familiarity with Agile methodologies, participating in sprints, fit/gap workshops, and peer reviews to ensure delivery excellence.
  • Continuous Learning Mindset – Enthusiasm for exploring Power Platform tools (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate) and emerging Microsoft technologies to drive innovation.

Experience

  • 2–4+ years of experience in the Microsoft stack, with at least 2+ years focused on Dynamics 365 CE/Dataverse and Power Platform.
  • Participated in multiple end‑to‑end full‑cycle implementations of Dynamics 365 CE, contributing to design, development, customization, and deployment.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

Preferred Certifications:

  • PL‑400: Power Platform Developer
  • MB‑210: Dynamics 365 Sales
  • MB‑230: Dynamics 365 Customer Service
  • MB‑910: Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (CRM)

With over 1.5 million connected assets worldwide, our teams use data, technology, advanced analytics, telematics and AI capabilities to help our customers build a better, more sustainable world.

Role Overview

We are hiring an Engineering Manager – Platform Engineering to lead multiple teams building and delivering high-quality, scalable, and performant core functionality for telematic platform.

This is a people and delivery leadership role, responsible for execution, engineering excellence, and team growth within the Experience Engineering stack. You will work closely with the Architect (for architecture) and Engineering teams (for design alignment), ensuring seamless delivery of consistent and high-quality functionalities.

This role is accountable for executing and building core functionality to support multiple dependent applications.

What You’ll Do

People Leadership & Team Development

  • Build, lead, and grow high-performing engineering teams.
  • Manage and coach senior engineers, tech leads, and emerging leaders.
  • Drive a culture of accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
  • Own:
  • Hiring, onboarding, and retention
  • Performance management and career development
  • Succession planning and team structure

Delivery & Execution Excellence

  • Own end-to-end delivery of engineering initiatives across multiple teams.
  • Translate product and architecture inputs into execution plans with clear milestones.
  • Manage:
  • Sprint execution, backlog prioritization, and release planning
  • Risks, dependencies, and cross-team coordination
  • Ensure predictable, high-quality releases using defined engineering metrics:
  • Lead time
  • Change failure rate
  • Ensure predictable and well-governed framework releases, including:
  • Release notes
  • Migration guides
  • Backward compatibility considerations

Technical Execution & Platform Delivery

  • Drive delivery and implementation of core platform using Java, AWS, backend development tools.
  • Ensure alignment with architecture standards defined by the Architect.
  • Drive core functionality across teams by:
  • Defining clear usage guidelines, patterns, and documentation
  • Monitoring and improving core platform
  • Partner with the Architect to implement architectural standards and ensure alignment with the broader strategy.
  • Establish scalable processes for:
  • Documentation and developer onboarding
  • Feedback loops to continuously improve the platform
  • Manage dependencies and rollout strategies across multiple teams.
  • Define support and development, including issue triage, resolution timelines, and escalation paths for consuming teams.

Platform Adoption & Engineering Metrics

  • Define and track success metrics for platform, including:
  • Developer onboarding time and productivity
  • Defect trends and issue resolution timelines
  • Use insights from usage and feedback to drive continuous improvement of the platform.

Engineering Excellence & Quality

  • Own enforcement of engineering quality standards and drive consistency across all teams.
  • Ensure adherence to engineering standards, coding guidelines, and best practices defined at the org level.
  • Drive implementation of:
  • Automated testing (unit, integration, regression)
  • CI/CD pipelines and release automation
  • Track and improve code quality, defect rates, and technical debt within teams.
  • Ensure code quality (SonarQube), open-source governance (FOSSA), and CI/CD quality gates

Performance, Reliability & Observability

  • Ensure delivery meets performance benchmarks.
  • Drive adoption of:
  • Monitoring and observability (logs, alerts)
  • Incident management and root cause analysis.
  • Ensure systems meet availability, scalability, and reliability expectations.

DevOps & Release Management

  • Establish strong release governance and operational cadence.
  • Progressive delivery (canary, blue-green deployments)

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with:
  • Architect for technical direction
  • Product teams for roadmap alignment
  • Platform/Cloud teams for scalability and reliability
  • Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs to stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience with strong focus on backed-end technologies.
  • 3–6+ years of experience managing engineering teams.
  • Proven experience delivering large-scale product.
  • Strong expertise in:
  • Java, AWS
  • Back-end architecture and scalable systems
  • Experience working with design systems and component-driven development.

job.title: Senior Solutions Architect (Network and 5G)
job.description:
Job Description

  • Partner with large deal pursue team and Account Teams to shape account strategies and build pipeline through a consultative selling approach, supporting strategic pursuits and new customer acquisition.
  • Lead customer discovery and architecture workshops; translate business, technical, operational and service requirements into end-to-end network architectures, defined scope, assumptions and measurable outcomes.
  • Act as the design authority for complex solutions covering campus and data centre networking, wired and wireless networks, routing and switching, WAN/SD-WAN, application delivery and managed network services.
  • Architect telco connectivity solutions across internet, DIA, MPLS/IP VPN, Ethernet and local or international connectivity, addressing bandwidth, latency, QoS, carrier and access diversity, last-mile resilience, failover and SLA requirements.
  • Apply network security by design, including segmentation, NGFW/firewall, IPS/IDS, NAC, secure remote access, SASE/ZTNA, DDoS protection, secure management and traffic visibility.
  • Evaluate architecture options and technology choices based on performance, availability, scalability, interoperability, operational supportability, commercial viability and risk, while maintaining vendor-neutral judgement.
  • Own the technical solution package, including reference architecture, high-level design, bill of materials, compliance responses, statement of work, assumptions, dependencies, risks, customer presentations and proof-of-concept approach.
  • Lead technical workstreams for complex bids and architecture reviews, coordinating specialists, product teams, delivery, operations and technology partners to ensure the solution is complete, deliverable and aligned with customer outcomes.
  • Provide technical input to pricing, licensing and total-cost-of-ownership considerations, and ensure alignment among the architecture, service model, implementation schedule, SLA and contractual commitments.
  • Lead the transition from presales to delivery and provide architecture assurance during implementation, reviewing major design changes and governing deviations from the approved solution.
  • Coach and mentor network presales consultants and engineers through discovery, design and proposal reviews, opportunity support and structured knowledge sharing.
  • Lead internal initiatives to develop reusable network offerings, reference architectures, design standards, playbooks and enablement materials, and monitor relevant market and technology developments. *

Qualifications

  • Degree in Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline, with at least 12 years of relevant ICT experience and substantial experience in network presales, solution architecture or technical consulting.
  • Demonstrated experience acting as the technical authority for complex, multi-site and multi-technology network solutions, including leadership of strategic bids and cross-functional solution teams.
  • Strong architectural knowledge of campus and data centre networking, wired and wireless networks, routing and switching, WAN/SD-WAN, application delivery, network automation, network observability and managed network services.
  • Have experience in telco connectivity design, including internet/DIA, MPLS/IP VPN, Ethernet, local and international connectivity, access selection, carrier diversity, bandwidth and QoS planning, latency, resilience and SLA considerations.
  • Strong understanding of network security architecture, including segmentation, NGFW, IPS/IDS, NAC, secure remote access, SASE/ZTNA, DDoS protection and secure network management.
  • Ability to define and evaluate non-functional requirements covering availability, resilience, scalability, performance, interoperability, operability, observability and supportability.
  • Sound solutioning knowledge of major networking platforms such as Cisco, Huawei, Aruba, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point, F5 and Arista, or equivalent technologies; depth in selected platforms and vendor-neutral judgement are expected.
  • Strong capability in high-level design, proposal development, bill-of-materials building and validation, statement-of-work definition, risk and dependency management, proof-of-concept planning and commercial solutioning.
  • Proven ability to coach and develop technical professionals, lead initiatives without relying solely on formal authority, and influence senior business and technical stakeholders.
  • Relevant professional certification such as CCIE, HCIE, Aruba ACE, PCNSE or equivalent is preferred.
  • Exposure to private 5G and 5G integration with enterprise networks is an added advantage.
  • Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to manage multiple strategic pursuits in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

job.title: Retail Consultant, Mirrabooka
job.description:
Perth, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, connecting more than 11 million customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

We’re looking for a vibrant and motivated Casual Retail Service Consultant to join our Mirrabooka team. If you love helping people, thrive in being a part of a supportive crew, and bring positive energy to every interaction, then we’d love to have you on board!

At Optus, you’ll feel connected to what truly matters. We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity, and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships with our customers and with each other.

What you’ll do:

  • Be the face of Optus, delivering standout customer experiences powered by optimism, curiosity and genuine care.
  • Explore our range of tech products and services, and share your knowledge in a way that’s simple, helpful and accessible.
  • Bring your personality and charm to uncover customer needs and deliver personalised solutions that make their day.
  • Work as one team, crafting a warm, welcoming environment where customers feel supported and memorable moments happen.

What you bring:

  • Service Superpower: You know how to understand customer needs, deliver genuine support, and let phenomenal service drive fantastic outcomes.
  • Tech Explorer: You enjoy helping customers make sense of tech by breaking things down simply and guiding them to the right solutions.
  • Problem‑Solving Pro: You listen with empathy, act with integrity, and turn challenges into opportunities to help with calm, practical solutions.
  • Composure Under Pressure: You’re confident in navigating difficult enquiries, ease tricky situations with empathy and respect, and work toward the best solution for the customer.
  • Team Spirit: You build strong connections with your teammates, support one another, stay accountable, and create a customer‑first environment where everyone succeeds.

What’s in it for you?

  • $36 p/h + super + applicable loadings.
  • Phenomenal perks, including 25% off Optus products and exclusive access to unique discounts with our retail partners.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, available 24/7 across multiple channels.
  • Flexible rosters that work around the life you live outside of work.

job.title: ILHBS Screener
job.description:
Baggage Screening and Threat Detection:

Attend all the regulatory trainings and clear trainings as per the regulatory attempts

Operate X-BIS equipment for image analysis to detect Dangerous Goods, Prohibited Articles, Weapons, or Ammunition in check-in baggage as per Avsec circulars/ orders /guidelines and SOPs.

Perform physical inspections and ETD tests for baggage flagged during X-ray screening.

Maintain a high standard of TIP (Threat Image Projection) scores to reflect strong image interpretation capabilities.

Compliance with Aviation Security Directives:

Follow BCAS and DGCA guidelines to ensure strict compliance during baggage handling and inspection tasks.

Record and document all findings and operations to meet audit and inspection requirements.

Equipment Maintenance and Pre-Operational Checks:

Conduct routine pre-operational checks of X-BIS, ETD, CT-EDS other security equipment to confirm their readiness and functionality.

Report equipment malfunctions or downtime and assist in maintaining operational registers.

Stakeholder Interaction and Coordination:

Work collaboratively with CISF and Airlines staff during physical baggage inspections or suspicious item resolutions.

Provide timely updates to supervisors about ongoing operations or issues that may require intervention.

Time Management and Efficiency:

Ensure baggage screening and inspection are completed within strict timelines to avoid operational delays.

Balance thoroughness and speed to maintain operational flow without compromising safety.

Workplace Conduct and Decorum:

Maintain professionalism and discipline at all times, contributing positively to the team environment.

Uphold organizational standards in workplace behavior, ensuring compliance with company policies.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

CSO

Lead Avsec Audit & Compliance

Pass Section

Lead - ILHBS/ Duty Manager - ILHBS/ Sr Screener

Terminal Operations

IT

HR Department

Compliance and Regulatory Teams

Other Airport Departments (e.g., Operations, Customer Service)

Key Stakeholders - External:

Transportation Security Administration (TSA)

Aircraft Operator

Airport Authorities

Passengers

ASG

BCAS

Local Police

Service Providers

Law Enforcement Agencies

Regulatory Bodies

Industry Associations

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

High school diploma or equivalent.

Bachelor’s or equivalent degree

Certifications: TSA certification required; Desirable to have cleared AVSEC basic course by BCAS, standalone / Inline Screeners certification by BCAS, DGR CAT 12 certification by DGCA Approved training center

NCC – “C” or “B” Certificate Holder will be preferred

Work Experience:

Freshers or 1-2 years of experience in security screening or a related field, preferably within an airport setting.

Experience operating screening equipment and familiarity with security protocols.

Physical Qualification:

Visual accuracy - Eyesight shall be equal or better than 20/60 in both eyes without glasses /

lenses or equal or better that 20 / 20 in one eye and 20 / 30 in the other when using glasses

or contact lenses. Adequate color perception shall be required.

Hearing – Hearing loss in each ear should be less than 30 dB when tested by audio graph for

frequencies below 2000 Hz.

Speech – There shall be clear ability to communicate orally efficiently and effectively.

Movement-of-crisis communication necessitates that screening personnel be free from any

pronounced speed impediment.

Sense of smell – Security personnel shall have the ability to sense Oduor

Deportment & Appearance - Security personnel must demonstrate a high standard of civility,

deportment, appearance and sobriety as well as offer the public all appropriate courtesies.

job.title: Lead - Technical Services Lead
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Partner with Head-Ahmedabad in understanding the organization’s requirement for Hard services across all facilities (including MEP maintenance services, Inventory management for all supplies and tools, Infrastructure management and maintenance, and space management)
  • Develop the budget for Hard Services in consultation with Head-Ahmedabad;
  • Ensure adherence to pre-defined budgetary and cost optimization guidelines
  • Define a service delivery framework and service delivery plan for hard services basis the requirements for every facility/property under purview
  • Define and communicate operating procedure/ guidelines for hard services in accordance with the overall policy guidelines; Update the operating procedures from time to time keeping in consideration the changing business dynamics and requirements
  • Conduct Need assessment of MEP services from future operational perspective
  • Develop a Business Continuity plan from an Admin perspective to ensure smooth operations across locations
  • Develop & ensure implementation of SOPs, Engineering Guidelines for Electro- mechanical services, and operation control procedures for smooth operations
  • Prepare, analyse & improve SoWs for AMCs for maximum benefit realisation
  • Assess, identify, and plan the Life Cycle Completion, replacement of the Electro-mechanical equipment
  • Plan a calendar and ensure all MEP activities and structural upgradations are carried out for all facilities (heating/cooling systems, plumbing and water management, lightings, scientific tank cleaning, façade cleaning, painting etc.) with minimal/ zero downtime/ service disruption
  • Conduct service inspection and create a sustenance plan for pre-emptive and reactive maintenance to minimize downtime at Sites
  • Track and ensure timely renewal & submission of all mandatory compliances, licenses and health, safety, and statutory environmental requirements
  • Run and oversee complete snag management cycle for acquired property / infrastructure; Ensure closure of critical snags pertaining to MEP services.
  • Ensure monitoring of PPM calendar with adherence to all safety protocols
  • Management of readable Blue-prints, Schematics and diagrams of the equipment’s
  • Analyse and record all test results and prepare analysis documentation statement
  • Oversee all mechanical services including HVAC systems, elevators, escalators, Mechanized Systems- BMU, Façade Cradle systems, Dumb waiters, waste disposal systems, Lift well and Stairwell pressurization system, Basement Ventilation & Exhaust System, etc.
  • Oversee all electrical & instrumentation services including lighting, load Management & distribution systems, UPS, elevators, earthing and grounding systems
  • Oversee all plumbing services including domestic water system, Softener System, RO system, hot & cold-water system, flushing water system, sewage water system, storage tanks, rainwater harvesting system, Water bodies etc.
  • Design a plan for mechanical services basis the requirement for the property and work closely with engineering team for proper and timely support
  • Devise an annual maintenance calendar for inspection of all services and create a plan for preventive and reactive maintenance for mechanical services to minimize downtime
  • Develop a robust breakdown maintenance plan for all core mechanical services; Manage proper placement of signage pertaining to demarcation of safety lines around electromechanical area
  • Create a training calendar to ensure resources are updated with the technical know-how, market best practices and industry standards
  • Manage day to day operations (including routine maintenance operations, IBMS Rooms and related services and preventive controls) of all mechanical services at respective facility, site or guest house and address critical incidents if any while reporting any near misses
  • Review mechanical services’ performance at regular intervals; Conduct audits and root cause analysis of identified issues and ensure timely resolution of all problems with optimal utilization of all resources to increase site effectiveness.
  • Lead the conceptualization, design development and planning of new building and infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with Architect, Interior Design, MEP Consultants to finalize the design and execute strategy.
  • Review and validate design proposals, layout plans and construction drawings.
  • Execution and monitoring of Projects.
  • Monitor appropriate and timely resolution of hard services’ queries/ grievance redressal at the Helpdesk; Address escalations if any and provide guidance to teams to effectively resolve all queries
  • Analyse the service performance and employee satisfaction levels (through formal / informal feedback) and pilot strategic initiatives to drive process improvements to improve employee satisfaction
  • Maintain close coordination with other departmental services viz. Fire, Security, Telecom, IT and extend support as required
  • Manage communication pertaining to planned maintenance activities
  • Adhere to the Admin Governance framework and ensure all hard service processes are in compliance with the same
  • Analyse audit findings with regards to hard service operations and collaborate with the concerned stakeholders to develop effective action plans for mitigating risks/ gaps identified
  • Ensure timely submission & verification of service partner bills as well as timely pay-out as per agreed SLAs (for all facility services)
  • Conduct operational reviews from time to time and ensure smooth service delivery and adherence to defined SLAs for hard services
  • Identify and build partnerships and relationships with external vendors, government officials to ensure all necessary permits are in place
  • Successfully leverage these networks for value creation for Adani; Oversee partner offerings and lead negotiations with them for all hard services
  • Provide insights on service partner performance and address/ resolve any escalations
  • Identify areas within Hard services which could be automated/ integrated with technology and collaborate with the relevant stakeholders to plan and deploy these initiatives
  • Ensure smooth functioning of the tools for Hard services’ delivery; Track customer satisfaction levels
  • Assets’ database to be maintained basis tagging of assets and verified on a bi-annual basis
  • Coordinate with third party for timely availability of contractual manpower, manage them through shift planning and manage daily roster for all services; Ensure staff is working in line with the agreed SLA
  • Drive a performance driven culture – Set goals, review performance and provide feedback to ensure a motivated and committed team
  • Foster an environment of learning and excellence within the team

Qualifications

  • B.E./B.Tech in Electrical / Mechanical Engineering (Preferred: MBA (Operations/Facilities Management) / PGDM in Facilities Management)
  • 8-12 years of experience in Facility Management, Corporate Administration, Workplace Services, Hospitality, Real Estate Operations, or IFM.
  • Min 5+ years in Technical Services, Facility Engineering, Building Operations, or IFM.
  • Experience managing corporate campuses, commercial buildings, data centers, industrial facilities, or mixed-use developments.
  • Hands-on exposure to MEP operations and critical infrastructure management.
  • Exposure in facility digitization and CAFM implementation.
  • Experience handling senior leadership and executive workplace environments

job.title: Factory Medical Officer
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Oversee and manage the on-site medical center, ensuring it is equipped and staffed to handle emergencies and routine health issues effectively.
  • Develop and implement health and wellness programs aimed at improving employee well-being and reducing absenteeism.
  • Conduct regular health check-ups and maintain accurate medical records for all employees and contractors.
  • Provide immediate medical care and first aid in case of workplace injuries or emergencies, ensuring compliance with safety protocols.
  • Collaborate with the Site HR Head to design and execute health awareness campaigns, focusing on occupational health risks specific to thermal power plant operations.
  • Ensure the medical center complies with all internal standards and aligns with Adani Power’s focus on operational excellence and sustainability.
  • Train and guide first responders and safety teams on emergency medical procedures and protocols.
  • Monitor and manage health-related KPIs, such as incident response times and employee health indices, to support the site’s operational goals.
  • Liaise with external medical facilities and specialists to ensure advanced care when required.
  • Stay updated on the latest medical practices and technologies relevant to industrial health services

Qualifications

  • MBBS degree from a recognized medical institution.
  • AFIH - Associate Fellow of Industrial Health (Mandatory)
  • Additional certification in Occupational Health or Industrial Medicine is preferred.

job.title: Head - Training Delivery - Ports & Logistics (Other than Gujarat Cluster)
job.description:
Responsibilities

a { text-decoration: none; color: #464feb; } tr th, tr td { border: 1px solid #e6e6e6; } tr th { background-color: #f5f5f5; }

  • Own the training delivery strategy, annual training calendar, governance framework, and capability roadmap for ports and logistics operations across assigned regions.
  • Lead the delivery of technical, operational, safety, compliance, supervisory, and leadership training programs for frontline workforce, technicians, operators, supervisors, and management personnel.
  • Drive capability development across cargo handling, terminal operations, marine activities, warehousing, logistics, equipment operation, maintenance, and operational excellence domains.
  • Establish competency frameworks, certification pathways, training standards, assessment systems, and refresher training mechanisms for all critical roles.
  • Manage training centers, simulators, laboratories, practical learning infrastructure, and deployment resources across locations.
  • Build, mentor, and manage a cadre of internal trainers, SMEs, external faculty, and partner agencies to ensure training quality and scalability.
  • Partner closely with Business Heads, Operations Leaders, HR, Safety, Maintenance, and Functional Excellence teams to align capability-building initiatives with business priorities.
  • Ensure training effectiveness through assessments, workplace observations, operational KPIs, certification compliance, and post-training performance tracking.
  • Lead deployment planning, trainer allocation, budget utilization, training audits, governance reviews, and stakeholder reporting.
  • Drive standardization of content, delivery methodology, competency assessments, and reporting systems across all assigned locations.
  • Identify future capability requirements emerging from automation, digitalization, new equipment deployment, and business expansion projects.
  • Represent Adani Skills & Education in capability-building discussions with OEMs, industry bodies, technology partners, regulators, and external institutions.

Qualifications

a { text-decoration: none; color: #464feb; } tr th, tr td { border: 1px solid #e6e6e6; } tr th { background-color: #f5f5f5; }

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Marine Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or related discipline.
  • MBA, PGDM, M.Tech., Maritime Management, Port Management, or related postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Minimum 15 years of relevant experience in Ports, Logistics, Maritime Operations, Terminal Operations, Heavy Equipment Operations, Industrial Operations, or Technical Capability Development.
  • Minimum 5 years in a leadership role managing large-scale workforce capability-building, technical training, competency development, or learning operations.
  • Strong exposure to cargo handling systems, port operations, terminal processes, safety management, workforce productivity, and operational excellence practices.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing multi-location training delivery, large trainer pools, certification systems, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Experience in competency mapping, capability frameworks, training governance, assessment architecture, and performance measurement.
  • Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, program management, communication, and execution capabilities.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across assigned port locations outside Gujarat.

Operate X-BIS equipment for image analysis to detect Dangerous Goods, Prohibited Articles, Weapons, or Ammunition in check-in baggage as per Avsec circulars/ orders /guidelines and SOPs.

Perform physical inspections and ETD tests for baggage flagged during X-ray screening.

Maintain a high standard of TIP (Threat Image Projection) scores to reflect strong image interpretation capabilities.

Compliance with Aviation Security Directives:

Follow BCAS and DGCA guidelines to ensure strict compliance during baggage handling and inspection tasks.

Record and document all findings and operations to meet audit and inspection requirements.

Equipment Maintenance and Pre-Operational Checks:

Conduct routine pre-operational checks of X-BIS, ETD, CT-EDS other security equipment to confirm their readiness and functionality.

Report equipment malfunctions or downtime and assist in maintaining operational registers.

Stakeholder Interaction and Coordination:

Work collaboratively with CISF and Airlines staff during physical baggage inspections or suspicious item resolutions.

Provide timely updates to supervisors about ongoing operations or issues that may require intervention.

Time Management and Efficiency:

Ensure baggage screening and inspection are completed within strict timelines to avoid operational delays.

Balance thoroughness and speed to maintain operational flow without compromising safety.

Workplace Conduct and Decorum:

Maintain professionalism and discipline at all times, contributing positively to the team environment.

Uphold organizational standards in workplace behavior, ensuring compliance with company policies.

Lead Avsec Audit & Compliance

Pass Section

Educational Qualifications:

High school diploma or equivalent.

Bachelor’s or equivalent degree

Certifications: TSA certification required; Desirable to have cleared AVSEC basic course by BCAS, standalone / Inline Screeners certification by BCAS, DGR CAT 12 certification by DGCA Approved training center

NCC – “C” or “B” Certificate Holder will be preferred

Work Experience:

Freshers or 1-2 years of experience in security screening or a related field, preferably within an airport setting.

Experience operating screening equipment and familiarity with security protocols.

Physical Qualification:

Visual accuracy - Eyesight shall be equal or better than 20/60 in both eyes without glasses /

lenses or equal or better that 20 / 20 in one eye and 20 / 30 in the other when using glasses

or contact lenses. Adequate color perception shall be required.

Hearing – Hearing loss in each ear should be less than 30 dB when tested by audio graph for

frequencies below 2000 Hz.

Speech – There shall be clear ability to communicate orally efficiently and effectively.

Movement-of-crisis communication necessitates that screening personnel be free from any

pronounced speed impediment.

Sense of smell – Security personnel shall have the ability to sense Oduor

Deportment & Appearance - Security personnel must demonstrate a high standard of civility,

deportment, appearance and sobriety as well as offer the public all appropriate courtesies.

job.title: Data Loss Prevention Lead
job.description:
Strategic Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Manage a comprehensive DLP program, including data discovery, classification, and protection policies.
  • Conduct DLP and DSPM assessments to identify, mitigate, and report data protection risks.
  • Ensure compliance with data protection regulations across multiple geographies.
  • Collaborate with legal teams to review contracts and MSAs for DLP compliance.
  • Oversee deployment and tuning of disk encryption technologies (e.g., BitLocker).
  • Understanding of Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and evaluate vendor risks from a DLP perspective.
  • Participate in Architecture Review Board (ARB) reviews to ensure DLP/DAM/DSPM considerations are integrated.
  • Manage and respond to data breaches and DLP incidents.
  • Stay up to date with the latest DLP trends, threats, and technologies.

People Management

  • Foster an environment of learning, excellence, and innovation within the team and across teams.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members.
  • Conduct performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.
  • Ensure continuous professional development of team members.

Qualifications

Educational qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or related field.
  • 10–12 years of experience in data loss prevention, data discovery/classification, and database/data security.
  • Experience with DSPM tools and integration in hybrid environments.
  • Familiarity with security standards and frameworks such as GDPR, ISO 27001, and NIST.
  • Experience with DLP, DSPM, disk encryption tools and automation.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CEH, or OSCP are a plus.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to stay up to date with the latest DLP trends, threats, and technologies.

job.title: Associate Officer - Mine Surveyor
job.description:
Mine Surveyor - Coal Mining

Conducting Surveys and Measurements:

Perform detailed topographic and underground surveys using the latest surveying equipment and techniques to accurately measure and map the mine’s physical features.

Measure and record the dimensions, elevations, and contours of mine workings and geological formations, ensuring all data is precise and reliable.

Utilize advanced surveying software to collect, analyze, and process survey data, ensuring accurate and timely reporting.

Developing and Maintaining Mine Plans:

Create and regularly update accurate mine plans, layouts, and sectional drawings that reflect the current state of mine workings and future development plans.

Ensure all mine plans and layouts comply with statutory requirements, industry standards, and company policies, facilitating smooth regulatory audits and inspections.

Collaborate with mining engineers, geologists, and mine management to adjust and optimize plans based on operational needs and geological findings.

Monitoring Geological Features:

Identify, record, and monitor geological formations, faults, and potential hazards within the mine, providing early warnings of any changes that could impact safety or operations.

Assist in the assessment of ground stability, roof conditions, and potential safety risks by providing accurate geological data and interpretations.

Support geological mapping and modeling efforts with precise survey data, aiding in the prediction and management of geological conditions.

Ensuring Regulatory Compliance:

Adhere to all relevant mining regulations, safety standards, and environmental guidelines, ensuring that all surveying activities are conducted legally and ethically.

Prepare, maintain, and submit required reports, records, and documentation to regulatory bodies, ensuring all data is accurate and submitted in a timely manner.

Participate in safety audits, inspections, and reviews, providing necessary survey data and supporting documentation to demonstrate compliance and identify areas for improvement.

Supporting Mine Planning and Development:

Provide critical survey data and insights to support the design, planning, and optimization of mine development projects, ensuring efficient and safe operations.

Assist in the planning, coordination, and execution of mine expansion and development projects, providing accurate survey data to guide decision-making and project implementation.

Work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, operations, and safety, to ensure alignment of surveying activities with overall mine operational goals and objectives.

Implement and Optimize Digital Solutions:

Coordinate with cross-functional teams to deploy digital tools that align with business objectives.

Ensure the effective utilization of digital platforms to improve team efficiency and productivity.

Employees

job.title: Executive - Technical Services
job.description:

Technical Services Trainee - O2

Technical Specification Drafting:

  • Assists in drafting technical specifications for services and projects under the guidance of senior staff, ensuring alignment with the business requirements of ATGL.
  • Aids in the technical analysis process by collecting data to determine specifications for new projects.
  • Contributes to the creation of technical documents and guides for internal use, ensuring consistency with company standards.

Procurement Support and Documentation:

  • Raises Purchase Requisitions according to the specified contract terms, facilitating the timely procurement of materials and services.
  • Maintains and organizes documentation for all procurement activities, adhering to company protocols and procedures.

GIS Management and Value Engineering:

  • Utilizes GIS to gather spatial data for project planning under the direction of senior staff.

job.title: Wind BOP
job.description:
Operational Support and Performance Monitoring:

Monitor the performance of solar systems, ensuring that energy production targets are being met and all equipment is functioning efficiently. Assist in the analysis of operational metrics such as Performance Ratio (PR), Capacity Utilization Factor (CUF), Plant Availability (PA), and Grid Availability (GA). Collect performance data and identify potential areas for improvement, reporting findings to senior team members.

Safety and Compliance Support:

Adhere to safety protocols and ensure safe working conditions by following operational and safety guidelines. Participate in safety training sessions, toolbox talks, and safety audits to ensure compliance with safety regulations. Help maintain safety documentation and ensure timely submission of reports, including Joint Meter Readings (JMR) and other regulatory compliance reports.

Operational Procedure and Policy Support:

Follow established procedures and assist in recommending improvements for operational efficiency. Support the implementation of operational policies by providing feedback on procedures and identifying inefficiencies. Assist in collecting and analyzing feedback to suggest improvements in processes and procedures for better operational outcomes.

Team Collaboration:

Work closely with operations, maintenance, and engineering teams to ensure smooth and efficient operations. Assist in supporting cross-functional team efforts to improve system performance and resolve operational challenges. Provide support to senior team members in troubleshooting, data collection, and problem-solving.

Continuous Improvement and Innovation Support:

Participate in continuous improvement activities by suggesting minor process enhancements and providing input on operational best practices. Assist in the testing and adoption of new technologies or tools aimed at enhancing wind energy production or operational efficiency. Collect data and provide insights that contribute to optimizing solar operations and improving system reliability.

Documentation and Reporting:

Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of performance data, maintenance activities, and safety compliance. Prepare reports on system performance, operational issues, and maintenance logs as required by the operations team. Assist in compiling data for senior management presentations, providing feedback on system performance and areas for improvement.

job.title: Lead- Transport Services
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Design and implement a Group-wide transportation strategy aligned with business goals.
  • Lead national planning, route optimization, and long-term capacity design to enhance service and ROI.
  • Establish a strong governance framework to ensure consistency, transparency, and accountability across transportation operations.
  • Provide regular assurance to leadership on spend control, vendor compliance, and performance standards.
  • Drive internal audits, compliance checks, and corrective actions where required.
  • Ensure compliance to respective processes w.r.t. governance protocols
  • Drive the standardization of Transport services across group.
  • Lead the deployment of a centralized Transportation Management System (TMS) and digitization initiatives.
  • Ensure all 3000+ vehicles are integrated under a unified Central Command Center for real-time monitoring, analytics, and decision-making.
  • Make recommendations to the concerned teams to add features and upgrade the transport portal to enhance user experience & signoff key features and functionalities of the portal and other tools as applicable
  • Define and enforce standard operating procedures for vehicle sourcing, vendor engagement, billing, and documentation.
  • Institutionalize process rigor across all locations and business units.
  • Update the SOP’s from time to time keeping in consideration the business dynamics and user requirements
  • Partner with techno-commercial and BU teams to analyze spend trends & rate structures.
  • Monitor transport resource utilization and optimize allocation across BUs to reduce idle time and inefficiencies.
  • Drive cost-saving initiatives without compromising service or compliance.
  • Build a pan-India network of reliable transport partners.
  • Oversee vendor performance, SLA compliance, and periodic re-evaluations to ensure continuity and quality of service.
  • Conduct Quarterly reviews with service partners, ensuring SLA and performance levels are achieved
  • Manage and optimize the Group’s 400 Cr plus transportation budget.
  • Provide strategic inputs on budget planning, variance analysis, and cost rationalization.
  • Ensure full adherence to national and state-level transport regulations and safety mandates.
  • Lead risk identification and develop mitigation frameworks, including business continuity planning.
  • Act as the Group’s transport strategy lead, aligning with BU heads and senior stakeholders to drive operational efficiency, compliance, and cost visibility.
  • Build and lead a high-performing national transport team, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop strong internal working relationships with all departments
  • Prepare FAQs and monitor timely resolution of queries raised at the Traveller Helpdesk; Address escalations if any and provide guidance to teams to effectively resolve all queries/ grievances
  • Analyse service performance and traveller satisfaction levels (through formal / informal feedback) and pilot strategic initiatives to drive process improvements.

Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in Transport Operations, Fleet Management, Logistics, Mobility Services, Corporate Administration.

Minimum 5 years in a leadership role managing enterprise-wide travel operations.

job.description:

Ensure the smooth and efficient operation of all Food & Beverage outlets, driving high levels of customer satisfaction and seamless service delivery.

Effectively manage client grievances through a structured and empathetic approach to ensure timely resolution and client satisfaction.

Provide excellent customer service by ensuring a welcoming environment by maintaining cleanliness and orderliness in the dining areas.

Assist in daily operations of F&B outlets, ensuring smooth service flow and compliance with brand standards.

Ensure the smooth and efficient operation of all Food & Beverage outlets, driving high levels of customer satisfaction and seamless service delivery.

Stay updated and maintain a thorough understanding of the lounge's F&B offerings, including menus, beverages, and special dietary requirements, to effectively answer guest inquiries.

Continuously assess and improve operational processes, from check-in to service delivery, to enhance efficiency, reduce wait times, and improve guest satisfaction.

job.title: Site Head - Tara (Revised)
job.description:
Site Head - Coal Mining

Mine Operations & Production Management:

Oversee daily mining operations, ensuring production targets are met while maintaining safety, environmental, and regulatory compliance.

Supervise drilling, blasting, excavation, and transportation activities to optimize efficiency and minimize downtime.

Implement cost-effective measures to enhance operational performance and stay within allocated budgets.

Monitor and evaluate mining equipment performance, ensuring timely maintenance and repairs to prevent delays.

Develop and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to streamline mining processes.

Pre-Construction Planning & Regulatory Compliance:

Lead pre-construction activities, ensuring all statutory clearances, including environmental and forest approvals, are obtained.

Liaise with regulatory bodies such as DGMS, Pollution Control Board, and State Mining Offices to secure necessary permits.

Manage land acquisition challenges and ensure smooth transition processes for mining operations.

Develop and implement a comprehensive Safety Management Plan in compliance with DGMS norms, MMDR Act, and environmental laws.

Conduct regular safety audits, risk assessments, and training programs to ensure a zero-accident workplace.

Resource Allocation & Cost Management:

Strategically deploy personnel and equipment to maximize efficiency and achieve production goals.

Coordinate preventive maintenance schedules to reduce equipment downtime.

Ensure proper inventory management for spare parts and consumables to avoid disruptions in operations.
