job.title: Business Head - Lounges & Hotels
job.description:
Responsibilities

Talent & Culture

  • To create a high-performance culture by ensuring that business and individual objectives are set, understood and cascaded appropriately.
  • To establish an excellent internal communication system through regular and transparent communication as well as cross-functional collaboration to maximize synergies.
  • To lead, inspire, develop and engage a talented workforce that supports the strategic and future needs of the business and drives for efficiency and improves effectiveness

Operational

  • Develops effective best practice work and business procedures for Adani Group
  • Collaborates with executive leadership to define the organization's long-term mission and goals, identifying ways to support this mission through talent management.
  • Identifies and executes key performance indicators for the organization on commercial, operations, finance, human resource, etc. to ensure relevant KPIs are executed and reviewed on a quarterly basis.
  • Understanding of operational departments [Guest Services, Facilities Management, Housekeeping, Culinary, Food & Beverage, Customer Engagement, Quality Assurance, etc.] and work with country and local leadership to ensure it is functioning in line with the standards set by partners and HQ.
  • Ensures corporate policies and procedures are being utilized and recommends improvements.
  • Drives the overall business using technology to improve efficiency and achieve maximum operational efficiencies including but not limited to automation and optimization.
  • Leads the City or Country in the event of a Crisis working closely with HQ.
  • Actively participates in addressing internal and external audit findings by working with relevant stakeholders and taking necessary corrective action promptly.
  • Lead the Executive Committee [ExCom] and hold meetings at least once a month by focusing on the company’s overall priorities and goals from a City and Country level.
  • ExCom must define specific strategic plans and actions that will be undertaken to drive and increase revenue, profit, productivity, market share, staff development, technology and attach them to measurable KPIs. The minutes of ExCom meetings will be shared between the leadership Steering Committee members.

Revenue, Growth and Profit Maximization

  • Sets comprehensive goals for department performance and growth
  • Liaises with Commercial Leadership to develop and execute commercial strategies in each location.
  • Directly accountable for driving the budget and forecast by implementing a commercial strategy and business plan through execution, utilizing all available business tools and intelligence.
  • Ensures the delivery of budgeted revenues across all revenue streams.
  • Utilizes Business Intelligence tools to analyze data and performance, providing actionable information for making informed business decisions.
  • Optimizes manpower costs by analyzing trends and costs, setting systemic standards for teams to follow, and tracking the results of planned efforts.
  • Prepares the annual business plan and budgets including but not limited to manpower, etc.
  • Works with the various airport General Managers, Assistant General Managers, Finance PIC, Human Resources PIC including Operations PIC to ensure profits are maximized in line with budgeted revenue and profit targets set.
  • Ensures regular business reviews are conducted with all relevant stakeholders, including pricing and rate strategies are in place to achieve positive business results.

Pre – Opening

  • Drives collaboration across all departments and stakeholders to ensure pre-opening, refurbishment, or delisting projects are opened or closed within the set time frame.
  • Communicate with the Project Team and Project Manager for the project completion timeline.
  • Review the Pre-Opening critical path to schedule key project milestones, work streams, and activities.
  • Manage and approve resources requirements for pre-opening as needed.
  • Communicate and liaise with leadership to define project priorities and implementation opportunities and challenges and keep them up to date with project risks and opportunities.
  • Ensure company standards are reflected in the projects in terms of Marketing, Branding, IT, F&B, HR requirements/standards.

Financial and Commercial Acumen

  • Supports the country finance teams with clear guidelines, responsibilities and ways of working that benefit the Corporate, Shared Services and Country-Level Finance team
  • Reviews, monitors and analyses financial performance in collaboration with the Country Finance against established goals and benchmarks by managing relevant revenue workstreams including driving cost efficiency and savings without impacting customer or brand experience.
  • Supports the collection of accounts receivable by collaborating with respective Country Finance and Commercial teams, including HQ and other stakeholders.
  • Conducts necessary monthly meetings covering commercial and revenue management strategies, credit collection, operational, strategic planning and execution, etc.
  • Manages underperforming or loss-making outlets, developing short-to-long action plans for each business unit to restore profitability.

Business Development

  • Represents the business units in presentations to the Investment Committee, Steering Committee, and other relevant entities as necessary.
  • Forges strategic partnerships and relationships with clients, vendors, agencies, venue partners, and all other professional business relationships.
  • Be a key stakeholder collaborating with the legal team on contract management, including but not limited to contributing to the development of effective and efficient contract terms and conditions.
  • Growth Management aggressively promotes the business unit maximizing its utilization and negotiating lease agreements as determined necessary and in the best interest of the company.
  • Conducts frequent sales and calls with clients to stay updated on the business status and trends.
  • Develops and maintains strong relationships with all internal and external stakeholders including but not limited to airport authorities, owners, business units, etc.
  • Develops and aligns with Country and HQ business development teams on strategic plans for expansion and growth of the country’s business
  • Works with business development and finance stakeholders to analyze ROI for capital projects before committing funds and assesses if anticipated results were achieved upon completion.
  • Works with various stakeholders to provide efficient and accurate assessments on project leads and opportunities including inherent risk in the event of underperformance or early termination.
  • Proposes relevant new concepts and designs to various stakeholders for review and consideration with the objective to expand and grow the business through quality product differentiation.

Qualifications

  • Degree or relevant qualification in a relevant field to the role.
  • 15–20 years of progressive industry experience across business development, revenue generation, P&L management, and operations, with a proven track record of driving business growth and operational excellence.
  • Minimum 15+ years in a senior management role within the Travel, Airline or Hospitality Industry.
  • A mix of experience from management to operations of Airports, Hotels, F&B and/or Travel industry.
  • Proven prior experience in a leadership role with analytical, strategic and tactical decisions making including evaluating and identifying business opportunities.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience presenting financial, commercial and operational plans.
  • Working experience in various countries and regions would be an advantage.
  • Strong and proven leadership skills with an emphasis on leading, engaging, recognizing, developing and mentoring employees.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, handle pressure, and establish clear expectations.
  • Experience working in a collaborative and hierarchal environment.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English as well as other key languages.

job.title: Developer I - E-Learning Developer
job.description:
What will you do?

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in any discipline (e.g., B.Sc, BE, B.Com, B.A).
  • 2–5 years of hands-on experience in eLearning development and design, preferably in a corporate learning environment.
  • Proven experience developing interactive eLearning courses using Articulate Storyline 360 and Articulate Rise.
  • A strong portfolio showcasing eLearning authoring, interaction design, and visual storytelling capabilities.

Skills

eLearning Authoring & Development

  • Strong expertise in Articulate Storyline 360 and Articulate Rise 360 for developing interactive and responsive learning experiences.
  • Experience creating custom menus, slides, interactions, variables, triggers, layers, states, and custom players.
  • Proficiency in HTML5, JavaScript and the ability to incorporate web-based elements into eLearning solutions.
  • Good understanding of Instructional Design principles and the ability to translate storyboards into effective digital learning experiences.

Design & Delivery

  • Ability to develop creative, engaging, and learner-centered courses aligned with defined learning objectives.
  • Strong troubleshooting and quality-checking skills across eLearning content, interactions, navigation, and course functionality.
  • Ability to optimize courses for usability, accessibility, performance, and compatibility across supported devices and browsers.
  • Experience publishing, packaging, testing, and deploying eLearning courses using standard formats such as SCORM.
  • Ability to manage feedback, revisions, and multiple development priorities while meeting tight deadlines.

Creative & Technical Skills

  • Ability to create compelling visual storytelling and interactive learning experiences.
  • Ability to generate effective creative prompts and use AI-assisted workflows to improve development speed and quality.
  • Attention to detail with a strong focus on consistency, accuracy, and learner experience

Soft Skills

  • Strong English communication skills (verbal and written).
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in cross-functional teams.
  • Problem-solving mindset with openness to feedback and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.

Preferred

  • Advanced knowledge of GenAI tools such as Copilot for Microsoft 365, ChatGPT, Storyline AI, or AI-assisted content development workflows.
  • Experience developing accessible eLearning content aligned with recognized accessibility standards.
  • Familiarity with graphics (Adobe Suite), audio, video (Vyond), animation, or other media-development tools used in eLearning production.
  • Basic knowledge of Digital Adoption Platforms (DAP) such as Whatfix and Navattic.
  • Exposure to learning management systems (Workday), course deployment, and testing in corporate learning environments.

job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

14 Oct 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Telstra Retail: Part Time Customer Service & Sales Consultant WERRIBEE

Job Summary

As a Retail Consultant, you will provide frontline support by assisting customers with product selection, service activation, and troubleshooting basic issues. You will create positive experiences through effective communication and adherence to retail standards. This role demonstrates foundational autonomy and contributes to customer satisfaction and store performance.

Job Description

Ready to Make a Difference? Join Our Iconic Team at Telstra!

At Telstra, we’re more than just a leading telecommunications company—we’re where passion meets purpose. As a Retail Customer Service & Sales Consultant, you’ll have the opportunity to work for an iconic Aussie brand that’s been connecting Australians for generations. You won’t just be a friendly face in-store—you’ll be the trusted expert who helps customers find tech solutions that enhance their lives. This is your chance to make a meaningful impact by bringing our purpose to life: to build a connected future so everyone can thrive.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Deliver Exceptional Customer Experiences: Help customers find the right products and services to suit their needs, ensuring their time at Telstra is a memorable one.
  • Be the Go-To Tech Expert: Stay up-to-date with the latest gadgets and services, offering informed guidance and solutions.
  • Achieve and Excel: Use your consultative selling skills to meet and exceed sales targets and KPIs, while keeping customers connected.
  • Collaborate and Contribute: Work closely with your team to create a welcoming environment where everyone is supported to achieve store goals.

Salary and Benefits:

  • Hourly Rate: $33.33 per hour

*Junior rates apply for those under 20 years of age.

Penalty rates are as follows: Additional 25% for weekday hours worked after 6 PM, 25% for hours worked on Saturday, 100% for hours worked on Sunday and 150% for hours worked on public holidays.*

  • Plus 12% Superannuation
  • Generous Discounts: Enjoy 30% off Telstra services and exclusive offers with over 240 brands and partners.
  • Leave Options: Take advantage of 16 weeks of paid parental leave, the Telstra Extra Day Off, gender affirmation leave, Cultural Leave, Blood Donor Leave, and the ability to purchase up to 4 weeks of additional leave.
  • Training & Career Growth Opportunities: Access over 17,000 learning programs through LinkedIn Learning and take advantage of a range of development opportunities designed to build your skills and support your career growth, helping you prepare for your next step.
  • Flexibility: We offer flexible working hours and a supportive approach to parental leave—do it your way!
  • Recognition & Rewards: Benefit from performance rewards and a range of recognition programs to celebrate your success.
  • Inclusive Culture: Join a diverse and inclusive team where everyone’s unique perspective is valued and respected.

Is It You We’re Looking For?

  • Great Communication Skills: You’re a natural at connecting with people and making their day better.
  • Solution-Oriented Approach: You enjoy thinking on your feet and tailoring solutions for each customer.
  • Sales Drive: You’re motivated to achieve (and exceed!) sales targets and KPIs.
  • Passion for Learning: You’re eager to grow and develop your skills in a dynamic environment.
  • Resilience and Positivity: You have a can-do attitude, even when things get busy.
  • Customer-Facing Experience: Previous experience is a plus but not required—bring your enthusiasm and we’ll teach you the rest!

How to Apply:

Ready to kickstart your journey with us? Click "Apply Now" to submit your application! After applying, keep an eye out for an email from our partner, HireVue, to complete the next step in our assessment process.

Join Us at Telstra Retail:

When you become part of the Telstra team, you’re joining a brand that celebrates diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone is respected, valued, and can thrive. We can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to our team!

Morayfield, Australia

Optus is one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, connecting more than 11 million customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital experiences that help people feel more connected.

We’re searching for positive, customer focused Retail Service Consultant to join our Morayfield team in a Part-Time capacity. If you love helping people, thrive in a supportive team environment, and bring energy to every conversation, we’d love to have you on board.

At Optus, you’ll feel connected to what truly matters. We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships, with our customers and with each other.

Your day to day:

  • Be the face of Optus, delivering standout customer experiences powered by optimism, curiosity and genuine care.

job.title: Director, Risk Governance & CSRO Secretariat
job.description:
Sydney, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband, and digital solutions.

At Optus, effective risk governance enables better decisions at pace, helping us navigate complexity, strengthen resilience and deliver transformation with confidence. We are seeking an experienced risk governance professional to own the end-to-end governance, reporting and secretariat relationship between the Office of the Chief Security & Risk Officer (CSRO), the Board, and its subcommittees, principally the Risk Committee and the Audit Committee.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility leadership role for someone who has mastered the craft of corporate governance and Board-level writing and communication, and who can operate with genuine urgency in a fast-moving, transformation-heavy environment. Working closely with the CSRO, EGM Integrated Risk & Controls Management (IRCM), Executive Committee members and key governance stakeholders, you will translate complex risk, culture and control i into clear, actionable and impactful material for the Board and its sub-committees.

**

What You’ll Do

  • Establish contemporary risk governance practices and forums for Optus Management and act as a trusted advisor and challenge function on governance practice across Optus, modern terms of reference, actionable risk intelligence, decision rights and escalation pathways.
  • Lead the end-to-end governance and secretariat function for the CSRO, coordinating papers, packs, minutes, actions and follow-up for the Risk and Audit Committees.
  • Own the preparation, review and quality assurance of Board and Committee papers, ensuring they are accurate, evidence-based and impactful, while maintaining strong document control.
  • Manage governance calendars, meeting agendas, action tracking and reporting deadlines, ensuring high-quality and timely stakeholder contributions.
  • Partner with the EGM, IRCM and CSRO to shape Board reporting on risk, culture, controls and governance initiatives.
  • Drive continuous improvement of governance processes, templates and reporting cadence in line with Optus’ governance transformation.
  • Coordinate risk reporting with Singtel Group, ensuring alignment of key messages, escalations and governance requirements.
  • Build trusted relationships and influence stakeholders across Risk, Audit, Compliance, Legal and Executive Committee where needed.

What makes you perfect for the role?

  • 10+ years' experience in corporate governance, risk governance, company secretariat or Chief of Staff-type roles supporting Group CRO, CEO, CSRO or equivalent C-suite executive, ideally in a regulated, listed or Board-governed environment.
  • Deep knowledge of Board and Board Committee governance practices, including papers, minutes, terms of reference, RACI and escalation protocols for Risk and Audit Committees.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to develop compelling Board and Executive-level material.
  • A genuine craft for corporate governance — meticulous attention to accuracy, structure, tone and evidentiary standard in everything produced for the Board. Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills and confidence engaging with C-suite leaders, Board members and governance teams.
  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities, tight deadlines and sensitive information with discretion and sound judgement.
  • Sound understanding of enterprise risk management, controls assurance and/or cyber and security risk concepts (highly regarded, not mandatory).
  • Experience supporting organisational transformation programs relating to risk, culture or governance uplift is highly valued.

**

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. The User Experience (UX) Designer champions the user perspective across all stages of the digital product lifecycle. This role leads and supports user research, facilitates design thinking activities, and creates intuitive, user‑centered digital experiences. Working in an agile environment, the UX Designer translates business objectives, user needs, and technical requirements into high‑quality designs that elevate customer and partner experiences and drive consistency across the organization.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating user experience design expertise.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication.

job.title: Senior Director, Enterprise Risk Management
job.description:
Sydney, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband, and digital solutions.

Optus is undergoing one of the most significant transformations in its history, bringing cyber, physical and enterprise risk together under a single integrated Security & Risk function. This is a rare opportunity for a seasoned enterprise risk leader to help shape the future of enterprise risk management in one of Australia's largest and most complex organisations.

We're looking for an accomplished risk governance leader who as Senior Director, Enterprise Risk Management will own the Risk Management Approach (RMA), Risk Management Framework (RMF), Risk Appetite Statement (RAS), Three Lines model, enterprise risk profile and risk culture agenda bringing people, process, accountability, governance and capability together into one coherent enterprise risk management system. You will shape how Optus understands its material risks, sets risk appetite, governs risk ownership, escalates emerging threats and reports the enterprise risk profile to Executive management and the Board.

The role carries genuine visibility and influence at the most senior levels of the organisation, with direct input into Executive Risk Committee and Board Risk Committee reporting. Success is measured by whether enterprise risk insight changes decisions, directs resources toward the highest exposures and produces demonstrable, measurable risk reduction in an environment where customer trust, network reliability, cyber security, privacy, regulatory confidence and critical service resilience are central to business performance.

**

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and continuously enhance Optus' enterprise risk management approach, ensuring it remains effective, practical and fit for purpose.
  • Own the enterprise Risk Appetite Statement, including key risk indicators, tolerances and escalation triggers that guide business decision-making.
  • Own the Three Lines model and ensure accountabilities, independent challenge, oversight and assurance operate effectively in practice.
  • Maintain and evolve the enterprise risk profile, risk taxonomy and risk register, providing a clear view of material and emerging risks.
  • Drive enterprise-wide risk assessments, scenario analysis and risk aggregation activities to identify priorities and inform strategic decisions.
  • Own the enterprise risk assessment methodology, including rating criteria and scales, and lead risk aggregation and scenario analysis across material and emerging risks.
  • Lead enterprise risk assessments across material risk categories and challenge the credibility of risk ratings, target states and management responses, with Line 2 Business Partners.
  • Own the enterprise risk culture agenda, including leadership expectations, behavioural measures, capability and interventions, using culture insights, incidents and issues to identify where organisational culture is enabling or inhibiting effective risk management.
  • Establish a clear emerging risk process, including thematic analysis and escalation, and drive consistency in risk assessment, rating, reporting and acceptance practices across the business.Create clear line of sight from material risk and appetite to gaps, remediation, investment priorities and residual exposure, driving prioritisation of people, process, control, system and capability improvements toward high exposures.
  • Produce the Enterprise Risk Profile and provide the EGM, CSRO, Executive Committee and Board with a forward-looking view of risk trajectory, movement and required intervention.
  • Support Executive risk owners to understand, assess and manage their material risks, and work closely with Non-Financial Risk Management, Controls Management & Assurance, Compliance, Cyber, Technology, Legal, Resilience and business teams.

**

What makes you perfect for the role?

  • Minimum 15 years’ experience in enterprise risk management, non-financial risk or risk transformation within banking, financial services, telecommunications, critical infrastructure or another complex regulated organisation.
  • Deep expertise in risk appetite, enterprise risk profiles, Three Lines of Defence models, risk culture and enterprise risk management architecture.
  • Proven ability to translate risk insights into business priorities, investment decisions and tangible risk reduction outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of risk governance, risk ownership and the ability to translate risk frameworks into practical business decision-making.
  • Significant Executive and Board reporting exposure, with confidence and judgement to challenge senior leaders constructively.
  • Ability to connect risk, controls, incidents, issues, obligations, customer outcomes and resilience into a single coherent narrative.
  • Experience in telecommunications, financial services, technology, energy, infrastructure, aviation, transport, government or other regulated sectors would be highly valued.

**

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.

job.title: Senior Director, Non-Financial Risk Management
job.description:
Sydney, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband, and digital solutions.

At Optus, we're building a modern, integrated Security & Risk function that brings together enterprise risk, cyber security, physical security and resilience to better protect our customers, people and business. This is a unique opportunity to join at a pivotal time and shape a best-in-class risk function and set the benchmark for how non-financial risk is managed across one of Australia's largest critical infrastructure organisations.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Director, Non-Financial Risk Management to report into the EGM, Integrated Risk and Controls Management and own the enterprise disciplines, RCSA, issues, incidents, risk acceptance, material change risk, and risk and control remediation that translate Optus’ Risk Management Approach into consistent, practical execution.

This is a high-impact role for an experienced NFR leader who can build the bridge between the enterprise risk framework and day-to-day management of risk across the business. You will set the standards, simplify the processes and hold the line on quality, so that risk is visible, controls are effective and remediation is disciplined. You will work across operational, technology, cyber, network, resilience, third-party, compliance, privacy, fraud and security domains to create consistency without adding bureaucracy, and you will drive standardised, contemporary risk practice disciplines and tooling that prioritises and address Optus’ highest exposures.

**

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Optus' enterprise approach to non-financial risk management, establishing standards, methodologies and best practices across the business.
  • Own and continuously improve core risk processes including RCSA, issues management, incident management, risk acceptance and material change assessments
  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of the enterprise RCSA program, scheduling cycles, facilitating self-assessments, aggregating results and quality-assuring outputs across business units.
  • Translate the enterprise Risk Management Approach (RMA) and Risk Appetite Statement (RAS) into practical, business-facing risk policies, standards and minimum requirements that can be consistently applied.
  • Set clear standards for issue severity rating, ownership, closure criteria, evidence and escalation, and for incident classification, root cause analysis and lessons learned.
  • Scope and conduct post-incident reviews (PIRs), leading independent root cause analysis and delivering actionable recommendations, and maintain the lessons-learnt repository for the organisation.
  • Partner with specialist risk teams and business leaders to embed consistent risk practices across technology, cyber, network, resilience, privacy, fraud and security domains.
  • Build practical NFR capability across the Three Lines of Defense through guidance, education and targeted uplift.
  • Support Executive and Board reporting on non-financial risk themes, issues, incidents, remediation, resilience and control environment trends.
  • Act as the enterprise architect for non-financial risk, designing the risk processes and practices that are built into Optus’ GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) platform — critical to enabling scalable, well-managed risk across the organisation.

**

What makes you perfect for the role?

  • Minimum 15 years’ experience in non-financial risk, operational risk, risk frameworks or controls within a large, complex organisation.
  • Deep expertise with RCSA, risk acceptance, incidents, issues management and control assessment, resilience practices, tooling and outcomes.
  • Proven success designing, implementing and simplifying enterprise risk standards, procedures and governance practices.
  • Strong understanding of risk management within highly regulated or critical infrastructure environments.
  • Ability to connect incidents, issues and control weaknesses to root causes and systemic management actions.
  • Experience scoping and leading independent post-incident reviews, with the rigour and objectivity to deliver credible root cause analysis and recommendations.
  • Exceptional stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to influence executives and translate complex risk concepts into practical business outcomes.
  • Experience in telecommunications, banking, financial services, energy, utilities or another highly regulated or critical infrastructure.

**

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.

job.description:

As a Senior Service Engineer, you will deliver advanced service, commissioning, and troubleshooting expertise for chiller systems in mission-critical data center environments. You will:

job.title: Tech Lead - Electrical Engineering
job.description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at [Trane Technologies](https://www.tranetechnologies.com/), and through our businesses including [Trane®](http://www.trane.com/index.html) and [Thermo King](http://www.thermoking.com/na/en.html), sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our [benefits](http://careers.tranetechnologies.com/global/en/benefits) designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.

Essential skills:

New Technology Projects (NTP), New Product Development, Productivity (VAVE), Q&R

  • Develop products by studying customer requirements and criteria
  • Proficient in Electrical Component Specifications, Selection, Analysis, Testing (Functional & Reliability) of followings:
  • Electrical Components: Contactor, Relay, Primary and Secondary Protection devices, Transformer
  • LV Motors (AC Induction, Brush DC, BLDC, Stepper, Servo, Permanent Magnet)
  • LV Motor Controllers (Drives, VFD, Inverter)
  • Design and development of control panels
  • Hands-on experience on UL and IEC STDs for Electrical system development & qualification
  • Responsible for developing Product Level Electrical design, Wiring & Harness Design
  • Work along with Multi-Disciplinary (Structural, Electronics, Software and Reliability) Team to develop System or Component Level Functional, Reliability & Qualification Requirements and Design
  • To Foster an Environment conducive for Innovation & Change with good Analytical Thinking and must make design trade-offs to ensure high reliability and best performance & low cost
  • Work closely with Supply Management to Source and Evaluate / Qualify the purchased Components and Assemblies
  • Make Tradeoff analysis of circuits and components with respect to performance, cost, quality and design flexibility
  • Manage multiple technical requirements in parallel as lead of the Electrical team
  • Mentor & Guide team members on technical areas
  • Good understanding of safety and protection standards and their implementation
  • Thorough understanding of various electrical codes and country standards
  • Knowledge in PLM and system level activities
  • Good Communication Skills – Ability to work with onsite Teams and engineers
  • Experience in hiring and leading contract resources & interns
  • Strong problem solving and analysis skills
  • Vendor identification, co-ordination and follow up
  • Knowledge in Electrical design tool – preferred
  • Developing strategic projects, and proof of concepts on futuristic cutting-edge technologies, towards future readiness
  • Diagnose electrical faults and identify root causes
  • Troubleshoot low‑voltage and line‑voltage electrical systems. Understand and interpret electrical schematics, diagrams, and blueprints
  • Assess system performance and detect issues. Test systems thoroughly and document results.
  • Perform testing and diagnostics using multimeters, megohmmeters, and other instruments
  • Strong understanding of electrical circuits, power electronics, and control systems
  • Familiarity with electrical failure modes (shorts, opens, drift, thermal stress, EMI/ESD issues)
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA) using tools such as 5 Whys, Fishbone diagrams, Fault tree analysis, Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA)

Experience/Skills and Education:

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in Electrical, Electronics, Power Electronics or related fields
  • Work experience: 11+ years in the relevant field of Electrical system development for HVAC and other Industrial products development for Global market
  • Experience in HVAC Electrical Systems, HVAC equipment and controls is desirable
  • Must be an innovative self-starter capable of setting and meeting goals and deadlines, and of making critical business decisions. Excellent communication and teamwork skills are necessary
  • Demonstrate intellectual curiosity and industrial awareness, capable of applying advanced approaches, technologies, and innovations in Electrical system development, and Decarbonization for organizational advancement
  • Experience in coaching & mentoring technical know-how to others is preferred.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. job.title: Asst Project Manager_DC
job.description:
What will you do:

As a Senior Service Engineer, you will deliver advanced service, commissioning, and troubleshooting expertise for chiller systems in mission-critical data center environments. You will:

  • Perform service, preventive maintenance, and corrective repairs on Air-Cooled and Water-Cooled Chillers, including screw, scroll, and centrifugal systems.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control-related issues in chiller and HVAC systems.
  • Conduct chiller start-up, commissioning, performance testing, and system optimization.
  • Manage site execution for data center cooling projects, including planning, installation oversight, and coordination with contractors and OEM teams.
  • Support upgrades, retrofits, and energy-efficiency improvements in existing cooling infrastructure.
  • Review technical drawings, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, submittals, and project documents for accuracy and compliance.
  • Maintain detailed service reports, performance logs, and equipment documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with safety standards, regulatory requirements, and customer-specific operational protocols.
  • Provide technical mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
  • Interface regularly with customers to provide updates, clarify technical issues, and ensure timely project and service completion.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis and implement corrective/preventive actions.
  • Collaborate with internal teams including sales, engineering, and project management to ensure seamless service delivery.
  • Submit RCA and 8D reports in a timely manner.
  • Attend Monthly MOR and Quarterly QBR meetings with data center clients.

What you will bring: (Skills & Competencies)

  • Strong expertise in Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, ideally in data center environments.
  • Deep understanding of refrigeration cycles, HVAC controls, BMS/EMS integration, and redundancy concepts.
  • Proficiency in diagnosing mechanical, electrical, and controls issues using diagnostic tools and software.
  • Ability to interpret wiring diagrams, technical drawings, P&IDs, and OEM manuals.
  • Strong communication skills to operate effectively in mission‑critical customer environments.
  • Sound knowledge of safety standards and best practices.
  • Strong problem-solving capability and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical data centers or large industrial cooling systems.
  • OEM-specific training or certifications (Trane, Carrier, Daikin) preferred.
  • Knowledge of energy-efficiency programs, retrofits, and performance optimization.
  • Project management experience or certification is a plus.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. job.description:

In this role you will:

  • Develop and implement complex control algorithm models to perform transient analysis, supporting key strategic areas like advanced control optimization, electrification and decarbonization, power electronics, HVAC units, building management and data centers.
  • Demonstrate good understanding of software engineering concepts, Model based development for controls, auto code generation, etc. Apply this expertise to develop and analyze control system models for HVAC equipments.
  • Participate in long term technology roadmap development discussions and help build new external partnerships for Trane Technologies.
  • Work with internal and external partners in technical execution of short & long term externally funded new technology, & new product development projects.
  • Work closely with global team members, cross-functional associates and internal customers in dynamic environment, to understand the implications of modeling results and drive system level optimization and answer critical design questions through modeling results.
  • Lead the evaluation of new and innovative technologies as they appear for potential commercial value, either as disruptive competition or prospective new products or services for the company.
  • Develop and communicate clear understanding of customer requirements and meet or exceed those expectations.
  • Conceptualize & develop project ideas leading to new advanced capability development in related domain areas to keep Trane Technologies to the leading edge of technology.
  • Network across the organization and externally to identify and communicate opportunities to apply controls modelling, system modeling and simulation to product design, applications & processes.
  • Develop team, competencies and skillset in Controls modelling, algorithms development for HVAC and transport refrigeration systems.
  • Developing strategic projects, and proof of concepts on futuristic cutting-edge technologies, towards future readiness.

What you will bring:

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, or related fields.
  • Work experience: 8+ years in the relevant field of Matlab/Simulink for Model Based Development.
  • Experience with Auto Code Generation.
  • Experience in software development best practices, including version control (e.g., Git), and agile methodologies.
  • Good knowledge of control systems with practical experience in closed-loop control.
  • Experience with Model In-Loop (MIL) and Hardware In-Loop (HIL) simulation.
  • Emphasis on computer programming or related experience is beneficial, particularly in C, C++ and Python.
  • Experience and knowledge in advanced nonlinear control disciplines such as adaptive or variable structure/sliding mode control, intelligent control schemes such as neural networks or fuzzy logic control.
  • Understanding reinforcement learning, machine learning, and predictive maintenance is desirable.
  • Experience in HVAC systems modeling, building energy management systems, or HVAC equipment and controls is desirable
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically and creatively.
  • Experience with CUDA and GPU Computing is a plus.
  • Understanding of Containers, HPC and Cloud technologies is a plus.
  • Expertise in communication protocols such as CAN, MODBUS, and EtherCAT is preferred.
  • Must be an innovative self-starter capable of setting and meeting goals and deadlines, and of making critical business decisions. Excellent communication and teamwork skills are necessary.
  • Demonstrate intellectual curiosity and industrial awareness, capable of applying advanced approaches, technologies, and innovations in modeling and simulation for organizational advancement.
  • Knowledge in Model Based System Engineering (MBSE) on controls development is plus.
  • Experience in coaching & mentoring technical know-how to others is preferred

job.title: Salesforce Delivery Leader
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Salesforce Delivery Strategy & POD Oversight

  • Provide governance and direction to multiple Salesforce PODs within the Bangalore Global Practice.
  • Ensure each POD delivers against milestones, velocity expectations, and quality KPIs.
  • Define and enforce global delivery and architectural standards aligned with Trane Technologies’ Salesforce guidelines, including Apex, LWC, Flows, integrations, and platform security.
  • Own sandbox strategy and release governance, ensuring stable and repeatable deployments through CI/CD pipelines such as Copado, Gearset, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions.
  • Act as the top-level escalation point for delivery risks, technical bottlenecks, integration issues, and architectural challenges.

##

2. Operational Excellence & P&L Accountability

  • Manage the financial performance of Salesforce delivery in Bangalore, ensuring productivity, budget adherence, and predictable margins.
  • Establish robust reporting mechanisms (weekly and monthly) providing insight on sprint performance, velocity, technical debt, and resource utilization.
  • Support Trane Technologies’ innovation roadmap by driving adoption of Salesforce advancements such as Salesforce AI/Einstein, Data Cloud, DevOps Center, and automation tools.

##

3. Stakeholder & Client Management

  • Serve as a senior delivery leader representing the Bangalore practice for global stakeholders.
  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with cross-functional business partners, product owners, and global delivery teams.
  • Partner with Sales and Solution Architects to assess feasibility, estimate complex Salesforce work, and support global pre‑sales initiatives.

##

4. People Leadership & Mentorship

  • Lead, coach, and develop POD Leads, Technical Architects, Senior Developers, and Analysts.
  • Drive career development, technical upskilling, and continuous learning within the Bangalore Salesforce talent community.
  • Facilitate knowledge-sharing and promote engineering excellence, focusing on areas like Apex best practices, LWC, Integration Patterns, Flow Orchestration, and platform governance.

Experience

  • 17+ years of total IT experience, with 10+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience in development, analysis, architecture, and delivery leadership.
  • Proven expertise in Apex, LWC, Aura Components, Integration Patterns, and platform security.
  • Strong background in translating complex business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Minimum of 5 years leading multi-disciplinary delivery teams or PODs in a global delivery model.
  • Deep experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies tailored to Salesforce delivery.
  • Strong financial acumen with experience handling P&L, forecasting, and resource planning.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across geographies.

Desired Skills

  • Ability to align Bangalore Salesforce delivery operations with Trane Technologies’ global roadmap and strategic priorities.
  • Experience driving organizational change and adoption of new Salesforce tools and delivery frameworks.
  • Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills, particularly in high-stakes or time-sensitive environments.
  • A passion for emerging Salesforce technologies and continuous improvement.

job.title: Embedded Software Architect
job.description:
What you will do

  • Provide technical leadership and architectural direction for telematics firmware development.
  • Manage a team of Software Engineers developing Embedded software. This will involve understanding the requirements and driving across various software development life cycle.
  • Define overall system and firmware architecture, including hardware abstraction, OS configuration, connectivity modules, and application layers.
  • Drive firmware roadmap, platform modularization, and long‑term architectural strategy.
  • Responsible for delivering software releases for new products and enhancing existing products.
  • Collaborate closely with hardware, cloud, and product teams to align system requirements and interface specifications.
  • Architect, design, and develop embedded systems and modular software applications in C, Rust for Embedded Linux platforms
  • Develop multithreaded applications and libraries for embedded systems, ensuring efficiency and scalability.
  • Oversee firmware performance optimization, memory management, bootloader strategy, and power‑management architectures.
  • Identify and suggest improvements for products and its quality.
  • Work on new product development, new technology initiatives & productivity improvements.
  • Establish coding standards, architectural guidelines, and best practices for embedded Linux development.
  • Conduct design reviews, risk assessments, and feasibility studies.
  • Support security architecture including secure boot, OTA firmware updates, and data protection.
  • Serve as a technical mentor to firmware engineering teams.

**

What you will bring:

  • Experience in design and development of an Embedded Systems.
  • Expert knowledge in developing modular application software using C for an Embedded Linux system.
  • Experience in writing multithreaded application software’s and libraries for Embedded Linux system.
  • Strong expertise in embedded Linux, including kernel configuration, device drivers, BSP creation, and system services.
  • Experience with ARM-based microprocessors and SoCs.
  • Good knowledge of Hardware/Software interfaces and reading schematics.
  • Experience in communication interfaces like CAN, RS232, I2C, SPI, Bluetooth/BLE & GSM AT Commands.
  • Experience in standard automotive communication protocols like J1939.
  • Experience in using various tools like static code analysis, run time debugging tools like GDB & memory debugging tools like Valgrind.
  • Experience in managing cross functional stakeholders.
  • Experience in release planning and executions.
  • An innovative approach to improve processes and solve problems.
  • Good working knowledge in agile-based product development methodology.

job.title: Technical Lead – Applied Mechanics
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute structural and FEA simulations for Thermo King components and systems across truck, trailer, bus, rail, and marine applications.
  • Analyze static, dynamic, fatigue, and vibrational loads that reflect real-world harsh transport conditions, including road-induced vibration, shock, mounting stresses, and thermal structural interactions.
  • Build high-fidelity finite element models for complex assemblies such as compressors, frames, mounts, enclosures, brackets, refrigerant line supports, and other mechanical subsystems within Thermo King units.
  • Provide clear, actionable design recommendations to global engineering teams to improve durability, manufacturability, reliability, and weight efficiency.
  • Partner with Reliability Engineering, Product Engineering, and Test Labs to align analysis assumptions with actual duty cycles, test profiles, and validation plans specific to transport refrigeration.
  • Develop and maintain simulation methods tailored for Thermo King’s dynamic, vibration, and shock‑load environments , including vibration durability, road load simulation, fatigue estimation, and structural integrity assessments.
  • Support new product development (NPD) programs with early-stage design evaluations and simulation-driven insights to accelerate development and reduce physical test iterations.
  • Prepare high-quality technical documentation summarizing analysis approach, boundary conditions, correlations, and engineering recommendations.
  • Contribute to capability growth within the Modeling & Simulation team through method development, knowledge-sharing, and informal mentoring of early career analysts.
  • Collaborate with global Thermo King stakeholders to understand program priorities, feasibility risks, and analysis needs.
  • Leverage experience with physical test techniques—such as single and multi-axes shaker table testing, accelerated life testing, strain measurement/strain gauging, and related methods—to improve model correlation and enhance simulation accuracy.
  • Provide technical leadership within projects, influencing decisions, guiding analysis strategies, and coordinating simulation activities across cross-functional teams (without formal people management).

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.
  • PhD will be a plus.
  • 8–12+ years of hands-on experience in structural/FEA analysis, ideally in automotive, off-highway, refrigeration, or transport-related industries.
  • Strong proficiency in FEA tools such as ANSYS, Abaqus, or similar platforms.
  • Solid grounding in mechanical behavior under vibration, impact/shock, fatigue, and nonlinear material/structural response.
  • Proven expertise building and validating complex models that correlate well with physical testing.
  • Ability to convert simulation results into clear engineering guidance for multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong communication, documentation, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Technical Background

  • Experience with mobile equipment or transport-related engineering (automotive, rail, off-road equipment, refrigeration units, etc.).
  • Familiarity with Thermo King product categories or similar ruggedized HVAC/transport cooling systems.
  • Exposure to vibration spectrum analysis, random vibration, harmonic response, and durability methodologies aligned with transport environments.
  • Experience with scripting (Python, APDL, etc.) to automate workflows or develop reusable modeling templates.
  • Understanding of thermal-structural coupled simulations or refrigerant system component behavior is a plus.
  • Experience with single and multi-axes shaker table testing, accelerated life testing, strain measurement/strain gauging, and related structural validation techniques.
  • Technical project leadership, task leadership, or cross-functional technical coordination experience.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly analytical with strong problem‑solving capability.
  • Self-driven, with the ability to manage work priorities independently.
  • Collaborative mindset with strong initiative to influence design improvements.
  • Proven ability to apply best‑practice approaches and engage in continuous learning.
  • Ability to lead technically within cross-functional programs and drive engineering clarity.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

job.title: Senior Data Scientist
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Analyze large, complex datasets to uncover trends, patterns, anomalies, and actionable business insights.
  • Design, develop, and deploy AI and GenAI applications that address business needs using machine learning, large language models, and intelligent workflow orchestration.
  • Build and optimize predictive, statistical, and time series models for business and operational use cases.
  • Develop robust data pipelines, ETL workflows, and feature engineering processes using SQL and Python to support AI/ML applications.
  • Lead Python-based application development for automation, data transformation, model integration, API development, and AI-powered workflows.
  • Develop LLM-powered solutions such as copilots, knowledge assistants, summarization tools, search-and-retrieval solutions, and domain-specific recommendation systems.
  • Apply Generative AI techniques including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), orchestration frameworks, grounding strategies, response evaluation, and workflow integration.
  • Prototype and productionize AI application architectures, including integrations with vector databases, model APIs, cloud services, and enterprise systems.
  • Contribute to the evaluation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI systems, including model quality, hallucination reduction, latency, cost, and user experience.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, analysts, domain experts, and business stakeholders to define, prioritize, and deliver AI-driven solutions.
  • Translate business problems into scalable AI/ML and GenAI use cases, technical designs, and implementation roadmaps.
  • Develop and enhance dashboards, reports, and BI solutions using Tableau where needed to support model insights and business decisions.
  • Ensure strong data quality, governance, security, compliance, and responsible AI practices across solution development and deployment.

Technical Skills/ Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, AI, or a related field; master’s degree or advanced certification preferred.

Global Salesforce Practice

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Technical Manager to lead technical delivery, grow team capability, and support the continued expansion of the CX Salesforce Practice at ITC, Trane Technologies. This role combines people leadership, solution development, and hands-on technical oversight across Salesforce core platform capabilities.

The ideal candidate brings 12+ years of overall experience with strong expertise in Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Apex, LWC, integrations, and Salesforce B2B Commerce. Job Description: The Analyst, SOX Compliance plays an important role in supporting the annual SOX compliance program for the organization under various regional SOX Leadership. This role is part of the Assurance & Advisory Services group and is based in Bangalore, India. The objective of the position is to support the Company’s annual SOX compliance program through testing controls for operating effectiveness, identifying and reporting control deficiencies, supporting and tracking remediation efforts with local management teams, and assisting with the annual control design assessment process.   • Supporting project management activities related to SOX initiatives, projects, and reporting requirements
  • Engage with process and control owners to identify opportunities for process improvement
  • Perform research or assessments to support continuous improvement of financial reporting processes
  • Serve as a business partner to management teams on compliance-related questions, interpretation of policies, internal control standards, and standard work instructions

  • Ability to travel 5–10%, including international travel preferred

Desired qualification :

job.title: Senior ICM Developer
job.description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced ICM Rule and Advanced Workflow Developer to support our SAP-based incentive compensation platform. This role plays a critical part in translating compensation plan design into system configuration, ensuring accurate payouts, strong governance, and efficient approval workflows. You will work closely with Sales Operations, HR, Finance, and IT teams to configure calculation rules, build scalable workflows, and support ongoing compensation processing.

Roles & responsibilities

  • Configure and maintain complex incentive compensation calculation rules within SAP
  • Translate plan documents into system logic including rate tables, tiered curves, accelerators, thresholds, caps, and clawbacks
  • Develop eligibility and crediting rules based on role, hierarchy, territory, and business unit
  • Support compensation cycles including accruals, adjustments, and final payouts
  • Troubleshoot calculation discrepancies and perform root cause analysis
  • Validate inbound data from HR, Finance, and operational systems
  • Design and configure multi-step approval workflows for plan assignments, exceptions, and manual adjustments
  • Implement conditional routing based on business attributes and compensation structures
  • Configure automated notifications and escalation triggers
  • Ensure workflows align with internal control and compliance requirements
  • Improve process efficiency by reducing manual intervention

What We’re Looking For

  • 3 to 6 years of experience working with SAP-based incentive compensation systems
  • Strong understanding of incentive plan design and payout mechanics
  • Hands-on experience configuring calculation rules and Advanced workflows
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable system logic
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, HR, Finance, and IT

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SAP HR or Finance integrations
  • Familiarity with compensation accrual and reconciliation processes
  • Background in Sales Operations or Compensation Operations

The Sales Manager – South India will be responsible for developing and growing Trane’s rental cooling & power business across the South India region. The role will focus on identifying new rental opportunities, developing strategic customer relationships, generating sales pipeline, converting opportunities into profitable rental contracts, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure successful mobilization and execution of rental projects.

The candidate will play a key role in establishing Trane Rentals as a preferred temporary and emergency cooling solutions provider across industries including data centres, pharmaceuticals, manufacturing, commercial buildings, infrastructure, healthcare, hospitality and other industrial applications.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales & Business Development

  • Develop and execute the rental sales strategy for South India.
  • Identify new customers, applications, industries and market opportunities for temporary cooling solutions.
  • Generate and maintain a healthy sales pipeline to achieve revenue and margin targets.
  • Drive the complete sales cycle from lead generation and opportunity qualification through proposal, negotiation and order closure.

2. Market Development

job.title: Core Technician
job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Service Engineer will be responsible for service, maintenance, troubleshooting, and commissioning of Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chiller systems in data centre environments. The role also includes supporting and executing data centre HVAC projects, ensuring timely delivery, quality compliance, and seamless customer communication. This position requires deep technical expertise in chiller operations, system optimization, and data centre cooling infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform service, preventive maintenance, and corrective actions on Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, including screw, scroll, and centrifugal systems.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control-related issues in chiller and HVAC systems.
  • Conduct chiller start-up, commissioning, performance testing, and system optimization.
  • Manage site execution for data center cooling projects, including planning, installation oversight, and coordination with contractors and OEM teams.
  • Support upgrades, retrofits, and energy‑efficiency improvements in existing data centre cooling infrastructure.
  • Review technical drawings, submittals, and project documents for accuracy and compliance.
  • Maintain detailed service reports, performance logs, and documentation for all equipment.
  • Ensure strict adherence to safety standards, regulatory requirements, and customer operational protocols.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
  • Interface with customers regularly to provide updates, clarify technical issues, and ensure completion of service and project tasks.
  • Participate in root‑cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues.
  • Coordinate with internal teams (sales, project management, engineering) for seamless service and project delivery.
  • Timely submission of Root cause analysis & 8D reports to customers
  • Monthly MOR, Quarterly QBR meetings required to be attended with DC customers

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or relevant technical field.
  • 5–10 years of hands-on experience servicing Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, preferably in data centre applications.
  • Strong knowledge of refrigeration cycles, HVAC controls, BMS/EMS integration, and cooling redundancy concepts.
  • Experience in project execution, installation supervision, and commissioning of HVAC equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and equipment manuals.
  • Proficient in diagnosing mechanical, electrical, and control faults using service tools and diagnostic software.
  • Strong customer communication skills and ability to work in critical data centre environments.
  • Familiarity with safety standards and industry best practices.
  • Good problem‑solving skills and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with mission‑critical data centres or large industrial cooling systems.
  • OEM-specific chiller training or certifications (e.g., Trane, Carrier, Daikin).
  • Knowledge of energy‑efficiency programs, retrofits, and system performance optimization.
  • Project management experience or certification is a plus.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

job.title: Rental - Site/Depot Engineer-1
job.description:
Role purpose

Ensure safe, reliable, and timely deployment of rental cooling equipment while maximizing fleet availability and delivering excellent customer support at project sites.

Key responsibilities

Fleet readiness

  • Inspect, test and certify rental chillers before dispatch.
  • Carry out preventive maintenance and repairs on chillers, pumps and accessories.
  • Maintain service records, checklists and equipment history.

Mobilization & installation

  • Supervise loading, unloading and site positioning of equipment.
  • Install chillers, pumps, hoses, cables and temporary cooling systems.
  • Commission equipment and verify performance before handover.

Breakdown & emergency support

  • Attend emergency breakdowns across India (24×7 rotation).
  • Diagnose electrical, refrigeration and control system faults.
  • Restore equipment within agreed response times.

Demobilization

  • Decommission equipment safely.
  • Inspect returned equipment and prepare refurbishment reports.
  • Coordinate with warehouse for fleet restoration.

EHS & compliance

  • Follow Trane safety standards, LOTO and permit-to-work procedures.
  • Conduct site risk assessments before installation.
  • Ensure statutory compliance during lifting and electrical work.

Customer support

  • Train customer operators on basic operation.
  • Provide daily service reports and performance updates.
  • Maintain high customer satisfaction during rental projects.

Required qualifications

  • Diploma/B.Tech in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
  • 2–5 years of experience in chillers, HVAC or rental equipment.
  • Experience with air-cooled/water-cooled chillers, pumps and electrical panels.
  • Knowledge of refrigeration circuits and PLC-based controls is preferred.

Skills

  • Chiller troubleshooting
  • Electrical fault diagnosis
  • Refrigeration servicing
  • Pump & hydronic systems
  • Commissioning and testing
  • Customer communication
  • MS Office & digital service reporting

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

job.title: Sr. AI, ML Research Engineer-1
job.description:
Sr. AI / ML Research Engineer

Description - External

At Trane Technologies and through our businesses including Trane and Thermo King, we create innovative climate solutions for buildings, homes, and transportation that challenge what’s possible for a sustainable world. We’re a team that dares to look at the world’s challenges and see impactful possibilities. We believe in a better future when we uplift others and enable our people to thrive at work and at home. We boldly go.

We are seeking a Sr. AI / ML Research Engineer to help build next-generation physics-based AI capabilities for fluid and thermal systems. This role is ideal for a candidate who combines deep expertise in computational fluid dynamics, scientific computing, and modern machine learning to accelerate simulation, design optimization, and digital engineering workflows.

The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience applying physics-informed neural networks, neural operators, surrogate modeling, reduced-order modeling, and related scientific ML methods to real engineering problems. They will work across research and product teams to translate advanced methods into robust, production-oriented solutions that improve simulation speed, fidelity, and decision-making.

What’s in it for you

Be a part of our mission!

As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient environments, it is our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. If you want to apply advanced AI to high-impact engineering systems and help define the future of physics-based product development, we invite you to join us.

In this role, you will

  • Develop and apply AI/ML methods for CFD and multi-physics simulation problems, especially in fluid flow, heat transfer, turbulence, and system-level thermal management.
  • Build physics-informed neural networks and related scientific ML approaches for forward modeling, inverse problems, parameter estimation, data assimilation, and hybrid simulation workflows.
  • Create surrogate and reduced-order models that accelerate high-fidelity simulation while preserving engineering accuracy.
  • Apply Design of Experiments methods to simulation campaigns, data generation strategies, sensitivity analysis, and efficient exploration of high-dimensional design spaces.
  • Work with structured and unstructured simulation data from commercial and open-source solvers such as ANSYS Fluent, STAR-CCM+, OpenFOAM, Moldflow, or similar platforms.
  • Design training, validation, and benchmarking workflows for scientific ML models using both simulated and experimental datasets.
  • Partner with domain experts, software engineers, and product teams to deploy research into usable tools and scalable engineering workflows.
  • Partner with external vendors and strategic technology providers to evaluate, adapt, and transition advanced AI/ML solutions into scalable in-house capabilities and engineering workflows.
  • Contribute to technical strategy in physics AI, scientific machine learning, model validation, and engineering optimization.
  • Communicating results clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders and support adoption across the organization.

What you will bring

Required qualifications

  • PhD or MTech in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, or a closely related field with strong emphasis on CFD or computational science.
  • Strong foundation in computational fluid dynamics, numerical methods for PDEs, turbulence modeling, and heat transfer.
  • Demonstrated experience applying physics-informed neural networks or related methods to engineering or scientific computing problems.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and experience with scientific ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.
  • Experience building end-to-end ML workflows including data preparation, training, evaluation, hyperparameter tuning, and model deployment.
  • Experience working in Linux and HPC environments, including parallel computing and GPU-based training (desirable).
  • Strong understanding of model verification, validation, uncertainty, and physical consistency in engineering applications.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across research and engineering teams.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with neural operators, operator learning, graph neural networks, geometric deep learning, differentiable simulation, or hybrid physics-ML modeling.
  • Experience integrating AI models with CFD solvers, optimization frameworks, or digital twin platforms.
  • Knowledge of Design of Experiments, design optimization, Bayesian optimization, inverse design, or control for thermal-fluid systems.
  • Familiarity with geometry/mesh pipelines, simulation automation, workflow orchestration, and injection molding or Moldflow-style simulation workflows.
  • Track record of publications, patents, or production deployments in scientific ML, CFD, or physics-based AI.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

Job Summary

The Junior OT Security Engineer supports the Operational Technology (OT) Security program by assisting in the management, monitoring, and continuous improvement of security technologies that protect manufacturing and industrial environments.

This role is focused on foundational OT cybersecurity operations, execution of Run & Maintain (R&M) activities, and maintaining strong asset visibility across OT environments. The engineer will work under the guidance of senior OT engineers to execute operational tasks, improve data quality, and help sustain OT security controls at scale.

This position plays a critical role in maintaining the health, accuracy, and reliability of OT security platforms and metrics, ensuring the program continues to mature and operate effectively.

Responsibilities

  • Support daily operations of OT security technologies, with a primary focus on OT asset visibility and detection platform, maintenance, and data quality
  • Execute Run & Maintain (R&M) activities, including device classification, asset reconciliation, exception handling, and rule tuning
  • Assist with maintaining high-quality OT asset inventory
  • Perform basic troubleshooting for discovery configurations, integrations, and platform health issues, escalating as needed
  • Monitor OT security alerts, identify anomalies, and support investigation and escalation processes
  • Support ongoing improvement of OT metrics (e.g., asset designation, collector health, visibility gaps) through continuous data cleanup and validation
  • Assist with onboarding new sites, validating OT asset inventory, and supporting enforcement or audit readiness activities

  • Partner with OT Administrators, Network Engineering, and Security Engineering teams to support secure and stable OT environments
  • Participate in OT Office Hours and assist site teams with operational questions and issue resolution
  • Support improvements, changes, and configurations to our security suite.
  • Provide backup and support for other security capabilities managed by the Security Engineering Team.
  • Manage and track security metrics to be included in Monthly Operating Reviews (MORs), Project Status Reviews (PSRs), and workshops.
  • Up to 10% travel required based on business and project needs, including visits to manufacturing and distribution sites.

Required Qualifications and Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 1–3 years of experience in cybersecurity, IT operations, or a related technical discipline
  • Foundational understanding of networking concepts, including:IP addressing, subnets, routing, and switching fundamentals
  • VLANs and network segmentation concepts (especially IT vs OT separation)
  • Firewall rules and how traffic flows between systems

Preferred Qualifications and Competencies:

  • Basic troubleshooting skills for connectivity issues (e.g., device communication failures, segmentation impacts)
  • Understanding of how asset discovery tools use network traffic and integrations to identify devices
  • Exposure to OT/ICS environments or manufacturing systems
  • Familiarity with asset discovery, monitoring, or security tools (e.g Armis, Claroty, Dragos, and Nozomi)
  • Experience supporting operational platforms or infrastructure tools
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly with asset data, classification, and system accuracy
  • Ability to follow defined processes and execute repeatable operational tasks with consistency
  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills for troubleshooting and data validation
  • Effective communication and collaboration across IT, OT, and security teams
  • Willingness to learn OT-specific technologies, environments, and security practices
