job.title: Senior Engineer
job.description:
Summary

The Modeling & Simulation team is seeking a highly skilled and collaborative Senior Engineer – Acoustics to lead advanced predictive modeling efforts. In this role, you will apply state-of-the-art numerical methodologies to solve complex noise and vibration challenges across our diverse product portfolios.

The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise spanning both vibro-acoustics and aero-acoustics. This role requires a unique balance of rigorous engineering execution alongside a global perspective—focusing on commonizing acoustic methodologies and simulation standards across different regional engineering teams to meet varying regional customer and regulatory requirements.

.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced Modeling & Simulation: Develop, validate, and execute high-fidelity numerical models to predict and optimize the acoustic performance of HVAC systems, transport refrigeration units, and components (such as compressors, fans, structures, and air handlers).

ü Aero-Acoustics & Fluid-Structure Interaction: Conduct Computational Aero-Acoustics (CAA) simulations to predict flow-induced noise, fan noise, and turbulence-driven acoustic phenomena.

ü Vibro-Acoustics & Structural Dynamics: Analyze structural-acoustic coupling, structure-borne noise transmission, and vibration propagation using Finite Element Method (FEM) and Boundary Element Method (BEM) solvers.

ü Regional Commonization & Standards: Champion efforts to standardize and commonize acoustics simulation methodologies globally. Collaborate with international design centers to harmonize workflows while addressing varying regional regulations and market requirements.

ü Experimental Correlation: Collaborate closely with physical testing laboratories to design validation tests, analyze dynamic measurement data (sound power, vibration, modal testing), and correlate experimental results with simulation models.

ü Design Optimization: Partner with product development teams to provide actionable, physics-based design recommendations early in the development cycle to reduce noise and enhance sound quality.

ü Innovation: Keep abreast of emerging simulation technologies, and drive continuous improvement in simulation capability and speed.

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree (M.S./M.Tech) in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Acoustics, or a highly related technical discipline.
  • PhD will be a plus.
  • 3–5+ years of hands-on industrial experience in acoustics modeling and simulation..
  • Knowledge in Acoustics and noise control (specific to HVAC products is desirable).
  • Should be able to perform Acoustics (Aero/Vibro) simulations, with emphasis on fan/blowers.
  • Good depth in CFD (or) FEA with experience in performing simulations is an added advantage
  • Hands-on experience on Acoustics/CFD/FEA tool preferably Actran, ANSYS Mechanical, Fluent, CFX, or Simcenter.
  • Theoretical knowledge of Acoustics, Numerical methods, Fluid dynamics and FEA.
  • Experience in Acoustics testing is desirable.
  • Experience in the HVAC industry is desirable.
  • Knowledge of AI/ML, IIOT and digital twin is preferred.
  • Strong teamwork, interpersonal, communication, and project management skills required.
  • Knowledge of programming languages and proven examples of improving productivity using various scripts.
  • Ability to work in a matrix team environment for the common objectives
  • Be part of org initiatives and contribute to ensure progressive, diverse and inclusive environment imbibing Trane values and culture.

.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly analytical with strong problem‑solving capability.
  • Self-driven, with the ability to manage work priorities independently.
  • Collaborative mindset with strong initiative to influence design improvements.
  • Proven ability to apply best‑practice approaches and engage in continuous learning.
  • Ability to lead technically within cross-functional programs and drive engineering clarity.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

job.title: Service Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Service Engineer will be responsible for service, maintenance, troubleshooting, and commissioning of Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chiller systems in data center environments. The role also includes supporting and executing data center HVAC projects, ensuring timely delivery, quality compliance, and seamless customer communication. This position requires deep technical expertise in chiller operations, system optimization, and data center cooling infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform service, preventive maintenance, and corrective actions on Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, including screw, scroll, and centrifugal systems.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control-related issues in chiller and HVAC systems.
  • Conduct chiller start-up, commissioning, performance testing, and system optimization.
  • Manage site execution for data center cooling projects, including planning, installation oversight, and coordination with contractors and OEM teams.
  • Support upgrades, retrofits, and energy‑efficiency improvements in existing data centre cooling infrastructure.
  • Review technical drawings, submittals, and project documents for accuracy and compliance.
  • Maintain detailed service reports, performance logs, and documentation for all equipment.
  • Ensure strict adherence to safety standards, regulatory requirements, and customer operational protocols.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.

job.title: Data Engineering Analyst
job.description:
The Role

Trane Technologies is seeking a Data Engineering Analyst to join our ISC Data Architecture & Governance team based in Bangalore, India. This is a hands-on role for a candidate who can build scalable data engineering pipelines, analyze legacy systems and workflows, and help modernize our data landscape on Google Cloud Platform.

In this role, you will be responsible for ingesting data from internal and external sources into our enterprise data lake, with a strong focus on the bronze layer of a medallion architecture. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data analysts, and technical teams to gather requirements, clarify business logic, support testing, and design practical solutions that improve reliability, usability, and scalability.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical data engineering skills with the ability to work independently, determine next steps, and communicate effectively with customers and stakeholders throughout the solution lifecycle.

This role is based in our Bangalore, India corporate office and reports directly to the Data Architecture & Governance Manager for ISC.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, integrations, and ETL/ELT workflows on Google Cloud Platform using BigQuery, Airflow, and Cloud Data Fusion.
  • Ingest data from internal and external sources into the enterprise data lake, with primary ownership of the bronze layer within a medallion architecture.
  • Analyze legacy systems, databases, workflows, and transformation logic to understand current-state processes, dependencies, and opportunities for modernization.
  • Document current-state data flows and system behavior and develop recommendations for process improvement, architecture simplification, and legacy-to-cloud modernization.
  • Use strong SQL skills to analyze source data, validate transformations, understand embedded business logic, and support data analysts with trusted datasets.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and internal customers to gather requirements, clarify needs, support testing, and translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
  • Work independently to identify next steps, resolve technical and process issues, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality data solutions.
  • Apply data quality, governance, documentation, and security standards while continuously improving pipeline reliability, scalability, and performance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering, cloud data platforms, data integration, or related roles.
  • Hands-on experience building data pipelines in Google Cloud Platform.
  • Strong working knowledge of BigQuery, Cloud Composer, and Cloud Data Fusion.
  • Strong SQL skills, including the ability to analyze legacy systems, investigate data issues, validate transformations, and support analytics users.
  • Knowledge of Python and Data Engineering packages such as PySpark and Airflow
  • Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and semi-structured data.
  • Familiarity with data lake concepts and medallion architecture, especially bronze-layer ingestion patterns.
  • Familiarity with data governance, metadata, lineage, and data quality practices.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and self-management skills.
  • Experience working in cross-functional or global teams.
  • Google Cloud certifications are a plus.

**

What You Will Bring

  • A hands-on engineering mindset with the ability to move from analysis to design to delivery.
  • Strong curiosity and comfort working through ambiguity in legacy environments.
  • The ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
  • A proactive, self-directed approach to identifying priorities and driving work forward.
  • A passion for building scalable, maintainable data solutions that support business value.

At Trane Technologies, we offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs that help our employees thrive in both their professional and personal lives. We are proud of our winning culture, which is inclusive and respectful at its core. We share a passion for serving customers, caring for others, and boldly challenging what’s possible for a sustainable world.

We are committed to achieving workforce diversity reflective of our communities. We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

job.title: Engineer - Customer Interaction Suite
job.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Automation Test Engineer / Quality Engineer with strong technical expertise in web and API automation, complete test lifecycle ownership, and a deep understanding of Agile methodologies.

The ideal candidate will play an integral role in the product development lifecycle, working closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to ensure that every release meets the highest quality standards through automation, continuous testing, and data-driven validation.

Key Responsibilities:**

1. Test Strategy and Planning

Define and implement comprehensive test strategies and test plans aligned with product requirements, user stories, and sprint goals.

  • Create detailed test cases, test data, and test environments for functional, regression, integration, load, and automation testing.
  • Perform complete test lifecycle activities including requirement analysis, test design, test execution, defect management, and test closure reporting.
  • Ensure traceability between user stories, test cases, and defects.

2. Automation Framework Design and Maintenance

Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for both Web UI and API services using tools like Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, RestAssured, or Postman/Newman.

  • Develop reusable automation scripts and integrate them within the CI/CD pipeline to enable continuous testing.
  • Configure and maintain automated test execution as part of the merge and deployment process to validate builds in lower and higher environments.
  • Implement version control and review mechanisms for automation code using Git-based repositories.
  • Track automation coverage and integrate reports with dashboards for visibility.

3. Collaboration and Agile Delivery

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

  • Work closely with developers during sprints to clarify acceptance criteria and ensure early detection of defects.
  • Collaborate with developers during debugging sessions and reproduce defects effectively with detailed logs and evidence.
  • Participate in user story creation and refinement using BDD and Gherkin syntax, ensuring test coverage and acceptance criteria are clear and measurable.
  • Contribute to Test Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior Driven Development (BDD) initiatives to improve code quality and reliability.

4. Testing Types and Execution

Execute different forms of testing including sanity testing, regression testing, hotfix validation, load and performance testing, and full automation testing.

  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and help implement preventive measures.
  • Conduct end-to-end testing across multiple environments and integrations.
  • Ensure quality gates are met before each release.

5. CI/CD Integration and Tooling

Integrate test automation with CI/CD systems like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.

  • Configure automated build validation, smoke test runs, and regression tests during deployment pipelines.
  • Manage environment setup for test execution including containerized test environments using Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Use monitoring tools to track build health and test results.

6. Data and Database Validation

Perform data validation and integrity testing across systems involving both RDBMS and document-based storage.

  • Work with databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB for test data creation, verification, and validation of business logic.
  • Write SQL and NoSQL queries to validate backend data consistency and performance.

7. Release and Quality Governance

Participate in release management processes and coordinate test readiness before deployment.

  • Provide test summary reports and present quality metrics in release readiness meetings.
  • Conduct release demos to product and business teams, showcasing test results and automation coverage.
  • Ensure quality compliance and documentation for all production releases.

Required Skills and Experience

2–4 years of strong hands-on experience in test automation for web and API-based systems.

  • Proficiency in programming languages ; Java, TypeScript, or JavaScript.
  • Hands-on experience with automation frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or RestAssured ( With Selenium and Playwright being mandatory )

Deep understanding of Agile practices and ceremonies.

  • Proven experience collaborating with large, cross-functional teams, developers, and DevOps engineers.
  • Knowledge of BDD tools like Cucumber, SpecFlow, or Behave with Gherkin syntax.
  • Familiarity with TDD approaches and integration with CI/CD systems.
  • Practical experience in integrating test automation with tools such as Jenkins, GitLab, or GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or Xray.
  • Exposure to load and performance testing tools like JMeter, Locust, or LoadRunner.
  • Strong database skills in both RDBMS and NoSQL systems (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in a product-based company with end-to-end ownership of testing and automation processes.

  • Familiarity with API mocking and simulation tools like Postman, WireMock, or Swagger.
  • Experience executing automated tests in cloud-based test platforms such as BrowserStack or Sauce Labs for browser compatiblity

Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple priorities with attention to detail.

Required Skills

  • playwright
  • selenium
  • rest assured
  • api testing
  • typescript
  • javascript
  • load testing

job.description:
Job Title: F5 Load Balancer - Level 3 Engineer

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced F5 Load Balancer L3 Engineer to manage, maintain, and optimize network load balancing infrastructure. This role is crucial to ensure high availability, performance, and security of applications delivered through F5 technologies. As an L3 engineer, you will work on complex troubleshooting, configuration, and implementation tasks, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless service delivery.

Responsibilities

  • F5 Load Balancer Administration:
  • Implementation and manage F5 load balancers (LTM, GTM, ASM, APM modules).
  • Develop and implement F5 profiles, rules and policies to meet business requirements.
  • Maintain, upgrade, and troubleshoot F5 infrastructure to ensure uptime and reliability.
  • Analyze logs and performance data to proactively identify and resolve issues.
  • Implement health checks and failover strategies to ensure high availability of applications.

Firewall Administration:

  • Network Security
  • Manage Checkpoint/Cisco ASA firewalls
  • Provide support for firewalls

Troubleshooting:

  • Serve as the Level 3 (L3) escalation point for resolving complex network and application-related issues.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve connectivity, traffic flow, and application performance issues involving F5 products.

Collaboration:

  • Work closely with network engineers and application teams to ensure alignment on load balancing requirements.
  • Collaborate on security compliance audits and assessments related to load balancing and traffic management.

Security:

  • Implement security measures such as SSL offloading, web application firewalls (WAF), and DDoS protection on F5 devices.
  • Stay updated on the latest security threats and ensure configurations are optimized to mitigate risks.

Documentation:

  • Create and maintain documentation for F5 configurations, processes, and network architecture.
  • Provide technical training and knowledge transfer to junior engineers or team members.

Automation & Optimization:

  • Automate routine tasks using F5 iControl REST API and scripting languages such as Python or Bash.
  • Propose improvements and optimization strategies for load balancing services.

Requirements

  • Education:
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Experience

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience with F5 load balancers (BIG-IP LTM, GTM, ASM, APM). Checkpoint or ASA firewalls.
  • Proven expertise in designing and implementing advanced load balancing solutions.
  • Experience with networking protocols such as TCP/IP, HTTP, SSL, DNS, and related technologies.

Skills

  • Proficiency in writing and debugging F5 iRules.
  • Strong understanding of application traffic flows and troubleshooting techniques.
  • Knowledge of network security principles, SSL certificates, and encryption methodologies. Firewall management
  • Familiarity with other load balancers, firewalls, and web proxies is a plus.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based load balancing solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience with DevOps tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Jenkins for infrastructure automation.
  • Soft Skills:
  • Flexible to work according to requirements
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure.
  • Strong communication skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and work independently or collaboratively.
  • Certifications:

job.title: Project Director
job.description:
About Us

Macquarie Data Centres are Australia's most experienced Data Centre Provider and experts in seriously secure, sovereign and compliant data centres.

Our AI and cloud data centres are trusted by the world’s biggest hyperscalers, Global Fortune 500 companies and 42% of the Australian Federal Government. All our campuses are Certified Strategic by the Australian Federal Government and backed by a highly experienced cohort of government cleared engineers.

We are an owned by the ASX listed Macquarie Technology Group.

Step into one of Australia’s most secure, high-performance Data Centres and launch your engineering career supporting mission-critical infrastructure for cloud, defence and enterprise customers.

The Opportunity

At Macquarie Data Centres, we don't just build data centres—we deliver the critical infrastructure that powers Australia's digital economy.

We're looking for an experienced Project Director to lead the delivery of some of Australia's most significant mission-critical infrastructure projects. Reporting to the Executive General Manager you'll take ownership of a portfolio of major capital programs, from design and construction through to commissioning and operational readiness.

This is a highly visible leadership role where you'll work alongside hyperscale customers, executive stakeholders, consultants and delivery partners to ensure complex, multi-million-dollar projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget and to the highest quality standards.

Beyond project delivery, you'll play a key role in shaping and maturing our Project Management Office (PMO), strengthening governance, reporting and delivery frameworks that will support the continued growth of our Data Centre business.

If you're passionate about delivering world-class infrastructure, thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy leading high-performing teams through complex challenges, we'd love to hear from you.

The Opportunity

At Macquarie Data Centres, we don't just build data centres—we deliver the critical infrastructure that powers Australia's digital economy.

For the third year in a row, we have been named a Global Winner of the 2026 Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award! job.title: Services Manager/Engineer - Mechanical (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Position Summary

The Services Manager/Engineer - Mechanical is the client-side technical and delivery lead for mechanical and hydraulic services on hyperscale and mission-critical data-centre projects. The role provides senior leadership from concept and design through procurement, manufacture, construction, commissioning and handover, ensuring the cooling and hydraulic infrastructure achieves the required capacity, resilience, maintainability, energy performance and programme outcomes.

The position requires proven data-centre experience and the ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams, engage credibly with designers, contractors and OEMs, and make sound technical and commercial decisions. A core focus is the integration of air-cooled chiller systems, liquid-cooled racks, hydraulic services and associated heat-rejection, distribution, controls and monitoring infrastructure, including phased deployment in live or operationally sensitive environments.

The role also leads the client interface for modular and off-site construction, including prefabricated plantrooms, skids, containerised systems and factory-tested assemblies. It establishes the assurance regime from factory acceptance through site integration and integrated systems testing.

#

Key Responsibilities

Services leadership and client representation

  • Lead the mechanical-services workstream on behalf of the client, setting technical priorities, delivery expectations, reporting and assurance activities.
  • Coordinate designers, principal contractors, specialist mechanical contractors, OEMs, commissioning providers and internal delivery, operations and commercial teams.
  • Provide clear advice on technical risk, programme, cost, constructability, resilience and operational impacts; escalate material issues with practical recommendations.
  • Promote a safety-first culture across design, factory and site activities, including safe commissioning and transition to operations.

Technical leadership and design assurance

  • Assist reviews of basis of design, drawings, specifications, calculations, equipment selections and design changes for critical cooling and hydraulic systems.
  • Provide technical assurance for air-cooled chiller systems, chilled-water distribution, pumps, heat exchangers, CRAH/CRAC equipment, ventilation, water treatment, hydraulic services, in-ground services, drainage, leak detection and BMS/DCIM interfaces.
  • Manage the coordination and delivery assurance of in-ground hydraulic services, including site water, fire-water interfaces, sanitary drainage, trade waste where applicable, stormwater interfaces, pits, pipework routes and connections to building systems.
  • Lead the mechanical integration strategy for liquid-cooled racks, including CDU architecture, secondary-loop distribution, water quality, containment, leak detection, controls, redundancy, maintainability and staged capacity deployment.
  • Review BMS architecture, points lists, control narratives, sequences of operation, alarms, trending and integration with electrical, fire, security and DCIM systems.
  • Contribute to design workshops, constructability reviews, HAZOP-style risk reviews, failure-mode assessments, value engineering and operational-readiness reviews.

Procurement, commercial and programme support

  • Lead technical evaluation of mechanical and controls tender submissions, identifying scope gaps, qualifications, programme risks and departures from requirements.
  • Support procurement and commercial teams with technical clarifications, vendor assessments, equipment lead-time strategies and package award recommendations.
  • Review progress against design, manufacture, delivery and installation milestones; intervene early where recovery actions are required.

Modular and off-site delivery

  • Lead the client-side approach to modular construction for mechanical infrastructure, including prefabricated plantrooms, skids, pipe-rack modules and factory-integrated controls systems.
  • Review modular design interfaces, logistics, lifting and installation methodology, tolerances, access, maintainability, in-ground services interfaces and site tie-in strategies.
  • Plan and witness factory acceptance tests, pre-functional checks and controls integration testing, ensuring documented close-out before shipment and site energisation.
  • Ensure modular systems are properly integrated with on-site services, controls, structural, electrical and commissioning interfaces.

Construction, commissioning and handover

  • Review contractor methodologies, inspection and test plans, quality records, commissioning plans and completion documentation.
  • Undertake site inspections and witness hold points, functional performance testing, integrated systems testing and reliability demonstrations.
  • Verify that defects, outstanding works, control issues and documentation gaps are closed before handover.
  • Support operational-readiness activities, including training, spares, maintenance information, asset data and as-built records.

Essential experience

  • 10+ years of relevant mechanical and hydraulic services delivery experience, including a services management, engineering management or client-side leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering data centres, mission-critical facilities or similarly resilient high-availability infrastructure.
  • Strong practical and technical understanding of air-cooled chiller plants, associated chilled-water systems, hydraulic services and in-ground services, controls and commissioning.
  • Demonstrated understanding of liquid cooling for data-centre racks, including CDUs, distribution systems, heat rejection, controls, leak management and operational interfaces.
  • Proven experience with modular or off-site construction methodologies, including factory acceptance testing and site integration.
  • Ability to lead design reviews, resolve complex services interfaces and assess technical, programme and commercial risk.
  • Strong knowledge of BMS and controls integration, sequences of operation and commissioning requirements for critical environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management and leadership skills.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering or a related discipline; trade-qualified HVAC/mechanical background with substantial senior delivery experience will also be considered.
  • Relevant Australian professional registration, chartership or industry memberships are advantageous.

Current construction-induction card and the ability to work on an active construction site.

#

Desirable Experience

  • Hyperscale data-centre experience and familiarity with phased build, live-site works and concurrent commissioning activities.
  • Experience with data-centre cooling standards, reliability frameworks and operational handover requirements.
  • Experience working with major chiller, cooling, controls and liquid-cooling OEMs.
  • Experience in integrated systems testing, seasonal testing and performance verification.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

job.title: Lead - Field Instrumentation (Boiler)
job.description:
Lead - Field instrumentation (Boiler)

Operational Excellence and Equipment Reliability:

Monitor the availability and functionality of all C&I systems related to Boiler area including firing systems, Mill fan, ASLD, CAMS, and MOV.

Conduct routine maintenance of MOV, Boiler, and Auxiliaries to prevent equipment failures.

Execute timely overhauls of the Boiler systems to maintain operational integrity.

Troubleshoot and rectify breakdowns of equipment to ensure continuous operation.

Coordinate with other departments to minimize maintenance delays and optimize equipment availability.

Execute calibrations as per schedule and prepare detailed reports on findings and adjustments.

Provide on-field support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Zero Forced Outage (ZFO) to enhance system reliability.

job.title: Lead Master Planner
job.description:
Responsibilities

Purpose:

The Lead Master Planner at City Side Developments, Adani Airport Holdings Ltd, will play a pivotal role in the design and development of Master planning and Urban design projects. The candidate will work collaboratively with a multidisciplinary team of Masterplanners, Architects, engineers, and project managers to create innovative and functional designs that meet the needs business needs and the highest standards of quality. Expertise in Urban design, design management, and stakeholder management is essential.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Lead the master planning for a large-scale mixed use development, encompassing commercial, hospitality, offices, convention centers, etc.

· Develop site layouts, urban design guidelines, transportation plans, and landscaping strategies that respond to site constraints, zoning codes, environmental conditions, and project goals.

· Lead the design development of the master plan through all stages, including feasibility analysis, data collection, design brief preparation, iterative concept development, and technical documentation, ensuring adherence to design standards, budgets, and timelines.

· Collaborate with external consultant and Internal project teams to develop detailed master plans, drawings, and specifications.

· Utilize demographic, economic, and geographic data to inform planning decisions and strategies.

· Develop comprehensive urban design strategies, master plans, and zoning guidelines that enhance the functionality, sustainability, and livability of urban spaces.

· Assess land use patterns, zoning regulations, and policy frameworks to guide development.

· Integrate transportation solutions, transit-oriented development, and multi-modal transportation systems into planning efforts.

· Contribute to the development of planning policies, guidelines, and regulations.

· Develop innovative and sustainable urban design solutions that enhance the functionality, aesthetics, and livability of urban areas.

· Provide guidance and mentorship to junior designers, fostering their professional growth and development.

· Conduct urban research and analysis to inform design decisions, incorporating best practices, emerging trends, and sustainable design principles.

· Prepare and present strategy documents, masterplan reports, and visualizations to internal and external stakeholders, including investors and statutory bodies

· Incorporate sustainable design principles and environmental considerations into master plans.

· Ensure that urban design projects comply with zoning regulations, local codes, and planning guidelines.

Qualifications

Experience:

· 15–18 years as a Master planner/Urban Designer, with significant work on large-scale mixed use real estate projects.

· Proven track record in leading full-cycle projects from concept development to on-site completion.

Education Qualification:

· Bachelor of Architecture from a recognized institution.

· Preferred: M. Arch from reputed institutes such as CEPT University and School of Planning & Architecture (SPA).

Certification Required:

No specific certifications required, but relevant certifications in architectural design are advantageous.

Behavioural Skills:

· Exceptional leadership and communication skills.

· Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.

· Ability to thrive in a collaborative, deadline-driven environment.

Technical Skills:

· Proficiency with AutoCAD, Sketch Up, MS office and know how of Revit, GIS would be essential.

· Proficiency in building/planning, infra codes for Urban design, planning and building.

· Experience in preparing design brief and feasibility studies.

Non-Negotiable Skills:

· Expertise in master planning, urban design, infrastructure coordination, transportation, landscaping, and sustainable development

· Must have exhibited design and design coordination skills with various design stakeholders like landscape, traffic, infra (including PHE, Electrical etc.) and SMEP

· Demonstrable workplace experience of survey and analysis of sites, preparation of base plans and supporting material required for urban design and master planning work is essential.

· At least one full cycle of experience from concept development to on-site completion

Conclusion:

The Lead Master Planner role at Adani presents an exciting opportunity for an experienced professional to lead transformative design initiatives in the real estate and hospitality industry. If you are passionate about creating innovative and sustainable architectural solutions and possess the requisite skills and qualifications, we encourage you to apply and become a valuable contributor to our dynamic team.

job.description:

  • Establish and maintain standardized technical service manuals, SOPs, specifications, and maintenance frameworks across all Group locations.
  • Define uniform standards for HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire & Life Safety, Building Management Systems (BMS), DG Sets, Elevators, and other critical assets.

Drive IFM Standardization Initiatives

  • Ensure consistency in maintenance practices, service levels, staffing models, and asset management processes.

Technical Governance & Compliance

  • Develop governance mechanisms to monitor compliance with approved technical standards.
  • Conduct periodic audits and assessments to identify gaps and drive corrective actions.
  • Ensure adherence to statutory, regulatory, environmental, and safety requirements.

Asset Lifecycle Management

  • Define asset performance standards, maintenance strategies, and lifecycle replacement frameworks.
  • Establish preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance programs to improve asset reliability and uptime.

CAPEX & Technical Project Support

  • Provide technical guidance for new facility developments, fit-outs, renovations, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Review and approve technical specifications, designs, equipment selection, and engineering standards.

Vendor & AMC Standardization

Performance Monitoring & Analytics

Cost Optimization & Efficiency Enhancement

job.title: Duty Terminal Manager
job.description:
Terminal Operations Shift Management:

  • Oversees all terminal operations during the assigned shift, ensuring smooth passenger flow and on-time departures & coordinates with other departments for efficient operations.
  • Manages staff schedules and assignments to optimize resource utilization.

Lounge Management and Customer Service:

  • Delivers exceptional customer service by assisting passengers with their needs and resolving issues promptly & builds positive relationships with passengers to enhance the overall airport experience.
  • Assist in the management of reserved lounges, ensuring a high standard of service and a seamless experience for passengers.

Trolley Operations and Asset Management:

  • Oversee the management and maintenance of trolley operations, ensuring availability and cleanliness.
  • Assist in managing the asset lifecycle, including regular checks and prompt reporting of any defects or damages.

Golf Cart and Inter Terminal Coach Operations:

  • Coordinate the timely deployment and safe operation of golf carts and inter-terminal coaches.
  • Ensure service levels are met, track performance scores, and address any complaints or operational issues promptly.

Staff Supervision:

  • Provides leadership and guidance to the terminal operations team during the shift & monitors staff performance and addresses issues promptly.
  • Ensures adherence to operational procedures and standards among staff members.

Vendor Management:

  • Manage operational aspects related to vendor management, golf cart management, baggage and shopping trolley management, Baggage Handling System (BCS) management, and inter-terminal coach management to ensure smooth operations and enhancing passenger experience within terminal
  • Monitor vendor performance and address any discrepancies to maintain operational standards.

Problem Solving:

  • Identifies and resolves operational issues and challenges that arise during the shift & implements immediate solutions to minimize disruptions.
  • Collaborates with other departments to address complex issues and find effective solutions.

Emergency Response Management:

  • Lead emergency response efforts during shifts, effectively managing situations such as bomb threats, evacuations, medical emergencies, and other contingencies.
  • Ensure all actions are carried out in accordance with laid-down SOPs and conduct post-incident reviews for continuous improvement.

Special Events and VVIP Movements:

  • Support the coordination of special events, ensuring smooth execution, budgeting, and event calendar management.
  • Assist in planning and ensuring security arrangements for VVIP movements, including liaising with relevant authorities for smooth execution.

Safety and Security Compliance:

  • Ensures compliance with safety and security regulations and procedures during the shift & conducts safety checks and responds to incidents.
  • Coordinates with security personnel to address security concerns and maintain a safe environment.

Operational Efficiency:

  • Optimizes resource utilization during the shift to maximize efficiency and minimize costs & implements process improvements to enhance operational performance.
  • Monitors key performance indicators (KPIs) and takes corrective actions to improve performance.

Stakeholder Management:

  • Shift wise coordination will all regulatory agencies, airlines and ground handlers.

Team Leadership and Development

  • Supervise and manage the terminal operations team during shifts, ensuring high levels of employee engagement and discipline.
  • Identify training needs of employees and ensure team members participate in all mandatory classroom training sessions.

job.title: Lead - Cybersecurity
job.description:
Responsibilities

Cybersecurity Strategy, Governance & Compliance

  • Develop, implement, and continuously enhance cybersecurity policies, standards, frameworks, and operational procedures across the business.
  • Establish cybersecurity governance mechanisms and drive periodic cybersecurity performance reviews with business leadership.
  • Define cyber KPIs, KRIs, scorecards, and reporting frameworks.
  • Ensure compliance with cybersecurity regulations, customer requirements, contractual obligations, and industry standards.
  • Maintain cyber risk registers and monitor closure of identified risks and audit observations.

Cyber Hygiene & Technology Controls

  • Govern and continuously improve cyber hygiene controls across all operational sites.
  • Ensure effective Identity & Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and user access governance.
  • Drive endpoint security, anti-virus management, security patch deployment, and operating system/application security updates.
  • Manage backup infrastructure, restoration testing, and cyber recovery controls.
  • Ensure OEM-supported security configurations and technology lifecycle compliance across critical systems.

Operational Technology (OT) Security

  • Develop and implement cybersecurity controls for Operational Technology environments including BMS, DCIM, IBMS, EPMS, CCTV, Access Control Systems, PLCs, and Building Automation Systems.
  • Ensure secure integration and segregation of IT and OT networks.
  • Lead OT vulnerability assessments, security audits, and remediation programs.
  • Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, and OEM partners to strengthen resilience of mission-critical operational systems.

Network & Endpoint Security

  • Manage enterprise and data center network security architecture.
  • Govern firewalls, IDS/IPS, NAC, VPNs, secure remote access, network segmentation, and threat detection controls.
  • Implement and manage Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR/XDR) solutions.
  • Continuously monitor network and endpoint security posture and drive corrective actions.

Cybersecurity Incident Response & Crisis Management

  • Lead cybersecurity incident detection, investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery activities.
  • Develop and maintain incident response plans, cyber playbooks, escalation matrices, and response procedures.
  • Conduct root cause analysis and implement preventive and corrective actions.
  • Coordinate with leadership, OEMs, customers, service providers, and regulatory agencies during cybersecurity incidents.
  • Conduct cyber crisis simulations, tabletop exercises, and business continuity testing.

Cyber Risk Management & Vulnerability Management

  • Conduct periodic cyber risk assessments for infrastructure, applications, networks, OT systems, and critical business processes.
  • Lead vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, security reviews, and threat exposure assessments.
  • Prioritize and drive remediation of identified vulnerabilities within defined timelines.
  • Monitor emerging cyber threats and ensure timely mitigation of associated risks.

Cybersecurity Solutions & Technology Deployment

  • Evaluate, recommend, and implement cybersecurity technologies aligned with business and operational requirements.
  • Drive deployment and lifecycle management of SIEM, SOAR, PAM, EDR/XDR, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, and other cybersecurity platforms.
  • Collaborate with digital, automation, infrastructure, and project teams for integration of secure technologies.

Cybersecurity Audits & Assurance

  • Lead internal and external cybersecurity audits, assessments, certifications, and customer security reviews.
  • Ensure readiness and compliance with standards such as ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls, and other relevant industry practices.
  • Maintain cybersecurity documentation, evidence repositories, and compliance records.

Vendor & Third-Party Cyber Risk Management

  • Conduct cybersecurity assessments of OEMs, contractors, managed service providers, consultants, and third-party vendors.
  • Review cybersecurity controls and contractual compliance of suppliers and service providers.
  • Ensure remediation and mitigation of identified third-party cyber risks.
  • Embed cybersecurity requirements into procurement, contracting, and vendor management processes.

Cybersecurity Awareness & Capability Building

  • Develop and implement cybersecurity awareness programs across operational data centers.
  • Conduct periodic employee awareness campaigns, phishing simulations, training sessions, and security workshops.
  • Build cybersecurity competency within operations, engineering, facility management, and support functions.
  • Promote a strong cyber-aware culture across the organization.

ESG, Sustainability & Workplace Safety

  • Demonstrate active commitment to AdaniConneX's Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG) objectives and sustainability agenda.
  • Promote environmentally responsible management of IT and electronic assets, including e-waste disposal and sustainable technology practices.
  • Comply with all applicable Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) policies, procedures, and statutory requirements.
  • Participate in safety audits, emergency response drills, incident investigations, and risk mitigation initiatives.
  • Ensure safe working practices while executing cybersecurity projects and operational activities at data center facilities.
  • Ensure vendors, contractors, and OEM representatives comply with site safety, environmental, security, and governance requirements.

Key Internal Stakeholders

  • Group Chief Information Security Officer
  • Head – Operations
  • Information Technology team
  • Engineering & Projects Teams
  • Digital & Automation Teams
  • Facility Management Teams
  • Risk & Compliance Teams
  • Procurement Teams
  • Physical Security Teams
  • Business Leadership Team

Key External Stakeholders

  • OEM & technology Partners and cybersecurity consultants
  • Clients
  • Managed Security Service Providers
  • Audit Agencies
  • Regulatory Authorities

Qualifications

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Electronics, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or related discipline.

Professional Certifications (Preferred)

  • CISSP
  • CISM
  • CISA
  • CEH
  • CCSP
  • ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor
  • GIAC Certifications
  • GICSP (OT Security)
  • Microsoft Security Certifications
  • Cisco / Palo Alto Security Certifications

Key Competencies Functional Competencies

  • Cybersecurity Governance
  • OT Security
  • Network Security Architecture
  • Endpoint Security
  • Incident Response & Crisis Management
  • Cyber Risk Management
  • Vulnerability Management
  • Security Operations
  • Third-Party Risk Management
  • Regulatory Compliance & Audits
  • Business Continuity & Cyber Resilience

Behavioral Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking
  • Leadership & Team Development
  • Stakeholder Management

job.title: Vice President, Power Procurement
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve. We differentiate through execution – delivering at speed and at scale while combining global standards with deep local expertise. This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

As Asia Pacific’s digital transformation accelerates, Digital Edge is building the infrastructure that powers the next wave of AI and cloud growth. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

Our values:

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

Reporting to the Chief Investment and Commercial Officer, the VP, Power Procurement will spearhead the power procurement strategy & contracts across our operations in Asia, integration of renewable energy solutions and support the renewable requirements of hyperscale & cloud customers. The role demands proficiency in procuring power directly from utility grids, acquiring renewable energy through Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs), Virtual Power Purchase Agreements (VPPAs), and other innovative structures. This position is based in Singapore.

Key Responsibilities

1) Grid Power Procurement – Operational & Development Support

  • Develop and implement comprehensive strategies to secure reliable and cost-efficient electricity supply for data centers in multiple markets across Asia Pacific.
  • Support local operations teams in the negotiations with utility providers and local suppliers to procure conventional (i.e., “grid”) power for both operational facilities and new developments.
  • Work closely with the Corporate Development team on new site selection, power due diligence, energization schedule and business plan modelling
  • Drive utility interface, quota negotiations, and execution of energy supply agreements and partner closely with the in-country teams.
  • Provide guidance on securing energy quota and capacity to support site selection and development timelines.
  • Ensure compliance with local energy procurement regulations and internal governance standards.

2) Renewable Power & Storage – Transition Strategy & Execution

  • Drive the adoption of energy solutions, including PPAs, VPPAs, on-site renewables, and battery storage, to meet company-wide ESG and sustainability targets.
  • Identify and implement hybrid renewable power strategies tailored to each market, whether as sole offtaker or in partnership with customer-driven initiatives.
  • Develop a long-term sustainability roadmap, monitor energy market trends, and identify cost-saving or innovation-driven procurement opportunities.
  • Build and manage relationships with renewable energy developers, aggregators, and other key ecosystem partners throughout key markets in Asia Pacific.
  • Track and report on renewable procurement KPIs including carbon intensity, cost performance, and renewable energy adoption.

3) Hyperscale & Cloud Customer Engagement – Renewable Commitments

  • Collaborate with the CCIO and hyperscale sales teams to engage directly with cloud and hyperscale customers on their renewable energy goals.
  • Lead or support negotiations of renewable energy commitments and ensure timely and accurate execution of agreed solutions.
  • Translate customer sustainability objectives / requirements into actionable procurement strategies that align with both regulatory frameworks and our internal power procurement roadmap.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure delivery of renewable energy in line with customer contract terms and reporting needs.

**

**

The successful candidate:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Energy Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
  • Extensive experience in electricity procurement, energy negotiations, and renewable energy acquisition within the Asia Pacific region.
  • Successful candidates will likely come from a similar role within a grid operator, DC platform, infrastructure, renewable Energy or adjacent industry
  • Proven expertise in structuring and negotiating PPAs, VPPAs, and other renewable energy instruments.
  • Strong knowledge of energy markets, regulations, and sustainability practices in the Asia Pacific region.
  • Exceptional negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Analytical mindset with a keen attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated commitment to sustainability and environmental stewardship.

If you’re ready to help shape the next phase of a fast-growing digital infrastructure platform, we’d like to hear from you!

job.title: System Planning Manager
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

The Systems Planning Manager for Managed WiFi Services is responsible for the strategic planning, engineering, lifecycle management, and governance of the centralized WiFi service platform and supporting headend infrastructure. The role drives technology evaluation and proof-of-concept (PoC) initiatives with key vendors, while working closely with architecture, product management, global competencies, technical pre-sales, and other stakeholders to establish service standards and technology roadmaps.

The incumbent provides technical leadership for platform deployment, feature development, and continuous service enhancement to ensure a secure, scalable, and high-performing WiFi environment. Responsibilities include managing technology lifecycle activities, knowledge transfer, product communications (including End-of-Life notifications), and advanced technical support for complex incidents and escalations (Level 3 and Level 4). The role also leads engineering, capacity planning, and security initiatives to maintain service reliability and support business growth.

Make an impact by:

  • Responsible for the design and build of the managed Wifi Services platforms and Infrastructure
  • Responsible Technologies Proof-of-Concept with principal vendors and supporting Proof-of-Value with customers.
  • Support product management team in defining and coordinating the scope of works with various stakeholders like Architecture Offices, Global Competencies, Product Management, Technical Pre-sale, Global Fulfillment, Global Competencies and so on.
  • Working closely with principal partners for technology knowledge transfer and technology notice broadcast such as End of Life or End of Sale i.e Release Life Cycle Management
  • Responsible for new features development, regression testing, verification checks and ensuring compliance to design specifications.
  • Providing Level 3 & 4 support with principal platform partner over bug or software escalation
  • Managing of Capex/Opex and assets management, ensuring project deliverables.
  • Responsible for technical planning, network/security engineering, and project management/coordination
  • Responsible for providing technical procedures, configuration standards, playbooks and knowledge-based documentation.
  • Stay updated with emerging WiFi standards (Wi-Fi 6/6E/7) and industry trends to evaluate and introduce new WiFi technologies and automation capabilities.

Skills for success:

  • Diploma / Degree in Information Technology/Computer Science
  • A 3+ years of relevant experience in WiFi engineering, preferably in a managed services or enterprise IT environment
  • Strong understanding of wireless networking standards, RF theory, and LAN/WAN integration.
  • Experience with enterprise or cloud-based WiFi platforms (Meraki, Aruba, Ruckus, Cisco).
  • Knowledge of authentication systems and network security protocols.

job.title: Senior Systems Engineer
job.description:
Macquarie Park, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Every day, millions of Australians connect, work, stream, and stay in touch on the Optus network. When it works seamlessly, it's easy to take for granted. But behind it is a team making thousands of decisions every day - decisions that keep people, businesses and communities connected.

Right now, Optus is passionate about getting the fundamentals right - simplifying how we work, lifting standards, and building a more reliable, resilient experience for our customers. It's not about surface-level change. It's about how we make decisions, how we work together, and how we deliver.**

The Senior Systems Engineer (SSE) is accountable for software development, configuration, and enhancement of OSS Assurance Systems including both off the shell product and inhouse built applications. The Systems Engineer is a hands-on software developer role but need to understand the business requirements prior to implementing the required solution, selecting the technology stack in alignment with the Solution Designer / Architects and to agreed roadmap and strategy.

What You’ll Do

  • Management of demands from different parts of Optus network for assurance integration to ensure project timelines are meet.
  • Translating high‑level solution or architecture designs into detailed component‑level designs for software implementations.
  • Managing and guiding vendor teams to ensure deliverables meet Optus standards, including code reviews, requirements clarifications, and owning the final codebase.
  • Leading and mentor small teams of inhouse developers and vendor resources in software development and introduction of new development toolsets to improve efficiency.
  • Own alarms plans and configurations that manage the alarming, auto ticketing, auto restoration of network functions and conduct review with operation and engineering.
  • Providing L3 support for OSS Operations teams, including diagnosing and implementing fixes that require code or configuration changes.
  • Managing source code, build pipelines, and deployment tools .

What You’ll Bring

  • 10–15 years’ IT experience, including strong hands‑on software engineering capability.
  • Experience in TeMIP adapter coding, IBM Netcool configuration, OpenNMS SNMP manager, Nokia Assurance Centre Fault Management + Performance Management, and Nokia UIV modelling will be highly regarded.
  • High‑level proficiency in Java and Groovy, with experience designing and delivering enterprise‑scale systems.
  • Strong database skills across relational, NoSQL and graph databases, including schema design, SQL, and performance tuning.
  • Strong development skill in Apache NiFi and Kafka including flow design and system integration patterns.
  • Strong development skill in Camunda and Drools, including BPMN modelling and workflow automation.
  • Broad technical exposure across infrastructure, OS (Linux/Windows), containers (Docker/Kubernetes), and integration technologies.
  • Proven experience managing vendors or offshore development teams — guiding technical direction, reviewing deliverables, and ensuring quality outcomes.

The good stuff …

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Direct your own development and build future-ready skills with Optus U’s industry-focused micro-credentials, developed with La Trobe and Macquarie Universities.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.

We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander.

job.title: Strategic Partner Manager, Global Partnerships, Vietnam
job.description:
Meta is looking for a strategic, results-driven and people-driven Strategic Partner Manager (SPM) for the global partnerships team covering Vietnam. Our team partners with the world's biggest and most innovative creators, public figures, and media companies on high-profile content and product opportunities. We are looking for someone who can own the Vietnam market end-to-end championing strategy and growth for our creator, public figure, production house, and media partners across the Family of Apps products, tools, and services.

This role manages the full Vietnam partner ecosystem — public figures, creators, and production houses — and is responsible for driving product adoption and leading the end-to-end go-to-market (GTM) strategy and programs in the market. This position is crucial for driving growth and success through strategic market development, innovative partner-led programs, new product solutions, and cultivating strong, long-term partner relationships across the industry and the country.

This role requires creative problem-solving and strategic thinking, combined with a hands-on approach to execution. This person will engage and align internal and external stakeholders through education, advocacy, and compelling presentations, and reports to the SEA Global Partnerships Director.

Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the full Vietnam market — public figures, creators, media, and production houses — building strong relationships across diverse verticals
  • Be the strategic advisor to the partner's business growth across Meta Family of App (FB, IG, Threads, Edits, and Meta AI)
  • Identify and translate market opportunities and challenges into a well-defined strategy that drives product adoption and leads end-to-end GTM strategy and programs for the Vietnam market
  • Drive goals and develop digital talent through strategic partnerships and development plans
  • Build strategic collaborations with cross-functional teams, achieve shared objectives, and track key performance metrics
  • Plan and execute impactful events and activations that engage partners
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to influence partner product and program development efforts both short-term feature requests and long-term strategic roadmap
  • Represent Meta in external meetings with partners and present Meta's value proposition to C-suite executives

Minimum Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in Vietnamese required to manage partner relationships and communications in the Vietnam market. Business fluency in English required to collaborate with internal cross-functional teams and regional stakeholders
  • 8+ years of experience in partnerships, product or go-to-market roles
  • Deep knowledge of creators, public figures, production houses, and media and their ecosystem in Vietnam, preferably with an existing network of relationships with creators and emerging and/or established talents
  • Experience with new business and partner development, building long-term partnerships, and partner management in Vietnam
  • Managing projects independently, with the ability to lead multiple time-sensitive, cross-functional projects on deadline
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, and the ability to serve as a spokesperson for Meta
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and influencing skills
  • Demonstrated excellence in collaboration and relationship-building with internal and external stakeholders
  • Familiarity with a high degree of autonomy, displaying leadership, organizational, and execution skills
  • Rapid learner who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and can pivot as necessary
  • The willingness to travel internationally and work across multiple time zones

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field
  • Preferably has experience in creator/talent management, media, label, technology, and/or gaming
  • Professional fluency in Vietnamese with an excellent command of English, required for communicating with external stakeholders in the APAC region
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Experience driving growth through technology and product integrations is a major plus. Experience applying business acumen to develop and scale strategic partnerships

job.title: Global Supply Chain Operations Manager
job.description:
Meta is seeking a Global Supply Chain Manager to drive supply chain execution of hardware that supports the development and manufacturing of Meta's data center infrastructure. In this role, you will lead cross-functional efforts to define and manage supplier ecosystems, and ensure that component quality, cost, and supply continuity requirements are met across complex, high-volume production programs.

Responsibilities

  • Define and execute commodity strategies for technically complex components such as server racks, semiconductors, electromechanical assemblies, optical systems, or custom silicon used in Meta's hardware product lines
  • Lead supplier engagement, demand versus supply assessments, manufacturing capability audits, and risk evaluations across global supply chains
  • Partner with hardware engineering, product development, and manufacturing teams to influence component architecture decisions and design-for-manufacturability trade-offs during early product development stages to ensure mass production schedules are maintained
  • Establish and lead supplier performance management frameworks, including scorecards, business reviews, and corrective action plans tied to quality, delivery, and responsiveness metrics
  • Identify and mitigate supply chain risks arising from geopolitical factors, single-source dependencies, commodity market volatility, or supplier financial instability
  • Drive multi-source supply strategies and qualification of alternate suppliers to improve supply chain resilience across critical component categories
  • Collaborate with planning, logistics, and operations teams to align supplier capacity and lead time commitments with product ramp schedules and demand forecasts
  • Provide technical and strategic guidance to peers and cross-functional partners, shaping commodity roadmaps and influencing organizational sourcing practices at scale

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in technical sourcing, commodity management, or supply chain engineering within the hardware manufacturing industry
  • Experience leading end-to-end supply chain execution for technically complex components, including supplier selection, negotiation, qualification, and lifecycle management
  • Experience conducting manufacturing capability assessments, process audits, and supplier risk evaluations for high-volume production programs
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Sourcing, Quality Engineering, NPI, hardware engineering, product development, and finance teams to align sourcing decisions with product and business requirements

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting new product introduction programs, including supplier ramp readiness, first article inspection, and production validation processes
  • Familiarity with responsible sourcing standards or supplier sustainability assessment frameworks
  • Experience using enterprise procurement or supply chain platforms to manage supplier data, contract workflows, and commodity spend analytics
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

job.title: Regional Manager, Regulatory Readiness (APAC)
job.description:
Meta's Regulatory Readiness team ensures the company is prepared for the evolving global regulatory landscape. We monitor, prioritize, and drive action on regulatory developments that affect Meta's products and billions of users worldwide. Our regional teams combine regulatory intelligence and risk analysis with structured program management to ensure Meta anticipates and responds to regulatory change effectively.

We are looking for an experienced Regional Manager to lead our combined Regulatory Readiness team across Asia-Pacific. You will build and manage a team that delivers regulatory risk intelligence, drives readiness programs, and coordinates cross-functional response to regulatory developments across one of the world's most dynamic and diverse regulatory environments.

APAC spans jurisdictions with rapidly evolving approaches to platform regulation, data protection, AI governance, online safety, and digital competition. You will be responsible for ensuring Meta has a clear, timely understanding of this landscape and is consistently prepared to respond.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the APAC team — Recruit, manage, and mentor a team of program managers responsible for regulatory readiness across Asia-Pacific
  • Own the APAC regulatory landscape — Build and maintain a comprehensive view of regulatory risks, pressures, and enforcement trends across the region. Produce actionable intelligence and strategic recommendations for senior leadership
  • Coordinate cross-functional response — Collaborate to ensure Meta's product, engineering, and operations teams are prepared for regulatory change. Align stakeholders on regulatory priorities and drive coordinated action
  • Advise on regulatory strategy — Translate complex regulatory environments into clear strategic implications. Help leadership understand trade-offs, prioritize responses, and make informed decisions
  • Represent the region globally — Ensure APAC perspectives are reflected in global regulatory readiness processes, frameworks, and leadership discussions

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in regulatory affairs, public policy, compliance, risk management, or related fields
  • 3+ years in a people management role, with experience building and developing teams
  • Deep knowledge of the APAC regulatory environment, with expertise in multiple key jurisdictions (e.g., India, Australia, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Southeast Asia)
  • Experience managing cross-functional programs involving legal, policy, product, and engineering stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Background in regulatory intelligence, horizon scanning, or policy risk management
  • Experience in the technology or internet platforms sector, particularly around content regulation, privacy, AI governance, online safety, or digital competition
  • Experience working in global, matrixed organizations across time zones and cultures
  • Ability to synthesize complex regulatory landscapes into actionable strategic insights for executive audiences
  • Advanced degree in law, public policy, international relations, political science, or a related field
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Proficiency in an APAC language in addition to English, as the role involves direct engagement with regional regulators and stakeholders across Asia-Pacific jurisdictions
  • Experience leading teams that combine analytical/research functions with program delivery

job.title: Network Development Manager, APAC
job.description:
To support the fast-growing user community and the introduction of new and innovative products and services, we are continually expanding our backbone network infrastructure around the globe. We are looking for a Network Development Manager to join our APAC network infrastructure group to support our growing network footprint needs. You will lead network investments through capacity and dark fiber leases and acquisitions, network infrastructure development, and construction. You will — often working with partners and vendors — develop and implement strategies to provide Meta with competitive economics, flexibility and scalability, reliable delivery and high availability as well as optimized operation and maintenance arrangements.

If you are passionate about network infrastructure and building and expanding global network infrastructure, please send your resume for consideration for this role.

Responsibilities

  • Develop supply strategies for capacity connecting and expanding our CDN network
  • Manage a portfolio of infrastructure suppliers globally, but with a focus on the APAC regions
  • Identify suppliers, negotiate commercial terms, and work with the engineering and legal departments to negotiate and execute supplier contracts
  • Project Management: Drive end-to-end execution of complex infrastructure projects across internal and external cross-functional stakeholders
  • Manage and develop partner relationships across a diverse range of countries
  • Oversee the performance and management of contracts through the full lifecycle, tracking and ensuring supplier compliance with the terms and conditions of the contract, processing of supplier invoices, creation of contract variances and renegotiation as needed
  • Understanding the subsea and telecom wholesale markets' technological and commercial developments and positioning Meta in the right place
  • Maintains a deep familiarity with other major market players and competitive dynamics on both the supply and demand side; keeps track of price trends in the market to ensure the company offers competitive commercial terms for Meta
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop network requirements and acquisition strategies, and generating clear and objective investment analysis and recommendations for investment approvals
  • Working closely with finance and planning teams to develop budgets, forecasts, and long-range investment plans, and with Accounting and Accounts Payable for the accurate processing of supplier invoices and compliance with accounting guidelines
  • Accommodate pre-planned travel as required for the role

Minimum Qualifications

  • B.A./B.Sc. or equivalent in a technical or business-related field with 5+ years of relevant experience
  • Experience in a lit capacity, fiber infrastructure, and carrier market players, and familiarity with evolving commercial trends

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
