job.title: Manager - Techno Commercial
job.description:
Responsibilities

Services Delivery Setup and Operations Management

  • Work with Service Delivery Lead - GCC TC and Head - GCC TC for setup and design Category Management and Sourcing support services at GCC
  • Develop and implement procurement strategies for various categories.
  • Streamline procurement processes to enhance operational efficiency and reduce costs.
  • Onboarding of new suppliers, ensuring they meet company standards and requirements.
  • Ensure procurement systems are integrated with other business systems for seamless operations. Ensure all procurement activities comply with internal policies and external regulations.

Transition and Operations Stabilization

  • Support interlock with BU stakeholders and CPOs to finalize the detailed process design and system enablement of sourcing strategies.
  • Responsible to update detailed SOW, policies and SLA / KPI framework
  • Work with Service Delivery Lead - GCC TC, Head - GCC TC and Group CPO for sign off on budget head count and migration of the process activities to GCC
  • Lead change management initiatives to transition new businesses into GCC Procurement function smoothly.
  • Identify and mitigate risks associated with the transition of procurement operations.
  • Monitor the performance of procurement activities during the transition phase to ensure stability.

Customer and Stakeholder engagement

  • Develop and build rapport and relationship with customer stakeholder organization linked to or influencing Techno Commercial operations outcomes of GCC
  • Proactively identify business requirements and changes and work with Head - GCC TC to modify operational flows/deliverables
  • Build business knowledge and its impact / requirements from TC Operations
  • Collaborate with different process owners in BU Techno Commercial for sign-off on any process changes and subsequently update RACI/HOTO/SOPs (incorporate this in quarterly cadence)
  • Implement robust communication model – including ad-hoc / informal tele conversations/ face to face meetings, structured Ops review update to all stakeholders
  • Work with customer organization to ensure updated organizational structure information and coordinate Proactive update to GCC workflow approval matrix.
  • Ensure customer signoff on existing and revised SOP/ SLA’s and all process change requests.

Operational Delivery and Service Excellence

  • Drive proactive alerts and escalate to Head - GCC TC / Head – BU TC for any upstream process gaps/ delays to ensure GCC deliverables and Reputation is positively managed
  • Leverage SAP/ workflow and other available information tracking mechanisms to proactive anticipate potential processing issues
  • Drive excellence and adherence to operational SLAs related to purchase requisition review, Category Management and Sourcing.
  • Review and update related operational SOPs and policies if required and adherence to DOAs
  • Maintain and identify any SLA commitment documentation, signoff and drive change requests
  • Perform operational governance for achieving service delivery excellence
  • Implement Service Excellence Framework with the following implemented as minimum standard:

Daily operations review and volume tracking

  • Delay track and proactive alert to drive upstream / downstream or in stream actions to closure
  • Maintain and have updated end-to-end Process delivery Tracker. Proactively identify opportunities to improve process velocity
  • Implement Issue and Escalation Tracker and log. Ensure timely closure of all improvement – corrective/preventive actions
  • Work with GCC TC Head to initiate, implement and monitor all continuous improvement projects relevant for operational performance improvement

Implement capacity management and operations business continuity management plans to ensure uninterrupted delivery to assigned Sector business. Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of procurement operations.

People and Performance Management

  • Guide assigned operational team leads for effective people management
  • Identify any people challenges quickly and work with Head - GCC TC and GCC HR for timely corrective action
  • Manage performance appraisal of the assigned Operational Team lead
  • Ensure timely and effective 1-1 with assigned Operational Team leads
  • Implement structure performance evaluation criteria and monitoring using tangible / operational data for assigned operational team leads
  • Conduct periodic Skip level with Operational team members
  • Ensure each operations team lead and operations team members (new /existing) are inducted to new operations model, expectations and governance mechanism including critical business scenarios
  • Drive and cultivate culture of Outcome focused customer centric organization by driving E2E process awareness / Business sector appreciation sessions with the operational team leads and members.

Operations Process Improvement and Knowledge Management

  • Drive year-over-year productivity leveraging Digital/Automation AI/Gen AI tools
  • Be the GCC Focal point and liaise / work with Business stakeholders in ensuring Process improvement program are aligned to Business needs
  • Participate in GCC Cross functional Process improvement council to identify variances across BU and work on driving standardization
  • Lead deployment of necessary IT Workflow tools

Qualifications

  • Graduate degree in Engineering, Commerce or Management. MBA Preferred
  • Certificate or proven exposure to Techno Commercial operations. IIMM or CSM/CPA preferred
  • Experience in working in SAP and Workflow driven Shared Services Environment. MM Certified preferred
  • Exposure to AI/Automation
  • Advanced user of Excel functions

Experiences:

  • 12-15 Years of total experience

More than 5 years of experience in managing team preferably in a GCC or Shared Services context

  • 3-5 years of experience in working in Projects, Assets, Infrastructure, Manufacturing, Services organization in the domain of Sourcing and Techno Commercial function.
  • 3-4 years’ experience in leading and managing Operations teams
  • 1-2 years’ experience in Customer/ Stakeholder Engagement and Service delivery management

Led a team with a size of 40-50 professionals Exposure to working in Indian conglomerates and working practices in promoter led organizations Experience in import procurement of materials and services Knowledge and experience of Indian tax including GST, eWay bill and Statutory compliance requirements Knowledge and understanding of Complex Services Techno Commercial scenarios in EPC/Project based organizations Exposure and experience in Category Management and Sourcing Processes PowerPoint presentation creation and delivery capabilities Basic knowledge of types of categories in sourcing and understanding of PR to PO processes.

Exposure to work in SharePoint/Tool based environment and project management.

job.title: Deputy Manager - Digital Marketing
job.description:
Responsibilities

Brand Strategy Execution:

Coordinate the implementation of approved branding strategies across all relevant platforms, ensuring alignment with the corporate objectives, which includes translating brand guidelines into operational plans and managing the execution of campaigns with adherence to brand voice, tone, and consistency across deliverables.

Regularly review campaign performance metrics and compile detailed analytical reports for higher management. & identify trends, campaign effectiveness, and actionable insights, leveraging data visualization tools like Power BI to provide clarity and direction for brand initiatives.

Content Curation & Development Oversight:

Supervise the development of high-quality, brand-compliant content across multimedia channels, ensuring adherence to brand narratives and market expectations by liaising with creative vendors to approve designs, graphics, and video scripts.

Monitor trends in social media and digital marketing to recommend adjustments in content strategies by working closely with internal technical teams to integrate storytelling with brand promotion activities for maximum reach and engagement.

Social Media Operations Management:

Manage day-to-day activities across all corporate social media accounts, ensuring campaigns run seamlessly and deliver expected outcomes, also scheduling posts, monitoring comments, and ensuring the timely resolution of flagged content issues.

Analyze competitor activities in the digital and social media space, preparing comparative insights to guide strategy refinement & also implement innovative ideas to optimize performance across emerging platforms, enhancing visibility and engagement.

Campaign Analytics and Reporting:

Prepare intermediate-level reports summarizing the effectiveness of executed branding campaigns with. emphasis is on data-backed analysis, employing tools like Google Analytics or SEMrush to identify growth opportunities.

Support the development of ROI-focused recommendations by using predictive analytics and providing insights to enhance campaign outreach and performance metrics.

Digital Advertising Monitoring:

Oversee the setup and operation of digital ad campaigns, ensuring alignment with corporate branding objectives & tracking advertisement impressions, click-through rates, and overall performance metrics.

Conduct periodic audits of paid media campaigns to ensure compliance with established KPIs, recommending mid-course corrections to maintain the alignment of strategies with outcomes.

Corporate Identity Consistency:

Verify and validate that all external and internal branding elements are consistent with corporate identity guidelines, by overseeing marketing collateral approvals, event branding, and co-branded initiatives with partners.

Audit brand usage across departments to identify any inconsistencies and implement corrective measures to maintain uniformity in perception across different consumer touchpoints.

Experience in executing multi-channel branding campaigns, handling performance analytics, and coordinating with creative agencies is critical for this role.

job.title: Contract Manager
job.description:

Team Support and Coordination:

Assist in setting team goals by gathering input from team members and ensuring that assigned tasks align with individual expertise and project requirements.

Facilitate smooth collaboration by coordinating schedules, following up on action items, and ensuring effective communication between departments as directed by the lead.

Help maintain vendor relationships by tracking contract timelines, monitoring vendor performance, and escalating any issues to the lead for resolution.

Risk Management:

job.title: Team - GCP - Civil & Structure
job.description:
Responsibilities

Purchase Requisition Processing:

Review and convert approved purchase requisitions into Requests for Quotation (RFQs) or Purchase Orders (POs) after thorough validation of item specifications, quantities, and required approvals.

Ensure that all commercial and technical details are accurately captured, aligned with procurement policies and category strategies.

Leverage data analytics to suggest procurement interventions, identify opportunities for optimization, and provide category-specific recommendations for cost, delivery, or quality improvement.

Vendor Coordination & Follow-up:

Coordinate with vendors for quote submission, clarifications, and material delivery.

Follow up for documentation, test reports, and certifications.

Support the preparation of the supplier segmentation matrix, Supplier performance evaluation criteria and frequency for each supplier segment, and supplier scorecards.

Evaluate and report on quality of materials / service procured vis-à-vis defined standards and execute corrective action as required at supplier end.

RFQ & Technical Document Preparation:

Assist in preparing comprehensive RFQ packages, ensuring inclusion of all relevant technical specifications, terms, and required documentation.

Ensure consistent formatting of vendor responses and timely dissemination of drawings, specifications, and offer details to relevant stakeholders for technical and commercial evaluations.

Order Tracking & Expediting:

Monitor the status of issued POs by tracking delivery schedules, milestones, and dispatch details on a continuous basis.

Identify and escalate delays proactively, coordinating with vendors to expedite shipments and ensure adherence to committed timelines.

Update ERP systems and procurement tracking tools with real-time order status to ensure transparency and smooth downstream processes.

Documentation & Compliance:

Maintain comprehensive documentation for each procurement activity, including RFQs, vendor quotations, comparative statements, POs, inspection reports, and correspondence.

Ensure that all documentation complies with audit requirements and internal control guidelines.

Monitor approval workflows and maintain structured filing systems (digital or physical) for traceability and regulatory compliance.

Coordination with Internal Teams:

Collaborate with Quality Assurance / Quality Control (QA/QC) and stores personnel for Goods Receipt Note (GRN) issuance and inspection coordination.

Share timely updates on vendor performance, delivery schedules, and any deviation resolutions.

Address and resolve operational or site-level procurement issues, acting as a bridge between vendors and internal stakeholders.

Reporting & Analytics Support:

Prepare and share daily, weekly, and monthly Management Information System (MIS) reports covering PO status, deliveries, and procurement health indicators.

Support category leads with data-driven insights on cost trends, savings realization, vendor performance, and procurement efficiency metrics.

Ensure accuracy in data consolidation and highlight any deviations or improvement areas for proactive action.

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Engineering in Civil / Electrical / Mechanical / Instrumentation. Masters Degree in SCM / Project Management / Operations Management is preferred

Work Experience:

7+ years of category-specific procurement experience in infrastructure, EPC, or industrial projects

Deep understanding of various bidding process (TBCB, limited tender, open tender, conventional, any specific strategy etc.), prepare vendor selection approach and vendor evaluation criteria depending on the nature of the Sub-category

Proficiency in category strategy, Logistics, Supply Chain and Material Management ,vendor management, and working knowledge of SAP, SLM, ARIBA, or equivalent e-Auction platforms

job.title: Assistant Manager-Guest Relations
job.description:

Guest Facilitation:

Coordinate all arrival and departure activities for VVIPs, VIPs, and CIPs ensuring they have an outstanding travel experience.

Ensure seamless movement and logistics for these guests, including transportation arrangements and security protocols.

Information Dissemination and Guidance:

Oversee guest movements through the airport, collaborating with internal teams for smooth operations and tracking guest preferences via management systems.

Assist guests by providing directions and answering queries related to services and facilities.

Offer expert advice on airport services, including transportation, and customs procedures.

Continuous Improvement:

Actively participate in initiatives aimed at improving service delivery and guest relations at CSIA.

Gather guest feedback to identify areas for improvement and share insights with management for service enhancement.

Crisis Management:

Assist in managing guest-related incidents during crises by providing clear, calm information and directions to guests. Follow established protocols to ensure guest safety and escalate any critical issues to supervisors promptly, supporting the team in maintaining a safe and controlled environment.

Smooth Passenger Movement:

Manage the flow of passengers during peak times, special events, and interconnecting flights, ensuring that VIPs and CIPs experience minimal delays.

Coordinate with airport security and other departments to facilitate efficient and secure passenger movement.

Data Reporting and Generation:

Ensure timely and accurate collection, analysis, and reporting of guest feedback and service performance data. Prepare detailed reports that highlight trends, areas for improvement, and key performance metrics, presenting them to senior management for decision-making and continuous service enhancement.

job.title: Deputy Manager -C&I -O&M
job.description:
Responsibilities

Lead - Field instrumentation (Turbine)

Operational Excellence and Equipment Reliability:

Monitor the availability and functionality of all Control & Instrumentation (C&I) systems related to Turbine including UPS, DCS, SWAS, CPU systems, Governing system, ETS, HPLP Bypass, Turbine, and Auxiliaries.

Conduct routine maintenance tasks for SWAS, Motor Operated Valves (MOV), Turbine, and Auxiliaries to prevent operational disruptions.

Execute timely overhauls of units to maintain optimal performance and reduce downtime.

Troubleshoot and resolve equipment breakdowns promptly to ensure continuous operations.

Conduct scheduled calibrations of instrumentation and generate detailed reports on findings and adjustments.

Allocate necessary resources and guidance to contractor technicians for the execution of routine maintenance tasks.

Provide on-field support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Zero Forced Outage (ZFO) to enhance system reliability.

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes.

Technical and Process Improvement:

Perform periodic backups of DCS, PLC, PSI, and other turbine and auxiliary systems to safeguard operational data.

Provide technical expertise and resources to contractor technicians for routine maintenance and system upgrades.

Follow equipment checklists meticulously to maintain high standards of operation and maintenance.

Inventory Management and documentation:

Provide inputs to Team Leads for effective spares and inventory management, including the development of indigenous spares.

Manage the procurement process for equipment and services, ensuring adherence to financial guidelines.

Manage documentation and as-built drawings for the section.

Business Sustainability:

Implement and Follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department to maintain business continuity.

Implement field related of ZFO Action Items and AWMS to promote continuous improvement.

Adhere to the BPT process, technical audits, and compliance with safety regulations to ensure zero accidents and a safe working environment.

Report any unsafe conditions, acts, and near misses in the work area to prevent potential hazards.

Follow the CHETNA process and ensure all departmental compliances are met.

Ensure compliance with safety audit observations and implement corrective actions as needed.

Utilize the work permit system guidelines to manage and control work-related risks effectively.

Ensure adherence to statutory compliances and regulations.

Digitization and Automation:

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies and automation solutions to optimize operational efficiency across the department.

Implement process and system improvements by adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.

Ensure the integration of advanced technology and digitization in daily operations to improve system performance.

Drive the adoption of digital tools and platforms to streamline workflows and enhance data-driven decision-making.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Environment & Sustainability

Techno Commercial

Operations & Maintenance

Security

Stores

Support Functions

ENDORSE

ENOC

Key Stakeholders - External:

Vendor

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor's degree in C&I or Electronics & Communication.

Work Experience (Range of years):

6+ years of experience in control and instrumentation within the power generation or related industry.

Preferred Industry:

Experience in power generation, or related process industries with a focus on control and instrumentation systems.

job.title: Assistant Manager - Field Quality Assurance
job.description:
Responsibilities

Quality Assurance and Inspection:

  • Coordinate and conduct site inspections with O&M engineers as per quality procedures, codes, and standards.
  • Execute all inspection activities of BTG and BOP, including PDI of materials and spares.
  • Execute inspection of boiler, pressure parts, welding, turbine and auxiliaries.
  • Identify and inspect Boiler Tube Leakage rectification works with NDT testing and other quality procedures.
  • Conduct visual inspections and witness various Destructive and Non-Destructive Testing (DPT, MPT, UT, RT) to verify equipment integrity.
  • Execute inspections and thickness surveys of boiler pressure parts, coal bunkers, APH, HP and LP Valves, rotary parts, etc.
  • Arrange PDI inspections of procurement material/spares at vendor premises and provide MDCC (Material Dispatch Claims Certification).
  • Provide support for third-party inspections and certifications of safety equipment and healthiness of equipment.

Quality Control and Testing:

  • Conduct welder qualification tests (for both IBR and non-IBR) and maintain welder performance records.
  • Prepare, review, and approve materials, QAPs, and FQPs of various site packages.
  • Prepare and review WPS, PQR, and WPQ documents.
  • Operational Excellence and Compliance:
  • Raise NFA (Note for Approval) for deviations and modifications and obtain approval through the system.
  • Provide budget inputs and ensure the sustainability of resources and processes.

Resource Management, Training, and Innovation:

  • Provide TNI inputs and drive feedback sessions for continuous learning.
  • Provide innovative ideas and recommendations.
  • Support quality awareness training sessions for maintenance engineers and agency engineers/supervisors to foster a culture of quality and excellence at the site.
  • Manage relationships with external agencies to ensure the timely submission of bills, closure of accounts, and resolution of financial matters related to mechanical works.

Business Sustainability:

  • Implement and follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department.
  • Maintain the safety of business associates/other contractors and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols.
  • Ensure compliance with technical audits, safety audits, and business excellence assessments.
  • Implement CHETNA Safety standards in the department to achieve zero harm.
  • Conduct regular safety audits and risk assessments to identify and mitigate potential hazards.
  • Ensure compliance with all relevant environmental, health, and safety regulations and company policies.

Digitization and Automation:

  • Execute integration of advanced technology and comprehensive digitization strategies in mechanical quality assurance processes to optimize operational efficiency.
  • Implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals and strategy.
  • Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.
  • Monitor and analyse data from digital systems to inform decision-making and improve quality outcomes.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Maintenance Mechanical
  • Operations & Maintenance
  • Techno Commercial

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • Agencies and contractors

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering or a related field from a recognized institution.

Work Experience (Range of years):

6+ years of experience in quality assurance/control, with a significant portion in a leadership role within the power sector or related heavy industries.

Preferred Industry:

Candidates with experience in the power generation, energy, or related heavy industrial sectors are preferred, with a strong background in operational excellence and quality management systems.

job.title: Deputy Manager - Mine Operations (FCC)
job.description:
Responsibilities

Blasting Officer - Coal Mining

Drilling and Blasting Operations:

Develop and implement drilling patterns and blasting patterns for efficient coal seam removal.

Develop detailed blast designs and plans based on geological data, operational requirements, and safety standards.

Collaborate with mine engineers and surveyors to determine the optimal placement and quantity of explosives for each blast.*Supervise explosive handling procedures to maintain safety standards.

Manage the cost of blasting operations through the selection of the most cost-effective blasting material, creating blasting plans, and strategy development.

Prepare blast sites according to the approved blast plan, ensuring all safety measures are in place.

Drill blast holes to the specified depth and diameter, and load explosives as per the blast design.

Conduct post-blast analysis to evaluate the effectiveness of the blast and identify any areas for improvement.

Collect and analyze data on fragmentation, muckpile characteristics, and environmental impact.

Magazine Maintenance and Explosive Handling:

Ensure all explosives are stored securely in designated, compliant storage facilities.

Monitor storage conditions to prevent any safety hazards, such as temperature or humidity fluctuations.

Maintain accurate records of explosives inventory, including quantities received, used, and remaining.

Conduct regular inventory checks to ensure all explosives are accounted for and stored correctly.

Statutory Record Maintenance and Government Coordination:

Maintain accurate records of drilling and blasting activities, equipment deployment, and maintenance.

Ensure compliance with DGMS guidelines and SOPs for record-keeping.

Obtain necessary permits and approvals for blasting activities, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.

Submit periodic reports to DGMS, including monthly returns, vibration studies, load sheets, and other required documentation.

Safety and Compliance:

Lead toolbox talks to promote safety awareness among staff and contractors.

Enforce safety guidelines, environmental regulations, and mine closure/reclamation requirements.

Conduct periodic mine rounds to observe operations and ensure compliance with safety standards, including ground vibration, sound air pressure, fly rocks, and shattering effects.

Operational Efficiency and Digital Dexterity:

Collaborate with colliery engineers to optimize mine operations and achieve production targets.

Implement measures to improve productivity, reduce costs, and enhance overall operational efficiency.

Provide guidance and training to shift incharge and contract employees to foster a culture of safety and excellence.

Coordinate with cross-functional teams to deploy digital tools that align with business objectives.

Ensure the effective utilization of digital platforms to improve team efficiency and productivity.

  • Execute preventive and corrective maintenance activities on PNG pipelines equipment, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
  • Utilize diagnostic tools and techniques to monitor the condition of pipelines and infrastructure, identifying maintenance needs.
  • Coordinate with contractors and service providers to carry out maintenance tasks, ensuring adherence to safety and quality standards.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all maintenance activities, inspections, and repairs, ensuring these are readily available for review.
  • Implement best practices in maintenance management, contributing to continuous improvements in efficiency and effectiveness.

Technical Problem Solving:

  • Troubleshoot technical issues that arise during operations or maintenance activities, providing timely and effective solutions.
  • Analyze system data and performance metrics to identify potential areas for improvement and to prevent future operational disruptions.
  • Collaborate with the O&M Lead to develop and implement engineering solutions that enhance the reliability and efficiency of PNG.
  • Participate in technical meetings and reviews, offering insights and recommendations to optimize project outcomes.

job.title: Senior Manager -Enggineering
job.description:
Responsibilities

Subsystem-Level Electrical Design

  • Lead the end-to-end design and optimization of turbine electrical subsystems, focusing on high-performance inverters, control circuits, and transformer interfaces for reliable grid integration.
  • Optimize nacelle cabling layouts to reduce electromagnetic interference (EMI), minimize power losses, and improve thermal management in compact spaces.
  • Design redundant electrical pathways to enhance fault tolerance and ensure continuous turbine operation under extreme conditions.

Integration of Electrical and SCADA Systems

  • Coordinate the seamless integration of electrical components with SCADA platforms, ensuring real-time data capture, fault detection, and rapid response mechanisms.
  • Resolve compatibility issues between SCADA software and electrical subsystems, focusing on synchronization of monitoring with turbine control logic.
  • Develop protocols for optimized data flow, ensuring minimal latency and reliable system feedback loops.

Component Validation and Testing

  • Manage comprehensive testing protocols for turbine electrical components, including insulation resistance, power converter efficiency, and transformer load handling.
  • Collaborate with instrumentation teams to ensure accurate sensor placement and calibration, capturing critical performance metrics.
  • Supervise fault simulation tests, such as grid fault ride-through (FRT) events, to validate subsystem behavior under adverse conditions.

Power Conversion Optimization

  • Oversee optimization of power conversion systems by implementing harmonic distortion mitigation strategies and fine-tuning inverter control parameters.
  • Analyze power quality metrics to ensure adherence to grid compliance standards, focusing on voltage stability and transient response performance.

Failure Analysis and Corrective Actions

  • Conduct root cause failure analysis (RCFA) for electrical subsystem failures, such as converter overheating or generator insulation breakdown.
  • Define and implement corrective actions, including design modifications for improved thermal management and enhanced material selection for reliability.
  • Develop reliability improvement plans, integrating predictive maintenance schedules into operational workflows.

Collaboration with Instrumentation Teams

  • Work closely with instrumentation engineers to configure and validate sensors for monitoring voltage, current, and thermal performance across components.
  • Ensure SCADA-integrated data acquisition systems provide accurate and actionable insights into subsystem performance.
  • Lead troubleshooting efforts for sensor-related issues, ensuring minimal disruption to turbine monitoring and control.

Grid Interface and Compliance

  • Analyze grid connection points to validate voltage stability and ensure compliance with international standards, such as IEC 61400-21.
  • Develop real-time voltage and frequency regulation algorithms to support grid stability during transient and steady-state operations.

Thermal and Power Loss Analysis

  • Conduct detailed thermal performance studies for converters, transformers, and cabling, focusing on heat dissipation efficiency and thermal stability under varying loads.
  • Analyze power loss patterns in nacelle wiring, identifying hotspots and proposing improved layouts or materials to enhance efficiency.
  • Validate thermal simulations with field data to ensure subsystem performance aligns with design expectations.

Technical Reporting and Documentation

  • Prepare detailed technical reports highlighting subsystem performance evaluations, failure analyses, and actionable recommendations for improvement.
  • Document testing procedures, validation protocols, and outcomes for traceability during audits and certifications.

Mentorship and Guidance

  • Mentor junior engineers in advanced topics, such as harmonic distortion analysis and thermal management in high-voltage systems.
  • Conduct regular technical reviews of team deliverables to ensure alignment with project requirements and quality standards.
  • Develop training modules focusing on the latest advancements in electrical engineering and renewable energy technologies.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Head - Engineering
  • Head - Electrical Engineering

job.title: Senior Manager- CCR
job.description:
Responsibilities

A. CCR Production Operations & Target Delivery

  • Lead day-to-day CCR production operations to achieve planned copper rod output, quality and dispatch readiness.
  • Ensure smooth operation of shaft furnace / holding furnace, casting system, rolling mill, cooling, coiling and handling areas.
  • Monitor production plan versus actual performance, identify deviations and drive corrective actions with shift teams.
  • Optimize plant throughput, yield, availability and operating discipline while minimizing process interruptions and rework.
  • Ensure effective shift handover, daily production review, manpower deployment and shop-floor execution governance.

B. Safety, Compliance & Shop-Floor Discipline

  • Ensure adherence to safety standards, SOPs, PTW requirements, LOTO, PPE compliance and safe operating practices in CCR operations.
  • Drive hazard identification, near-miss reporting, unsafe condition closure and safety engagement with operators and contract workforce.
  • Maintain operational discipline through checklist compliance, logbook accuracy, housekeeping, 5S and process control documentation.
  • Ensure statutory, environmental and quality system compliance applicable to CCR production operations.
  • Build a safety-first operating culture across shifts through training, audits and visible shop-floor leadership.

C. Process Control, Quality & Defect Reduction

  • Maintain critical process parameters for molten copper temperature, oxygen level, casting speed, rolling conditions, cooling and surface finish.
  • Work with quality, laboratory and process teams to ensure copper rod meets required specifications for diameter, conductivity, elongation, surface quality and coil condition.
  • Analyze process deviations, rod breaks, surface defects, dimensional variation, cracks, scale formation and other quality issues.
  • Drive root-cause analysis and corrective / preventive actions for recurring process and quality failures.
  • Support process trials, standard parameter setting and improvement projects for stable CCR operations.

D. Equipment Reliability, Maintenance Coordination & Utility Interface

  • Coordinate closely with mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and utility teams for equipment health, breakdown analysis and preventive maintenance planning.
  • Monitor critical equipment including furnace, casting wheel, rolling stands, shear, coiler, cooling system, pumps, burners and material handling systems.
  • Support planned shutdown execution, equipment readiness checks, start-up preparedness and post-maintenance trial stabilization.
  • Identify reliability concerns impacting production, quality, energy consumption and safety performance.
  • Ensure timely closure of process-related maintenance observations and operational improvement actions.

E. Continuous Improvement, Cost & Team Development

  • Drive improvement initiatives for productivity, yield, energy efficiency, consumable consumption, downtime reduction and quality cost reduction.
  • Use production data, process trends, defect analysis and equipment performance inputs to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Develop SOPs, OPLs, training modules and skill-building plans for operators, technicians and shift personnel.
  • Support digitalization of production monitoring through dashboards, shift MIS, process analytics and automated reporting.
  • Build a high-performance production team focused on safety, quality, reliability, accountability and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Education Qualification:

  • B.E./B.Tech in Metallurgy, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Production or Industrial Engineering.
  • Additional qualification in Operations Management, Process Engineering, Quality Management or Manufacturing Excellence will be preferred.

Work Experience (Range of years):

  • 10–15 years of experience in copper rod / CCR operations, non-ferrous metals production, casting and rolling, process control, production planning or plant operations in large manufacturing setups.
  • Minimum 4–6 years of direct exposure to CCR plant operations, copper rod quality, furnace / casting / rolling process, shift management, troubleshooting and maintenance coordination.

job.title: Smelter Blend Planner
job.description:
Responsibilities

A. Concentrate Material Planning & Availability

  • Prepare rolling concentrate material plans by using Blend optimization model aligned with smelter, SAP, Refinery, PMR feed requirements( in line with TOR ), production targets, stock norms, and shipment schedules.
  • Monitor concentrate inventory across port, plant, yards, warehouses, and in-transit positions to ensure uninterrupted availability.
  • Coordinate with commercial and procurement teams for shipment visibility, arrival schedules, allocation plans, and supply continuity.
  • Track daily consumption, receipts, stock ageing, inventory coverage, and deviations against plan.
  • Support proactive risk mitigation for feed shortages, shipment delays, quality variations, demurrage exposure, and operational constraints.

B. Concentrate Quality, Blending & Consumption Coordination

  • Coordinate with operations, laboratory, quality, and process teams for concentrate grade, moisture, impurity levels, assay results, and blend suitability.
  • Support development of concentrate blend plans considering copper grade, impurities, process constraints, availability, and plant performance requirements.
  • Track planned versus actual feed consumption, blend deviations, quality impact, and corrective actions.
  • Maintain material master data, quality records, stock reconciliation inputs, and planning assumptions for accurate decision-making.
  • Provide planning inputs for feed optimization, process stability, and raw material utilization improvement.
  • Optimize secondary materials, internal by products etc consumption plan basis concentrate blend for best utilization of resources and guide operation team.

C. Logistics, Port Coordination & Material Movement

  • Coordinate with port, logistics, supply chain, and operations teams for vessel berthing, unloading, evacuation, storage, and internal material movement.
  • Track vessel ETA, discharge status, rake / truck movement, yard capacity, handling constraints, and dispatch priorities.
  • Support timely movement of concentrate from port to plant based on production priorities and inventory cover requirements.
  • Monitor logistics-related risks including congestion, delays, demurrage, detention, handling losses, and storage limitations.
  • Prepare daily and weekly material movement updates for planning reviews and leadership visibility.

D. Inventory Control, Reconciliation & Reporting

  • Drive structured monitoring of opening stock, receipts, consumption, closing stock, in-transit material, and inventory cover days.
  • Coordinate periodic stock reconciliation with finance, stores, operations, port, commercial, and weighbridge teams.
  • Maintain planning dashboards, MIS reports, stock ageing analysis, shipment tracker, and concentrate availability summaries.
  • Identify variances in book stock versus physical stock and support root-cause analysis with concerned stakeholders.
  • Ensure accurate and timely reporting for daily production meetings, monthly reviews, and raw material governance forums.

E. Planning Governance, Risk Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish planning discipline through daily reviews, exception reporting, escalation mechanisms, and corrective action tracking.
  • Develop scenario plans for shipment delays, quality deviations, high / low stock situations, production changes, and logistics disruptions.
  • Support digitalization of raw material planning through dashboards, automated trackers, SAP / system reports, and analytics-based decision support.
  • Drive continuous improvement in inventory accuracy, planning reliability, stock visibility, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Develop strong functional depth across concentrate planning, commercial interfaces, logistics operations, plant consumption, and inventory governance to provide reliable planning support and business continuity.

Qualifications

  • B.E./B.Tech in Metallurgy, Chemical, Mechanical, Mining, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • MBA / PG Diploma in Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Materials Management, or Business Analytics will be preferred.
  • 10–15 years of experience in raw material planning, concentrate planning, supply chain, logistics, inventory control, production planning, commercial coordination, or operations planning in metals, mining, smelting, refinery, port-linked, or heavy manufacturing industries.
  • Minimum 4–6 years of exposure to copper concentrate / bulk raw material planning, shipment tracking, inventory reconciliation, stock governance, plant consumption planning, and cross-functional coordination.

job.title: CHIEF SALES & Marketing Officer
job.description:

  • Conduct regular audits and reviews to monitor compliance with internal controls and identify areas for improvement.
  • Implement risk management strategies to mitigate potential risks associated with sales and marketing activities.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

  • Drive innovation in sales and marketing strategies and processes to stay ahead of industry trends and competitors.
  • Encourage a culture of innovation within the department, supporting initiatives that enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Evaluate new technologies and methodologies to optimize sales and marketing operations and improve ROI.

job.title: Deputy Manager - Building Management Systems (BMS)
job.description:
Responsibilities

BMS System Engineering & Maintenance:

Lead the engineering, installation, commissioning, and maintenance of BMS systems, ensuring that they operate efficiently, reliably, and in compliance with airport standards.

Oversee the day-to-day operation of BMS infrastructure, including HVAC, lighting, electrical systems, fire alarm systems, and access controls, ensuring their seamless integration with other airport systems.

Ensure continuous monitoring, testing, and updating of BMS systems to maintain optimal performance levels across all facilities.

Develop and execute maintenance schedules for BMS systems, ensuring proper preventive maintenance and minimal downtime.

Troubleshooting and Fault Resolution:

Lead troubleshooting efforts in case of system failures, quickly diagnosing faults within BMS-related systems and resolving issues with minimal disruption to airport operations.

Coordinate with engineering teams to repair or replace faulty components of BMS systems, ensuring efficient and timely resolutions.

Implement diagnostic tools and technologies to identify potential issues before they impact the operations of the airport.

Energy Efficiency and Sustainability:

Monitor and optimize energy consumption across airport facilities by utilizing BMS for HVAC systems, lighting, and electrical load management.

Implement energy-saving initiatives through BMS systems, ensuring energy optimization and contributing to the airport’s sustainability goals.

Evaluate the performance of BMS systems in managing energy usage, recommending improvements for greater cost savings and environmental benefits.

Safety and Regulatory Compliance:

Ensure that all BMS systems comply with airport-specific safety standards, industry regulations, and local environmental health and safety guidelines.

Conduct regular safety audits and inspections on BMS-related systems, ensuring proper documentation and compliance with safety standards such as fire safety, electrical safety, and hazard control.

Assist in the development and updating of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for BMS operation and maintenance to ensure a safe environment for all stakeholders.

Budget Planning & Forecasting:

Develop and manage the annual budget for BMS operations, including system maintenance, upgrades, energy-saving initiatives, and staffing.

Prepare detailed budget forecasts, considering historical data, upcoming projects, and planned system enhancements to ensure adequate financial planning.

BMS Performance Monitoring:

Lead the monitoring of BMS data for system performance, energy usage, and operational efficiency, utilizing system dashboards and reports.

Analyze system data to detect performance trends and inefficiencies, implementing corrective measures as necessary.

Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to BMS system uptime, reliability, and energy consumption to ensure continuous improvement.

Vendor and Contractor Management:

Oversee relationships with third-party vendors and contractors responsible for BMS system components or services, ensuring high-quality service delivery and compliance with contractual obligations.

Coordinate with vendors for the timely procurement of equipment, materials, and parts required for the maintenance and repair of BMS systems.

Manage vendor service level agreements (SLAs) and ensure that maintenance and repair activities are performed within specified time frames and quality standards.

Team Leadership and Development:

Lead and supervise the BMS engineering and maintenance team, providing guidance, training, and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.

Develop and implement training programs to improve the technical skills and knowledge of the BMS team.

Ensure proper documentation of maintenance activities and work orders, ensuring that team members follow industry best practices and safety guidelines.

Project Management and System Upgrades:

Lead BMS system upgrade projects, including design, installation, and commissioning, ensuring alignment with airport’s engineering objectives and timelines.

Plan and manage engineering projects related to BMS integration with other airport systems, ensuring minimal disruption to ongoing operations during implementation.

Assist in evaluating and selecting new BMS technologies and tools to enhance operational capabilities.

Reporting and Documentation:

Provide regular reports on the status and performance of BMS systems, including energy usage, maintenance activities, and system health.

Maintain detailed records of system configurations, maintenance logs, troubleshooting reports, and compliance audits to ensure transparency and accountability.

Document system updates, troubleshooting efforts, and any changes to BMS configurations, ensuring all data is current and easily accessible for future reference.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Head - Engineering Services

Maintenance Team

Facility Management Team

Operations Team

Procurement Team

Safety and Compliance Team

Project Management Team

IT Support Team

Key Stakeholders - External:

Clients/Building Owners

Contractors and Subcontractors

Equipment Vendors and Suppliers

Regulatory Authorities

Third-Party Auditors

Consultants and Design Engineers

Service Providers for System Upgrades and Maintenance

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

Certification in Building Management Systems (BMS) or similar, such as from the Building Controls Industry Association (BCIA) or equivalent

Additional certifications in HVAC, electrical systems, or energy management are a plus

Professional engineering license (depending on the country/region)

Work Experience:

10+ years of experience working with BMS systems, including hands-on installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting

Proven experience in managing teams and leading projects within the BMS or building automation industry

Strong background in working with control systems, HVAC, lighting, and energy management solutions

Experience collaborating with contractors, clients, and other engineering teams on large-scale building projects

Familiarity with industry regulations, safety standards, and energy efficiency guidelines

job.title: Associate Manager - Fire & Safety
job.description:
Responsibilities

Lead Safety

Safety Training and Campaigns:

Conduct Safety induction Training and vertigo test for new staff and workers of agencies.

Support in safety campaigns and participate in mock drills to prepare staff for emergency situations.

Conduct various EHS Training programs and track training data.

Provide support and required information for investigation of near-miss incidents and incidents to identify root causes and implement preventive measures.

Conduct awareness sessions for agency workmen to reinforce safety standards.

Track and ensure monthly safety virus campaigns to highlight and mitigate potential safety risks.

Provide support for audits and inspections- daily, weekly, monthly to maintain high safety standards and continuous improvement.

Conduct weekly "Halla Boll" at assigned area, prepare report, enter observations in GENSUITE and monitor the compliance.

Conduct Action Employee Can Take (AECT) in all PIC's.

Monitoring and Reporting:

Upload daily safety observations for the whole plant in GENSUITE.

Conduct weekly initiatives at assigned areas, prepare reports, and monitor compliance.

Prepare data for different National Awards for Safety to recognize and promote safety achievements.

Ensure the display of safety signages to maintain awareness and compliance.

Manage the availability and usage of PPEs by staff and workers of agencies at the site as per service order.

Review contractual documents of the agencies to find out safety requirements mentioned therein related to defined area.

Monitor and ensure the right type of PPE’s are being used during Jobs.

Provide input for preparation of Monthly MIS report & HO submission.

Release of special Permits like Height, Confined, Hot, Opening in Floors, Radiography,and Excavation.

Business Sustainability:

Release and audit safety work permits at assigned areas to ensure strict adherence to safety protocols.

Ensure adherence to IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department.

Ensure the safety of personnel and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols.

Prepare activities and reports for AOH/COH and monitor compliance of safety requirements.

Implement RVDTS and represent its committee.

Manage Legatrix compliance for safety regulations.

Apply for different National Awards for Safety i.e. NSC Safety award.

Digitization and Automation:

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies to optimize operational efficiency, as directed by Section Head.

Innovate and implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals/strategy.

Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

All departments

Key Stakeholders - External:

Audit agencies

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

B.Tech/BE/BSc. (preferably in Fire Safety or Chemical Engineering) or related field and mandatory Advanced Diploma.

Work Experience (Range of years):

10+ years of experience in fire safety management and operations within the power or heavy industry sector.

Preferred Industry:

Power Generation or Energy sector

job.title: Manager – Business Excellence
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage all digital transformation initiatives for the coal trading business, ensuring alignment with business objectives, operational priorities, and leadership expectations.
  • Act as the key business coordinator with the Central IT team for planning, development, implementation, and stabilization of all business-related digital projects.
  • Prepare, review, validate, and finalize Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) in consultation with business users, functional teams, and technology partners.
  • Coordinate with end users for User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test-case preparation, issue identification, feedback consolidation, closure tracking, and final business sign-off.
  • Lead IRM digital initiatives and ensure effective implementation, adoption, and value realization across relevant business functions.
  • Drive improvement in GATI project.
  • Lead and support the MITRA App initiative.
  • Deal Portal - ADMIN, including user access coordination, master-data support, process compliance, system hygiene, and issue resolution.
  • Identify, evaluate, and implement new business excellence ideas, automation opportunities, and process-improvement projects to enhance efficiency, transparency, and decision-making.
  • Carry out customer analysis, market intelligence, and competitor benchmarking to support sales strategy, customer engagement, pricing decisions, and leadership reviews.
  • Prepare customer intelligence reports, business insights, and analytical summaries based on internal data, market trends, customer behavior, and business performance indicators.
  • Develop and maintain standardized business presentations for internal reviews, leadership meetings, customer discussions, marketing events, and strategic business updates.
  • Create, maintain, and improve business dashboards covering sales, operations, customer performance, project status, KPIs, market trends, and other key business metrics.
  • Coordinate with sales, sourcing, finance, operations, logistics, compliance, and other cross-functional teams to collect inputs, validate data, and ensure accuracy of reports and dashboards.
  • Monitor progress of ongoing digital and business excellence projects through structured trackers, timelines, status reports, issue logs, and periodic review mechanisms.
  • Support business leadership with data-driven insights, MIS reports, performance analysis, and actionable recommendations for faster and better decision-making.
  • Act as media and marketing coordinator for the IRM business, including coordination for LinkedIn account updates, business communication content, branding support, and digital media activities.
  • Plan, coordinate, and support marketing events, customer meets, conferences, media interactions, business campaigns, and other brand-building initiatives for the coal trading business.
  • Create a standardized format and template library for business presentations, review decks, customer proposals, leadership updates, project status reports, MIS reports, and event-related communication material.

Qualifications

Qualification

  • B.E./B.Tech (Computer Science, IT, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering)
  • MBA (Operations / Systems / Business Analytics / Marketing) from a reputed institute will be added as an advantage.
  • Strong proficiency in MS Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, SAP, CRM, and digital platforms.

Experience

  • 8-12 years of experience in Digital Transformation, Business Excellence, Project Management, Business Analytics, MIS, or Process Improvement roles.
  • Experience in Trading, Mining, Commodities, Energy, Coal, Logistics, Supply Chain, or Industrial sectors preferred.

job.title: Team Manager - FP&A
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Lead the annual budgeting, strategic planning, and rolling forecast processes by partnering with business leaders to develop robust financial and operational plans aligned with organizational objectives.
  • Drive monthly business performance reviews by providing insightful analysis of financial and operational results, key trends, risks, opportunities, and strategic recommendations.
  • Act as a trusted finance business partner to senior stakeholders, supporting critical decision-making through financial modelling, scenario analysis, investment evaluations, and business case development.
  • Oversee the preparation and review of management reports, board presentations, and executive dashboards, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and actionable insights.
  • Lead financial performance management initiatives by identifying cost optimization opportunities, productivity improvements, and value creation levers across the business.
  • Drive FP&A transformation, digitization, and automation initiatives to enhance reporting efficiency, analytical capabilities, governance, and decision support.
  • Establish and strengthen financial planning frameworks, reporting standards, and governance processes to ensure compliance, data integrity, and operational excellence.
  • Manage complex cross-functional projects and coordinate with finance, operations, commercial, and corporate teams to support strategic business priorities.
  • Provide leadership, coaching, and mentorship to junior and mid-level team members while fostering a high-performance, collaborative, and continuously improving FP&A culture.
  • Support senior leadership in evaluating strategic initiatives, growth opportunities, risks, and business performance through advanced analytics and data-driven insights.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Finance, Commerce, Accounting, Economics, or Business Administration with professional qualifications such as CA, CMA, MBA (Finance), or equivalent.
  • 12-16 years of progressive experience in FP&A, Business Finance, Corporate Finance, Performance Management, Budgeting, Forecasting, and Strategic Financial Planning.
  • Strong expertise in financial modeling, business partnering, strategic planning, performance analysis, management reporting, and driving business insights for senior leadership.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP/Oracle), planning and reporting tools (SAC, Power BI, Tableau, Hyperion, etc.), and leading finance transformation or automation initiatives.
  • Demonstrated leadership, stakeholder management, and team development capabilities with the ability to influence decision-making, manage cross-functional initiatives, and drive organizational performance improvements.
  • People and Team manager skills.

job.title: Lead - C&I Maintenance
job.description:
Responsibilities

Lead - DCS\_PLC (Distributed Control System\_ Programmable Logic Control)

System Reliability and Maintenance:

Ensure the availability and functioning of all control loops in auto mode, maintaining reliability of equipment protection under BTG.

Schedule and execute regular backups of DCS and PLC systems to prevent data loss.

Perform routine maintenance and troubleshooting of DCS and PLC hardware to minimize downtime.

Monitor system alarms daily and ensure the healthiness and redundancy of systems.

Coordinate with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) for annual maintenance activities and system upgrades.

Manage the proper functioning of Operator Workstations (OWS) and Engineering Workstations (EWS).

Maintain periodical backups and availability of historian systems for data integrity and recovery.

Hardware and Software Management:

Manage the availability of DCS and PLC hardware and software, including necessary spares for emergency replacements.

Maintain up-to-date DCS and PLC licenses and manage renewals to avoid operational disruptions.

Conduct patch updates of DCS and PLC software to address vulnerabilities and enhance system performance.

Upgrade DCS and PLC systems proactively to prevent obsolescence and maintain compatibility with new technologies.

Network and Cybersecurity:

Manage the storage, backup, and restoration of systems in compliance with cybersecurity policies.

Ensure the healthiness and redundancy of the DCS and PLC network, preventing single points of failure.

Oversee the transfer of data to third-party systems, such as Pi servers, ensuring secure and reliable communication.

Review and strengthen network security measures to protect against cyber threats and unauthorized access.

Business Sustainability:

Implement and Follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department.

Promote the safety of personnel and equipment through rigorous training and strict adherence to safety protocols.

Implement risk management practices to mitigate potential hazards and ensure operational continuity.

Develop and maintain emergency response plans to address potential incidents swiftly and effectively.

Ensure adherence to statutory compliances and regulations.

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes.

Provide support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Zero Forced Outage (ZFO) to enhance system reliability.

Implement field related ZFO action items and AWMS for continuous improvement in maintenance practices.

.

Digitization and Automation:

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies and automation solutions to optimize operational efficiency.

Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.

Drive the implementation of digital transformation initiatives.

Analyse data trends and system performance to identify opportunities for automation and digitization enhancements.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Environment & Sustainability

Techno Commercial

Operations & Maintenance

Security

Stores

Support Functions

ENDORSE

ENOC

Key Stakeholders - External:

Vendor

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor's degree in C&I or Electronics & Communication or equivalent degree.

Work Experience (Range of years):

6+ years of experience in industrial automation, specifically with DCS and PLC systems.

Preferred Industry:

Experience in the power generation, petrochemical, oil and gas, or heavy industrial sectors.

job.title: Brand on Digital Manager
job.description:
Responsibilities

Brand Strategy Leadership:

Design and lead the execution of advanced branding strategies, aligning them with overarching business objectives & utilize in-depth market research, brand positioning analysis, and competitive benchmarking to formulate campaigns targeting diverse audiences.

Integrate cross-platform approaches, including traditional and digital media channels, to enhance brand visibility and perception with high-level budget allocations, resource planning, and milestone-setting for key campaigns.

Content Ecosystem Development:

Develop a robust content ecosystem that spans multimedia formats, from video and infographics to long-form editorial content & guide teams in crafting narratives that resonate with specific audience segments while staying true to the corporate brand identity.

Ensure content complies with emerging industry standards, including accessibility and SEO optimization, while pioneering innovations in content presentation and user engagement tactics.

Social Media and Digital Branding Governance:

Define the strategic roadmap for corporate social media engagement, encompassing platform selection, content themes, and annual calendar planning to approve and monitor top-tier campaigns that involve significant investment or reputation impact.

Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) for social platforms, tracking metrics with sophisticated tools like Sprout Social or Hootsuite & drive efforts to capitalize on new-age platforms like metaverse branding or AR/VR experiences.

Data-Driven Brand Insights:

Lead initiatives to extract actionable insights from multi-channel branding efforts, utilizing tools like Tableau or advanced CRM analytics by studying user behaviors, preferences, and patterns to refine ongoing campaigns.

Propose data-backed modifications in brand positioning and outreach efforts to C-suite executives, ensuring strategic decisions are grounded in accurate, real-time analytics.

High-Impact Campaign Leadership:

Spearhead high-visibility campaigns such as corporate rebranding, mergers and acquisitions communication, and crisis management initiatives & develop the strategic framework and oversee operational execution to ensure measurable impact.

Employ advanced project management tools like Asana or Jira to manage timelines, resources, and deliverables, ensuring seamless coordination across multiple stakeholders.

Brand Consistency Authority:

Act as the final authority on brand guidelines and their application, resolving disputes or ambiguities in brand representation across marketing and communication channels.

Champion corporate identity adherence during collaborations with external agencies, ensuring third-party outputs align with internal standards and values.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Corporate Communications Team

Marketing Team

Digital Media Team

Content Development Team

Senior Management

Finance Department

Legal and Compliance Team

IT and Technology Support

Key Stakeholders - External:

Advertising Agencies

Creative Vendors

Social Media Platforms

Media Houses

Event Management Firms

Government Advertising and Media Regulatory Bodies

Brand Strategy Consultants

Digital Marketing Suppliers

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, or Business Administration from a recognized institution is essential.

Certifications in advanced digital marketing, brand strategy, or media planning are highly desirable.

Extensive knowledge of digital branding, analytics platforms, and emerging trends in social media ecosystems is required to drive strategic initiatives.

Work Experience:

13+ years of proven experience in branding, communication, or digital strategy roles, preferably within large corporate or multinational settings.

Demonstrated expertise in managing high-impact branding campaigns, overseeing digital advertising budgets, and leading cross-functional branding projects is essential for this role.

job.title: Assistant Manager - Techno Commercial
job.description:
Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities of Role

Purchase to Receipt Process Execution:

  • Process purchase requisitions (PR) and convert them into purchase orders (PO) as per approved workflows in SAP/Ariba.
  • Coordinate with suppliers for order acknowledgments
  • Support PO amendments, cancellations, and extension processes in alignment with business needs and approvals.

Post-PO Process Compliance & Coordination:

  • Maintain compliance with Delegation of Authority (DOA), tax (GST, eWay bill), and statutory requirements during procurement execution.

Operational Reporting & Issue Resolution:

  • Support root cause analysis (RCA) for any delays, process gaps, or data errors in the P2D cycle.
  • Escalate unresolved issues to the Lead – Purchase to Deliver for timely closure.
  • Ensure adherence to SLAs/KPIs related to procurement transaction processing.

Stakeholder & Vendor Support:

  • Act as the first point of contact for vendor BU TC queries on PO status, dispatch readiness, and payment eligibility post-receipt.
  • Coordinate internally with business unit procurement, operations, and finance teams for procurement clarifications.
  • Support process improvement initiatives and automation testing within procurement workflows. Implement Issue and Escalation Tracker and log. Ensure timely closure of all improvement – corrective/preventive actions

Work with GCC TC Head to initiate, implement and monitor all continuous improvement projects relevant for operational performance improvement

  • Implement capacity management and operations business continuity management plans to ensure uninterrupted delivery to assigned Sector business.

Qualifications

  • Graduate degree in Engineering, Commerce, or Management.
  • Certifications in Procurement, Techno-Commercial Operations, or Supply Chain (preferred).
  • Work Experience: 2–5 years of experience in procurement operations, purchase order processing, or techno-commercial functions.

job.title: Assistant Manager - Techno Commercial
job.description:
Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities of Role

Purchase to Receipt Process Execution:

  • Process purchase requisitions (PR) and convert them into purchase orders (PO) as per approved workflows in SAP/Ariba.
  • Coordinate with suppliers for order acknowledgments
  • Support PO amendments, cancellations, and extension processes in alignment with business needs and approvals.

Post-PO Process Compliance & Coordination:

  • Maintain compliance with Delegation of Authority (DOA), tax (GST, eWay bill), and statutory requirements during procurement execution.

Operational Reporting & Issue Resolution:

  • Support root cause analysis (RCA) for any delays, process gaps, or data errors in the P2D cycle.
  • Escalate unresolved issues to the Lead – Purchase to Deliver for timely closure.
  • Ensure adherence to SLAs/KPIs related to procurement transaction processing.

Stakeholder & Vendor Support:

  • Act as the first point of contact for vendor BU TC queries on PO status, dispatch readiness, and payment eligibility post-receipt.
  • Coordinate internally with business unit procurement, operations, and finance teams for procurement clarifications.
  • Support process improvement initiatives and automation testing within procurement workflows. Implement Issue and Escalation Tracker and log. Ensure timely closure of all improvement – corrective/preventive actions

Work with GCC TC Head to initiate, implement and monitor all continuous improvement projects relevant for operational performance improvement

  • Implement capacity management and operations business continuity management plans to ensure uninterrupted delivery to assigned Sector business.

Qualifications

  • Graduate degree in Engineering, Commerce, or Management.
  • Certifications in Procurement, Techno-Commercial Operations, or Supply Chain (preferred).
  • Work Experience: 2–5 years of experience in procurement operations, purchase order processing, or techno-commercial functions.

job.title: IMS Lead - Business Excellence
job.description:
Responsibilities

IMS Framework Design and Integration:

Design and integrate a comprehensive Integrated Management System (IMS) that aligns with ISO standards (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and organizational objectives.

Ensure the IMS framework integrates quality, environmental, and occupational health and safety management systems into a cohesive structure that enhances operational efficiency and regulatory compliance, leverage industry best practices and technological advancements to create a robust and scalable IMS.

System Architecture and Process Optimization:

Develop and refine the architecture of the IMS to support seamless integration across various management systems.

Focus on process optimization by implementing advanced methodologies such as Lean Six Sigma and Business Process Management (BPM), utilize process mapping and simulation tools to identify inefficiencies and enhance process performance, ensuring that the IMS supports continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Risk Management and Compliance Integration:

Integrate comprehensive risk management practices within the IMS to proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks.

Implement advanced risk assessment tools and techniques, including probabilistic risk analysis and scenario planning, to ensure robust risk management, ensure that the IMS supports compliance with local, national, and international regulations by embedding compliance checks and controls within the system.

Performance Monitoring and Data Analytics:

Establish advanced performance monitoring mechanisms using data analytics and real-time dashboards.

Implement Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of the IMS and its impact on organizational performance, utilize data analytics platforms and business intelligence tools to analyze performance trends, identify areas for improvement, and drive data-driven decision-making.

Audit and Assurance Processes:

Develop and manage rigorous internal and external audit processes to ensure the integrity and effectiveness of the IMS, implement automated audit management systems to streamline audit processes, track findings, and ensure timely corrective actions.

Coordinate with certification bodies and regulatory agencies to maintain compliance and certification status.

Technology Integration and System Upgrades:

Lead the integration of advanced technologies and digital solutions within the IMS to enhance system functionality and efficiency.

Explore and implement emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), and blockchain to improve data accuracy, process automation, and system interoperability, plan and execute system upgrades to ensure the IMS remains current with technological advancements and industry standards.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Senior Leadership Team

Department SPOCs

Operations Team

Key Stakeholders - External:

External Auditors

Industry Certification Bodies

Regulatory Agencies

Consultants

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Engineering or a related field

Master’s degree in Business Administration (MBA) or relevant certification in Operations Excellence (preferred)

Work Experience:

8+ years of experience in managing integrated management systems

Certifications in IMS standards (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO 14001, OHSAS 18001)
