job.title: Lead - Field instrumentation (Turbine)
job.description:
Responsibilities

Lead - Field instrumentation (Turbine)

Operational Excellence and Equipment Reliability:

Monitor the availability and functionality of all Control & Instrumentation (C&I) systems related to Turbine including UPS, DCS, SWAS, CPU systems, Governing system, ETS, HPLP Bypass, Turbine, and Auxiliaries.

Conduct routine maintenance tasks for SWAS, Motor Operated Valves (MOV), Turbine, and Auxiliaries to prevent operational disruptions.

Execute timely overhauls of units to maintain optimal performance and reduce downtime.

Troubleshoot and resolve equipment breakdowns promptly to ensure continuous operations.

Conduct scheduled calibrations of instrumentation and generate detailed reports on findings and adjustments.

Allocate necessary resources and guidance to contractor technicians for the execution of routine maintenance tasks.

Provide on-field support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Zero Forced Outage (ZFO) to enhance system reliability.

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes.

Technical and Process Improvement:

Perform periodic backups of DCS, PLC, PSI, and other turbine and auxiliary systems to safeguard operational data.

Provide technical expertise and resources to contractor technicians for routine maintenance and system upgrades.

Follow equipment checklists meticulously to maintain high standards of operation and maintenance.

Inventory Management and documentation:

Provide inputs to Team Leads for effective spares and inventory management, including the development of indigenous spares.

Manage the procurement process for equipment and services, ensuring adherence to financial guidelines.

Manage documentation and as-built drawings for the section.

Business Sustainability:

Implement and Follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department to maintain business continuity.

Implement field related of ZFO Action Items and AWMS to promote continuous improvement.

Adhere to the BPT process, technical audits, and compliance with safety regulations to ensure zero accidents and a safe working environment.

Report any unsafe conditions, acts, and near misses in the work area to prevent potential hazards.

Follow the CHETNA process and ensure all departmental compliances are met.

Ensure compliance with safety audit observations and implement corrective actions as needed.

Utilize the work permit system guidelines to manage and control work-related risks effectively.

Ensure adherence to statutory compliances and regulations.

Digitization and Automation:

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies and automation solutions to optimize operational efficiency across the department.

Implement process and system improvements by adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.

Ensure the integration of advanced technology and digitization in daily operations to improve system performance.

Drive the adoption of digital tools and platforms to streamline workflows and enhance data-driven decision-making.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Environment & Sustainability

Techno Commercial

Operations & Maintenance

Security

Stores

Support Functions

ENDORSE

ENOC

Key Stakeholders - External:

Vendor

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor's degree in C&I or Electronics & Communication.

Work Experience (Range of years):

6+ years of experience in control and instrumentation within the power generation or related industry.

Preferred Industry:

Experience in power generation, or related process industries with a focus on control and instrumentation systems.

job.title: Lead - SCADA (E&M)
job.description:
Responsibilities

Maintenance and Operation of SCADA Systems:

Conduct regular maintenance checks on assigned SCADA systems within specific plant segments, ensuring they run smoothly and efficiently by performing system diagnostics, software updates, and addressing any minor technical issues to prevent interruptions in operations.

Identify and troubleshoot any technical malfunctions in the SCADA systems, collaborating with other team members if necessary to resolve issues quickly and prevent unplanned downtime, which could impact plant productivity and safety.

Network Security and Protocol Management:

Regularly monitor and configure network security protocols within the SCADA system to ensure safe and uninterrupted data transfer across different plant sections by managing firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and encryption protocols that protect sensitive information.

Set up, configure, and maintain essential SCADA-related infrastructure, such as servers, switches, and routers, to provide a secure and stable network environment that supports the SCADA system and prevents unauthorized access or data breaches.

Technical Support for Business Development:

Act as a technical advisor to the sales and business development teams, providing insights on SCADA system functionalities and potential upgrades that align with client needs by giving input on the feasibility, cost, and benefits of different SCADA solutions to aid in sales strategies and client presentations.

Engage in discussions about emerging technologies in SCADA and related control systems, communicating potential benefits to the business development team to support marketing initiatives and promote advanced solutions that could attract new clients.

Technical Review and Vendor Communication:

Review technical specifications, industry standards, and product brochures when considering SCADA software purchases from vendors and carefully evaluate these documents to confirm the software meets plant requirements, is compatible with existing systems, and aligns with regulatory standards for SCADA.

Maintain open communication with vendors, discussing product capabilities, licensing terms, and support services to ensure any SCADA system acquisitions are well-understood, fully documented, and meet the plant's current and future technical needs.

SCADA System Programming and Development:

Assist in developing user-friendly SCADA screens, custom databases, and reporting tools that enable efficient monitoring and analysis of plant data by designing clear, responsive interfaces that give operators real-time access to critical information and streamline workflows.

Configure and manage SCADA system networks to support data integration across various plant segments.

Safety and Compliance Management:

Ensure that all SCADA system operations adhere to established safety protocols, regulatory standards, and industry best practices by routine checks and updates to safety features and compliance documentation, which help protect both personnel and equipment.

Maintain accurate documentation for all licenses, support contracts, and compliance-related records associated with SCADA software and hardware to avoid compliance issues, supports system audits, and ensures clear tracking of all SCADA-related liabilities and assets.

Data Analysis and Reporting:

Collect and analyze SCADA data to generate insights into system performance, energy consumption, and operational efficiency.

Develop and deliver detailed reports to management, including recommendations for system improvements.

Maintain accurate logs of system events, alarms, and incidents for audit and compliance purposes.

Energy Efficiency and Sustainability:

Use SCADA data to identify opportunities for energy conservation and sustainable practices.

Implement advanced control strategies to reduce energy waste and optimize resource utilization.

Collaborate with the Energy Management team to achieve airport-wide energy reduction goals.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Lead -MEPF

Plant Operations Team

Maintenance Team

IT/Network Security Team

Sales and Business Development Team

Engineering Department

Compliance and Safety Team

Key Stakeholders - External:

SCADA Software Vendors

Network and Hardware Suppliers

Regulatory Authorities

Third-Party Service Providers

Industry Consultants

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Control Systems, or a related field

Certifications in SCADA systems, Industrial Automation, or Network Security (preferred)

Work Experience:

5-7 years of experience in SCADA systems maintenance, operations, or control systems engineering in an industrial or plant setting

Experience with network configuration, server management, and troubleshooting in SCADA environments

Familiarity with industry standards, compliance protocols, and technical documentation

job.description:

•Assist colleagues whenever necessary.

Any Graduate + MBA preferably in HR

Experience - 8 to 12 years.

job.title: Associate Vice President - Techno Commercial
job.description:
Responsibilities

Strategy, Planning, and Governance:

  • Formulate and implement the Techno-Commercial strategy and plan at BU level to align with the Chairman’s vision and CPO guidelines.
  • Design the BU Techno-Commercial function structure and team organization at BU and Site levels to ensure alignment with business strategy and organizational principles.
  • Define and implement SOPs and guidelines for BU-specific Techno-Commercial processes to ensure standardized and efficient operations.
  • Monitor adherence to governance protocols, report on KPIs, and ensure compliance with audit & risk management processes to maintain process integrity and address gaps.

Core Procurement Activities

  • Oversee procurement plans and strategic sourcing for Common and BU-specific CapEx, OpEx & Services to ensure optimal vendor selection and procurement efficiency.
  • Approve sourcing channels and plans, and lead vendor evaluation, negotiation, and contract preparation to ensure compliance with standards and requirements.
  • Review and approve contract documents for selected vendors to ensure clear and enforceable agreements.
  • Ensure timely and accurate order placement and manage post-order activities to maintain supply chain efficiency.

Supplier Management:

  • Govern vendor performance management mechanisms and evaluations for BU-specific vendors to ensure quality and reliability.
  • Ensure vendor performance is evaluated and feedback is communicated effectively to foster continuous improvement.
  • Establish and maintain strong vendor relationships and engagement mechanisms to drive continuous improvement and long-term benefits.

Data Management and Logistics:

  • Spearhead data analysis for BU-specific procurement activities to identify efficiency and value improvement opportunities.
  • Oversee inventory control, logistics planning, and third-party agency selection to ensure effective material management and cost-effective operations.

People Management:

  • Implement the Techno-Commercial organization structure and formulate manpower plans to meet current and future talent requirements.
  • Drive talent acquisition, performance management, and capability development initiatives to build a competent and motivated Techno-Commercial team.
  • Foster a collaborative and high-performance culture through coaching, mentoring, and engagement initiatives to promote a positive work environment and continuous improvement.

Technology and IT Enablement:

  • Identify technology enablement/automation requirements for Techno-Commercial processes to enhance efficiency.
  • Spearhead the adoption of advanced digital tools and technologies to enhance overall operational efficiency and drive innovation in TCD operations.
  • Drive development and implementation of BU-specific Techno-Commercial IT applications and platforms to improve process efficiency and standardize procurement solutions across BUs.

Business Head/CEO

Chief Procurement Officer (CPO)

Vendors

External agencies

Bachelor's degree in engineering with a Master's degree preferred in business administration, supply chain management, operations, finance or a related area

job.title: Deputy Manager - Finance & Accounts
job.description:
Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

  • Lead annual budgeting, periodic forecasting, and rolling forecast processes for assigned business units or functions.
  • Develop and maintain driver‑based financial models for revenue, margins, headcount, Opex, and Capex.
  • Identify risks and opportunities through proactive financial analysis and scenario planning.

Performance Management & Analysis

  • Analyze actuals versus budget, forecast, and prior periods to identify key performance drivers.
  • Provide clear and concise financial commentary and insights to senior management.
  • Monitor business KPIs and link operational performance with financial outcomes.

Management Reporting & MIS

  • Prepare and review monthly management reports, dashboards, and executive presentations.
  • Ensure accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of financial data used for reporting.
  • Standardize and automate MIS reporting using advanced analytical tools.

Business Partnering

  • Act as a finance business partner to functional leaders (Sales, Operations, HR, Technology, etc.).
  • Support strategic initiatives through what‑if analysis, ROI assessments, and profitability analysis.
  • Drive cost optimization initiatives and support productivity improvement programs.

Month-End & Close Support

  • Partner with accounting teams to validate actuals, accruals, and allocations from an FP&A perspective.
  • Ensure alignment between management reporting and statutory financials.

Process Improvement & Transformation

  • Drive standardization, simplification, and automation of FP&A processes.
  • Support finance transformation initiatives, system enhancements, and reporting automation.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the FP&A function.

Team Leadership (if applicable)

  • Guide, review, and mentor FP&A analysts.
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timely delivery of outputs.

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications

  • CA / CMA / MBA (Finance) preferred
  • M.Com with strong FP&A experience may be considered

Experience

  • 5–10 years of relevant experience in FP&A / Business Finance / Management Reporting
  • Experience in GCC, Shared Services, or Corporate FP&A environments preferred
  • Hands‑on exposure to budgeting, forecasting, and business partnering
  • Prior experience in stakeholder management and cross‑functional collaboration

job.title: Lead - Sales & Marketing
job.description:
Responsibilities

Executive - Closing

Prospecting and Lead Generation:

Proactively identify and qualify leads in designated markets through high-volume B2B and B2C sales calls.

Aggressively seek new business opportunities and expand the client network to rapidly achieve revenue targets.

Continuously drive urgency for repurchase and referrals, ensuring a strong and fast-moving sales pipeline.

Client Engagement and Relationship Management:

Swiftly attend to customers, negotiate effectively, and close deals within defined timelines to meet month-on-month revenue goals.

Ensure immediate follow-ups to maintain engagement and convert interest into sales without delay.

Proactively push for faster closures through regular meetings with channel partners, driving engagement and empanelment for increased business.

Sales Process and Support:

Work with a sense of urgency alongside the Team Lead to convert proposals into confirmed sales through quick and effective site visits.

Minimize decision delays by actively addressing customer concerns and ensuring rapid communication of product knowledge.

Drive fast-tracked customer engagement, resolving queries immediately and ensuring smooth movement through the sales funnel.

Industry Awareness:

Keep abreast of relevant competitor details, including price movements, construction activity, key trends, and market dynamics.

Network effectively with peer teams and industry contacts to stay updated on key developments and potential business opportunities.

Liaise with various departments to gain deeper product knowledge and insights.

Team Collaboration:

Support peer teams in effective deal closure, ensuring all required documents (legal agreements, billing, credit, etc.) are in place and monitor collections for designated accounts.

Coordinate with departments (Customer Care, Sales & Marketing, Projects, etc.) to ensure exceptional customer service and experience.

Systems and Process Compliance:

Maintain accurate records for designated accounts and share regular updates with the Team Lead and Area Sales Manager.

Ensure thorough adherence to SFDC and lead tracking mechanisms as required.

Comply with the highest standards of Sales Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), policies, and processes.

Financial Management:

Maintain accurate records for designated accounts and provide regular updates to the Segment Head.

Monitor collections for designated accounts and ensure timely payments.

Strategic Sales Management:

Drive the overall sales strategy for the region, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and AOP targets.

Analyze market trends to identify opportunities for growth and expansion.

Collaborate with project heads to set clear sales objectives and performance metrics to achieve the broader organizational objectives.

Operational Oversight:

Ensure all project sites within the cluster are running smoothly and efficiently as per the plan.

Ensure regular visits are conducted to each site to assess performance and provide guidance, wherever necessary.

Implement standardized processes across sites to enhance operational efficiency.

Oversee the performance of Channel Partners (CP) within the cluster, ensuring that regular engagement and meetings are conducted to drive business results.

Monitor CP performance metrics and facilitate improvements as necessary.

New Business Development:

Identify and pursue new business opportunities at each project site.

Leverage existing client relationships and market insights to generate leads.

Encourage project heads to actively participate in B2B and B2C sales initiatives.

Develop and implement go-to-market (GTM) strategies for new product launches, and work with the CRM team for creation of right pricing and offers.

Coordinate marketing discussions to determine the best channels for advertising.

Stakeholder Liaison:

• Liaise with internal and Key Stakeholders - External:, including site engineers and CRM teams, to ensure seamless project execution and address any operational challenges.

• Establish effective communication channels to facilitate timely updates and feedback.

• Work collaboratively with various departments to optimize customer service and operational support.

Financial Performance Management

• Monitor topline performance across all projects within the cluster and provide regular updates to senior management.

• Analyze sales data to identify trends and undertake strategic decisions, to support the business.

• Adjust pricing strategies based on market conditions and competitive landscape.

Team Leadership and Development

• Lead, mentor, and support project heads and sales teams to achieve their targets.

• Foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and accountability

Compliance and Reporting

• Ensure adherence to organizational policies and sales SOPs across all projects.

• Maintain accurate records of sales activities and provide regular reports to management• Provide ongoing guidance to the team to ensure they are well-equipped to meet business objectives.

• Ensure team engagement, motivation, and consistent drive towards achieving set targets.

job.title: Associate Manager - Survey
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Survey Planning and Execution:

-

  • Plan and execute surveys, considering environmental factors for accuracy. Allocate resources and follow project goals.

-

  • Data Acquisition and Processing:

-

  • Conduct advanced hydrographic surveys. Track sediment and hazards for dredging and safety.

-

  • Mapping and Modelling:

-

  • Create detailed underwater maps and models. Use software like Hypack and AutoCAD for informative charts.

-

  • Tidal Analysis:

-

  • Analyze tidal data to ensure consistent depth measurements. Adjust for tidal effects in dredging operations.

-

  • Equipment Maintenance:

-

  • Keep survey equipment ready and calibrated. Schedule maintenance and stay technologically current.

-

  • Survey Data Management:

-

  • Organize data storage and backups. Standardize data formats for easy use.

-

  • Quality Control and Assurance:

-

  • Enforce quality control for reliable data. Calibrate equipment and validate data regularly.

-

  • Documentation and Reporting:

-

  • Manage data integrity and accessibility. Deliver comprehensive reports to stakeholders efficiently.

-

  • Budget Control:

-

  • Work with survey heads on budgeting. Control costs and ensure cost-effective resource use.

-

  • Continuous Improvement:

-

  • Evaluate and improve survey processes. Incorporate advancements for better efficiency and precision.

Digital Mindset:

  • Keep up with digital and AI advancements to enhance business and maintain competitiveness.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Head of Section - Survey
  • Project managers
  • Works managers
  • Dredge in charges

Prepare CAPEX and OPEX budgets for the mining department, including monthly MIS and provision preparation.

job.title: Manager
job.description:
Responsibilities

Safety and Compliance:

  • Ensure that all gas and chemical operations meet safety regulations and industry standards. Conduct audits and risk assessments to identify hazards, implement corrective actions, and mitigate risks.

Digitalization/Data-Driven Decision Making:

  • Overseeing the implementation of digital tools and smart technologies to optimize manufacturing processes and enhance data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Organizational & Culture Building:

  • Fostering a collaborative, agile culture that aligns with company values, driving employee engagement, and ensuring organizational growth and development.

Leadership in Change Management:

  • Leading effective change management strategies to guide the organization through transitions, ensuring smooth adoption of new processes and technologies.

Bulk Gas System Management:

  • Oversee the management of bulk gas systems, including their handling, storage, and distribution. Ensure adherence to safety protocols, and conduct regular inspections and maintenance to prevent leaks and maintain operational efficiency.

  • Supervise the storage, handling, and application of specialty chemicals. Ensure compliance with relevant regulations and develop safe use and disposal procedures.

  • Direct the operation and maintenance of gas systems to ensure safe and efficient handling. Perform regular inspections and maintenance to prevent leaks and ensure safety compliance.

  • Oversee chemical processes, including their handling, storage, and application. Develop procedures for safe use and waste management to meet environmental and safety standards.

Process Innovation:

  • Lead the development of efficient, eco-friendly chemical and gas processes to boost yield and sustainability.

System Optimization:

  • Enhance the efficiency and performance of gas and chemical systems through data analysis and process improvements. Collaborate on system upgrades to boost reliability and reduce costs.

Training and Development:

  • Develop and deliver training programs on safe gas and chemical handling and emergency procedures. Conduct drills and ensure that personnel are well-versed in safety protocols.

Team Development:

  • Foster a respectful and safe work environment. Lead effective teams, mentor team members, and promote professional growth and success.

People Development:

Proven track record in managing maintenance teams, implementing maintenance strategies, and driving operational efficiency. Demonstrated ability to lead and develop maintenance teams.

job.title: Completion Engineer
job.description:
Responsibilities

Lead - Completion Engineer

Completion Engineering and Operations:

• Design, plan, and execute completion engineering operations to achieve well objectives on time and within budget while minimizing environmental impact.

• Conduct engineering analyses to ensure completion designs meet well objectives efficiently, focusing on sand face completion concept selection, tubing stress analysis, and completion fluids.

Compliance and Standards:

• Ensure all completion activities adhere to AWEL policies and relevant safety, health, and environmental regulations.

• Carry out risk assessments for completion operations and communicate findings to relevant personnel.

Technical Documentation and Support:

• Assist in preparing Technical Scopes of Work for third-party services and completion rig contracts, aligned with the tendering strategy.

• Lead technical evaluations of third-party services and completion contracts.

Collaboration and Communication:

• Organize onshore and offshore Completion Work Optimization Plans (CWOP) meetings to familiarize key personnel with completion plans.

• Maintain computer models to track and predict key completion parameters and performance metrics.

Post-Completion Activities:

• Compile well recaps, including the Final Well Report, and facilitate post-well review meetings to capture lessons learned.

• Develop and maintain comprehensive well files and performance tracking in accordance with established formats.

Project Leadership:

• Collaborate with various E&P disciplines to ensure effective interaction and coordination throughout the completion process.

• Lead performance improvement initiatives, including operational scheduling, requisitions, and technical documentation preparation.

Cost Estimation and Budgeting:

• Develop completion operation cost estimates to support well Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) preparation.

• Compile necessary completion engineering documentation for partner reviews, audits, and well examinations.

job.title: Deputy General Manager (Safety)
job.description:
Responsibilities

HSE Governance and Compliance:

Develop a comprehensive occupational health and safety management system aligned with ISO 45001:2018, tailored to the specific risks and operational requirements of hydro PSP sites, and ensure its consistent implementation.

Conduct detailed safety audits, identify compliance gaps, and work collaboratively with site teams to close observations, ensuring adherence to both statutory and group-level safety standards.

Risk Management and Mitigation:

Regularly update the Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment (HIRA) framework based on incident learnings and site-specific observations to proactively address potential risks and hazards.

Develop and implement detailed Fatality Prevention Plans (FPP) for high-risk activities, ensuring the adoption of preventive measures to eliminate hazards before they escalate.

Incident Prevention and Response:

Lead the investigation of incidents, near-misses, and unsafe acts, using root cause analysis methodologies to derive actionable insights and prevent recurrence of similar events.

Create comprehensive incident reports that include learnings and corrective actions, sharing these insights across all Hydro PSP sites to promote organizational awareness and continuous improvement.

Employee Training and Skill Development:

Organize specialized training sessions tailored to Hydro PSP operational risks, focusing on emergency response, equipment handling, and compliance with safety standards to enhance overall site readiness.

Conduct competency assessments for all site employees and contractors, ensuring they possess the necessary skills and knowledge to operate safely and effectively in their respective roles.

Safety Engagement Initiatives:

Lead safety awareness campaigns and engagement initiatives, such as safety townhalls, workshops, and community safety programs, to foster a culture of shared responsibility and proactive safety behavior.

Plan and execute safety-focused events, including National Safety Day and World Environment Day, to reinforce the organization's commitment to safety excellence and employee well-being.

Reporting and MIS Management:

Maintain detailed safety scorecards and regularly update MIS systems with critical safety metrics, ensuring accurate and timely reporting to senior management.

Utilize digital tools and governance platforms to track compliance, monitor safety performance, and ensure seamless communication of key safety data across the organization.

job.title: Senior Manager - WSMD Lab (Copper Concentrate)
job.description:
Responsibilities

Lab Operations Planning and Execution:

  • Manage daily and shift-wise laboratory testing activities in line with smelter production priorities.
  • Ensure timely receipt, preparation, analysis, and reporting of samples from smelting, converting, refining, slag, dust, by-products, and related process streams.
  • Coordinate with production, process, and quality teams to prioritize urgent samples and ensure quick analytical feedback for operational decisions.
  • Monitor adherence to sample collection, labelling, preservation, testing, and reporting protocols to maintain reliability of results.

Process Optimization and Continuous Improvement:

  • Identify improvement opportunities in sample preparation, testing turnaround time, analytical accuracy, and laboratory workflow efficiency.
  • Support implementation of standard methods, best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives within WSMD laboratory operations.
  • Track routine operational bottlenecks and coordinate corrective actions with the Lab Head and concerned departments.
  • Assist in adoption of improved analytical practices, automation support, and digital tools for better lab productivity and data reliability.

Quality Assurance and Control:

  • Ensure execution of quality control checks, calibration verification, standardization, and validation of analytical results as per defined procedures.
  • Maintain compliance with approved laboratory SOPs, test methods, internal quality standards, and applicable statutory or customer requirements.
  • Review routine test data for abnormalities, deviations, or inconsistencies and escalate critical issues to the WSMD Lab Head.
  • Support root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for testing errors, repeat analysis, delays, and non-conformities.

Equipment Readiness and Troubleshooting:

  • Ensure availability, calibration, routine checks, and proper functioning of laboratory instruments and equipment used for WSMD analysis.
  • Coordinate with maintenance, OEMs, and service providers for troubleshooting, breakdown resolution, AMC support, and instrument reliability.
  • Maintain equipment logbooks, calibration records, preventive maintenance schedules, and breakdown history for audit readiness.
  • Support safe and correct operation of instruments by lab chemists, technicians, and shift personnel.

HSE and Regulatory Compliance:

  • Ensure strict adherence to HSE requirements, PPE usage, chemical handling procedures, waste disposal norms, and emergency response protocols inside the WSMD Lab.
  • Conduct routine safety observations, housekeeping checks, and compliance follow-ups in coordination with the Lab Head and Safety team.
  • Support compliance with environmental and statutory requirements related to laboratory chemicals, residues, samples, and waste streams.
  • Promote safe work practices among lab team members and ensure timely closure of safety observations and audit points.

Cost Management and Budgeting:

  • Monitor consumption of chemicals, reagents, gases, standards, glassware, spares, and other laboratory consumables to support uninterrupted operations.
  • Assist the Lab Head in inventory planning, PR follow-up, vendor coordination, and cost control initiatives for routine lab requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce wastage, optimize reagent usage, and improve cost efficiency without compromising testing quality.
  • Maintain records of consumable usage, stock levels, and critical inventory items for operational planning and audit purposes.

Shift Team Coordination and Capability Building:

  • Coordinate daily work allocation for lab chemists, technicians, samplers, and shift personnel as per testing load and operational requirements.
  • Guide team members on standard test procedures, safe lab practices, instrument handling, documentation, and quality expectations.
  • Support training, skill development, and multi-skilling of laboratory team members to build operational flexibility.
  • Ensure continuity of laboratory operations during shifts, peak workload, audits, and absence of senior leadership, while developing readiness to succeed the WSMD Lead role in future.

Reporting and Data Analytics:

  • Ensure timely preparation, review, and submission of routine analytical reports, shift reports, quality summaries, deviation reports, and MIS data.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of sample records, test results, calibration data, corrective actions, and audit-related information.
  • Analyze lab performance trends such as turnaround time, repeat testing, deviations, equipment uptime, and sample load to support improvement actions.
  • Escalate critical quality trends, abnormal results, and urgent operational issues to the WSMD Lab Head and concerned stakeholders.

Digitization and Tech Adoption:

  • Support use of SAP Lab/LIMS and other digital systems for sample tracking, result entry, report generation, and data traceability.
  • Ensure timely and accurate digital updating of test results, equipment records, calibration schedules, and lab MIS.
  • Assist in implementation of automation, dashboards, and data-driven reporting practices to improve laboratory efficiency.
  • Promote disciplined data entry, record retention, and system compliance among lab team members.

Qualifications

Education Qualification:

Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Industrial Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Metallurgy, or a related science/engineering discipline

Master’s degree in Chemistry/Analytical Chemistry or relevant postgraduate qualification preferred

Work Experience (Range of years):

Over 15 years of experience in Quality Assurance within the Copper Manufacturing industry

Relevant experience in laboratory operations, analytical quality control, or process lab functions, preferably in copper smelting, metals, mining, chemicals, or process industry environment; suitable for Senior Manager level with team coordination, operational ownership, and future leadership readiness

Certifications:

Certification in Quality Management or Quality Assurance

Additional certifications in Laboratory Management or Environmental Compliance preferred

job.title: Senior Engineer – Digital Solutions and AI Integration
job.description:
Responsibilities

Web Application & Software Engineering

  • Architect & Build Applications: Design, develop, and deploy responsive, high-performance web applications using modern full-stack frameworks (e.g., MERN, MEAN, LAMP, or Java/Spring Boot).
  • API Development & Integration: Design and implement RESTful APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and microservices to enable seamless communication between front-end interfaces, back-end systems, and third-party tools.
  • Database Management: Structure, optimize, and maintain relational (SQL), non-relational (NoSQL) and unstructured databases like SharePoint Lists, Excels, etc. to support high-throughput, enterprise-scale applications.

Data Engineering & Business Intelligence

  • ETL & Data Pipeline Design: Conceptualize, build, and maintain robust ETL/ELT flows to consolidate data from disparate transactional systems, cloud databases, and third-party APIs.
  • Dashboard & Analytics Engineering: Translate business requirements into intuitive, interactive Power BI dashboards and reports for executive decision-making.
  • Data Modeling & Governance: Ensure data accuracy, consistency, security, and integrity across relational data models, transactional schemas, and enterprise data marts.

Enterprise Process Automation

  • Workflow Automation: Identify manual operational workflows and design automated end-to-end process flows using Microsoft Power Automate and custom scripts.
  • System Integration: Connect enterprise applications (ERP, CRM, legacy databases, web portals) using cloud flows, desktop flows (RPA), and webhooks.

AI & Emerging Technology Integration

  • Generative & Agentic AI Solutions: Architect and implement solutions incorporating Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and autonomous Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex).
  • AI Tooling & Prompt Engineering: Build AI-driven feature enhancements into enterprise web portals and workflow engines to enhance productivity and user experience.

Cloud & DevOps Operations

  • Cloud Architecture: Deploy, manage, and scale applications and data infrastructure across major public cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform).
  • CI/CD & Code Hygiene: Implement robust CI/CD pipelines, maintain repository hygiene, conduct code reviews, and enforce security and data compliance standards.

Qualifications

Key Skill Requirements

Hands-on Experience

  • 4 to 8 years of core hands-on experience in full-stack software development, data engineering, and automation solutions.

Software & Web Development Stack

  • Proficiency in at least one primary full-stack development technology suite:
  • MERN / MEAN: React.js, Angular, Vue.js, Node.js, Express.js
  • Java Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Spring MVC
  • LAMP / Web: PHP, Apache/Nginx, Linux, MySQL, JavaScript/HTML5/CSS3

Data Engineering & Analytics

  • Experience in designing ETL/ELT processes using tools like Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, Apache Airflow, or SSIS.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Power BI (DAX, Power Query, Data Modeling, Security Management, Custom Visuals).
  • Proficiency with both SQL (PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, Cassandra) databases.

Process Automation

  • Proven track record in building enterprise automation workflows using Microsoft Power Automate (Cloud & Desktop flows).

Cloud Platforms

  • Practical experience with at least one major cloud provider ( Azure, AWS, or GCP), including serverless computing, object storage, managed database services, and IAM policies.

Teamwork, Communication & Execution

  • Collaboration & Team Player: Demonstrated capability to work effectively within multi-disciplinary & multi-location teams, engaging collaboratively with team members, product managers, vendor partners, UX designers, and business stakeholders.
  • Interpersonal & Communication Skills: Adept at verbal and written communication, with strong interpersonal skills to translate technical concepts for non-technical leadership and clearly express solution requirements, designs, concepts, etc.
  • Action-Oriented & Proactive: Highly self-motivated, action-oriented, and proactive in taking ownership, identifying potential roadblocks early, and proposing practical digital solutions.

Preferred Experience

  • Generative & Agentic AI:
  • Understanding of LLM/SLM fine-tuning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, ChromaDB, Qdrant).
  • Familiarity with Agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) and function-calling protocols.
  • DevOps & Containerization: Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps for automated building and deployment.
  • Scripting Languages: Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript/JavaScript for data processing and AI script integration.
  • Agile Delivery: Experience working in Agile/Scrum methodologies with cross-functional business, data, and digital product teams.
  • Problem-Solving & Communication: Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical architectures and articulate tech solutions to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualification

  • Primary Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a closely related discipline (B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech / MCA / M.Sc).
  • Certifications (Desirable):
  • Cloud: Azure Developer/Data Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Developer/Solutions Architect, or GCP Professional Data Engineer.
  • Analytics & Automation: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) or Power Platform App Maker / Developer (PL-100/PL-400).

job.title: Associate Manager - Cell Maintenance
job.description:
Responsibilities

Safety Compliance:

  • Ensure that all maintenance procedures for PERC technology comply with safety standards and protocols, focusing on handling and processing sensitive components like passivation layers.

Innovation:

  • Driving continuous improvement by leading R&D efforts to develop advanced solar technologies and identifying market trends to maintain a competitive edge.

Digitalization/Data-Driven Decision Making:

  • Overseeing the implementation of digital tools and smart technologies to optimize manufacturing processes and enhance data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Leadership in Change Management:

  • Leading effective change management strategies to guide the organization through transitions, ensuring smooth adoption of new processes and technologies.

People Development:

  • Leading from the front & being accountable for the professional growth of your teams. Developing/conducting/promoting training & learning initiatives to enhance skills & empowering them to take ownership of key processes and decisions.

PERC Technology Management:

  • Oversee maintenance operations specifically for PERC (Passivated Emitter and Rear Cell) solar cells, focusing on the unique aspects of this technology, such as passivation layers and rear surface treatment.

Issue Diagnosis and Repair:

  • Address and resolve issues related to PERC cell performance, including troubleshooting problems with passivation layers, rear surface contact, and overall cell efficiency.

Preventive Maintenance:

  • Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules tailored to the specific needs of PERC cells, such as ensuring the integrity of the passivation layer and rear contacts.

Quality Assurance:

  • Ensure that maintenance practices uphold the high standards required for PERC cells. Perform detailed inspections to verify the condition of passivation layers and rear surface contacts..

CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions):

  • Identify and address specific issues affecting PERC cells, such as degradation of passivation layers or rear contact problems, and implement corrective and preventive measures to enhance cell performance.

Team Leadership:

  • Lead and coordinate the maintenance team in handling PERC cells, providing specific guidance on handling and maintaining passivation and rear contact systems.

Performance Monitoring:

  • Track performance indicators specific to PERC cells, such as efficiency metrics and degradation rates of passivation layers, to optimize maintenance strategies and improve cell longevity.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Production Team
  • Engineering Department
  • Quality Assurance Team
  • Operations Management

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • PERC Equipment Manufacturers
  • Spare Parts Suppliers
  • Technical Consultants
  • External Auditors

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

Work Experience (Range of years):

  • 12-14 Years of experience in cell maintenance, with specific experience in PERC technology.

job.title: Buyer HO
job.description:
Responsibilities

Purchase Requisition (PR) Review:

Aid in the review of approved Purchase Requests (PR) from the user department; Assist in determining the procurement type and method.

Strategic Sourcing:

Choose the bidding process and develop vendor selection methods and evaluation criteria based on the category.Create the Request for Information (RFI) document for evaluating bidders; Develop commercial estimates using standardized templates and assess technical and commercial proposals. Engage in fact-based negotiations or e-auctions with shortlisted bidders. Draft the Note for Approval (NFA) for the selected bidder and secure necessary approvals as per the Delegation of Authority (DoA).

Contract Management:

Establish and maintain approved contract records within the ERP system, ensuring adherence to system functionalities and policies. Draft, review, and issue rate contracts based on approved decisions. Formulate master outline agreements (OA) in the ERP system based on rate contracts. Generate Purchase Orders (PO) or Sales Orders (SO) for procurement under valid rate contracts.

Post Order Management:

Expedite the delivery of ordered materials to ensure timely arrival. Create Change Orders or Amendments to orders, including adjustments in quantity/rate, additional items, and time extensions. Oversee inbound logistics services for other Ex-Works domestic supplies. Implement contingency plans in response to immediate business needs. Provide assistance to the operations team in managing resources effectively.

Supplier Management:

Formulate vendor evaluation criteria and a vendor segmentation matrix based on annual spending and associated risks. Establish vendor performance evaluation criteria and determine evaluation frequency for each vendor segment. Foster strategic partnerships with suppliers/vendors to benefit Adani from a long-term perspective and leverage them for business value additions.

Documentation & Reporting:

Assist in gathering and analyzing data related to various procurement activities (e.g., commodity analysis, supplier debugging) for respective categories. Identify and pursue efficiency and value improvement opportunities through data analysis. Support action planning and implementation based on data analytics for assigned categories.

Quality Assurance:

Ensure all procured materials and services meet the required quality standards and specifications. Work with the quality control team to address and resolve any quality-related issues with suppliers.

Digital Mindset:

Keep up with digital and AI advancements to enhance business and maintain competitiveness.

Team Development:

Promote a respectful and safe workplace, lead collaborative and productive teams, and mentor for growth and success.Offer guidance, support, and mentorship to team members, facilitating their development and success while maintaining high morale and motivation.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Site Techno-Commercial Head

Site Buyers

Projects, O&M, Quality and other departments

Finance & Accounts team, Quality/User/Engg Team

Direct Reportees

Key Stakeholders - External:

Customs Handling Agents, Customs Authority, Government Officials, Vendors, Logistics providers

Qualifications

Education Qualification:

Bachelor's degree in engineering in any discipline. MBA qualification will be most preferred.

Work Experience:

3-5 years of experience in supply chain management, procurement, contracts and related area

job.title: Deputy Manager - Environment
job.description:
Responsibilities

Ecological Survey and Monitoring:

Conduct seasonal surveys of terrestrial flora and fauna within a 10 km vicinity of power station, ensuring comprehensive data collection and analysis.

Perform extensive monitoring of avifauna and interpret terrestrial ecology data using various diversity indices to assess ecological health.

Prepare and submit half-yearly terrestrial ecological survey reports, detailing findings and providing insights for ecological management.

Coordinate with the horticulture department for the development and tracking of green zones, aligning with Environmental clearance conditions.

Ecological Reporting and Regulatory Adherence:

Coordinate, collect data, and submit Annual Terrestrial Ecology reports for other operational sites of APL, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

At the site level, manage the collection and submission of data for sustainability reporting, addressing observations raised by auditors and providing necessary backups.

Oversee terrestrial-related ISO certifications, maintaining compliance with international standards and best practices.

Conduct assigned internal audits to ensure adherence to ecological and environmental policies and procedures.

Interact with statutory bodies like State forest departments, government offices, and institutions for data generation and authentication.

Plant Level Engagement and Safety:

Actively participate in plant-level functions such as safety and 5S initiatives, contributing to a culture of operational excellence and workplace organization.

Ensure the safety of business associates and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols, minimizing risks and promoting a safe working environment.

Coordinate with external agencies for conducting Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) studies for upcoming projects, and thorough ecological evaluations.

Conduct training sessions for business associates on legal aspects related to terrestrial ecology, enhancing awareness and compliance.

Business Sustainability:

Ensure adherence to IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department, promoting sustainable practices and compliance.

Lead initiatives to reduce environmental impact and promote biodiversity conservation, aligning with the company's sustainability goals.

Implement measures to enhance resource efficiency and reduce waste, contributing to the company's environmental stewardship.

Digitization and Automation:

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies to optimize operational efficiency, streamlining data collection and analysis processes.

Innovate and implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals and strategy, enhancing ecological monitoring capabilities.

Review and implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas to advance ecological assessment methods.

Drive the integration of advanced technology and digitization within the department, ensuring the use of cutting-edge tools for ecological surveys.

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Master's degree in Ecology, Environmental Science, or a related field with a focus on terrestrial ecosystems/.PhD (preferred)

Work Experience (Range of years):

5+ years of relevant experience in ecological surveying, monitoring, and data analysis.

Preferred Industry:

Experience in the power sector or related industries with a strong background in environmental management and sustainability practices.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in AP / CAD / Billing functions

job.title: Manager - Engineering
job.description:
Responsibilities

Real-Time Monitoring of Turbine Operations

  • Monitor turbine operations in real-time using SCADA systems, tracking performance metrics such as power output, rotor speed, and grid connection status.
  • Identify and report deviations from normal operating parameters, coordinating with the SCADA lead for further analysis and corrective actions.

Alarm Response and Incident Reporting

  • Respond to alarms generated by the SCADA system, following predefined protocols to assess, document, and escalate incidents as necessary.
  • Maintain accurate records of incidents, actions taken, and outcomes to support continuous improvement and compliance reporting.

Data Logging and Analysis

  • Perform data logging and initial analysis of turbine performance data, identifying patterns that may indicate emerging issues or optimization opportunities.
  • Support detailed analysis by preparing data sets and reports for use by engineering teams in root cause analysis and troubleshooting.

System Health Checks and Maintenance Support

  • Conduct regular system health checks to ensure all SCADA components are functioning correctly, including sensors, communication links, and control interfaces.
  • Assist in basic maintenance tasks such as resetting alarms, recalibrating sensors, and updating software as directed by the SCADA lead.

Cybersecurity Compliance and Data Integrity

  • Adhere to cybersecurity protocols within the SCADA environment, ensuring data security and integrity are maintained at all times.
  • Report any suspicious activity or security breaches to the SCADA lead, supporting efforts to safeguard system operations.

Compliance with Operating Procedures

  • Follow all standard operating procedures for SCADA monitoring, including guidelines for alarm management, data handling, and communication with other departments.
  • Participate in regular audits and training sessions to ensure compliance with industry standards and internal policies.

Support for Troubleshooting Activities

  • Assist in troubleshooting activities, providing real-time data and observations to support root cause analysis conducted by SCADA engineers.
  • Document findings and recommendations from troubleshooting activities to contribute to the development of improved response protocols.

Team Collaboration and Communication

  • Work closely with SCADA and operations teams to ensure coordinated responses to system events, sharing information and insights as needed.
  • Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders, including engineers, technicians, and management, to ensure smooth SCADA operations.

Continuous Learning and Development

  • Engage in training and professional development activities to enhance skills in SCADA monitoring, data analysis, and system troubleshooting.
  • Stay informed about updates to SCADA systems and industry best practices to maintain a high level of technical competence.

Contribution to Continuous Improvement

  • Provide feedback on SCADA system performance, alarm settings, and response procedures, suggesting improvements to enhance monitoring effectiveness.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, supporting the SCADA team in implementing new technologies and optimizing system operations.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

job.title: Assistant Manager - ESG
job.description:
Responsibilities

ESG Analyst

Planning and Execution:

  • Assist in executing the ESG strategy by collecting data on environmental, social, and governance metrics from various departments.
  • Coordinate the submission of monthly data from KPIs across departments, ensuring accurate and timely reporting.
  • Support the planning of sustainability initiatives by providing critical data inputs for environmental and governance frameworks.

Process Optimization and Continuous Improvement:

  • Identify areas for process improvements in data collection, ensuring efficiency and accuracy.
  • Recommend improvements in the existing ESG reporting system to optimize data flow and minimize errors.
  • Implement streamlined data processes to enhance integration between departments for better ESG performance.

HSE and Regulatory Compliance:

  • Ensure adherence to the Environmental Management System (EMS) by collecting data on regulatory compliance for air, water, waste, and safety.
  • Monitor compliance across departments and submit findings to regulatory authorities as required.
  • Review the data for consistency with regulatory requirements, providing input for necessary corrections.

Cost Management and Budgeting:

  • Track costs associated with ESG-related activities, ensuring that data collection and reporting processes are within budget.
  • Assist in budget planning for sustainability and governance projects by analyzing financial data related to ESG initiatives.
  • Identify cost-saving opportunities in the implementation of ESG programs.

Resource and Workforce Management:

  • Coordinate with departments to gather ESG-related data, ensuring all teams are aligned with reporting timelines.
  • Support ESG-related workforce planning by providing data insights for staff involved in sustainability and governance projects.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to manage resources for ESG reporting and compliance activities.

Reporting and Data Analytics:

  • Prepare monthly and quarterly ESG reports, including integrated and sustainability reports, using data collected from various departments.
  • Analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for environmental and governance aspects, identifying trends and areas of concern.
  • Contribute to the development of the governance framework by providing detailed data analysis and insights.

Digitization and Tech Adoption:

  • Utilize digital tools and software for ESG data collection and analysis, improving the efficiency of reporting processes.
  • Implement digital dashboards to track key ESG metrics in real-time, allowing for quicker decision-making.

  • Legal team
  • Secretarial

Bachelor's / master’s degree in environmental science, Sustainability, or related field

4-8 years in sustainability, ESG reporting, or data analysis roles

job.title: Site Toll System & Instrumentation Lead
job.description:

Government Authorities

Contractors

job.title: SBU Head - Security & Intel.
job.description:
Responsibilities

Regional Security Head

Security Strategy & Governance:

Contribute to the Security Strategy and roadmap, aligning regional security initiatives with corporate policy.

Develop, manage, and monitor security budgets (Capex and Opex) and secure approvals in consultation with the Vertical Security Head.

Participate in governance meetings, reviewing ongoing initiatives, and suggesting improvements.

Security Risk Management & Audit:

Build relationships with local authorities and media to gather intelligence, assessing risks based on current events.

Conduct security risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities, ensuring timely mitigation of gaps in infrastructure, technology, and processes.

Coordinate internal and third-party audits, addressing findings promptly to maintain a reliable security management system.

Crisis & Incident Management:

Design and implement Emergency Response and Control Plans (ERCP) for crisis scenarios, ensuring preparedness and swift recovery.

Supervise Quick Reaction Team (QRT) readiness and refine response plans based on incident learnings.

Security Operations Management:

Monitor adherence to SOPs and SOGs, generating MIS reports for updates to Site CEO and Vertical Security Head.

Oversee Site Security Control Room operations, integrating with the National Security Control Room for seamless incident escalation.

Manage access control, visitor access, traffic flow, and ensure proper surveillance to maintain operational vigilance.

Investigation & Due Diligence:

Lead investigations into incidents such as theft, fraud, and vandalism, and implement corrective actions.

Report findings and provide insights into critical incidents to business units.

Protection & Performance Improvement:

Establish performance metrics for security functions and drive process improvement initiatives.

Conduct security events as per annual plans, ensuring robust protection protocols are maintained.

Outsourced Manpower Management:

Oversee recruitment, performance, and welfare of outsourced security staff, ensuring alignment with defined standards.

Lead recruitment for vacant positions, foster a performance-driven culture, and support talent identification for critical roles.

Project Management:

Drive projects focused on security technology implementation and infrastructure enhancement in line with group security standards.

Ensure seamless project integration into regional operations, engaging stakeholders for effective adoption.

Site Team

Human Resources

Existing Partners

Auditors

Local Police

District administration, local governing bodies, local leaders, and local community

10-15 Years

Experience in managing large or mid-sized site operations involving access control, risk management, surveillance, and crisis response; adept in budget management, compliance, and investigation protocols.

job.title: Senior Manager - Techno Commercial
job.description:
Responsibilities

TCD Site In-charge (Opex) - Mining

Strategic Procurement and Supplier Management:

Coordinate procurement activities across sites, ensuring strategic planning and alignment with operational needs.

Identify, evaluate, and select suppliers to procure quality OPEX items, ensuring cost-effectiveness and adherence to quality standards.

Manage supplier relationships to negotiate favorable terms and ensure continuous improvement in vendor performance.

Lead process improvement initiatives in purchasing, contract management, supplier selection, and sourcing to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.

Inventory Management:

Monitor and manage inventory levels to ensure availability of OPEX items, minimizing excess stock and obsolescence.

Conduct regular inventory audits and reconcile discrepancies to maintain accurate records.

Determine optimal reorder points and quantities to prevent stockouts and ensure uninterrupted site operations.

Generate and analyze inventory reports to identify trends, forecast needs, and inform procurement decisions.

Review inventory levels periodically and take necessary actions to maintain optimal stock at all sites.

Financial and Budget Management:

Conduct cost analysis of procurement activities to identify savings opportunities and drive cost reduction initiatives.

Ensure procurement activities are within budgetary constraints and provide regular updates to management on budget status.

Manage buying processes efficiently, including RFPs, proposal evaluations, negotiations, vendor selection, and contract awards.

Prepare and issue purchase orders for required OPEX items, ensuring adherence to company policies and procedures.

Operational Coordination and Reporting:

Coordinate with site managers and operational teams to understand OPEX requirements and ensure timely delivery of needed items.

Address and resolve procurement or inventory issues to ensure smooth operational activities.

Manage urgent procurement requests to support unplanned operational needs and minimize downtime.

Attend to internal/external audit queries, provide data, and take corrective actions for observations received.

Review commercial/stores SOPs annually, make necessary changes, and update the revision.

Review Pending PRs status with team members and take necessary corrective actions, providing performance feedback.

Attend review meetings conducted by TCD Leads/site head/corporate and prepare necessary data and presentations on OPEX-related procurements and inventory.

Release all e-NFA documents after checking the support documents and follow up for timely approval.

Check and release New Vendor code, VC unblock, and GRN error in MDG portal.

Review reports on inventory stock at all sites and follow up with contractors for monthly consumption reports.

Compliance and Quality Assurance:

Ensure compliance with quality, legal, financial, and safety terms in OPEX purchase and service contracts.

Monitor material/service providers’ performance and take necessary action to bridge gaps and ensure timely renewal of contracts.

Manage all commercial processes and data as per IMS standards, update data, attend audits, and address observations.

Technology Integration:

Deploy digital tools for real-time monitoring and optimization of operational expenditures on site, enhancing cost efficiency and project outcomes.

Implement advanced digital solutions for managing site operations and resource allocation, ensuring effective and efficient use of operational resources.

job.title: Duty Manager - Terminal Operations
job.description:

Terminal Operations Shift Management:

  • Oversees all terminal operations during the assigned shift, ensuring smooth passenger flow and on-time departures & coordinates with other departments for efficient operations.

  • Delivers exceptional customer service by assisting passengers with their needs and resolving issues promptly & builds positive relationships with passengers to enhance the overall airport experience.
  • Assist in the management of reserved lounges, ensuring a high standard of service and a seamless experience for passengers.

Trolley Operations and Asset Management:

  • Oversee the management and maintenance of trolley operations, ensuring availability and cleanliness.
  • Assist in managing the asset lifecycle, including regular checks and prompt reporting of any defects or damages.

Golf Cart and Inter Terminal Coach Operations:

  • Coordinate the timely deployment and safe operation of golf carts and inter-terminal coaches.
  • Ensure service levels are met, track performance scores, and address any complaints or operational issues promptly.

Staff Supervision:

  • Provides leadership and guidance to the terminal operations team during the shift & monitors staff performance and addresses issues promptly.
  • Ensures adherence to operational procedures and standards among staff members.

Vendor Management:

  • Manage operational aspects related to vendor management, golf cart management, baggage and shopping trolley management, Baggage Handling System (BCS) management, and inter-terminal coach management to ensure smooth operations and enhancing passenger experience within terminal
  • Monitor vendor performance and address any discrepancies to maintain operational standards.

Problem Solving:

  • Identifies and resolves operational issues and challenges that arise during the shift & implements immediate solutions to minimize disruptions.
  • Collaborates with other departments to address complex issues and find effective solutions.

Emergency Response Management:

  • Lead emergency response efforts during shifts, effectively managing situations such as bomb threats, evacuations, medical emergencies, and other contingencies.
  • Ensure all actions are carried out in accordance with laid-down SOPs and conduct post-incident reviews for continuous improvement.

Special Events and VVIP Movements:

  • Support the coordination of special events, ensuring smooth execution, budgeting, and event calendar management.
  • Assist in planning and ensuring security arrangements for VVIP movements, including liaising with relevant authorities for smooth execution.

Safety and Security Compliance:

  • Ensures compliance with safety and security regulations and procedures during the shift & conducts safety checks and responds to incidents.
  • Coordinates with security personnel to address security concerns and maintain a safe environment.

Operational Efficiency:

  • Optimizes resource utilization during the shift to maximize efficiency and minimize costs & implements process improvements to enhance operational performance.
  • Monitors key performance indicators (KPIs) and takes corrective actions to improve performance.

Stakeholder Management:

  • Shift wise coordination will all regulatory agencies, airlines and ground handlers.

Team Leadership and Development

  • Supervise and manage the terminal operations team during shifts, ensuring high levels of employee engagement and discipline.
  • Identify training needs of employees and ensure team members participate in all mandatory classroom training sessions.

job.title: Deputy General Manager - Land Survey
job.description:
Responsibilities

Mine Surveyor - Coal Mining

Conducting Surveys and Measurements:

Perform detailed topographic and underground surveys using the latest surveying equipment and techniques to accurately measure and map the mine’s physical features.

Measure and record the dimensions, elevations, and contours of mine workings and geological formations, ensuring all data is precise and reliable.

Utilize advanced surveying software to collect, analyze, and process survey data, ensuring accurate and timely reporting.

Developing and Maintaining Mine Plans:

Create and regularly update accurate mine plans, layouts, and sectional drawings that reflect the current state of mine workings and future development plans.

Ensure all mine plans and layouts comply with statutory requirements, industry standards, and company policies, facilitating smooth regulatory audits and inspections.

Collaborate with mining engineers, geologists, and mine management to adjust and optimize plans based on operational needs and geological findings.

Monitoring Geological Features:

Identify, record, and monitor geological formations, faults, and potential hazards within the mine, providing early warnings of any changes that could impact safety or operations.

Assist in the assessment of ground stability, roof conditions, and potential safety risks by providing accurate geological data and interpretations.

Support geological mapping and modeling efforts with precise survey data, aiding in the prediction and management of geological conditions.

Ensuring Regulatory Compliance:

Adhere to all relevant mining regulations, safety standards, and environmental guidelines, ensuring that all surveying activities are conducted legally and ethically.

Prepare, maintain, and submit required reports, records, and documentation to regulatory bodies, ensuring all data is accurate and submitted in a timely manner.

Participate in safety audits, inspections, and reviews, providing necessary survey data and supporting documentation to demonstrate compliance and identify areas for improvement.

Supporting Mine Planning and Development:

Provide critical survey data and insights to support the design, planning, and optimization of mine development projects, ensuring efficient and safe operations.

Assist in the planning, coordination, and execution of mine expansion and development projects, providing accurate survey data to guide decision-making and project implementation.

Work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, operations, and safety, to ensure alignment of surveying activities with overall mine operational goals and objectives.

Implement and Optimize Digital Solutions:

Coordinate with cross-functional teams to deploy digital tools that align with business objectives.

Ensure the effective utilization of digital platforms to improve team efficiency and productivity.

Key Stakeholders - Internal

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

HODs

Employees

Key Stakeholders - External

DGMS

Forest Department

Environment

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Diploma in Mine Survey.

Statutory - Surveyor Certificate.

Work Experience (Range of years):

10-15 years

job.title: General Manager - GCP MEP
job.description:
Responsibilities

Strategic Vision & Policy Development:

Define and lead the long-term vision for category procurement strategy and policy formulation across all Centers of Excellence (CoEs).

Ensure alignment of procurement objectives with overarching corporate goals, including cost efficiency, process standardization, and development of long-range planning frameworks.

Incorporate risk mitigation strategies, value engineering practices, and future-readiness into policy planning to create resilient and adaptable procurement practices.

Continuously analyze market trends and benchmark against industry standards to create policies and continuously align strategies with global procurement best practices informed procurement decisions and maintain competitive advantage.

Procurement Governance & Frameworks:

Establish governance structures, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and control mechanisms for centralized procurement processes across civil, electrical, mechanical, services, material categories and more.

Ensure comprehensive coverage across all procurement categories including civil, electrical, mechanical, services, and material purchases, while embedding standardization of specifications, documentation, and processes to enable consistency and scale.

Monitor and enforce compliance with sourcing strategies, policies and regulatory requirements across all business units and category teams.

Cost Optimization & Value Engineering:

Lead initiatives to deliver cost reduction and enhanced value creation by consolidating vendor base, leveraging economies of scale, and driving demand aggregation across businesses.

Promote long-term strategic planning, multi-year procurement visibility, and early supplier involvement to capture maximum commercial advantage.

Apply value engineering principles to optimize specifications and eliminate non-essential costs while maintaining functionality and performance.

Facilitate bulk procurement strategies, negotiate long-term contracts, and implement demand consolidation frameworks to unlock sustainable cost savings.

Sourcing & Contracting Strategy:

Design and implement robust sourcing strategies and contract frameworks that support centralized and decentralized buying models across business

Aggregate cross-business procurement needs and implement standardized sourcing and contracting strategies to maximize scale, efficiency, and commercial leverage.

Vendor Relationship Management:

Develop and nurture high-impact relationships with critical suppliers to drive supplier performance, innovation, and continuity of supply.

Oversee governance over vendor development programs, strategic partnerships, performance evaluations, and compliance audits to ensure alignment with organizational objectives.

Drive structured vendor development and engagement programs to build supplier capabilities and long-term collaboration.

Integration & Change Management:

Spearhead the integration of newly acquired businesses into the centralized procurement system, ensuring alignment of tools, processes, and reporting mechanisms.

Oversee transformation initiatives including the deployment of digital procurement platforms, adoption of new policies, and transitions in procurement categories or sourcing strategies.

Drive change management across stakeholders to ensure smooth adoption and sustained improvements.

Team Leadership & Capability Building:

Foster cross-functional collaboration by mentoring category leads, driving team synergy, and ensuring clarity of roles and responsibilities.

Develop talent development through structured hiring, training programs, and capability-building initiatives aligned with future procurement needs.

Drive succession planning and organizational resilience within the Global Central Procurement (GCP) team.

Executive Reporting & External Engagement:

Serve as the primary representative of the GCP function in executive management reviews, external audits, and industry conferences or forums.

Provide transparent and timely reporting on key procurement metrics including cost visibility, supplier performance, savings achieved, emerging risks, category-level benchmarks.

Ensure senior leadership is informed and aligned with procurement strategies, outcomes, and future plans.

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management / Operations / Project Management / Business Administration is preferred

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Instrumentation)

Work Experience:

18+ years of experience in strategic procurement, category management, and supply chain operations

Proven exposure in infrastructure or energy sectors, with leadership experience in centralized procurement and vendor strategy

Deep familiarity with procurement digital platforms like SAP, ARIBA, SLM, and e-auction tools

job.description:

job.description:

Lead - MIS and Performance

Data Collection and Issue Management:

Collect relevant information and data from all sites, ensuring completeness and accuracy, particularly focusing on daily generation parameters such as load factor and unit availability.

Address any data unavailability issues promptly by manually collecting data when necessary.

Prepare consolidated reports for energy and daily generation, coordinating with other business units such as renewables and transmission.

Provide information on live hot issues, such as unit trips or major maintenance activities, to the team lead for timely resolution.

Fill data in various Excel formats, including sensitive information on power sales, coal reports, and water stock.

Alerts and Data Collation:

Meeting Management and Documentation:

Act as a backup for the coal meeting endorsed by the ENDORSE team in the head office.
