job.title: Senior Manager - Regulatory and Commercial
job.description:
Responsibilities

Lead - Commercial (ERCG)

Billing and Revenue Management:

Manage the comprehensive management of revenue, ensuring all billing activities in accordance with the SOP for Power Sale align with organizational financial objectives.

Collect necessary information and inputs for billing, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.

Issue accurate and timely invoices to customers or power procurers

Monitor payments to ensure they are received by the due date.

Maintain and update all invoicing information on the Ministry of Power portal, responding to any disputes raised by customers.

Continuously monitor replies and communications within the portal.

Verify customer information and address anomalies if any to prevent delays.

Payment Tracking and Dispute Resolution:

Proactively track payments and initiate letters of credit (LC) to encash funds when payments are delayed.

In the event of a dispute, ensure that customers pay 85% of the invoice amount as per contract, providing justification for the payment.

Manage stay orders from the regulatory committee, waiting for resolutions before proceeding with collections.

Communicate with banks regarding payment statuses, letter of credit (LC) issuances.

Ensure the original letter of credit (LC) value is restored within 7 days if utilized.

Portal Management:

Update the Payment Security Portal (PSA) and Praapti portal with necessary information. For e.g. letter of credit (LC) availability.

Monitor power curtailment actions by the System Operator as mandated by the Ministry of Power.

Document payment statuses and upload all bills to the Praapti portal, ensuring accurate and timely updates of procurer details.

Enforce restrictions on short-term power purchases for entities with outstanding payments beyond 75 days as recorded in the Praapti portal.

Interact with the state load dispatch center, central dispatch, and Ministry of Power as necessary, ensuring compliance with operational guidelines.

Financial Reporting and Reconciliation:

Prepare MIS reports detailing expected revenue, expenses for each customer, due bills, and collection targets, comparing actual receipts against targets.

Conduct quarterly or annual reconciliations of bills admitted, signed off, and payments made, reporting reconciliation status.

Draft replies for customer correspondence and ensure accurate entry of bills into the SAP system as payments are made.

Regulatory Support and Tariff Management:

Provide data input to the regulatory team for unresolved disputes and ongoing cases.

Apply for provisional tariffs if petitions are not filed in a timely manner and submit claims for the regulatory team to file petitions.

In cases where section 63 of the PPA applies, ensure the sharing of fuel costs and other expenses for reimbursement.

Key Stakeholders - Internal

Finance Team

Corporate Affairs Team

Operations & Maintenance (O&M) Team

Fuel Management Team

Power Sales Team

Business Development (BD) Team

ABEX Team

Commercial Controller Team

Key Stakeholders - External

DISCOMs/Procurers

Regulatory Authorities

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor's Degree (Finance, Business Administration, related fields)

Work Experience (Range of years):

Minimum 5 years of experience in billing, financial management, or a relevant commercial role within a corporate setting.

Preferred Industry:

Background in the power and energy sector with exposure to commercial and regulatory processes pertaining to billing and payments.

job.title: Associate Manager- Cyber Security
job.description:
Responsibilities

IDAM Specialist

Identity Lifecycle Management:

Support the administration of identity lifecycle processes, including user provisioning, de-provisioning, and access reviews.

Implement role-based access control (RBAC), user provisioning policies, and workflows across applications and systems.

Assist in maintaining an accurate inventory of user identities and associated access rights across the enterprise.

Authentication and Authorization Management:

Implement and manage authentication mechanisms such as Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Single Sign-On (SSO), and other access controls.

Assist with configuring and managing federated identity management solutions, ensuring smooth integration with cloud and on-premises applications.

Ensure that proper access control mechanisms are in place to provide secure, role-appropriate access to critical systems and data.

IAM Tool Support and Maintenance:

Assist in the configuration, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions, including tools like Okta, Microsoft Azure Active Directory, SailPoint, or similar.

Provide technical support for IAM tools and applications, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating with vendors for escalated issues.

Perform regular system health checks, ensuring IAM tools and systems are performing optimally.

Access Reviews and Compliance:

Conduct regular access reviews to ensure compliance with the principle of least privilege and internal security policies.

Assist in ensuring that identity and access management practices are in compliance with relevant regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOX).

Prepare reports on user access and permissions for internal audits and compliance requirements.

Incident Response and Support:

Assist in investigating and remediating incidents related to identity and access management, such as unauthorized access, privilege escalation, and account compromise.

Support the resolution of identity-related security incidents, escalating as needed to senior security staff or incident response teams.

Monitor logs and user activity for anomalous behavior, ensuring that any incidents are reported and addressed promptly.

Policy and Process Support:

Assist in the development, implementation, and enforcement of identity management policies, including user access management, authentication protocols, and access control rules.

Collaborate with other teams to implement best practices for managing identity across the organization’s IT infrastructure and cloud platforms.

Collaboration and Stakeholder Communication:

Work closely with IT, HR, compliance, and application teams to understand their requirements and ensure appropriate identity and access controls are in place.

Provide support and guidance to internal teams regarding identity management processes and policies.

Assist with user training and awareness programs on the importance of strong identity management and secure access controls.

Continuous Improvement:

Contribute to the ongoing improvement of identity and access management processes and tools to enhance efficiency, security, and user experience.

Stay up-to-date on industry trends and emerging technologies in the identity and access management space.

Participate in regular training and professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge.

Key Stakeholders - Internal

Head of Identity and Access Management (IDAM)

Business Unit Heads and Department Heads

Information Security and IT teams

IT and Network Operations Teams

Legal and Compliance Teams

Audit Teams

Human Resources (HR)

Key Stakeholders - External

Vendors and service providers of IAM solutions

Regulatory bodies

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

Certification:

Relevant certifications such as Certified Identity and Access Manager (CIAM)/ CompTIA Security+, or similar are a plus.

Experience with IAM tools and technologies such as RSA, One Identity, Net IQ, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Okta, Microsoft Azure AD, SailPoint, or similar platforms with industry standards and regulations related to IAM, such as ISO 27001, NIST etc.

Strong knowledge of IAM technologies and best practices, including SSO, privileged access management (PAM), and user provisioning

5+ years of relevent experience working in Identity and Access Management (IDAM) roles.

job.title: Associate Manager - Tendering

job.title: Associate Manager - Regulatory & Commercial
job.description:
Responsibilities

Associate Manager - Regulatory & Commercial (ERCG)

Billing and Revenue Management:

Manage the comprehensive management of revenue, ensuring all billing activities in accordance with the SOP for Power Sale align with organizational financial objectives.

Collect necessary information and inputs for billing, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.

Issue accurate and timely invoices to customers or power procurers

Monitor payments to ensure they are received by the due date.

Maintain and update all invoicing information on the Ministry of Power portal, responding to any disputes raised by customers.

Continuously monitor replies and communications within the portal.

Verify customer information and address anomalies if any to prevent delays.

Payment Tracking and Dispute Resolution:

Proactively track payments and initiate letters of credit (LC) to encash funds when payments are delayed.

In the event of a dispute, ensure that customers pay 85% of the invoice amount as per contract, providing justification for the payment.

Manage stay orders from the regulatory committee, waiting for resolutions before proceeding with collections.

Communicate with banks regarding payment statuses, letter of credit (LC) issuances.

Ensure the original letter of credit (LC) value is restored within 7 days if utilized.

Portal Management:

Update the Payment Security Portal (PSA) and Praapti portal with necessary information. For e.g. letter of credit (LC) availability.

Monitor power curtailment actions by the System Operator as mandated by the Ministry of Power.

Document payment statuses and upload all bills to the Praapti portal, ensuring accurate and timely updates of procurer details.

Enforce restrictions on short-term power purchases for entities with outstanding payments beyond 75 days as recorded in the Praapti portal.

Interact with the state load dispatch center, central dispatch, and Ministry of Power as necessary, ensuring compliance with operational guidelines.

Financial Reporting and Reconciliation:

Prepare MIS reports detailing expected revenue, expenses for each customer, due bills, and collection targets, comparing actual receipts against targets.

Conduct quarterly or annual reconciliations of bills admitted, signed off, and payments made, reporting reconciliation status.

Draft replies for customer correspondence and ensure accurate entry of bills into the SAP system as payments are made.

Regulatory Support and Tariff Management:

Provide data input to the regulatory team for unresolved disputes and ongoing cases.

Apply for provisional tariffs if petitions are not filed in a timely manner and submit claims for the regulatory team to file petitions.

In cases where section 63 of the PPA applies, ensure the sharing of fuel costs and other expenses for reimbursement.

Finance Team

Corporate Affairs Team

Operations & Maintenance (O&M) Team

Fuel Management Team

Power Sales Team

Business Development (BD) Team

ABEX Team

Commercial Controller Team

Key Stakeholders - External

DISCOMs/Procurers

Regulatory Authorities

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor's Degree (Finance, Business Administration, related fields)

Work Experience (Range of years):

Minimum 5 years of experience in billing, financial management, or a relevant commercial role within a corporate setting.

Preferred Industry:

Background in the power and energy sector with exposure to commercial and regulatory processes pertaining to billing and payments.

job.description:

About Us

The road to empowerment is the one that guards a country’s stride onwards, keeping every hurdle that poses a threat to the constant pace of progress at bay. job.title: Plant Head - Strategic Precious Metals and Minor Metals
job.description:
Responsibilities

Plant Operations Management

  • Lead daily plant operations to achieve production volume, throughput, recovery, metal yield, plant availability, and dispatch targets as per business plan.
  • Optimize process parameters across smelting, refining, leaching, electrowinning/electrolysis, crystallization, casting, and allied processes based on feed composition and plant conditions.
  • Monitor shift-wise performance, identify bottlenecks, minimize unplanned downtime, and ensure timely troubleshooting of process deviations.
  • Ensure effective coordination between production, maintenance, quality, stores, utilities, logistics, and commercial teams for smooth plant operations.
  • Review and strengthen SOPs, operating discipline, shift handover practices, daily management systems, and production reporting mechanisms.
  • Drive continuous improvement in OEE, equipment reliability, manpower productivity, material flow, and process stability.

Safety, Health and Environment

  • Drive a zero-harm and LTI-free culture across the plant by implementing robust safety systems, behavior-based safety practices, and regular shopfloor engagement.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable statutory requirements including Factories Act, environmental regulations, hazardous waste handling rules, safety standards, and internal EHS guidelines.
  • Oversee management of effluent, emissions, fumes, dust, slag, hazardous material storage, and waste disposal in coordination with EHS and environment teams.
  • Lead incident investigations, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, emergency preparedness, mock drills, and safety audits.
  • Promote disciplined usage of PPE, permit-to-work systems, HIRA/JSA, SOP compliance, and contractor safety management.

Quality, Metallurgy & Process Excellence

  • Ensure achievement of product quality standards including metal purity, impurity control, physical quality, casting quality, and customer specification compliance.
  • Work closely with laboratory, R&D, and process engineering teams to improve yield, recovery, impurity removal, energy efficiency, and process robustness.
  • Review process data, assay results, mass balance, heat balance, and quality trends to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Reduce rework, rejection, customer complaints, off-spec production, and process variability through structured corrective actions.
  • Support new product development, process trials, technology improvements, and scale-up initiatives for minor metals and by-products.

High Value Project

  • Conceive, evaluate, and drive high-value projects related to recovery, processing, and value maximization of minor metals in the copper value chain, including lead (Pb), zinc (Zn), chlorine (Cl), rhodium (Rh), bismuth, selenium, tellurium, and platinum group metals (PGMs).

Cost, Budgeting & CAPEX

  • Own plant OPEX budgets and drive cost optimization across power, fuel, chemicals, consumables, refractory, electrodes, maintenance, manpower, and logistics.
  • Track cost per ton, conversion cost, specific energy consumption, consumable usage, productivity, and variance against budget.
  • Plan and execute plant shutdowns, debottlenecking projects, modification jobs, and CAPEX initiatives within approved cost, quality, safety, and timeline parameters.
  • Support technical evaluation of vendors, contractors, spares, equipment, consumables, and service contracts in coordination with procurement and commercial teams.
  • Identify value engineering opportunities and drive initiatives for capacity enhancement, yield improvement, waste reduction, and cost competitiveness.

People Leadership & Capability Building

  • Lead, guide, and develop teams across production, shift operations, process, quality, maintenance coordination, and support functions.
  • Build a high-performance work culture focused on safety, accountability, operational discipline, problem-solving, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop succession plans for critical roles and ensure capability building of engineers, supervisors, operators, and shift in-charges.
  • Drive training on SOPs, safety practices, process fundamentals, equipment operation, emergency response, and quality requirements.
  • Ensure effective manpower planning, shift rosters, contractor deployment, productivity tracking, and employee engagement across the plant

Systems, Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Implement and sustain systems such as TPM, 5S, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, Daily Management, ISO systems, and audit compliance.
  • Coordinate with regulatory bodies, auditors, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional teams for statutory, quality, safety, and environmental compliance.
  • Ensure accurate production reporting, SAP transactions, MIS dashboards, inventory control, and documentation for audit readiness.
  • Leverage DCS/SCADA, process data, digital dashboards, and analytics to improve decision-making and operational visibility.
  • Ensure reliability of all critical equipment through asset optimization and timely corrective actions.
  • Drive process optimization initiatives to improve plant efficiency, productivity, cost effectiveness, and operational stability.

Qualifications

Education Qualification:

  • B.E./B.Tech in Metallurgy, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related discipline. M.Tech/M.E. in Metallurgy, Chemical, Materials Science, or Process Engineering will be preferred.

Experiences:

  • 18 - 20 years of relevant experience in metals, non-ferrous metals, minor metals, smelting, refining, electrolysis/electrowinning, chemical processing, or continuous/process plant operations.
  • 10-15yrs of experience in handling plant at highest level

About Us

The road to empowerment is the one that guards a country’s stride onwards, keeping every hurdle that poses a threat to the constant pace of progress at bay. Yet another milestone in our growth story, is the business of Natural Resources. The scale of our business assures a steady availability of coal, extracted in the most responsible ways, which promises constant supply of power to both urban and rural geographies of India ensuring no hurdles are faced by the citizens in the path to achieving their dreams. The mining industry is considered a major contributor to the growth of the Indian economy. The mining business unit of the Adani group was established in 2007 as the last link in ensuring energy security for India. We are also developing and operating mines in Indonesia and Australia.

In the past few years, we have transformed from a coal trading and importing company to a comprehensive integrated coal management company. We have a diversified trading portfolio and are involved in Coal and Coke trading.

job.title: EBDG - Power Sales & Trading- Senior Manager
job.description:
Responsibilities

Team Lead - Sales, Billing and Licence

Tender Analysis and Participation:

Analyze monthly tender data from state-wise utilities to understand requirements and plan for participation.

Assess available capacity based on quarterly and yearly Operations and Maintainence (O&M) projections.

Review tender terms and conditions, identify risk factors, and highlight them for management review.

Float approval notes to the management for tender participation as per the Delegation of Authority (DOA).

Manage one-time registration for new plants on online portals and handle payments for participation.

Address clarifications from utilities and update management on critical points via email.

Coordinate with the Company Secretary for board resolutions required for tender participation.

Oversee the technical and financial bid qualification process, including support for Ernest Money Deposit (EMD) and Bank Guarantee (BG) submissions.

Monitor reverse auction proceedings, perform competitor analysis, and make strategic decisions based on market intelligence.

Prepare and submit Letters of Intent (LOI) and review Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) drafted by team members for accuracy and compliance.

Communicate effectively with utilities regarding any clarifications and maintain meticulous records of these communications.

Open Access Management:

Manage short-term open access contracts, ensuring compliance with buyer agreements and utility requirements.

Coordinate with utilities to determine the mode of power take-off, whether under General Network Access (GNA) or Temporary General Network Access (TGNA).

Conduct continuous contract monitoring from the start of the power supply, ensuring customer power off-take aligns with contract.

General Network Access (GNA) Contracts

Verify delivery points and create contracts based on the receiving substations' requirements.

Create and approve contracts on the Web-Based Scheduling (WBS) platform and ensure RLDC approval for power flow commencement.

Temeporary General Network Access (TGNA) Contracts

Apply for power flow applications through the National Open Access Registry (NOAR).

Ensure applications are submitted within the stipulated timelines and that Regional Load Dispatch Center (RLDC) approvals are diligently pursued and received.

Contract Monitoring:

Monitor daily power off-take by buyers and record data accurately in the system.

Notify buyers promptly if off-take falls below the contracted 85% threshold.

Ensure uniformity in off-take patterns and manage communication with buyers accordingly.

Request power requirements from buyers two days before execution and coordinate accordingly.

Collective Transactions:

Manage daily bidding activities on Indian Energy Exchange for collective transactions.

Coordinate availability confirmation from plants on Day-2 and Day-1.

Optimize trading strategies based on market dynamics and trade analysis reports from ELECOR.

Facilitate direct negotiations with buyers to secure premium rates and ensure timely trade execution.

Supervise Real-Time Market (RTM), Day Ahead Market (DAM), and Term Ahead Market (TAM) activities as per market conditions.

Long Duration Contracts:

Facilitate the submission and management of long-duration contracts on exchanges, ensuring compliance with timelines and commitments.

Participate in reverse auctions, monitor competing bids, and strategize to secure optimal rates.

Coordinate with buyers for prompt confirmation post-auction and manage power flow commencement timelines.

MIS Management:

Generate and circulate MIS reports to CEO and senior management, detailing power sales, revenue generated, and plant-wise performance.

Compile monthly trading analytics and sales reports across bilateral, term ahead, day ahead, and real-time markets.

Provide insights for future planning and decision-making based on exchange market performance.

Energy Trading (Power Sales to other Adani Group Companies):

Facilitate the purchase of power from wind and solar generators, acting as an intermediary to supply power to other Adani Group companies such as AEML, consumer products, ports, and Ambuja Cement.

Negotiate terms and conditions to establish contracts that meet the needs of both the power generators (sellers) and the end clients (buyers).

Benchmark industry rates to inform pricing decisions and finalize contracts based on competitive market analysis.

Customize standardized contracts to accommodate deviations on a case-by-case basis, ensuring all parties' interests are addressed.

Oversee the uploading of contracts onto the system for digital signing by the power generators.

Manage applications on State Load Dispatch Center (SLDC) portals for each power agreement, coordinating agreements by substations as needed.

Evaluate tender terms and conditions, identify potential risks, and seek necessary amendments or clarifications to ensure compliance and favorable contract terms.

Lead the bidding process on buyer-floated tenders, assessing the viability and risks involved.

Secure bank guarantees (BG) and board resolutions through the finance team, and manage the payment of fees to the Power Finance Corporation (PFC).

Monitor reverse auction proceedings and make strategic decisions based on competitor analysis and market intelligence.

Coordinate with utilities for the issuance of Letters of Intent (LOI) and review Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) for accuracy and compliance.

Act as a liaison between the State Load Dispatch Center (SLDC) , power generators, and buyers, resolving any queries that arise during contract formation.

Circulate the No Objection Certificate (NOC) provided by the State Load Dispatch Center (SLDC) to all parties, ensuring clear communication and agreement on contract terms.

Manage financial transactions between the generator and the buyer, including the issuance of invoices and the processing of payments, while ensuring margins are accounted for.

Handle the credit notes provided by the State Load Dispatch Center (SLDC) to the respective generator based on the power generation amount.

Raise invoices to the buyer based on consumption units as per the group credit note (GCN) and manage the payment process, deducting AEL's margins before paying the generator.

Energy Trading (Power Sales of other Adani Group Companies):

Manage daily forecasting for power generation from other Adani Companies such as Adani Green and execute contracts based on agreed terms and conditions, ensuring a smooth contractual process.

Sign power agreements digitally on a daily basis under a blanket contract with defined trading margins, and make informed decisions regarding the inclusion of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) in sales.

Oversee and facilitate the power flow from green energy sources to final buyers, handling invoice processes and transaction settlements accordingly.

Analyze market trends for Day Ahead Market (DAM) and Green DAM, deciding on the most favorable strategy for selling Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs).

Prepare comprehensive monthly trading reports detailing all green energy transactions and perform ongoing registration tasks for buyers and generators on national exchanges.

Exchange Bidding and Monitoring:

Monitor residual power for daily bidding in the Indian Energy Exchange across various markets: Day Ahead Market (DAM), Real-Time Market (RTM), and Term Ahead Market (TAM).

Analyze the best times to sell energy for premium rates and coordinate with buyers for one-to-one trades.

Observe market dynamics to capitalize on opportunities for obtaining premium rates.

Manage contingency trading in the RTM and ensure bids are placed within capacity limits.

Track bid validity, contract acceptance, and power flow commencement for long-duration contracts on the exchange.

Supervise long-duration contract applications, assess buyer confirmations, and monitor completion of reverse auctions for price setting.

Engage in Real-Time Market trading as required to manage any unfavorable circumstances which necessitate the buy or sale of power at short notice.

Create detailed sales analytics and allocation reports to aid in future planning and inform the strategic division of power sales channels across bilateral contracts and exchange markets.

Ensure timely completion of all contract performance guarantees and manage follow-ups for power supply commencement.

Manage the distribution of MIS reports to the management, detailing revenue generated, power sold, contract participation, and power availability insights.

Digitization and Automation:

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies to optimise operational efficiency

Implement automation solutions to support overall organisational goals / strategy

People and Team Management:

Foster a constructive team environment, managing team performance, and driving initiatives for continuous development and departmental excellence.

Ensure that all team members are aligned with the business strategy, promoting a culture of innovation and response to changes.

Manage team performance, driving initiatives for continuous development, and ensuring departmental excellence in line with business strategy.

Adani Green, AEML, Cement, Wilmur, Ports

Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Team

Finance Team

Legal Team

Fuel Management Team

State and Regional Utilities

SLDC

RLDC

Energy Exchange Platforms

Direct Consumers of Energy

Qualifications

B.E./ B.Tech (Mechanical, Electrical, related field), Additional Degrees or Cetifications (Energy management, Business Administration, related field) preferred

Minimum 6 years of experience in power trading negotiations, contract management, or related role.

Preferred Industry:

Background in the power and energy sector with exposure to power trading mechanisms, policy landscapes and renewable energy trading.

job.title: Lead Fire & Safety
job.description:
Responsibilities

Lead the planning, engineering, and design of Fire Alarm & Public Address (FAPA) systems, CCTV systems, and associated ELV infrastructure for high-rise and large-scale developments.

Ensure compliance with applicable National and International Fire Safety Codes & Standards, including NBC, NFPA, BS/EN, and other relevant regulations.

Develop and review fire safety solutions for:

  • High-rise buildings
  • Commercial developments
  • Mixed-use developments
  • Large floor area facilities
  • Smart and integrated buildings

Drive the integration of FAPA systems with various building systems to enhance fire safety management and emergency response effectiveness, including:

  • Building Management System (BMS)
  • HVAC & Smoke Management Systems
  • Elevator Recall & Fireman's Lift Operations
  • Access Control Systems
  • CCTV & Video Management Systems
  • Public Address & Voice Evacuation Systems
  • Emergency Lighting Systems
  • Central Monitoring Stations
  • Integrated Command & Control Centers

Establish and optimize centralized fire monitoring and control room operations, ensuring real-time monitoring of:

  • Fire alarms and events
  • System health status
  • Fault management
  • Device connectivity
  • Emergency response workflows

Review cause-and-effect matrices, system architecture, zoning philosophy, network design, and automation logic for integrated fire protection systems.

Provide technical leadership during design reviews, commissioning, testing, and handover stages.

Desired Candidate Profile

✔ Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Electrical/Electronics/Instrumentation/Fire Engineering or equivalent)

✔ Minimum 12-14 years of proven experience in planning and designing FAPA and CCTV systems.

✔ Demonstrated experience in delivering fire safety technology solutions for high-rise buildings and large-area developments.

✔ Strong knowledge of:

  • NBC India
  • NFPA Standards
  • BS/EN Standards
  • Fire Engineering Principles
  • ELV Systems Design
  • Intelligent Building Systems

✔ Hands-on experience in integrating fire alarm systems with building automation and centralized monitoring platforms.

✔ Strong understanding of command center operations, remote monitoring, system analytics, and fire system health management.

✔ Excellent stakeholder management and multidisciplinary coordination skills.

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor's, Master's Degree, Additional Degrees or Certification in Security Management preferred

Work Experience (Range of years):

Minimum 15 years in the corporate security field, fire , safety field

job.title: Deputy Manager - Mine Surveyor
job.description:
Responsibilities

Mine Surveyor - Coal Mining

Conducting Surveys and Measurements:

Perform detailed topographic and underground surveys using the latest surveying equipment and techniques to accurately measure and map the mine’s physical features.

Measure and record the dimensions, elevations, and contours of mine workings and geological formations, ensuring all data is precise and reliable.

Utilize advanced surveying software to collect, analyze, and process survey data, ensuring accurate and timely reporting.

Developing and Maintaining Mine Plans:

Create and regularly update accurate mine plans, layouts, and sectional drawings that reflect the current state of mine workings and future development plans.

Ensure all mine plans and layouts comply with statutory requirements, industry standards, and company policies, facilitating smooth regulatory audits and inspections.

Collaborate with mining engineers, geologists, and mine management to adjust and optimize plans based on operational needs and geological findings.

Monitoring Geological Features:

Identify, record, and monitor geological formations, faults, and potential hazards within the mine, providing early warnings of any changes that could impact safety or operations.

Assist in the assessment of ground stability, roof conditions, and potential safety risks by providing accurate geological data and interpretations.

Support geological mapping and modeling efforts with precise survey data, aiding in the prediction and management of geological conditions.

Ensuring Regulatory Compliance:

Adhere to all relevant mining regulations, safety standards, and environmental guidelines, ensuring that all surveying activities are conducted legally and ethically.

Prepare, maintain, and submit required reports, records, and documentation to regulatory bodies, ensuring all data is accurate and submitted in a timely manner.

Participate in safety audits, inspections, and reviews, providing necessary survey data and supporting documentation to demonstrate compliance and identify areas for improvement.

Supporting Mine Planning and Development:

Provide critical survey data and insights to support the design, planning, and optimization of mine development projects, ensuring efficient and safe operations.

Assist in the planning, coordination, and execution of mine expansion and development projects, providing accurate survey data to guide decision-making and project implementation.

Work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, operations, and safety, to ensure alignment of surveying activities with overall mine operational goals and objectives.

Implement and Optimize Digital Solutions:

Coordinate with cross-functional teams to deploy digital tools that align with business objectives.

Ensure the effective utilization of digital platforms to improve team efficiency and productivity.

Key Stakeholders - Internal

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

HODs

Employees

Key Stakeholders - External

DGMS

Forest Department

Environment

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Work Experience (Range of years):

12-20 years

job.title: Duty Manager - Aocc&jcc
job.description:
Responsibilities

| | | | --- | --- | | Key Responsibilities of Role | |

Operation Management:

Oversee daily operations at the AOCC and JCC during shifts to ensure smooth functioning of airport systems, including flight operations, baggage handling, and passenger management.

Monitor and coordinate real-time operational data to maintain high On-Time Performance (OTP), proactively addressing delays or disruptions.

Oversee the allocation of airport resources such as check-in counters, boarding gates, parking stands, and conveyor belts to optimize asset utilization.

Manage Flight Information Display Systems (FIDS) to display real-time, accurate information for passengers and stakeholders.

Monitor and notify stakeholders of adverse weather warnings and implement Low Visibility Procedures (LVP) during weather disruptions to ensure safe operations.

Crisis Management and Incident Response:

Develop and implement crisis management plans to effectively respond to emergencies such as security threats, medical incidents, and operational disruptions.

Ensure the effective implementation of Low Visibility Procedures (LVP) and maintain close coordination with ATC during weather challenges.

Provide training and conduct regular drills with AOCC/JCC staff for better preparedness during emergencies.

Resource Allocation and Utilization:

Allocate and manage resources such as personnel, equipment, and technology within the AOCC to ensure optimal utilization and operational efficiency.

Monitor resource usage including ground support equipment and personnel deployment, addressing any issues related to allocation, availability, and maintenance.

Compliance and Regulatory Oversight:

Ensure strict adherence to the Operational Management Development Agreement (OMDA) and comply with guidelines from government agencies and regulatory bodies (e.g., DGCA, AAI).

Implement and monitor the Noise Abatement Plan to mitigate the environmental impact of airport operations, aligning with prescribed standards and ensuring regulatory compliance.

Documentation and Reporting:

Ensure accurate and timely documentation of all operational activities, events, and incidents to maintain an updated operational record.

Generate and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly reports related to airport performance, On-Time Performance (OTP), resource utilization, and emergency management.

Oversee the maintenance of MIS systems to ensure that operational data is captured correctly for aero invoicing and compliance audits.

Prepare comprehensive reports on disruptions, emergencies, and performance trends for internal review and management decision-making.

Team Leadership and Development:

Lead and mentor team members within the AOCC/JCC, providing guidance on best practices in airport operations, emergency response, and customer service standards.

Conduct performance evaluations and implement professional development plans for team members, ensuring adherence to industry regulations and performance benchmarks.

Stakeholder Coordination and Communication:

Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, including airlines, ground services, security, and customs, to ensure smooth operations and address any issues that arise within the AOCC.

Facilitate communication and collaboration between the AOCC and other JCC departments to resolve operational challenges, improve efficiency, and enhance passenger experience.

Process Improvement:

Support in the execution of Business Excellence programs focusing on process improvement, energy-saving initiatives, and operational efficiency during shift operations.

Contribute to the implementation and maintenance of Business Continuity Management Systems (BCMS) to ensure uninterrupted airport operations in case of emergencies.

Assist in DA-CDM (Domestic Airport Collaborative Decision Making) implementation to improve operational coordination between stakeholders and enhance On-Time Performance (OTP).

Digital Mindset:

Use real-time dashboards, data analytics, and collaborative decision-making tools to enhance operational efficiency.

Ensure accurate data capture for generating MIS reports and aero invoicing for operational reconciliation.

Monitor the use of digital platforms like A-CDM to streamline collaboration with stakeholders.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Head - AOCC/JCC

Direct Supervisors & other Department Leaders

Airport Operations Team

Air Traffic Control

Airport Security

Emergency Medical Services

Engineering & Maintenance Team

Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Team

Key Stakeholders - External:

Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA)

Airports Authority of India

Ministry of Civil Aviation

Airlines

Ground Handling Agencies

Service providers

Govt. agencies (CISF/ATC)

Qualifications

Educational Background:

Bachelor's Degree in Aviation Management, Business Administration, or a related field

Master's Degree in a relevant field is preferred.

Work Experience:

10 years of relevant experience in managing operations at a control centre

Same Posting Description for Internal and External Candidates

job.title: Lead Automation
job.description:
Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end planning, design, implementation, and commissioning of security automation systems for new and existing projects.
  • Take ownership of all security automation solutions deployed at sites, ensuring seamless functionality and reliability.

  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to engineers, technicians, and project teams.
  • Manage project execution timelines, resources, and stakeholder expectations.

  • Vendor management and stakeholder coordination

job.title: Associate Manager - Terminal Retail & F&B
job.description:

Retail Operations Support:

  • Monitor the retail floor for compliance with operational standards, ensuring adherence to store opening times, product displays, and customer service protocols.

  • Ensure retailers are adhering to product quality standards on a daily basis.

  • Report any non-compliance or quality issues immediately to Senior Executive/ Assistant Lead - Retail for further action.

Merchandise Stock and Layout Support:

  • Ensure that the retail merchandise is adequately stocked and available on the floor at all times.
  • Assist with the daily checking and replenishment of stock, ensuring a balanced and attractive product range.
  • Support the team in implementing zoning strategies within the retail space to maximize product visibility and sales.

Data Collection and Reporting Assistance:

  • Collect and maintain data related to sales, customer trends, and stock levels from different retail outlets.
  • Help prepare simple reports based on collected data, highlighting key trends and areas for improvement.
  • Track inventory levels and assist in identifying items with low stock or high sales potential.
  • Update inventory management systems with real-time data and report any stock discrepancies.

Retailer Coordination and Operational Support:

  • Serve as a point of contact for retailers, ensuring they receive the support they need in day-to-day operations.
  • Coordinate with retailers to resolve minor operational issues promptly, ensuring minimal disruption.
  • Communicate with the operations department to fulfill retailer requests and address any operational concerns.

Education Qualification:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Retail Management, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Certifications in Retail Management, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).

Work Experience:

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in retail sales and customer service, preferably within the airport retail sector.

job.title: Supervisor - Operations (ILHBS)
job.description:
Responsibilities

Baggage Screening and Threat Detection:

  • Attend all the regulatory trainings and clear trainings as per the regulatory attempts
  • Operate X-BIS equipment for image analysis to detect Dangerous Goods, Prohibited Articles, Weapons, or Ammunition in check-in baggage as per Avsec circulars/ orders /guidelines and SOPs.
  • Perform physical inspections and ETD tests for baggage flagged during X-ray screening.
  • Maintain a high standard of TIP (Threat Image Projection) scores to reflect strong image interpretation capabilities.

Compliance with Aviation Security Directives:

  • Follow BCAS and DGCA guidelines to ensure strict compliance during baggage handling and inspection tasks.
  • Record and document all findings and operations to meet audit and inspection requirements.
  • Equipment Maintenance and Pre-Operational Checks:
  • Conduct routine pre-operational checks of X-BIS, ETD, CT-EDS other security equipment to confirm their readiness and functionality.
  • Report equipment malfunctions or downtime and assist in maintaining operational registers.

Stakeholder Interaction and Coordination:

  • Work collaboratively with CISF and Airlines staff during physical baggage inspections or suspicious item resolutions.
  • Provide timely updates to supervisors about ongoing operations or issues that may require intervention.

Time Management and Efficiency:

  • Ensure baggage screening and inspection are completed within strict timelines to avoid operational delays.
  • Balance thoroughness and speed to maintain operational flow without compromising safety.

Workplace Conduct and Decorum:

  • Maintain professionalism and discipline at all times, contributing positively to the team environment.
  • Uphold organizational standards in workplace behavior, ensuring compliance with company policies.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • CSO
  • Lead Avsec Audit & Compliance
  • Pass Section
  • Lead - ILHBS/ Duty Manager - ILHBS/ Sr Screener
  • Terminal Operations
  • IT
  • HR Department
  • Compliance and Regulatory Teams
  • Other Airport Departments (e.g., Operations, Customer Service)

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • Transportation Security Administration (TSA)
  • Aircraft Operator
  • Airport Authorities
  • Passengers
  • ASG
  • BCAS
  • Local Police
  • Service Providers
  • Law Enforcement Agencies
  • Regulatory Bodies
  • Industry Associations

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Bachelor’s or equivalent degree
  • Certifications: TSA certification required; Desirable to have cleared AVSEC basic course by BCAS, standalone / Inline Screeners certification by BCAS, DGR CAT 12 certification by DGCA Approved training center
  • NCC – “C” or “B” Certificate Holder will be preferred

Work Experience:

  • Freshers or 1-2 years of experience in security screening or a related field, preferably within an airport setting.
  • Experience operating screening equipment and familiarity with security protocols.

Physical Qualification:

  • Visual accuracy - Eyesight shall be equal or better than 20/60 in both eyes without glasses /
  • lenses or equal or better that 20 / 20 in one eye and 20 / 30 in the other when using glasses
  • or contact lenses. Adequate color perception shall be required.
  • Hearing – Hearing loss in each ear should be less than 30 dB when tested by audio graph for
  • frequencies below 2000 Hz.
  • Speech – There shall be clear ability to communicate orally efficiently and effectively.
  • Movement-of-crisis communication necessitates that screening personnel be free from any
  • pronounced speed impediment.
  • Sense of smell – Security personnel shall have the ability to sense Oduor
  • Deportment & Appearance - Security personnel must demonstrate a high standard of civility,
  • deportment, appearance and sobriety as well as offer the public all appropriate courtesies.

job.title: Executive - IT
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Assist in establishing annual IT departmental goals and objectives.
  • Support overall management of IT operations including hardware, software, applications, digital, and networking.
  • Assist in IT governance – contract management, vendor management, IT procurement, vendor performance evaluation, SLA management, AMC/warranty management, etc.
  • Help in preparing IT Opex/Capex budget, IT cost control, and cost optimization on operational expenses/budget.
  • Support IT requirement analysis, planning, prioritizing, and execution for setting up new project sites.
  • Ensure uninterrupted operation of IT systems to support business requirements.
  • Assist in the identification, design, development, and implementation of new IT applications/IT infrastructure and changes to existing computer systems and software packages.
  • Provide technological support in the implementation of automation, security, surveillance, and access control systems and create interfaces of these applications with other business applications.
  • IT service management with Service Now tool as per ITIL framework. Track all incidents and service requests in the Service Now tool. Fetch all reports and prepare MIS from the Service Now database. IT asset management through CMDB database.
  • Manage and maintain data centers, all servers, networks, video conference systems, video surveillance, and access control systems.
  • Manage facility (IT helpdesk) management services. Manage user ticket escalation and take up with partner/vendor and respective teams to close in a timely manner.
  • Ensure IT network security through robust firewall and proxy server administration and management systems.
  • Monitor IT security compliance of end-user devices, DC devices, and network devices. Use Power BI reports to identify gaps and mitigate any risks.
  • Implement and provide support for video surveillance and access control systems.
  • Review the network, datacenter, DR, and security design of new projects (apps, infra) or changes to existing systems by internal teams or by the IT service partner(s).
  • Research the latest market/technology trends for IT, OT/IOT, and information security.
  • Act as a technical expert on routing and switching, datacenter networking, and security technologies. Implementation and operational experience with enterprise-class routers, switches, and firewalls.
  • Experience with load balancers, internet gateways, IPS/IDS, network security technologies like ACLs, VPN, L2VPN, L3VPN, IPSEC, GRE.
  • Experience working with visualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-v, etc.) and virtual networks, datacenter networking like BGP-Lite, VLAN, VxLAN, FCoE, TRILL, OTV, IS-IS.
  • Knowledge and experience in cloud computing infrastructure and orchestration, advanced knowledge of Cisco security policy design and implementation, strong to advanced knowledge of Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers.

Success Measures

  • Domain: Information Technology
  • Key Result Area: IT infrastructure, IT security, IT facility management, IT and digital projects, automation/digitization, IT budgeting, cost control procurement, vendor management, IT applications, data center management.
  • KPI / Outcome: Server availability & security, network availability & security, EUS availability & security, no of incidents, % of tickets breaching SLA, on-time completion of IT and digital projects, no of projects completed, timely adherence & within budget, IT applications availability (SAP ERP, Outlook, HCMS, KRONOS, Minex, WB applications, Oracle-based application, etc.) – 99.5%, 99.5% uptime.

Qualifications

  • Qualifications: Essential: BE/B.Tech in CSE/IT or MCA from a reputed institute (Regular)
  • Certifications: Desirable: ITIL, CCNA, MCSE, PMP, SIAM, Cloud Certification, PRINCE2, CISSP
  • Experience: 5 - 10 years of experience

Manager - Regulatory & Commercial (ERCG)

Billing and Revenue Management:

Manage the comprehensive management of revenue, ensuring all billing activities in accordance with the SOP for Power Sale align with organizational financial objectives.

Collect necessary information and inputs for billing, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.

Issue accurate and timely invoices to customers or power procurers

Monitor payments to ensure they are received by the due date.

Maintain and update all invoicing information on the Ministry of Power portal, responding to any disputes raised by customers.

Continuously monitor replies and communications within the portal.

Verify customer information and address anomalies if any to prevent delays.

Payment Tracking and Dispute Resolution:

Proactively track payments and initiate letters of credit (LC) to encash funds when payments are delayed.

In the event of a dispute, ensure that customers pay 85% of the invoice amount as per contract, providing justification for the payment.

Manage stay orders from the regulatory committee, waiting for resolutions before proceeding with collections.

Communicate with banks regarding payment statuses, letter of credit (LC) issuances.

Ensure the original letter of credit (LC) value is restored within 7 days if utilized.

Portal Management:

Update the Payment Security Portal (PSA) and Praapti portal with necessary information. For e.g. letter of credit (LC) availability.

Monitor power curtailment actions by the System Operator as mandated by the Ministry of Power.

Document payment statuses and upload all bills to the Praapti portal, ensuring accurate and timely updates of procurer details.

Enforce restrictions on short-term power purchases for entities with outstanding payments beyond 75 days as recorded in the Praapti portal.

Interact with the state load dispatch center, central dispatch, and Ministry of Power as necessary, ensuring compliance with operational guidelines.

Financial Reporting and Reconciliation:

Prepare MIS reports detailing expected revenue, expenses for each customer, due bills, and collection targets, comparing actual receipts against targets.

Conduct quarterly or annual reconciliations of bills admitted, signed off, and payments made, reporting reconciliation status.

Draft replies for customer correspondence and ensure accurate entry of bills into the SAP system as payments are made.

Regulatory Support and Tariff Management:

Provide data input to the regulatory team for unresolved disputes and ongoing cases.

Apply for provisional tariffs if petitions are not filed in a timely manner and submit claims for the regulatory team to file petitions.

In cases where section 63 of the PPA applies, ensure the sharing of fuel costs and other expenses for reimbursement.

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor's Degree (Finance, Business Administration, related fields)

Work Experience (Range of years):

Minimum 5 years of experience in billing, financial management, or a relevant commercial role within a corporate setting.

Preferred Industry:

Background in the power and energy sector with exposure to commercial and regulatory processes pertaining to billing and payments.

job.title: Lead - Travel Services
job.description:
Responsibilities

Partner with Head-Ahmedabad in understanding the organization’s requirement for Hard services across all facilities (including MEP maintenance services, Inventory management for all supplies and tools, Infrastructure management and maintenance, and space management)

Develop the budget for Hard Services in consultation with Head-Ahmedabad;

Ensure adherence to pre-defined budgetary and cost optimization guidelines

Define a service delivery framework and service delivery plan for hard services basis the requirements for every facility/property under purview

Define and communicate operating procedure/ guidelines for hard services in accordance with the overall policy guidelines; Update the operating procedures from time to time keeping in consideration the changing business dynamics and requirements

Conduct Need assessment of MEP services from future operational perspective

Develop a Business Continuity plan from an Admin perspective to ensure smooth operations across locations

Develop & ensure implementation of SOPs, Engineering Guidelines for Electro- mechanical services, and operation control procedures for smooth operations

Prepare, analyse & improve SoWs for AMCs for maximum benefit realisation

Assess, identify, and plan the Life Cycle Completion, replacement of the Electro-mechanical equipment

Plan a calendar and ensure all MEP activities and structural upgradations are carried out for all facilities (heating/cooling systems, plumbing and water management, lightings, scientific tank cleaning, façade cleaning, painting etc.) with minimal/ zero downtime/ service disruption

Conduct service inspection and create a sustenance plan for pre-emptive and reactive maintenance to minimize downtime at Sites

Track and ensure timely renewal & submission of all mandatory compliances, licenses and health, safety, and statutory environmental requirements

Run and oversee complete snag management cycle for acquired property / infrastructure; Ensure closure of critical snags pertaining to MEP services.

Ensure monitoring of PPM calendar with adherence to all safety protocols

Management of readable Blue-prints, Schematics and diagrams of the equipment’s

Analyse and record all test results and prepare analysis documentation statement

Oversee all mechanical services including HVAC systems, elevators, escalators, Mechanized Systems- BMU, Façade Cradle systems, Dumb waiters, waste disposal systems, Lift well and Stairwell pressurization system, Basement Ventilation & Exhaust System, etc.

Oversee all electrical & instrumentation services including lighting, load Management & distribution systems, UPS, elevators, earthing and grounding systems

Oversee all plumbing services including domestic water system, Softener System, RO system, hot & cold-water system, flushing water system, sewage water system, storage tanks, rainwater harvesting system, Water bodies etc.

Design a plan for mechanical services basis the requirement for the property and work closely with engineering team for proper and timely support

Devise an annual maintenance calendar for inspection of all services and create a plan for preventive and reactive maintenance for mechanical services to minimize downtime

Develop a robust breakdown maintenance plan for all core mechanical services; Manage proper placement of signage pertaining to demarcation of safety lines around electromechanical area

Create a training calendar to ensure resources are updated with the technical know-how, market best practices and industry standards

Manage day to day operations (including routine maintenance operations, IBMS Rooms and related services and preventive controls) of all mechanical services at respective facility, site or guest house and address critical incidents if any while reporting any near misses

Review mechanical services’ performance at regular intervals; Conduct audits and root cause analysis of identified issues and ensure timely resolution of all problems with optimal utilization of all resources to increase site effectiveness.

Lead the conceptualization, design development and planning of new building and infrastructure.

Collaborate with Architect, Interior Design, MEP Consultants to finalize the design and execute strategy.

Review and validate design proposals, layout plans and construction drawings.

Execution and monitoring of Projects.

Monitor appropriate and timely resolution of hard services’ queries/ grievance redressal at the Helpdesk; Address escalations if any and provide guidance to teams to effectively resolve all queries

Analyse the service performance and employee satisfaction levels (through formal / informal feedback) and pilot strategic initiatives to drive process improvements to improve employee satisfaction

Maintain close coordination with other departmental services viz. Fire, Security, Telecom, IT and extend support as required

Manage communication pertaining to planned maintenance activities

Adhere to the Admin Governance framework and ensure all hard service processes are in compliance with the same

Analyse audit findings with regards to hard service operations and collaborate with the concerned stakeholders to develop effective action plans for mitigating risks/ gaps identified

Ensure timely submission & verification of service partner bills as well as timely pay-out as per agreed SLAs (for all facility services)

Conduct operational reviews from time to time and ensure smooth service delivery and adherence to defined SLAs for hard services

Identify and build partnerships and relationships with external vendors, government officials to ensure all necessary permits are in place

Successfully leverage these networks for value creation for Adani; Oversee partner offerings and lead negotiations with them for all hard services

Provide insights on service partner performance and address/ resolve any escalations

Identify areas within Hard services which could be automated/ integrated with technology and collaborate with the relevant stakeholders to plan and deploy these initiatives

Ensure smooth functioning of the tools for Hard services’ delivery; Track customer satisfaction levels

Assets’ database to be maintained basis tagging of assets and verified on a bi-annual basis

  • Coordinate with third party for timely availability of contractual manpower, manage them through shift planning and manage daily roster for all services; Ensure staff is working in line with the agreed SLA
  • Drive a performance driven culture – Set goals, review performance and provide feedback to ensure a motivated and committed team
  • Foster an environment of learning and excellence within the team.

4.

Internal External

  • Interact with Group Admin Head/Lead-Shantigram Cluster to formulate and continually validate the roadmap and plan for Hard Services’ delivery
  • Interact with a service partners and build strategic relationships with them with an objective of service excellence.
  • Collaborate with various stakeholders across businesses and understand their requirements, grievances about hard services
  • Interact with existing partners to reinforce working relationship, strengthen collaboration, track service deliveries and mitigate risks if any

5.

6.

Key Result Areas (KRAs)

Strategy

  • Business Plan formulation & Deployment
  • Improvement Initiatives’ Implementation

Financial

  • Budget Creation
  • Budget Compliance
  • Cost Optimization

Process

  • Hard Services Process Compliance
  • Hard Services Process Efficiency
  • Hard Services Process Enhancement
  • Drive Process Optimization and Standardization
  • Customer Satisfaction
  • Query Resolution /Grievance Redressal

People

  • Partner Relationship Management
  • People management & Skill Development

Qualifications

  • B.E./B.Tech in Electrical / Mechanical Engineering (Preferred: MBA (Operations/Facilities Management) / PGDM in Facilities Management)
  • 8-12 years of experience in Facility Management, Corporate Administration, Workplace Services, Hospitality, Real Estate Operations, or IFM.
  • Min 5+ years in Technical Services, Facility Engineering, Building Operations, or IFM.
  • Experience managing corporate campuses, commercial buildings, data centers, industrial facilities, or mixed-use developments.
  • Hands-on exposure to MEP operations and critical infrastructure management.
  • Exposure in facility digitization and CAFM implementation.

Experience handling senior leadership and executive workplace environments

job.title: Site HR Operations Partner
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Onboarding:

Support recruitment processes tailored to the site's requirements

  • Enabling the Day-1 onboarding based on document verification in coordination with security
  • Coordinate with Admin for Joining Kit distribution based on pre-shared joining lists
  • Ensure IT asset allocation on day of joining by coordinating with the IT team
  • Manage the onboarding process to ensure a seamless transition for new hires.
  • Administrative support for managing the induction process as designed
  • Welcome session with the new joiner and meet & greet with the Manager & team

Contractor Labor Management System:

  • Unique contractor ID creation & update in the CLMS (Kronos) for all contractors
  • Enable time and attendance tracking for all workmen at the sites
  • Manage the off-roll workforce management with focus on Legatrix platform and oversee the licenses and RC of labor laws
  • On ground coordination with the BU, contractor, security & other departments in case of offboarding

Performance and Development:

  • Administer performance management systems and work with leaders to ensure regular feedback and development planning.
  • Identify training needs and coordinate relevant learning and development initiatives to upskill employees.
  • Support GCC Towers in execution of the annual review cycles in order to achieve timely competition

Compliance and Policy Implementation:

  • Ensure adherence to all applicable labor laws and internal policies.
  • Review and update HR policies to reflect the dynamic needs of the capability center.
  • Managing Labor law related notices, filing of Monthly/ Quarterly/ Half yearly/ Annual returns (Non-Payroll) (including Apprentice Act)
  • Statutory documentation and recordkeeping team is responsible for the document management of all the sites

Health, Safety, and Wellbeing:

  • Coordinates the communication between the Site HR/Cluster HR Head and GCC LEA team whenever needed on employee health & safety issues
  • Support in incident management with coordination between employee/workmen, regional site manager, reporting manager and BU HR
  • Logging & escalating the required incidents to Group IR team over a call/e-mail in case of critical incidents

Stakeholder management:

  • Cultivate long standing relationships with local departments, regional labor office and other external stakeholders to maintain seamless operations.
  • Develop and implement effective communication strategies to engage stakeholders and keep them informed about site activities, changes, and developments.

Employee Engagement and Culture:

  • Organize events, workshops, and activities to foster a vibrant and inclusive workplace culture.
  • Support the employee engagement events by coordination with established vendors, procurement and administration teams
  • Calendarization of events and designing, communicating and coordinating for all engagement events at the sites

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. A Master’s degree or MBA in HR is advantageous.
  • 3-10 years of HR experience, with at least 2 years in a management role within a manufacturing unit, plant or similar environment.

job.title: Duty Manager - Landside Security
job.description:
Responsibilities

Security Operations Management:

Oversee day-to-day landside security operations during shifts for landside, city side, airport village site, including patrolling, access control, and surveillance activities, to ensure adherence to established policies and procedures.

Act as the primary point of contact for on-site security teams, providing guidance and addressing any issues that arise promptly to maintain secure and seamless operations.

Conduct regular inspections of landside areas to identify potential risks or deviations from established standards.

Ensure operational readiness of all security equipment, including CCTV systems, access control devices, and communication tools. Coordinate with the Integrated Security Operations Center (ISOC) for seamless monitoring and response.

Incident Reporting and Response:

Coordinate initial response efforts during security incidents, gathering relevant information and ensuring immediate actions are taken to address the situation effectively.

Prepare detailed incident reports for the Lead - Landside Security, capturing all relevant information and contributing to follow-up investigations and preventive measures.

Supervision of Access Control and Traffic Management:

Oversee access control, Crowd control, Traffic management, loss prevention and asset protections measures for landside areas, including vehicle and personnel access, ensuring compliance with security protocols and addressing any exceptions or irregularities.

Manage traffic flow within landside zones, implementing measures to prevent congestion and maintain a secure environment for all employees, visitors, and vendors.

Ensure round the clock protection to both the tangible and intangible assets.

Risk Assessment and Mitigation:

Conduct routine risk assessments of landside operations and recommend mitigation measures.

Monitor local, national, and international developments that may impact landside security operations.

Report potential risks to the Lead - Landside Security and suggest proactive measures to address them.

Team Coordination and Scheduling:

Plan and manage shift schedules for landside security staff, coordinating coverage to ensure all critical areas are monitored and secured at all times.

Facilitate communication within the team, holding regular briefings to discuss daily objectives, key concerns, and any updates to security protocols that need to be followed.

Provide on-the-job training and guidance to security staff to improve performance and compliance.

Monitor the performance of outsourced security staff and escalate issues to the vendor management team if needed.

Compliance and Audit Support:

Conduct routine audits of landside security operations to identify areas for improvement and ensure full compliance with established standards.

Support internal and external audits by providing required documentation and ensuring compliance with findings.

Update staff on new regulations, SOP changes, and directives issued by regulatory agencies.

Stakeholder Liaison:

Act as the primary point of contact for landside security issues during the shift.

Collaborate with airport operations, law enforcement agencies, and other stakeholders to resolve operational challenges.

Address complaints or concerns from passengers, visitors, and employees regarding security matters.

Reporting and Documentation:

Review and submit shift reports detailing incidents, operational highlights, and staff performance.

Maintain accurate records of access control activities, visitor management, and incident investigations.

Ensure all documentation is updated and stored securely for audit and compliance purposes.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Lead - Landside Security

Operations Team

Facilities Management

Security Control Room Team

Airlines

HR and Training Team

Key Stakeholders - External:

Local Law Enforcement Agencies

Regulatory Bodies (e.g., BCAS)

Third-Party Security Service Providers

Contractors and Vendors

Community Representatives

Customs

Emergency Response Services (EMS, Fire Services)

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Security Management, Public Safety, or a related discipline.

AVSEC certification or equivalent airport security certification.

Training in Crisis Management or Incident Response is preferred.

Work Experience:

5-10 (Depending on the site complexity/ requirement) years of experience in a security operations role, with at least 2 years in a supervisory capacity.

Experience in managing daily security operations, handling incidents, and ensuring compliance with security policies and protocols.

job.title: Assistant Manager - IT
job.description:
Responsibilities

Business Applications

  • Support and coordinate business applications such as SAP, MES, PLM, and other plant systems.
  • Work closely with business users and application partners to resolve issues and implement improvements.
  • Ensure smooth operation and availability of applications to support business processes.
  • Manage user access, application changes, and audit-related activities.

IT & OT Cybersecurity

  • Ensure compliance with IT and OT cybersecurity policies and guidelines.
  • Coordinate cybersecurity assessments, audits, and closure of security observations.
  • Monitor and support resolution of cybersecurity incidents and risks.
  • Assist in securing critical manufacturing and business systems.

Partner & Vendor Management

  • Coordinate with application, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and telecom partners.
  • Monitor service quality and ensure timely resolution of issues.
  • Conduct regular reviews and follow up on pending action items.
  • Support contract renewals, procurement, and service improvements.

Telecom Services Management

  • Manage telecom services such as mobile connectivity, internet links, leased lines, and IBS solutions.
  • Coordinate with service providers to resolve connectivity issues and improve service quality.
  • Ensure reliable communication services across all plant locations.

Server & Data Center Management

  • Oversee server and data center operations to ensure stable and secure services.
  • Coordinate backups, patching, upgrades, and disaster recovery activities.
  • Monitor infrastructure health and support capacity planning initiatives.

Compliance & Audit Support

  • Support internal and external audits, cybersecurity reviews, and compliance activities.
  • Ensure adherence to IT policies, SOPs, and governance requirements.
  • Track audit observations and ensure timely closure of action items.

Service Continuity

  • Ensure uninterrupted availability of critical business applications and IT services.
  • Coordinate incident, problem, and change management activities.
  • Support disaster recovery and business continuity initiatives.

Digital & Continuous Improvement

  • Support digital transformation and smart manufacturing initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements.
  • Work with business teams to enhance system effectiveness and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

B.E./B.Tech in IT, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field with 3-5 years of experience in business applications, IT operations, IT/OT cybersecurity, vendor management, infrastructure support, and governance activities. Experience in a manufacturing environment and exposure to SAP/MES applications will be preferred.

job.title: Manager - Operations Research Scientist
job.description:
Responsibilities

Operations Research Scientist-AI Labs

Development & Implementation of Optimization Models:

Improve operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness by developing and implementing optimization models for logistics, supply chain, manufacturing, and other business processes.

Enhance business decision-making by applying mathematical optimization techniques such as linear programming, combinatorial optimization, integer programming, and network flow algorithms.

Ensure scalability and adaptability of models by leveraging advanced AI ML methodologies, hybrid optimization techniques, and data-driven simulation models.

Optimize business strategies by integrating optimization models into long-term strategic planning and short-term tactical decision-making.

Advanced Algorithm Development & Problem Solving:

Enhance model performance and accuracy by leveraging simulated annealing, genetic algorithms, tabu search, Markov decision processes, and ant colony optimization.

Drive process automation and optimization by designing data-driven decision support systems to optimize business workflows.

Optimize EV fleet operations by designing data-driven charging optimization models, ensuring cost-effective and efficient EV charging strategies.

Enhance cost reduction in logistics by applying combinatorial optimization, network flow algorithms, and machine learning-driven route planning.

Reduce complexity and improve computational efficiency by implementing decomposition algorithms and large-scale mathematical models.

Business Problem-Solving with Operations Research:

Enable predictive and prescriptive decision-making by analyzing historical and real-time data to develop optimal operational strategies.

Minimize operational disruptions and enhance resource utilization by applying discrete event simulation techniques.

Improve cost efficiency and risk mitigation by integrating optimization models with business forecasting and financial planning.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & AI Integration:

Ensure alignment of optimization models with business objectives by collaborating with business leaders, strategy teams, and data scientists.

Drive AI adoption in operations research by working with IT and engineering teams to deploy models on scalable cloud-based platforms.

Translate complex mathematical models into actionable insights by effectively communicating findings to C-level executives and decision-makers.

AI Governance, Compliance & Continuous Improvement:

Ensure regulatory compliance and ethical AI implementation by developing governance frameworks for AI-driven optimization models.

Improve model robustness and reliability by conducting regular model validation, risk assessment, and algorithm tuning.

Drive continuous innovation in operations research by staying updated with emerging AI trends, algorithmic advancements, and best practices in mathematical optimization.

Key Stakeholders - Internal

Business Strategy & Operations Teams

Data Science & AI Teams

IT & Cloud Engineering Teams

Finance & Risk Management Teams

Key Stakeholders - External

Technology Vendors & AI Solution Providers

Research Institutions & Academia

Regulatory Authorities & Compliance Bodies

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related fields.

Certification:

Certified Optimization & OR Specialist (CPLEX Gurobi Certification)

Advanced AI & ML Certification (Google AWS Microsoft AI)

Data Science & Statistical Analysis Certification (Coursera IBM DataCamp)

Work Experience (Range of years):

5-10 years of experience in developing and deploying operations research models in engineering, logistics, manufacturing, or supply chain domains.

Brand Positioning: Ensure Adani's brand values are shown in all interactions. Strengthen relationships to boost the organization's brand and trust within the market and company.

Promote a respectful and safe workplace, lead collaborative and productive teams, and mentor for growth and success. job.title: BU SPOC - Techno Commercial
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • BU Partnership: Serve as the primary GCC interface for assigned Business Units; understand priorities, clarify requirements, manage expectations and maintain regular stakeholder engagement.
  • End-to-End Delivery: Coordinate service delivery across Procurement, Governance, GDGC and MDM; monitor demand, backlog, ageing, dependencies and closure against agreed SOW, SLA and TAT.
  • Governance & Escalation: Conduct periodic reviews with Business Units, SDLs, Tower Leads and Team Leads; maintain dashboards and action trackers; resolve bottlenecks and escalate critical risks promptly.
  • Procurement Coordination: Support sourcing, contracting, auctions, supplier onboarding, catalogue management, PO-related services and associated governance within the approved GCC scope.
  • Master Data & GDGC: Coordinate master data requests and governance across vendor, material, service, customer and finance domains; ensure required validation, approvals, data-quality controls and audit evidence.
  • Operational Excellence: Drive process compliance, audit readiness, root-cause resolution, standardization, automation and continuous improvement to enhance quality, productivity and customer experience.

Key Deliverables

| | | | --- | --- | | Service Delivery | At least 95% adherence to applicable SLA/TAT commitments | | Stakeholder Governance | Regular reviews with timely closure of agreed actions | | Escalation Control | Prompt resolution with zero critical avoidable escalations | | Data & Compliance | Improved data quality, process compliance and audit readiness | | Continuous Improvement | Measurable productivity, quality and automation improvements |

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering in any discipline; MBA / PGDM preferred.
  • 8-12 years of relevant experience in Procurement, Shared Services/GCC Operations, Governance, Master Data Management or Business Operations.
  • Experience in cross-functional stakeholder management and service delivery in an SLA-driven environment.
  • Working exposure to platforms such as SAP, SAP Ariba, SAP MDG, ServiceNow or equivalent systems is preferred.
