job.title: NSD Program Director
job.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Position Description

The Program Director is accountable for leading the front-end development lifecycle of new data center opportunities across APAC, progressing projects from initial site identification through land acquisition and execution readiness. Acting as the central coordinator across internal and external stakeholders, this role drives due diligence, investment decision-making, and governance processes to maximize site conversion and ensure development opportunities align with Vantage's strategic growth objectives.

The Program Director will oversee cross-functional due diligence programs spanning site evaluation, technical and infrastructure assessments, commercial analysis, and risk management. A key responsibility will be leading governance frameworks, stage-gate processes, and investment approval pathways to ensure opportunities meet defined criteria before advancing. The role will provide transparency across the APAC project pipeline, develop robust business cases, and lead the preparation and presentation of investment recommendations to the APAC Investment Council and other executive decision-making forums.

Success in this role requires strong collaboration across Leadership, Site Selection, Design & Engineering, Construction, Operations, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and other subject matter experts. Acting as a key integrator, the Program Director will align technical, commercial, operational, and strategic priorities, drive decision-making through effective governance, and ensure Vantage has the right capacity in the right markets at the right time to support customer demand and long-term growth across the APAC region.

Essential Job Functions

  • Lead the APAC Investment Council, driving strategic investment decisions, prioritization of development opportunities and portfolio growth initiatives across the region.
  • Lead and manage all aspects of technical and commercial due diligence and front-end planning for new development projects, including site assessments, feasibility studies, conceptual design, due diligence workstreams, power and fibre strategy development, entitlement, and permitting activities.
  • Provide strategic leadership, thought partnership, and executive-level guidance on key projects and initiatives, including budget management, schedule oversight, risk mitigation, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment between development, investment, operations, legal, finance, and commercial teams to ensure successful project execution and achievement of regional growth objectives.
  • Lead the definition and execution of due diligence programs for complex infrastructure development opportunities, ensuring key technical, commercial, regulatory, and delivery risks are identified, appropriately investigated, and assessed to support investment, acquisition, and development decision-making.

Duties

  • Lead the APAC Investment Council process, providing transparency across the regional development pipeline, developing robust business cases, and preparing and presenting investment recommendations to executive leadership and decision-making forums.
  • Serve as the primary owner of front-end development activities, driving opportunities from site identification through land acquisition by coordinating due diligence, risk management, stakeholder alignment, and investment approvals to improve conversion of site selection opportunities.
  • Lead all early-stage project development and due diligence activities, including site selection, feasibility assessments, conceptual design, utility strategy (power, water, and fiber), permitting pathways, commercial assessments, risk evaluations, and investment approval processes.
  • Interpret technical findings and provide development and commercial recommendations and risk mitigation strategies to support acquisitions.
  • Act as the central point of integration across internal and external stakeholders undertaking due diligence, ensuring alignment, accountability, and timely decision-making throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Provide executive oversight and portfolio governance across the APAC development pipeline, delivering regular updates to Executive Leadership on project progress, risks, schedules, budgets, quality, financial performance, cash flow, and critical decisions required to achieve business objectives.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration across Site Selection, Development, Operations, Finance, Legal, Commercial, Procurement, Design, Engineering and Construction, and Executive Leadership teams to define project requirements, resolve issues, manage risks, and support informed investment decisions.
  • Lead and manage relationships with external consultants, landowners, contractors, utilities, government authorities, regulatory agencies, and industry stakeholders to secure successful project outcomes and maintain development momentum.
  • Drive project outcomes from concept through execution readiness, establishing scope, schedule, budget, governance frameworks, consultant engagement strategies, and business case approvals while maintaining alignment with strategic objectives and investment criteria.
  • Oversee portfolio reporting and governance, ensuring leadership maintains full visibility of pipeline health, site conversion performance, project risks, costs, schedules, market dynamics, and capital deployment priorities.
  • Identify and mitigate development, permitting, commercial, infrastructure, and execution risks to support successful project advancement and informed investment decisions.
  • Lead contract governance, performance reporting, and financial management activities, ensuring robust controls, risk management, and informed decision-making across the portfolio.
  • Champion continuous improvement by incorporating lessons learned, market intelligence, industry trends, and best practices to enhance development processes, strengthen governance, and support Vantage's long-term growth strategy across APAC.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience

  • Proven experience managing complex development, infrastructure, construction, or real estate projects, ideally in a client-side environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities, work independently, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience across APAC markets, particularly Singapore, Malaysia, Japan, and Australia, is highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of site acquisition, due diligence, planning, permitting, and utility infrastructure (power and fibre).
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior leaders and external partners.
  • Degree in Engineering, Construction, Real Estate, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • Flexibility to travel regularly across APAC.
  • Adaptable, self-motivated, and comfortable working across multiple time zones, cultures, and remote environments.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage.

job.title: Senior Director, DC Operations Health & Safety
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading provider of sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure across Asia Pacific. Backed by Stonepeak, a global alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has over US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital from some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Since our founding in 2020, we have rapidly scaled across key Asia markets, operating 31 data centers with over 1.8GW of secured IT power. We operate as a regional platform delivering consistent global standards, combining scale with strong local execution across every market.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

About the role

  • *

Reporting to the Head of Health and Safety, the Senior Director, Operations Health and Safety provides strategic Health and Safety leadership and technical expertise across Digital Edge’s data center portfolio in APAC, working closely with Design & Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, and country leadership teams to establish Health and Safety standards, embed operational Health and Safety requirements during the design phase, and continuously strengthen operational Health and Safety through capability building, assurance and lessons learned.

This role will be based in Singapore, with regular travel across Digital Edge’s regional portfolio.

Key responsibilities

  • Act as the senior Health and Safety technical authority for the design and operational lifecycle, setting strategic direction and technical standards and assurance requirements for implementation by Regional, Country and Campus teams.
  • Establish Health and Safety requirements and review criteria for Design for Safety (DfS) reviews, providing expert Health and Safety input and constructive challenge to Design & Engineering, Construction, and Operations teams to ensure significant risks are identified, assessed, eliminated, or appropriately controlled through design.
  • Develop and maintain Health and Safety standards, requirements, and assurance frameworks for operational readiness and live data center operations.
  • Provide technical Health and Safety leadership and assurance requirements for critical infrastructure and high-risk operational activities, including electrical, mechanical, fire and life safety, high-voltage systems, energy isolation, switching, and other mission-critical hazards.
  • Define and maintain assurance requirements for PTW systems and high-risk activities, and establish and monitor leading Health and Safety indicators across the portfolio, using platform-level dashboards and performance data to identify gaps, trends, and systemic risks and translate these into improvements to standards, assurance priorities, and capability programs.
  • Develop and oversee Health and Safety competency and training programs for Operations personnel, including digital learning and practical onsite training, and define competency requirements for employees and contractors performing safety-critical and high-risk activities.
  • Define and maintain requirements for critical electrical safety controls across the portfolio, including requirements for the review and application of arc flash studies and associated operational controls at site level.
  • Partner with Operations and Facilities Management teams to strengthen Health and Safety standards, safe systems of work, and accountability frameworks across live facilities, particularly for high-risk maintenance and operational activities.
  • Define Health and Safety standards and assurance requirements for internal fit-out works, supporting consistent implementation by Country and Campus teams while maintaining operational continuity.
  • Review operational Health and Safety incidents, including high-potential events, to identify systemic learnings and ensure lessons are incorporated into future designs, Health and Safety standards, training programs, procedures, and operating practices across the portfolio.
  • Drive cross-country learning and continuous improvement, ensuring significant Health and Safety learnings, effective controls and good practices are systematically shared and incorporated into standards, training and operational practices across Regional, Country and Campus teams.
  • Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health and safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate:

  • 15+ years of progressive Health and Safety experience, including significant leadership experience across the design, commissioning, and/or operations of data centers or other mission-critical facilities.
  • Proven experience in Design for Safety, operational safety assurance, and risk management within large-scale, complex, mission-critical or high-risk environments, including data centers, pharmaceutical, chemical, or process industries.
  • Strong technical understanding of critical data center systems and associated safety risks, including electrical, mechanical, fire and life safety, high-voltage systems, energy isolation, switching, and commissioning activities.
  • Strong understanding of operational Permit-to-Work systems, high-risk work controls, electrical safety, and management of change in live operational environments.
  • Experience developing and implementing technical Health and Safety standards, assurance frameworks, leading indicators, competency frameworks, training programs, and portfolio-level programs.
  • Proven ability to influence senior Design & Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, and Operations stakeholders and embed Health and Safety into technical and operational decision-making.
  • Strong knowledge of international Health and Safety standards, risk management principles, and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide Health and Safety leadership across design environments, commissioning sites, and live operational data centers, with regular travel across the region.
  • Fluent in English, with the ability to work effectively across diverse cultures and regional teams.

job.title: Well-being & Engagement Intern (Jan 2027 intake) - #GeneralInternship
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Join Singtel Group’s Rewards & Well-being team (part of Group People & Sustainability) and help shape how employees stay healthy, supported, and engaged at work. You’ll work on real well-being programs, benefits, communications, and events that make a genuine difference to people’s lives.

What You’ll Learn & Do

  • Explore how employee well-being works at scale—from mental and physical health to inclusion, growth, financial well-being, and purpose.
  • Review and suggest improvements to well-being and benefits programs using data, employee feedback, and research.
  • Create engaging content (emails, intranet posts, newsletters) that gets people excited about well-being initiatives.
  • Support and run events not limited to Wellness Roadshows, World Mental Health Day activations and etc.
  • Track participation and engagement metrics to see what works—and how to do it better.
  • Collaborate with teams across the business and build strong communication and presentation skills.

What You’ll Be Working On

  • Reviewing well-being programs, benefits, and policies to spot gaps and opportunities.
  • Analysing survey feedback and turning insights into clear recommendations.
  • Researching best practices and trends in employee well-being and engagement.
  • Supporting internal communications and improving well-being content on the intranet.
  • Helping with event planning, logistics, and award submissions.

What We’re Looking For

  • Currently pursuing a Degree or Diploma (Communications, HR, Psychology, Business, or related fields).
  • Strong communicator who enjoys creating content for different audiences.
  • Curious, proactive, and comfortable juggling multiple projects.
  • A team player who’s open to feedback and keen to learn.
  • Interested in people, culture, and making workplaces healthier and more inclusive.

job.title: Registration of Interest for #AIDA Talent Acceleration Day (Sept 2026) -Senior AI Knowledge Engineer
job.description:
Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

Build AI. Unlock BIG Possibilities with Singtel.

Singtel’s Artificial Intelligence & Data Analytics team, AIDA, is growing its team of AI, data and cybersecurity and technology professionals.

We are inviting experienced AI Knowledge Engineer to register their interest in current and upcoming opportunities.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Responsible for building, integrating, and operating AI knowledge system components, including knowledge graphs, structured knowledge formats, memory stores, vector databases, and retrieval pipelines that support GenAI and agentic AI use cases.
  • Develop and maintain data preparation, indexing, embedding, and retrieval workflows using tools such as Databricks, Python, SQL, vector databases, and graph databases, applying sound engineering practices for reliability and maintainability.
  • Contribute to the delivery of reliable, secure, and reusable knowledge assets for enterprise search, retrieval-augmented generation, agent memory, and AI assistant use cases.
  • Implement and enhance knowledge base, retrieval-augmented generation, and memory-store solution components under approved architecture patterns to support scalable Generative AI, Machine Learning, Analytics and Agentic AI use cases.
  • Implementing real-time context stores that give Agents a way to commit into and access shared customer contexts
  • Build and maintain knowledge ingestion, transformation, entity extraction, embedding, indexing, and retrieval workflows using platforms such as Databricks, Python, SQL, graph databases, and vector databases, ensuring reliability, traceability, and maintainability.
  • Perform data transformation, cleansing, entity normalization, relationship extraction, metadata enrichment, and schema mapping using Python, PySpark, SQL, or graph query languages based on business and technical requirements.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data workflows to ensure data quality and pipeline reliability
  • Support code quality, deployment readiness, documentation, and production support activities for knowledge-system components, working with senior engineers, architects, and delivery partners where required.
  • Contribute to integration of structured and unstructured content from files, APIs, databases, enterprise systems, and streaming sources, working with source-system owners and consuming teams to implement approved ingestion and knowledge-modelling patterns.
  • Help maintain metadata and pipeline documentation for transparency and traceability
  • Own production readiness for assigned data and AI platform components, including observability, incident triage, root-cause analysis, release coordination, and continuous improvement of operational runbooks.
  • Participate in integrating pipelines with tools such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Delta Lake, and other platform components
  • Build and maintain knowledge graph components, including entity models, relationship mappings, ontology-aligned schemas, graph loading jobs, and graph query interfaces to support AI retrieval and reasoning use cases.
  • Implement and operate knowledge storage and retrieval components, including document stores, vector databases, embedding pipelines, semantic indexing, memory stores, lifecycle management, and access-controlled retrieval.
  • Contribute to work process automation efforts using version control and CI/CD workflows, and
  • Implement structured knowledge representations and interchange formats, including JSON-LD, RDF-style triples, ontology-aligned schemas, and Google Open Knowledge Format where applicable, to support reusable and machine-readable enterprise knowledge assets.
  • Apply data governance, security, access control, privacy, and operational risk policies during implementation, ensuring knowledge-system components handle enterprise content safely and meet approved compliance requirements.

job.title: Registration of Interest for #AIDA Talent Acceleration Day (Sept 2026) -Senior AI Harness Engineer
job.description:
Role Summary

At Singtel, we are building AI capabilities across customer experience, network and service operations, enterprise solutions and internal productivity.

As a Lead AI Harness Engineer, you will define and build the engineering foundations around AI models and agents that enable them to operate reliably, safely and at enterprise scale.

You will lead the design of reusable orchestration, context, memory, tool integration, evaluation, simulation, guardrail and instrumentation capabilities that allow AI systems to interact securely with Singtel's data, knowledge, APIs and operational systems.

This is a senior individual-contributor role combining deep hands-on engineering with technical leadership. You will solve complex cross-cutting engineering problems, establish reusable patterns and standards, and shape how production AI systems are engineered across Singtel.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Define the architecture and technical direction for reusable AI harness capabilities across Singtel.
  • Design and build common frameworks for agent orchestration, context engineering, memory, tool integration, evaluation, simulation, instrumentation and runtime controls.
  • Establish engineering patterns for connecting AI agents securely to enterprise data, APIs, MCP servers, workflows and operational systems.
  • Define evaluation strategies and quality gates covering task success, grounding, tool execution, safety, reliability, latency and cost.
  • Design scalable evaluation and experimentation infrastructure supporting automated regression testing, simulation, replay and production feedback loops.
  • Establish instrumentation and observability patterns that enable teams to understand and diagnose AI and agent behaviour end to end.
  • Design mechanisms to capture production failures, user feedback and operational outcomes and convert them into continuously improving evaluation datasets and tests.
  • Define patterns for agent identity, permissions, policy enforcement, human oversight, graceful degradation and fail-safe behaviour.
  • Build reusable SDKs, libraries, services and reference implementations that enable engineering teams to develop production AI systems faster and more consistently.
  • Make architectural trade-offs across model capability, reliability, latency, security, sovereignty, scalability and cost.
  • Lead complex technical investigations and resolve systemic engineering and reliability issues across AI applications.
  • Partner with AI Engineering, Central AI Platform, AI & Agent Operations, Data, Cybersecurity and business engineering teams to establish production engineering standards.
  • Provide technical leadership through architecture and design reviews, code reviews, mentoring and hands-on engineering.
  • Evaluate emerging AI infrastructure, agent frameworks and engineering approaches and determine where Singtel should build, adopt or standardise.

Skills for Success

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Typically 8+ years of software, platform, distributed systems, AI or ML engineering experience, with significant experience designing and operating production-grade systems.
  • Deep software engineering expertise in Python, with strong foundations in APIs, distributed systems, concurrency, testing and system design.
  • Hands-on experience architecting and building production LLM, RAG or agentic systems.
  • Strong understanding of agent architectures, context engineering, retrieval, memory, tool/function calling and orchestration.
  • Strong experience in evaluation, observability, testing or reliability engineering for complex production systems.
  • Strong understanding of integration architectures including REST APIs, event-driven systems and modern agent/tool protocols such as MCP.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise security including identity, authentication, authorisation, secrets management and least-privilege access.
  • Experience designing reusable platforms, frameworks, SDKs or developer infrastructure adopted by multiple engineering teams.
  • Strong cloud-native and distributed-systems engineering experience.
  • Experience with agent or LLM frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or equivalent is advantageous, but deep engineering fundamentals are more important than familiarity with a particular framework.
  • Ability to operate as a senior technical authority, influence engineering decisions across teams and translate rapidly evolving AI capabilities into robust production engineering practices.

job.title: Solution Architect
job.description:
Macquarie Park, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Every day, millions of Australians connect, work, stream, and stay in touch on the Optus network. When it works seamlessly, it’s easy to take for granted. But behind it is a team making thousands of decisions every day - decisions that keep people, businesses and communities connected.

Right now, Optus is focused on getting the fundamentals right - simplifying how we work, lifting standards, and building a more reliable, resilient experience for our customers.

It’s not about surface-level change. It’s about how we make decisions, how we work together, and how we deliver.

As a Solutions Architect, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams across the organization, including engineering, operations, security, and business stakeholders, to develop and implement high-level and low-level designs that align with our strategic objectives. You will also play a crucial role in driving technology innovation, lifecycle management, and governance to ensure our network infrastructure remains resilient, scalable, and future proof.

This role requires a blend of technical expertise in muti-technologies areas, leadership, and strategic thinking to design, implement, and manage robust network solutions that support an organization's objectives. The role will report to the Director – IP Core and Access Engineering/Networks.

**

What You’ll Do

  • Own the architecture, roadmap, performance, and lifecycle management of Common Packet Core, IP Access, and Management Networks, ensuring alignment with business and technology objectives.
  • Define strategic direction for network growth, resiliency, modernization, and decommissioning, while driving architectural evolution and platform optimisation.
  • Lead the adoption of emerging IP technologies, automation, and engineering best practices to improve network reliability, operational efficiency, and customer experience.
  • Provide end-to-end technical leadership across network design, governance, product integration, vendor management, major upgrades, cutovers, and Tier 3 operational support.

What You Bring

  • Degree-qualified Telecommunications/Network Engineer with 10+ years’ experience designing, implementing, and evolving large-scale, resilient carrier-grade fixed, mobile, and data networks.
  • Deep technical expertise across IP networking, routing and switching, MPLS/SRv6, EVPN/VXLAN, cloud and data centre networking, network automation, QoS, timing and synchronisation, and network security.
  • Strong network architecture and strategy leader with proven success translating business requirements into scalable, cost-effective solutions, driving technology roadmaps, new product introductions, PoCs, and network transformation initiatives.
  • Accomplished technical leader and problem-solver with extensive experience in cross-functional stakeholder engagement, vendor management, regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and delivery of complex telecommunications services across consumer, enterprise, wholesale, and mobile domains.

By empowering one another, backing bold ideas and helping you own your impact, we’ve designed a workplace that gives you the freedom to grow, the support to thrive, and the chance to be part of something bigger – a team that’s shaping a more connected, inclusive and inspired Australia.

**

The good stuff:

  • Competitive remuneration, plus $80 monthly credit, 25% off Optus products and exclusive shopping discounts with our retail partners — making everyday life a little more affordable. Genuine Flexibility - work three days in the office, two days from wherever works best for you.
  • An office campus that has it all - cafes chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre. It’s designed for real life.
  • Great leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever matters most to you.
  • Inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks, because family comes first.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Your wellbeing matters, so we offer with free counselling and support services, available 24/7 in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • A free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon. Or, heaps of onsite parking. Plus, end of trip facilities with lockers, showers, irons and hair dryers**

Not every box ticked? Apply anyway. We believe the right mindset matter more than a perfect CV. We’ll back you to grow from there.

This is an end-to-end ownership role: shape the bet, align stakeholders, mobilize cross-functional task forces, execute with rigor, and drive measurable impact across Meta's family of apps.

This is a hands-on strategic role, not a communications-only function or a program management office. You will own a portfolio of bets, lead through influence, and build durable operating leverage through AI-fluent ways of working.

You'll be part of the APAC Marketing leadership team as an individual contributor, working across markets and functions to help APAC show up as a global driver, not just a participant.

Responsibilities

  • Own critical bets: Identify and ship multi-quarter opportunities across apps and audiences, turn ambiguity into a plan (strategy, milestones, resourcing), and drive measurable outcomes with clear incrementality and testable hypotheses
  • Lead through influence: Mobilize cross-functional partners, drive decision clarity on priorities, tradeoffs, and execution — keeping bets aligned and moving without direct authority
  • Build AI-fluent operating advantage: Design and implement AI-driven workflows that improve speed and quality across synthesis, briefs, experimentation, creative iteration, and reporting — and establish repeatable mechanisms that scale beyond individual output and increase team velocity
  • Influence roadmaps as a marketing unlock: Surface product needs and leverage points from APAC execution, run a closed-loop with partners (signal → asks → plans → shipped outcomes), and turn APAC signals into scalable plays that travel across markets without losing local nuance
  • Raise the bar on execution and measurement: Set the standard for full-stack delivery; partner with Insights and Analytics to define success metrics, run tests, and translate learnings into next-bet decisions

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record of APAC market knowledge and ability to translate local nuance into scalable strategies
  • Demonstrated use of AI-driven workflows that materially improved speed or quality — not just tool familiarity
  • Demonstrated analytical and operational rigour: hypotheses, success metrics, instrumentation, and learning loops
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience operating at a portfolio or multi-market level
  • 12+ years of experience delivering cross-functional marketing initiatives from strategy through execution and measurement
  • Proven communication skills with the ability to produce executive-ready narratives and decision documents
  • Proven ability to lead complex, ambiguous work through influence across senior stakeholders — not just coordination or program management
  • Evidence of building repeatable operating systems that scale impact beyond individual output

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

job.title: Technician - Field Service
job.description:
We are looking for a talented Diesel Technician to join our high performing team in Darwin, NT. In this role you will diagnose and complete repairs to engines at the customer’s site.

You will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Engage customers in a courteous and professional manner. Anticipates and ensures prompt and efficient attention to customer needs.
  • Apply the use of specialized tools and follows documented procedures and policies to diagnose and complete repairs, including identifying and preparing required parts and tools.
  • Perform preventative maintenance activities as per documented schedules and standards on engine and related components in the field.
  • Escalate unresolved issues to more experienced Field Service Technicians and/or Supervisor.
  • Complete required documentation, such as service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens.
  • Identify additional service opportunities with customer.
  • Complete training in line with skill and business requirements.
  • Maintain service vehicle and tools for cleanliness and proper operation.
  • Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to site management and to their supervisor.
  • Complete in workshop repairs as required

Additional Information:

  • Full Time / 38 hours per week
  • On Call Roster 1 week per month
  • Overtime as required – Penalty rates paid for all work above 38 hours
  • All your Safety equipment / PPE and uniforms are provided and laundered
  • Domestic Relocation from across Australia _may_ be offered for the right candidate
  • _Local Valid Drivers License is required_
  • _Remote Area Travel Required_

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Apprentice Trained Engine Technician (Cert III) or equivalent
  • Basic level of workshop or field service experience required
  • Intermediate level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products
  • Heavy Vehicle or Mobile Plant Experience preferred
  • HR License preferred
  • _Cummins experience preferred but not essential_
  • _Remote Work Experience highly preferred_
  • _Power Generation (Mechanical) experience preferred but not essential_

Critical Competencies:

  • Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.
  • Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.
  • Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.
  • Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.
  • Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.
  • Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.
  • Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.
  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

job.title: Supply Planning Coordinator - Level II
job.description:
Job Summary

The Materials Planner is responsible for planning, scheduling, and controlling indirect materials and packaging materials to support uninterrupted production operations. This role ensures material availability aligned with production requirements, optimizes inventory levels, coordinates with suppliers and cross-functional teams, and drives supply chain stability while maintaining compliance with quality, safety, and operational standards.

Key Responsibilities Material Planning & Procurement

  • Plan and manage procurement of indirect materials and finished goods packaging materials to support production schedules.
  • Process, monitor, and expedite purchase orders to ensure timely material availability.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external suppliers to meet supply requirements.
  • Monitor procurement signals and adjust planning parameters as required to support business needs.
  • Build and maintain safety stock levels for critical runner parts and long lead-time components.
  • Support Annual Operating Plan (AOP) activities and supply planning initiatives.

Inventory Management & Warehousing

  • Manage indirect inventory planning, control, and optimization activities.
  • Ensure availability of materials in FPC zones as per production requirements.
  • Oversee warehousing, storage, issuance, and replenishment of indirect materials.
  • Manage chemical storage in accordance with applicable safety and regulatory requirements.
  • Drive inventory accuracy and support inventory reduction initiatives without impacting production.

Supply Chain Coordination

  • Conduct and participate in weekly cross-functional meetings to review inventory status, supply risks, and action plans.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to improve lead times, delivery performance, and inventory management.
  • Support supplier improvement initiatives and maintain effective supplier relationships.
  • Coordinate part change management activities while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.

Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Follow all Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) policies, procedures, and regulations.
  • Maintain accurate planning parameters and master data to support Plan for Every Part (PFEP) requirements.
  • Support timely disposition of non-conforming materials in collaboration with Quality teams.
  • Participate in continuous improvement projects related to quality, safety, inventory, and material flow.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor supply chain KPIs and inventory performance metrics.
  • Analyze material shortages, excess inventory, and supply risks and drive corrective actions.
  • Prepare reports and provide timely updates regarding inventory availability and recovery plans.
  • Identify opportunities to improve planning processes, inventory optimization, and supply chain efficiency.

Qualifications

  • Diploma, Bachelor's Degree, or equivalent qualification in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Logistics, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • Additional certifications in Supply Chain Management, Materials Planning, Inventory Management, or Logistics will be an advantage.

Skills

  • Strong understanding of materials planning, procurement, and inventory management principles.
  • Knowledge of indirect procurement planning and packaging material management.
  • Experience with PFEP (Plan for Every Part) methodologies and inventory optimization techniques.
  • Proficiency in ERP and materials planning systems.
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and data analysis capabilities.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work in a cross-functional and fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Experience

  • Relevant experience in materials planning, procurement, inventory management, supply chain operations, or logistics within a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience coordinating with suppliers and managing procurement schedules.
  • Exposure to inventory optimization, warehouse operations, and material flow management.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and supply chain performance metrics.
  • Knowledge of packaging material planning and indirect material management is preferred.
  • Flexibility to support evolving business and operational requirements.

Job Supply Chain Planning

job.title: Quality Technician - Level III
job.description:
Job Summary

Ensures products received or produced meet technical specifications trains others and assists in process development. Works under minimal supervision. Supports customer issues resolution at customer end

Key Responsibilities

Support at customer end , SPOC for customer to identify and resolve issues . Provide 8D and issues resolution to customer for any issues , Verifies the final quality of products on the production line at customer end

Compares the physical characteristics of components, materials, equipment and products to technical specifications to identify defects.

Separates products that do not have the desired technical specification, using basic and/or complex measurement techniques and equipment.

Documents products that do not meet technical specifications using specified systems.

Trains others in the use of measurement equipment, segregation of non-conforming product and documentation.

Follows the norms and standards of quality defined by the Company.

Reports progress on problem resolution to management.

Assists in the development of new methods and procedures.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

Diploma in Engineering preferred.High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Competencies:

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

Measurement Science - Analyzes measurement processes throughout the relevant traceability chain to identify and quantify sources of measurement uncertainty relevant to the appropriate applied measurement science, “Metrology” e.g. Chemical, Dimensional, Electrical, Mechanical, Optical and Radiation and Physical.

Quality Process Management - Proficient application of quality tools and methods (e.g. APQP, FMEA, PPAP, SPC, Capability studies, Process Audit, inspection, test, etc.) to ensure quality of products, processes and services.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Laboratory Management - Leads technical resources while managing the business aspects of a laboratory using measure to control both the technical and business aspects of the organization and assuring the requirements of the appropriate certifications and/or accreditations are met.

Examples:

  • Coordinates with DCPD Construction Managers to prioritize H&S in planning and execution in all phases of DCPD projects.
  • Ensures & Monitors General Contractors and AWS deployment vendors compliance to onboarding requirements in Avetta.

  • Conduct regular site visits with construction managers

job.title: Senior Partner Account Manager, Singapore Public Sector , ASEAN Partner and Specialist Organisation
job.description:
Would you like to own building the future of AWS's public sector partner business in Singapore? Are you energized by the opportunity to drive cloud adoption across Government, Healthcare, and Education through strategic partner relationships? Do you thrive at the intersection of sales execution, partner development, and public sector impact?

AWS Partner Account Managers (PAMs) work with select large Systems Integrator (SI) partners to develop go-to-market strategies that expand cloud adoption across Public Sector organizations. As a Public Sector PAM based in Singapore, you will lead the joint sales motion between AWS and your assigned SI partner(s) - creating and executing campaigns that align to AWS Worldwide Public Sector (WWPS) strategic initiatives and your partner's market positioning in Singapore's Government, Healthcare, and Education sectors.

You will work closely with AWS Account Executives, Solution Architects, Public Sector Industry Leaders, and Partner Marketing to develop new routes to market - building pipeline through joint offerings, solutions, and strategic initiatives tailored to Singapore's public sector landscape. The ideal candidate possesses a direct sales and partnership/alliance background that enables them to engage, earn trust, and influence at the CxO level with both partner executives and public sector decision-makers. Successful PAMs think strategically about business, policy, and technical challenges to convey compelling partner value propositions that address public sector outcomes.

Key job responsibilities Drive public sector revenue (Government, Healthcare, Education) through partner-attached opportunities with assigned SI partner(s) Build senior relationships with SI partner executives and AWS leaders to drive joint business value for public sector customers Create and execute Joint Partner Sales Plans targeting government initiatives (Smart Nation, GovTech modernization, healthcare digitization), aligned to AWS strategic direction Work cross-functionally with AWS Account Executives, Solution Architects, Public Sector SMEs, and Partner Marketing to develop new revenue opportunities Develop regular stakeholder interlocks between partner sales teams, AWS public sector account teams, and government stakeholders Cultivate long-term partner relationships and execute joint pursuits with AWS, partner, and end-customer interests at the forefront Communicate partner initiatives, joint wins, and successes across AWS field teams Prepare and lead regular business reviews for AWS senior management

A day in the life The PAM is an individual contributor role responsible for leading the public sector partner business with partner. You will define CxO relationship strategy - engaging AWS senior leaders for executive sponsorship, coordinating executive business reviews, and developing sales opportunities around partner offerings and solutions for public sector customers. You will build and maintain key relationships across government agencies and institutional buyers, advance strategic sales opportunities, and work with a regional team of Partner Managers to manage pipeline and deliver results. This role requires navigating Singapore's public sector procurement landscape, understanding government technology priorities, and translating them into joint partner-AWS solutions.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 8+ years of business development, partner development, sales or alliances management experience
  • Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
  • Experience working with public sector customers (Government, Healthcare, or Education) or Systems Integrators serving public sector

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience identifying, negotiating, and executing complex legal agreements
  • Experience in business development including complex agreements with integrators and ISVs
  • Experience working with Singapore Government agencies, GovTech, statutory boards, or public healthcare/education institutions
  • Understanding of Singapore public sector procurement processes, government cloud policies, and Smart Nation initiatives

Ready to Make a Difference? Join Our Iconic Team at Telstra!

At Telstra, we’re more than just a leading telecommunications company—we’re where passion meets purpose. As a Retail Customer Service & Sales Consultant, you’ll have the opportunity to work for an iconic Aussie brand that’s been connecting Australians for generations. Is it You We’re Looking For?

job.title: Sales Manager - Low Voltage Systems
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

LVS Sales and Marketing Manager – South East Asia__

As a Sales Manager for ABB's Low Voltage Switchgear business in Singapore, you will be responsible for driving sales growth, market penetration, and customer engagement across ABB's Low Voltage Systems and Solutions portfolio. You will develop and execute sales strategies, build strong customer relationships, identify new business opportunities, and achieve sustainable growth in orders, revenue, profitability, and market share while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute sales strategies and business plans to achieve order growth, revenue, profitability, market share, and customer satisfaction targets for ABB's Low Voltage Systems and Solutions business.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with customers, consultants, EPCs, and contractors key stakeholders by understanding their needs and providing technical and commercial solutions aligned with ABB's value proposition.
  • Identify, develop, and drive new business opportunities through market analysis, customer engagement, competitive positioning, and promotion of ABB's Low Voltage Switchgear portfolio.
  • Prepare and manage quotations, proposals, contracts, and commercial negotiations, ensuring technical and financial accuracy while supporting project execution, cash collection, and sales administration activities.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to execute marketing initiatives, product launches, and customer engagement activities that strengthen ABB's market presence and brand positioning.
  • Monitor sales performance, pipeline development, and project opportunities, implementing recovery plans and corrective actions where necessary to achieve business objectives.
  • Maintain the highest standards of safety, integrity, compliance, and ethical business conduct in accordance with ABB's policies and values.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or any related engineering field.
  • Minimum 7 years of sales, business development, or account management experience within the electrical industry, with a strong focus on Low Voltage Systems, Switchgear, Power Distribution, Motor Control, or related Electrification solutions.
  • Proven track record of achieving sales targets and developing business opportunities within the Singapore market, particularly with consultants, contractors, EPCs, and end users.
  • Strong technical and commercial knowledge of Low Voltage Switchgear, Power Distribution Systems, Motor Control Centers (MCC), Protection Solutions, and related ABB or competitor product offerings.
  • Experience in preparing commercial proposals, contract negotiation, strategic account management, and managing complex sales opportunities from identification through order closure.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build long-term customer relationships and influence decision-makers at multiple levels.
  • Demonstrated commitment to safety, integrity, compliance, and ethical business practices, with the ability to work collaboratively across local and regional teams.

More about us

Electrification provides leading electrical distribution and management technologies, solutions and services to electrify the world in a safe, smart and sustainable way. The portfolio includes medium- and low-voltage electrical components, switchgear, digital devices, enclosures, and circuit breakers, among others. With our products, solutions and services, we collaborate with customers to improve power delivery and security, enhance energy management, efficiency and operational reliability, as we seek to achieve a low carbon society. go.abb/electrification

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit [https://www.abb.com](https://www.abb.com) to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Business Mobile App, Payments
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

As the engineer of Google Pay for Business, our mission is to empower Small and Medium Businesses (SMBs) by enriching their digital presence and driving growth through intuitive tools.

We are a team of builders who value collaborative innovation; using AI in our daily work both for development and to ensure complex technology feels simple and empowering for every merchant.

Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and improve mobile software, from user-facing applications to server-side Application Programming Interfaces (APIs).
  • Collaborate effectively with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to define and implement user-facing features in a changing environment across all phases of the software development lifecycle.
  • Write high-quality, well-tested, and maintainable code in Flutter.
  • Advocate product excellence and ensure features are universal, considering accessibility and internationalization.
  • Leverage AI tools to enhance and accelerate development workflows.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Data Center Technician | Microsoft Careers
job.description:
Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will stage, set up and perform hardware deployments. In addition, you will also perform troubleshooting and diagnostics on equipment, as well as perform hardware decommissions for simple changes and refreshes following Standard Operating Procedures. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your understanding of Data Center standard processes and procedures, develop mentoring skills while providing guidance to peers, familiarizing yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

  • Performs diagnostics and troubleshooting following standard procedures, quickly identifies the cause(s) of issues, and replaces faulty components with minimal customer and business disruption.
  • Performs post-execution quality checks and verifies that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up properly according to safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs).
  • Decommissions hardware for simple changes and refreshes (e.g., memory upgrades, rebuilds) following standard procedures with minimal guidance.
  • Follows procedures to communicate, report, and escalate incidents to appropriate Microsoft data center operations management units, Technician Leads, and engineering specialists.
  • Assists and provides guidance to other technicians to complete challenging or complex tasks.
  • Completes required training aligned to the role and workload; observes more experienced technicians to gain hands-on experience and relevant on-the-job training.
  • Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work.
  • Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and resulting user experience; displays accountability and ownership of the data center facilities.
  • Embodies our[culture](https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/culture)and[values](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/about/corporate-values).

Qualifications

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components AND some experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
  • A valid drivers licence for the country posting is required due to the remote location and future on call duties.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

While not required, we also look for the following_Preferred Qualifications:_

  • Solid experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
  • Applicable certifications: CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC).

Data Center Technicians ATR-B - The typical base pay range for this role across Greece is € 22,500.00 - € 29,800.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.

Find additional benefits and pay information here:

Data Center Technicians ATR-C - The typical base pay range for this role across Greece is € 26,000.00 - € 37,100.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.

Find additional benefits and pay information here:

You will also follow safety policies and procedures and participate in root cause analysis (RCA) of incidents. This job will allow you to build a solid understanding of data center procedures, engage in collaboration across various teams as well as provide mentorship across data centers by sharing outstanding practices.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services.   • Perform troubleshooting for service incidents and escalates, as appropriate, to meet SLA/OLAs, with minimal disruption to the client/customer and business.

  • Manage relationships with clients and suppliers to ensure that all expectations are clarified, understood, documented, and met.
  • Suggest ways for reducing the risk of performing maintenance; work with others to accommodate scheduling needs.

  • Applicable certifications: ASICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA, Microsoft, Network Certifications, PMP, ITIL, CDCP.

job.title: Territory Manager - Sales
job.description:
Job Description

As a Territory Manager, you will play a crucial role in expanding our market presence and achieving sales targets. You will be responsible for developing and executing sales strategies, building strong relationships with clients, and providing excellent customer service. Your expertise in the electrical trade and knowledge of our primary and secondary drive products will be key to your success in this role.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement sales plans to achieve revenue goals in the assigned territory.
  • Identify and target potential customers, including electrical contractors, distributors, and end-users.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders.
  • Provide product demonstrations, technical support, and training to customers.

  • Valid driving license and willingness to travel within the assigned territory.
  • Familiarity with the local market and industry trends is an advantage.
  • A self-motivated and proactive attitude, with a passion for sales and customer satisfaction.

job.title: Architect - Information Security
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Define and maintain security architecture standards, ensuring alignment with business strategy, risk appetite, and industry standards (NIST CSF, CIS 18, Zero Trust principles).
  • Develop threat models for AI/ML systems, establish guardrails for GenAI usage (including LLM-integrated applications and AI-assisted development), and evaluate AI security tooling.
  • Design and govern security controls for cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP), including identity architecture, network segmentation, data protection, and workload security posture.
  • Provide authoritative security architecture review for new products, platforms, infrastructure, and third-party integrations, delivering actionable findings and remediation guidance.
  • Develop and maintain security reference architectures, patterns, and guardrails for use by engineering and development teams; socialize and evangelize standards across technology organizations.
  • Partner with other security analysts and engineers to ensure architectures are informed by threat actor TTPs and emerging attack vectors.
  • Collaborate with the Security Enablement team to translate architectural decisions into control evidence, supporting audits, client assessments, and regulatory requirements.
  • Evaluate and recommend security tooling and vendors; contribute to build-vs-buy decisions and support RFP/RFI processes as a technical subject matter expert.
  • Mentor security engineers and cross-functional technology peers; elevate the security maturity of the broader engineering organization through enablement and consultation.

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

About the Position

The key role of the Product Support Operations Representative (PSOR) allows you to learn and assist others while building industry knowledge. This is a parts and service operations-focused assignment working directly with Cat dealers in achieving service support and distribution capabilities that positively contributes to the sale of new and used Caterpillar products. This position will be based in Perth.

**

Key Responsibilities will include:

  • Lead and deliver on initiatives to elevate differentiated dealer capabilities, capacity and profitability.
  • Support the implementation of key initiatives such as Services Commitment.
  • Identify and deliver targeted Service Operations improvements.
  • Liaise with dealers, customers, and other Caterpillar personnel to analyse, identify and develop solutions to solve our customers’ toughest challenges.
  • Assist dealers in business planning including recommending changes to facilities, tooling, systems to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Counsel dealers in developing increased human performance capability (i.e. assess, identify and implement performance gap solutions).
  • Support initiatives to enhance dealer effectiveness, safety capabilities, overall business growth, process improvement, and warranty policy.
  • Support rollout of new products, services and solutions (e.g., products, parts, customer service agreements, other service solutions)
  • Stay abreast of industry, technology and digital advancements and incorporate within Caterpillar and dealers to meet customer needs.

As a dealer facing representative, you will collaborate with dealers to build capability, drive process improvement, and execute Product Support Operations related strategies. You will build strong business relationships with the Cat dealers in your portfolio, connect data to identify opportunities and develop solutions to solve our customers’ toughest challenges.

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • Customer Focus
  • Problem Solving and Project Management
  • Service Excellence
  • Consulting and Change Management
  • Decision Making and Critical Thinking
  • Analytical skills to interpret and understand data to drive actions
  • Effective communications and negotiation skills
  • Prior experience in field assignments, engineering / product support-related roles, or dealer facing positions is beneficial
  • Must be willing to travel up to 30%

Career & Development:

Your career and development are important to us. On top of your field assignment, there are additional learning and development programs to help you develop a strong technical foundation, business and commercial acumen, key skills and capabilities for you to be successful in your career with Caterpillar.

If you can meet the above requirements and are looking for an exciting and rewarding career, please apply today. Whilst applicants will be considered from across Australia, the role will be based in Perth. Company support maybe provided for relocation.

Additional Information:

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in future require sponsorship for employment-based non-immigrant and immigrant visas. However, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of Australia which can be found through our employment website http://www.caterpillar.com/careers.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Relocation is available for this position.

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

job.title: Technical Project Manager (Back End)
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Technical Project Manager with strong experience in agile delivery and backend engineering environments to lead the development and operational rollout of StarHub’s core digital platforms.

You will work cross-functionally with Domain Owners (DOs), Engineering Managers (EMs), DevOps teams, QA, Solution Designers (SDs), and Release Program Managers (RPMs) to drive predictable, high-quality delivery of back-end services that support consumer and enterprise customer journeys.

Your ability to manage modern cloud-native development cycles — across CI/CD pipelines, containerized microservices, and API ecosystems — will be critical to enabling secure, scalable, and resilient platforms that power StarHub’s digital evolution.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery & Agile Management

  • Drive agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) and maintain team rhythm and cadence.
  • Manage backlog hygiene, ensuring stories are well-defined, estimated, and prioritized.
  • Plan and execute phased delivery strategies, ensuring release readiness through Blue/Green deployments, canary releases, and feature flagging.
  • Track delivery health through velocity, throughput, and scope stability metrics.
  • Identify and resolve blockers, risks, and cross-domain dependencies early.
  • Maintain clear delivery dashboards and status reporting to senior stakeholders.

Technical Coordination & Planning

  • Partner with Domain Owners and Tech Leads to align on architecture, delivery scope, and capacity planning.
  • Coordinate with DevOps and QA/QE teams to ensure readiness for integration, testing, and release.
  • Support implementation of continuous delivery and observability practices across teams.
  • Define, Monitor and report on key delivery KPIs, including deployment frequency, Mean Time To Recovery, defect Leakage rate, change failure rate ensuring all releases meet defined Service Level Objectives and performance baselines.

Design and maintain a data lake using Apache Hudi to support: Upserts and deletes Incremental queries Time-travel and auditability

Mandatory / Primary Skills Apache Pulsar (topics, partitions, subscriptions, geo-replication) Apache Flink (stateful stream processing, windows, checkpoints) Apache Hudi (Merge-On-Read, Copy-On-Write, incremental processing) ClickHouse (real-time analytics, high-cardinality datasets) Event-driven and streaming data architectures Event sourcing and state-transition modeling Idempotent, replay-safe, and failure-tolerant data pipelines Designing systems for high TPS and frequent state updates Multi-region data design and disaster recovery Secondary Skills Redis for low-latency caching, counters, and ephemeral state PostgreSQL for transactional, relational, and reference data MySQL for operational data stores and legacy integrations Low-Level Design (LLD) for scalable, fault-tolerant components High-Level Design (HLD) for distributed, multi-region systems NoSQL stores for hot state (e.g., Mongo, DynamoDB, Cassandra) Relational databases for reference/config data Data lake query engines (Athena, Spark) Observability for data pipelines (lag, freshness, reconciliation) Containerized runtimes and cloud-native deployments Prior experience with CPaaS, telecom, or large-scale messaging platforms Experience & Background 12-14 years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, or distributed systems Proven experience building large-scale, streaming-heavy data platforms Strong hands-on background in real-time analytics and data consistency Comfortable operating at Principal & Staff Engineer level with full technical ownership
