job.title: Asst. Manager - Financial Reporting & Compliance
job.description:
Role Overview

The Fixed Assets Assistant Manager will be part of the Finance Centre of Excellence and will be responsible for end‑to‑end fixed assets, leases and ARO accounting, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and strong financial governance. The role will own accounting, reporting, reconciliations, and audit coordination related to fixed assets, while partnering with multiple stakeholders to maintain compliance with applicable GAAP and internal policies.

This role will also contribute to process improvement, standardization, and automation initiatives within the fixed assets domain.

Key Responsibilities

Fixed Assets, Leases & ARO Accounting

  • Manage complete lifecycle accounting for fixed assets, including capitalization, depreciation, impairments, transfers and disposals.
  • Perform Capex and fixed assets accounting ensuring adherence to accounting standards and company policies.
  • Account for leases and Asset Retirement Obligations (ARO) in accordance with applicable GAAP.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed schedules for fixed assets, leases, ARO and related balances.

Reconciliations & Book Hygiene

  • Prepare and review fixed asset related reconciliations and ensure timely resolution of open items.
  • Ensure clearing of open items in General Ledger accounts in SAP to maintain hygiene of the books.
  • Review accrual accounting related to capex and fixed assets to ensure accurate financial reporting.

Reporting & Financial Analysis

  • Prepare monthly MIS for India and international entities with focus on fixed assets and capex.
  • Prepare monthly variance analysis and provide commentary to management.
  • Prepare consolidated schedules and reports and respond to consolidation‑related queries.
  • Support monthly and quarterly financial review processes with fixed asset related inputs.
  • Prepare standard, ad‑hoc reports and KPIs related to fixed assets and capital expenditure.

Audit, Compliance & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary liaison with statutory auditors for fixed assets, leases and ARO matters.
  • Ensure timely closure of statutory audits and related audit reports for assigned entities.
  • Prepare and submit audit data and respond to audit queries in a timely manner.
  • Support internal audits and other external reviews, including tax and regulatory surveys.
  • Coordinate with cross‑functional stakeholders for capex approvals, asset tagging, and reporting requirements.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Drive process simplification, standardization and automation across fixed assets accounting and reporting.
  • Support implementation and adherence to finance policies, standards and processes.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the Finance Centre of Excellence.

Qualifications & Experience

  • CA / ACCA or other equivalent professional qualification.
  • 1–3 years of relevant experience in finance, with exposure to fixed assets and capex accounting preferred.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Exceptional proficiency in Advanced Excel.
  • Hands‑on experience with SAP (mandatory).
  • Strong understanding of financial and accounting principles.
  • Working knowledge of leases, ARO, and asset accounting under applicable GAAP.
  • Familiarity with financial analysis and reporting tools.
  • Understanding across finance domains including taxation, treasury and FP&A.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

job.title: Lead - Captive Operations
job.description:
Job Description - L2 SD-WAN Engineer Job Title: L2 SD-WAN Engineer Location: Hyderabad Experience: Minimum 5-7 years Qualification: B.E./B.Tech./MCA with minimum 5 years of relevant experience OR BCA/B.Sc.-IT with minimum 7 years of relevant experience

Certifications Required: OEM certification in at least one SD-WAN technology is preferred/mandatory, such as:

Cisco SD-WAN Fortinet Secure SD-WAN Versa SD-WAN

CCNA/CCNP, NSE/FCP, Versa Certified or equivalent networking/SD-WAN certification will be an added advantage. CEH certified

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly capable and experienced L2 SD-WAN Engineer to join the Network Operations team at the client location. The candidate will be responsible for the day-to-day operation, monitoring, troubleshooting, configuration, maintenance, and implementation of multi-vendor SD-WAN environments. The role requires strong hands-on experience in SD-WAN technologies and enterprise networking, with the ability to work across different OEM platforms such as Cisco SD-WAN, Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, and Versa SD-WAN. The candidate will work closely with L1, L3, Network, Security, ISP, and OEM teams to ensure high availability, optimal performance, and secure connectivity across data centers, branch offices, cloud environments, and remote locations.

  • The candidate should have a good understanding of SD-WAN architecture, centralized orchestration, underlay and overlay networks, routing protocols, VPN/VRF, IPsec tunnels, application-aware routing, QoS, high availability, and Internet/MPLS connectivity.
  • Key Responsibilities:
  • Monitor and manage multi-vendor SD-WAN infrastructure, including Cisco, Fortinet, and Versa SD-WAN solutions.
  • Perform day-to-day operational support and troubleshooting of SD-WAN devices, controllers, orchestrators, and management platforms.
  • Monitor the health and availability of SD-WAN overlay and underlay networks, including WAN links, tunnels, controllers, and edge devices.
  • Troubleshoot SD-WAN connectivity issues involving MPLS, Internet, broadband, LTE/4G/5G, and other WAN transport technologies.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to IPsec tunnels, overlay connectivity, routing, VPN/VRF, BGP, OSPF, static routes, and route propagation.
  • Analyze SD-WAN alarms, events, logs, and performance metrics to identify and resolve network incidents.
  • Configure and troubleshoot application-aware routing, traffic steering, SLA-based path selection, QoS, and bandwidth utilization.
  • Perform configuration and policy changes through centralized SD-WAN management and orchestration platforms.
  • Implement SD-WAN policies, templates, profiles, routing configurations, security policies, and application-based traffic steering as per approved requirements.
  • Support deployment and implementation of new SD-WAN sites, branches, data centers, and cloud connectivity.
  • Participate in SD-WAN migration projects, including migration from traditional MPLS-based networks to SD-WAN solutions.
  • Perform SD-WAN edge device onboarding, provisioning, configuration, and validation activities.
  • Support integration of SD-WAN with existing network and security infrastructure, including firewalls, routers, switches, Internet gateways, and cloud platforms.
  • Perform health checks, configuration backups, software upgrades, firmware upgrades, and patch management for SD-WAN infrastructure.
  • Troubleshoot performance issues related to latency, packet loss, jitter, bandwidth utilization, and application performance.
  • Coordinate with ISPs and telecom service providers for resolution of WAN link-related incidents and performance issues.
  • Work with L1 and L3 teams to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex SD-WAN incidents and service-impacting issues.
  • Participate in the incident, problem, and change management processes and ensure compliance with defined ITIL processes and SLAs.
  • Validate and implement approved SD-WAN change requests, including impact assessment, implementation planning, rollback planning, and post-change validation.
  • Support SD-WAN high-availability configurations, redundancy testing, failover testing, and DR drills.
  • Perform planned and emergency changes during maintenance windows and ensure proper post-change validation.
  • Support troubleshooting and implementation of SD-WAN security features, including IPsec encryption, segmentation, secure connectivity, and integration with next-generation firewalls.
  • Support network segmentation using VPN/VRF and SD-WAN segmentation policies based on business and security requirements.
  • Perform configuration-level remediation activities identified through vulnerability assessments, security audits, and compliance reviews.
  • Analyze and act upon OEM advisories, security vulnerabilities, bug notifications, and recommended software upgrades relevant to SD-WAN platforms.
  • Maintain updated network diagrams, configuration documents, implementation documents, SOPs, MOPs, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Create and maintain knowledge base articles for recurring SD-WAN incidents, known errors, and standard troubleshooting procedures.
  • Prepare operational reports covering SD-WAN availability, incidents, link performance, SLA compliance, capacity utilization, and recurring issues.
  • Generate reports and dashboards related to SD-WAN health, network performance, incidents, and service trends.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for operational reporting, data analysis, and management presentations.
  • Coordinate with OEM support teams for complex technical issues and track cases through resolution.
  • Participate in technology refresh, capacity expansion, and SD-WAN optimization initiatives.
  • Continuously optimize SD-WAN configurations and policies to improve network availability, application performance, and bandwidth utilization.
  • Ensure compliance with defined security policies, operational procedures, change management processes, and SLA requirements.
  • Maintain awareness of the latest SD-WAN features, technologies, best practices, and product enhancements from Cisco, Fortinet, Versa, and other relevant OEMs.
  • Technical Skills / Desired Competencies:
  • Strong hands-on experience in enterprise networking and SD-WAN operations.
  • Good understanding of SD-WAN architecture, control plane, data plane, management plane, and orchestration components.
  • Hands-on experience with one or more of:

Cisco SD-WAN / Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Fortinet Secure SD-WAN / FortiGate Versa SD-WAN

  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, VLAN, NAT, DNS, DHCP, ACL, IPsec, GRE, and routing concepts.
  • Good hands-on knowledge of BGP, OSPF, static routing, route redistribution, and routing policies.
  • Good understanding of MPLS, Internet, broadband, LTE/4G/5G and hybrid WAN connectivity.
  • Experience in troubleshooting IPsec tunnels, overlay/underlay connectivity, routing issues, packet loss, latency, jitter, and application performance.
  • Knowledge of QoS, application-aware routing, traffic engineering, and dynamic path selection.
  • Understanding of network security concepts, including firewalls, segmentation, secure tunnels, encryption, and security policies.
  • Experience with SD-WAN monitoring, centralized management, orchestration, and analytics platforms.
  • Ability to perform packet-level troubleshooting using tools such as Wireshark, ping, traceroute, and vendor-specific troubleshooting utilities.
  • Good analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to handle critical network incidents under SLA-driven operations.
  • Ability to work in a multi-vendor environment and adapt to different OEM technologies and operational processes.
  • Strong communication and coordination skills for working with L1/L3 teams, OEMs, ISPs, and client stakeholders.
  • Willingness to work in 24 7 operations / rotational shifts, including weekends and holidays, as required by business needs.
  • Strong documentation and reporting skills with proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio or equivalent network diagramming tools.
  • Preferred Experience:
  • Experience in large enterprise or managed services environments.
  • Experience supporting geographically distributed branch networks.
  • Experience in SD-WAN implementation, migration, and rollout projects.
  • Experience in multi-vendor SD-WAN environments involving Cisco, Fortinet, and Versa.
  • Experience in managing critical incidents and participating in major incident management processes.
  • Experience in network automation, API-based configuration, or SD-WAN orchestration is an added advantage.
  • Experience working with ITIL-based Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management processes.

#LI-JK1

Required Skills

  • sd-wan
  • mpls
  • routing
  • vpn
  • ipsec tunnels
  • qos
  • cisco sd-wan

Job Summary

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Fixed Assets accounting lead to join our finance team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the company's fixed assets, ensuring compliance with multiple GAAP standards, performing timely monthly closures, and preparing Management Information System (MIS) reports. This role requires proficiency in SAP Hana, advanced Excel skills, and a strong aptitude for automation and advanced technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Fixed Assets Management: Maintain the fixed assets register, ensuring all acquisitions, disposals, and depreciation entries are accurately recorded. Conduct regular physical verification of assets and reconcile with the fixed asset register. Coordinate with various departments for capital expenditure (CapEx) budgeting and tracking.
  • Compliance and Reporting: Ensure compliance with multiple GAAP standards (e.g., IFRS, US GAAP, local GAAP) in all fixed asset transactions and reporting.

  • Provide training and support to team members on fixed asset management best practices.

job.description:
Enterprise Services Provisioning, Testing, and Migration Engineer

Location: Pune Experience Level: 4–6 years Customer-Facing Role: Global Clients/Customers

Role Overview:

The Enterprise Services Provisioning, Testing, and Migration Engineer will be responsible for provisioning, configuring, and troubleshooting access network services for enterprise customers. The role demands a strong technical foundation in Carrier Ethernet, IP routing, and switching, alongside the ability to manage escalations and support field engineers. This is a hands-on role requiring adherence to agile delivery processes, stakeholder communication, and the flexibility to work in secure environments or shifts.

Key Responsibilities:

Provisioning:

  • Provision and configure access networks manually and through automation tools.
  • Identify and resolve network provisioning failures, determining root causes and recommending corrective actions.
  • Support field engineers remotely for commissioning new services.
  • Optimize provisioning processes for agile and timely delivery.
  • Manage escalations within the team and ensure clear communication with stakeholders.

Testing and Migration:

  • Perform throughput and performance testing using tools like Wireshark and Geoprove.
  • Troubleshoot enterprise voice provisioning issues, including SIP PRI.
  • Conduct network validations and assist in migrations with minimal service interruptions.

Collaboration:

  • Engage with global customers, providing regular updates on provisioning and testing.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end enterprise network solutions.
  • Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety (WHS) policies.

Additional Requirements:

  • Work shift hours as required, including in secure rooms if necessary.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Strong expertise in Carrier Ethernet, IP management, routing, and switching.
  • Proficiency in networking protocols such as VLAN encapsulation, MPLS, L2/L3 VPN, BGP, OSPF, Static Routing, and IPv4/IPv6.
  • Experience with enterprise voice switching and provisioning.
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills, with the ability to articulate issues clearly.
  • Hands-on experience with packet tracing and analysis tools like Wireshark and Geoprove.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certifications: CCNA/CCNP
  • Knowledge of scripting and Excel VBA for automation.
  • Adaptability to flexible time schedules and the ability to work independently.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • "Can-do" attitude with excellent time management and multitasking capabilities.

Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Responsibilities:

From AI Studios and GPU-as-a-Service to cloud cost management and developer platforms, Vayu Cloud is shaping the future of enterprise cloud in India and beyond.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Product Designer to shape the end-to-end user experience of Vayu Cloud, Tata Communications’ next-generation AI-native cloud platform.

This role will drive product-led growth (PLG), simplify complex cloud workflows, and build world-class, developer-first experiences across Cloud and AI Studio.

You will work at the intersection of AI, Cloud Infrastructure, and Enterprise UX, defining how users discover, onboard, build, and scale on Vayu.

job.description:
The Privacy Manager will lead the integration of privacy-by-design into customer-facing products and services across telecom, SaaS, CPaaS, and cloud solutions. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise in application architecture, information security, and access control protocols, enabling proactive privacy risk management and regulatory compliance throughout the product lifecycle.

Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define and implement privacy controls. Conduct Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) and Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) for new and existing products. Evaluate and implement technical safeguards including encryption, pseudonymization, and secure access controls. Monitor and interpret global privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, DPDP Act) and translate them into actionable product requirements. Develop and maintain privacy notices, consent mechanisms, and data handling protocols. Support incident response and breach management for commercial products. Provide technical guidance and training to cross-functional teams on privacy best practices. Qualifications & Skills: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. Minimum 7 years of experience in privacy and data protection roles. Strong understanding of application architecture, data flows, and security protocols. Hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies and privacy governance tools and software. Certifications such as DCPP, CIPP, CIPT, FIP, CISSP, CISA or CISM are highly desirable. Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and analytical skills.

We are seeking an experienced Branch Network L2 Engineer to support and manage enterprise branch network infrastructure across multiple locations. The ideal candidate should possess strong hands-on expertise in Routing & Switching, enterprise network operations, incident management, and compliance-driven environments.   • Strong hands-on experience with Cisco or Aruba enterprise switching platforms.

  • Experience with HSRP/VRRP/GLBP.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, subnetting, NAT, DHCP, DNS, and IPv4 addressing.

job.title: Deputy General Manager - CSM- Sales - Continental Europe
job.description:
Purpose of your Role:

The broad objective of this role is to drive Customer Success through revenue growth, contract renewals, churn mitigation, timely SDWIP closure, Cross-sale/Up-sale and driving adoption and consumption of usage-based services and provide life-cycle support to clients finally resulting into achieving Revenue AOP and NPS Targets.

Grows the revenue from the assigned account/s through:

  • Build and execute revenue growth plan in allocated accounts.
  • Churn mitigation using cross sell or upsell during renewals maintaining a "farming" mindset to CSM. ("Farming" term is used in the context of performance analysis linked upgradation, cross-sales & up-sales of the contracted services).
  • Drive accelerated conversion of Service Delivery funnel into realizable revenue.
  • Drive consumption of usage-based services to expand revenue, through effective boarding, adoption, and expansion of services.
  • Ensures quality 360-degree life cycle management of the customer account, ensuring meeting / exceeding the NPS threshold for the territory and all other contractual obligations.
  • Nurturing and retaining the customer, voice of the customer analysis, reference programs and Service reviews.
  • Develops deep relationships within the customer senior management (C-Level) account across functions create greater value for TCL services thereby enhancing customer lifetime value.

Key Responsibilities

  • CSM is expected to meet Account Contracted Gross Revenue Targets. Contracted Gross Revenue is defined by the following 4 areas.
  • Baseline Revenue as FY start.
  • SDWIP Acceleration.
  • Usage services adoption and growth - revenue target.
  • Managing AOP for Price erosion, terminations, Service credits, aged debt.

Contact / Customer Onboarding

  • Own the customer contract/project onboarding process and drive alignment between Sales, Solutions, Program Management, and key customer stakeholders who are responsible for buying, designing, delivering, and consuming TCL services.
  • Internal Kick-off call & handover from Sales to Delivery Program Management.
  • Agree with the customer on an approach to Time to Value with customer and internal teams.
  • Introduce relevant customer stakeholders to Tata Communications People, Processes & tools and make it easier for them to do business with us.
  • Define Customer Engagement Model along with the customer (Time based, Value-based, Event-Based).
  • SDWIP funnel management to accelerate implementation for faster revenue realization by clearing the internal and external dependencies.
  • Govern on-hold decision at entry and reduce cancellations.
  • Service Adoption & revenue enhancement.
  • Ensuring timely activation and service acceptance.
  • Services which are usage based and require end user deployment or migration of traffic such as GSIP are to be monitored and tracked effortlessly to ensure order aspirations are reached.
  • For usage-based services like UCAAS, analyze customers’ usage to help identify areas for adoption and enhancement.
  • Identify training needs for end users and if identified, orchestrate this with a product or other functions.
  • For network services, understand current network usage and establish predictive capacity and trending.
  • Drive adoption on customer self-service portal (Optimus/TCX)

Nurture and Retain

  • Monitor performance & customer health signals & proactively mitigate any pain points.
  • Ensure availability of services as per contract.
  • Develop and execute action plan based on various customer feedback including CSAT, NPS and other ways of capturing Voice of Customer.
  • Retain Loyalist, Convert Neutral & Detractors into Loyalist.
  • Define and operate Governance Model along with the customer (Time based, Value-based, Event-Based).
  • Own and end to end managed customer service life cycle.
  • Churn mgmt.: The CSM is required to come up with a clear renewal and retention strategy for the allocated account/s and orchestrate the execution of the strategy leveraging the larger TCL set of stakeholders across functions. The objective is to proactively retain the customer and ensure churn mitigation through a combination of minimal erosion and service and consumption expansion. Some opportunities may be handed to Account Mgmt. teams to close depending on qualifications. (e.g. technology migration laden renewals or those that involve public sector / government tendering / RFPs).
  • Continuous service improvement planning.
  • Own and provide in-life contract life cycle management to the account.
  • Contract management in terms of deployment obligations, Terms and conditions, service level agreements, penalties.

Moves, Adds, Changes and Deletes (MACD)

  • Own end-to-end MACD responsibility, including providing repricing, quotations, documentation and closure formalities. Post MACD order closure hand over to the respective teams for regular execution of the MACD orders.

Expand

  • Work together with sales to create a near- and long-term account success plan (ADP)
  • Traffic expansion for subscription services and consumption expansion for usage-based services.
  • Help uncover new opportunities for the sales team and pass on those opportunities to them.

Role Development

  • Ensure Individual remains certified and trained with our Growth Services
  • Position himself/herself as the knowledge partner to the customer in the context of the customer environment

Required Qualification and Experience:

  • Relevant Technical/Business Studies Degree or MBA with 10 - 15 years of experience in customer facing role.
  • Customer Experience should be relationship based either through Account Mgmt. or Service
  • Customer Success Mgmt. profile. Should have carried targets in some form in previous role/s.

Base Salary Range: €66,400 - €87,316. The salary may be adjusted within this range based on the candidate's qualifications, experience, and the specific needs of the position.

Other Compensation: The position is eligible to participate in a sales-based incentive program

Job Description for Structural Engineer:

Professional skills:

Structural Designer Engineer with 2 to 4 years of experience in Structural Design and Analysis of Steel structures such as Lattice towers, Monopoles and Guy Masts using various tools and techniques. Analysis of foundations of steel structures.

Software skills: -

Primary: STAAD Pro, MS Tower, RSTAB / RFEM, MS Excel

Additional skills: AutoCAD, RISA-3D, Hilti, Idea statica, Bluebeam

Qualification

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering / B.E Structural Engineering.
  • Proficiency in English & German (Preferable)

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform structural design and/or assessment of telecommunication structures and preparation of relevant documentation using Indian and international standards.
  • Steel lattice towers
  • Steel and concrete monopoles
  • Rooftops poles and Antenna mounts
  • Quality check for the assessments with respect to the client requirements.
  • Provide modification/strengthening solutions in case of member failure.
  • Analysis of existing modifications for monopoles such as flat plates, bridge stiffeners, transition stiffeners and extensions.
  • Study and analyze all inputs from client to prepare & include Structure information, Antenna details, Shelter information, Mount/strengthening structural modelling, connection drawing, Lease area details and Technologies.
  • Analysis of existing modifications for self-supporting towers such as half pipe attached to the leg members, member replacements and bracing changes.
  • Analysis of anchor bolts and baseplates for telecommunication structures.
  • Foundation design and analysis of various kinds of foundations such as isolated footing, mat footing, pile foundation etc.
  • Analysis of foundation modifications such as foundation jacketing and composite foundations.
  • Develop the excel tools for different types of manual calculations to be performed outside software being used.
  • Engineering review of construction drawings prepared by the CAD technicians.
  • Prepare BOM (Bill of Materials) and technical documentation for production.
  • Conduct design reviews and implement feedback for continuous improvement.

Knowledge required -

  • Good knowledge and working experience in Eurocodes / Australian codes and standards such as:
  • AS3995-1994
  • ANSI/TIA-222-G and ANSI/TIA-222-H
  • IBC2015
  • BS EN 1993-1-1
  • IS 875- Part III- 2015
  • IS 800 – 2007
  • Good knowledge & understanding of Telecom network mainly on Cell sites structures.
  • Strong Knowledge in Steel members, Mounting standards, Member connections, Bolts, Brackets etc.
  • Good to have knowledge in technological upgradation like 4G and 5G networks.
  • Hands on experience and exposure to Nokia, Huawei and Ericsson wireless platforms.

Purpose of Role:

Lead & own the complete lifecycle management of the network infrastructure across ODCs, Data Centers, Customer Environments, and Internet connectivity. Responsible for architecture, deployment, operations, security, compliance (ISO 27001), capacity planning, lifecycle management, and technology modernization.

Key Responsibilities:

job.title: Sr. Manager - India Prime
job.description:
Position Overview

The Senior Partner Sales Account Manager (PSAM) – Prime Segment is a senior sales leadership role responsible for driving revenue growth, net-new customer acquisition, and aggressive territory expansion within top-tier ("Prime") enterprise partner ecosystems.

Designed for a seasoned sales professional with 10 to 12 years of enterprise sales and partnership experience, this position blends strategic territory development with senior-level deal execution. You will build and scale new geographic or vertical territories, lead complex co-selling pursuits, and align matrixed teams—orchestrating tight execution across Territory Sales Managers (TSMs), Inside Sales Representatives (ISRs), and executive partner leadership.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Territory Development & New Customer Acquisition

  • Formulate and execute multi-year territory growth plans to capture white space and drive aggressive net-new customer acquisition across Prime enterprise accounts.
  • Lead end-to-end sales pursuits for high-value strategic opportunities, establishing multi-threaded connections across C-suite executives, procurement, and technical leadership.
  • Own the overarching revenue and pipeline development results for the Prime Segment portfolio.

2. Cross-Functional Sales Orchestration (TSM & ISR Leadership)

  • Territory Sales Managers (TSMs): Co-develop regional GTM plans, align on field coverage, and co-sell high-stakes enterprise deals to drive velocity and deal size.
  • Inside Sales Representatives (ISRs): Direct inbound and outbound pipeline-generation initiatives, set lead-qualification standards, and convert high-intent prospects into closing opportunities.
  • Establish clear rules of engagement across partner, field, and inside channels to eliminate overlap and maximize rep productivity.

3. Senior Partner Alliance & Executive Alignment

  • Architect and manage Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with Prime partners, securing executive buy-in, co-investment budgets, and dedicated partner sales resource commitments.
  • Design and deploy advanced partner enablement models, sales playbooks, and co-selling frameworks that increase partner-led deal sourcing.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for strategic deal structuring, commercial negotiations, and high-value renewals.

4. Operational Rigor & Commercial Execution

  • Maintain rigorous pipeline management and accurate multi-quarter forecasting using enterprise CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Lead high-impact Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with internal executive sponsors and external partner leadership to evaluate performance.
  • Gather market and competitor intelligence to influence product roadmaps and strategic GTM investments.

Qualifications & Requirements

Experience & Track Record

  • 10–12+ years of progressive experience in B2B enterprise sales, channel account management, or strategic alliances within SaaS, Enterprise Software, or Cloud Infrastructure environments.
  • Consistent track record of managing enterprise-level client and partner accounts.
  • Demonstrated history of launching net-new territories and building high-yield partner co-sell ecosystems from the ground up.

Leadership & Collaborative Competencies

  • Master-level expertise in orchestrating tri-party coverage models with Field Sales (TSMs) and Inside Sales (ISRs) teams.
  • Executive presence with proven capability to negotiate complex, multi-stakeholder commercial terms with C-level executives (CEO, CRO, CIO).
  • Strategic mindset with strong financial literacy, capable of designing revenue-share models, joint GTM budgets, and commercial contracts.

Technical & Systems Proficiency

  • Advanced proficiency in CRM ecosystems (Salesforce), partner relationship management (PRM) tools, and sales engagement stacks

  • partner management
  • account management
  • partner enablement
  • territory sales
  • salesforce

job.title: Sr Engineer - Digital Fabric
job.description:
## Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer – ThreadSpan Product

Role Summary

## The QA Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of the ThreadSpan product. This role involves validating end-to-end product functionality, identifying defects early, and working closely with Product, Engineering, and Delivery teams to ensure that business and technical requirements are met with high standards of quality.

Key Responsibilities

Functional & Regression Testing

##

  • Perform comprehensive functional, regression, integration, and system testing of the ThreadSpan product.
  • Validate product features against business requirements, user stories, and product specifications.
  • Ensure seamless functionality across modules, workflows, and integrations.

Test Planning & Execution

##

  • Design, document, and execute test plans, test cases, and test scenarios based on product requirements and use cases.
  • Maintain traceability between business requirements, product requirements, and test coverage.
  • Execute test cycles for new features, enhancements, bug fixes, and releases.

Defect Management

##

  • Identify, log, track, and retest defects using defect-tracking tools.
  • Collaborate with Development and Product teams to clarify issues and ensure timely resolution.
  • Validate fixed defects and ensure no regression issues are introduced.

Automation & Tools (If Applicable)

##

  • Contribute to or maintain test automation scripts for regression and sanity testing.
  • Identify scenarios suitable for automation to improve test efficiency and coverage.
  • Work with CI/CD pipelines where applicable to support continuous testing.

Product & Business Alignment

##

  • Understand ThreadSpan’s business use cases, customer workflows, and end-user expectations.
  • Work closely with Product Managers and Business stakeholders to validate acceptance criteria.
  • Provide quality-related insights and risk assessments before releases.

Non-Functional Testing

##

  • Support performance, security, usability, and compatibility testing as required.
  • Validate product behavior under different environments, configurations, and user loads.

Required Skills & Experience

##

  • Proven experience in Software Quality Assurance / Testing for web-based or SaaS products.
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, SDLC, and STLC.
  • Experience in writing clear and structured test cases and test documentation.
  • Good knowledge of defect tracking and test management tools.
  • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective test coverage.

Minimum Qualifications & Experience

  • Graduation in Computer Science and Engineering or a related field
  • 4-7 Years relevant experience

Required Skills

  • quality assurance
  • performance testing
  • regression testing
  • black box testing
  • white box testing
  • software testing methodologies
  • software development life cycle
  • software testing life cycle

Zscaler Administration

Configure URL Filtering, SSL Inspection, Cloud Firewall, CASB, Sandbox, DLP, and Browser Isolation.

Infoblox BloxOne Threat Defense

Detect and block malicious domains.

Investigate DNS tunneling activities.

Analyze DNS logs for threat detection.

Manage DNS forwarding and recursive resolver security.

Security Operations

Analyze malware and phishing URLs.

Block Indicators of Compromise (IOCs).

Perform threat hunting using Zscaler and DNS telemetry.

Tune detection rules to reduce false positives.

Support Incident Response activities.

Coordinate with SOC, Network, Endpoint, and Cloud Security teams.

job.title: Sr. Manager - Digital Fabric
job.description:
Senior Technical Architect / Principal Software Engineer

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Senior Technical Architect / Principal Software Engineer with 17+ years of proven expertise in enterprise application development, SaaS-based ERP solutions, and full software development lifecycle management. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience designing scalable, high-performance applications, leading technical teams, driving architectural decisions, and delivering innovative solutions that align with business objectives.

This role requires deep expertise in Java/J2EE technologies, Spring ecosystem, cloud-native application development, SaaS platforms, database design, DevOps practices, and Agile methodologies. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in defining technical strategy, mentoring engineering teams, and ensuring the successful delivery of enterprise-grade software solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Architecture & Design

  • Design, develop, and implement scalable SaaS-based ERP solutions to meet complex business requirements.
  • Collaborate directly with business stakeholders and internal customers to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Define application architecture, system integration strategies, and technical roadmaps.
  • Ensure solutions are secure, maintainable, highly available, and optimized for performance.
  • Lead architectural reviews and technology selection initiatives.
  • Establish best practices, design standards, and governance frameworks.

Software Development

  • Develop enterprise-grade applications using Java/J2EE, Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, JPA, JDBC, and Servlets.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs and web services using Jersey, SOAP, WSDL, and XML technologies.
  • Lead feature development, product enhancements, and customization initiatives.
  • Write high-quality, reusable, and maintainable code adhering to industry standards and best practices.
  • Conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with secure coding standards.

Data & Search Technologies

  • Design and optimize relational database schemas to support enterprise-scale applications.
  • Develop complex SQL queries, Stored Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Cursors, and database objects.
  • Implement enterprise search capabilities using Apache SOLR, including schema design, indexing strategies, and query optimization.
  • Ensure database performance, data integrity, scalability, and availability.
  • Optimize caching and distributed data management strategies using technologies such as Hazelcast.

DevOps & Automation

  • Build, manage, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Maven, and related automation tools.
  • Develop shell scripts and automation utilities for build, deployment, and release management.
  • Implement modern DevOps practices to enhance software delivery efficiency.
  • Monitor and optimize system performance, availability, and deployment processes.
  • Implement logging, monitoring, and troubleshooting solutions using Log4j and related tools.

Agile Delivery & Technical Leadership

  • Work within Agile/Scrum environments to deliver high-quality software solutions.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and technical governance activities.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to development teams.
  • Conduct peer reviews and guide engineers on software engineering best practices.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and lead root-cause analysis efforts.
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including Product Management, QA, DevOps, and Business Stakeholders.

Modern Technology Enablement

  • Drive development automation initiatives leveraging JMR and modern engineering frameworks.
  • Provide technical leadership across Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, JavaScript, React, Angular, and Vue.js ecosystems.
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies, architectural patterns, and engineering practices.
  • Support cloud modernization and digital transformation programs.

Required Skills & Technical Expertise

Core Technologies

  • Java
  • J2EE
  • Spring Framework
  • Spring Boot
  • Spring Cloud
  • Servlets
  • JDBC
  • JPA
  • Hibernate

  • RESTful APIs (Jersey)
  • SOAP Web Services
  • WSDL
  • XML
  • Enterprise Application Integration
  • Microservices Architecture

  • SQL Development
  • Stored Procedures
  • Functions
  • Triggers
  • Cursors
  • Database Schema Design
  • Database Performance Optimization

Search & Caching Technologies

  • Apache SOLR
  • Indexing & Search Optimization
  • Hazelcast
  • Distributed Caching Solutions

DevOps & Build Tools

  • Jenkins
  • Maven
  • Shell Scripting
  • CI/CD Pipelines
  • Build & Release Management

Source Control & Collaboration Tools

  • Git
  • SVN (Subversion)
  • JIRA
  • Agile Project Management Tools

Front-End Technologies

  • JavaScript
  • React
  • Angular
  • Vue.js

Microsoft Technologies

  • VB.NET
  • C#.NET
  • Web Services
  • XML Technologies

Logging, Monitoring & Troubleshooting

  • Log4j
  • Application Monitoring
  • Performance Tuning
  • Production Support
  • Debugging & Troubleshooting

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 17+ years of hands-on experience in software development, technical architecture, and enterprise solution delivery.
  • Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale SaaS applications and ERP solutions.
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns, object-oriented programming principles, and distributed systems architecture.
  • Demonstrated experience in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
  • Experience leading technical teams, architecture reviews, and complex transformation initiatives.

job.title: AM - Financial Reporting & Compliance
job.description:
Assistant Manager – FR&C**

Role Overview

We are seeking a finance professional to join our Finance team as an Assistant Manager – Financial Reporting & Compliance. This role is ideal for candidates with 1–2 years of experience who are keen to build a strong foundation in accounting, compliance, reporting, and financial controls through hands‑on operational exposure.

The role will work closely with senior finance members and support day‑to‑day finance operations, reconciliations, audits, and statutory compliance activities.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting & Financial Reporting

Assist in preparation of monthly financial statements and schedules. Support month‑end close activities including postings for accruals, payroll, prepaid expenses, and fixed assets. Prepare basic variance analysis and supporting workings. Reconciliations & Controls

  • Perform general ledger reconciliations and follow up on reconciling items.
  • Prepare bank reconciliations and ensure timely clearance of differences.
  • Support intercompany accounting, accounting entries, and reconciliation tracking.

Ensure compliance with internal control documentation and standard operating procedures. Compliance, Audit & Tax Support

Assist in statutory audit and internal audit by preparing data, schedules, and responses to audit queries. Support tax compliance activities including documentation. Maintain statutory compliance trackers and filings calendar. Systems & Process Support

Update and maintain financial data in SAP or other ERP systems. Assist in identifying process gaps, errors, and improvement opportunities. Support implementation of standardized templates and reporting formats. Stakeholder Coordination

Coordinate with internal finance teams, auditors, consultants, and shared service teams. Escalate discrepancies, delays, or risks with proper documentation. Desired Skills & Competencies

  • Foundational understanding of accounting principles and financial controls.
  • Basic exposure to financial reporting, audits, and compliance requirements.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel (lookups, pivots, basic reconciliations).
  • Exposure to SAP or similar ERP systems preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn.
  • Good communication and coordination skills.

Ability to manage routine finance tasks in a structured environment. Experience & Qualification

1–2 years of relevant finance/accounting experience. Qualified / Semi‑qualified CA, or M.Com / CWA (CMA). Experience in corporate finance, shared services, audit firms, or consulting preferred.

Required Skills

  • financial reporting
  • chartered accountant
  • financial analysis
  • accounting records
  • reconciliations
  • audits
  • microsoft excel

job.title: Manager - Financial Reporting & Compliance
job.description:
The role is part of the finance centre of excellence and will support in any one or more areas of finance including financial planning and analysis, reporting and compliance, taxation, and treasury. This is an operational role, responsible for delivering results that have direct impact on the achievement of results within the assigned account and business.

Minimum Qualifications & Experience CA

  • 0-2 years experience in Finance
  • Other Knowledge & Skills
  • Exceptional knowledge of Advanced Excel.
  • SAP/ERP exposure .
  • Familiarity with finance and statistical analysis software
  • Understanding of financial and accounting principles
  • Understanding business process (Order to Cash, Procure to Pay)

Key Responsibilities

  • Review customer contracts, amendments, renewals, and side agreements to assess accounting implications and appropriate revenue recognition treatment.
  • Evaluate whether contracts meet recognition criteria under IFRS 15 / Ind AS 115 and document key terms, assumptions, and judgments.
  • Identify performance obligations, determine transaction price, allocate consideration, and assess timing of revenue recognition based on obligation satisfaction.
  • Revenue-cost mapping, ensuring alignment between performance obligations, incurred costs, and revenue recognition.
  • Reviewing cost provisions, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and appropriate linkage to contractual obligation.
  • Prepare and review technical accounting memos, contract summaries, and revenue schedules for complex or non standard arrangements.

job.title: Data Center Technician
job.description:
Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will stage, set up and perform hardware deployments. In addition, you will also perform troubleshooting and diagnostics on equipment, as well as perform hardware decommissions for simple changes and refreshes following Standard Operating Procedures. This early careersprofessional opportunity will allow you to deepen your understanding of Data Center standard processes and procedures, develop mentoring skills while providing guidance to peers, familiarizing yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process. This role is based 100% onsite within one of our Data Centers.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications. Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

  • Perform diagnostics and troubleshooting following standard procedures, quickly identify the cause(s) of issues, and replace faulty components with minimal customer and business disruption.
  • Perform post-execution quality checks and verifies that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up properly according to safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs).
  • Decommission hardware for simple changes and refresh (e.g., memory upgrades, rebuilds) following standard procedures with minimal guidance.
  • Follow procedures to communicate, report, and escalate incidents to appropriate Microsoft data center operations management units, Technician Leads, and engineering specialists.
  • Assist and provide guidance to other technicians to complete challenging or complex tasks.
  • Complete required training aligned to the role and workload; observe more experienced technicians to gain hands-on experience and relevant on-the-job training.
  • Contribute to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work.
  • Take pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and resulting user experience; displays accountability and ownership of the data center facilities.
  • Embody our [culture](https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/culture) and [values](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/about/corporate-values).

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma, GED, TAFE or equivalent and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components AND 1+ year(s) industry work experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.

As a Senior Critical Environment Technician (CET) within Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team, you will maintain the critical infrastructure that keeps our Datacenters up and running. This role is based 100% onsite within one of our Data Centers.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. Responsibilities

  • Inspect and supervise critical environment-related facility equipment (e.g., controls, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning [HVAC], mechanical systems), building, and grounds regularly for unsafe or abnormal conditions and escalate per applicable policies and standards.
  • Utilize internal computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to track all equipment assets and to complete work order requests for maintenance work.
  • Safely and quickly respond to and leads onsite incident response teams for all abnormal conditions that impact operations, and coordinates with other critical facilities professionals to perform corrective repairs without supervision.
  • Enhance, develop new or follow preexisting emergency operating procedures (EOPs), methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) in relation to CE operations and incidents.
  • Perform various types of maintenance (e.g., planned, predictive, corrective) and repairs following methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for CE equipment (e.g., electrical, mechanical, cooling systems) and escalate when appropriate.

  • Provide consultation to lower-level colleagues in troubleshooting systems and problems.

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, GED, TAFE or equivalent AND 3+ years industry mission critical services work/applied learning experience (e.g., high availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields)
  • OR equivalent experience.
  • 3+ year(s) industry work experience in a specialized area (e.g., mechanical field, electrical field, HVAC, controls field) or related field.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
  • Citizenship Verification: This position requires verification of Australian Citizenship to meet federal government security requirements. This includes verification of a current Australian Passport.
  • NV1/2, PV Clearance Assessment: This position may require an enhanced background check conducted through the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency.

Whilst not required, we also look for the followingPreferred Qualifications:

This includes information processing, packaging, shipment, and receipt of return for Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) devices following all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) related to RMA warranty process.
  • Leverage process knowledge and best judgment to complete tasks with minimal direct supervision.
  • Maintain a strong focus to understand the impact of their work when completing tickets and assigned Inventory and Asset Management (IAM) tasks.

job.title: Data Center Technician
job.description:
Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will stage, set up and perform hardware deployments. In addition, you will also perform troubleshooting and diagnostics on equipment, as well as perform hardware decommissions for simple changes and refreshes following Standard Operating Procedures. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your understanding of Data Center standard processes and procedures, develop mentoring skills while providing guidance to peers, familiarizing yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process. This role is suitable for an early careers professional and is based 100% on site in one of our Data Centers in Canberra.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications. Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

job.title: Critical Environment Ops Tech
job.description:
Overview

As aCritical Environment Technician (CET)(Fayetteville, GA)in Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team, you will help to maintain the critical infrastructure that keeps our datacenters up and running. This could be anything from performing basic monitoring and inspection, performing various types of maintenance, participating in equipment troubleshooting, enforcing all safety and security requirements, and developing methods of operating procedures (MOPs) and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Critical Environment Technician, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

In this environment, you may be asked to go on business travel to support other metros periodically, 0-25% of the time and have the ability to work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends and/or holidays. Microsoft is unable to sponsor a work visa for this role due to the nature of the role's job duties.

Responsibilities

Critical Environment Culture

  • Understands, follows, and ensures safety and security requirements (e.g., job hazard assessments [JHAs], toolbox talks), and business processes and procedures are met, to properly perform work in a safe, quality, and reliable manner in accordance to applicable Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) regulations, and Microsoft requirements. Recognizes safe versus unsafe working conditions and responds accordingly (e.g., stop/pause tasks, stand down vendors where necessary).Escalates immediately when unsafe working conditions are observed and promotes a safe working culture to empower less experienced team members. Participates in required meetings, trainings, and necessary handoffs. Assesses and identifies appropriate resources and equipment necessary to fully support environmental health and safety (EHS) objectives.Actively maintains safe working conditions at all times. Proactively ensures safety and security requirements are followed and met for the work of themselves and others.

Equipment and Systems Maintenance

  • Prepares and submits required reports (e.g., turnover, preventative maintenance [PM]) as assigned following preexisting scripts and templates, or using ad hoc methods required to support trending and analysis (e.g., Maintenance data, equipment trending data). Develops methods of operating procedure (MOPs), standard operating procedures (SOPs), and/or digital methods of operating procedures (DMOPs) for devices and disciplines within their coverage and expertise to ensure safe and reliable execution. Documents completed work using approved tools and procedural templates for more experienced technician review. Completes and provides coaching to support less experienced technicians for mandatory, technical, and procedural training assignments. Analyzes findings from reports and documents observations.
  • Performs various types of maintenance (e.g., planned, predictive, corrective) and repairs following methods of procedure (MOPs), standard operating procedures (SOPs), and digital methods of operating procedures (DMOPs) for multiple disciplines and one or more types of equipment (e.g., electrical, mechanical, cooling systems) with minimal supervision - in consideration of Task Hazard Analysis (THA), Method Statement of Work (MSOW), or varying permit requirements. Communicates and/or escalates maintenance activities per established process and procedure. Prioritizes maintenance activities as required and/or appropriate. Documents tasks or issues during maintenance activities within appropriate systems per process and procedure as needed. Performs maintenance tasks and repairs that can be performed with minimal oversight. Follows recommended maintenance schedules. Oversees maintenance tasks within a single discipline or area of expertise. Maintains all systems and equipment in a safe and professional manner and understands levels of risk (LORs) associated with varying types of maintenance with established mastery of maintaining systems of a specific discipline.
  • Provides necessary escort to third-party contractors, sub-contractors, vendors, and service providers on site based on the appropriate procedure levels of risk (LOR). Takes part in getting third-party work underway (e.g., making sure systems are properly energized/deenergized), ensuring the work is started and completed in a safe manner in accordance with standard practices, procedures, and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) regulations. Ensures work performed by suppliers/vendors is performed to scope, all documentation is performed correctly, and escalates as appropriate. Recognizes circumstances when to stop supplier/vendor work to address potential and/or identified concerns. Coordinates per appropriate LOR applicable to preventative and/or corrective maintenance. Identifies and recommends procedure corrections if/when errors are detected or when appropriate. Coordinates and schedules supplier/vendor on-site activities. Reviews and completes appropriate work orders to support approval of vendor supplier field service reports or invoices.
  • Processes method statement of work (MSOW) documents. Coordinates activities and associated schedules with contractors. Performs inspections of equipment in a facility. Participates in testing and commissioning activities.
  • Documents issues found in troubleshooting process within appropriate systems per process and procedure as needed. Ensures equipment and system settings are consistent with established parameters and designs. Determines when troubleshooting efforts are deemed adequate and communicates or escalates to suppliers, engineers, or more experienced colleagues as needed. Has a hands-on understanding of how equipment works within disciplines they have been trained and how to troubleshoot to a subsystem level. Provides consultation to less experienced colleagues with troubleshooting systems and problems. May lead efforts to troubleshoot issues and identify root causes.

Equipment and Systems Operations

  • Works on advanced tasks (e.g., vendor contact, escalations) independently. Serves as a subject matter expert in critical environments-related systems within the data center, and advises less experienced colleagues on such topics. Possesses an understanding of and operates equipment and systems within a set discipline (e.g., electrical, mechanical, controls) with knowledge of the interactions between them and overall operation of a data center. Operates all systems and equipment in a safe and professional manner.
  • Inspects and supervises critical environment-related facility equipment (e.g., controls, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning [HVAC], mechanical systems), building, and grounds for unsafe or abnormal conditions to develop and analyze trends. Understands critical system alarms for single discipline(s) of equipment, their meanings, and engages with appropriate escalation processes or procedures. Recognizes circumstances where execution would be considered safe to proceed. Performs various inspections and validations of equipment performance. Monitors the performance from central monitoring locations (i.e., Facility Operations Centers) of maintenance and operations of equipment (e.g., electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety) within the data center. Escalates per applicable policies and standards. Utilizes telemetry, control systems, and other platforms to monitor site status, analyze past and current events, as well as other processes, and can identify all alarms. Uses technical expertise, prior experience, and device analytics to recognize trends with equipment behavior and checks potential issues as they arise. Advises less experienced colleagues on issues found while monitoring applicable CE systems. Performs all monitoring equipment repair, replacement, and maintenance work, which meets or exceeds Microsoft Service Level Agreement (SLA) requirements.
  • Utilizes internal computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to track all equipment assets and to complete work order requests for maintenance work. Tracks hours for performed tasks within applicable task management systems. Adds required data, documents, logs changes, and upkeeps procedures related to building management systems and reports. Properly signals spare equipment and parts utilization within maintenance work orders.
  • Safety and quickly responds to and leads an onsite incident response team for all abnormal conditions that impact operations, and coordinates with other critical facilities professionals to perform corrective repairs, without supervision. Gathers necessary information and creates incident timelines/data, root-cause analyses, and/or action items following an abnormal condition as required. Identifies and contacts/engages appropriate parties to mitigate incidents as they occur. Develops new or follows preexisting emergency operating procedures (EOPs), methods of procedure (MOPs), standard operating procedures (SOPs), and digital methods of operating procedures (DMOPs) in relation to incidents. Directly provides emergency monitoring response to irregular or malfunctioning conditions.

Physical Requirements

  • Applies to but is not limited to US-based Data Center roles: Occasional climbing of ladders. Frequent climbing of stairs and/or ramps. Prolonged standing. Occasional lifting 50lbs / 22.5kg. Occasional push or pull 50-75 lbs / 22.5-34kg. with assistive device. Normal visual acuity (near, far and peripheral with correction), defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria. Normal color vision for electrical work, defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria.

Working Conditions

  • Applies to but is not limited to US-based Data Center roles: Working for extended periods under elevated levels of ambient noise, heat, and light due to necessary equipment and ventilation systems.
  • As indicated above, this role has a travel requirement of up to 25% which means you may be required to travel, from time to time, as part of this role.
  • As indicated above,have the ability to work 12-hour shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime,weekends and/or holidays.

Other

  • * Embodies our[culture](https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/culture)and[values](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/about/corporate-values)

Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent.

Other Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check:This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
  • This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have authorization to work in the United States that does not now or in the future require employer sponsorship.

Additional or preferred qualifications

  • Associate's Degree or technical trade certification (e.g., military, trade school), or higher-equivalent education AND 2+ years mission-critical services experience (e.g., high-availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields) OR High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent AND 3+ years mission critical services experience (e.g., high-availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, Chillers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields) OR equivalent experience.
  • 1+ year(s) mission critical services work/applied learning experience (e.g., high availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields) OR equivalent experience.
  • 1 + year(s) experience with knowledge and understanding of the critical electrical and mechanical systems of a facility (e.g. generators, Uninterruptable Power Supply [UPS] systems, static transfer systems, chillers, air handlers, controls) their interdependencies, and how they perform to support critical IT load.

job.title: Datacenter Operations Manager
job.description:
Overview

As aDatacenter Operations Manager, you will lead the day-to-day operations of a critical datacenter environment, ensuring the highest standards of reliability, availability, safety, and operational excellence. You will oversee teams responsible for infrastructure operations, maintenance, and service delivery while driving continuous improvement across processes, capacity management, and operational readiness. This role offers the opportunity to have a direct impact on the performance and scalability of the technology infrastructure that powers global services, working in a fast-paced environment where innovation, collaboration, and customer focus are essential to success.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Datacenter Operations Manager (DCOM), you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 100 datacenters and 1 million servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Do you want to empower billions across the world? Come and join us in CO+I and be at the forefront of the action!

Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team, creating an environment of accountability, empowerment, continuous learning, and professional growth.
  • Attract, retain, and develop talent by aligning team capabilities, career aspirations, and business needs to build a sustainable workforce.
  • Establish clear objectives, priorities, and performance expectations, driving execution and adaptation to changing business requirements.
  • Oversee the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of critical data center infrastructure, ensuring adherence to operational, safety, and regulatory standards.
  • Provide technical leadership across Critical Environment (CE) infrastructure, including high-voltage and low-voltage electrical systems, UPS and battery systems, standby generators, fuel systems, electrical distribution, cooling infrastructure, BMS, EPMS, and fire detection and suppression systems.
  • Ensure compliance with service level agreements, operational processes, maintenance standards, and all applicable regulatory and safety requirements.
  • Lead and govern maintenance activities, including the execution and review of MOPs, SOPs, EOPs, permits to work, change management activities, and operational risk assessments.
  • Manage vendor, landlord, contractor, and stakeholder relationships to ensure operational excellence, service reliability, and effective service delivery.
  • Drive service quality, infrastructure availability, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement initiatives across data center operations.
  • Lead major incident management activities, coordinating response efforts, recovery actions, root cause investigations, and corrective and preventive measures.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate operational, electrical, mechanical, and facility-related risks that could impact safety, service availability, or business continuity.
  • Support operational readiness, capacity planning, commissioning activities, lifecycle management, and long-term infrastructure strategy for critical facility assets.
  • Plan and manage budgets, forecasting, resource allocation, and operational priorities while maintaining fiscal responsibility and efficiency.
  • Partner cross-functionally to deliver strategic initiatives, support environmental health and safety programs, strengthen risk management practices, and achieve business objectives.
  • Foster a culture of safety, quality, accountability, collaboration, and customer obsession throughout all operational activities.
  • Remove operational barriers, proactively resolve issues, and implement improvements to enhance reliability, performance, and business continuity.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders by communicating risks, dependencies, operational impacts, costs, and mitigation strategies to enable informed decision-making.
  • Ensure teams are prepared to respond to and recover from incidents affecting mission-critical infrastructure, maintaining operational resilience and service continuity.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent AND experience of mission-critical service management (e.g., providing IT services, manufacturing, warehouse, retail, military, or managing physical operations in an IT).
  • Experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., mechanical systems, electrical systems, controls systems)
  • Proven experience leading, directly managing, and influencing a diverse organization across multiple disciplines and platforms.
  • This role requires fluency in reading, writing, and conversational French and English, as all business operations and stakeholder communications are conducted in these languages

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft,customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Enterprise-level experience managing large scale and complex projects/programs AND experience in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) AND Experience managing budget $500k+.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or related field.
  • Experience of managing managers, leading diverse, technical workforce or managing global and virtual teams.
  • Applicable certifications: ASICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA, Microsoft, Network Certifications, CCNA Certifications, ITIL v3 Foundation, Microsoft Operations Framework (MOF) Certifications, Leadership Development Certifications, PMP, CDCP.
