  • Co-ordinate body movements when using tools or equipment.
  • May require bending or twisting the body to access equipment while working.
  • Involves performing physical tasks all day.
  • Use hands to manipulate small wires and objects.
  • Push or pull objects into position.

Key Requirements

  • 8 - 10 years working experience in building services design and construction project delivery (data centre projects preferred).
  • Bachelor’s in Electrical or Building Services Engineering
  • Chartered Engineer preferred
  • Relevant Uptime/TIA certificates preferred
  • Good knowledge in Electrical HV/LV distribution Engineering with a good understanding on data centre project and protection study
  • Proficiency in MS Office (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc) with experience in Mechanical HVAC software, such as IES.
  • Good command of written and spoken English is required. Additional language skills such as Chinese and/or Bahasa Indonesia/Malaysia will be preferred.
  • Candidates who are active, initiative, conscientious, sociable, flexible and optimistic.

Interpersonal Requirements

  • Committed to the delivery of excellent customer service.
  • Calm Manner, able to work under pressure.
  • Self-motivated, ability to work on own initiative.
  • Punctual and reliable.
  • Good attention to detail.

#JR 557

Bachelors

Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Electrical Engineering & Electronics

Radiologist

Job Description

The Medical Imaging Technology team of Siemens Healthcare Technology Center has an immediate opening in Princeton, NJ for an experienced Chest Radiologist to join our multidisciplinary team focused on advancing AI-based solutions in medical imaging. The ideal candidate will bring clinical expertise in thoracic imaging and play a pivotal role in the development, validation, and deployment of AI-driven diagnostic tools. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of clinical radiology and cutting-edge technology, contributing to the future of AI in healthcare.

What are my responsibilities?

  • Collaborate with data scientists, AI engineers, and clinical teams to develop algorithms for automated detection, diagnosis, and quantification of thoracic diseases (e.g., lung cancer, pneumonia, interstitial lung disease) in medical imaging.
  • Lead the clinical validation efforts for AI models by evaluating algorithm performance, ensuring diagnostic accuracy, and comparing AI outputs against radiologist interpretation.
  • Provide expert annotations and guidance on chest imaging datasets to improve AI model training. Ensure the quality and consistency of labeled datasets used in AI development.
  • Work with AI developers to refine algorithms, providing clinical feedback on areas for improvement and offering suggestions to enhance diagnostic performance.
  • Assist in integrating AI solutions into radiology workflows, ensuring tools are user-friendly, efficient, and improve clinical outcomes.

What do I need to qualify for this job?

  • Education: Doctor of Medicine (MD) degree with board certification in Diagnostic Radiology. Fellowship training in Chest or Thoracic Imaging is required.
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in chest imaging, with a strong background in diagnosing pulmonary and thoracic conditions. Experience in AI development, clinical research, or advanced imaging techniques is highly desirable.
  • Technical Skills: Familiarity with AI applications in medical imaging, including automated segmentation, classification, and detection algorithms. Experience with AI platforms, machine learning models, and medical imaging software is a plus.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment.

job.title: Retail Consultant, Brisbane South
job.description:
Beenleigh, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, connecting more than 11 million customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

We’re looking for a vibrant and motivated Casual and Part-Time Retail Service Consultant to join our Beenleigh team. If you love helping people, thrive in being a part of a supportive crew, and bring positive energy to every interaction, then we’d love to have you on board!

At Optus, you’ll feel connected to what truly matters. We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity, and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships with our customers and with each other.

What you’ll do:

  • Be the face of Optus, delivering standout customer experiences powered by optimism, curiosity and genuine care.
  • Explore our range of tech products and services, and share your knowledge in a way that’s simple, helpful and accessible.
  • Bring your personality and charm to uncover customer needs and deliver personalised solutions that make their day.
  • Work as one team, crafting a warm, welcoming environment where customers feel supported and memorable moments happen.

What you bring:

  • Service Superpower: You know how to understand customer needs, deliver genuine support, and let phenomenal service drive fantastic outcomes.
  • Tech Explorer: You enjoy helping customers make sense of tech by breaking things down simply and guiding them to the right solutions.
  • Problem Solving Pro: You listen with empathy, act with integrity, and turn challenges into opportunities to help with calm, practical solutions.
  • Composure Under Pressure: You’re confident in navigating difficult enquiries, ease tricky situations with empathy and respect, and work toward the best solution for the customer.
  • Team Spirit: You build strong connections with your teammates, support one another, stay accountable, and create a customer‑first environment where everyone succeeds.

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and access to exclusive discounts.
  • Phenomenal perks, including 25% off Optus products and exclusive access to unique discounts with our retail partners.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Yarn First Nations, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, available 24/7 across multiple channels.
  • Flexible rosters that work around the life you live outside of work.

Intrigued, but not sure you tick every box? That’s completely okay! We still encourage you to apply. We all grow, learn and develop together, and this role might be the perfect next step in your career journey.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit [https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity](https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity)

job.title: IT Service Delivery Leader - Senior (SAP EWM)
job.description:
Job Summary

Responsible for the management, operations, delivery and support of defined IT applications and/or infrastructure services; directs and coordinates the efforts of people to accomplish goals and objectives using available resources.

Key Responsibilities

Contributes to the delivery and support of specific IT services. Supports the development and maintenance of services and ensures that tools and resources are capable and available (i.e. IT Service Catalog, Asset Management system) Generates and reports service delivery metrics and drives standards across regions and locations (i.e. Scorecards, Service Level Agreement (SLAs) and Customer Satisfaction or Net Promoter Scoring). Acts as a point of contact for customers for service related inquiries and maintains relationships with key customers and suppliers. Is familiar with SLA / Operational Level Agreements between other IT Services Provided. Encourages root cause analysis using the formal problem solving approach for recurring issues. Champions the use of Six Sigma to reduce costs and improve processes. Identifies opportunities for service improvements, discuss with the customer and raise the request for change for assessment if appropriate Maintains the accuracy of service related standards, procedures and work instructions in a knowledge management system. Able to support the Service Owner when needed. Champions the use of ITIL Standards for IT Service Deliverables Maintain strong relationships to deliver business value using relevant Business Relationship Management practices.

Competencies:

Financial acumen - Interpreting and applying understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions.

Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

IT Supplier Relationships - Leverages a vendor management framework to manage strategic supplier relationships and supplier performance based on business need throughout the contract life using the required processes and tools to control costs, drive service excellence, mitigate risks, and gain increased value from the suppliers.

Request Fulfillment - Manages a service request through its life cycle with efficiency and professionalism using the required processes and tools to maintain customer satisfaction.

Service Asset and Configuration Management - Manages service assets and configuration items by maintaining accurate configuration records to support other service management processes with documented and verifiable information.

Service Catalog Management - Maintains a service catalog that contains all details of active and approved services in service operations using the required processes and tools to provide clear and relevant information to users.

Service Level Management - Ensures the quality of the services delivered meet agreed levels using the required processes and tools in order to maintain customer satisfaction.

Troubleshooting - Diagnoses and resolves the customer-identified issue by utilizing appropriate department standards to satisfy customer expectations.

Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Intermediate level of relevant work experience required. 3-5 years of experience.

  • Owns global operational accountability for SAP S/4HANA Extended Warehouse Management, Inventory Management, and adjacent logistics capabilities.
  • Oversees warehouse process performance, inventory accuracy support, fulfillment reliability, logistics execution stability, and operational insights.
  • Partners with warehouse, distribution, supply chain, logistics, and regional operations stakeholders to improve process performance and adoption.
  • Governs incidents, problems, enhancements, and operational risks impacting warehouse execution, inventory movement, order fulfillment, and distribution operations.

Drives continuous improvement opportunities across EWM, IM, RF/mobile warehouse execution, integration touchpoints, and warehouse operations reporting.

Job Systems/Information Technology

job.title: Technical Training Instructor
job.description:
Job Summary

The Technical Training & Dealer Capability Development Specialist is responsible for supporting the design, development, and delivery of technical training programs that strengthen the capability of dealer service engineers and service network personnel. This role focuses on enhancing product knowledge, troubleshooting expertise, service quality, and customer handling skills while ensuring compliance with Cummins standards, safety requirements, and operational excellence. The position works closely with cross-functional teams and dealership partners to build a skilled service network that delivers exceptional customer support and business performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, coordinate, and deliver technical training programs for dealer service engineers and service personnel to improve product knowledge, troubleshooting capability, technical proficiency, and customer service skills.
  • Assist senior technical trainers in the preparation, delivery, and continuous improvement of classroom, virtual, and hands-on technical training programs.
  • Complete product qualification requirements and continuously develop expertise on Cummins products, systems, and technologies.
  • Update and maintain training materials, participant handouts, instructor guides, and training documentation to ensure accuracy and consistency across training centers.
  • Communicate training material updates and best practices to regional training teams and relevant stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Service, Sales, Technical Support, Engineering, and Dealer Development to align capability-building initiatives with organizational objectives.
  • Partner with dealerships to ensure the availability of qualified technical manpower and support workforce capability planning based on required skill sets.
  • Establish and implement structured technical training and certification programs to improve service engineer competency, repair quality, and troubleshooting effectiveness.
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning by promoting ongoing technical development, certifications, and participation in relevant learning programs.
  • Conduct regular audits of dealership service centers to evaluate repair quality, adherence to Cummins service processes, and compliance with operational standards.
  • Ensure dealership personnel follow Cummins safety requirements, standard operating procedures, compliance guidelines, calibration requirements, and proper usage of standard service tools.
  • Support training administration activities including maintaining training records, attendance, certifications, and learning documentation.
  • Coordinate training equipment, tools, and inventory to ensure effective execution of training programs.
  • Monitor training effectiveness and identify opportunities for continuous improvement in dealer capability development initiatives.
  • Build strong relationships with dealers, customers, and internal stakeholders to enhance service capability and customer satisfaction.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technical Education, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Additional technical certifications or training qualifications are advantageous.
  • Ability to obtain any licenses required for export control or regulatory compliance, where applicable.

Skills

  • Knowledge of technical training delivery methodologies and adult learning principles.
  • Strong understanding of technical service operations, dealer network management, and capability development.
  • Ability to develop and deliver engaging technical and customer service training programs.
  • Knowledge of troubleshooting techniques, service quality standards, and repair processes.
  • Familiarity with Cummins products, systems, and service procedures is preferred.
  • Excellent presentation, facilitation, and communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to assess training effectiveness and identify capability gaps.
  • Planning, organization, and project coordination skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and learning management systems.
  • Customer-focused approach with a commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Ability to adapt training delivery to different audiences and learning environments.
  • Strong commitment to health, safety, compliance, and quality standards.

Experience

  • Minimal to early-career experience in technical training, learning and development, field service, dealer support, or a related technical function.
  • Experience assisting with training preparation, delivery, or learning administration is preferred.
  • Exposure to dealer service operations, technical support, or customer service environments is advantageous.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and external partners is desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to build technical knowledge and support capability development initiatives through training and coaching.

job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

26 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Digital Producer

Job Summary

Job Description

As Digital Producer you will have an obsessive attention to detail that dots all the i's and crosses all the t’s, but rest assured most days at Belong won’t look the same! You will be responsible for maintaining, updating and building our web content, contributing to the development of our website at an impeccably high standard using strong expertise in accessibility, responsiveness and usability. This will be paired with a strong understanding of web and customer experience analytics, as well as the design and development of CMS (Content Management System), HTML/CSS, Information Architecture, site structure, individual page design and content creation.

As a member of the Content Experience team in the Digital team, you will support rapid growth, improve our speed to market, deliver data-driven, automated and customer centric experiences via our digital channels. You must have experience working in cross functional teams and be able to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously. Reporting to the Content Experience Manager, you will have a thorough understanding of the agile and scrum framework and HCD (Human Centred Design) approach.

You are a passionate and dedicated digital who wakes up every day wanting to create world class customer experiences developing delightful products and services that people absolutely love!

About the job

You will be responsible for:

  • Working in close collaboration with your Digital Content Experience Manager , the Content experience team and the delivery squads to deliver on our strategic customer and digital experience vision aligned to our business KPIs (Key Performance Indicators)
  • Planning, scheduling and managing the digital content from draft review to publishing using our Content Management System (CMS)
  • Gathering business requirements from stakeholders and translating to world-class digital solutions
  • Proactively monitoring and testing the site to identify maintenance and experience quality improvements
  • Working as a team; supporting, communicating and collaborating with other producers
  • Collaboratively working with other teams including design, technology and product to achieve a seamless digital customer experience
  • Prioritizing and triaging content requests from internal stakeholders
  • Continually refining and enhancing our CMS to maintain hygiene and best practice standards
  • Pushing your knowledge of industry best practice including website development, and CMS production

Skills and experience:**

  • Demonstrated professional experience in digital content publishing in a media corporate, business or agency setting
  • Ability to write, edit and proof-read quality written content
  • Strong editorial judgement
  • Ability to liaise with a variety of digital disciplines, from design to development
  • Challenge the norm with confident and assertive communication skills to influence and build relationships
  • Effectively able to manage changes to scope, budget and timeline
  • Knowledge of the WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines) 2.1 accessibility standards
  • Strong SEO understanding
  • Experience with Contentful would be advantageous
  • Exposure to or experience with Design Systems and regard for implementation of visual identity of brand guidelines
  • Ability to brief relevant supporting functions, such as Content Writers and Designers, in a clear and concise manner
  • Provide Quality Assurance (QA) of the solution in testing environments to ensure our design quality and customer experience expectations are met
  • Customer-first mindset!

We’re flexible

We’re all about flexibility and choice at work. Will you choose to work from home, in our office workspace, or on the go? Somewhere regional or the city? We want you to work where, when, and how you're most engaged, safe, and productive – wherever in Australia that may be.

About Belong

It feels good to bring people together.

As a telco, we’re making our world a more inclusive place. That means giving Australians the tools they need to get things done in the digital world. Oh, and we’re doing that while being 100% carbon neutral.

As an organisation, we're focused on having a customer-first mindset and delivering effortless customer experiences.

As a workplace, we’re building a community of people who bring their whole selves to work. Workplaces can be brutally bland and that’s not good for anyone. Difference makes us all better and we’re always trying to get better.

Our values

We’re here to make our world a more inclusive place. That’s reflected in our four values:

  • We care
  • We’re better together
  • We make it simple
  • We’re change makers

They help remind us that we care about the work we do and that, if we do it together, we can make our world a better place for our team and our customers.

_______

We want our people to represent the customers we serve and encourage anyone with diverse experiences and unique perspectives to apply.

Get to know what life at [Belong is like and what we value](https://www.linkedin.com/company/belong.com.au/life/).

job.title: Superintendent, HSSEQ
job.description:
Job Summary

To provide proactive HSSEQ leadership and operational assurance for a defined segment of the marine fleet. The Superintendent acts as the critical link between the Head HSSEQ and vessel-level HSSEQ Managers, ensuring consistent implementation of the Integrated Management System (IMS) across all assigned vessels, driving performance improvement, and ensuring full compliance with ISM, ISPS, MLC, MARPOL, ISO 45001, 14001, and 9001.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic & Operational Oversight (Segment Level)

  • Segment Performance Ownership: Accountable for all HSSEQ KPIs (TRIR, LTIF, near-miss reporting rate, audit closure rates, environmental incidents) across assigned fleet segment.
  • Risk Profiling: Maintain a live risk register for the segment (geographic, operational, asset-specific) – e.g., heavy weather routes, piracy-prone areas, client-specific HSSE requirements.
  • Fleet Assurance Schedule: Plan and execute a rolling program of announced and unannounced vessel visits, safety inspections, ISM internal audits, and ISPS security assessments (minimum 1 visit per vessel per 6 months).

Management of Offshore HSSEQ Managers & Vessel Leadership

  • Direct Support & Coaching: Provide technical guidance and performance feedback to Offshore HSSEQ PIC and Masters regarding incident investigation, PTW audits, safety culture interventions, and client HSSE interface.
  • Competency Assurance: Verify that all offshore HSSEQ PIC and vessel safety officers meet segment-specific competency requirements (e.g., DP familiarization, heavy-lift, anchor handling safety).
  • Succession Planning: Identify high-potential offshore HSSE talent for promotion within the segment.

Incident Management & Investigation (Segment Level)

  • Lead or escalate high-potential (HiPo) incidents, LTI, and major environmental breaches across the segment, ensuring consistent use of investigation methodology (e,g. TapRooT / 5-Why).
  • Review all incident reports from vessels before submission to the Head HSSEQ – ensure root causes and systemic corrective actions are identified.
  • Track corrective action closure rates across the segment and escalate overdue actions.

Client & Third-Party Interface (Segment-Specific)

  • Act as the primary HSSEQ point of contact for client HSSE teams within the segment (e.g., major oil companies, NOCs).
  • Lead client pre-qualification and tender responses for HSSE sections – present segment performance data during client audits.
  • Coordinate joint safety campaigns and client-led verification visits on assigned vessels

Compliance & Assurance (ISM / ISPS / MLC)

  • Serve as alternate or designated DPA (Designated Person Ashore) for vessels within the segment (if qualified under ISM Code).
  • Monitor certificate validity (Class, Flag, Oil Major COCs, DOC extension) and advise vessels on upcoming surveys.
  • Oversee external audit readiness (Flag state, Class, Oil Major, ISO) – pre-audit vessels and debrief findings.

Environmental & Quality Performance

  • Monitor segment-level environmental metrics – carbon intensity (CII), oil-in-water exceedances, garbage segregation deviations, NOx/SOx compliance.
  • Drive ISO 14001 segment objectives (e.g., reduction in single-use plastics, improved fuel efficiency measures).
  • Review customer satisfaction feedback (quality angle) and identify systemic non-conformities across the segment.

REPORTING & ANALYTICS (Segment Dashboard)

  • Weekly: Highlight report to Head HSSEQ – significant incidents, outstanding audits, permit deviations.
  • Monthly: Segment HSSEQ Dashboard (leading/lagging, trend analysis, vessel ranking by safety observation rate).
  • Quarterly: Segment Management Review input – resource gaps, training needs, risk profile changes.
  • Ad Hoc: Root cause analysis summaries for any Tier 1 or Tier 2 process safety events (per IOGP).

Key Requirements

  • A degree in Nautical Studies, Engineering or any relevant degree.
  • COC Class 1 Master/Engineer
  • Candidates should ideally have at least 10 years of experience in operations or HSE & Quality

Certifications

job.title: Supervisor (Electrical)
job.description:
Job Summary

Plan and execute (Manpower planning, Cost control, Attend Vessel Issue, Technical issue, achieve department target & KPI) and collaborate with supervisor and foreman for job execution.

Key Responsibilities

.

  • Read and understand technical specifications, prepare job-list, work schedule, plan material take off and manpower planning of yard men and contractor for each given jobs. Report department head and update any special contractor (Vendor/Maker) requirements
  • Order the material required as per material take off and co-ordinate with purchase department for timely delivery of the materials
  • During job execution, supervise and provide technical solution to electricians.
  • Ensure safety, discipline and welfare for all subordinates.
  • Collaborate with ship crews and ETO to ensure that trade work carries out as per specifications and to the satisfaction of the owner/class & timely completion. Ensure good quality work and perfect safety. Ensure that owner acknowledged on AWRF for all additional works.
  • Collaborate with engineering department for design and engineering requirement as and when required.
  • Ensure that all trade work modification works are recorded with mark-up / red-line drawings to be made and approved by owner’s representative.
  • Always maintain good housekeeping and Safety on board vessel & workshop. Ensure that all workers always follow safe work procedures
  • Ensure that minimum wastage of materials and balance material to be accounted and returned to store at the end of the project.
  • Prepare, setup and review department documents (RA, SOP, Internal & External auditing, OR) with line managers.
  • Ensure all work completion reports are done by Ship in-charge (foreman/supervisor), verify & submit to owner Rep to get sign before handing over to commercial department on time (before vessel delivery).
  • Monitoring vessel daily job deployment report to achieve target on time.
  • Independent capable of tracing, identify and troubleshoot E&I related faults onboard vessels such as Generators, Sensors and Instruments and DP2 system.
  • Perform other related jobs as assigned by DH.
  • Ensure Permit to work system is followed strictly.

Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Electrical Engineering & Electronics

job.title: Principal Engineer/Assistant Manager/Manager, Project (Electrical)
job.description:
Job Summary

Purpose of the Role:

Due to K2's expansion, APAC technical and delivery team is looking to hire an Assistant Project Manager (Electrical) to support external design team management and design review work. This person will be working closely with SG HQ based PM to handle the daily design related issues for existing and future projects in APAC region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist Project Manager or Site Delivery Manager in data centre design and construction phases for site management and construction quality control.
  • Monitor construction activities closely on a regular basis and ensure the data centre facility is built to group's standard.
  • Responsible for the review and approval of design consultant’s work to ensure design documents are sufficiently developed with all necessary engineering calculations in place.
  • Responsible for communicating with design consultants to ensure all required deliverables are achieved.
  • Responsible for maintaining K2 internal engineering standard with particular focus on HVAC and plumbing systems.
  • Support project commissioning and final handover activities.
  • Support of K2 internal engineering design and development activities.
  • Establish engineering and operation procedures following K2 standard.

Working environment entails

  • Walking job sites which have areas of uneven terrain.
  • Work at heights.
  • Work in a noisy environment.
  • Work in confined spaces.
  • Work environment applicable to operation team
  • Regularly lift and/or move items and participate in group lifts.
  • Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration.
  • Co-ordinate body movements when using tools or equipment.
  • May require bending or twisting the body to access equipment while working.
  • Involves performing physical tasks all day.
  • Use hands to manipulate small wires and objects.
  • Push or pull objects into position.

Key Requirements

  • 6 years’ minimum working experience in building services design and construction project delivery (data centre projects preferred).
  • Bachelor’s in Electrical or Building Services Engineering
  • Chartered Engineer preferred
  • Relevant Uptime/TIA certificates preferred
  • Good knowledge in Electrical HV/LV distribution Engineering with a good understanding on data centre project and protection study
  • Proficiency in MS Office (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc) with experience in Mechanical HVAC software, such as IES.
  • Good command of written and spoken English is required. Additional language skills such as Chinese and/or Bahasa Indonesia/Malaysia will be preferred.
  • Candidates who are active, initiative, conscientious, sociable, flexible and optimistic.

Interpersonal Requirements

  • Committed to the delivery of excellent customer service.
  • Calm Manner, able to work under pressure.
  • Self-motivated, ability to work on own initiative.
  • Punctual and reliable.
  • Good attention to detail.

Education

Bachelors in Electrical Engineering or Electrical Engineering & Electronics

job.title: Senior Manager, Project Cost Control
job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Manager, Project Cost Control, will develop, implement, and maintain the project cost control framework and management reporting for post-award selected newbuild projects in Zhoushan. This role will also ensure the timely, accurate, and complete reporting of project revenue, costs, forecasts, and financial performance to support effective project management and decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take over post-award contracts, tender documents, and bid estimates from the Commercial team to establish the project Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and develop the project as-sold budget as the baseline for project cost control.
  • Set up client revenue reporting, where required under the contract, in collaboration with the Commercial team.
  • Monitor and update actual costs incurred, work performed and committed costs on a monthly basis using the ERP system, and perform detailed cost analysis.
  • Verify that costs are correctly allocated in accordance with the WBS and ensure that actual costs and budgets are measured and reported consistently at the same WBS level.
  • Identify cost variances, analyse their causes, forecast the Estimate at Completion (EAC), and report financial performance and cost trends.
  • Establish and maintain registers for change orders, invoices, budget transfers, and cost trends, and prepare the necessary supporting documentation.
  • Identify, quantify, monitor, and develop mitigation or action plans for project risks and opportunities.
  • Prepare the Monthly Project Status Report (PMSR), detailed project cost reports, cost phasing, and other project financial analyses.
  • Conduct monthly project cost reviews to identify cost optimization opportunities and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Work closely with Commercial, Engineering, Project Management, Finance,Procurement, and Subcontract teams to ensure alignment on project cost control objectives and financial performance.
  • Promote cost awareness, financial discipline, and best practices across the project team.
  • Prepare ad hoc financial and project performance reports as required by Senior Management.
  • Participate in the implementation and continuous improvement of ERP systems and other project management tools and processes.
  • Provide guidance, coaching, and mentorship to Project Cost Control personnel in the Zhoushan Yard.
  • Undertake regular business travel (expected once a quarter) to support project execution and stakeholder engagement.

Key Requirements

  • Degree Holder in Engineering or Science with exposure in maritime industry.
  • 15 years relevant working experience.
  • Proficiency in project cost control management with strong reporting and effective communication skills
  • Microsoft Office (Advanced in MS Excel, Intermediate to Advanced Word and PowerPoint) and ERP system (like SAP, Oracle etc.)
  • Good analytical skill with the ability to interpret complex data and make sound recommendation.
  • Attention to detail, accuracy, and a commitment to meeting deadlines and objectives.
  • Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Education

Bachelors in Engineering or Science

job.title: Applied AI Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

The Applied AI Engineer supports POSH's AI programme by contributing to the delivery of prioritised use cases — assisting in the development of AI agents and solutions built on the Group's enterprise AI platform. This person will develop hands-on experience across the full AI delivery lifecycle: from translating business requirements into working prototypes, to deployment and user adoption support.

This is not a purely technical role. Equal weight is placed on business engagement, user adoption, and solution delivery as on technical execution. Prior domain knowledge is not a requirement for this role. This person is expected to spend time with the various functional and operational teams in POSH — understanding how the business works, what problems matter, and what good looks like in practice — and to bring that understanding back into everything they build.

Key Responsibilities

Use Case Delivery & Business Engagement

**

  • Work with POSH business functions to understand operational workflows, identify AI opportunities, and validate that proposed solutions address the right problems.
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications and working prototypes.
  • Facilitate structured user acceptance testing sessions with operational teams. Presenting solutions, capturing feedback, and documenting gaps for iteration
  • Manage expectations proactively on timelines, data dependencies, and scope.
  • Develop HITL review interfaces and feedback mechanisms in close collaboration with domain experts.
  • Support the handover of deployed solutions to operational owners with documentation, user guides, and structured walkthroughs.

Data & System Integration

  • Assess data quality, validate schemas, and surface integration issues with the Business Excellence Team and data owners.
  • Integrate AI solutions with POSH's / Group’s enterprise systems using the integration standards and infrastructure.
  • Flag aspirational data assumptions and system-dependent dependencies early for programme-level decision

AI Agent Development

  • Configure and deploy AI agents on the enterprise platform — applying agentic design patterns including multi-agent architectures, tool-use, and autonomous workflow execution.
  • Build and maintain RAG pipelines for POSH-specific knowledge bases: ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector indexing, and retrieval optimisation.
  • Implement LLM integration — prompt engineering, structured output design, and iterative refinement for operational and regulatory quality standards
  • Build document processing components: OCR pipeline integration, multimodal content extraction and pre-processing for AI consumption.
  • Document and escalate platform gaps or POSH-specific requirements for COE review.

Testing, Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement

  • Assist in developing and maintaining AI evaluation frameworks for POSH use cases: accuracy benchmarking, hallucination detection, retrieval quality scoring, and regression testing across model updates.
  • Conduct structured testing of agent behaviour before any production deployment, including edge cases, adversarial inputs, and failure mode analysis
  • Monitor deployed solutions; escalate anomalies promptly and support resolution with clear documentation.
  • Collaborate with the Group Data & Automation COE on platform standards and technical governance.
  • Document all agents, configurations, data schemas, and integration points to enterprise standards.

Key Requirements

Experience

  • 1-2 years of software engineering or data/AI engineering experience – including exposure to LLM-based development in any context. Internships, research attachments, and early-career roles are all considered.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one AI or ML project from concept to working output. Production deployment is advantageous but not required
  • Some experience, or a demonstrated interest in, working with non-technical users: explaining technical concepts in plain language, gathering requirements, or presenting findings.
  • Final-year graduates with strong AI project portfolios are encouraged to apply.

Essential Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Python for AI/ML pipeline development and data processing.
  • Working knowledge of LLM-based application development: RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and structured output handling.
  • Familiarity with agentic AI design patterns and orchestration frameworks – multi-agent architectures, tool-use, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
  • Exposure to cloud-native development (Microsoft Azure preferred) and vector databases
  • Good understanding of document processing pipelines — OCR, PDF/image extraction, chunking strategies, and multimodal content handling.
  • Basic understanding of API design (REST/ async) and microservices integration.

**

Advantageous — Domain & Industry Knowledge

  • Familiarity with maritime, offshore, or similarly regulated, asset-heavy industries.
  • Exposure to compliance-driven environments where audit trails and regulatory alignment are operational necessities.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint / Microsoft 365, SAP, or equivalent enterprise platforms.

Personal Attributes

  • Curiosity: Genuinely interested in how operations work and how AI can improve them — not just in the technology itself.
  • Structured thinking: Manages concurrent tasks, communicates priorities clearly, and keeps stakeholders informed.
  • Credibility with users: Communicates clearly without jargon. Earns trust through listening and delivering solutions that fit how people actually work.
  • Ownership mindset: Takes initiative, follows through, raises blockers early — and knows when to escalate rather than proceed alone.
  • Comfort with ambiguity: Makes sound technical decisions when requirements are evolving. Moves forward pragmatically and documents assumptions.
  • Engineering rigour: Builds things others can understand, maintain, and build on. Takes documentation and testing seriously.

Job Summary

This role supports the preparation of competitive and commercially sound proposals for shipyard, offshore, marine, and module construction projects.

You will work closely with engineering, procurement, operations, finance, and other internal stakeholders to understand project requirements, develop cost estimates, and prepare tender submissions.

The position is suitable for both early-career candidates and experienced professionals. While relevant experience is beneficial, we place strong emphasis on analytical thinking, attention to detail, openness to new ideas, and a willingness to learn.

Key Responsibilities

job.title: Engineer, Quality Systems
job.description:
Job Summary

This role ensures ISO 9001:2015 compliance by maintaining and improving the QMS, managing audits, training staff, analysing quality data, and addressing nonconformities. It includes overseeing KPIs, customer satisfaction, subcontractor performance, and continuous improvement initiatives while collaborating across departments to adapt the QMS to business needs and drive operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support the maintenance of ISO 9001:2015 certification by ensuring full compliance with applicable standards, corporate requirements, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS).
  • Develop, review, update, and continuously improve QMS documents to ensure alignment with ISO 9001 requirements, best practices, and group-wide standardization across sister yards.
  • Manage the nonconformity reporting process, ensuring root cause analysis is conducted, corrective actions are implemented effectively, and closure is achieved within the defined timeframe.
  • Conduct QMS induction briefings for new employees and deliver quality-related training programs to enhance employee awareness, competency, and compliance with QMS requirements.
  • Prepare Management Review presentation materials, perform data analysis on quality performance indicators, and prepare meeting minutes. Follow up on action items and ensure timely closure with clear accountability.
  • Prepare and analyse monthly QS reports, identify key quality trends and recurring issues, and coordinate with relevant departments to implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage departmental KPI reporting, verify performance data accuracy, analyse trends, and follow up with departments to ensure performance targets are achieved and improvement actions are implemented.
  • Monitor Customer Satisfaction Questionnaire (CSQ) results, analyse feedback, identify improvement opportunities, and coordinate corrective actions to enhance customer satisfaction.
  • Oversee in-house calibration records and ensure measuring and test equipment (e.g., micrometres, pressure gauges) are properly calibrated, maintained, and compliant with calibration schedules and requirements.
  • Conduct subcontractor and supplier qualification audits, evaluate performance, and monitor ongoing compliance with quality requirements.
  • Collaborate with departments to identify, review, and update risks, opportunities, and interested party requirements to ensure the QMS remains effective and aligned with business objectives.
  • Actively participate in and support continuous improvement initiatives, quality improvement projects, and operational excellence programs.
  • Perform any other duties, as assigned by superior.

Key Requirements

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in Quality Management System (QMS), preferably in the maritime or engineering industry.
  • Experience in developing and maintaining procedures and work instructions.
  • Experience in conducting internal quality audits and follow-up on corrective actions.
  • Experience in root cause analysis, CAPA, and nonconformity management.
  • Experience in data analysis and identifying improvement opportunities.
  • Experience in continuous improvement activities.

Education

Bachelors in Engineering or Industrial and System Engineering

job.title: Lead Engineer
job.description:
POSH is looking for Lead Engineers to manage and execute the SURF (Subsea Riser Umbilical and Flowline) and diving construction scopes on a project.

The role reports directly to the Project Package Manager on a specific project and works closely with other members of the Project Management Team (PMT) on a day to day basis, such as Engineering Manager, Project Operations Manager, HSE and Quality Managers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinating with other departments and teams to ensure that SURF/Diving package activities are properly integrated into the overall project plan.
  • Provides specialist skills, integrity, and knowledge in key areas of discipline engineering, including design codes, legislative requirements and current good engineering practice.
  • Understands clients' needs; identifies and addresses design parameters and problems; develops and implements solutions.
  • Ensures project and HS&E compliance and adherence to project budget & schedule.
  • Under own supervision, independently evaluates, organises and prioritises work.
  • Undertakes responsibility for production of installation deliverables, which may include engineering support to the Drawing Office, installation procedures, technical bid evaluations, study reports and various 3rd-party submissions.
  • Signs and issues technical documentation as originator or checker, accepting personal responsibility for its adequacy.
  • Ensures all relevant safety objectives and legal requirements are observed.
  • Developing and managing procurement strategies and plans to ensure that equipment and materials are delivered on time and within budget.
  • Coordinating with suppliers and vendors to ensure that equipment and materials are manufactured, tested, and delivered to the required quality standards.
  • Coordinating with offshore installation teams to ensure that the SURF package is installed and commissioned according to the project schedule and quality standards.
  • Providing technical advice and guidance to senior management and other stakeholders.
  • Providing technical guidance and support to the team of engineers and technical professionals working on the package. Trains / mentors more junior engineers.
  • May manage a team of engineers on a project or within a discipline
  • Manage interfaces within a project structure, including other disciplines, drawing office, document control, project management, client and suppliers.
  • Manage change control within own remit on a project. Inform team members where constraints will affect a project in terms of programme or budget.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related field
  • At least 10-15 years of experience in SURF/Diving Installation operations
  • Relevant experience working on previous EPCI or T&I offshore construction projects is preferred
  • Previous track record of working on Saudi Aramco LTA Projects of similar scopes is an advantage
  • Knowledge: Must have a good understanding of SURF Installation operations including various lay spreads (horizontal lay for flexibles and umbilicals / basket carousel for cable lay), lay techniques and procedures, as well as relevant installation regulations and standards. Knowledge of project management principles and practices is also required.
  • Knowledge: Must have a good understanding of diving operations including DSV and diving spreads, diving techniques, and procedures, as well as relevant diving regulations and standards. Knowledge of project management principles and practices is also required.
  • Skills: Must possess strong leadership, communication and problem-solving skills. Must be able to work under pressure and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to lead and function within a design team and across multiple projects.
  • Ability to prioritise own and others’ workload, manage time accordingly and inform team members where constraints will affect a project in terms of programme or budget.
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders
  • Fluent in English

job.title: Assistant Manager, Learning & Development
job.description:
Job Summary

The Assistant Manager, Learning & Development is responsible for supporting the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of learning and development initiatives across PaxOcean Group. The role partners with business leaders and stakeholders to identify training needs, develop learning solutions, enhance workforce capabilities, and foster a culture of continuous learning. This position also supports talent development programmes, competency framework initiatives, and training effectiveness measurement to ensure employees are equipped with the skills required to meet current and future business needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development and implementation of learning and development strategies that align with organisational goals and business priorities.
  • Conduct training needs analyses in collaboration with business units and key stakeholders to identify capability gaps and learning opportunities.
  • Coordinate and administer learning programmes, workshops, leadership development initiatives, and employee development interventions.
  • Support the development, maintenance, and implementation of competency frameworks across various functions and employee groups.
  • Assist in the management and execution of graduate, management trainee, and talent development programmes to support employee growth and succession planning initiatives.
  • Curate, source, and recommend internal and external training programmes that address organisational and employee development needs.
  • Monitor training participation, learning outcomes, and programme effectiveness through feedback, assessments, and data analysis.
  • Prepare training reports, dashboards, and insights to support data-driven learning and talent decisions.
  • Work closely with HR and business stakeholders to promote a culture of continuous learning and professional development.
  • Ensure proper administration of learning records, training databases, budgets, and vendor partnerships where applicable.

Key Requirements

  • Minimum 4–6 years of relevant experience in Learning & Development, Talent Development, Training, or related HR functions.
  • Experience in conducting training needs analyses and coordinating employee development programmes.
  • Familiarity with competency frameworks, learning management systems (LMS), and adult learning methodologies.
  • Ability to analyse learning data, identify trends, and recommend improvements based on insights.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively with employees and leaders across different levels of the organisation.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and results-driven with a continuous improvement mindset.
  • High level of professionalism, integrity, and credibility.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.

Education

Bachelors in Human Resources or Organization Development

job.title: Manager, Technology Solutions
job.description:
Job Summary

The IT Manager is an influential IT Application Owner responsible for delivering IT support operation excellence, continuous improvement, and strong application project delivery. This role emphasises delivering high-quality outcomes, bringing in emerging technologies — including AI and advanced analytics and delivering measurable business value while fostering sustainable growth. Ideal for a motivated individual passionate about driving digital transformation, deploying AI solutions, and delivering excellence in a complex, multi-site maritime and industrial environment.

Key Responsibilities

Application Ownership:

  • End-to-End Management: Serve as the IT owner for designated software applications, managing the full lifecycle including implementation, updates, support & maintenance, and decommissioning. IT owner also to ensure the application continues to meet business needs and performance standards.
  • System Stability and Performance Monitoring: Ensure quality support meeting SLA. Oversee the performance of applications, ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement to meet evolving business needs.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the primary point of contact between IT and business stakeholders, ensuring alignment between the organization's objectives and the application's capabilities. Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors, ensuring optimal service delivery, ongoing support, and contract management. Work collaboratively across IT team to ensure seamless data flow and interoperability across systems.
  • Governance & Compliance: Ensure that applications comply with internal policies, industry standards, and legal regulations. Maintain security best practices and manage risks. Oversee VAPT exercises, vulnerability remediation, and security hardening for Application and Hosting environment.
  • Requirements Gathering: Lead the process of gathering business and technical requirements for enhancements or new software solutions, working closely with cross-functional teams to define project scope.

Application Landscape Management & Modernisation

  • Define, Design, Document and continuous modernization of application architecture landscape in partnership with SaaS providers and Developer Partners for bespoke Applications. Drive migration from legacy monoliths toward modern, cloud-native, microservices-based architectures with API and Agentic AI MCP readiness
  • Own availability and disaster recovery (DR) planning for critical applications; test and validate RTO/RPO targets.
  • Access cloud and hybrid deployment models to evaluate fit for applications under management. Assess data sovereignty, cost, and risk trade-offs when recommending hosting options

AI Adoption & Automation

  • Define and execute an AI adoption roadmap for the application support function, identifying high-value use cases for automation, augmentation, and intelligence.
  • Champion the integration of AI/ML-driven observability, AIOps tooling, and intelligent alerting to reduce noise and accelerate diagnostics.
  • Drive a shift-left culture — moving reactive break-fix toward proactive monitoring, self-healing automation, and knowledge management

Key Requirements

  • At least 5-7 years of experience in application management, with a proven track record of performing Support and Project implementations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science.
  • PMP, ITIL or equivalent certifications is an advantage.
  • Cloud or AI certifications (AWS, Azure, Salesforce AI Specialist) are advantageous.
  • Experience with Applications used by maritime related industry is advantageous.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based applications, SaaS solutions, and modern IT architecture.
  • Candidates must possess technical acumen and the ability to develop solutions
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess system performance and implement improvements.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities and changing requirements.

Responsible in preparation of all commercial aspects of Onshore and Offshore Modules Construction Projects tendering, which includes but not limited to Costing, Pricing, Tender Proposal and Prequalification, by coordinating with all relevant departments to collate the correct inputs necessary to prepare a compelling commercial and technical tender proposal for submission, with primary objective to achieve successful project awards.

Key Responsibilities

Project Prequalification

  • Review Pre-qualifications documentation requirements and deliverables received from customers.
  • Work with all relevant departments in the Company to collate the necessary supporting documents for Prequalification.
  • Prepare client’s prequalification questionnaire and supporting documents for submission.
  • Review the Prequalification response with AGM Commercial and Senior Management.
  • Submit deliverable either via client’s portal or email.
  • Monitor and ensure various deadlines by customer are strictly adhered to.

Project Tendering

  • Compile and review customer enquiries, tenders and/ or RFQs and provide a scope summary to Paxocean Management to review for bid decision.
  • Check sanction risk from company portal and credit risk of client company from company Risk and Compliance Team.
  • When bid decision is to proceed, determine the required tender deliverables and coordinate and work will all relevant departments to collate tender inputs for proposal preparations.
  • Review the technical specifications/ requirements/ engineering drawings and prepare commercial proposal/ bid for submission through coordination with various stakeholder in the yard. Collate all clarifications and send to client and follow up for response and advise.
  • Compile all inputs from relevant departments for submission based on client’s requirement on tender deliverable

Tender Costing & Pricing

  • Monitor and ensure various deadlines by customer are strictly adhered to.
  • Prepare costing and pricing using the established excel templates with supporting suppliers and subcontractor cost for substantiation.
  • Prepare tender qualifications and exceptions in accordance with the basis of the costing estimates.
  • Collate all material cost received from suppliers and labour cost from subcontractors in the respective disciplines folders, for further reference, price revalidations and project handover after tender award.
  • Review the commercial and tender proposal with AGM commercial when the preparation is completed and incorporate all comments received from AGM Commercial after the review.

Prior Submission and Post Submission

  • Invite Senior Management for Tender review to get approval for tender submission.
  • Upon approval for submission, prepare the clean copy of commercial and technical tender proposal, including cover letter for submission.
  • Follow up with Clients for tender status and feedback on the submitted proposal. Response to all clients clarifications.
  • Upon project award, prepare presentation highlighting scope of work, technical, commercial and contractual information of the project for commercial handover meeting.

Post Project Award

  • Maintain and cultivate good relationship with existing and potential associates/customers through regular communication.
  • Provide advice to Project Managers on any potential variation orders.
  • Compile all inputs from relevant departments for submission based on client’s requirement on tender deliverables.

Key Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Engineering from reputable institution.
  • At least 5-8 years of relevant industry experience including a minimum of 3 years in commercial roles and in addition, preferably also with experience in technical or commercial aspects in FPSO projects or module construction and project management.
  • Able to read, interpret and prepare applicable technical / commercial information including proposal, Engineering Drawings and suggest process changes to ensure functional and cost-effective results.

Education

Bachelors in Engineering

job.title: Senior Executive, Cost & Contract
job.description:

We are the specialists in providing critical digital infrastructure in the form of Data Centre environments to leading technology companies, we lay the physical foundations of the internet, cloud services and tomorrow's digital solutions, today.

With a proven track record operating to world leading service levels, we pride ourselves in being technically focused long term partners, providing our customers peace of mind when investing in significant physical network, storage and computing resources that provide the digital solutions to millions of users around the world everyday.

We seek to hire the best talent in the industry, who has the passion and motivation to join the growing team in K2.

job.title: Data Centre Solutions Architect (Design Manager/Senior Manager)
job.description:
Job Description

[ Apply now ](/talentcommunity/apply/355/?locale=en_GB)

Data Centre Solutions Architect (Design Manager/Senior Manager)

Posting Start Date:

18/12/2025

Country/Region:

Singapore

Work Location:

Singapore Great World City

Business/Function:

K2

Req ID:

355

Job Summary

The Data Centre Solutions Architect (Design Manager/Senior Design Manager) will be responsible for design and innovation, market research, evaluating, and implementing the newly technical solutions to optimize K2 future data centre’s infrastructure with high efficiency, and performance. This role plays a critical part in ensuring K2 always advanced and prepared to fulfil the quick change and demand of the global data centre requirements, ensure technical excellent, stand operational, sustainability, and scalability goals while aligning with industry best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Design, Innovation & Technical Solutions

  • Conduct market research to identify new ideas and technologies that can be used to develop a comprehensive K2 data centre design solution, including layout planning, power distribution, cutting-edge high-density cooling systems, critical control/monitoring infrastructure with different construction methods.
  • Ensure all K2 newly developed design solutions adhere to customer requirements, Uptime Institute’s Tier standards, ASHRAE thermal guidelines and relevant industry best practices.
  • Participate in the development of new MEP design and construction concepts, produce K2 data centre design libraries, and system specifications.
  • Lead and manage design and innovation projects, influence K2 technical design decision-making. Efficiently handle technical problems with demonstrate creativity in solutions.
  • Assisting customer RFP support, developing new ideas on MEP design to meet the new AI ready data centre on performance, operation and quality requirements.
  • Recommend and integrate advanced solutions to improve energy efficiency, reduce carbon footprint, and enhance facility performance and availability.
  • Works closely with internal teams as well as collaborating with external vendors to perform and support design and development activities.
  • Conduct feasibility studies on new MEP technology on the market, support technical due diligence for the new supply chain and manufacture data centre products.
  • Perform on going technology market research on Liquid Cooling on high density Data Centres. Develop a design scheme to how power delivery can be provided in a small footprint.
  • Design, develop the system prototypes of data centre solution with vendors to ensure the newly developed solution meets the specifications and K2 engineering requirements.
  • Writing white paper, producing reports and documentation. Participating in technical meetings, seminars and conferences.

Infrastructure Design Optimization

  • Evaluate and implement newly developed design and product solutions to optimize data centre power usage effectiveness (PUE) and water usage effectiveness (WUE).
  • Assess and improve construction methods, cooling design, rack layout, and power distribution for maximum construction, commissioning and operation efficiency.
  • Develop TCO strategies to improve equipment lifecycle management and reduce maintenance costs.

Management & Implementation

  • Lead design development and innovation, support technical discussions and provide guidance to project delivery teams during construction, commissioning, and handover stages.
  • Ensure proper documentation of design specifications, drawings, equipment details, and solution implementation processes.
  • Conduct risk assessments and ensure designs support redundancy and resilience for critical systems.
  • Implement vendor-agnostic procurement strategies / process with a multi-vendor design template for each MEP system.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Collaborate with internal teams, including Delivery, Operations, Facilities and IT to align the newly developed technical solutions with business needs.
  • Engage with suppliers and contractors to ensure solution/equipment developed fully aligns with K2 technical vision and design requirements.
  • Develop a geopolitical risk register to guide equipment selection and procurement strategies by customer type and region.

Compliance & Sustainability

  • Ensure all newly developed designs and solutions comply with local regulations, industry standards and company policies.
  • Integrate sustainable design practices including renewable energy solutions, heat recovery systems and carbon footprint reduction initiatives.

Key Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, data centre engineering, or related fields.
  • Certifications such as CDCP (Certified Data Centre Professional), DCD (Data Centre Design), or Uptime Institute Accredited Tier Designer are highly desirable.
  • Minimum 5–8 years of experience in data centre design, solutions architecture, or infrastructure engineering.
  • Sound technical knowledge and proven experience in delivering high-density data centres, colocation facilities, or hyperscale environments.
  • Strong understanding and technical background in electrical power or cooling system, excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with others.
  • Keen interest in construction industry and M&E infrastructure development
  • Demonstrate technical rigor and creativity, continuous learning and improvement, alignment to fast changing data centre industry needs.
  • Solid problem-solving skills and excellent understanding of data centre MEP system interface requirements.
  • Proficient in design software such as AutoCAD, Revit, or BIM (Building Information Modelling).
  • Ability to work autonomously with minimal supervision, including time management and prioritisation.
  • Ability to analyse and resolve complex technical issues at a basic principle level, collaborating across multiple disciplines of DC application.
  • Flexible approach to working in a small design and innovation team, requiring a hands-on approach to getting things done.
  • Familiarity with industry standards such as TIA-942, ISO 27001, and ASHRAE guidelines.

Education

Bachelors in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering

job.title: Mobile & Full Stack Application Development Analyst
job.description:
Job Summary

We are an established property and retail organisation managing a portfolio of shopping destinations. Our loyalty programme connects members with participating malls and tenants through a mobile application that supports rewards points and other digital services.

The Loyalty team works closely with marketing teams and technology vendors to enhance the member experience and deliver new digital capabilities. We are looking for a Mobile & Full Stack Application Developer who can take ownership of the application’s technical design, development, testing and deployment across both iOS and Android platforms, as well as contributing to backend services, APIs and web-facing components that power our loyalty ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactively analyse and clarify business requirements with the team, and technical requirements with internal and external system owners.
  • Work closely with relevant system owners to support application integration, investigate and troubleshoot production issues across interconnected systems in a timely manner.
  • Take ownership of translating business requirements into user journeys and technical designs for the loyalty programme’s iOS and Android applications, from development, integration, testing to release.
  • Be accountable for the complete testing lifecycle, including preparation of test scenarios and test cases, SIT, regression testing, UAT coordination, defect resolution and production release readiness.
  • Plan quarterly application releases, including submission and deployment through the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
  • Monitor and optimise application performance, reliability, responsiveness and user experience.
  • Apply mobile and full stack development best practices relating to coding standards, security, maintainability, version control and release management, covering both client-side and server-side components.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date technical documentation, including system designs, integration specifications, deployment procedures and operational support guides.
  • Use artificial intelligence tools to improve development productivity and automate the generation and execution of test cases for regression and enhancement testing.
  • Liaise with backend API vendors and third-party service providers to review integration specifications, validate API contracts, and ensure backend services reliably support mobile application features, loyalty transactions and member data management.
  • Collaborate on web portal or admin dashboard development where applicable, leveraging frontend frameworks such as React or Vue.js alongside backend technologies (Node.js, Python, or equivalent).
  • Ensure data consistency and integrity across mobile, web and backend layers, applying best practices in database design, caching and API versioning.

Key Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in end-to-end mobile and full stack application development. Candidates must demonstrate experience across BOTH iOS and Android mobile platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in React Native or other hybrid mobile development frameworks.
  • Proficiency in full stack development, including backend frameworks (e.g. Node.js, Python/Django, Java Spring Boot) and relational or NoSQL databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB).
  • Prior experience working in or building digital solutions for hospitality, loyalty programmes, retail, or consumer lifestyle industries is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) and containerisation tools (Docker, Kubernetes) is an advantage.
  • Experience integrating mobile applications with APIs, backend platforms and third-party systems through conducting technical design, development, SIT and production support.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication, data privacy and secure API integration.
  • Experience with source-code management, automated build pipelines and mobile application release processes.
  • Familiarity with Apple and Google Play Store submission, review and deployment processes.
  • Had experience using artificial intelligence tools to generate, automate or maintain test cases for regression and enhancement testing.
  • Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies is a plus.
  • Able to proactively host collaboration meetings independently with various stakeholders
  • Strong sense of accountability for application quality, stability and successful delivery.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

job.title: Commissioning Specialist
job.description:
Job Summary

The Commissioning Specialist is responsible for supporting and executing commissioning activities across multiple projects, ensuring systems and equipment are installed, tested, and operating in accordance with design requirements, project specifications, and applicable standards. The role supports the Commissioning Manager in delivering projects safely, efficiently, and on schedule.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute commissioning activities from pre-commissioning through final acceptance.
  • Review commissioning procedures, method statements, test scripts, and technical documentation.
  • Witness and support FAT, SAT, functional testing, integrated system testing (IST), and performance testing.
  • Coordinate commissioning activities with contractors, vendors, consultants, and project teams.
  • Monitor Cx1–Cx5 commissioning progress and ensure activities are completed according to the project schedule.
  • Review test results, identify deficiencies, and follow up on punch list items through closure.
  • Verify equipment and system performance against design intent and project requirements.
  • Prepare and maintain commissioning reports, test records, trackers, and close-out documentation.
  • Support troubleshooting and resolution of technical issues during commissioning.
  • Ensure compliance with project safety requirements and applicable codes and standards.

Key Requirements

  • Diploma/Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Building Services Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Relevant experience in testing, commissioning, construction, or facilities engineering.
  • Experience in data centre / mission-critical projects
  • Familiarity with relevant industry standards and commissioning practices.
  • Experience with electrical and/or mechanical systems such as generators, UPS, switchgear, cooling systems, CDU, CRAH, pumps, and BMS/EPMS is advantageous.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of testing and commissioning processes.
  • Ability to read and interpret drawings, SLDs, schematics, specifications, and technical documents.
  • Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong coordination and communication skills.
  • Able to manage multiple commissioning activities and priorities concurrently.
  • Detail-oriented with good documentation and reporting skills.
  • Able to work effectively with contractors, vendors, consultants, and internal stakeholders.
  • Willingness to support FAT/commissioning activities outside normal working hours when required.
  • Proactive, responsible, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.

#JR815

Education

Bachelors in Electrical Engineering

Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering & Electronics
