Performs preventative maintenance activities as per documented schedules and standards on engine and related components in the field. Escalates unresolved issues to more experienced Field Service Technicians and/or Supervisor. Completes required documentation, such as service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens. Identifies additional service opportunities with customer. Completes training in line with skill and business requirements. Maintains service vehicle and tools for cleanliness and proper operation. Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to site management and to their supervisor.

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Locally valid driving permit

Basic level field service work experience

Intermediate level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products

Customer service experience

Good communication skills. Work well within a team environment , also need to work autonomously when required in the field. Good computer skills. Insite and QSOL experience preferred. Good attitude towards work and team.

job.title: Regional Branch Manager
job.description:
Regional Branch Manager - Tomago

We provide global opportunities to develop your career, make your community a better place and work with today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems.

We believe in flexibility for you to explore your passions while making an impact through meaningful work within our inclusive workforce. That’s what _\#LifeAtCummins_ is all about.

We are looking for a experienced Regional Branch Manager to join our team in Tomago, Newcastle NSW.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Manages the day-to-day operations for our 3 branches Tomago, Muswellbrook and Tamworth
  • Full accountability for creating and maintaining Right Work Environment,
  • Leading sustained growth through the provision of world-class sales and support for an enviable on-highway, off-highway, power generation, mining and marine customer base whilst ensuring best in class operational efficiency
  • Building and promoting a team environment that works collaboratively.
  • Responsible for all functions and financial metrics for the group of branches.
  • Identify improvements and encourage an innovative culture.
  • Ensures business growth by managing annual marketing and sales plan; develops and maintains business relationships with customers and develops new business partners and alliances for the business segment and geographical locations
  • Manages compliance with health, safety, and environmental standards and compliance; oversees health, safety, and environmental audits.
  • Drive growth in your area by having strong relationships with existing and potential customers
  • Ensure customer expectations are met and managed accordingly

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Previous experience / knowledge within diesel and alternative fuel engines and generators industry is ideal
  • A proven strong team leader with a business development mindset that can lead a diverse team to safely meet business objectives.
  • Committed to providing exceptional customer service to customers across a diverse region and customer base.
  • Dedicated to building the ‘Right Work Environment’, including a focus on Health, Safety and Environment

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive Salary Package – Base + Super + Car Allowance + Annual Variable Compensation Program (bonus)
  • Annual remuneration reviews
  • Income Protection continuance insurance
  • A range of personal and professional benefits
  • Paid Parental leave (Conditions apply)
  • Uniforms provided
  • Comprehensive Cummins product training provided
  • Discounts with select private health insurance, PC software/hardware and a range of vehicles
  • Onsite parking
  • Employee Assistance Program available to employees

Experience

Significant relevant experience required, including managerial and budgetary experience.

Qualifications for Internal Candidates:

This is a key leadership role responsible for Newcastle, Muswellbrook and Tamworth branches reporting to Central Region Area Director.

This region supports strategic global coal mining customers and OEM's in a highly competitive environment. This region accounts for over $100m in parts and service revenue annually.

The role will have oversight of large On Highway Truck Shop and HHP rebuild shop in Newcastle, 24/7 Field service operation in Muswellbrook and On Highway Truck Shop and large field service team in Tamworth.

The Regional Branch Manager will be required to manage complexity across multiple markets, identify and implement strategic initiatives that improve efficiency, productivity, profitability and customer and employee experience with eight direct reports.

Current knowledge of Mining, On Highway and Power Gen markets will be highly regarded and previous experience successfully leading large teams essential.

job.title: Procurement Risk Analyst
job.description:
The Procurement Risk Analyst supports procurement and supply chain operations by identifying, analyzing, and mitigating supplier and supply chain risks to ensure business continuity and operational efficiency. This role executes procurement strategies aligned with material buying plans, with a focus on improving supplier performance, capacity readiness, and risk mitigation ahead of demand. The position requires strong analytical capabilities, supplier risk management expertise, data visualization skills, and stakeholder collaboration to provide actionable insights that support procurement decision-making and supply continuity. The analyst will also act as a data steward, ensuring data quality, governance, and consistency across procurement systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze supplier and supply chain data to identify risks, vulnerabilities, and potential business impacts, and provide actionable insights to procurement and business leaders.
  • Coordinate with sourcing managers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to assess risks and develop mitigation and business continuity plans.
  • Support supplier performance improvement initiatives while maintaining high-quality product and service delivery.
  • Monitor supplier capacity, continuity of supply, reputational risks, and margin-related risks, and proactively implement risk mitigation strategies.
  • Prepare and present recommendations for process improvements, risk reduction opportunities, and alternative courses of action to procurement leadership.
  • Support procurement operations related to supplier onboarding, qualification, contract management, payment issues, and order fulfillment.
  • Serve as the communication conduit between suppliers, sourcing teams, and manufacturing facilities during supplier issues or disruptions.
  • Provide delivery and expediting support to plants/sites during supplier constraints or operational challenges.
  • Support management and execution of engineering releases impacting suppliers.
  • Collect, validate, and maintain supplier scorecard data and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Act as a Data Steward by ensuring data integrity, governance, quality, and consistency across procurement systems.
  • Develop dashboards, reports, and automations using tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, Excel, and database systems to improve efficiency and visibility.
  • Proactively monitor procurement systems, identify issues, and drive corrective actions to ensure uninterrupted operations.
  • Document and share best practices, lessons learned, and continuous improvement initiatives across procurement teams.
  • Drive process automation and system enhancements to improve productivity and reduce manual effort.

Skills & Competencies

  • Supply Base Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate supplier risks related to supply continuity, reputation, and profitability.
  • Data Analytics & Visualization: Strong capability to analyze qualitative and quantitative data, identify trends, and present actionable insights using dashboards and reporting tools.
  • Procurement Systems Knowledge: Proficiency in ERP and procurement systems such as SAP, Oracle, Ariba, and related purchasing, quality, and payment systems.
  • Advanced Technical Skills: Expertise in Advanced Excel (Power Query, Power Pivot, VBA, Macros), Power BI, Power Automate, SQL, and reporting automation.
  • Supplier Performance Management: Ability to monitor supplier KPIs, manage corrective actions, and drive continuous supplier improvement.
  • Supplier Capacity Management: Understanding of supplier capacity planning, forecasting, and demand alignment.
  • Contract Management: Ability to assess contractual terms, monitor supplier compliance, and manage contract lifecycle activities.
  • Problem Solving: Strong root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving using data-driven methodologies.
  • Negotiation Excellence: Ability to support negotiations to achieve mutually beneficial business outcomes.
  • Stakeholder Management: Strong collaboration and relationship-building with suppliers, sourcing teams, manufacturing, and internal stakeholders.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence and present insights effectively.
  • Escalation & Conflict Management: Ability to manage escalations calmly and resolve issues with minimal business disruption.
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset: Ability to identify inefficiencies, implement process improvements, and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Agility & Decision Making: Quick decision-making capability with strong business judgment in dynamic environments.

Experience

  • Minimum 5–6 years of experience in procurement, supply chain analytics, supplier management, or source-to-pay operations.
  • Hands-on experience in procurement data analysis, business intelligence, and visualization tools.
  • Experience in supplier risk management and business continuity planning.
  • Exposure to end-to-end Source-to-Pay processes including supplier qualification, onboarding, contract management, and payment cycles.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in global or matrix organizations.
  • Experience in manufacturing or industrial environments preferred.

Additional Information

  • Work Location: Cummins India Technical Center (IOC), Pune, India
  • Shift Timing: Afternoon / EMEA Shift (12:30 PM – 9:30 PM IST)
  • Work Mode: Hybrid / On-site with flexibility

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, or a related field.
  • Master’s degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred, with specialization in Supply Chain, Procurement, or Operations.
  • Additional certifications in Risk Management, Procurement, Project Management (PMP/Prince2), or Data Analytics are an advantage.

Contributes to solution development, design, integration and testing, and configuration of technology solutions ensuring that delivered solutions adhere to defined architecture and security standards. Works closely with with cross-functional teams, vendors, and business partners to ensure smooth execution and continuous improvement in solution performance and quality. Ensure seamless solution implementation and effective issue resolution.

Supports the design of fit-for-purpose solutions by collaborating with stakeholders to identify integration points and ensure alignment with business processes and goals. Supports technical analysis, design and customization of potential solutions including evaluating the technical fit and viability of commercial-off-the-shelf products versus custom built solution. Develops and maintains technical design documents, workflows, and architecture diagrams. Assists in defining and executing the test strategy and validating solutions against business objectives. Ensures smooth interoperability by validating integrations and documenting configuration steps. Identifies and communicates potential technical dependencies and risks. Works with vendors and IT service providers to address technical issues, evaluate and improve product functionality and ensure proper configuration according to design specifications. Designs and implements data migration solutions to ensure data accuracy and reliability. Develops, designs, tests, maintains and configures solutions and systems as needed. Serves as subject matter expert and point of contact on content, processes, procedures and functionality associated with assigned applications for projects and application support (as needed). Documents recommendations to enhance business process efficiency and increase adoption of standard application features and capabilities, aligning solutions with enterprise standards. Supports continuous improvement initiatives by following established design standards and learning to identify potential enhancements in solution design or workflow efficiency. Technician- Mechanical

We are seeking experienced Technician- Mechanical to join our dynamic workshop team based in Perth.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

job.title: Product Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

This entry level/early career professional, product focused position performs established technical tasks at the sub-system and/or component level for current and future products within a given business unit or corporate area. This involves work across many steps in the product life cycle. Because of the product centered nature of this position, they are very often a central point of coordination and decision making between product line engineers, customer teams, systems engineers, purchasing, suppliers and manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities

Investigates product problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution and documents results with guidance from more experienced team members. Main focus will include working in business processes of Product Preceding Technology (PPT), Value Package Introduction (VPI) or Current Product Support (CPS) and executing technical processes such as Engineering Standard Work (ESW), iDFMEA, Failure Incident Review Group (FIRG) while using tools such as 7-step problem solving, design review checklist and other specialized tools required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Obtains input from stakeholders such as technical managers, project leaders, other product and manufacturing engineers and supplier partners to deliver information and recommendations that lead to quality product decisions. Applies academic knowledge and existing experience to take action and make decisions that progress projects forward without sacrificing project quality expectations. Examples of these decisions include day to day project details, analysis or test work instruction details, coordination across discipline areas that are necessary to make quality progress. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Competencies:

Applies Principles of Statistical Methods - Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data-based decisions.

Cross-Functional Design Integration - Translates the value package requirements that include the voices of many stakeholders into virtual designs, and communicates the capability of the design through an approved cross-functional design review.

Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls - Specifies software features that interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products.

Mechanical Design of Mechanical Systems - Acquires and applies an in-depth understanding of mechanical systems through working knowledge that guides a designer’s ability to create innovative and sound design concepts to meet Cummins and customer expectations; designs for requirements of all lifecycle stages by considering the customer requirements in different operating environments to ensure a robust system.

Mechanical Design Specification - Creates complete specifications in the form of solid models, configured engineering bill of materials and detailed drawings that cross-functionally communicate the information required to manufacture and inspect a product per its design intent; considers national, international, industry, and Cummins’ standards that accurately and concisely define the part specification.

Product Configuration and Change Management - Establishes a baseline of identified product artifacts to be placed under configuration management; releases, tracks, controls and communicates changes from concept to obsolescence often through work requests; establishes and maintains the integrity of the product artifact baselines.

Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Interface Management and Integration - Identifies and analyzes the interfaces and interactions across system boundaries by specifying the requirements and limits to ensure that the product meets requirements; controls the interactions across the system element boundaries by making sure that they remain within specified limits; integrates system elements by creating an integration plan, including identification of method and timing for each activity to make it easier to find, isolate, diagnose, and correct.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Entry level/Early career professional. Preferred candidates would have relevant experience working in either a temporary student employment environment (intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities) or as an early career professional in a relevant technical discipline area. Knowledge of MS Office tools is also preferred

Skills

  • Good understanding of ADS components like Doser, Mixers and/or fuel systems components.
  • Proficiency in 3D modeling tools (Creo) and engineering drawing standards (GD&T).
  • Knowledge of design tools and methodologies (DFMEA, DFM, DFA, DV&V).
  • Familiarity with Cummins processes (VPI, PPT, CPS) and tools (Windchill, RV&S).
  • Ability to interpret simulation results (structural and flow analysis).
  • User level understanding on analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Effective communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Working knowledge of manufacturing processes and product validation techniques.

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in CES products or Fuel Systems product lines
  • 3–5 years of product design and development experience preferred.
  • Experience in cross-functional design reviews and product lifecycle processes.

job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE)

  • Demonstrate a strong commitment to workplace safety by adhering to all Cummins HSE policies, procedures, and standards.
  • Stop work immediately and report unsafe conditions, incidents, near misses, or injury hazards.
  • Follow Lockout-Tagout (LOTO), electrical safety requirements, and safe work practices.
  • Conduct Job Safety Assessments (JSA) and utilize appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Recognize environmental impacts and support sustainability initiatives within manufacturing operations.
  • Promote an interdependent safety culture by identifying, correcting, and escalating hazards.

Maintenance & Equipment Reliability

  • Perform preventive, predictive, corrective, emergency, and breakdown maintenance activities.
  • Troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair electrical systems, industrial controls, automation equipment, PLCs, drives, and production machinery.
  • Support equipment uptime initiatives through effective failure analysis and reliability improvement activities.
  • Maintain and repair production, assembly, and testing equipment according to established standards and procedures.
  • Document maintenance activities and provide feedback into preventive maintenance systems.

Automation, Robotics & Controls

  • Maintain and troubleshoot Siemens S7-1500 PLC-based automation systems using Siemens TIA Portal.
  • Perform PLC programming modifications, upgrades, and system enhancements.
  • Support operation and maintenance of industrial robots including ABB, FANUC, Yaskawa, Universal Robots, and collaborative robotics systems.

job.title: Industrial Engineer - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

Designs, improves, and installs integrated manufacturing or administrative systems which use people, materials, information, equipment, and energy.

Key Responsibilities

Leads work studies for new and current production lines. Leads standard work methods for new and current production lines. Leads the work for specific projects to create and implement all aspects of a manufacturing processes to ensure safety requirements, manufacturing goals, business goals, and product specifications are met. Leads by applying the knowledge or use of manufacturing principles and practices to improve manufacturing equipment and processes. Maintains the application of Cummins standards and develops manufacturing standards. Leads the communications with and influences key external stakeholders, business leaders, and functional members. Works with internal and external resources on specific project assignments. Leads the advanced knowledge of manufacturing principles and practices as they are applied to Cummins. Maintains relationships and coaches key stakeholders. Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Ergonomic Fundamentals - Understands ergonomic concepts by applying Cummins ergonomic standards, guidelines, controls and tools to reduce ergonomic risk to employees while at work.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Line Balancing - Evaluates work activities performed by individuals or machines to identify opportunities to optimize operating time and distributing of the work content to meet the changes in customer demands while continuing to optimize manufacturing processes.

Manufacturing Analysis Led Design - Uses digital tools to model and simulate manufacturing processes, equipment and performance to make data driven decisions before changes are made and to drive continuous improvements.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Process Layout - Creates and/or modifies an optimized manufacturing process by incorporating knowledge of equipment, human interfaces, sequences of production steps, and facilities requirements in order to reduce process time and waste.

Work Measurement - Quantifies and evaluates the elements of work that make up a process by breaking it down into detailed steps to identify and reduce waste, and redistribute work content to optimize process flows.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Continuous Process Improvement - Recognizes areas in which a process can be improved by properly implementing process improvement and waste reduction methodologies to reduce process cost and improve quality in current manufacturing processes.

Drawing Interpretation - Integrates product design and manufacturing equipment engineering drawings to support the design and development of an optimal manufacturing process that meets product design specifications.

Industrial Engineering Knowledge - Integrates the pillars of industrial engineering techniques by applying a comprehensive and quantitative analysis to available data to be used as decision factors for the development or improvement of manufacturing processes to contribute to the most efficient process.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Math) or related field, or equivalent experience required.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Intermediate level relevant work experience required.

Job Description: Industrial Engineer Senior

Role Summary: We are seeking an Industrial Engineering professional with strong expertise in discrete manufacturing, industrial engineering, and data analytics. This role will transform manufacturing data into actionable insights, drive continuous improvement, and support the deployment of AI and analytics solutions across plant operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze data from digital manufacturing systems such as CMES, Connected Factory, Maximo, Q-DAS, OEE platforms, and other plant applications to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Partner with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to understand process challenges and convert them into data-driven improvement projects.
  • Develop dashboards, analytics models, and performance insights to improve productivity, equipment utilization, quality, cost, and operational efficiency.
  • Support AI and machine learning use cases by providing manufacturing domain expertise, validating data logic, and helping enterprise AI teams translate plant requirements into practical solutions.
  • Perform data validation, root-cause analysis, and performance investigations using SQL, Python, Power BI, and other analytics tools.
  • Identify bottlenecks, waste, process variation, and reliability issues, then recommend practical actions to drive measurable business improvements.
  • Facilitate Industry 4.0 analytics workshops, train plant teams on analytics tools, and build capability for data-driven decision making.
  • Design and support Operations Control Tower concepts by integrating data from manufacturing, maintenance, quality, and ERP systems to provide a consolidated view of operations.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of discrete manufacturing processes, plant operations, lean manufacturing, industrial engineering methods, and continuous improvement practices.
  • Hands-on experience with manufacturing performance metrics such as OEE, throughput, downtime, cycle time, productivity, quality losses, and cost improvement.
  • Proficiency in data analytics tools and methods, including SQL, Python, Power BI, statistical analysis, and data visualization.
  • Ability to work with large operational data sets, validate data quality, identify trends, and convert analysis into business actions.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional plant teams and translating shop-floor challenges into analytics or AI use cases.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and project execution skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in Industry 4.0, smart manufacturing, connected factory, MES, ERP, or digital manufacturing platforms.
  • Exposure to AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, or advanced operations analytics in a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience leading value stream improvement, or data-driven productivity projects.
  • Ability to influence plant stakeholders and drive adoption of analytics-based improvement actions.

Looking at the data we gather from multiple systems, this position will add value in bringing meaningful insights for effective operations.

job.title: Supply Chain Planner
job.description:
The Supply Chain Planner is responsible for planning, coordinating, and maintaining daily supply chain operations across one or more functional areas, including material planning, production planning, inventory management, logistics, demand management, customer service, and order fulfillment. The role ensures alignment between supply and demand while meeting internal and external customer expectations. Working in a global supply chain environment, the Supply Chain Planner collaborates with suppliers, manufacturing sites, logistics providers, and cross-functional stakeholders to optimize inventory, improve supplier performance, mitigate supply risks, and drive continuous process improvements across regional and global operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, execute, and maintain supply and material plans that align with customer demand while balancing inventory, production capacity, and logistics requirements.
  • Plan and manage end-to-end material flow across global supply networks, including suppliers, manufacturing facilities, distribution centers, and regional operations.
  • Monitor and optimize planning parameters within ERP and planning systems to improve planning accuracy and ensure consistent supply chain signals.
  • Analyze supply chain performance using key performance indicators (KPIs), identify performance gaps, conduct root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
  • Identify and proactively mitigate supply risks related to supplier capacity, material shortages, logistics constraints, long lead times, geopolitical disruptions, and transportation delays.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to improve delivery performance, capacity commitments, order fulfillment, and On-Time-In-Full (OTIF) performance.
  • Coordinate with procurement, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, customer service, and regional planning teams to ensure effective execution of supply plans.
  • Manage inventory strategies across multiple supply chain nodes, including origin, in-transit, and destination inventory, while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.
  • Monitor shipment pipelines and logistics performance, ensuring accurate delivery tracking and timely escalation of potential delays.
  • Support engineering change implementation, part lifecycle management, and material planning activities while minimizing operational disruptions.
  • Apply Plan for Every Part (PFEP), Master Supply Scheduling, and Material Planning principles to improve planning efficiency and material availability.
  • Evaluate cost, service, and inventory trade-offs to support effective supply chain decision-making.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives through data analysis, process optimization, and participation in cross-functional improvement teams.
  • Maintain effective communication across global stakeholders while supporting supply continuity and operational excellence.

Skills and Experience

  • Significant experience in supply planning, material planning, inventory management, or broader supply chain operations within a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience working in global supply chain environments supporting multiple regions, with exposure to Asia-to-North America and/or EMEA supply networks preferred.
  • Strong understanding of supply planning processes, demand planning, inventory optimization, production planning, logistics, and supplier management.
  • Experience using ERP and Advanced Planning Systems such as Oracle R12, Oracle ASCP/APCC, or equivalent supply planning platforms.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, data analysis, business intelligence tools, and reporting platforms such as Power BI.
  • Knowledge of materials planning systems, Master Production Scheduling (MPS), PFEP methodology, engineering change management, and materials KPI management.

job.title: Principal Data Analyst
job.description:
Cummins is seeking a hands-on SAP Data professional who is equally comfortable analyzing data, resolving complex issues, engaging with business stakeholders, and executing migration activities. This is a critical role and requires a self-starter who takes ownership, delivers outcomes, has the credibility and experience to lead critical data activities and data quality across complex business and technical environments within a major S/4HANA transformation program.

Location – This role could be based in any major Australian city.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Experience migrating both master and transactional data across Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Service Management domains.

  • Strong ETL, data quality, data governance, and data management expertise.

job.title: Supply Chain Planner
job.description:
The Supply Chain Planner is responsible for planning, coordinating, and maintaining daily supply chain operations across one or more functional areas, including materials planning, production planning, inventory management, logistics, demand management, customer service, and order fulfillment. The role ensures a reliable flow of materials and products to meet customer and business requirements while optimizing inventory, improving operational efficiency, and mitigating supply chain risks. The Supply Chain Planner collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to drive continuous improvement initiatives and leverage planning systems to enable effective end-to-end supply chain execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute daily supply chain planning activities across materials, production, inventory, logistics, demand planning, and order fulfillment.
  • Develop and maintain planning system strategies that improve planning signals and overall supply chain performance.
  • Monitor, maintain, and optimize planning parameters within enterprise planning systems.
  • Analyze supply chain data and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to identify performance gaps, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
  • Identify potential supply chain risks, shortages, or disruptions and develop mitigation plans to minimize business impact.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to implement short-term tactical improvements and support long-term planning objectives.
  • Utilize planning systems to drive consistent and accurate planning signals across the end-to-end supply chain.
  • Support Master Supply Scheduling activities by aligning procurement, production, and replenishment plans with manufacturing capacity and customer demand.
  • Manage engineering changes, part supersessions, new part introductions, and obsolescence activities while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.
  • Apply Plan for Every Part (PFEP) principles to optimize material flow, inventory management, warehouse operations, and transportation planning.
  • Leverage planning tools and business intelligence solutions to improve inventory optimization, parts availability, and supply chain decision-making.
  • Participate in cross-functional continuous improvement initiatives to enhance planning processes, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, quality standards, and applicable export control or regulatory requirements.

Skills & Experience

Required Skills

  • Knowledge of end-to-end supply chain planning processes.
  • Understanding of material planning, inventory management, production planning, demand planning, and order fulfillment.
  • Experience using ERP and supply chain planning systems such as SAP , Oracle , or similar enterprise planning platforms.
  • Knowledge of planning parameters, master scheduling, and supply chain optimization techniques.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data and KPIs.
  • Experience using Microsoft Excel and business intelligence or reporting tools for planning analysis.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to prioritize work, manage multiple tasks, and perform in a fast-paced environment.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with strong organizational and execution skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with advanced planning solutions such as Kinaxis RapidResponse or other Advanced Planning Systems (APS).
  • Knowledge of Business Intelligence dashboards, Advanced Planning Command Center (APCC), or similar analytics tools.

job.description:
Job Summary

Acts as the technical specialist and primary customer support contact to independently diagnose and complete repairs to products at a single customer site

Key Responsibilities

Independently performs diagnostics and completes repairs on equipment at customer site Maintains productive customer relations and ensures prompt and efficient attention to customer needs to minimize customer product downtime Coaches on preventative maintenance and/or repairs completed by more experienced technicians and/or customer technicians; may provide work direction to others; may review repair plans, parts and tool lists, etc Manages parts and spares inventory at the work site Escalates unresolved issues to product specialists / Supervisor Completes required documentation, such as service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens. Identifies additional sales and service opportunities with customer Completes training in line with skill and business requirements Maintains work area and tools for cleanliness and proper operation Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety &Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to site management and to their supervisor.

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

This role manages regional commodities aligned to global category strategies, develops supplier relationships, conducts sourcing and market analysis, mitigates supply risks, and drives continuous improvement initiatives. The position collaborates closely with cross-functional teams and suppliers to ensure a resilient supply base, support global procurement initiatives, and optimize total cost of ownership.

job.title: Manufacturing Engineer - Senior
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Leads the work for specific projects to create and implement all aspects of a manufacturing processes to ensure safety requirements, manufacturing goals, business goals, and product specifications are met. Leads by applying the knowledge or use of manufacturing principles and practices to improve manufacturing equipment and processes. Impacts the work by utilizing continuous improvement tools, following the Cummins standards, and leading the development of manufacturing standards and working methods. Leads the communications with and influences key external stakeholders, business leaders, and functional members. Works with internal and external resources on specific project assignments. Leads the advanced knowledge of manufacturing principles and practices as they are applied to Cummins. Maintains relationships and coaches key stakeholders.

Competencies:

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Drawing Interpretation - Integrates product design and manufacturing equipment engineering drawings to support the design and development of an optimal manufacturing process that meets product design specifications.

Equipment/Capital Procurement - Selects manufacturing equipment which meets the Cummins manufacturing specifications and meets the project or program needs.

Manufacturing Analysis Led Design - Uses digital tools to model and simulate manufacturing processes, equipment and performance to make data driven decisions before changes are made and to drive continuous improvements.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Process Documentation - Produces written manufacturing procedures in proper sequence which are followed correctly by all approved stakeholders to establish continuity in processes and standardization.

Tool and Fixture Design - Selects work-piece-holding devices capable of effectively holding parts and products during a manufacturing process to secure their position to meet functional requirements.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Continuous Process Improvement - Recognizes areas in which a process can be improved by properly implementing process improvement and waste reduction methodologies to reduce process cost and improve quality in current manufacturing processes.

Ergonomics Process and Workplace Design - Designs, creates or adapts processes and workstations by implementing ergonomic controls through the application of the Cummins ergonomic design guidelines to reduce risk and deliver ergonomically designed work.

Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

Workstation Design - Designs operator work stations that are safe, healthy, and ergonomic while accounting for cost, quality, and delivery to contribute to an efficient work environment.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Math) or related field, or equivalent experience required.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Intermediate level of relevant work experience required.

Structured Responsibility Buckets

1. CAPEX PLANNING & EQUIPMENT PROCUREMENT

Primary Responsibilities

  • Capex Budget Planning & Tracking: Develop, manage, and track annual and multi-year capital expenditure plans (AOP capex) for manufacturing equipment and infrastructure projects; monitor cash flow against planned vs. actual spend across quarters.
  • Equipment Sourcing & RFQ Management: Prepare detailed RFQs for production equipment (e.g., VPI plants, HRD machines, presses, ovens, conveyors, winding machines, balancing machines); coordinate site visits for vendors; manage techno-commercial bid evaluations.
  • Vendor Selection & Negotiation: Conduct techno-commercial comparisons across multiple vendors (L1/L2 analysis); negotiate pricing, delivery timelines, payment terms, and warranties; finalize vendor selection with procurement and leadership approval.
  • Purchase Order Execution: Issue POs for equipment, utilities, and construction packages; manage advances, milestone payments, NFA (Non-Financial Approval) submissions, and contractor invoicing aligned to project progress.
  • Equipment Delivery & Installation Oversight: Track equipment receipt against delivery schedules; coordinate dismantling (if refurbishing existing assets), transportation, installation, and commissioning activities; ensure adherence to DAP (Delivered at Place) timelines.
  • Factory & Site Acceptance Testing (FAT/SAT): Plan and execute FAT at vendor facilities and SAT at plant; document test results, snag lists, and ensure resolution of technical issues before handover to operations.
  • Cash Flow & Financial Reporting: Prepare monthly/quarterly capex spend reports; reconcile invoices, track payment milestones, and report variances to finance and plant leadership.

2. CIVIL & INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECT MANAGEMENT

Primary Responsibilities

  • Plant Layout Design & Optimization: Develop manufacturing facility layouts (including assembly lines, storage, utilities); collaborate with architects and civil consultants to finalize layouts in PREDCR format for MIDC submission.
  • Civil Tender Management: Prepare BOQ, technical specifications, and tender documents for civil construction (building footings, PEB structures, flooring, plaster, painting, waterproofing); evaluate civil contractor bids and finalize L1 vendor.
  • Building Expansion & Construction Supervision: Oversee new building construction, plant expansions (Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 3), and infrastructure projects (dock, scrap yard, admin blocks); track progress against Gantt charts and milestone completion.
  • Contractor Coordination & Billing: Manage civil, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, and interior contractors; verify work completion, approve RA (Running Account) bills, process mobilization advances, and manage retention payments.
  • Utility Installation Projects: Coordinate installation of plant utilities including transformers, DG sets, UPS, compressors, STP/ETP upgrades, hydrant systems, fire suppression, HVAC, earthing, IT infrastructure, and electrical cabling.
  • Excavation, Grading & Site Preparation: Oversee site grading, excavation, foundation work, and legal clearances for land use; coordinate with legal teams on royalty approvals and excavation permits.

3. STATUTORY COMPLIANCE & LEGAL APPROVALS

Primary Responsibilities

  • MIDC Building Plan Approval: Prepare and submit building plans to MIDC (Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation); obtain approvals for plinth-level construction, building completion certificates, and occupancy certificates (OC).
  • Fire NOC & Safety Clearances: Coordinate with fire consultants to obtain provisional Fire NOC, part-final Fire NOC, and final Fire NOC from Maharashtra Industrial Fire Department; ensure hydrant system installation and inspection readiness.
  • Environmental & Pollution Clearances:
  • CTE (Consent to Establish): Apply for and obtain CTE from MPCB before commencing manufacturing operations.
  • CTO (Consent to Operate): Submit CTO applications post-equipment installation (varnishing ovens, chemical processes); track approval timelines (60–90 days); implement mitigation plans for delays.
  • DISH Layout Approval: Obtain layout approval from Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH) for industrial equipment placement, factory layout, and worker safety compliance.
  • Electrical Load Enhancement Approvals: Coordinate with MSEDCL (Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Ltd.) for load enhancement applications, WCR (Work Completion Report) approvals, demand notes, fixed deposits, and transformer charging permissions.
  • BOCW (Building and Other Construction Workers) Registration: Register construction projects under BOCW Act; ensure labor welfare cess payments and statutory contractor registrations are current.
  • Safety Standards & Compliance Documentation: Ensure compliance with NFPA (National Fire Protection Association) standards, LOTO (Lockout/Tagout) procedures, HSE (Health, Safety, Environment) protocols, and maintain MAITRI portal documentation for legal audits.

4. VENDOR & COMMERCIAL MANAGEMENT

Primary Responsibilities

  • Vendor Identification & Capability Assessment: Identify and assess vendors for equipment supply, civil construction, electrical works, HVAC, interior fit-outs, and specialty services; conduct technical and financial due diligence.
  • Techno-Commercial Evaluation: Prepare comparative techno-commercial matrices for initial offers, final offers, and revised bids; validate technical compliance, delivery schedules, warranty terms, and total cost of ownership.
  • Contract Negotiation & Finalization: Negotiate pricing, payment terms (advances, milestones, retentions), scope changes, and penalty clauses; finalize contracts with legal, procurement, and finance sign-offs.
  • Vendor Performance Management: Monitor vendor adherence to delivery timelines, quality standards, and safety compliance; escalate delays, conduct root-cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
  • Commercial Documentation & Payments: Process vendor invoices, verify work completion against milestones, approve RA certificates, manage advance adjustments, and ensure timely payment releases aligned to contract terms.
  • Supplier Development & Relationship Management: Build long-term relationships with OEMs and contractors; facilitate supplier visits, audits, and capability showcases; maintain vendor databases and performance scorecards.
  • Legal & HR Compliance for Contractors: Ensure contractors maintain valid licenses (architect, plumber, structural engineer), provide labor welfare documentation, safety PPE, and comply with site safety regulations.

Additional Context & Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engg, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related field
  • 12-15 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, plant projects, or capex execution
  • Proven track record in managing multi-crore capex projects (₹10–50 Cr range)
  • Strong knowledge of Indian industrial regulations (MIDC, MPCB, Factory Act, BOCW)
  • Experience with equipment procurement (machining centers, assembly lines, utilities)
  • Familiarity with EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) project lifecycles

Reporting Structure:

  • Reports to: Manufacturing Engineering Leader
  • Collaborates with: Procurement, Finance, Legal, HSE, SCM, Operations, Quality, and Facilities teams

job.title: Supply Chain Coordinator - Level II - OFFC
job.description:
Under general supervision, the Supply Chain Coordinator - Level II supports end-to-end supply chain planning and coordination by analyzing demand and supply data, maintaining planning parameters, and ensuring optimal inventory levels. The role collaborates with cross-functional teams to align supply plans with customer demand, improve material flow, resolve supply chain issues, and support continuous improvement initiatives. The position also contributes to reporting, planning accuracy, and operational excellence while maintaining compliance with quality, safety, and business standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support demand and supply planning activities by analyzing demand trends, inventory levels, and planning data to maintain a stable and efficient supply chain.
  • Monitor inventory performance and planning parameters, including reorder points, safety stock, lead times, and other planning settings, ensuring alignment with Plan for Every Part (PFEP) principles.
  • Perform supply and demand analysis, identify potential risks or shortages, and recommend corrective actions to improve supply chain performance.
  • Execute approved planning parameter and forecast adjustments within planning systems to optimize inventory and customer service levels.
  • Coordinate with planning, procurement, warehouse, transportation, and manufacturing teams to resolve material, transaction, and system-related issues.
  • Monitor shipment movement, transit performance, and logistics activities, escalating exceptions and supporting timely resolution of delivery issues.
  • Maintain accurate documentation, reporting, and records related to supply chain activities, inventory, shipments, and planning processes.
  • Prepare and maintain MIS reports, dashboards, and analytical reports to support operational decision-making and KPI tracking.
  • Support purchase order management, planning attributes, EDI/Kanban processes, and material flow coordination.
  • Participate in simulation and scenario analysis to evaluate the impact of planning changes on supply chain KPIs.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality, safety, material flow, inventory optimization, and process efficiency.
  • Follow Cummins Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) policies, quality standards, and standard operating procedures.
  • Complete required training and actively contribute to personal and professional development.

Experience

Technical Skills

  • Experience with MIS reporting and data analysis.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills with the ability to analyze and interpret operational data.
  • Knowledge of ERP systems such as Oracle or SAP is preferred.
  • Understanding of transportation management systems (TMS) and shipment monitoring is desirable.
  • Familiarity with purchase orders, planning attributes, EDI, and Kanban processes.

Core Competencies

  • Effective communication and stakeholder management.

Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and negotiates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Responsible for review of less-experienced developers/testers’ work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient designs. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across function(s) within a global business unit or managing improvement across business units. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.

Competencies:

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.

Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred

  • Experience with the Vector diagnostic tool chain, including CANdelaStudio and DaVinci Configurator/Developer.
  • 6+ years of experience in AUTOSAR BSW integration including BSW and RTE concepts.
  • Proven expertise in AUTOSAR BSW module configuration (COM, DCM, DEM, NvM, etc.) and diagnostic architecture, particularly DCM, DEM, and FIM.
  • Advanced debugging and system analysis skills using Trace32. Understanding of embedded C programming and embedded software development best practices.
  • Experience configuring UDS diagnostic services, including DIDs, RIDs, Diagnostic Sessions, Security Access, Routine Control, ECU Reset, and Communication Contro and SAE J1939-73 diagnostics, including SPNs, DM messages, and DTC mapping
  • Experience configuring and maintaining Diagnostic Events, DTCs, Freeze Frames, Extended Data Records, and OBD-related diagnostic data.
  • Strong understanding of Diagnostics Protocol UDS (ISO 14229), OBD-II, WWH-OBD (ISO 27145), SAE J1939 -73-84, J1979-02, ISO 15765-2.
  • Experience analyzing diagnostic requirements and translating them into DEM/DEXT configurations.
  • Experience with Python or other scripting languages for automation.
  • Familiarity with Git/GitLab.
  • Understanding of FUSA and ASPICE processes.
  • Experience using work items and change management tools to track Change Requests (CRs), defects, and development activities.

Job Summary – JM2

Junior Collection Manager is responsible for managing accounts receivable, ensuring timely collection of outstanding invoices from business clients, performing account reconciliations, and resolving disputes. The role requires strong analytical skills, stakeholder communication, and attention to detail to maintain healthy cash flow and minimize aged receivables

Key Responsibilities

1. Collections

  • Manage an assigned portfolio of customer accounts, ensuring timely collection of outstanding balances and reducing delinquency
  • Handle outbound and inbound calls to customers for payment reminders
  • Conduct proactive outreach to customers via phone and email to resolve past-due invoices and secure payment commitments
  • Maintain detailed and accurate collection notes and account histories within the system to support transparency and continuity
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in collections processes
  • Collaborate with field representatives and internal stakeholders to resolve complex customer issues and support strategic initiatives
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of collections policies, procedures, and tools to enhance efficiency and scalability
  • Build strong relationships with customers to improve payment cycles

2. Account Reconciliation (Recon)

  • Perform periodic reconciliation of customer accounts
  • Identify discrepancies between internal records and customer statements
  • Investigate unapplied cash, short payments, or overpayments
  • Work with internal teams (billing, sales, finance) to resolve mismatches
  • Maintain accurate and updated account statements

3. Dispute Management

  • Identify, log, and track customer disputes related to invoices
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders (billing, operations, sales) for resolution
  • Ensure timely closure of disputes to avoid payment delays
  • Maintain dispute logs and provide root cause analysis
  • Work on preventing recurring issues through process improvements

4. Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare daily/weekly/monthly MIS reports on collections, aging, disputes
  • Analyze aging reports to identify trends, highlight at-risk accounts, and provide actionable insights to leadership
  • Provide insights and recommendations to improve collection efficiency
  • Perform monthly and quarterly responsibilities such as Allowance Analysis and journal entry, collection escalation for doubtful accounts and monthly reporting package for collections metrics.
  • Track KPIs such as DSO (Days Sales Outstanding), collection rate, dispute resolution TAT

5. Compliance & Process Adherence

  • Ensure adherence to company credit policies and collection procedures
  • Maintain proper documentation for audits and compliance requirements
  • Support internal and external audit queries related to receivables

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelors or Master’s degree in finance or equivalent
  • 7–8 years of experience in Global Collections, including U.S. customer portfolios
  • Experience managing large, high-volume AR portfolios with measurable impact on DSO
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and problem‑solving capabilities
  • Ability to negotiate and influence outcomes while remaining tactful and respectful.
  • Excellent time management with the ability to independently prioritize and manage portfolios
  • Proficiency in ERP Systems & Collection Tools – SAP, Oracle, High Radius
  • Demonstrated ownership of high-value, complex AR portfolios with material cash impact
  • Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail
  • Willingness and ability to work U.S. Shifts
