job.title: Procurement and Supply Continuity Analyst - Team Lead
job.description:
Job Summary

Executes buying strategies in accordance with agreed upon material buying plans, specifically focused on improving supplier overall performance and capacity ahead of demand.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborates with sourcing team for supplier process improvement while maintaining high quality product and/or service delivery. Analyzes Procurement initiatives and processes in support of the delivery of cost effective and high quality goods and services. Prepares and presents recommendations of improvement opportunities and alternative courses of action to senior Procurement leaders. Consistently applies sourcing policies, procedures and processes. Supports linkage between Procurement and manufacturing facilities and will serve as communication conduit between manufacturing and the suppliers. Interacts with suppliers with regard to payment issues and order fulfillment. Collects/validates relevant supplier score card data. Provides delivery/expediting support to the plant/site during supplier issues. Supports management and execution of engineering releases

Competencies:

Negotiations Excellence - Utilizes tools and methods in negotiations to achieve Cummins stakeholder objectives and achieve a mutually agreed upon all contract terms between all parties.

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Procurement Ethics - Avoids supplier engagement that may compromise supplier sourcing, selection, and management processes and seeks counsel to ensure compliance.

Procurement Policies, Procedures, Tools - Understands all of the relevant Procurement policies and procedures and complies with them in daily work; Masters all tools required to conduct procurement work. Knows how to access documents in the appropriate Document Management System (DMS) and/or who to ask if clarification or expansion of the information contained in each document is needed.

Procurement Systems - Recognizes linkage to multiple systems such as purchasing order, payment, engineering release, and quality systems; troubleshoots and corrects issues resulting from data issues; writes ad-hoc reports using tools within each application; identifies and documents work flows and system testing; actively participates in implementation process of new purchasing systems including requirements gathering, design, communication, and training.

Supplier Capacity Management - Leverages Cummins marketing forecast processes and data required from suppliers for capacity planning; negotiates capacity requirements in supplier contracts to deliver the lowest Total Cost of Ownership; links interrelationship between capacity management and product quality; assesses suppliers to ensure that they are capable of meeting Cummins total demand for both production and aftermarket.

Supplier Contract Management - Assesses and enforces contractual terms and conditions; monitors key performance indicators throughout the term of the contract to ensure Cummins reach the intended value of the contract; manages supplier delivery of product/services to Cummins requirements, and tracks the term of the contract (when it expires).

Supplier Performance Management - Leverages functional roles and responsibilities to appropriately manage supplier performance; negotiates defined metrics and supplier management processes to ensure robust management by all functional stakeholders; assimilates cross-functional, cross-site performance data across geographies; ensures suppliers awareness to performance deficiencies and communicates Cummins expectations relative to continuous improvement.

By minimize disruption and services throughout supply chain. Manage and leverage supplier selection and dual sourcing opportunities as a first line of defense against supplier risk.

job.title: Manufacturing Shop Operations Team Manager - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Manager / Manager – Camshaft Manufacturing Operations is responsible for leading day-to-day manufacturing operations for camshafts across QSK, KV, NT, ISX, and other engine platforms at Kothrud Engine Plant. The role focuses on ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality production through effective management of machining processes, manpower, equipment performance, automation systems, and continuous improvement initiatives.

The incumbent will lead operations involving cam milling, grinding, induction hardening, straightening, superfinishing, washing, inspection, and packaging processes while ensuring achievement of safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity targets. The role also requires strong coordination with cross-functional teams including Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, Planning, and Supply Chain.

Key Responsibilities

Production & Operations Management

  • Execute and monitor daily production plans to meet customer delivery schedules and operational targets.
  • Ensure smooth operation of manufacturing lines with focus on safety, quality, productivity, and cost optimization.
  • Manage manpower deployment, shift planning, absenteeism control, and resource utilization.
  • Coordinate with planning, quality, maintenance, and manufacturing engineering teams to minimize downtime and production losses.
  • Drive production stability across multiple camshaft variants and engine platforms.
  • Lead and manage daily operations of cylinder head machining lines.
  • Drive high-mix, high-volume production while maintaining flexibility and efficiency.
  • Optimize manpower utilization, line balancing, and throughput.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Supply Chain, Quality, Maintenance, and Engineering to ensure seamless operations.

Equipment & Process Management

  • Oversee end-to-end machining processes including:
  • Oversee operation and performance of critical manufacturing equipment including:
  • Cam Milling Machines
  • Journal & Cam Lobe Grinding Machines
  • Induction Hardening Systems
  • Straightening Machines
  • Superfinishing Machines
  • BHN Testing & Crack Detection Systems
  • Washing, Laser Marking & Final Inspection Machines
  • Ensure adherence to preventive and predictive maintenance schedules for improved equipment reliability.
  • Support machine trials, process validation, commissioning, and production ramp-up activities.
  • Monitor process capability and implement corrective actions to sustain process stability.

Automation & Manufacturing Systems

  • Support implementation and stabilization of automation systems such as robotic handling, gantry systems, and automated inspection systems.
  • Drive CMS (Cummins Manufacturing System) implementation and sustainment across the shop floor.
  • Participate in Industry 4.0 and digital manufacturing initiatives to improve operational visibility and machine utilization.
  • Promote data-based decision-making through operational reviews and KPI tracking.

Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure adherence to Cummins quality standards and customer requirements.
  • Lead root cause analysis and implementation of corrective/preventive actions for process and quality issues.
  • Drive reduction in scrap, rework, and customer complaints.
  • Ensure compliance with HSE, environmental, ergonomic, and statutory requirements.
  • Support audits, VPCR activities, layered process audits, and quality improvement initiatives.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead and develop supervisors, operators, technicians, and support staff.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, discipline, and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct training, skill development, performance reviews, and competency enhancement initiatives.
  • Encourage employee involvement in Kaizen, safety, and productivity improvement activities.

Continuous Improvement & Cost Optimization

  • Improve OEE, productivity, cycle time, and process efficiency.
  • Drive Lean Manufacturing initiatives including 5S, TPM, Kaizen, SMED, and waste elimination.
  • Support cost reduction initiatives related to tooling, consumables, utilities, and manpower optimization.
  • Participate in CAPEX execution, operational budgeting, and resource planning activities.

Competencies:

Core Competencies

  • Operations Management
  • Manufacturing Excellence
  • Team Leadership
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Lean Manufacturing & TPM
  • Problem Solving & Root Cause Analysis
  • Decision Making
  • Collaboration & Cross-functional Coordination
  • Health, Safety & Environmental Awareness
  • Technical Expertise in Precision Machining

job.title: Buying Analyst
job.description:
Job Summary

The Strategic Sourcing / Procurement Specialist supports sourcing, localization, supplier management, commercial negotiations, and cost optimization activities for Cummins products. The role is responsible for analyzing supplier quotations, conducting should-cost and benchmarking analysis, developing sourcing strategies, managing supplier agreements, and identifying cost reduction opportunities while ensuring quality, delivery, compliance, and long-term supplier relationships.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage supplier agreements, including Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), purchasing agreements, and other commercial contracts.
  • Lead sourcing and localization programs, ensuring timely execution and achievement of project milestones.
  • Develop and evaluate should-cost models for castings, forgings, machined components, sheet metal, brake components, and proprietary parts.
  • Prepare and evaluate tooling cost estimates for new product development and localization projects.
  • Conduct raw material cost trend analysis, RM indexing, price benchmarking, and commercial analysis to support supplier negotiations.
  • Lead commercial negotiations with suppliers and drive successful cost settlements while maintaining strong supplier relationships.
  • Prepare and issue RFQs and evaluate supplier quotations using Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and technical-commercial analysis.
  • Analyze and benchmark BOM costs for complete vehicles, aggregates, and sub-systems to identify cost optimization opportunities.
  • Identify and implement Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VA/VE) and cost reduction initiatives across commodities.
  • Develop sourcing strategies, assess supplier capabilities, and support supplier selection and development.
  • Monitor manufacturing technologies, cost drivers, market trends, and industry developments across commodities such as gears, castings, forgings, sheet metal, brake components, bearings, rubber, and seals.
  • Manage procurement transactions and reporting using ERP systems such as SAP MM, JD Edwards, or Oracle .
  • Ensure compliance with procurement policies, procedures, ethical sourcing practices, and applicable commercial requirements.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Program Management teams to achieve sourcing and project objectives.
  • Analyze sourcing data and market intelligence to identify process improvement and cost reduction opportunities.
  • Maintain appropriate supplier, legal, and compliance documentation in applicable systems.
  • Support supplier onboarding, vendor management, and procurement process improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • A degree or specialization in Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing, or related discipline is preferred.
  • Additional qualifications in strategic sourcing, cost engineering, or supply chain management will be an advantage.

Skills & Experience

  • Relevant experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, commodity management, cost engineering, or supplier management .
  • Hands-on experience in should-cost analysis and cost estimation for manufacturing processes such as castings, forgings, machining, sheet metal, brake components, or proprietary parts.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, tooling costs, raw material cost drivers, and supplier economics.
  • Experience in RFQ management, supplier quotation analysis, cost benchmarking, and commercial negotiations.
  • Knowledge of VA/VE, cost reduction, localization, and sourcing strategy development .
  • Working knowledge of SAP MM, JD Edwards, Oracle , or similar ERP/procurement systems.
  • Strong analytical and data interpretation skills with the ability to use cost and market data for business decisions.
  • Understanding of Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) principles and supplier evaluation methodologies.
  • Strong financial acumen and understanding of procurement cost structures.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, stakeholder management, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to build effective relationships with suppliers and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong project/program management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver against timelines.
  • High level of integrity and understanding of procurement ethics, policies, and compliance requirements.

Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional environment and adapt to changing business requirements.

Junior Collection Manager is responsible for managing accounts receivable, ensuring timely collection of outstanding invoices from business clients, performing account reconciliations, and resolving disputes. Key Responsibilities

1. Collections

  • Manage an assigned portfolio of customer accounts, ensuring timely collection of outstanding balances and reducing delinquency
  • Handle outbound and inbound calls to customers for payment reminders

  • Maintain detailed and accurate collection notes and account histories within the system to support transparency and continuity

  • Collaborate with field representatives and internal stakeholders to resolve complex customer issues and support strategic initiatives

  • Identify discrepancies between internal records and customer statements
  • Investigate unapplied cash, short payments, or overpayments

5. Compliance & Process Adherence

  • Maintain proper documentation for audits and compliance requirements
  • Support internal and external audit queries related to receivables

Job Summary – JM2

Junior Collection Manager is responsible for managing accounts receivable, ensuring timely collection of outstanding invoices from business clients, performing account reconciliations, and resolving disputes. The role requires strong analytical skills, stakeholder communication, and attention to detail to maintain healthy cash flow and minimize aged receivables

Key Responsibilities

1. Collections

  • Manage an assigned portfolio of customer accounts, ensuring timely collection of outstanding balances and reducing delinquency
  • Handle outbound and inbound calls to customers for payment reminders
  • Conduct proactive outreach to customers via phone and email to resolve past-due invoices and secure payment commitments
  • Maintain detailed and accurate collection notes and account histories within the system to support transparency and continuity
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in collections processes
  • Collaborate with field representatives and internal stakeholders to resolve complex customer issues and support strategic initiatives
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of collections policies, procedures, and tools to enhance efficiency and scalability
  • Build strong relationships with customers to improve payment cycles

2. Account Reconciliation (Recon)

  • Perform periodic reconciliation of customer accounts
  • Identify discrepancies between internal records and customer statements
  • Investigate unapplied cash, short payments, or overpayments
  • Work with internal teams (billing, sales, finance) to resolve mismatches
  • Maintain accurate and updated account statements

3. Dispute Management

  • Identify, log, and track customer disputes related to invoices
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders (billing, operations, sales) for resolution
  • Ensure timely closure of disputes to avoid payment delays
  • Maintain dispute logs and provide root cause analysis
  • Work on preventing recurring issues through process improvements

4. Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare daily/weekly/monthly MIS reports on collections, aging, disputes
  • Analyze aging reports to identify trends, highlight at-risk accounts, and provide actionable insights to leadership
  • Provide insights and recommendations to improve collection efficiency
  • Perform monthly and quarterly responsibilities such as Allowance Analysis and journal entry, collection escalation for doubtful accounts and monthly reporting package for collections metrics.
  • Track KPIs such as DSO (Days Sales Outstanding), collection rate, dispute resolution TAT

5. Compliance & Process Adherence

  • Ensure adherence to company credit policies and collection procedures
  • Maintain proper documentation for audits and compliance requirements
  • Support internal and external audit queries related to receivables

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelors or Master’s degree in finance or equivalent
  • 7–8 years of experience in Global Collections, including U.S. customer portfolios
  • Experience managing large, high-volume AR portfolios with measurable impact on DSO
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and problem‑solving capabilities
  • Ability to negotiate and influence outcomes while remaining tactful and respectful.
  • Excellent time management with the ability to independently prioritize and manage portfolios
  • Proficiency in ERP Systems & Collection Tools – SAP, Oracle, High Radius
  • Demonstrated ownership of high-value, complex AR portfolios with material cash impact
  • Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail
  • Willingness and ability to work U.S. Shifts
  • Mandatory Work from Office

job.title: Technician - Field Service
job.description:
Being part of Cummins means working alongside today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems. We are proud to offer learning and development opportunities designed to promote individual performance and spark purpose and trust within our teams. We look to hire the best and then help you to become even better.

We are seeking an experienced Technician – Field Service to join our dynamic team based out of our coastal Bunbury branch, south of Perth in Western Australia. In this role, you will diagnose and complete repairs to Cummins engines and related components at customer sites, while also supporting workshop repairs and other Cummins branches as required.

  In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways: **

  • Engage customers in a courteous and professional manner, anticipating needs and ensuring prompt, efficient service.
  • Diagnose and complete repairs to Cummins engines and related components at customer sites using specialised tools, documented procedures and policies.
  • Identify and prepare required parts and tools to complete repairs efficiently and to a high standard.
  • Perform preventative maintenance activities in line with documented schedules and standards on engines and related components in the field.
  • Escalate unresolved technical issues to more experienced Field Service Technicians and/or the Supervisor.
  • Complete required documentation, including service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims and quality documents, via handwritten forms or business system input screens.
  • Identify additional service opportunities with customers and support a positive customer experience.
  • Complete training in line with skill and business requirements.
  • Maintain the service vehicle and tools for cleanliness and proper operation.
  • Ensure adherence to all relevant Health, Safety and Environmental policies, procedures and legislation, reporting any issues or incidents to site management and your Supervisor.
  • Complete in-workshop repairs as required and provide support to other Cummins branches when needed.

To be successful in this role you will need the following: **

  • WA driver’s licence
  • Australian working rights
  • Mechanical trades qualified as Heavy Diesel Mechanic or Mobile Plant Mechanic or Light Vehicle with Heavy Diesel experience.
  • Cummins experience is not required however engine experience is desirable
  • Safety Focused and the ability to work effectively in a team environment

Additional Information:

  • Full Time / 38 hours per week
  • Overtime as required – Penalty rates paid for all work above 38 hours
  • On Call Roster 2:6 weeks
  • All your Safety equipment / PPE and uniforms are provided and laundered
  • Domestic Relocation from across Australia _may_ be offered for the right candidate
  • _Local Valid Drivers License is required_

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Apprentice Trained Engine Technician (Cert III) or equivalent
  • Basic level of workshop or field service experience required
  • Basic level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products
  • Heavy Vehicle Experience preferred
  • HR License preferred

Critical Competencies:

  • Health & Safety Fundamentals – Champions proactive safety behaviours and actions to prevent injuries.
  • Diagnostics Application – Troubleshoots issues, identifies failed components, and documents solutions.
  • Electronic Service Tool Application – Uses electronic tools to diagnose, maintain, and resolve service issues.
  • Engine Systems Interactions – Analyses electrical and mechanical system interactions to diagnose and repair effectively.
  • Product Repair & Maintenance – Completes quality repairs and maintenance in line with guidelines and standards.
  • Service Documentation – Accurately records customer, equipment, technical, and repair information.
  • Technical Escalation – Escalates complex issues appropriately and records troubleshooting activities.
  • Values Differences – Recognises the value of diverse perspectives and experiences.

job.title: IT Business Analyst - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

Partners with business functions to define, determine, analyze, document and communicate the objectives, business requirements and priorities for information systems and solutions; works with application and technical experts on the solution design, implementation, support, maintenance and enhancement of the information systems.

Key Responsibilities

Leads the effort, working with the business, to define and document what constitutes business success for medium to large size initiatives within a single organization. Elicits, analyzes, and documents functional requirements across the five aspects (process, information, event, socio-political, and location), as appropriate for the large initiative. May either lead or work as part of a team to gather requirements. Elicits, analyzes, and documents non-functional business requirements Leads or conducts requirements management activities, as necessary, ensuring that the impact of changes are well understood and approved by the appropriate stakeholders within the organization. Leads or conducts solution assessment and validation to ensure that functional and technical specifications meet the identified business needs within the organization Reviews test plans and testing methodology to mitigate risks and participates in testing the solution to ensure the solution meets functional and non-functional requirements within the organization Conducts problem analysis as needed. Escalates complex issues for additional analysis and resolution as appropriate. Acts as a point of escalation for moderate to difficult problems. Develops positive relationships with both the business and other functions involved in downstream technical processes May coach and mentor less experienced business analysts Maintain strong relationships to deliver business value using relevant Business Relationship Management practices.

Competencies:

Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Strategic mindset - Seeing ahead to future possibilities and translating them into breakthrough strategies.

Business Analysis Planning - Identifies the activities needed to conduct business analysis considering the five business aspects, level of detail, and approach for eliciting requirements to plan for resources and techniques to document the business needs and solution characteristics.

Requirements Analysis - Evaluates relationships and interdependencies between requirements based upon their complexity and value to the business in order to determine feasibility and prioritization.

Requirements Elicitation - Discovers and documents functional and non-functional requirements using the Business Analysis Toolkit (modeling the five aspects and creating use cases) to effectively communicate the business needs and solution characteristics for solution design.

Solution Assessment and Validation - Assesses the proposed solution using the requirements traceability through the life cycle of the requirements to determine if they deliver the desired business outcome.

Solution Design - Creates and defines the solution design complete with instrumentation and measurement, using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to synthesize diagrams, models and documentation in order to build a solution that meets buildability, business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.

Solution Functional Fit Analysis - Composes and decomposes a system into its component parts using procedures, tools and work aides for the purpose of studying how well the component parts were designed, purchased and configured to interact holistically to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Project Issue and Risk Management - Manages the process to identify, assess and prioritize issues and risks using recommended tools and disciplines. Drives actions to minimize, monitor and control risks and issues and to maximize the most positive outcomes possible.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Business Need Definition - Defines the business outcome that the proposed work will provide using the Business Analysis Toolkit (modeling the five aspects and creating use cases) to justify investment of resources (people, time, finances).

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Intermediate level of relevant work experience required. 3-5 years of experience.

Summary

Seeking a Salesforce Functional Analyst to support the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of Salesforce solutions across the EAME region. This role acts as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions that drive operational excellence, user adoption, and business value. This position will play a key role throughout the project lifecycle—from requirements gathering and solution design through testing, training, deployment, and post-go-live support. This position requires strong stakeholder management skills, hands-on Salesforce configuration experience, and a passion for enabling business transformation through digital technologies.

Key Responsible:

  • Elicit, document, and validate business requirements from regional stakeholders across EAME markets
  • Translate requirements into functional specifications and Salesforce solution designs
  • Configure Salesforce including flows, validation rules, page layouts, reports, and dashboards
  • Lead and coordinate UAT — writing test scripts, managing defect logs, and facilitating business sign-off
  • Design and deliver end-user training programmes: materials, job aids, and live sessions
  • Drive change management activities: impact assessments, stakeholder engagement plans, communications, and adoption tracking
  • Support go-live planning, hyper-care periods, and post-deployment stabilisation
  • Manage the enhancement backlog and sprint prioritisation with the product owner
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Europe and Middle East regions

Core experience

  • 3+ years in a Salesforce functional role
  • Sales Cloud & Service Cloud configuration
  • CPQ / Revenue Cloud exposure
  • Data modelling & object design
  • Salesforce Flow & declarative automation
  • Reports, dashboards & analytics
  • Integration awareness (APIs, middleware)

Preferred certifications

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator
  • Sales Cloud Consultant
  • Service Cloud Consultant
  • CPQ Specialist (advantageous)
  • Agent Force

job.title: Senior Project Engineer - Power Generation
job.description:
Job Summary

This role is based at our Pooraka Branch, South Australia, where you will join our expanding Power Generation team providing technical leadership and application engineering support for projects across Data Centres, Energy Management, Healthcare, Commercial Buildings, Industrial Facilities, Utilities, Mining, and other critical infrastructure sectors.

Working closely with customers, consulting engineers, EPC contractors, project managers, and Cummins teams across the Asia Pacific region, you will develop reliable, high-performance, and cost-effective power generation solutions that meet both technical and commercial requirements.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Develop technical solutions for diesel and gas generator systems, power generation packages, and integrated power solutions.
  • Engage directly with customers, consulting engineers, EPC contractors, and internal stakeholders to understand technical and commercial requirements.
  • Prepare and review technical specifications, single line diagrams, system architecture, equipment schedules, and engineering documentation.
  • Provide on-site expertise during installation and commissioning of equipment, ensuring we provide a high quality and safe solution for our customers.
  • Review electrical and mechanical system designs to ensure compliance with Australian Standards, customer specifications, and Cummins engineering guidelines.
  • Provide technical leadership throughout project execution including design reviews, factory acceptance testing (FAT), site installation, commissioning, and project close-out.
  • Work collaboratively with Sales, Service, Project Management, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to ensure successful project delivery.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • A bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Mechanical engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years' experience in power generation, electrical infrastructure, critical power, or industrial power systems.
  • Experience delivering technical solutions for industries such as Data Centres, Healthcare, Mining, Commercial Buildings, Utilities, Manufacturing, or Infrastructure.
  • Experience creating and reviewing engineering drawings, electrical schematics, technical specifications, and project documentation.
  • Strong understanding of Australian Standards and relevant electrical codes.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to work effectively with customers, consultants, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.

Desirable traits for the role include:

  • Knowledge of SCADA, PLCs, Building Management Systems (BMS), or Power Management Systems.
  • Design drafting skills, Autocad, Creo, Solidworks or similar.
  • Experience with Cummins, CAT, MTU, Kohler, or other power generation equipment.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Flexible Lifestyle – Monday to Friday (Hybrid)
  • Competitive salary package
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • Income Protection continuance insurance
  • Discounts with select private health insurance, PC software/hardware and a range of vehicles.
  • Annual remuneration review
  • Participation in an annual variable compensation (bonus) program
  • A range of personal and professional benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program available to employees
  • Paid Parental leave (Conditions apply)

Responsibilities

The successful applicant will be responsible for working independently and leading a small team of engineers towards successful completion of engineering projects with a key focus on systems engineering. This role requires a blend of mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, systems engineering, team leadership and project/task management skills. This role will have no direct reports.

This role requires occasional extended travel both within Australia and Internationally in support of project needs. This typically involves travel to a Cummins or sub-supplier facility or to a construction site, and providing engineering expertise in the construction phase or witnessing or performance of testing/commissioning. Some work sites may be in remote areas.

In support of wider power generation projects, the successful applicant will have the opportunity to lead a multi-discipline team of engineers and to support other Lead Engineers in the deployment of major projects.

  • Engineering support for major projects, provide technical solution/proposal,
  • Mentor junior engineers and engineering interns,
  • Be the key conduit and liaison for Project Managers to plan and direct works
  • Assess a project for required engineering input,
  • Identify and manage technical risk within a project,
  • Develop an engineering delivery plan appropriate to the project’s needs,
  • Lead a team of other engineers, external consultants and sub-suppliers in the delivery of the engineering plan,
  • Work with other lead engineers towards the delivery of other projects as necessary,
  • Interface with customers and sub-suppliers on engineering matters,
  • Asist the Engineering Leadership Team in the development of standardised work practices towards a continuous improvement goal,

The preferred applicant would be able to demonstrate:

  • Extensive experience in previous project delivery (power generation, green energy, distribution, substation, high voltage, switchgear, mining, rail, defence, heavy industry, construction or similar),
  • Create, review and critique designs, test plans, procedures and reports,
  • Adhere to ISO 9001 quality work practices,
  • Assess engineering risks in accordance with ISO 31000,
  • Develop and maintain engineering deliverable plans while tracking task progress for their team as a key conduit for the Project Management team,
  • Task planning and basic project management skills
  • Customer facing skills,
  • Maintain an interdependent safety culture within their team,

Job Engineering

job.title: Senior Project Engineer - Power Generation
job.description:
Job Summary

This role is based at our Carole Park Branch, Queensland, where you will join our expanding Power Generation team providing technical leadership and application engineering support for projects across Data Centres, Energy Management, Healthcare, Commercial Buildings, Industrial Facilities, Utilities, Mining, and other critical infrastructure sectors. Working closely with customers, consulting engineers, EPC contractors, project managers, and Cummins teams across the Asia Pacific region, you will develop reliable, high-performance, and cost-effective power generation solutions that meet both technical and commercial requirements.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Develop technical solutions for diesel and gas generator systems, power generation packages, and integrated power solutions.
  • Engage directly with customers, consulting engineers, EPC contractors, and internal stakeholders to understand technical and commercial requirements.
  • Prepare and review technical specifications, single line diagrams, system architecture, equipment schedules, and engineering documentation.
  • Provide on-site expertise during installation and commissioning of equipment, ensuring we provide a high quality and safe solution for our customers.
  • Review electrical and mechanical system designs to ensure compliance with Australian Standards, customer specifications, and Cummins engineering guidelines.
  • Provide technical leadership throughout project execution including design reviews, factory acceptance testing (FAT), site installation, commissioning, and project close-out.
  • Work collaboratively with Sales, Service, Project Management, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to ensure successful project delivery.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • A bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Mechanical engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years' experience in power generation, electrical infrastructure, critical power, or industrial power systems.
  • Experience delivering technical solutions for industries such as Data Centres, Healthcare, Mining, Commercial Buildings, Utilities, Manufacturing, or Infrastructure.
  • Experience creating and reviewing engineering drawings, electrical schematics, technical specifications, and project documentation.
  • Strong understanding of Australian Standards and relevant electrical codes.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to work effectively with customers, consultants, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.

Desirable traits for the role include:

  • Knowledge of SCADA, PLCs, Building Management Systems (BMS), or Power Management Systems.
  • Design drafting skills, Autocad, Creo, Solidworks or similar.
  • Experience with Cummins, CAT, MTU, Kohler, or other power generation equipment.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Flexible Lifestyle – Monday to Friday (Hybrid)
  • Competitive salary package
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • Income Protection continuance insurance
  • Discounts with select private health insurance, PC software/hardware and a range of vehicles.
  • Annual remuneration review
  • Participation in an annual variable compensation (bonus) program
  • A range of personal and professional benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program available to employees
  • Paid Parental leave (Conditions apply)

Responsibilities

The successful applicant will be responsible for working independently and leading a small team of engineers towards successful completion of engineering projects with a key focus on systems engineering. This role requires a blend of mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, systems engineering, team leadership and project/task management skills. This role will have no direct reports.

This role requires occasional extended travel both within Australia and Internationally in support of project needs. This typically involves travel to a Cummins or sub-supplier facility or to a construction site, and providing engineering expertise in the construction phase or witnessing or performance of testing/commissioning. Some work sites may be in remote areas.

In support of wider power generation projects, the successful applicant will have the opportunity to lead a multi-discipline team of engineers and to support other Lead Engineers in the deployment of major projects.

  • Engineering support for major projects, provide technical solution/proposal,
  • Mentor junior engineers and engineering interns,
  • Be the key conduit and liaison for Project Managers to plan and direct works
  • Assess a project for required engineering input,
  • Identify and manage technical risk within a project,
  • Develop an engineering delivery plan appropriate to the project’s needs,
  • Lead a team of other engineers, external consultants and sub-suppliers in the delivery of the engineering plan,
  • Work with other lead engineers towards the delivery of other projects as necessary,
  • Interface with customers and sub-suppliers on engineering matters,
  • Asist the Engineering Leadership Team in the development of standardised work practices towards a continuous improvement goal,

The preferred applicant would be able to demonstrate:

  • Extensive experience in previous project delivery (power generation, green energy, distribution, substation, high voltage, switchgear, mining, rail, defence, heavy industry, construction or similar),
  • Create, review and critique designs, test plans, procedures and reports,
  • Adhere to ISO 9001 quality work practices,
  • Assess engineering risks in accordance with ISO 31000,
  • Develop and maintain engineering deliverable plans while tracking task progress for their team as a key conduit for the Project Management team,
  • Task planning and basic project management skills
  • Customer facing skills,
  • Maintain an interdependent safety culture within their team,

job.title: Technician – Electrical Field Service
job.description:
Being part of Cummins means working alongside today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems. We are proud to offer learning and development opportunities designed to promote individual performance and spark purpose and trust within our teams. We look to hire the best and then help you to become even better.

We are looking for a talented Electrical Field Service Technician to join our Power Generation Team in Perth.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Apply documented procedures and policies to complete diagnostics, repairs, and scheduled maintenance on power generation equipment in field-based environments, including preparing required parts and tools.
  • Perform on-site disassembly, inspection, and reassembly of power generation systems.
  • Assist with completing required documentation, such as work completed reports, time sheets, warranty claims, and quality forms via handwritten forms or business system input screens.
  • Complete training in line with skill and business requirements.
  • Maintain tools, service vehicles, and work areas to ensure cleanliness and proper operation.
  • Ensure adherence to all relevant Health, Safety, and Environmental policies, procedures, and legislation while working on customer sites, and report any issues/incidents to their supervisor.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Effective communication and accountability when working autonomously in the field.
  • Strong problem-solving ability with nimble learning and planning skills.
  • Commitment to health and safety in dynamic site environments.
  • Proficiency in electrical diagnostics and electronic service tools.
  • Knowledge of power generation systems, electrical fault finding, and product repair.
  • Experience in service documentation, customer interaction, and technical escalation.
  • Recognise the value of diverse perspectives.

At Cummins, we are an equal opportunity employer dedicated to diversity in the workplace. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to race, gender, colour, disability, national origin, age, religion, union affiliation, sexual orientation, veteran status, citizenship, gender identity and/or expression, or other status protected by law.

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Power Generation Systems Knowledge - Demonstrates knowledge of Cummins and industry standards by complying with all safe work procedures including Personal Protective Equipment to create a safe work environment; interprets and analyzes Power Generation system operation and integration (switch gear, power system controls, uninterruptable power supply, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Apprentice Certified Power Generation/ Electrical Technician (Preferred)

Vocational diploma from relevant technical institution

Current relevant electrical certification

Locally valid driving permit

Experience

Basic level field service work experience

Intermediate level knowledge of and/or experience with of power generation products

High Voltage/ Low Voltage experience

Customer service experience

A Grade electrical license essential

job.title: Data Engineer 4
job.description:
Job Summary

Supports, develops and maintains a data and analytics platform. Effectively and efficiently process, store and make data available to analysts and other consumers. Works with the Business and IT teams to understand the requirements to best leverage the technologies to enable agile data delivery at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Implements and automates deployment of our distributed system for ingesting and transforming data from various types of sources (relational, event-based, unstructured). Implements methods to continuously monitor and troubleshoot data quality and data integrity issues. Implements data governance processes and methods for managing metadata, access, retention to data for internal and external users. Develops reliable, efficient, scalable and quality data pipelines with monitoring and alert mechanisms that combine a variety of sources using ETL/ELT tools or scripting languages. Develops physical data models and implements data storage architectures as per design guidelines. Analyzes complex data elements and systems, data flow, dependencies, and relationships in order to contribute to conceptual physical and logical data models. Participates in testing and troubleshooting of data pipelines. Develops and operates large scale data storage and processing solutions using different distributed and cloud based platforms for storing data (e.g. Data Lakes, Hadoop, Hbase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Accumulo, DynamoDB, others). Uses agile development technologies, such as DevOps, Scrum, Kanban and continuous improvement cycle, for data driven application.

Competencies:

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Data Extraction - Performs data extract-transform-load (ETL) activities from variety of sources and transforms them for consumption by various downstream applications and users using appropriate tools and technologies.

Programming - Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.

Quality Assurance Metrics - Applies the science of measurement to assess whether a solution meets its intended outcomes using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including the SDLC standards, tools, metrics and key performance indicators, to deliver a quality product.

Solution Documentation - Documents information and solution based on knowledge gained as part of product development activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Data Quality - Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.

Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree in relevant technical discipline, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Relevant experience preferred such as working in a temporary student employment, intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities.

Knowledge of the latest technologies in data engineering is highly preferred and includes:

  • Exposure to Big Data open source
  • SPARK, Scala/Java, Map-Reduce, Hive, Hbase, and Kafka or equivalent college coursework
  • SQL query language
  • Clustered compute cloud-based implementation experience
  • Familiarity developing applications requiring large file movement for a Cloud-based environment
  • Exposure to Agile software development
  • Exposure to building analytical solutions
  • Exposure to IoT technology

Core Responsibilities Unique to the Role

1) Develop and maintain enterprise data products by building data pipelines, data transformations, and curated datasets that support reporting, analytics, automation, and GenAI use cases across Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Product Lifecycle, and other Enterprise Products domains.

2) Apply Data-as-a-Product principles to create reusable, discoverable, and governed data assets with appropriate metadata, lineage, and quality controls, enabling self-service consumption and consistent business outcomes across multiple consumers.

3)

Collaborate with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Solution Engineers to support delivery of AI-ready data products by ensuring data is reliable, well-structured, and optimized for analytics, machine learning, and GenAI applications.

Required Skills, Education, or Experience

1) Experience developing and supporting data integration, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and data transformations using modern data platforms and cloud-based technologies.

2) Working knowledge of data modeling, SQL, data quality practices, metadata management, and data governance principles supporting enterprise-scale data products.

3) Ability to translate business and product requirements into efficient technical solutions while considering scalability, performance, maintainability, and reusability.

4) Experience working in Agile, cross-functional teams and collaborating effectively with product, engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.

5) Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred (Nice to Have) Skills, Education, or Experience

1) Experience working within a Data-as-a-Product operating model, including exposure to data catalogs, lineage, data quality frameworks, and certified data products.

2) Exposure to AI/ML or GenAI initiatives, including preparation of AI-ready datasets, semantic models, knowledge assets, or data structures supporting intelligent business solutions.

job.title: Project Manager - Supply Chain Planning
job.description:
Manages, develops, and implements supply chain planning and order management projects of varying complexity and size. Partners with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to define project objectives, establish plans and timelines, manage risks and resources, and deliver sustainable solutions. Acts as a subject matter expert in Oracle EBS Order Management, EDI, and related supply chain processes while driving continuous improvement and change management initiatives across global teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead multiple supply chain planning and order management projects from initiation through successful completion, ensuring delivery against agreed scope, timelines, and business objectives.
  • Facilitate project planning sessions with internal stakeholders to define scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, resources, and performance measures.
  • Deploy Order Management initiatives and projects in line with agreed objectives, priorities, and timelines.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, IT, supply chain, and global cross-functional teams to design and implement sustainable global order management solutions.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in Oracle EBS Order Management , EDI, Release Management (RLM), processing rules, CUM management, forecasting solutions, and data management.
  • Provide expertise across key EDI transactions, including Planning (830), Sequenced (866), Shipping (862), Purchase Orders (850), Order Acknowledgment (855/865), Shipment Notification (856), and Invoicing (810).
  • Act as an Order Management process owner, supporting the end-to-end flow from source systems through order fulfillment at plants.
  • Develop project plans, schedules, timelines, milestones, and resource plans; monitor progress and take corrective action to ensure timely delivery.
  • Identify, assess, prioritize, and manage project risks and issues; work with stakeholders to develop alternatives and effective solutions.
  • Monitor and communicate project status, key risks, dependencies, issues, and performance to project sponsors, stakeholders, and project teams.
  • Plan and monitor project budgets, resources, and other project requirements to support effective execution.
  • Identify and assign appropriate resources to project activities and provide guidance and coaching to team members throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Support user training, adoption, and change management activities associated with new processes, systems, and solutions.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve supply chain performance, process efficiency, customer experience, cost, inventory, and delivery outcomes.
  • Conduct research and analysis to support project decisions and solution development.
  • Document project outcomes, lessons learned, process knowledge, and best practices and share them across teams.
  • Collaborate with global and cross-functional teams across different time zones to achieve project and business objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with internal customers and stakeholders and ensure solutions address business and customer needs.

Skills and Experience

  • Strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes , particularly Order Management and the integration of information, products, and services from source systems through fulfillment.
  • Hands-on or strong working knowledge of Oracle EBS Order Management .
  • Strong knowledge of EDI transactions and file formats , including 830, 866, 862, 850, 855, 865, 856, and 810.
  • Experience with Release Management (RLM), Processing Rules, CUM Management, and forecasting solutions .
  • Experience with supply chain data management and integration across systems.
  • Strong project planning, scheduling, scope, resource, budget, issue, and risk management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while meeting agreed commitments and timelines.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex and sometimes conflicting information and develop practical solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage different audiences across business and technical teams.
  • Experience supporting change management, user training, and implementation of new processes or systems.
  • Strong business acumen and financial awareness, with the ability to understand business drivers and make informed decisions.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across functions, geographies, and organizational levels.
  • Customer-focused approach with the ability to develop and deliver solutions aligned with customer and business requirements.
  • Ability to manage conflict constructively and resolve project issues with minimal disruption.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with global teams across multiple time zones.
  • Ability to recognize and leverage diverse perspectives and cultural differences in a global working environment.
  • Strong documentation, presentation, and project reporting skills.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement and application of project management tools, processes, and best practices.

Qualifications

  • College, university, or equivalent degree required; preferably in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in project management, supply chain, order management, or related functional areas.

job.title: Territory Sales - Field Sales Account Executive
job.description:
Job Summary

The Territory Sales – Field Sales Account Executive is responsible for driving profitable business growth by developing new customer opportunities, managing existing accounts, and executing sales strategies within the assigned territory. The role focuses on building long-term customer relationships, delivering value-based solutions, achieving sales targets, improving dealer performance, and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction while collaborating with cross-functional teams to meet business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, prospect, and develop new business opportunities to expand market presence within the assigned territory.
  • Develop and execute account plans to achieve territory sales objectives and drive sustainable revenue growth.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, dealers, and channel partners to understand their business needs and provide tailored solutions.
  • Conduct customer meetings, sales presentations, and negotiations while following company sales processes and commercial guidelines.
  • Present and communicate the value proposition of Cummins products and solutions to differentiate from competitors.
  • Achieve assigned sales targets, dealership Annual Operating Plan (AOP) commitments, and territory growth objectives.
  • Drive dealer performance by improving parts secondary sales and supporting Power Generation (PowerGen) business initiatives.
  • Manage dealer account receivables, support collections, and ensure timely resolution of outstanding payments.
  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts, monitor pipeline health, and update customer activities through CRM systems.
  • Collaborate with internal teams including service, operations, finance, and supply chain to ensure effective product availability, delivery, and customer support.
  • Respond promptly to customer concerns and deliver high levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Support inventory planning and balance customer expectations with operational capabilities.
  • Manage customer accounts across assigned regions, including Rajasthan, Haryana, and Punjab.

Competencies:

  • Customer Focus
  • Action Oriented
  • Effective Communication
  • Persuasion and Influencing
  • Relationship Management
  • Account Planning and Territory Management
  • Sales Pipeline Management
  • Sales Forecasting
  • Negotiation Excellence
  • Pricing Strategy
  • Value Proposition Development
  • Channel and Market Awareness
  • Customer Insight and Sense Making
  • Business Acumen
  • Cross-functional Collaboration

job.title: Data Engineer 2
job.description:
Job Summary

Supports, develops and maintains a data and analytics platform. Effectively and efficiently process, store and make data available to analysts and other consumers. Works with the Business and IT teams to understand the requirements to best leverage the technologies to enable agile data delivery at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Implements and automates deployment of our distributed system for ingesting and transforming data from various types of sources (relational, event-based, unstructured). Implements methods to continuously monitor and troubleshoot data quality and data integrity issues. Implements data governance processes and methods for managing metadata, access, retention to data for internal and external users. Develops reliable, efficient, scalable and quality data pipelines with monitoring and alert mechanisms that combine a variety of sources using ETL/ELT tools or scripting languages. Develops physical data models and implements data storage architectures as per design guidelines. Analyzes complex data elements and systems, data flow, dependencies, and relationships in order to contribute to conceptual physical and logical data models. Participates in testing and troubleshooting of data pipelines. Develops and operates large scale data storage and processing solutions using different distributed and cloud based platforms for storing data (e.g. Data Lakes, Hadoop, Hbase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Accumulo, DynamoDB, others). Uses agile development technologies, such as DevOps, Scrum, Kanban and continuous improvement cycle, for data driven application.

Competencies:

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Data Extraction - Performs data extract-transform-load (ETL) activities from variety of sources and transforms them for consumption by various downstream applications and users using appropriate tools and technologies.

Programming - Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.

Quality Assurance Metrics - Applies the science of measurement to assess whether a solution meets its intended outcomes using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including the SDLC standards, tools, metrics and key performance indicators, to deliver a quality product.

Solution Documentation - Documents information and solution based on knowledge gained as part of product development activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Data Quality - Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.

Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree in relevant technical discipline, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

3 to 6 Years of relevant experience

Relevant experience preferred such as working in a temporary student employment, intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities.

Knowledge of the latest technologies in data engineering is highly preferred and includes:

  • Exposure to Big Data open source
  • SPARK, Scala/Java, Map-Reduce, Hive, Hbase, and Kafka or equivalent college coursework
  • SQL query language
  • Clustered compute cloud-based implementation experience
  • Familiarity developing applications requiring large file movement for a Cloud-based environment
  • Exposure to Agile software development
  • Exposure to building analytical solutions
  • Exposure to IoT technology

Core Responsibilities Unique to the Role

1) Develop and maintain enterprise data products by building data pipelines, data transformations, and curated datasets that support reporting, analytics, automation, and GenAI use cases across Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Product Lifecycle, and other Enterprise Products domains.

2) Apply Data-as-a-Product principles to create reusable, discoverable, and governed data assets with appropriate metadata, lineage, and quality controls, enabling self-service consumption and consistent business outcomes across multiple consumers.

3)

Collaborate with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Solution Engineers to support delivery of AI-ready data products by ensuring data is reliable, well-structured, and optimized for analytics, machine learning, and GenAI applications.

Required Skills, Education, or Experience

1) Experience developing and supporting data integration, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and data transformations using modern data platforms and cloud-based technologies.

2) Working knowledge of data modeling, SQL, data quality practices, metadata management, and data governance principles supporting enterprise-scale data products.

3) Ability to translate business and product requirements into efficient technical solutions while considering scalability, performance, maintainability, and reusability.

4) Experience working in Agile, cross-functional teams and collaborating effectively with product, engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.

5) Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred (Nice to Have) Skills, Education, or Experience

1) Experience working within a Data-as-a-Product operating model, including exposure to data catalogs, lineage, data quality frameworks, and certified data products.

2) Exposure to AI/ML or GenAI initiatives, including preparation of AI-ready datasets, semantic models, knowledge assets, or data structures supporting intelligent business solutions.

job.title: Senior Project Engineer - Power Generation
job.description:
This role is based at our Wetherill Park, NSW office, where you will join our expanding Power Generation team providing technical leadership and application engineering support for projects across Data Centres, Energy Management, Healthcare, Commercial Buildings, Industrial Facilities, Utilities, Mining, and other critical infrastructure sectors.

Working closely with customers, consulting engineers, EPC contractors, project managers, and Cummins teams across the Asia Pacific region, you will develop reliable, high-performance, and cost-effective power generation solutions that meet both technical and commercial requirements.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Develop technical solutions for diesel and gas generator systems, power generation packages, and integrated power solutions.
  • Engage directly with customers, consulting engineers, EPC contractors, and internal stakeholders to understand technical and commercial requirements.
  • Prepare and review technical specifications, single line diagrams, system architecture, equipment schedules, and engineering documentation.
  • Evaluate customer specifications and provide technical compliance, deviations, and value engineering recommendations.
  • Support tender submissions by preparing technical proposals and ensuring solutions meet customer and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide on-site expertise during installation and commissioning of equipment, ensuring we provide a high quality and safe solution for our customers.
  • Review electrical and mechanical system designs to ensure compliance with Australian Standards, customer specifications, and Cummins engineering guidelines.
  • Provide technical leadership throughout project execution including design reviews, factory acceptance testing (FAT), site installation, commissioning, and project close-out.
  • Work collaboratively with Sales, Service, Project Management, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior engineers where required.
  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, project delivery, and customer outcomes.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • A Washington Accord recognised bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Mechanical engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years' experience in power generation, electrical infrastructure, critical power, or industrial power systems.
  • Experience delivering technical solutions for industries such as Data Centres, Healthcare, Mining, Commercial Buildings, Utilities, Manufacturing, or Infrastructure.
  • Experience creating and reviewing engineering drawings, electrical schematics, technical specifications, and project documentation.
  • Strong understanding of Australian Standards and relevant electrical codes.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to work effectively with customers, consultants, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
  • Experience with commissioning or field support of generator systems or other electrical power, or large industrial equipment.
  • Strong knowledge of generator systems, synchronisation, switchgear, control systems, ATS, paralleling systems, and power distribution.

Desirable traits for the role include:

  • Knowledge of SCADA, PLCs, Building Management Systems (BMS), or Power Management Systems.
  • Experience with Cummins, CAT, MTU, Kohler, or other power generation equipment.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Flexible Lifestyle – Monday to Friday (Hybrid)
  • Competitive salary package
  • Further training provided on site.
  • Income Protection continuance insurance
  • Discounts with select private health insurance, PC software/hardware and a range of vehicles.
  • Annual remuneration review
  • Participation in an annual variable compensation (bonus) program
  • A range of personal and professional benefits
  • Onsite parking
  • Employee Assistance Program available to employees
  • Paid Parental leave (Conditions apply)

Our culture believes in _POWERING YOUR POTENTIAL_ . We provide global opportunities to develop your career, make your community a better place and work with today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems.

We believe in flexibility for you to explore your passions while making an impact through meaningful work within our inclusive workforce. That’s what _\#LifeAtCummins_ is all about.
