job.title: Engine Field Service Technician - Level II
job.description:
Job Summary

The Engine Field Service Technician – Level II is responsible for diagnosing, maintaining, and completing less complex repairs on engines and related components at customer sites. The role requires a strong customer focus, sound technical knowledge, effective troubleshooting skills, and adherence to Cummins’ safety, quality, and service standards.

The role may be considered for both internal and external candidates , based on relevant qualifications, technical capability, experience, and business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Diagnose and complete less complex repairs on engines and related components at customer sites using approved procedures, service publications, specialized tools, and electronic service tools.
  • Engage with customers in a courteous and professional manner, understand their needs, and provide prompt and effective service solutions.
  • Translate customer complaints into structured troubleshooting plans and identify failed components through appropriate diagnostic methods.
  • Perform preventive maintenance activities in accordance with documented schedules, procedures, and technical standards.
  • Identify, prepare, and use the required parts, tools, equipment, and service information to complete repairs efficiently and accurately.
  • Apply knowledge of engine mechanical and electrical systems, including fuel, cooling, exhaust, aftertreatment, sensors, controls, and related systems, to diagnose and resolve issues.
  • Validate completed repairs by confirming that the reported issue has been resolved and the equipment is operating as required.
  • Escalate unresolved or complex technical issues to experienced Field Service Technicians, technical experts, or the Supervisor, as appropriate.
  • Accurately complete service documentation, including service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality records, and required information in business systems.
  • Maintain accurate customer, equipment, technical, and troubleshooting records to support service history and future diagnostics.
  • Identify additional service opportunities and communicate relevant customer needs to support service excellence.
  • Maintain service vehicles, tools, and equipment in a clean, safe, and operational condition.
  • Complete required technical and developmental training in line with individual skill requirements and business needs.
  • Comply with all applicable Health, Safety & Environmental policies, procedures, standards, and legislation, and promptly report incidents, hazards, or other concerns to site management and the Supervisor.
  • Promote a professional, customer-focused, and safety-oriented approach across all field service activities.

Key Competencies

  • Effective Communication: Communicates clearly and professionally across different audiences and situations.
  • Customer Focus: Builds positive customer relationships and delivers solutions aligned with customer needs.
  • Diagnostics & Troubleshooting: Uses structured troubleshooting approaches, technical information, service tools, and measurements to identify and resolve product issues.
  • Electronic Service Tool Application: Selects and effectively uses appropriate electronic hardware and software tools for diagnosis, maintenance, and repair.
  • Engine Systems Knowledge: Understands the interaction between mechanical and electrical engine systems and applies this knowledge to field diagnostics and repair.
  • Product Repair & Maintenance: Performs repairs, maintenance, component replacement, disassembly, and assembly in accordance with approved procedures and quality standards.
  • Service Documentation: Accurately records technical information, troubleshooting activities, repairs, and service outcomes in the required systems.
  • Technical Escalation: Recognizes issues requiring additional expertise and escalates them appropriately while ensuring complete documentation of troubleshooting performed.
  • Health & Safety: Demonstrates proactive safety behavior, identifies hazards, follows HSE requirements, and contributes to a safe working environment.
  • Manages Complexity: Analyzes technical information and applies sound judgment to resolve field service issues.
  • Self-Development: Demonstrates a willingness to learn, develop technical capability, and complete required training.
  • Develops Talent: Supports knowledge sharing and contributes to the development of colleagues where appropriate.
  • Values Differences: Works effectively with people from diverse backgrounds and values different perspectives.

Qualifications

  • Vocational diploma/certificate from a relevant technical institution.
  • Apprentice-trained Engine Technician qualification is preferred.
  • Locally valid driving permit/license.
  • Any additional technical certifications relevant to engine, mechanical, electrical, or field service activities would be advantageous.
  • The position may require applicable licensing or authorization to comply with export control and sanctions regulations.

Skills

  • Basic to intermediate troubleshooting and diagnostic skills for engines and related systems.
  • Ability to use mechanical and electronic service tools and diagnostic equipment.
  • Ability to interpret service manuals, technical publications, diagnostic results, and repair procedures.
  • Basic understanding of mechanical and electrical engine systems.
  • Ability to perform preventive maintenance and less complex repairs independently.
  • Good customer service and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to accurately complete service reports, warranty documentation, timesheets, and electronic service records.
  • Good problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work safely and effectively at customer sites.
  • Ability to identify when technical escalation is required.
  • Willingness to travel and work in field/customer-site environments as required.

Experience

  • Basic level field service experience is preferred.
  • Intermediate-level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products.
  • Experience in engine maintenance, repair, troubleshooting, or related technical service environments.
  • Customer service experience, preferably in a technical or field service environment.
  • Experience using diagnostic tools, service software, and technical documentation would be advantageous.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be a technically capable and customer-focused professional who can independently handle routine field service activities and less complex engine repairs while recognizing when issues require escalation. The candidate should demonstrate strong safety awareness, willingness to learn, disciplined service documentation, and the ability to build effective customer relationships.

Key account manager service for HHP segment.

Adherence to Service Level Agreement (SLA), HSE guidelines and other business compliance.

  • Have clear understanding of contract scope and discuss with all the concerned at dealership on the commencement of any new contract.
  • Support dealership and solution team to prepare an accurate PM schedule.
  • Failure trend analysis especially under LHP CAMC and ensure stocking of parts as per FTA through DAMs.
  • Ensure the team reviews open SRN regularly and supporting dealership on PM and breakdown SLA compliance.
  • Ensure 100 % utilization of contract cap value. Have a monthly review of parts consumption to be tracked and ensure consumption of supplied parts are as per agreed cap value of individual contract. Prepare proactive maintenances and parts replacement in order to prevent breakdowns and share with the customer as per capped value yearly.
  • Ensure that vendor evaluation score should be above 95% for all the CAMC customers

Develop relationship with customer

  • Prepare and update key / CAMC customer profiles highlighting decision-making positions. Update yearly
  • Plan proactive customer engagement and comply. Plan monthly 10 customer / month
  • Create 100% activities against all the action points decided in the meeting and track to close as per the agreed timelines. Also keep the customer posted with updates for the Open action items. Within 3 days of the meeting.
  • Conduct QBR / MIS with key CAMC customers. Quarterly
  • Identify critical success factor of all the key customer in the region and prepare customer support plan accordingly.
  • Aim to improve the percentage of customer issues resolved on the first contact, minimizing escalations and enhancing overall customer satisfaction.

PM Quality Enhancement

  • ensure that all CAMC service KAMs carryout service quality audits at least for 5 DGs in a month based on 2 previous PMs done and share report with HOD, maintain a tracker with before and after audit status.

  • Drive alternator maintenance compliance with all the CAMC customers. Increase in Alternator maintenance SRNs by 20% over previous year.
  • Conduct health checks and lube oil sample analysis. Prepare and release an yearly plan and release compliance status monthly.

Predictive Maintenance Drive

  • Analyse service data of 5 Key customer's in the area at least for last 2 years and identify parts support gaps and failure trend and take proactive measures to prevent the failures for HHP/LHP at key customers. Publish the analysis once in 6 months.
  • Identify the engines having clocked more than 5000 hours or 5 years, whichever is earlier and carry out health check ups to demonstrate our value added services to customer.

職務描述

We are looking for a Sourcer to join our Procurement Team and support supplier sourcing, cost management, and supply capability development.

This role works closely with Engineering, Operations, Finance, Product Management, and suppliers to ensure sourcing activities support business growth, operational stability, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate enjoys solving business problems through structured analysis, supplier collaboration, and practical execution. You do not need to know everything from day one — but we value people who are curious, organized, and willing to take ownership beyond assigned tasks.

This position provides opportunities to gradually develop sourcing capability through supplier exposure, project participation, and cross-functional collaboration.

職責

ESSENTIAL  DUTIES  AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Cost Analysis & Sourcing Execution

  • Review and analyze component spend, sourcing opportunities, and cost structure then further to set up sourcing strategy.
  • Execute RFQ, quotation comparison, bidding activities, and commercial negotiations.
  • Support annual standard cost review and cost reduction initiatives.
  • Perform sourcing analysis including TCO (Total Cost of Ownership), cost comparison, and business case evaluation.
  • Maintain sourcing and procurement data in ERP systems (e.g. standard cost, MOQ, lead time, PIR, source list).
  • Execute risk mitigation, business continuity, cost management, and operation strategies

Supplier Development & Supplier Management

  • Develop and maintain relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Manage supplier onboarding, approval, and supplier master data maintenance.
  • Manage supplier agreements, payment terms, and Incoterms alignment.
  • Support supplier qualification, audits, supplier performance reviews, and supplier scorecard activities.
  • Maintain supplier records and support supplier-related compliance requirements.
  • Conduct regular business review with suppliers to ensure continuous improvement (ex: cost, capacity or operation excellence…)

Product Sourcing & Project Support

  • Work with Engineering to support sample sourcing and component qualification.
  • Participate in new projects, product launch, and pilot run activities.
  • Support product lifecycle management including EOL control, second source development, last-time-buy execution, and sourcing readiness.
  • Manage sourcing-related documentation and approval processes.

Supplier Performance & Operational Improvement

  • Coordinate supplier quality-related topics and commercial recovery activities when applicable.
  • Support KPI reporting, process documentation, and sourcing operational excellence initiatives.

Sustainability & Business Compliance

  • Manage ESG / CSR related activities of suppliers.
  • Support environmental and carbon-related data collection where required.
  • Assist with company compliance and supplier governance initiatives.

資格

REQUIREMENTS/QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Electronics, Business, Operations, or related disciplines.
  • 5-10 years of experience in Procurement, Sourcing, Supply Chain, Supplier Management, Engineering support, or related functions.
  • Familiar with Microsoft Excel and ERP systems (SAP preferred).
  • Business-level English communication capability.
  • Experience with sourcing, supplier interaction, or manufacturing environment is preferred.

DESIRED KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS

We value people who demonstrate：

  • Ownership and accountability
  • Curiosity to understand how products and supply chains work
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management
  • Ability to organize information and drive follow-up actions
  • Structured thinking and problem-solving capability
  • Ability to balance execution quality and business speed
  • Continuous learning mindset and willingness to improve existing ways of working

Success in this role looks like：

  • Supplier activities move forward with clear ownership
  • Cost and sourcing opportunities are identified proactively
  • Cross-functional collaboration becomes more efficient
  • Operational issues are solved with sustainable improvements
  • Gradual growth toward independently managing sourcing activities

Buyer

新北市, 台灣(On-site)

職務資訊

  • 職務識別241
  • 公告日期2026/07/02 下午11:30
  • 學位學士學位
  • 工作時程全職
  • 地點5F,No.121,Lane 235,Baoqiao Road Xindian District, New Taipei, 231, TW(On-site)
  • BrandRaritan
  • Employment typeRegular
  • Travel RequiredNo
  • 職務類目Purchasing

職務描述

We are looking for a Buyer to join our Procurement Team and support purchasing execution and supply operations.

This role is responsible for managing purchase orders, coordinating supplier delivery, and supporting stable material supply to meet business and production requirements.

The ideal candidate enjoys organizing information, solving operational issues, and collaborating across functions to move things forward. You do not need to know everything from day one — but we value people who take ownership, follow through, and continuously improve the way work gets done.

This position provides opportunities to develop procurement capability through supplier interaction, operational exposure, and cross-functional collaboration.

職責

ESSENTIAL DUTIES  AND  RESPONSIBILITIES

Procurement & Supply Execution

  • Convert purchase requests into purchase orders and maintain purchasing records in ERP systems.
  • Issue purchase orders and coordinate order execution with suppliers.
  • Monitor delivery schedules and follow up supply status to support business requirements.
  • Support order adjustments, long-term order planning, and pre-order preparation when required.
  • Coordinate operational issues across internal teams and suppliers to ensure smooth order execution.
  • Support pricing discussions for specific purchasing scenarios when applicable.

Supplier Coordination & Operational Support

  • Work with suppliers to confirm delivery commitments and resolve operational issues.
  • Maintain order status visibility and support issue escalation when necessary.
  • Coordinate purchasing-related transactions and support cross-business unit collaboration.
  • Build productive working relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Invoice & Procurement Administration

  • Monitor supplier invoice submission and support invoice reconciliation activities.
  • Coordinate with Finance to resolve invoice-related issues and ensure transaction accuracy.
  • Maintain procurement documentation and system records.

Quality Coordination & Issue Follow-up

  • Coordinate supplier responses for quality issues and corrective action follow-up.
  • Support defect return processes and purchasing-related system transactions.
  • Track issue closure and support supplier communication when required.
  • Participate in activities to improve supply quality and operational effectiveness.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Participate in KPI reviews, project meetings, pilot runs, and improvement activities.
  • Follow up agreed actions and support execution alignment across teams.
  • Build and maintain SOPs and operational documentation where applicable.
  • Complete training plans and contribute to internal improvement initiatives.
  • Support additional assignments and cross-functional projects as required.

資格

REQUIREMENTS/QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, or related disciplines.
  • 0–3 years of experience in Procurement, Purchasing, Supply Chain, Operations, or related functions.
  • Fresh graduates are welcome.
  • Familiar with Microsoft Excel and ERP systems (SAP experience is preferred).
  • Basic understanding of procurement processes and supply chain concepts.
  • Good English communication capability.

DESIRED KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS

We value people who demonstrate：

  • Ownership and accountability
  • Strong attention to detail and execution discipline
  • Ability to organize information and manage priorities
  • Good communication and stakeholder coordination
  • Structured problem-solving mindset
  • Adaptability in a fast-changing environment
  • Curiosity to understand business operations and supply chain flow
  • Willingness to improve processes instead of repeatedly solving the same issues

Success in this role looks like：

  • Purchase orders are executed accurately and on time
  • Supply issues are identified and communicated early
  • Suppliers and internal teams experience efficient coordination
  • Daily operations become more stable and predictable
  • Gradual growth toward independently managing procurement activities
  • We trust people to own outcomes, not just execute tasks.

關於我們

About Legrand

Legrand is the global specialist in electrical and digital building infrastructures. Our comprehensive offering of solutions for residential, commercial, and data center markets makes us a benchmark for customers worldwide. We harness technological and societal trends with lasting impacts on buildings with the purpose of improving life by transforming the spaces where people live, work, and meet with electrical and digital infrastructures and connected solutions that are simple, innovative, and sustainable. Legrand is a global, publicly traded company listed on the Euronext (Legrand SA EPA: LR). For more information, visit www.legrandgroup.com/en

About Legrand North and Central America

Legrand, North & Central America (LNCA) is a leader in the AV, Lighting & Controls, Electrical, and Data Center markets. LNCA offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as distinctive benefits like a high employer 401K match, paid time off (PTO) and holiday pay, short-term and long-term disability benefit plans, above-benchmark paid maternity and parental leave, bonus opportunities in accordance with the Company’s incentive plans, paid time off to volunteer, and an active/growing Employee Resource Group network. For more information, visit [legrand.us](https://eur01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.legrand.us%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cglen.gracia%40legrand.com%7Cfcf5f2be05474ce1cbfb08dd3a664e0e%7C199686b5bef4496087867a6b1888fee3%7C0%7C0%7C638730933237519237%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=ARsMSODB2LEc0e7YpDqRtjG%2FhNvIklc3hL6P%2FLEB5TU%3D&reserved=0)

About Legrand’s Data Center Power and Control Division

The industry-leading brands of Approved Networks, Ortronics, Raritan, Server Technology, and Starline empower Legrand’s Data, Power & Control to produce innovative solutions for data centers, building networks, and facility infrastructures. Our division designs, manufactures, and markets world-class products for a more productive and sustainable future. The exceptional reliability of our technologies results from decades of proven performance and a dedication to research and development.

job.title: Team Lead - Embedded (UI)
job.description:
Job Description

Required Skills

  • Strong experience in Embedded C/C++ programming.
  • Hands-on experience with FreeRTOS development.
  • Strong experience in Embedded Linux system development.
  • Experience in Bare Metal firmware development.
  • BSP development and customization experience.
  • Experience in board bring-up and hardware debugging.
  • Device driver development for embedded peripherals.
  • Strong understanding of ARM Cortex-A/R/M or similar processor architectures.
  • Experience with IPC mechanisms: Message Queues, Shared Memory, Semaphores, Pipes, and Socket-based Communication.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP/HTTPS, MQTT, SNMP, and SSH/TLS.
  • Linux kernel fundamentals, Device Tree concepts, boot sequence, and startup architecture.
  • Strong debugging skills using GDB, JTAG Debuggers, Lauterbach/Trace32, Wireshark, Logic Analyzers, and Oscilloscopes.
  • Experience with Git and version control systems.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with FreeRtos BSP development.
  • Knowledge of AMP/SMP architectures.
  • Experience with secure boot and embedded security concepts.
  • Familiarity with IoT protocols such as BLE, Zigbee, Thread, Matter, and Wi-Fi.
  • Exposure to cloud-connected IoT devices and edge computing.
  • Experience with CI/CD and automated build systems.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity concepts for connected products.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain embedded software solutions on FreeRtos, Embedded Linux, and Bare Metal platforms.
  • Perform BSP development and customization for new hardware platforms.
  • Lead and support board bring-up activities, including bootloader, kernel, device drivers, and hardware validation.
  • Develop and integrate device drivers for UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, USB, GPIO, ADC, PWM, and PCIe peripherals.
  • Design and implement IPC mechanisms, message queues, shared memory, semaphores, sockets, and synchronization primitives.
  • Work on real-time applications with deterministic performance requirements.
  • Develop and optimize embedded applications using C/C++.
  • Configure and customize bootloaders (U-Boot or equivalent).
  • Debug hardware-software integration issues during platform bring-up and product development.
  • Analyze and optimize system performance, memory utilization, boot time, and CPU utilization.
  • Collaborate with hardware, firmware, validation, and system teams throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical design discussions.
  • Support product validation, deployment, and field issue analysis.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

Domain

IoT Devices / Smart Home Solutions / Building Automation / Connected Products / Embedded Systems

job.title: Applications Engineer II
job.description:
Job Description

At a Glance

Legrand has an exciting opportunity for a Aplications Engineer (Design) - APAC to join the Data, Power & Control - Starline Team in Tuas, Singapore (Remote). The Applications Engineer provides high-level engineering expertise, technical design and commercial support on the application of Starline high amperage busduct products to specific projects and customers. The Engineer has the task of overseeing the activities aimed at defining and consequently drafting the offers for the products. The role is also responsible for identifying and providing reliable solutions for all technical issues related to design and field install to assure complete customer satisfaction through all stages of the project. The role establishes and maintains strong relationships throughout the project life cycle.

Responsibilities

What Will You Do?

  • Maintain High-level expertise of product knowledge and application.
  • Complete System Layouts: design layouts of busduct systems based on site
  • Audit & Surveys, Customer drawings, Project tenders and Field input.
  • Utilize AutoDesk Suite to assess understand customer requirements
  • Experienced in 3D design such as AutoCAD, Revit, Inventor & BIM360
  • Create product technical system layouts from engineered drawings (catalog sheets, FAQ’s, Tech Briefs, Reports, instructions, etc.)
  • Provide technical and commercial support to sales and to customers onsite or remotely as required on topics including but not limited to product estimation, RFQ support, ratings, compliance with local regulations and Standards, safety, functionality, Product hands on training, customization, troubleshooting and pricing.
  • Attend customer facing meetings which may include providing customer presentations for product solutions and project updates.
  • Drafting offers related to bus duct products, verifies the technical aspects of the application (based on the technical needs expressed by the customer, drawings of the installation layout.)
  • Verifying the technical characteristics (operating temperature, power, installation, material, quantity, etc.)
  • Supports the management of the customer’s project through the entire project life cycle
  • Work with internal departments such as Purchasing, R&D, Test, Product Engineering, 3rd party assembly providers, for assembly designs, resolve customer & Field technical design issues.

Additional Duties

  • Onsite troubleshooting and rework.
  • Technical liaison to the sales team
  • Training on busduct products and design tools to Sales network
  • Provides Service Group through helping to project manage installations.

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Aptitude for electrical product design and application in power distribution and busduct products.
  • Experienced user of AutoDESK programs – AutoCAD, Revit, Inventor
  • Experience using BIM360
  • Familiarity with the IEC standards and various IEC certifications
  • Persuasive and articulate, with an ability to communicate and influence people at all levels, verbally, in writing and by presentation.
  • Stable, loyal and reliable, with a customer focused personality.
  • Self-reliant, flexible and resourceful.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering.
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in the Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering field.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office.
  • Familiar with project management tools such as Prince2
  • Proficient in technical writing and communication.
  • Prior experience with Busduct products is preferred
  • Ability to travel up to 15% on a regular basis and 20% occasionally, mainly in APAC, other locations as required.

Working Conditions / Physical Requirements

  • The performance of this position may occasionally require exposure to the manufacturing and construction areas where, under certain areas, the use of personal protective equipment such as safety glasses and mandatory hearing protection are required. Also exposed to certain high working areas like high ceiling or floor level.
  • Ability to sit for prolonged periods of time
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 23kg occasionally

Note: The above Job Description is representative of the responsibilities and qualifications necessary to be successful in this role. It does not encompass every job duty or responsibility; other tasks may be assigned as necessary. Further the job

description does not alter the at-will nature of employment with Legrand and does not create a contract of employment.

job.title: Drafter II
job.description:
Job Description

At a Glance

Legrand has an exciting opportunity for a Drafter II to join the Starline Team in Singapore. The Drafter II is responsible for creating mechanical and electrical drawings of low and medium complexity using 3D CAD system and associated BOM via ERP system.  Drawing work supports Application Engineering, Marketing and Sales. Works closely with Application Engineering Team members to provide customized solutions and products to high profile customers.

Responsibilities

What Will You Do?

  • Create dimensioned drawings and 3D models based on input from engineers and customer.
  • Perform low and medium complexity design work on components as directed including 3D library components and assemblies.
  • Create parts lists for new products.
  • Create catalog pages, illustrations and animations; support work within ERP system.
  • Perform a variety of tasks related to new design and project work, included but not limited to Purchasing support, Quality, Production assistance on new designs and customer communication.
  • Organize the creation of demonstration units; work with Production to build prototypes of new designs.
  • Assist production personnel related to product assembly, testing, and methods.
  • Engineering drafting support to develop custom solutions for customers, conceptual drawings, and other project work.
  • Provides 2D overlay assembly system drawings for contractors, and end users.
  • Maintains public cad and BIM library.
  • Ability to work Independently with minimal supervision
  • Will require interaction with existing or potential customers.
  • Assist with drawing and other support collateral for listing projects with VDE, UL, CSA, Intertek (ETL), etc.
  • Participate in customer meetings, presentations, site visits and sales events
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally up 10% of time.

Qualifications

Education

  • Two-year technical degree, associate's in mechanical or electrical Drafting preferred or equivalent experience

job.title: Deputy Manager - Mould Tool Development (MTDM)
job.description:
Job Description

The Deputy Manager will play a crucial role in developing, validating, and standardizing injection moulding processes for new and existing moulds. They will qualify moulds, support production commissioning, and establish robust parameters to maintain consistent quality and performance. This role is integral to the success of the Mould Tool Development (MTDM) department and the overall research and development efforts of the company.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct T1, T2, and follow-up mould trials at supplier sites to assess mould functionality and process capability.
  • Qualify new injection moulds at suppliers before dispatch, ensuring they meet quality standards.
  • Execute mould commissioning and validation at production plants, aiming for First Time Right (FTR) performance.
  • Optimize moulding process parameters for repeatability and efficiency.
  • Perform root cause analysis to identify and eliminate moulding defects, ensuring defect-free components.
  • Prepare and maintain comprehensive process documentation, including setting sheets, reports, and SOPs.
  • Coordinate with mould suppliers for trials, process optimization, and timely delivery of moulds.
  • Support cross-functional teams, including Production, Tool Room, Quality, and R&D, for successful mould commissioning.
  • Provide technical support and training to production and tool room teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Plastic, Polymer, or Tool & Die Engineering.
  • 8-12 years of experience in injection moulding process development, mould qualification, and production commissioning.
  • Scientific Injection Moulding certification is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience with injection moulding machines from leading manufacturers.
  • Strong knowledge of plastic material processing (PP, ABS, PC, etc.) and hot/cold runner systems.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD and Creo for interpreting engineering drawings and GD&T.
  • Understanding of DFM principles and mould construction.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001/14001/45001 systems and documentation.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and technical troubleshooting skills.
  • Effective communication and the ability to collaborate across functional teams.

job.title: Senior Manager
job.description:
Job Description

The Senior Manager - Corporate Finance & Controllership is responsible for leading the organization's finance operations, ensuring robust financial governance, regulatory compliance, effective cash management, and accurate financial reporting. The role oversees Accounting, Accounts Payable, Treasury, Direct Taxation, Statutory Audits, Internal Controls, and Internal Audit coordination while partnering closely with cross-functional teams to support business objectives and maintain strong compliance standards.

Responsibilities

Financial Accounting & Reporting

  • Lead and oversee all accounting activities ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable accounting standards and company policies.
  • Ensure timely month-end and year-end closing of books.
  • Review and validate financial statements, reconciliations, and accounting entries.
  • Drive continuous improvement in accounting processes and controls.

Accounts Payable Management

  • Ensure timely verification, approval, and processing of vendor payments.
  • Monitor payable cycles and maintain strong vendor relationships.
  • Ensure adherence to delegation of authority and payment control procedures.
  • Drive efficiencies and automation within the procure-to-pay process.

Treasury & Cash Flow Management

  • Manage working capital, cash flow planning, and liquidity requirements.
  • Monitor banking operations and maintain strong relation with bankers.
  • Ensure timely execution of payments and treasury transactions.
  • Validate EMDs & Bank Guarantee’s as per business requirement.
  • Support EXIM business for compliance and LC related activities where applicable.

Taxation & Regulatory Compliance

  • Oversee direct tax compliance.
  • Coordinate with external consultants for certifications, Form 15CA/CB.
  • Ensure compliance with all statutory, legal, and regulatory requirements with internal and external team.

Audit Management

  • Lead and coordinate statutory audit activities ensuring timely completion and closure of audit observations.
  • Manage internal audit engagements and facilitate implementation of corrective actions.
  • Act as the primary finance liaison with external auditors and internal audit teams.
  • Monitor audit findings and drive sustainable process improvements.

Internal Controls & Governance

  • Establish and maintain a robust internal control framework.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies and financial governance requirements and strong adherence to DOA.
  • Drive a strong control environment with a zero-tolerance approach toward compliance violations.
  • Conduct periodic reviews to identify and address financial and operational risks.

SG&A Analysis & Business Performance Monitoring

  • Prepare and present monthly SG&A expense analysis.
  • Analyze cost variances, spending trends, and key financial performance indicators.
  • Provide actionable insights and recommendations to management for cost optimization.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities.

Team Leadership & People Management

  • Lead and develop finance teams including plant finance and accounting personnel.
  • Allocate responsibilities, monitor team performance, and support capability development.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, accuracy, and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor team members and strengthen succession planning within the finance function.

Business Partnering

  • Collaborate closely with operations, procurement, sales, HR, legal, and other functions to support business requirements.
  • Provide financial guidance to stakeholders for strategic and operational decision-making.
  • Participate in business initiatives and transformation projects.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and financial governance requirements.

Managing of Numeric Subsidiary and Gratuity trust account

  • Interacting with Bankers for closure of Lanka Technology along with filing of annual income tax returns.
  • Annual filing of Income Tax return for Numeric Trust accounts.

Qualifications

Chartered Accountant with 8 to 10 years of relevant Experience

job.title: Plugs Assembler I
job.description:
Job Description

At a Glance

Starline – a company of Legrand has an exciting opportunity for an Assembler to join the Data, Power, Control Team in Singapore. The Assemblers manufactures and assembles a variety of configurations of mechanical and basic electrical assemblies used in electrical distribution systems.

Responsibilities

What Will You Do?

Essential Functions

  • Read shop drawings and wiring diagrams
  • Read Bills of Materials (BOMs) to determine component parts and assembly sequences of electromechanical units
  • Make electrical connections according to specifications
  • Assemble parts, and position, align, and fasten assemblies, subassemblies, using hand tools and power tools.
  • Modify parts by drilling, tapping, countersinking, etc. machine tools, power and pneumatic hand tools.
  • Position, align, and adjust parts for proper fit and assembly.
  • Measure parts to determine tolerances, using tape measures and precision measuring instruments such as micrometers and calipers.
  • Attach labels and mark identifying information on parts.
  • Adhere to all company policies, guidelines and practices including the SECRIT values.

Additional Duties

  • Cross training to work in other functional department of the plant
  • Other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Tool selection — determining the kind of tools and equipment needed to do a job.
  • Oral Comprehension – The ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
  • Ability to operate cordless hand tools, power tools and pneumatic tools.
  • Ability to read shop drawings and wiring diagrams preferred.
  • Ability to read standard tape measure.
  • Ability to work in a cohesive team environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Level/A Level/ ITE or High School Diploma or equivalent
  • One year of experience in manufacturing preferred

Working Conditions / Physical Requirements

  • Lifting:  Ability to lift and carry up to 75 lbs occasionally; ability to lift and carry up to 25 lbs often.
  • Finger Dexterity: The ability to make precisely coordinated movements of the fingers of one or both hands to grasp, manipulate, or assemble very small objects.
  • Manual Dexterity: The ability to quickly move hand, hand together with arm, or two hands to grasp, manipulate, or assemble objects.
  • Arm-Hand Steadiness: The ability to keep hand and arm steady while moving arm or while holding arm and hand in one position.
  • Vision: The ability to see details at a close range and have the ability to tell the difference in the colors of wires.

job.title: Group Manager - Trade and Experiential Marketing
job.description:
Job Description

A. Trade Marketing & Retail Excellence

  • Own the annual Trade Marketing strategy and calendar, aligned to business priorities, brand strategy, product launches, scheme calendars and regional market opportunities.
  • Develop the retail visibility strategy across Retail, Experience Centres and other relevant channels, including POSM, in-shop branding, display systems, outdoor branding and retail experience assets.
  • Define differentiated retail interventions by outlet/customer segment and ensure the POSM mix reflects priority categories, new launches and premiumization objectives.
  • Drive deployment and compliance of retail assets through the sales network; identify gaps through market visits, audits and data and close them with clear action plans.
  • Develop scalable retail toolkits and standards that improve counter share, shelf/display presence, shopper navigation and brand consistency.
  • Partner with Sales to identify high-potential outlets and markets where focused trade interventions can unlock incremental throughput, visibility or premium mix.

B. Experience Centres & Strategic Partner Activation

  • Build and manage an engagement calendar for Legrand’s Experience Centres (Studios/ ZIPs)
  • Improve the overall customer and shopper experience through displays, demonstrations, experiences, launch programs and partner-specific activations.
  • Develop programs that support incremental sales, lead generation, conversion and premiumization
  • Create post-activation measurement frameworks linking activity to sales uplift, leads/funnel movement, conversion and partner performance.

C. Experiential Marketing, BTL & Influencer Engagement

  • Own the BTL and experiential activation calendar across electricians, retailers, architects, dealers and other relevant influencers/decision-makers.
  • Develop concepts and execution frameworks for retailer meets, electrician engagement, product demonstrations, roadshows, consumer experiences, launches and other field activations.
  • Lead end-to-end planning of experiential programs: objective, audience, concept, agency brief, production, logistics, on-ground execution, measurement and post-event learning.
  • Ensure every experience is consistent with Legrand's premium brand standards while remaining relevant to the audience and commercial objective.
  • Build repeatable activation properties and playbooks rather than relying only on one-off events.

D. Events, Exhibitions & Brand Experiences

  • Lead Legrand’s participation in major exhibitions, industry events, customer events
  • Own event objectives and success metrics - visibility, engagement, qualified leads, customer/partner participation, sales opportunity and brand impact - rather than measuring events only on attendance.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders, agencies and vendors to ensure delivery within agreed timelines, budgets and quality standards.
  • Develop post-event reports with learnings, ROI/impact assessment and recommendations for future editions.

E. Agency, Vendor & Budget Management

  • Build and manage a capable ecosystem of regional and national vendors/fabricators/activation agencies to improve speed, quality and scalability of execution.
  • Drive vendor onboarding, rate benchmarking, negotiation, quality control, timelines, service levels and reconciliation.
  • Continuously identify cost optimization opportunities without compromising brand experience or execution quality.
  • Own allocated Trade/BTL/Experiential budgets, ensuring disciplined planning, approvals, utilization and ROI tracking.

F. Data, Measurement & Trade Marketing Dashboard

  • Establish a Trade Marketing dashboard covering deployment, outlet activation, visibility compliance, activation impact, Modern Trade scorecards, competition intelligence and spend.
  • Define simple, decision-oriented KPIs that connect marketing activity with business outcomes such as throughput, incremental sales, counter/shelf share, leads, conversion and premium mix.
  • Use DMS/sales data, retail audits, market intelligence and field feedback to identify opportunities and recommend corrective actions.
  • Institutionalize pre- and post-activity measurement and build a culture of test–learn–scale.

G. Cross-functional Leadership

  • Work closely with Sales, Brand, Product, Commercial, Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain and regional teams to convert business priorities into market execution.
  • Act as the bridge between Brand strategy and last-mile execution, ensuring that what is planned centrally is practical, scalable and measurable in-market.

Influence without authority and build strong relationships with sales leaders, channel partners, agencies and Vendors.

Responsibilities

  • Should have independently managed multi-city activations, retail visibility programs, exhibitions/events and external agencies/vendors.
  • Strong commercial orientation with the ability to connect marketing interventions to sales, throughput, conversion and ROI.
  • Comfort with data and dashboards; strong Excel and PowerPoint skills. Exposure to Power BI or similar reporting tools is an advantage.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, vendors, timelines and budgets simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.
  • High ownership, attention to detail and willingness to travel extensively across India.

Qualifications

  • 4-5 years of relevant experience in Trade Marketing, Shopper Marketing, BTL, Experiential Marketing, Retail Marketing or Channel Marketing.
  • Experience in Building Materials & allied categories is preferred. Also open to Telecomm, Baggage, etc.

job.title: Lead Program Administrator

This role involves coordinating with various stakeholders, ensuring project milestones are met within time & budget, and maintaining high standards of quality and efficiency. The Project Coordinator will also be responsible for maintaining project documentation, tracking progress, and communicating updates to stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in industrial automation, power plant operations, project management, and excellent communication skills.

Responsibilities

The fulfillment of this role is essential due to the project volume and complexity. The lead program administrator shall handle and be responsible for:

•Project coordination for multiple clients and related vendors.

•Customer satisfaction, ensuring smooth execution and delivery.

•Coordination with Factory and Other Stake Holders for readiness of Control System for FAT at Shope floor.

•Monitor project progress and handle any issues that arise.

•Efficient execution of new projects to achieve targeted business numbers.

•Closure of legacy projects to maintain revenue flow and avoid penalties. Stakeholder management, including clients, vendors, and internal teams.

•Operational excellence, compliance, and safety management to reduce risks.

Core Activities* Work with Project manager closely to understand project requirement and support project execution from inception till closure.

  • Reporting daily progress to Project Manager and taking proactive actions.
  • Proactively identifying potential quality and efficiency improvements within assigned work.
  • Co-ordinate with the internal cross functional team like Factory, Procurements, Logistics, Stores and other relevant functions to keep day to day operations going on.
  • Project Planning, Scheduling and Execution:Support Project Managers to Develop detailed project plans, including timelines, budgets, and resource allocation. Ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
  • Stakeholder Coordination:Liaise with clients, vendors, and internal teams to ensure clear communication and alignment with project goals and deliverables.
  • Risk Management:Identify potential risks and develop a mitigation plan to ensure project success.
  • Quality Assurance:Implement and monitor quality control processes to ensure the highest standards of project delivery.
  • Documentation and Reporting:Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including progress reports, meeting minutes, and other project related documentation.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies. Monitor project progress to anticipate and resolve any issues that may arise.
  • Compliance:Ensure all projects comply with relevant industry standards, regulations, and safety protocols. CORA, GPMO, SAP etc. to be followed and maintained. Conduct regular reviews to ensure compliance throughout the project lifecycle.

Qualifications

  • Education:Bachelor’s degree/ or BBA, Project co-ordination experience in Industrial Automation DCS/ PLC/ SCADA projects, or a related field. CAPM certification is an added advantage.
  • Experience:Minimum of 8-12 years of experience in industrial automation and project management.
  • Skills:
  • Strong understanding of commercial T&C.

job.title: Director User Exp Design
job.description:
Job Description

Honeywell User Experience (HUE) design studios lead the creation of next-generation experiences for the connected world. Leveraging well-established human-centered design principles, HUE ensures that Honeywell products and applications are the most useful, usable, and desirable in the marketplace. The studios operate globally across North America, Europe, China, and Australia, fostering a collegial,

ROLE OVERVIEW

The PA HUE Leader at HTCS is a senior design executive responsible for two interconnected capabilities: (1) leading the HUE Design Studio for the Process Automation (PA) business, driving the UX vision, strategy, and delivery aligned with the PA SBG and GBE leadership; and (2) overseeing the Technical Writer team, ensuring that product knowledge is translated into accurate, user-centered documentation that enhances the overall customer experience.

This dual mandate positions the PA HUE Leader as a key steward of both visual-interactive experience design and content-driven experience design — recognizing that great products must be equally well-designed and well-documented.

Responsibilities

SCOPE OF LEADERSHIP

A. HUE Design Studio — Process Automation

Lead a growing, multidisciplinary team of User Experience designers delivering next-generation, delightful solutions across the PA product portfolio. Key responsibilities include:

  • Developing design capability and infrastructure aligned with PA business strategy.
  • Recruiting, developing, and managing UX design talent; managing resources and operational plans.
  • Overseeing multidisciplinary competencies: design research, experience design, interaction design, visual design, and industrial design.
  • Driving 2–3 high-impact, innovative offerings based on a UX-led approach.
  • Delivering design projects on time to support business growth and enhance product value.
  • Collaborating with PA Global Experience Design teams to implement a design strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Contributing to HUE best practices for User Experience Design throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Participating as a decision-maker at project reviews; providing a clear, consistent UX perspective to teams and stakeholders.
  • Creating and executing human-centered designs that differentiate Honeywell brands globally.
  • Applying, building, and evolving the Honeywell Design Language System (DLS) and brand identity program.
  • Contributing to management updates, operational reviews, and leadership dialogue at HUE Global Leadership and HTS India Leadership.
  • Collaborating with all Honeywell functions that interact with customers to deliver end-to-end journey alignment.
  • Establishing a framework for regular usability testing with dedicated UX researchers embedded across studios.
  • Overseeing co-creation workshops with end users to inform new product and service development.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve data visualization and interpretability through design.
  • Promoting a holistic, end-to-end user experience strategy across all product touchpoints.
  • Championing system thinking and storytelling techniques to align product vision with user needs.

B. Technical Writer Team — Documentation & Content Experience

Provide leadership and strategic direction to the Technical Writer team, ensuring product documentation is accurate, structured, and user-centered. This team is integral to the customer experience and works at the intersection of product knowledge and communication design. Key responsibilities include:

  • Overseeing end-to-end documentation for products and programs, covering user guides, installation manuals, administrator guides, and troubleshooting references.
  • Directing the development of feature walkthroughs, process flow documentation, and security white papers.
  • Ensuring the team effectively uses MadCap Flare to produce high-quality HTML and PDF documentation.
  • Guiding the creation of HTML-based user assistant files that enhance in-product guidance.
  • Building and managing a structured review and feedback cycle with key stakeholders — developers, testing teams, program managers, installation teams, and security teams.
  • Embedding technical writing quality standards focused on content accuracy, clarity, and consistency.
  • Aligning documentation strategy with the broader UX and product experience roadmap, ensuring parity between product design intent and user-facing documentation.
  • Fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the technical writing function, including upskilling in structured authoring and content design principles.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) from an institute of repute in Design, Human Factors, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related discipline.

Experience

  • 12 or more years of experience in User Experience design of products and software applications.
  • Demonstrated experience in a senior design leadership role, managing multidisciplinary teams including UX designers, researchers, and/or technical writers.
  • Experience working in Agile environments with lean UX methodologies.
  • International experience working with regional businesses and geographically distributed design teams.
  • Proven track record of delivering innovative, market-released UX design solutions; portfolio required.
  • Experience directing and managing external design and development firms.
  • Exposure to or direct experience overseeing technical documentation functions is an advantage.

Design & Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in UX design tools: Figma, prototyping platforms, interaction and visual design toolsets.
  • Deep understanding of Design Language Systems and brand identity programs.
  • Ability to create low-fidelity to high-fidelity prototypes across the design lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated research skills across qualitative and quantitative methods.
  • Familiarity with technical documentation platforms (e.g., MadCap Flare, HTML/PDF publishing pipelines) is desirable.
  • Understanding of structured content principles, single-source publishing, and content strategy.

Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Ability to translate complex vision into understandable concepts and workable design narratives.
  • Strong ability to influence product, software, hardware, and development teams during early-stage development.

Required Skills

  • B.Des, M.Des
  • Team handling
  • UX design
  • Ux Research

job.title: Assistant Manager, Finance – Reporting
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically sound finance professional to support the financial reporting and technical accounting functions of DayOne Data Center. With a focus on US GAAP compliance and NASDAQ IPO readiness, the Assistant Manager will assist in the preparation of financial statements, SEC filings, and technical accounting analyses. This role provides strong exposure to group reporting, external audit, and internal controls in a dynamic multinational data centre environment.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Reporting & SEC Compliance

  • Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidated financial statements in accordance with US GAAP.
  • Support the preparation of management reports and variance analyses, and contribute to clear financial commentary for management review.
  • Prepare supporting schedules and materials for executive, audit committee, and board reporting.
  • Coordinate with external auditors, IPO advisors, and regulators as directed by the Finance Manager.
  • Assist in the preparation of SEC filings, including Form S-1, 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, and related disclosures for NASDAQ-listed or IPO-ready entities.
  • Support IPO readiness activities, including financial statement conversion, disclosure drafting, and coordination with underwriters and legal advisors.

Technical Accounting & Policy Development

  • Assist in researching, drafting, and reviewing technical accounting memoranda on complex accounting issues (e.g. revenue recognition, share-based compensation, business combinations, lease accounting).
  • Monitor new accounting standards and assist in assessing their impact on the Group.

Internal Controls & SOX Compliance

  • Support the design, implementation, and enhancement of SOX-compliant internal controls over financial reporting.
  • Assist in risk assessments and help address control gaps in collaboration with finance stakeholders.
  • Help maintain SOPs, reporting calendars, and training materials to support reporting efficiency.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement and automation initiatives for reporting processes and systems.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Degree holder in Finance, Accounting, or equivalent professional qualification.
  • CPA/ACCA or equivalent certification (or actively pursuing).
  • Minimum 4–6 years of relevant accounting experience; Big 4 background is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of US GAAP financial reporting and SEC filings.
  • Exposure to NASDAQ IPO or public company reporting environment is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with SOX compliance frameworks and internal control concepts.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA would be advantageous.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain accounting matters clearly.
  • High level of integrity and a collaborative, ownership-driven approach to work.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

This is a highly visible regional role supporting construction and expansion projects across Asia, requiring regular travel sites. Candidates who enjoy working in dynamic environments, influencing cross-functional teams and seeing projects come to life from concept through to operational handover will thrive in this position.

Regular travel throughout Asia should be expected, including visits during design validation, installation, commissioning, operational readiness and handover phases. The successful candidate should enjoy being on-site and working directly with project teams, stakeholders and vendors to drive successful outcomes.

Responsibilities

Physical Security Program Enablement

  • Lead the deployment and integration of physical security programs across new data centre builds and expansion projects throughout Asia-Pacific
  • Partner closely with Global Design & Construction (GDC), Data Centre Operations and Security Program teams to ensure security requirements are successfully incorporated into project delivery
  • Support security readiness activities during design, construction, installation, commissioning and operational handover
  • Identify and mitigate physical security risks throughout the project lifecycle
  • Drive consistency and standardisation of physical security practices across the region

Project & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Lead multiple concurrent security enablement initiatives across geographically dispersed locations
  • Partner with internal stakeholders, contractors, consultants and vendors to ensure successful project outcomes
  • Provide guidance and leadership to regional security teams supporting active project sites
  • Influence cross-functional teams to deliver security solutions that support both operational excellence and customer requirements
  • Act as a key escalation point for security-related incidents, project risks and vendor performance issues

Security Systems & Technical Oversight

  • Provide leadership and oversight across physical security technologies including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection and associated infrastructure
  • Support installation, commissioning, testing and operational acceptance of security systems
  • Manage security vendor relationships responsible for hardware installation, upgrades, maintenance and support
  • Lead SPOF (Single Point of Failure) and End-of-Life (EOL) assessments and remediation initiatives
  • Support issue resolution, root cause analysis and vendor escalation for complex technical security challenges

People Leadership

  • Lead and develop a small regional team, and own performance management with direct reports currently based in Singapore
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement
  • Provide coaching, mentoring and guidance to security professionals supporting regional programs and projects

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience leading physical security programs, projects or operations within a data centre, mission-critical, hyperscale, telecommunications, infrastructure or high-security environment
  • Experience supporting large-scale construction, commissioning, fit-out or infrastructure projects
  • Strong stakeholder management capabilities across engineering, construction, operations and vendor organisations
  • Experience leading geographically dispersed teams and influencing cross-functional stakeholders
  • Strong understanding of physical security systems and their deployment within operational environments
  • Experience supporting new builds, expansions and commissioning activities
  • Experience working with security systems integrators, consultants and technology vendors
  • Understanding of project lifecycle delivery from design through operational handover
  • Experience working within highly regulated, operationally critical or customer-facing environments
  • Knowledge of business continuity, security governance and risk management practices

Benefits of the role:

  • Direct impact on some of the largest digital infrastructure projects in Asia-Pacific
  • Opportunity to shape physical security standards across a growing regional portfolio
  • High visibility role with significant stakeholder engagement across Operations, Security, Engineering and Construction teams
  • Leadership opportunity with regional scope and influence, including APAC travel
  • Salary package containing company shares, annual bonus and salary reviews
  • Onsite gyms, access to company wellness, financial and other benefits and initiatives
  • Exposure to industry-leading technology, innovation and mission-critical operations

job.title: Vice President, Portfolio Management
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Role Overview

The VP will serve a dual mandate — driving portfolio management excellence across Keppel’s private data centre funds, while acting as a product specialist and capital formation partner. The role sits at the intersection of portfolio management, investor relations, and product development, requiring a commercially astute individual who can credibly engage both institutional investors and internal investment teams.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Management & Fund Oversight

  • Develop and execute portfolio strategy, business plans, and annual budgets in alignment with the fund's mandate and investment guidelines.
  • Maintain centralized oversight of the private data centre funds, encompassing capital allocation, compliance with investment restrictions, performance monitoring, and adherence to governance frameworks.
  • Actively manage fund liquidity, control fund-level expenses, and implement strategies to optimize investor distributions and risk-adjusted returns.
  • Build, own, and continuously maintain life-of-fund financial models, ensuring integrity of projections, cash flow forecasting, and scenario analysis.
  • Produce rigorous fund-level performance metrics, investor reporting, and returns benchmarking against relevant private real estate, infrastructure, and data centre peer universes.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for existing investors of the Funds, to respond to their queries

Investment & Asset Management Support

  • Participate actively in the investment process — including evaluation of acquisition and divestment opportunities — by providing portfolio-level context, capital allocation perspectives, and investor return considerations.
  • Collaborate with asset management teams to monitor business plan execution across portfolio assets, escalating risks and opportunities as appropriate.
  • Contribute the portfolio and investor lens to investment committee deliberations, ensuring deal-level decisions are evaluated within the context of overall fund construction and mandate constraints.

Product Specialist / Capital Raising

  • Act as a product specialist for the data centre fund strategy in investor meetings
  • Working as part of a team to support end-to-end capital raising activities, including contributing to the development of marketing materials, pitchbooks, DDQs, RFP responses, and fund terms documentation.
  • Provide substantive responses on fund strategy, portfolio construction, performance attribution, and risk management.
  • Partner with structuring teams on the design and launch of new fund products and co-investment vehicles, ensuring alignment with market demand and investor preferences.
  • Develop and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with a broad institutional investor base including sovereign wealth funds, pension funds, insurance companies, family offices, and fund-of-funds.

Market Intelligence & Thought Leadership

  • Monitor and synthesize competitive intelligence across private real estate, digital infrastructure, and data centre investment markets, tracking trends in capital flows, fund structures, pricing, and investor sentiment.
  • Produce thematic content to support fundraising narratives, investor communications, and strategic planning.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Pre-requisites:

  • Masters / Degree in Finance / Business Administration from leading university
  • Minimum 10 years of relevant experience with private real estate / infrastructure funds in investment or asset management role with broad knowledge and extensive networks in the private infrastructure/ real estate markets for the Asia Pacific region.
  • Commercially astute, and possess sharp analytical, research, problem solving skills and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead investor discussions; Proven track record in dealing with international institutional investors will be viewed favorably.
  • A self-motivated team player who is meticulous, detailed oriented, organized and able to learn quickly and independently
  • Proficient with financial modelling, market and industry research in infrastructure, real estate or other private equity assets;
  • A strong communicator with excellent stakeholder management skill and ability to interact well with different functions and levels.
  • Ability to multi-task and work in fast pace dynamic environment

BUSINESS SEGMENT

Connectivity

PLATFORM

Fund Management

job.title: Senior Grid Connection Manager (APAC)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Senior Grid Connection Manager is a key technical role within STACK’s Power & Energy function, responsible for leading the technical grid connection process for large-scale data centre developments across Australia.

The role will provide technical ownership from early-stage grid connection feasibility through connection application, power-system studies, Connection Performance Standards (CPS), Generator Performance Standards (GPS), model development and acceptance, technical approvals, compliance requirements, commissioning and energisation.

Operating at transmission-scale load levels, the role will work closely with AEMO, VicGrid, Transmission Network Service Providers (TNSPs), Distribution Network Service Providers (DNSPs), specialist power-system consultancies, OEMs and STACK engineering and delivery teams to develop technically robust, achievable and commercially practical connection solutions.

The Senior Grid Connection Manager will act as a key technical interface between the electricity network and STACK’s development, engineering and delivery organisations. The role will also lead the engagement and performance management of external technical consultants and specialist contractors supporting the connection process.

The role does not require the individual to personally undertake all detailed power-system studies; however, the successful candidate must have sufficient technical depth to define study requirements, challenge assumptions, review results, identify risks and ensure technical outcomes are appropriately incorporated into the project design.

Grid Connection & Technical Interface

  • Lead the technical grid connection process for large-scale data centre developments from feasibility through energisation.
  • Manage technical engagement with AEMO, VicGrid, TNSPs and DNSPs, including technical submissions, information requests, reviews and approvals.
  • Assess connection options, network constraints, capacity, technical risks, augmentation requirements and programme implications.
  • Maintain the technical connection roadmap, key dependencies, risks and actions.
  • Provide clear technical recommendations to Power & Energy, Development and senior leadership.

CPS, Power-System Studies & Modelling

  • Lead development and technical negotiation of Connection Performance Standards (CPS), Generator Performance Standards (GPS), and associated connection requirements.
  • Define and manage the power-system study programme, including load-flow, fault-level, dynamic, EMT, harmonic, power-quality and system-strength studies as required.
  • Coordinate development and validation of facility models, ensuring they accurately represent the intended data centre electrical system and operating philosophy.
  • Review and challenge consultant outputs, assumptions and conclusions, identifying technical risks and required further analysis.
  • Ensure changes to equipment, load configuration or operating philosophy are appropriately reflected in models and studies.

Consultant, Contractor & OEM Management

  • Lead engagement and technical management of specialist grid-connection consultants, power-system engineers, testing specialists and OEM technical resources.
  • Develop clear scopes of work, technical deliverables, interfaces, programmes and acceptance criteria.
  • Manage external providers against scope, quality, programme and technical requirements.
  • Coordinate multiple consultants to ensure consistent assumptions and integrated technical outputs.
  • Obtain and review technical data and models from major equipment suppliers, including UPS, transformers, generators, BESS and other power-electronic equipment.

Engineering & Delivery Interface

  • Work closely with Engineering and Delivery to translate connection requirements into the design and delivery of upstream HV infrastructure.
  • Work closely with Engineering to ensure the downstream electrical design and actual facility load behaviour are appropriately reflected in connection studies and CPS.
  • Identify design changes that may affect connection assumptions, models, studies or technical approvals.
  • Support technical requirements for testing, commissioning, compliance and energisation.
  • Maintain alignment between the approved connection solution and the delivered project.

Technical Governance & Risk

  • Maintain clear technical governance, documentation and decision records for connection activities.
  • Identify and escalate technical connection risks early and drive resolution.
  • Track connection conditions and technical approvals through to energisation.
  • Develop repeatable standards, processes and lessons learned to improve future connection programmes.

Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of Australian electricity networks and grid-connection processes.
  • Strong understanding of AEMO, VicGrid, TNSP/DNSP, CPS and GPS requirements.
  • Strong power-system engineering knowledge covering steady-state, dynamic and EMT studies.
  • Ability to critically review and challenge technical studies and consultant outputs.
  • Strong understanding of HV systems, substations, transformers, protection, control and power quality.
  • Strong stakeholder, consultant and contractor management capability.
  • Excellent technical communication and report-writing skills.
  • Ability to translate complex technical issues into clear business recommendations.
  • Strong programme, risk and interface-management capability.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering or related discipline.
  • 8+ years’ relevant experience in power systems, electricity networks, generation, large industrial loads, data centres or major electrical infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated experience with Australian grid-connection processes.
  • Experience working with AEMO, VicGrid, and/or TNSPs/DNSPs on complex connections.
  • Experience with CPS / GPS development or equivalent technical connection requirements.
  • Experience managing power-system studies and specialist technical consultants.
  • Experience interpreting RMS and/or EMT modelling results.
  • Strong understanding of transmission and HV infrastructure.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience with transmission-scale large-load connections.
  • Experience with hyperscale data centres or other large power-electronic loads.
  • Experience with PSCAD, PSS®E and/or PowerFactory.
  • Experience with system-strength, harmonic, fault-level and power-quality studies.
  • Experience with BESS and renewable generation.
  • Experience with 132 kV, 220 kV, 275 kV, 330 kV or higher-voltage infrastructure.
  • Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) or equivalent professional recognition.

Additional Eligibility Requirements

  • Ability to work flexibly to accommodate project, utility and stakeholder requirements
  • ·Willingness to attend site, technical workshops and commissioning activities outside standard business hours where required.
  • Comfortable operating in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

job.title: Assistant Store Manager, Gawler
job.description:
Gawler Place Store, Adelaide, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

As one of Australia’s top telecommunications providers, Optus connects more than 11 million customers daily across mobile, broadband and digital products.

We’re looking to bring on board a supportive, driven and people‑focused Assistant Store Manager to join our Gawler team. If you love developing others, energising a team, delivering outstanding customer experiences and stepping into a challenge of leadership with confidence, then take the next step in your career with us.

At Optus, we collaborate with purpose, support one another, take accountability, act with integrity and celebrate our wins as one team. Together, we learn, grow, overcome challenges and build genuine connections, both with our customers and with each other. As a Second in Charge, you’ll play a key role in helping to develop the store’s culture, driving performance outcomes and contributing to its overall success.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead by example, supporting your Store Manager to create a positive, high‑performance culture where your team feels motivated, included and confident to shine.
  • Support the store manager to coach, mentor and develop team members through clear guidance, meaningful feedback and day‑to‑day support, helping them deliver exceptional customer experiences.
  • Help to maintain an energised, customer‑first environment that feels warm, welcoming and inspiring for both customers and your team.
  • Support smooth daily operations, from team coordination to service delivery, while finding opportunities to uplift performance, efficiency and customer experience.
  • Handle escalated customer enquiries with calm professionalism, modelling effective de‑escalation techniques and guiding the team through various situations.
  • Help to drive team engagement by celebrating wins, supporting goal setting, encouraging continuous learning and strengthening collaboration.

What you bring:

  • Calm Under Pressure: You stay composed during reactive or complex situations, modelling effective de‑escalation and helping your peers to manage challenges with care.
  • Operational & Business Awareness: You have a strong grasp of retail operations, know what drives performance, and showcase balanced step up to leadership with store efficiencies.
  • Team Culture & Adaptability: You support to build an inclusive team environment and stay flexible and solutions‑focused when priorities shift or customer needs change.

What’s in it for you?
