Not sure you meet every requirement? Don’t let that hold you back. We value potential just as much as experience, and this role might be exactly where your next chapter begins.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit [https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity](https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity)

job.title: Senior Engineer II, Industrialization PCBA and Product Test
job.description:
Job Description

1\. EOL Test System Design & Commissioning

  • Design, build, and validate automated EOL test fixtures (both AC and high-power DC test benches) using programmable electronic loads, power analyzers, grid simulators, and EV emulators.
  • Develop and maintain EOL test execution scripts and sequences using NI LabVIEW, TestStand, Python, or PLC architectures.
  • Implement and manage safety-critical systems for high-voltage and high-current testing environments, including interlocks, light curtains, emergency stop (E-stop) circuits, and Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) protocols.

2\. Functional & Safety Testing Integration

  • Integrate mandatory electrical safety checks into the automated test cycle, including dielectric withstand (Hi-Pot), insulation resistance, and ground continuity testing.
  • Automate validation of critical safety devices such as CCID (Charge Circuit Interrupting Device) ground fault detection and overcurrent protection.
  • Automate the functional validation of communication interfaces, including vehicle-to-charger handshakes (CCS/NACS physical layers via PLC/PWM) and network interfaces (OCPP via Ethernet, Wi-Fi, or cellular).

3\. Diagnostics & Root Cause Analysis

  • Troubleshoot complex test stand issues involving hardware, firmware, or test software to minimize line downtime.
  • Establish robust processes for diagnosing units that fail EOL testing; define clear "Rework" instructions and verify the effectiveness of those repairs.
  • Use diagnostic and network tracing tools (e.g., CANalyzer, CANoe, Wireshark) to analyze communication trace logs when troubleshooting vehicle-to-charger signaling failures.

4\. Continuous Improvement & Data Traceability

  • Integrate EOL test systems with the factory Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and database architectures (SQL) for complete serial-number-level test result traceability.
  • Monitor first-pass yield (FPY) and cycle times at EOL, utilizing statistical data analysis to isolate and eliminate false failures and process bottlenecks.
  • Lead the transfer of new product EOL test requirements from R&D (Design Verification Testing) to high-volume manufacturing lines.
  • Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a highly related technical field.
  • 6 to 14+ years of hands-on experience as a Manufacturing Test Engineer, with at least 6 years dedicated to End-of-Line (EOL) testing in an automotive, EVSE, battery, or high-power electronics environment.
  • Experience working directly with high-voltage AC (up to 480V three-phase) or high-voltage DC (up to 1000V+) test systems.

Technical Skills

  • Software: Highly proficient in test development environments, specifically NI TestStand/LabVIEW and/or Python for hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) automation.
  • Protocols & Standards: Solid understanding of EV charging physical layers and messaging standards (e.g., J1772, ISO 15118, DIN 70121, OCPP).
  • Equipment: Direct experience configuring and controlling programmable power supplies, electronic loads (E-Loads), digital oscilloscopes, and safety testers.
  • Safety & Compliance: Familiarity with high-voltage lab safety guidelines, NFPA 70E compliance, and UL standards relevant to EVSE (e.g., UL 2202, UL 2594, UL 2231).

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical, data-driven mindset with the ability to draw root-cause conclusions from complex test logs.
  • Excellent collaborative communication skills to interface effectively with firmware developers, hardware engineers, and production operators.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with unified EV/EVSE functional test platforms (e.g., Keysight, Chroma, or similar systems).
  • Direct experience with CTEP / NTEP metrology and calibration requirements for commercial EVSE billing accuracy.
  • Certification in Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt or Black Belt) and experience with Gauge R&R studies on test equipment.

Rewards designed for you

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our [Career Page](https://www.se.com/careers).

\\* Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our  IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

job.title: Senior Solutions Engineer, Post Sales

This role is specifically focused on helping close existing hyperscale and enterprise business via data center and product knowledge, solution design, quoting, exceptional presentation skills, and leading tours of the NTT Data GDC facilities. The Senior Solutions Engineer will ensure the highest standards of technical excellence and customer satisfaction, contributing to the overall success of the organization. This role requires a technical oriented thinker with a deep understanding of infrastructure engineering as well as MEP systems, and customer requirements, who can build trust, and work collaboratively across various internal and external stakeholders.

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Based in the INDIA region and reports to the Director of Central Solutions Engineering Services and works closely with NTT Data GDC Sales Representatives to develop a thorough understanding of existing customer technical requirements particularly electrical, mechanical, fiber network systems.
  • Executes the technical solutioning of existing hyperscale/enterprise client requirements in alignment with NTT Data GDC company goals and objectives.
  • Gathers existing client technical requirements and collaborates with other NTT Data GDC teams including Subject Matter Experts, Service Operations, Client Success Managers to oversee the development, design, and delivery of complex MEP, BMS, Fiber Network solutions, ensuring they meet the highest standards of quality and performance.
  • Leads the preparation of the technical response package for existing client requests and communicates solutions back to the client in a timely manner.

  • Demonstrates expert understanding of MEP, BMS, Fiber Networks data center design concepts and differentiators (liquid cooling, maintainable fault tolerant power, security redundancy, etc.).
  • Supports NTT Data GDC Legal teams in contract and lease reviews, ensuring terms align with both the customer’s and NTT Data GDC requirements.
  • Works closely with NTT sales representatives, product management, SMEs, operations, legal, and customer support teams to ensure seamless integration of solutions and successful project delivery.

KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES

  • Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to think strategically and make data-driven decisions.
  • Able to mark-up electrical and mechanical single lines, as well as floor plan layouts of equipment and systems in AutoCAD, Bluebeam or other drafting software.
  • A thorough understanding of modern data center and IT client topologies, design requirements, and environments with a primary focus on wholesale customers and their data center requirements.
  • Proficient with software application such as AutoCAD, CFD Modeling, Visio, Word, Excel, Power Point, Project Outlook, SharePoint and Salesforce.
  • Comfortable speaking/presenting to groups of all sizes.

job.description:

You'll craft and execute strategies to drive customer adoption and use of AWS services while providing expert guidance on architecture, support strategies, project planning, and operational excellence.

Working with some of the most iconic businesses in the country, you'll provide technical leadership and consultative expertise across the customer lifecycle. This role offers opportunities to develop your technical and consulting skills while solving challenging problems in cloud adoption, migration, and optimization. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure customer success while building long-term relationships that enable business transformation.

You might start with a workshop helping a retail customer architect their cloud solution, followed by collaborating with account teams to develop approaches for an upcoming migration project. job.title: Senior Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Support, ES – APJC-ASEAN
job.description:
The AWS Enterprise Support team is growing to meet the demands of a portfolio of always-on, latency-sensitive enterprise customers whose production workloads run across global AWS regions. As a Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will be the named technical point of accountability for some of the team's largest accounts — owning architectural guidance, operational strategy, and proactive support delivery end to end. The team is investing in three areas where you will have immediate impact: converting recurring support patterns into reusable automation and documented procedures, deepening technical expertise in databases, containers, networking, and capacity planning, and shifting the delivery mix from reactive case work to proactive resilience reviews, cost planning, and measurable customer outcomes. If you want to own a customer relationship where every interaction matters and your contributions raise the bar for the whole team, this is the role.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end technical relationship for a portfolio of enterprise customers, advising on cloud architecture, operational strategy, and launch readiness across global AWS regions.
  • Assess customer environments for architectural risks and scaling constraints, then build actionable plans that maintain business continuity for workloads with 24/7 uptime requirements and unpredictable demand patterns.
  • Collaborate with account teams, Solutions Architects, and AWS service teams for compute, database, container, and networking services to resolve complex issues and drive product improvements informed by real customer patterns.
  • Analyze operational metrics and deliver periodic performance reviews to customer leadership, translating data into clear recommendations that strengthen security posture, cost efficiency, and system reliability.
  • Contribute to the team's shared knowledge base, standard operating procedures, and reusable automation, and mentor fellow Technical Account Managers to raise the collective capability of the group.

A day in the life You might start the morning reviewing an operational dashboard for a customer whose traffic can spike without warning, then jump into a call with their engineering team — in Mandarin — to walk through a scaling plan for an upcoming product release. After lunch you could be partnering with an AWS service team to troubleshoot a networking issue that spans a complex multi-account topology, and later in the afternoon you present a quarterly architecture review to a customer's leadership, highlighting risks mitigated and opportunities ahead.

About the team We are a cross-border Enterprise Support team within AWS that serves enterprise customers headquartered in Singapore while their production infrastructure runs in global AWS regions. Our closest partners are the account teams and Solutions Architects on our shared accounts, along with AWS service teams in compute, database, container, and networking. As our customer portfolio grows and workloads become more demanding, we are looking for a senior engineer ready to take designated ownership of key accounts and help us scale proactive delivery through better mechanisms, deeper technical expertise, and shared tooling.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of design/implementation/operations/consulting with distributed applications experience
  • 7+ years of technical engineering experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a 24x7 operational services or support environment
  • Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. job.title: Specialist Solutions Architect - Amazon Connect, Applied AI Solutions
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is proud to be the pioneer and widely recognised leader in Cloud Computing. Our web services provide IT infrastructure in-the-cloud that is used by hundreds of thousands of developers and businesses around the world, ranging from start-ups to leading web companies to Global 500 companies in industries such as financial services, pharmaceuticals, and manufacturing.

AWS Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are technologists with deep domain-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs. As part of the AWS sales organization, SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert-level knowledge to solve. SSAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or designing entirely new cloud-based systems. Do you enjoy solving novel and unique technical challenges for customers? Become an AWS Specialist SA!

The Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) is part of AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS), which is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. We work backwards from our customer’s most complex and business critical problems to build and execute go-to-market plans that turn AWS ideas into multi-billion-dollar businesses. WWSO teams include business development, specialist and technical solutions architecture. As part of WWSO, you'll provide expertise across the entire life cycle of an AWS customer initiative, from developing ideas for new services to accelerating the adoption of established businesses. We pride ourselves on thinking big, delivering exceptional results for our customers, and working across AWS as #OneTeam.

Key job responsibilities

  • Represent the voice of the customer; bring customer feedback to product teams to influence feature development and future product roadmap.
  • Provide advanced technical knowledge to your domain aligned GTM teams to unblock our customers’ largest and most critical business challenges.
  • Act as a thought leader sharing best practices through forums such as AWS blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures and public-speaking events such as AWS Summit, AWS re: Invent, etc.
  • Partner with Business Development teams to define the technical components of best in class GTM concepts, solutions, and initiatives.
  • Develop and support an AWS internal community of technical subject matter experts worldwide. Create field enablement materials for the broader SA population, to help them understand how to integrate Amazon Web Services solutions into customer architectures.

A day in the life AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

About the team The APJ CXE Specialist Solution Architecture team is a diverse group of architects located throughout Asia, Pacific and Japan. The team develops Contact Centre architectures and solutions using Amazon Connect for our customers. Specialist SAs play a critical role in capturing customer feedback, advocating for roadmap enhancements, and anticipating customer requirements as they work backwards from their needs. As domain experts, SSAs also participate in field engagement and enablement, producing content such as whitepapers, blogs, and workshops for customers, partners, and the AWS Technical Field.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • Cloud Technology Certification (such as Solutions Architecture, Cloud Security Professional or Cloud DevOps Engineering), or Bachelor's degree
  • Knowledge of AWS services

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with end user or developer communities
  • Experience with AI/ML technologies
  • Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Executive Digitalization – Logistics.

497297

03-Mar-2026

We're improving the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings, and industries!!

Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place – where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered optimally and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components, and systems to connected, cloud-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solutions.

JOIN US! WE MAKE REAL WHAT MATTERS. THIS IS YOUR ROLE

The Executive – Digitalization (Logistics) will be responsible for driving digital transformation initiatives within the Supply Chain & Logistics function. The role requires strong expertise in Power BI analytics, data engineering, SAP MM/Fiori processes, workflow automation, and AI‑based improvements. The Executive will also support buying activities, supplier coordination, and inventory management while implementing digital solutions across SCM operations.

Core Responsibilities

  • Digitalization & Analytics (Primary Responsibility)
  • Drive the SCM digitalization roadmap focusing on dashboards, automation, AI tools, and workflow optimization.
  • Develop and maintain advanced Power BI dashboards using DAX, data modelling, and Snowflake or other data platform integrations.
  • Perform data engineering activities including data cleaning, structuring, modelling, and standardization for analytics.
  • Build digital trackers for PO, GR, TECO, inventory KPIs, and planning accuracy.
  • Integrate AI and automation tools to eliminate repetitive SCM tasks and increase process efficiency.
  • Support digital upskilling within the department and contribute to analytics maturity improvement.
  • Identify digital improvement opportunities and convert them into actionable solutions.
  • SAP Management & Automation
  • Manage and update SAP MM master data including material master, lead time, safety stock, and procurement parameters.
  • Implement SAP automation enhancements such as Auto‑Availability Check, Auto‑TECO, Auto‑CLSD, and related workflows.
  • Use SAP Fiori apps for procurement, analytics, inventory, and reporting.
  • Extract and transform SAP data for dashboards, reporting, and decision support.
  • Improve SAP processes to reduce manual efforts and enhance system reliability.
  • Buying & Supplier Coordination
  • Perform material coverage checks to ensure planning accuracy and timely availability.
  • Manage PR–PO cycle including PO creation, placement, follow‑up, and closure.
  • Coordinate with suppliers for confirmations, delivery schedules, and adherence.
  • Track import orders and collaborate with EXIM for documentation and shipment tracking.
  • Monitor GRN status, WebCycles updates, and highlight discrepancies.
  • Support inventory monitoring to prevent shortages, excess, or obsolescence.
  • Cost Saving Responsibilities
  • Generate data‑driven cost‑saving ideas aligned with business objectives.
  • Validate ideas with Finance and prepare OPW documentation.
  • Manage monthly OPW reporting and track cost‑saving initiatives.
  • Use analytics insights to identify cost risks, negotiate better terms, and optimize procurement.

Qualifications & Skills

  • B. Tech./B.E. in Mechanical Eng. with 2 - 5 years of experience in relevant fields.
  • Strong proficiency in Power BI (Advanced) including DAX, modelling, and data integration.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP MM, SAP Fiori, and procurement/inventory processes.
  • Exposure to Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms.
  • Strong SCM domain understanding: procurement, MRP, inventory, supplier coordination.
  • Analytical, data‑driven mindset with strong problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to independently manage digitalization tasks and work with cross‑functional teams.

WE DON'T NEED SUPERHEROES, JUST SUPER MINDS!

WE’VE GOT QUITE A LOT TO OFFER. HOW ABOUT YOU?

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in across Gender, LGBTQ+, Abilities & Ethnicity. job.title: CFIN O2C Solution Architect
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

O2C Solution Lead ###

We are seeking a skilled Order-to-Cash (O2C) Solution architect to play a key role in configuring, implementing, and supporting O2C processes within the Central Finance (CFIN) system. The O2C Solution architect will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, process owners, and technical teams to ensure seamless integration of O2C functions within the CFIN framework. This role requires deep functional knowledge of O2C processes, as well as the ability to translate business requirements into system configurations that optimize efficiency, accuracy, and business performance. This position requires close coordination with Deployment team, Functional architects and external vendors, to maintain and evolve the O2C architecture, ensuring it meets business needs and complies with ABB's standards.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Finance Services business Finance Process Data Systems division in Bangalore, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • O2C Process Configuration: Configure and maintain Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes such as credit management, billing, collections, and accounts receivable within the Central Finance (CFIN) system, ensuring alignment with business needs and industry best practices. Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders and process owners to thoroughly understand their requirements, document functional specifications, and translate these into system configurations.
  • System Integration: Facilitate seamless integration of O2C processes within the CFIN system, as well as with other enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, etc.), ensuring smooth data flow and automation of processes across platforms. User Support & Training: Provide ongoing functional support to end-users, addressing issues, offering solutions, and conducting training to ensure optimal utilization of the system and full understanding of O2C processes.
  • Testing & Validation: Participate in testing and validation activities for new configurations, enhancements, and fixes, ensuring they meet business and functional requirements. Process Optimization: Regularly monitor and evaluate O2C processes to identify opportunities for automation, efficiency improvements, and best practice implementation within the CFIN system.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for O2C system configurations, process flows, and integration points, ensuring compliance with internal standards and regulatory guidelines. Collaboration with Technical Teams: Work closely with IS architects, developers, and technical teams to ensure that functional requirements are correctly implemented and aligned with system design specifications.
  • Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution: Provide expert troubleshooting support for O2C-related system issues, working collaboratively with cross-functional teams to resolve any challenges promptly. Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about the latest industry trends, best practices, and system updates to continuously enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of O2C processes within CFIN.
  • Project and New Demand Management: Take ownership of configuring new demands or changes in system functionality, ensuring proper alignment with system design documentation and business requirements. O2C-Related Data Management: Oversee the management and accuracy of O2C-related data within the system, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and compliance with business rules across all O2C processes.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. Relevant certifications in O2C SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP CFIN, or IT architecture. Proven experience (5+ years) in O2C process management, with a strong background in system configuration and implementation within SAP or similar ERP environments (SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP CFIN).
  • Strong functional knowledge of Order-to-Cash processes, including order management, credit management, billing, collections, and accounts receivable. Experience in configuring O2C processes in SAP or similar ERP systems, with a solid understanding of integration points and data flows across systems. Familiarity with Central Finance (CFIN) and integration with other finance-related modules.
  • Experience with requirements gathering, business analysis, and documentation of functional specifications. High level understanding on Credit Management & Integration process between source & CFIN High level Down Payment concepts, Industry solution for Project Cash flow, Provisioning based on global rule sets, Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and technical teams. A strong focus on continuous improvement and automation, with a passion for driving innovation within enterprise systems. Experience in managing relationships with external vendors and third-party service providers to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions. Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, dynamic work environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

More about us:

ABB Finance is a trusted partner to the business and a world-class team who delivers forward-looking insights that drive sustainable long-term results and operates with the highest standards.

We value people from different backgrounds. Apply today for your next career step within ABB and visit www.abb.com to learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. #MyABBStory

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Trade, Customs & Transportation Specialist
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Procurement and Logistics Manager ###

Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will support ABB’s Automation business in India by improving excellence in trade, customs, and logistics operations. You will collaborate closely with Legal, Procurement, Trade Compliance, SCM, and Logistics teams to improve compliance practices and enhance operational efficiency across the end-to-end supply chain. Each day, you will apply your skills to ensure smooth customs operations, regulatory adherence, and optimized logistics performance.

The work model for the role is: #LI - Onsite

This role contributes to the Automation Business Unit in the India-Bangalore region. Main Stakeholders include Trade Compliance Officers, Customs Brokers, Freight Forwarders, Procurement teams, Logistics Providers, and Customs/Regulatory Authorities

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Optimizing trade and customs operations by developing strategies that reduce costs, improve efficiency, and ensure full regulatory compliance.
  • Managing end-to-end logistics processes including transportation, freight forwarding, customs clearance, and warehousing.
  • Managing customs compliance activities by acting as the primary contact for brokers, ensuring accurate declarations, and conducting audits to verify correctness of entries and records.
  • Maintaining regulatory knowledge by staying updated on import/export laws, tariffs, duties, licensing requirements, and global sanctions frameworks, while working closely with Trade Compliance Officers.
  • Managing vendor and partner relationships through evaluation of customs brokers, freight forwarders, and logistics providers, supporting Procurement in negotiations and KPI development.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in International Trade, Supply Chain, Economics, Commerce, or related discipline.
  • 10–12 years of experience in Trade & Customs Logistics Operations with solid experience in compliance and local regulations.
  • Extensive knowledge of customs laws, DGFT processes, regulatory compliance, sanctions frameworks, and internal audit practices.
  • Experience in developing and implementing trade compliance policies and process improvements.
  • Practical experience with Global Trade Management Systems, including SAP GTS.
  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex trade and customs topics for diverse stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to track, report on, and manage government communications, notices, and dispute resolution processes.

More about us:

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: R&D Software Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

R&D Team Manager ###

What We Believe In

ABB's Energy Industries business enables customers across oil & gas, chemicals, life sciences, power generation, and water sectors to operate safer, smarter, and more sustainable industrial facilities.

We deliver integrated automation, electrification, and digital solutions that help customers improve operational efficiency, reliability, cybersecurity, and sustainability through advanced industrial software, control systems, and digital engineering technologies.

Your Role and Responsibilities

In this role, we are looking for an R&D Software Engineer – Industrial Automation to join our Energy Industries Digital Organization. You will contribute to the design, development, testing, and deployment of enterprise-grade industrial automation software, supporting next-generation SCADA, HMI, communication, and digital engineering platforms.

Working as part of a collaborative Agile engineering team, you will develop scalable software solutions using C++, .NET/C#, ASP.NET Core, Angular/React, and modern cloud technologies while partnering with Product Management, Solution Architects, Test Engineering, and Domain Experts to deliver secure, reliable, and high-performance industrial software.

This role is contributing to the Energy Industries – Research & Development organization in Bangalore, India.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

##

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise-grade industrial automation applications using C++, .NET/C#, ASP.NET Core, Angular/React, and modern engineering practices, ensuring scalable, secure, and high-quality software delivery.
  • Develop and support SCADA, HMI, historian, and industrial communication solutions by integrating PLCs, RTUs, Flow Computers, and third-party systems using protocols such as OPC UA, Modbus, IEC 60870-5-104, and DNP3, while optimizing system performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Architects, Test Engineering, and cross-functional teams to deliver software through Agile methodologies, implement CI/CD practices, leverage AI-assisted development tools, and support Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and customer deployments.
  • Drive engineering excellence by adopting software development best practices, performing root cause analysis, improving cybersecurity, enhancing application performance, maintaining technical documentation, and contributing to continuous innovation and product improvements.

##

Qualifications for the Role

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5–10 years of experience in industrial automation software development using C++, .NET/C#, ASP.NET Core, Web APIs, and modern enterprise application development practices.
  • Strong experience with Angular or React, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, NoSQL databases, object-oriented programming, and enterprise software architecture.
  • Knowledge of SCADA, HMI, historian systems, industrial communication protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3), Windows Server environments, and Industrial Cybersecurity principles (IEC 62443) is preferred.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Azure or AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, cloud-hosted industrial solutions, and AI-assisted software development tools is considered an advantage.
  • Understanding of process automation domains such as Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Power Generation, or Water industries, along with high-availability and disaster recovery architectures, is desirable.
  • Strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently in Agile teams while continuously learning emerging technologies and engineering best practices.

More About Us

ABB's Energy Industries business enables safe, smart, and sustainable operations across the oil & gas, chemicals, life sciences, power generation, and water sectors. We deliver integrated automation, electrification, digitalization, and industrial software solutions that help customers improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, optimize energy consumption, and accelerate digital transformation.

Our R&D organization develops innovative industrial software, cloud-enabled applications, intelligent automation platforms, and advanced digital engineering solutions that empower customers to operate more safely, efficiently, and sustainably. By combining deep domain expertise with cutting-edge technologies, ABB continues to shape the future of industrial automation.

At ABB, you'll collaborate with global engineering teams to build next-generation industrial software while advancing your expertise in automation, cloud technologies, AI-assisted engineering, and digital transformation. We foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, diversity, and inclusion where every individual is empowered to make a meaningful impact.

ABB is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants. Employment is subject to applicable background verification and pre-employment screening in accordance with ABB policies.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Associate Principal Software Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

R&D Team Manager ###

What We Believe In

ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.

We deliver automation, electrification, and digital solutions across process, hybrid, and maritime industries through advanced industrial software, cloud-native platforms, AI-enabled technologies, and analytics solutions that accelerate digital transformation and operational excellence.

Your Role and Responsibilities

In this role, we are looking for a Principal Software Engineer – SCADA & Industrial Automation to join our Energy Industries Digital Organization. You will provide technical leadership in the design, development, and evolution of next-generation SCADA and industrial automation software platforms while driving innovation across enterprise-scale, mission-critical applications.

Working closely with Product Management, Architects, DevOps, Quality Engineering, and global R&D teams, you will lead end-to-end product development, influence software architecture, mentor engineering teams, and deliver secure, scalable, and high-performance software solutions using C++, C#, .NET, Angular, and modern cloud-native technologies.

This role is contributing to the Energy Industries – Research & Development organization in Bangalore, India.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Lead the architecture, design, development, and lifecycle management of enterprise SCADA and industrial automation software by delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance solutions using modern full-stack technologies, industrial communication standards, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Drive technical leadership by defining engineering standards, conducting architecture and code reviews, mentoring engineers, leading complex technical investigations, and collaborating with Product Management, Architecture, Quality Engineering, and global R&D teams to deliver strategic product initiatives.

For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. In this role, you will handle the engineering, configuration, integration, testing, and technical implementation of security solutions from design through commissioning. You will work closely with project managers, technical managers, construction teams, commissioning engineers, clients, and third-party vendors to deliver integrated systems that meet project specifications, client requirements, and industry standards.

How you will do it:

  • Prepare and provide technical documentation, including shop drawings, as-built drawings, operation and maintenance manuals, and programming matrices.
  • Develop and review system architecture, security system designs, device schedules, and technical specifications.

  • Support factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), pre-commissioning activities, and troubleshooting.
  • Identify and resolve system configuration issues, software-related issues, integration challenges, and technical queries.
  • Promote and practice health and safety policies and procedures throughout project operations and client contracts.
  • Carry out and encourage proactive customer relations.
  • Provide on-site placement when needed.

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s degree from a reputable university in Electronics, Computer & Science, Instrumentations, or Industrial Engineering.
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in installation, configuration, or servicing of Lenel OnGuard, CCURE 9000, AMAG, BVMS, Interlogix, PIDS, DSC, Kantech, or HID.
  • Experience with enterprise security platforms such as Software House, LenelS2, Gallagher, Genetec, Milestone, Senstar, and Traka.
  • English proficiency in reading, writing, and conversation.
  • Computer literacy and networking knowledge, including MS Windows, Linux, Office, LAN, and Fiber Optic.
  • Experience in civil and electrical construction works.
  • Strong interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate with vendors and make decisions using industry-standard knowledge.
  • One or more certifications in Lenel OnGuard, CCURE 9000, AMAG, or BVMS.
  • Experience with AutoCAD or Revu BlueBeam.
  • Ability to provide technical assistance as needed to related parties.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally

job.title: Service Team Manager (HVAC & Chillers) - Brisbane Relocation Opportunity
job.description:
Build Your Future with Johnson Controls

At Johnson Controls, we're shaping the environments where people live, work, learn, and thrive. As a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, we help customers optimize energy performance, reduce carbon emissions, and deliver resilient operations across critical industries including data centres, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

With more than 140 years of innovation and industry leadership, Johnson Controls combines world-class technology, lifecycle services, and an unrivalled field service network to help customers achieve exceptional results while creating a more sustainable future.

Ready for a Lifestyle Change?

If you're an experienced HVAC, Refrigeration, or Chiller Services leader currently based elsewhere in Australia and looking for your next challenge, this could be the opportunity you've been waiting for.

Join our Brisbane leadership team and enjoy the benefits of living and working in Queensland, including a warm climate, affordable lifestyle, excellent schools, and easy access to some of Australia's most iconic beaches and outdoor destinations.

We welcome applications from experienced professionals across Australia who are open to relocating to Brisbane for the right career opportunity.

About the Opportunity

An exciting leadership opportunity has become available for an experienced Service Team Manager to lead our Brisbane Chiller Services team.

In this pivotal role, you will oversee day-to-day service delivery operations, leading a team of highly skilled technicians, apprentices, and a Service Delivery Manager. You'll play a key role in driving operational excellence, developing talent, strengthening customer relationships, and growing our service and maintenance portfolio across Queensland.

This position is ideal for a proven HVAC or Chiller industry leader who enjoys being close to the business, supporting teams in the field, and delivering outstanding outcomes for customers.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead, coach, and inspire a high-performing service team to achieve operational and financial objectives.
  • Drive operational excellence across the Chiller Service business.
  • Manage service delivery performance, maintenance schedules, contract execution, and budget outcomes.
  • Review customer accounts to identify opportunities for growth, profitability, and enhanced service delivery.
  • Oversee backlog management, estimating activities, contract renewals, and onboarding processes.
  • Manage workforce planning, technician utilisation, labour forecasting, and materials allocation.
  • Support the ongoing development of technicians through coaching, mentoring, training, and performance management.
  • Lead recruitment and onboarding initiatives to build a strong and capable team.
  • Partner directly with customers and attend site visits to ensure exceptional service delivery and customer satisfaction.

What You'll Bring

  • Demonstrated leadership experience within the HVAC, Refrigeration, or Chiller industry.
  • Strong technical understanding of Chiller systems, with Controls experience highly regarded.
  • Proven ability to lead teams, drive performance, and deliver operational results.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong commercial acumen, planning, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Exceptional organisational skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a focus on safety, quality, and customer outcomes.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

  • Lead an established and growing service business in Brisbane.
  • Opportunity to relocate and build your career in one of Australia's fastest-growing regions.
  • Career development opportunities within a global industry leader.
  • Access to world-class training, leadership development, and technical expertise.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Competitive remuneration package and employee benefits.
  • Opportunity to contribute to innovative and sustainable solutions that make a real impact.

Eligibility

This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Australia with full, unrestricted Australian working rights.

Successful candidates will be required to complete pre-employment checks, including a medical assessment, criminal history check, and drug and alcohol screening.

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you're an experienced HVAC or Chiller leader ready to take the next step in your career and relocate to Brisbane for an exciting leadership opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of sustainable building solutions with Johnson Controls.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Johnson Controls, diversity and inclusion are fundamental to who we are. We foster a culture where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives. Together, we create an inclusive environment that drives innovation, strengthens our teams, and helps us deliver exceptional outcomes for our customers and communities.

You have the opportunity. You have the voice. You belong at Johnson Controls.

job.description:
What you will do

The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Security System global projects as per country specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid.   • Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc.
  • Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction.
  • Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences.
  • Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects.
  • Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
  • Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.
  • Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives

What we look for

  • BE (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication).
  • Strong knowledge of Security Systems (Access, Video, Intrusion , Complete ELV system etc)
  • Expertise in Security Guidelines.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.) , Blue Beam
  • Knowledge of different types of network protocols like BACNet, Modbus, OPC, and other protocols.
  • Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.

Preferred

9+ years of relevant experience in Security System.

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. Provide technical product application support ( mech plus electrical knowledge) to sales teams in pursuit of air cooled chiller equipment sales opportunities in the India Market, to power our customer’s mission by utilizing the right equipment for the application. job.description:
Who we are: -

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What you will do :-

The primary responsibility will be Sales in the Industrial vertical. Shall focus on Industrial projects and sell solutions related to Fire Detection, Fire Protection, Security Systems and Building management Systems as an added advantage. Knowledge on Fire Protection systems such as Gas based suppression systems, Water Mist, Hydrants, Foam, and CO2 will be of added advantage along with Fire Detection and Security background.

job.title: Lead Application Engineer I
job.description:
What you will do

The primary responsibility for this role is to work on end-to-end presales engineering activities of Fire and Security opportunities within India from various verticals (e.g., Transportation, Data Center, Commercial, Industries, Fit-outs, Key Accounts, etc.). You will be handling techno-Commercial activities of the projects covering various ELV systems such as Fire Alarm System, CCTV Surveillance & Security System, Access Control System, Public Address System, Parking Management System, Structured Cabling System, network Infrastructure, Building Management Systems etc. You should own the technical consideration to win the job and should be part of HOTO process to get the D&E and OPS approval for booking

How you will do it:

  • Review the project inputs and project intake form shared by the Front desk/Sales.
  • Analyze the requirement and initiate the Kick-off call with Front Desk after getting CoE SFDC Code and time frame.
  • Prepare designs on given floor plans to arrive with the BOQ; in case BOQ is unavailable.
  • Identify potential issues/risks and proactively bring them to the customer's knowledge and help to mitigate the identified risks.
  • Initiate the discussion with OEMs & subcontractors and get the right solution and proposal from OEMs.
  • Analyze the proposal and commercials received from the OEM and verify the same based on the past data and benchmark costing available in the SCM Database.
  • Upon completion of cost comparison, prepare the optimized techno-commercial Costing sheet, Proposal, and Compliance Statements.
  • Once the deliverables are ready, perform Self QC and get the 2nd level QC done by the Delivery Manager. Eventually, submit the deliverables to the Front Desk.
  • Perform 2nd level QC of the deliverables done by other Application Engineers in the team
  • Update the SFDC regularly, and complete timesheet & assigned training on time.
  • Actively negotiate and follow up with OEMs and Internal OPS/ Post Sales team to get the right kind of prices for the project.
  • Regularly participate in the Daily Call /Cadence Call with the business team.
  • Actively derive the strategy for increasing the win rate.
  • Align with Organization KPIs such as Quality, Cycle Time, OTD, Win rate, Productivity, etc.

What we look for

  • BE (Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication)
  • Must have 11+ years of relevant experience in ELV Systems domains.
  • Strong knowledge of ELV & ICT Systems (Fire Alarm System, CCTV, Access Control, PAVA, Intrusion Detection Systems, Intercom Systems, Gate Barriers, Car parking system, Structured Cabling, Network Switches, etc.).
  • Knowledge in Building Management System will be added advantage for the role.
  • Must have India projects' presales and estimation experience on various verticals.
  • Design know-how of the ELV & ICT Systems.
  • Capable of understanding ELV Systems specifications and doing product selections along with the deviation/compliance statements.
  • Must be able to work on complex costing sheets covering Material, Engineering, Operations, and Subcon costs.
  • Skill in articulating offered solutions in a structured way through high-standard technical proposal documents.
  • Must have a strong network with the 3rd party vendors in India.
  • Must be a quick learner & keen on problem-solving techniques.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Must be a good team player.

job.title: HVAC Equipment Service Technician 1
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and customer-focused Service Engineer - HVAC to install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems. The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in commercial and industrial HVAC equipment and be capable of delivering quality service while ensuring customer satisfaction.

##

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform installation, commissioning, testing, and maintenance of HVAC systems.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot issues related to chillers, AHUs, FCUs, VRF/VRV systems, package units, and other HVAC equipment.
  • Conduct preventive and corrective maintenance activities.
  • Attend service calls and provide timely resolution of customer complaints.
  • Prepare detailed service reports and maintenance records.
  • Monitor system performance and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with safety standards, company policies, and industry regulations.
  • Coordinate with customers, contractors, and internal teams for project execution and service delivery.
  • Manage spare parts requirements and inventory for service activities.
  • Support warranty and annual maintenance contract (AMC) activities.

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, or related field.
  • Relevant HVAC certification is preferred.

Required Skills

  • Strong knowledge of HVAC systems and refrigeration principles.
  • Hands-on experience with VRF/VRV systems, chillers, cooling towers, AHUs, FCUs, and ducting systems.
  • Ability to read technical drawings, wiring diagrams, and schematics.
  • Knowledge of HVAC controls and building management systems (BMS).
  • Strong troubleshooting and fault diagnosis skills.
  • Good communication and customer-handling abilities.
  • Proficiency in MS Office and service documentation.

job.title: Site Reliability Engineer, AI Infrastructure
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why you’ll love working here

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work.

Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

ROLE SUMMARY

Firmus Technologies is seeking a skilled Site Reliability Engineer, AI Infrastructure to join our Operations team, supporting the daily operations and maintenance of our AI-accelerated high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure. This role will work closely with Field Service Engineers, HPC and Network Engineering teams, and assist the Global Operations Centre (GOC). This is a unique opportunity to contribute directly to the stability and growth of cutting-edge AI infrastructure.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support in the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of various high-end GPU servers, storage servers, networking equipment and software components in highly secure environments.
  • Perform hardware diagnostics, systems functionality and firmware updates as required.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to assist in tailored customer environments deployment (eg: bare-metal systems, HPC Clusters, Kubernetes, Slurm etc).
  • Serve as first line of engineering support for onsite operational issues, including troubleshooting hardware, network and software problems, and firmware compliance.
  • Troubleshoot incidents, escalate critical issues and provide feedback to appropriate teams for improvements.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure 24/7 availability and responsiveness to critical issues.
  • Provide technical support to the GOC Support Specialist team in troubleshooting compute infrastructure related problems.
  • Document incident details, resolutions, and lessons learned to enhance future problem-solving.
  • Maintain clear, accurate, and up-to-date documentation to promote effective knowledge sharing across the team.
  • Communicate effectively with GOC, HPC Engineers, internal teams, stakeholders, and end-users to ensure alignment on issue resolution.
  • Take part in team meetings and knowledge-sharing sessions to foster collaboration and continuous learning.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of experience in field service technical areas.
  • Strong understanding of server hardware technology, firmware lifecycle, Linux environments and troubleshooting hardware problems, with adherence to physical and system-level security standards.
  • Experience with scripting languages (eg: Bash, Python)
  • Familiarity with using configuration management, CICD tools, workload manager and cluster softwares (eg: Slurm, Kubernetes, Nvidia BCM) and Observability tools (eg: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc)
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

Location

This role is based in Brooklyn, Melbourne, Australia.

Employment Basis

Full-time

job.title: Sr Program Specialist (Airport)
job.description:
Job Description

THE FUTURE IS WHAT WE MAKE IT.

_Sr Program Specialist (Airport)_

_Jurong, Singapore_

Start your career by making an impact and real connections with some of the most meaningful challenges around. When you join Honeywell, you become a member of our performance culture comprised of diverse leaders, thinkers, innovators, dreamers, and doers who are changing the future.

Make the Best You.

Working at Honeywell is not just creating incredible things. You will collaborate with top minds, grow through continuous learning, and benefit from an inclusive environment that rewards performance and celebrate achievements.

Join Us and Make an Impact.

The Senior Project Engineer is responsible for the engineering, execution, installation, testing, commissioning, and successful delivery of airport systems projects involving Airfield Ground Lighting Control & Monitoring Systems (AGLCMS), Airfield Lighting Facilities (AFL), Constant Current Regulators (CCR), Emergency Response Systems (ERS), Airfield Electrical Infrastructure, and related airport systems.

The role serves as the technical lead during project execution, coordinating engineering design, procurement support, site installation, system integration, FAT/SAT activities, commissioning, and handover. The Senior Project Engineer works closely with clients, airport authorities, consultants, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with ICAO, FAA, EASA, and airport authority standards.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering & Technical Leadership

  • Lead the detailed engineering design, review, and implementation of airport and airfield-related systems.
  • Prepare and review:
  • System architecture drawings
  • Shop drawings
  • Single-line diagrams
  • Cable schedules
  • Interface documents
  • Method statements
  • Testing and commissioning procedures
  • Ensure compliance with:
  • ICAO Annex 14
  • FAA Advisory Circulars
  • EASA Standards
  • Airport Authority Specifications
  • Client Technical Requirements
  • Provide technical support throughout project lifecycle from concept to handover.

Project Execution

  • Support the Project Manager in planning and executing airport projects.
  • Monitor project schedules and engineering deliverables.
  • Coordinate engineering, procurement, installation, testing, and commissioning activities.
  • Track project progress and proactively identify execution risks.
  • Prepare weekly and monthly project reports.
  • Participate in project review meetings and stakeholder discussions.

Airport Systems Responsibilities

Lead engineering and implementation activities for:

Airfield Ground Lighting Systems (AGL)

job.title: Advanced Data Scientist
job.description:
Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Mathematical Formulation: Translate ambiguous business problems into mathematically sound framework objectives and optimisation targets.
  • Production-Grade Engineering: Write clean, modular, and maintainable code using production-level design patterns to scale mathematical models.
  • Big Data Processing: Design and manage scalable data pipelines to process massive datasets efficiently for model training and inference.
  • Deep Learning & Vision Development: Build, train, and fine-tune complex neural networks across text, audio, and visual modalities.
  • Cloud Deployment: Architect and deploy models to cloud environments, leveraging distributed computing and robust cloud infrastructure.

Required Technical Skills & Competencies

1\. Tooling, Libraries & Software Engineering

  • Core Language: Advanced proficiency in Python with a strict adherence to Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles, clean coding standards, and design patterns.
  • Machine Learning Libraries: Advanced proficiency in scikit-learn (sklearn) for data preprocessing, feature engineering, and baseline modelling.
  • Deep Learning Frameworks: Core expertise in PyTorch (preferred) or TensorFlow for building, customizing, and training deep neural networks from scratch.
  • Big Data Ecosystem: Experience with Apache Spark (PySpark) and the Hadoop Ecosystem (HDFS, Hive, MapReduce) for handling, transforming, and querying large-scale distributed datasets.
  • Cloud Architecture: Experience building and deploying scalable machine learning applications on major cloud platforms ( AWS, Azure, or GCP).

2\. Core Mathematics & First-Principles ML

  • Foundational Math: Solid foundation in Linear Algebra (eigenvalues, SVD, matrix decompositions), Multivariable Calculus (partial derivatives, gradients, Jacobians), and Probability Theory (Bayesian inference, probability distributions, expectation maximization).
  • Machine Learning: In-depth understanding of standard Machine Learning algorithms (Trees, Boosting, SVMs, GMMs) with the ability to explain the underlying loss functions and optimizations mathematically.
  • Deep Foundations: Thorough understanding of Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs), mathematical derivation of backpropagation, hyperparameter initialization strategies (Xavier, He), optimization variants (Adam, RMSProp), and advanced regularization techniques (L1/L2, Dropout, Batch Normalization).

3\. Advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP)

  • Sequential Networks: Hands-on experience with sequence modeling, including Word Embeddings (Word2Vec, FastText), RNNs, LSTMs, and GRUs.
  • Transformer Ecosystem: Deep structural knowledge of the Transformer architecture (Self-Attention math, Multi-Head mechanisms).
  • Pre-trained NLP Models: Experience implementing and fine-tuning encoder-only (BERT, RoBERTa) and decoder-only (GPT series) architectures.

4\. Computer Vision (CV) & Document AI

  • Spatial Networks: Deep understanding of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), feature map mathematics, pooling operations, and advanced CV backbones.
  • OCR & Document Processing: Proven track record building or customizing Optical Character Recognition (OCR) systems for complex text extraction pipelines.
  • Vision Transformers: Familiarity with the adaptation of attention mechanics to visual tasks (ViTs, Swin Transformers).

Education & Experience

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s, Master's, or Ph.D. in a highly quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Physics, or Operations Research).
  • Experience: 4 to 6 years of industry experience working as a Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer with a portfolio of complex multimodal projects.

Job Summary

As a Genesys Technical Architect, you will be responsible for defining, designing and governing the technical architecture of the global Genesys Cloud contact center platform. The role will translate business and operational requirements into scalable, secure and maintainable Genesys Cloud solutions across Universal UI, voice, digital channels, routing, IVR, integrations, reporting and automation capabilities. You will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, service owners, integration teams, vendors and delivery teams to ensure architecture quality, platform standardization, solution consistency and successful implementation of Genesys capabilities across regions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the end-to-end technical architecture for Genesys Cloud contact center solutions, ensuring alignment with global platform standards, business requirements and enterprise architecture principles.
  • Design scalable Genesys Cloud solutions across IVR, call flows, queues, routing strategies, skills, data tables, callbacks, voicemail, digital channels, workforce management, analytics and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Lead technical solution design for integrations between Genesys Cloud and enterprise systems such as CRM, ServiceNow, SAP, Microsoft Teams, identity management, reporting platforms and middleware solutions.
  • Translate business processes, customer journeys and operational needs into technical designs, architecture documents, configuration blueprints and implementation guidelines.
  • Provide technical leadership to delivery teams during configuration, development, testing, deployment and transition to operations for new Genesys features and enhancements.
  • Review and validate solution designs, integration patterns, security controls, data flows, API usage and configuration changes to ensure stability, performance, maintainability and compliance.
  • Missing Telco Architecture capability – Technical knowledge & setup, Global geo capability of legal laws/regulation
  • Internal SHS Infra setup – know-how & understanding
  • Integration Architecture – Data Lake / DB (Snowflake/SQL/Azure), Pipeline (Snaplogic) & other middleware with source
  • Support complex technical issue resolution by analyzing platform behavior, integration failures, routing logic, call flow defects, performance concerns and configuration dependencies.
  • Maintain technical architecture documentation, reusable design patterns, standards, decision logs and roadmap inputs for continuous platform evolution.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Strong hands-on experience in Genesys Cloud architecture, configuration and implementation for enterprise contact center environments.
  • Deep understanding of Genesys Cloud capabilities including Architect call flows, IVR, ACD routing, skill-based routing, bullseye routing, queues, users, roles, divisions, scripts, wrap-up codes and reporting.
  • Experience designing omnichannel contact center solutions across voice, email, chat, messaging, SMS, callbacks, voicemail and digital engagement channels.
  • Strong knowledge of Genesys Cloud APIs, integration patterns, event-driven architecture, authentication, SCIM/user provisioning, data actions and middleware-based integrations.
  • Experience integrating Genesys Cloud with CRM, ITSM, ERP, Microsoft Teams, identity platforms, data lake, analytics or reporting solutions.
  • Good understanding of cloud architecture, security, network connectivity, telephony concepts, SIP, SBC, BYOC/Cloud Voice concepts and enterprise identity management.
  • Ability to create technical architecture documents, solution designs, sequence flows, integration specifications, test support documentation and operational handover materials.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder & project management skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions, risks and trade-offs to business, IT and vendor stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Telecommunications or a related technical discipline.
  • 8-10 years of overall IT experience, including significant experience in contact center technology, cloud platform architecture or enterprise communications solutions.
  • Minimum 4-5 years of practical experience with Genesys Cloud or Genesys PureCloud implementation, configuration, architecture or technical leadership.
  • Genesys Cloud certifications such as Genesys Cloud Certified Professional, Architect or Developer are preferred.
  • Experience with integration platforms and cloud technologies such as Azure, AWS, Snaplogic, REST APIs, JSON, JavaScript or similar technologies is an advantage.
  • Experience working in global transformation programs, multi-country rollouts, managed service environments or distributed delivery teams is preferred.
  • Experience working with managed service providers, platform vendors and distributed support teams across multiple countries and time zones.
