job.title: Research and Development Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Vertiv is seeking a Research and Development Engineer to join our high-density liquid cooling R&D team in Edenbridge, UK. The successful candidate will independently lead test design, experimental analysis, and development of next-generation liquid cooling solutions for data centre and critical infrastructure applications. This role involves hands-on laboratory work, test rig design and commissioning, data acquisition and analysis, and active collaboration with cross-functional engineering teams to advance Vertiv's thermal management product portfolio.

Responsibilities

  • Design, set up, operate, and maintain liquid cooling test rigs and experimental apparatus in accordance with Vertiv Engineering SOPs and Standard Work procedures.
  • Lead and execute product performance test design and validation protocols for high-density liquid cooling systems, including cold plate assemblies, coolant distribution units (CDUs), and rear-door heat exchangers.
  • Independently collect, record, and analyse test data, drawing conclusions and presenting findings using data acquisition systems, ensuring accuracy and traceability per Vertiv's Item and Item Structure Management SOP (PLM-ISM-SOP-001).
  • Design and prepare test apparatus and instrumentation setups for R&D experiments, ensuring alignment with defined test objectives
  • Perform routine calibration and maintenance of laboratory instruments, pressure transducers, flow meters, thermocouples, and data acquisition tools.
  • Lead the development and documentation of test procedures, work instructions, and standard operating procedures aligned with Vertiv's Model-Based Definition (MBD) process
  • Maintain laboratory housekeeping standards, ensuring cleanliness and compliance with workmanship standards (processes, tools, materials, discipline, and cleanliness)
  • Lead prototype assembly, leak testing, pressure testing and functional operation of liquid cooling components, coordinating with senior engineers as required.
  • Comply with Vertiv's Electrical Safety Programme requirements, including proper use of PPE, risk assessments, and Lock-Out/Tag-Out (LOTO) procedures when working with energised test equipment.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to Standard Work development as outlined in the VOS Global Procedure.
  • Independently compile, analyse, and present test results, anomalies, and technical observations to the R&D engineering team in a timely manner.
  • Lead and support ECN (Engineering Change Notice) release processes and configuration management activities.

Requirements

Education

  • BEng (Hons) or HNC/HND (Level 4/5) in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline.

Experience

  • Ideally, previous engineering R&D or relevant field experience, with demonstrated ability to independently plan and conduct experiments.

Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience with hydraulic/fluid systems, including pumps, valves, heat exchangers, and piping assemblies.
  • Proficiency in using data acquisition systems and laboratory instrumentation (thermocouples, pressure sensors, flow meters, power quality analysis).
  • Competence in reading and interpreting engineering drawings and technical specifications.
  • Solid understanding of heat transfer principles and fluid dynamics, with ability to apply theory to experimental design.
  • Familiarity with electrical safety practices for test environments.
  • Competent in the use of Microsoft Office applications and data analysis tools.

Personal Attributes

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative R&D team.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proactive approach to health and safety compliance.
  • Proven ability to independently solve engineering problems and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

Nice to have

  • Foundation Degree or BEng (Hons) in a relevant engineering discipline.
  • Experience with liquid cooling systems, thermal management, or HVAC/R technologies.
  • Experience with programming languages (Python, Labview).
  • Knowledge of CAD software (Creo Parametric or equivalent) for reviewing 3D models and assemblies.
  • Experience with PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) systems, particularly Oracle Product Development Cloud.
  • Familiarity with Lean manufacturing principles and Standard Work methodologies.
  • IOSH Managing Safely or NEBOSH General Certificate.
  • 18th Edition IET Wiring Regulations (BS 7671) awareness.
  • Experience working in a data centre or critical infrastructure environment.

About Us

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

  • High-Performance Culture
  • Customer Focus
  • Operational Excellence
  • Innovation
  • Financial Strength

VERTIV BEHAVIORS

  • Own it
  • Act with urgency
  • Foster a customer-first mindset
  • Think big and execute
  • Lead by example
  • Drive continuous improvement
  • Learn and seek out development
  • Promote transparent & open communication

About Vertiv

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Vertiv is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We promote equal opportunities for all with respect to hiring, terms of employment, mobility, training, compensation, and occupational health, without discrimination as to age, race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy status (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression (including transgender status or sexual stereotypes), genetic information, citizenship status, national origin, protected veteran status, political affiliation, or disability. If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, you can request help by sending an email to [help.join@vertiv.com](mailto:help.join@vertiv.com)

job.title: Technical Service Delivery Director
job.description:
Milan, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

This position is based in Milan, Italy.

The Service Delivery Director is responsible for end-to-end delivery of telco and ICT services, ensuring services are delivered on time, within budget, and in line with agreed service levels and customer expectations.

This role provides strategic and operational leadership across Project and Service Management, driving service excellence, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement for enterprise and/or wholesale customers.

Service Delivery Leadership

  • Own end-to-end service delivery performance across telco and ICT portfolios (e.g. fixed line network services, cloud, cybersecurity, managed services, unified communications).
  • Act as executive sponsor for key customer accounts, ensuring strong governance, escalation management, and relationship management.
  • Ensure service delivery aligns with commercial commitments, contractual SLAs, and regulatory requirements.
  • Drive a customer-centric culture focused on service quality, reliability, and continuous improvement.

2. Project Management Oversight

  • Provide executive oversight of all delivery projects, including telco provisioning, network rollout, ICT transformation, service onboarding, and customer migrations.
  • Establish and govern a standardized Project Management framework (e.g. waterfall, agile, hybrid).
  • Ensure strong project governance, risk management, dependency management, and financial control.
  • Monitor delivery KPIs such as schedule adherence, cost variance, scope control, and benefits realization.
  • Intervene proactively on at-risk or critical projects to ensure successful outcomes.

3. Service Management & Operations

  • Lead Service Management functions aligned to ITIL / ISO 20000 best practices, including:
  • Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management
  • Service Level Management
  • Capacity, Availability, and Continuity Management
  • Ensure operational readiness for new services and smooth transition from project to BAU.
  • Oversee 24/7 operational support models (internal teams and/or vendors).
  • Drive service stability, reduction of repeat incidents, and improved MTTR and SLA compliance.

4. Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Establish service delivery governance frameworks, forums, and reporting structures.
  • Ensure compliance with security, data privacy, and regulatory standards relevant to telco and ICT services.
  • Manage vendor and partner performance, including SLAs, OLAs, and contractual obligations.
  • Oversee audit readiness and remediation of service delivery risks.

5. Financial & Commercial Management

  • Own service delivery budgets, cost optimisation initiatives, and financial forecasting.
  • Ensure delivery efficiency while protecting margins and supporting revenue growth.
  • Support pre-sales and bid activities by shaping delivery models, cost estimates, and risk assessments.
  • Drive productivity improvements through automation, tooling, and process optimisation.

6. People & Capability Leadership

  • Lead and develop high-performing teams across project management, service management, and operations.
  • Build succession plans and capability uplift in areas such as cloud, cybersecurity, automation, and digital service delivery.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Set clear performance objectives and manage talent development.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Telecommunications, Information Technology, Business, or related field.
  • 15+ years of experience in telco/ICT service delivery, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles.
  • Proven track record in managing large-scale service delivery portfolios and complex ICT/telco projects.
  • Strong knowledge of ITIL, ISO 20000, and project management methodologies (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile).
  • Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, optimize costs, and drive revenue-supporting initiatives.
  • Experience in vendor/partner management and regulatory compliance.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive-level presentation skills.

job.title: Retail Consultant, Rockingham
job.description:
Rockingham, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, connecting more than 11 million customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital experiences that help people feel more connected.

We’re searching for positive, customer‑focused Retail Service Consultant to join our Rockingham team in a Full-Time capacity. If you love helping people, thrive in a supportive team environment, and bring energy to every conversation, we’d love to have you on board.

At Optus, you’ll feel connected to what truly matters. We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships, with our customers and with each other.

Your day to day:

  • Be the face of Optus, delivering standout customer experiences powered by optimism, curiosity and genuine care.
  • Build strong product knowledge and become an expert across the full range of tech solutions, explaining everything in a friendly, simple and accessible way.
  • Use your personality, listening skills and service centric approach to understand customer needs and deliver personalised solutions that make their day.
  • Support customers through all enquiries, anything from general questions to complex issues, using empathy, clear communication and calm de‑escalation.
  • Contribute to a welcoming, customer‑first environment by working closely with your team and helping create memorable moments for every visitor.
  • Stay adaptable and proactive, helping out in periods of high activity and jumping in where needed to keep the store running smoothly.

It starts with you!

  • Service Superpower: You naturally focus on customer needs, offer genuine support, and let great service lead to phenomenal outcomes.
  • Tech Explorer: You enjoy helping customers understand technology, breaking it down simply and guiding them to the right solution.
  • Problem‑Solving Pro: You listen with empathy, act with genuine curiosity and integrity, and turn challenges into opportunities to help with calm, practical solutions.
  • Composure Under Pressure: You stay steady during tricky situations, easing tension with care and working toward the best result for the customer.
  • Team Spirit: You build strong connections with your teammates, support and educate one another, stay accountable and create a space where everyone succeeds together.

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and access to exclusive discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.

job.title: Offensive Security Consultant, Google Cloud, Mandiant Consulting
job.description:
About the job

Mandiant's offensive security consulting team is responsible for performing Red and Purple Team assessments of customer environments. We breach our customer networks to reveal flaws, test weaknesses, and to exercise defensive teams and capabilities. We take Mandiant's frontline incident response and intelligence knowledge and apply cutting edge techniques and tradecraft being used by threat actors in the wild.

Our consultants are offensive security experts who specialize at executing all stages of the attack lifecycle, from initial compromise, privilege escalation, lateral movement, to achieving desired objectives. We adapt to customer technologies, from on-premises networks, to modern cloud architecture, to zero-trust and identity-centric environments, and everything in between.

We work together to emulate ransomware, financial, espionage, and other threat actors, and we aim to deliver the most realistic breach scenarios.

Part of Google Cloud, Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. Mandiant's cybersecurity expertise has earned the trust of security professionals and company executives around the world. Our unique combination of renowned frontline experience responding to some of the most complex breaches, nation-state grade threat intelligence, machine intelligence, and the industry's best security validation ensures that Mandiant knows more about today's advanced threats than anyone.

**

Responsibilities

  • Perform Red and Purple Team assessments, including end-to-end adversarial emulation of cyber attacks against customer organisations, and other technical cyber assessments including external penetration, web application, mobile and wireless security testing.
  • Expand the team’s capabilities through tool creation, research on offensive techniques, incorporation of threat actor intelligence, internal presentations and knowledge share.
  • Develop comprehensive and accurate reports and presentations for both technical and executive audiences, and act as a trusted advisor to c-level, security leaders and other customer stakeholders.
  • Assist with scoping prospective engagements, leading teams for engagements from kickoff through remediation phase, as well as mentoring other staff.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Remediation Specialist
job.description:
What You'll Do

  • Assess and investigate customer cases across remediation programs, executive escalations, TIO disputes, Financial Counsellor referrals and other complex customer matters.
  • Review and analyse high-profile cases, develop remediation recommendations and present outcomes to senior stakeholders where required.
  • Lead complex investigations and collaborate with Quality Control, Regulatory, Legal and operational teams to ensure appropriate customer outcomes.
  • Champion the customer voice by identifying vulnerability, assessing customer impact and recommending fair and transparent resolutions.
  • Identify root causes and systemic issues, translating insights into improvements across processes, controls and customer experience.
  • Support proactive remediation initiatives while ensuring outcomes align with regulatory obligations and customer expectations.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years' experience in a dedicated remediation, complaints, dispute resolution or customer advocacy role managing complex cases end-to-end.
  • Proven experience identifying root causes, applying remediation frameworks and delivering fair outcomes for customers.
  • Strong experience managing escalated and sensitive customer matters with sound judgement, empathy and resilience.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple business areas and senior leadership groups.
  • Strong understanding of customer vulnerability, customer experience drivers and fair customer outcomes.
  • Knowledge of regulatory, complaint management or remediation environments will be highly regarded.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present clear recommendations and insights.

The good stuff….

  • Competitive remuneration and colleague discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and outstanding shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.

job.title: Telstra Retail: Part Time Customer Service & Sales Consultant RHODES
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

7 Oct 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Telstra Retail: Part Time Customer Service & Sales Consultant RHODES

Job Summary

As a Retail Consultant, you will provide frontline support by assisting customers with product selection, service activation, and troubleshooting basic issues. You will create positive experiences through effective communication and adherence to retail standards. This role demonstrates foundational autonomy and contributes to customer satisfaction and store performance.

Job Description

Ready to Make a Difference? Join Our Iconic Team at Telstra!

At Telstra, we’re more than just a leading telecommunications company—we’re where passion meets purpose. As a Retail Customer Service & Sales Consultant, you’ll have the opportunity to work for an iconic Aussie brand that’s been connecting Australians for generations. You won’t just be a friendly face in-store—you’ll be the trusted expert who helps customers find tech solutions that enhance their lives. This is your chance to make a meaningful impact by bringing our purpose to life: to build a connected future so everyone can thrive.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Deliver Exceptional Customer Experiences: Help customers find the right products and services to suit their needs, ensuring their time at Telstra is a memorable one.
  • Be the Go-To Tech Expert: Stay up-to-date with the latest gadgets and services, offering informed guidance and solutions.
  • Achieve and Excel: Use your consultative selling skills to meet and exceed sales targets and KPIs, while keeping customers connected.
  • Collaborate and Contribute: Work closely with your team to create a welcoming environment where everyone is supported to achieve store goals.

Salary and Benefits:

  • Hourly Rate: $33.33 per hour

*Junior rates apply for those under 20 years of age.

*Penalty rates are as follows: Additional 25% for weekday hours worked after 6 PM, 25% for hours worked on Saturday, 100% for hours worked on Sunday and 150% for hours worked on public holidays.

  • Plus 12% Superannuation
  • Generous Discounts: Enjoy 30% off Telstra services and exclusive offers with over 240 brands and partners.
  • Leave Options: Take advantage of 16 weeks of paid parental leave, the Telstra Extra Day Off, gender affirmation leave, Cultural Leave, Blood Donor Leave, and the ability to purchase up to 4 weeks of additional leave.
  • Training & Career Growth Opportunities: Access over 17,000 learning programs with LinkedIn Learning, and develop your career with our Future Ready program designed to build on your skills and prepare you for your next step.
  • Flexibility: We offer flexible working hours and a supportive approach to parental leave—do it your way!
  • Recognition & Rewards: Benefit from performance rewards and a range of recognition programs to celebrate your success.
  • Inclusive Culture: Join a diverse and inclusive team where everyone’s unique perspective is valued and respected.

Is It You We’re Looking For?

  • Language Skills: Fluency in Mandarin and English is highly desirable, as you'll be supporting and communicating with Mandarin-speaking customers within our local community.
  • Great Communication Skills: You’re a natural at connecting with people and making their day better.
  • Solution-Oriented Approach: You enjoy thinking on your feet and tailoring solutions for each customer.
  • Sales Drive: You’re motivated to achieve (and exceed!) sales targets and KPIs.
  • Passion for Learning: You’re eager to grow and develop your skills in a dynamic environment.
  • Resilience and Positivity: You have a can-do attitude, even when things get busy.
  • Customer-Facing Experience: Previous experience is a plus but not required—bring your enthusiasm and we’ll teach you the rest!

How to Apply:

Ready to kickstart your journey with us? Click "Apply Now" to submit your application! After applying, keep an eye out for an email from our partner, HireVue, to complete the next step in our assessment process.

Join Us at Telstra Retail:

When you become part of the Telstra team, you’re joining a brand that celebrates diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone is respected, valued, and can thrive. We can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to our team!

job.title: Site Security Manager
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As a Site Security Manager reporting directly to the Building Services Manager you will work closely with the rest of the Operations team, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • Supervise the security and soft services aspects of the data centre facility operations for assigned properties
  • Manage 3rd party security staff’s performance to ensure adherence to standard operating procedures and any other requirements to deliver AirTrunk’s maintenance and compliance programs
  • Oversee maintenance and upgrades on the site security network

Your Day to Day

  • First point of contact for all visitors, responsible for the efficient processing of visitors, contractors, clients and AirTrunk staff into the facility as well as any other front of house requests
  • Conduct regular property inspections focusing on security and EHS
  • Ensure all aspects of data centre security systems are in line with AirTrunk’s policies
  • General administrative duties, such as producing reports, providing evidence for audit, and tracking time and attendance of staff
  • Coordination with Site FM team leads on security, access, and maintenance requirements
  • Ensure new security staff and security vendors are trained and qualified
  • Assist in the delivery of various accreditation initiatives, including, but not limited to, ISO 27001 and SOC 2
  • Support the Critical Environments team in the management of physical security incidents at the property
  • Develop emergency response plans and conduct drills
  • Coordinate staff when responding to emergencies and alarms
  • Ensure compliance with all relevant security regulations and standards
  • Support Building Service Manager in soft services

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of experiences and 2+ years of experience in a people management role, ideally in a physical security or operations environment
  • Data centre or mission critical background is a plus
  • Successfully managed audit and ideally experience with managing 3rd party vendors and customers
  • Security License and First Aid Certificate holder or meet requirements to acquire these
  • Experience in reporting and emergency response planning
  • Ability to comprehend, analyse and interpret operational documents
  • Can establish and review incident reports, emergency event summaries, root cause analysis reports and O&M manuals
  • Proficient in computer systems, ideally with experience in CCTV and/or EACS systems (such as Genetec or Lenel)
  • Registered as Fire Safety Officer

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Security Design and Integration Manager - India
job.description:
Led by an experienced management team and supported by a strong investor group, including large and experienced institutions and strategic partners, EdgeConneX offers a dynamic, fast-paced work environment where we are bringing flexibility, proximity, power, and connectivity to some of the world’s key businesses. With major offices in Herndon, Denver, Amsterdam, Singapore and Malaysia, we have a global footprint and a unified team of employees committed to providing a premier customer experience and delivering the full spectrum of data center solutions, from core to edge, like no other data center provider can do.

Focused on driving innovation and helping our customers define and deliver their own unique vision for the Edge, at any scale, in any market worldwide, for any requirement, we are building tomorrow’s data center infrastructure, today for some of the world’s most demanding Network, Content, and Cloud customers.

The Security Design and Integration Manager will drive efforts in securing data centers across India and will be based out of Mumbai, or Hyderabad, working in a remote setup.

This role supports the delivery of physical security scope for AdaniConneX projects in the region, from early design through commissioning and turnover, and oversees compliance with EdgeConneX physical security standards across security design, integration, implementation, and programming. The role also supports the integration of EdgeConneX security and customer security efforts, ensuring compliance with all applicable standards. Successful execution requires strong navigation of local construction practices, regulatory authorities, and stakeholder dynamics, and the ability to build durable working relationships with sophisticated enterprise customers. This position is customer-facing and must uphold the ideals of EdgeConneX excellence.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Support the delivery of physical security scope for AdaniConneX projects across from early design through commissioning and site turnover and oversee compliance with EdgeConneX physical security standards throughout.
  • Serve as subject matter expert (SME) on EdgeConneX requirements and physical security standards, providing authoritative guidance to project teams, delivery partners, and stakeholders.
  • Support the definition of project security requirements and acceptance criteria, ensuring alignment to EdgeConneX physical security standards and customer expectations.
  • Support procurement and provide technical oversight of security designers, integrators, and programmers.
  • Review security designs and submittals produced by integration partners for compliance with EdgeConneX physical security standards, including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, intercoms, and related field devices.
  • Liaise with customer security teams and local construction teams to align AdaniConneX project delivery with EdgeConneX physical security standards and customer-specific requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate and liaise with both AdaniConneX stakeholders and customer subject matter experts (SMEs) to align on security requirements, resolve issues, and maintain a shared understanding throughout delivery.
  • Oversight of physical security systems, including S2, Lenel, and Genetec systems.
  • Validate installation and configuration quality through quality checks, site walks, and commissioning reviews; audit security contractors on quality, schedule, and compliance.
  • Support closure of design gaps, defects, and punch items, including verification of corrective actions.
  • Adapt EdgeConneX baseline standards to local conditions and to authorities holding jurisdiction in India.
  • Maintain documentation quality, including design drawings, as-built records, test results, configuration records, and turnover packages.
  • Provide estimating and budgeting inputs for physical security systems when requested.
  • Collaborate with Security Operations on site turnover and operational acceptance.
  • Participate in shaping Security Design and Integration global standards and processes, and improve standards, templates, and repeatable design patterns to reduce rework and improve consistency across the portfolio.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong technical understanding of physical security systems and integration methods.
  • Ability to evaluate designs quickly, identify gaps, and make practical decisions under delivery pressure.
  • Strong vendor management sets expectations, enforces baseline requirements, and holds delivery partners accountable.
  • Strong communications, both written and verbal, in leading teams and coordinating with peers and other disciplines on driving projects and issues to closure.
  • Clear communicator who can translate technical requirements into simple, executable direction for integration partners and internal project teams.
  • Customer-facing presence; able to represent EdgeConneX professionally with sophisticated enterprise customers and sustain alignment through extended ramp and onboarding cycles.
  • Strong and effective team player working across various disciplines and peer groups; able to cover the full range of tasks required to get the job done.
  • Superb ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and responsibilities simultaneously.
  • Disciplined execution: tracking, documentation, follow-through, and closure.
  • Comfortable operating across multiple sites and stakeholders in a multilingual Indian environment without losing attention to detail.
  • Commitment to organizational excellence and constant awareness of opportunities to improve processes and quality of deliverables.
  • Superb ability to work independently while adhering to standards.
  • Ability to use computer systems related to security management and reporting.

Experience / Education

  • 3+ years of experience in physical security design, systems integration, or physical security program delivery.
  • Minimum 2 of those years managing large-scale security design and installation projects.
  • Experience supporting critical infrastructure environments; Data center experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience delivering in India or the broader APAC region, including working knowledge of local construction practices and jurisdictional security requirements.
  • Experience working with technical drawings and standard construction deliverables such as submittals, requests for information, and as-built documentation.
  • A working knowledge or ability to learn: PCI/DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001 certifications, as well as AutoCAD and associated drawing programs.
  • Candidates with experience in S2, Lenel, ExacqVision and/or Genetec are highly encouraged to apply.
  • Certified Protection Professional (CPP), Physical Security Professional (PSP), or equivalent certification preferred, or willingness to pursue.
  • Fluent in English required; proficiency in Hindi or additional Indian regional languages a plus.
  • Interest in cyber security.
  • Travel - the candidate is expected to travel around 50% regional and global travel for this position, including travel on short notice.

EdgeConneX believes inclusion – of thought, backgrounds and experiences – affects all that we do, from our employees to the solutions we deliver. Our goal is to create an environment where embracing differences helps deepen the lives and work experience of our employees, enhances our innovation and creativity, and enriches our involvement in our communities. EdgeConneX is an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, as well as any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

EdgeConneX offers a competitive benefits package.

job.title: Critical Operations Technician - Mechanical (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Critical Operations Technician provides 24×7×365 operational coverage to support continuous, safe and reliable performance of critical electrical, mechanical, cooling, controls and life-safety systems across the data centre. The role performs hands-on operational maintenance, system monitoring, first-response troubleshooting, incident support and contractor coordination to uphold STACK’s 100% uptime commitment. Technicians operate and monitor facility infrastructure across power and cooling paths within approved procedures and role-specific authorisations, while maintaining a concierge-level customer service approach in all stakeholder interactions.

Essential Functions – Critical Operations

  • Maintain 24×7×365 shift coverage, ensuring safe and stable operation of all critical infrastructure systems.
  • Operate and monitor critical electrical and/or mechanical systems (based on background, training and authorisation) including UPS, PDUs, switchboards, generators, CDU/FWU/CRAC/CRAH units, chilled water systems, pumps and associated plant—strictly within approved operating procedures.
  • Perform hands-on operational maintenance within authorised scope, including inspections, condition monitoring, equipment resets, minor adjustments and component-level replacements (non-licenced work).
  • Identify abnormal conditions, complete initial diagnostics, implement first-level rectification actions where authorised, and escalate promptly to the Senior Data Centre Specialist.
  • Respond to alarms and operational incidents, supporting containment, investigation, communication and restoration activities.
  • Use BMS/EPMS and monitoring platforms to track alarms, interpret trends and support performance optimisation within approved limits.
  • Complete structured rounds including meter readings, thermal/capacity checks and condition observations, recording findings accurately.
  • Coordinate and supervise licenced contractors performing trade-restricted works, ensuring compliance with permits, LOTO and site safety requirements.
  • Support planned maintenance, shutdowns, testing and return-to-service activities through operational tasks, witnessing and verification.
  • Maintain accurate shift logs, event records, handover notes and CMMS updates to ensure full operational traceability.
  • Proactively identify and report reliability risks and improvement opportunities to support STACK’s 100% uptime commitment.
  • Participate in incident management training and exercises, acting as a trained first responder under direction of incident leaders.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of SOPs, MOPs, EOPs, risk assessments and operational readiness activities.
  • Provide professional, timely communication to customers and stakeholders to support a high-quality service experience.
  • This role does not perform licenced electrical, mechanical or refrigeration work. All trade-restricted activities are undertaken by appropriately qualified contractors or licenced personnel. The role focuses on operational system management, first-response troubleshooting, vendor coordination and component-level maintenance within authorised limits.

People

  • Set a high standard for safety behaviour, operational discipline and professional conduct across the shift.
  • Support technicians through on-the-job coaching, demonstrations and constructive feedback to improve capability and consistency.
  • Assist with onboarding and familiarisation of new team members, reinforcing authorised boundaries and operational expectations.
  • Strengthen team communication by ensuring clear handovers, accurate escalation details and calm coordination during events.
  • Participate actively in briefings, toolbox talks, training and operational discussions, offering practical observations and improvement ideas.
  • Build collaborative relationships with Security, Projects and vendor personnel to support safe, coordinated site operations.
  • Demonstrate a concierge‑level customer service approach in all interactions with customers, visitors and stakeholders.

Competencies

  • Operational discipline with a strong focus on safety, risk control and reliability
  • Ability to operate critical electrical and/or mechanical systems within procedural and authorisation boundaries
  • Effective troubleshooting, root-cause thinking and first-response decision-making under pressure
  • Ability to interpret alarms, trends and technical documentation (SLDs, O&M manuals, procedures)
  • Proficient in digital operational systems (BMS/EPMS, CMMS, workflow platforms) and reporting tools
  • Strong communication skills and calm, structured incident support
  • Contractor coordination capability with sound permit-to-work and LOTO awareness
  • Customer-focused, professional service orientation
  • Collaborative team behaviour with personal accountability and consistency on shift
  • Continuous improvement approach (procedures, logs, risk reduction and operational uplift)

Preferred Education and Experience

  • 2-3 years' experience in critical environments such as data centres, hospitals, utilities, defence, industrial plants or similar operational settings.
  • Demonstrated capability operating and/or monitoring electrical and/or mechanical infrastructure (e.g., UPS, generators, switchgear, PDUs/PMMs, ATS/STS, CRAC/CRAH, chilled water systems, pumps, fire systems and controls).
  • Hands-on experience performing operational maintenance and first-level rectification activities within authorised limits.
  • Experience using BMS/EPMS and CMMS/workflow tools to manage alarms, work orders and operational documentation.
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings and documentation (including single-line diagrams and O&M manuals).
  • Familiarity with permit-to-work, LOTO and basic risk assessment principles.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills suitable for shift logs, incident updates and customer/stakeholder engagement.

Work Environment/Conditions

  • Role operates on a 24×7 rotating shift roster including nights, weekends and public holidays.
  • Work occurs in data halls, plant rooms, electrical/mechanical spaces and external plant areas; PPE is required as per site policy.
  • Participation in emergency response activities and incident exercises is required.

Work Authorization/Security Clearance Requirements

  • Legal entitlement to work in Australia.
  • Ability to satisfy pre-employment screening requirements (as applicable), including right-to-work checks, background checks and reference checks.
  • Ability to meet data centre security requirements including badging, access control and adherence to customer-mandated security protocols.
  • Security clearance is not required unless specified for a customer-specific facility.

job.title: Energy Portfolio Analyst (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Energy Analyst – Markets & Sustainability is a key role within STACK’s Power & Energy team, responsible for energy accounting, consumption forecasting, utility cost validation and administration of STACK’s electricity supply and renewable energy arrangements across its Australian portfolio.

The role will establish and maintain accurate visibility of energy consumption, cost and forecast demand across STACK’s data centres, providing the data and analysis required to support energy procurement, budgeting, sustainability reporting and business decision-making.

The Energy Analyst will also manage day-to-day interfaces with electricity retailers, Metering Service Providers and DNSPs, administer energy contracts and renewable energy certificate requirements, and support the implementation and ongoing management of STACK’s energy accounting systems.

This role will work closely with Power & Energy, Finance, Operations and other relevant stakeholders to ensure energy data, costs and forecasts are accurate, transparent and effectively managed.

Energy Accounting, Forecasting & Analytics

  • Manage energy forecasting across STACK’s Australian data centre portfolio, including validation of electricity invoices against metering data, contracted rates, network tariffs and applicable charges.
  • Investigate billing and consumption discrepancies and coordinate resolution with retailers, Metering Service Providers, DNSPs and internal stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain short-, medium- and long-term electricity consumption forecasts, incorporating actual and forecast data centre load growth.
  • Track actual energy consumption and cost against forecast, identify material variances and provide supporting analysis.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards covering energy consumption, cost, forecasts and other relevant energy metrics.
  • Support Finance with energy accruals, budgeting, reconciliations and energy-related financial reporting.

Energy Markets, Contracts & Stakeholder Administration

  • Support administration of electricity retail contracts, PPAs, metering arrangements and other energy-related agreements.
  • Maintain a central register of energy contracts, key dates, pricing arrangements, obligations and renewal requirements.
  • Manage day-to-day interfaces with electricity retailers, Metering Service Providers and DNSPs relating to billing, metering, consumption data and account administration.
  • Coordinate LGC and other renewable energy certificate surrender requirements, including tracking, reconciliation and supporting evidence.
  • Support electricity procurement activities, retailer engagements, contract renewals and commercial evaluations.
  • Analyse consumption profiles, tariffs and energy costs to support procurement and portfolio decisions.

Energy Systems, Sustainability Reporting & Business Support

  • Support selection, implementation and ongoing administration of STACK’s energy accounting and energy management software, including integration of retailer, metering and internal energy data.
  • Maintain appropriate data-quality, validation and reconciliation processes across energy systems and reporting.
  • Provide accurate energy consumption, renewable energy and supporting data inputs into NABERS, NGER, renewable energy indices and other applicable sustainability and regulatory reporting.
  • Support establishment of energy accounting, metering and reporting processes for new and expanding data centre sites.
  • Identify opportunities to automate and improve energy data collection, invoice validation, forecasting and reporting.
  • Provide ad hoc energy analysis and administrative support as STACK’s energy procurement, sustainability and portfolio requirements continue to evolve.

Competencies

  • Strong numerical, analytical and data-management capability.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify billing and data discrepancies.
  • Understanding of electricity billing, metering, network tariffs and retail electricity arrangements.
  • Strong Excel/ Power BI and data-analysis capability.
  • Ability to develop clear forecasts, dashboards and management reporting.
  • Strong organisational and contract-administration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple external service providers and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and establish processes within a developing function.
  • Commercial mindset and interest in Australian electricity markets and renewable energy.

Travel Required

Travel within Australia and, from time to time, internationally to support STACK projects, stakeholder meetings, technical reviews, workshops and commissioning activities.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, Energy or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3–5 years’ relevant experience in energy, utilities, energy accounting, commercial analysis, finance or a related field.
  • Experience working with electricity invoices, utility accounts, energy data or metering information.
  • Experience with forecasting, budgeting, reconciliation or management reporting.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience analysing large datasets.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and ability to manage recurring analytical and administrative processes.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience within the Australian electricity market.
  • Experience with large commercial and industrial electricity customers.
  • Experience working with electricity retailers, Metering Service Providers and/or DNSPs.
  • Understanding of NEM metering and electricity settlement data.
  • Experience with energy accounting or energy management software.
  • Experience with Power BI or similar data visualisation tools.
  • Understanding of LGCs, renewable energy certificates and renewable electricity procurement.
  • Exposure to electricity retail contracts, PPAs or energy procurement.
  • Familiarity with NABERS, NGER and renewable energy / sustainability reporting frameworks.
  • Data centre or other large energy-user experience would be highly regarded experience with 132 kV, 220 kV, 275 kV, 330 kV or higher-voltage systems.
  • Experience with Australian TNSPs/DNSPs and contestable assets.
  • Experience with hyperscale data centres or large industrial loads.
  • Experience with BESS and renewable-energy infrastructure.

Equal Opportunity Employer

job.title: Senior Specialist - Environment, Health and Safety Officer
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Senior Environmental Health and Safety Officer is an advanced subject matter expert, responsible for consulting on and implementing Environmental Health, and Safety (EHS) policies, ensuring health and safety conditions in the work environment to prevent harm, injury and illness.

This role is accountable for instituting controls and remedial measures for hazardous and potentially hazardous conditions or equipment, including those that harm the external environment.

This role analyzes and designs control for the prevention of occupational diseases, and manages the risk related to the environment and related incident management.

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities

  • Creates surveys and assessments to identify hazardous conditions that affect workers, property, the environment and the general public and develop measures to eliminate these.
  • Responsible for surveying and investigating the working conditions, determine the causes, and recommend action that will prevent further incidents or accidents.
  • Provides consulting around the practical steps to ensure compliance to laws and regulations that govern environment, health and safety matters.
  • Responsible for conducting risk assessments and related audits to mitigate organisational liability against relevant laws and regulations.
  • Accountable for new employee health and safety orientation.
  • Responsible for conducting safety training and education programs with existing employees, including demonstrating the use of safety equipment.
  • Co-ordinate and attend related committee meetings.
  • Networks with external stakeholders, including the local authorities, communities, hospitals and disaster management groups to develop maintain and update emergency response plans and procedures.

May act evacuation marshal, fire marshal and/or incident coordinator Knowledge, Skills and Attributes: Strong knowledge and understanding of applicable laws, regulations and other legal regulations that govern environment, health and safety in the workplace Display strong influencing ability and interpersonal and verbal and written communication skills Display strong planning, organising and problem-solving ability Strong attention to detail and display the ability to collaborate with a variety of internal and external stakeholders Academic Qualifications and Certifications: Relevant Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification and/or experience Relevant Health, Safety and Environmental certification(s) Required Experience: Advanced active working experience with environment, health and safety issues in a related industry / environment Advanced experience dealing with a variety of stakeholders and influencing decision making to manage business risk Advanced experience dealing with legislators and governing bodies Advanced knowledge of the environmental, health and safety laws, regulations, codes, and standards and their application and interpretation

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Electrical & Electronics VAVE - Product Testing
job.description:
Job Description

Job Description forEngineer – Product Testing(VAVE)

Job Description

Coordinate with design, production, procurement, and product testing teams to validate cost-optimized solutions for existing and new products under VAVE (Value Analysis and Value Engineering) initiatives. The primary responsibility is to ensure reliability, functional integrity, and certification compliance after implementing VAVE changes. This role requires validating design and component modifications through structured testing, automation programs, and compliance assessments. The candidate must ensure that all VAVE changes maintain product performance, safety, and quality standards without compromising customer requirements. Being part of a Global Engineering Function, the role demands strict adherence to defined processes and communication protocols.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform testing and validation of VAVE-related design and component changes in power supply products, modules, and systems.
  • Conduct hardware and software testing (black box/white box) for communication power products to ensure compliance post-cost optimization.
  • Develop and maintain automated test programs for validating VAVE modifications efficiently.
  • Formulate test plans, stress conditions, and procedures for evaluating new components or design changes introduced through VAVE.
  • Collaborate with design, procurement, reliability, and compliance teams to verify cost-optimized solutions without affecting performance.
  • Ensure all VAVE changes comply with UL, CE, and other international safety and certification standards.
  • Prepare detailed test reports, risk analysis, and recommendations for each VAVE implementation.
  • Participate in root cause analysis for failures during VAVE validation and provide corrective action inputs.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance cost competitiveness while maintaining high reliability and safety standards.

Job Specifications:

  • Education: Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Power Electronics / Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
  • Experience: 5 to 6 years of experience in power electronics product/module testing (AC/DC chargers, DC/DC converters, UPS preferred).
  • Hands-on experience in automation testing tools and programming for test systems.
  • Strong understanding of analog and digital circuits, power conversion principles, and common topologies.
  • Knowledge of safety certification processes (UL, CE) preferred.
  • Familiarity with VAVE methodology, cost optimization principles, and supplier component qualification.
  • Proactive, analytical, and result-oriented, with the ability to think critically and solve problems independently.
  • Excellent time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal in English).

Key Skills:

  • VAVE (Value Analysis & Value Engineering) implementation and testing
  • Power electronics testing (AC/DC, DC/DC, UPS)
  • Automation testing and scripting
  • Analog & digital electronics troubleshooting
  • Compliance & certification validation (UL, CE)
  • Test plan creation and execution
  • Cost optimization validation techniques
  • Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis
  • Hands-on test and measurement capability (oscilloscopes, power analyzers, etc.)

About the Team

Work Authorization

No calls or agencies please. Vertiv will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

job.description:
Job Description

Technical Project Lead (Energy Storage)

Pune, India

Job Description

Job Summary

The Technical Project Lead works with the offering management team to refine product requirements and turn them into product specifications that drive cross-functional team development. This role leads the development teams through the NPD process cycle at a technical level (as opposed to high-level program management) to make sure the end product meets the requirements.

This role will focus on Vertiv Energy Storage product line offerings. The individual will be responsible for understanding product requirements and developing technical product specifications that will drive the cross-functional development teams. This role works through the entire product development cycle to make sure the R&D team stays on schedule and meets the original market requirements. Close collaboration between offering management, system engineering, mechanical engineering, product engineering, firmware engineering, agency compliance, and product integrity teams.

Responsibilities

  • Drive requirements refinement, specification development, and task tracking through iterative review cycles.
  • Hold authority on system design decisions as they pertain to meeting market requirements for energy storage products.
  • Translate detailed technical development plans into simplified project milestones for executive tracking purposes.
  • Must track development progress vs plan and manage resource needs to stay on schedule.
  • Provide technical support and leadership to product development teams as the first step in the escalation path if issues or questions arise. Escalate major issues to the appropriate resources and pursue to closure.
  • Work with cross-functional teams (Offering Management, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical/System Engineering, Firmware Engineering, Engineering Test) to create development plans and strategy and bring products from ideation to concept and market launch. Example development stages:

  • Detailed specification breakdown and work/task breakdown based on higher-level requirements
  • Concept development and refinement

job.title: Engineer II Electrical & Electronics Engineering X
job.description:
Job Description

Job Description for Sr. Engineer – Product (VAVE & Sustaining)

Job Description

Lead and coordinate with design, production, procurement, and product testing teams to validate cost-optimized solutions for existing and new products under VAVE (Value Analysis and Value Engineering) initiatives. The primary responsibility is to ensure reliability, functional integrity, and certification compliance after implementing VAVE changes. This role requires validating design and component modifications through structured testing, automation programs, and compliance assessments. The candidate must ensure that all VAVE changes maintain product performance, safety, and quality standards without compromising customer requirements. Being part of a Global Engineering Function, the role demands strict adherence to defined processes and communication protocols.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform testing and validation of VAVE-related design and component changes in power supply products, modules, and systems.
  • Conduct hardware and software testing (black box/white box) for communication power products to ensure compliance post-cost optimization.
  • Develop and maintain automated test programs for validating VAVE modifications efficiently.
  • Formulate test plans, stress conditions, and procedures for evaluating new components or design changes introduced through VAVE.
  • Collaborate with design, procurement, reliability, and compliance teams to verify cost-optimized solutions without affecting performance.
  • Ensure all VAVE changes comply with UL, CE, and other international safety and certification standards.
  • Prepare detailed test reports, risk analysis, and recommendations for each VAVE implementation.
  • Participate in root cause analysis for failures during VAVE validation and provide corrective action inputs.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance cost competitiveness while maintaining high reliability and safety standards.

Job Specifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Power Electronics / Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
  • Experience: 5 to 6 years of experience in power electronics product/module testing (AC/DC chargers, DC/DC converters, UPS preferred).
  • Hands-on experience in automation testing tools and programming for test systems.
  • Strong understanding of analog and digital circuits, power conversion principles, and common topologies.
  • Knowledge of safety certification processes (UL, CE) preferred.
  • Familiarity with VAVE methodology, cost optimization principles, and supplier component qualification.
  • Proactive, analytical, and result-oriented, with the ability to think critically and solve problems independently.
  • Excellent time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal in English).

Key Skills:

  • VAVE (Value Analysis & Value Engineering) implementation and testing
  • Power electronics testing (AC/DC rectifier, DC/DC converters, UPS)
  • Automation testing and scripting
  • Analog & digital electronics troubleshooting
  • Compliance & certification validation (UL, CE)
  • Test plan creation and execution
  • Cost optimization validation techniques
  • Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis
  • Hands-on test and measurement capability (oscilloscopes, power analyzers, etc.)

Job Description

IT End User Services Senior Analyst

POSITION SUMMARY

  • The IT End User Services Senior Analyst provides foundational technical support to all users. They assist in analyzing and troubleshooting issues related to end-user computing digital assets (e.g., laptops, desktops, printers, mobile phones) and serve as a point of escalation for incidents that require local resolution.  Should have knowledge network and server troubleshooting. They work alongside the Platform Service Team to support corporate infrastructure and participate in various IT projects.

RESPONSIBILITIES

job.title: FSI Solutions Arch, FSI Solutions Arch
job.description:
AWS Global Sales (AGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

AWS India is looking for an experienced Solutions Architect to help advise our Financial Services & Insurance (FSI) customers in India on how to best adopt and leverage the value of AWS technology. This is an ideal role for someone with deep experience in the FSI industry, expert knowledge of financial services applications and infrastructure and a solid understanding of the transformational value cloud technologies can bring.

In this role, you will engage with customers in India to determine business needs, identify opportunities and issues, and develop related technical solutions and value propositions leveraging the power of AWS cloud technology.

Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

#aws-ags-India

Key job responsibilities

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design customer solutions with a focus on the Financial Services industry, collaborating with the AWS Business Development function and internal teams in India to help customers migrate to AWS cloud-based technology solutions.
  • Architect solutions leveraging AWS technology, including solution development and potentially demonstrate technical feasibility through mechanisms including proof-of-concepts and/or prototypes.
  • Serve as a thought leadership, evangelizing AWS services and technologies through forums such as AWS blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures and public-speaking opportunities such as AWS first-party events and third-party industry events.
  • Capture and share best practices and insights internally and with Partners and customers in India.
  • Identifying customer requirements and providing feedback into appropriate AWS services teams. Provide updates on customer progress and ensure plan execution by partners.
  • The right individual will leverage FSI Industry expertise, architecture experience, and customer-facing skills to be a "trusted advisor" to customers. They will be able to facilitate relationships with senior executive stakeholders, as well as easily interact with and give guidance to technology experts, software developers, IT professionals, and system architects to ensure better CX and compliance with global AWS standards, practices and policies.
  • The right individual will also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges. If you are someone who enjoys innovating, likes solving hard problems and working on cutting edge technology, we would love to hear from you.

  • 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
  • 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
  • Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
  • Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

job.title: Partner Success Manager -FED gov, Public Sector
job.description:
Partner Success Manager -FED gov Location: Gurugram External job description Would you like to own building the future for a leader in the Cloud Computing business? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is leading the next paradigm shift in computing and is building a team of business development professionals to establish relationships and manage the success of our emerging Technology and Consulting partners within the India Public Sector market for Amazon Internet Services Pvt. Ltd (AISPL), the local seller for cloud services in India. Do you have the business savvy, government business development, ecosystem experience and the technical background necessary to help further establish Amazon as a leading cloud platform provider for these partners? As a Partner Development Manager at AISPL, you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to build mindshare and adoption of AWS cloud in the Public Sector. Your mission will be to develop AWS cloud awareness and adoption, build AWS competency, and foster the development of cloud-based solutions with key AWS Partner Network (APN) of AISPL who deliver solutions for government, education, healthcare and non-profits. In this role, you will manage a territory of high value APN partners while developing business and technical relationships to grow the overall business. You will have day-to-day interactions with these partners as they progress in their adoption of AWS cloud for their solutions, and then as they bring the solutions to market and sell jointly with AISPL. The ideal candidate will possess both a business background that enables them to drive an engagement and interact at the executive level, as well as a technical background that enables them to easily interact with software developers and architects. He/she should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about the mission, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to build and convey compelling value propositions to all levels. Effectively developing and managing partners will require that you establish strong business and technical relationships through your knowledge of the Public Sector industry and customer requirements of AISPL. Through these relationships, you will be responsible for growing internal adoption of AWS, as well as broad organizational AWS competency in the partners in India. You will also work closely with the AWS Public Sector business development team to drive joint business engagement, as well as strategically plan for development of future opportunities and pursuits. Ideal candidates will possess both and technical business background that enables them to drive engagements and interact at multiple levels with APN partners and customers of AISPL, including the partner founders/ board. Candidates should also have strong industry experience and demonstrated the ability to think and act strategically on the government customer mission, industry directions, and partner/customer technical challenges. Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a key member of the AISPL Public Sector Team in helping to drive overall business goals.
  • Manage multiple APN partners in the West states ready to develop AWS cloud competency and fulfil government transactions. Manage a set of APN partners who build vertical solutions for the Public Sector.
  • Understanding of government procurement and contracting process to navigate the Public Sector contracting vehicles and RFP procedures with key strategic and advisory partners.
  • Understand the legal, compliance, security, and technical considerations and certifications specific to the Public Sector that impact your APN partner ecosystem.
  • Build and execute a plan to develop the competency and capabilities of the strategic and advisory APN partners in India through technical trainings/enablement, business development engagement, programs and operations that translates into a sustained and growing business portfolio for these APN partners.
  • Identify specific prospects/partners/channels to approach while communicating the specific value proposition for their business and use case.
  • Develop and manage the pipeline by engaging with prospects, partners, and key customers.
  • Manage complex contract negotiations and liaison with the Legal group.
  • Engage with APN partner teams on the new partner programs to build and scale the strategic partner engagements in the India state and local government segments.
  • Develop strategic relationship with chosen public sector domain partners to ensure that they adopt AWS as their cloud platform and jointly develop GTM (Go-To-Market) plans with solution focused approach.

Basic Qualifications

  • Partner, Tech Sales

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA, or Master's degree in computer science, technology, design
