job.title: Regional Standardized Offer & Sales Development Expert (Industrial Automation)
job.description:
Job Description

In Schneider Electric everything we do promotes progress and sustainability for all — our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies where we live and work. From the products, software, and services driving the digital transformation of energy management and automation to corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make an impact by helping people and organizations become more resilient and efficient, more electric and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

The Role

Join Schneider Electric as the Regional Standardized Offer & Sales Development Expert and drive the growth of Industrial Automation across East Asia. In this strategic regional role, you will shape market expansion, strengthen partner networks, and influence business outcomes by delivering innovative automation solutions. Collaborating with country, regional, and global teams, you will play a key role in driving transformation and creating a lasting impact in a rapidly evolving industry.

What will you do?

  • Identify and review market trends strategy involved to drive Go-To-Market Standardized Offer growth with stakeholders.
  • To gain market share within the region and in targeted application.
  • Design sales and marketing strategies for offer portfolio and arranging technical Seminars.
  • Evaluate and improve existing channel marketing strategies, develop new channel marketing strategies and implement action plans.
  • Ability to effectively market the key values and functions of standardized offer within multiple Go-To-Market & drive sales.
  • Build deep understanding of key OEM to promote and convert standardized architecture by leading sales technical engagement.
  • Leverage the channel to address the customer applications & nurturing them for technical capability enhancement.
  • Build market intelligence and implement battle cards against local competitors.
  • Drive digital campaigns to grow long-tail customers for lead generation.
  • Monitor and improve customer satisfaction within the region. Concentrate on the "voice of the customer" with the Line of Business in the monthly cadence to build sustainable growth.

What qualifications will make you successful?

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Mechanical), Business, Marketing, or a related discipline.
  • Min 3+ years of sales / business development experience in Industrial Automation, Industrial Components, Manufacturing, OEMs, Machine Builders, System Integrators, Distributors, or Automation Vendors.
  • Proven track record in business development, sales, product marketing, channel management, or technical sales within the industrial automation industry.
  • Strong understanding of industrial automation technologies, including: PLCs & HMIs, Variable Speed Drives (VSDs), Motion Control, Motor Control and Industrial Control Components, Power Supplies and Automation Architectures
  • Experience developing and executing Go-to-Market (GTM) strategies, channel development programs, and customer acquisition initiatives.
  • Ability to engage with OEMs, partners, distributors, and end-users to drive business growth and increase market penetration.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to analyze market trends, identify growth opportunities, and develop competitive strategies.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across local, regional, and global teams.

What's in it for me?

  • Work on high-impact projects that shape the future of energy management and sustainability
  • Collaborate with talented professionals in a culture that values innovation and technical excellence
  • Grow your expertise with access to advanced technologies and continuous learning opportunities

Let us learn about you! Apply today.

Rewards designed for you

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our [Career Page](https://www.se.com/careers).

\\* Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our  IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!

+9% organic growth

150 000+ employees in 100+ countries

job.title: Senior Project Engineer -SIS
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Engineering Manager ###

Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be a design authority for an engineering discipline. Each day, you will complete assignments on multiple projects of moderate size or portions of major projects in a cost-effective manner. You will also showcase your expertise by ensuring assignments are completed in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and cybersecurity policies and standards.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Process Automation business for Energy Industries division based in Bangalore, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Collaborating on project installation, commissioning, and site activities, to clarify potential issues or provide solutions to rectify the engineering errors.
  • Coaching the project engineers and designers on the translation of conceptual designs to engineering documentation, including modelling, prototyping, and calculations.
  • Leading, supervising, and coordinating teams (less than 10 members) in all engineering disciplines (both in-house and outsourced) on projects.
  • Applying design thinking or design for excellence concepts in projects, including modelling, prototyping, simulation, and calculations.
  • As a technical lead for all engineering disciplines - evaluates, selects and applies standard techniques, procedures and criteria to perform tasks for conventional projects.
  • Execute assignments using established solutions. May act as a design authority and completes engineering assignments.
  • Collaborates on project installation, commissioning and site activities, clarifying potential issues or providing solutions to correct engineering errors. Provides technical support to commissioning and start-up activities. Assists in creating proposals for projects.
  • Supports Contract Manager in issuing claims. Creates work plans and cost estimates in one’s area of responsibility.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Minimum 10 years of design, engineering, testing, commissioning and consulting experience of Control and Safety Systems in oil & gas production / refining / petrochemical / pharmaceutical industry. Experience in managing cross-functional teams.
  • TUV Functional Safety Engineer Certification (or equivalent).
  • Working knowledge of the Safety Lifecycle and participation in functional safety assessments. Working knowledge of IEC61508 and IEC61511
  • Proficiency in Safety System design, application programming, hardware design, and HMI graphics development.
  • Experience in safety system hardware inspection, FAT, SAT, loop checks, start-up and commissioning.

More about US :

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Sales Specialist - Product
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Sales Manager ###

What we believe in

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be responsible for the sales of products/systems/services within a designated market/division, in line with the division strategy. Each day, you will meet both qualitative and quantitative sales targets to ensure sustainable order growth, revenues, profitability, market share, and customer satisfaction. You will also use your skills by identifying and developing new sales opportunities.

The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite

As a Sales Engineer, you will manage the post-sales performance of ELSP & ELSB Products in Faridabad (NCR), India, specifying and implementing effective Panel Builder channel initiatives in line with global strategy.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Territory & Business Development: Manage coverage of Panel Builders, Key Industries, Building, Utility End Users, and influencers; identify new business opportunities and develop strategies to reach regional sales targets.
  • Sales Pipeline & Market Intelligence: Build and maintain a healthy opportunity pipeline, provide accurate sales forecasts, and share relevant market intelligence and customer insights with the Sales and Marketing teams.
  • Customer & Channel Management: Develop good, long-term relationships with Panel Builders and Channel Partners by understanding customer needs, resolving issues, ensuring a positive customer experience, and acting as a trusted technical partner.
  • Partner Expansion & Business Growth: Expand the expansion of IEC 61439-compliant partners in the assigned territory, promote new products and digitalization solutions across ELSP & ELSB, and conduct product promotion events and technical seminars.
  • Order Fulfillment & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate material delivery and after-sales service for Panel Builders, ensure effective information flow across sales activities, and collaborate with internal teams to deliver seamless customer support and business results.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Sales Experience: 5–10 years of relevant experience in Sales, with solid exposure to the LV Switchgear market in the NCR region.
  • Product Knowledge: Solid knowledge and practical experience in Low Voltage Equipment, LV Switchgear, and Electrical Distribution solutions.
  • Industrial Segment Knowledge: Good understanding of the Industrial customer segment, market dynamics, customer requirements, and electrical distribution applications.
  • Direct Sales & Business Development: Demonstrated experience in direct sales, account management, business development, and cross-selling to meet sales and revenue targets.
  • CRM & Sales Operations: Working knowledge of SFDC/CRM operations, including opportunity management, sales pipeline tracking, forecasting, and maintaining customer information.
  • Customer & Communication Skills: Solid written, verbal, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with a customer-centered mindset and an initiative-driven approach.
  • Educational Qualification: BE/B.Tech or higher qualification in Electrical or Electronics Engineering from a full-time, regular program, with relevant industry experience.

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Technician II, Process
job.description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.

We are looking out for a Process Technician to join our team in Goa!

How You'll Help Us Connect the World:

Work closely with Team Leaders and Process Engineer to implement standard production processes. Ensure correct BOM, drawings, routings and Work Instructions being followed.

Modify or develop new processes/methods, tools, fixtures or equipment for repeatable, reliable and cost-effective manufacturing.

Provide precise feedback to Process Engineer on Yield issues.

Analyze and find root causes for the product failure. Introduce Corrective, Preventive majors and improve First Pass Yield

Elaborate actions plan, audits to prevent non-conformity product situation. Call out disciplinary issues to Shift Supervisor.

Support new product introduction on manufacturing lines.

Address Critical Machine, tool breakdowns and maintenance.

Implement ECN

The role will involve working in all 3 rotational shifts.

Required Qualifications for Consideration:

  • Diploma/Bachelor’s in Engineering Mechanical/Electrical/ETC.
  • BE with preferably 1-2 years of related experience and Diploma with preferably 3-4 years of related experience.
  • Experience in a medium volume /mix electro-mechanical manufacturing or production environment with an emphasis on manufacturing processes.
  • Ability to effectively interact with personnel of different levels and subject areas. Ability to regularly contact, influence, and negotiate with both internal and external individuals on complex issues.

You Will Excite Us If You Have:

  • Experience in SAP.

Why CommScope?

CommScope is on a quest to deliver connectivity that empowers how we live, work, and learn. Our employees push the boundaries of communications technology that enables groundbreaking discoveries like 5G, the Internet of Things, and gigabit speeds for everyone, everywhere. With our unmatched expertise in copper, fiber, and wireless infrastructure, our global clients rely on us to outperform today and be ready for the needs of tomorrow.

job.title: Retail Consultant, Chirnside Park
job.description:
Chirnside Park, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, connecting more than 11 million customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

We’re looking for a vibrant and motivated Casual Retail Service Consultant to join our Chirnside Park team. If you love helping people, thrive in being a part of a supportive crew, and bring positive energy to every interaction, then we’d love to have you on board!

At Optus, you’ll feel connected to what truly matters. We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity, and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships with our customers and with each other.

What you’ll do:

  • Be the face of Optus, delivering standout customer experiences powered by optimism, curiosity and genuine care.
  • Explore our range of tech products and services, and share your knowledge in a way that’s simple, helpful and accessible.
  • Bring your personality and charm to uncover customer needs and deliver personalised solutions that make their day.
  • Work as one team, crafting a warm, welcoming environment where customers feel supported and memorable moments happen.

What you bring:

  • Service Superpower: You know how to understand customer needs, deliver genuine support, and let phenomenal service drive fantastic outcomes.
  • Tech Explorer: You enjoy helping customers make sense of tech by breaking things down simply and guiding them to the right solutions.
  • Problem Solving Pro: You listen with empathy, act with integrity, and turn challenges into opportunities to help with calm, practical solutions.
  • Composure Under Pressure: You’re confident in navigating difficult enquiries, ease tricky situations with empathy and respect, and work toward the best solution for the customer.
  • Team Spirit: You build strong connections with your teammates, support one another, stay accountable, and create a customer‑first environment where everyone succeeds.

What’s in it for you?

  • $35 p/h + super + applicable loadings.
  • Phenomenal perks, including 25% off Optus products and exclusive access to unique discounts with our retail partners.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Yarn First Nations, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, available 24/7 across multiple channels.
  • Flexible rosters that work around the life you live outside of work.

Intrigued, but not sure you tick every box? That’s completely okay! We still encourage you to apply. We all grow, learn and develop together, and this role might be the perfect next step in your career journey.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. job.title: Campaign Analyst, AI Decisioning & Campaigns
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

**

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Collaborate with business, marketing, product, analytics, data science and Martech stakeholders to translate campaign objectives into audience strategies, segmentation logic, eligibility criteria and targeting recommendations for retention, upsell, cross-sell and next-best-action campaigns.
  • Maintain campaign configuration details and metadata required for execution, tracking and reporting. Perform pre-launch QA on audience counts, segmentation logic, exclusions, suppression rules, sample records, offer eligibility, channel eligibility and campaign setup.
  • Support the design and implementation of A/B tests, champion/challenger tests, holdout groups and control-group frameworks. Define campaign hypotheses, treatment groups, success metrics, measurement windows and evaluation approach.

  • Manage campaign analytics workstreams, timelines, dependencies, risks and follow-ups across cross-functional teams to support timely campaign delivery and continuous improvement.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Marketing, Business, Economics, Computer Science, Information Systems or equivalent.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in in marketing analytics, campaign analytics, customer analytics, lifecycle marketing, CRM, digital marketing analytics or data-driven campaign operations.
  • Experience in Marketing analytics,Excel/SQL, Formulate hypothesis, conduct experiment, statistical knowledge and Data platforms/visualization tools.
  • Understanding of lifecycle marketing, CRM, retention, upsell, cross-sell, customer value management and digital/direct marketing channels.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: AI Solutions Engineer
job.description:
Nxera, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

Passionate about making a real impact? Be at the forefront of the data centre (DC) industry with a unique focus on sustainability, connectivity and AI which sets us apart as the next generation DC operator. You will also get to gain invaluable experience in a fast-growing industry that is powering the digitalisation wave. Be empowered to co-create the future with our dynamic teams!”

We are seeking an AI Solutions Engineer (Agentic AI) to design, build and deploy enterprise AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI Agents. You will develop production-ready AI applications that automate knowledge-intensive workflows, integrate with enterprise systems and deliver secure, scalable and trustworthy AI experiences.

How You will Make An Impact:

AI Solution Development

  • Design, develop and deploy AI agents using LLMs, RAG and prompt engineering.
  • Build scalable AI workflows that automate enterprise business processes.
  • Translate business requirements into practical AI solutions.
  • Develop reusable prompt workflows, tool-calling capabilities and structured outputs.

Knowledge & RAG Engineering

  • Build and optimise RAG pipelines connected to approved enterprise knowledge sources.
  • Improve retrieval quality through chunking, embeddings, indexing and metadata strategies.
  • Maintain trusted knowledge bases and ensure source-grounded AI responses.

AI Platform & Integration

  • Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems, APIs, databases and internal platforms.
  • Develop secure tool-calling capabilities and support deployment into production.
  • Monitor and optimise AI application performance.

Model Quality & Governance

  • Design evaluation frameworks to measure response quality, retrieval accuracy and hallucination risks.
  • Optimise prompts, guardrails and model performance.
  • Support governance, version control and human-in-the-loop review processes.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Partner with product, engineering and business teams to deliver AI solutions.
  • Support demonstrations, UAT, production rollout and technical documentation.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or related discipline.
  • 3–5 years of software engineering experience with Python.
  • Hands-on experience building LLM applications, AI Agents or RAG solutions.
  • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or similar AI frameworks.
  • Experience integrating APIs, databases and enterprise systems.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, semantic search and prompt engineering.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD and container technologies.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI.
  • Knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) or AI agent orchestration.
  • Experience deploying open-source LLMs (e.g. vLLM, Ollama).
  • Exposure to MLOps, model fine-tuning or domain adaptation.

AWS is seeking an experienced Sr. Account Manager for selling to Strategic ISV’s and to expand the business with our hottest ISV customers. The Sr. Account Manager will be responsible for setting a long-term strategy and executing daily to grow customers. In addition to being a customer, these companies partner with AWS as an ISV and have multiple GTM goals. In the role, you will build and maintain broad relationships, develop and manage opportunities, and facilitate a large team of extended resources.

#aws-ags-asean

Key job responsibilities The ISV Account Manager is responsible for teaming with all aspects of the customer’s organization. This includes C-level executives, engineering, IT/operations, partner org, and sales. Skills required to build relationships across an account include creative systems thinking, visioning, and executing via collaboration with an extended team to address all ISV customer's needs. The Account Manager is responsible for selling at the most strategic (C-level) within the account and implementing a broad strategy for earning customer acceptance and service implementation. The Account Manager works collaboratively with all appropriate AWS resources (Executives, Partner, Support, Solution Architect) to support customer interests, and will understand how to strongly advocate for the customer in harmony with what the AWS business needs. In addition to new service adoption and new line of business development, this role includes dotted line responsibility for partnership and technical collaboration.

About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

  • 5+ years of business development, partner development, sales or alliances management experience

Preferred Qualifications

job.title: Senior Commercial Manager
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Your Impact

As Senior Commercial Manager, India based in our HQ in Mumbai, you will report to the Commercial Director, India & Middle East and work closely with various teams and leadership across the Asia Pacific region, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • You will provide commercial leadership, guidance and advice to support the delivery teams in all aspects of commercial and contract issues across the entire lifecycle of our data centre developments
  • You will negotiate complex contracts, both domestically and internationally, including the development and management of all contractual documentation
  • You will lead the commercial development reporting and administration function for the region, ensuring a high level of governance and accuracy to stakeholders

What you’ll do

  • Support management team with procurement and contract strategies for existing and new hyperscale developments in India
  • Lead customer contracts review during pre-flight and develop risk management strategy to manage any upstream/downstream gaps
  • Lead contract, cost and claims management and strategy across all in flight projects, partnering with the development team to resolve all day-to-day matters
  • Resolve contract interpretation issues and disputes in a creative manner, balancing both parties’ objectives and the long-term implications of changes or solutions
  • Proactively onboard new vendors for the region
  • Lead project close outs across region and conduct project lesson learned analysis upon all project completions
  • Develop and manage effective and streamlined processes and procedures and develop metrics quantifying performance across all projects
  • Assist with innovations, initiatives and continuous improvements aimed at increasing time and costs efficiencies of the delivery of our data centres
  • Develop complex business cases and analysis to management
  • Develop and review tender packages including developing scope of works, bid templates, tender evaluations, reviews, contracts negotiation and recommendations
  • Concurrently manage multiple projects including new data centre buildings and capital improvement projects associated with existing data centres
  • Travel to data centre sites both domestic and internationally for project initiation, project reviews and audits, constructability reviews, commissioning, project close out, and the like as required.

What you’ll bring

  • A relevant degree such as Law, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management or Engineering (or similar) with a minimum of 10 years work experience in the construction industry
  • Strong understanding of contract management and administration with a sound

understanding of contract law

  • Strong communication, negotiation, contract drafting and presentation skills

###

Required: Java, Spring Boot, JavaScript, React.js, SQL, NoSQL

job.title: Health and Safety Director APAC DE&C
job.description:
Your Role

Lead Health & Safety across an assigned regional business portfolio by implementing the Global Health & Safety strategy, providing strategic leadership, governance and practical support that enables safe operational delivery. Build trusted relationships with regional leaders and ensure global standards are embedded while responding effectively to local business, regulatory and cultural requirements.

What you'll do

Regional Health & Safety Leadership

  • Develop and deliver the Regional Health & Safety Plan aligned with the Global Health & Safety strategy and annual priorities.
  • Lead the regional implementation of the Safely Powering Progress strategy.
  • Provide strategic advice to regional leadership on performance, priorities and emerging risks.
  • Promote a proactive safety culture that encourages leadership engagement, learning and continuous improvement.
  • Integrate Health & Safety into planning, operational delivery and business decision making.

Business Partnership

  • Provide strategic and operational Health & Safety support across the regional business.
  • Support implementation of global standards, frameworks and minimum requirements.
  • Work closely with operational leaders to develop practical solutions that enable safe business outcomes.
  • Support regional delivery of global programmes, projects and change initiatives.

Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build trusted relationships with business leaders, project teams, contractors and the Global Health & Safety team.
  • Influence decision making through credibility, collaboration and technical expertise.
  • Coach leaders to strengthen Health & Safety capability and accountability.

Governance & Assurance

  • Monitor regional performance using leading and lagging indicators.
  • Lead or oversee investigations into significant incidents and ensure lessons learned are shared regionally and globally.
  • Facilitate audits, assurance activities and management reviews.
  • Support contractor governance and performance management where applicable.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable legislation while maintaining alignment with global standards.

Global Collaboration

  • Contribute to the development of global standards, programmes and strategic initiatives.
  • Share regional insights, innovation and best practice to strengthen global capability.
  • Support cross-functional projects and working groups to improve Health & Safety performance.

Key Behaviours

  • Visible leadership
  • Business partnering
  • Collaborative
  • Pragmatic
  • Influential
  • Accountable
  • Continuous improvement mindset
  • Culturally aware

Skills & Experience

  • Extensive leadership experience in Health & Safety within complex operational environments.
  • Experience supporting multiple business units or regions within multinational and matrix organisations.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing capability.
  • Knowledge of Health & Safety management systems, governance, assurance and risk management.
  • Strong analytical capability with a practical, solutions-focused approach.

Success Measures Common Measures

  • Global Health & Safety standards are consistently implemented across the region.
  • Regional leaders view Health & Safety as a trusted business partner.
  • Governance, assurance and performance reporting support informed decision making.
  • Lessons learned and collaboration drive continual improvement.

Role-specific Measures

  • The Regional Health & Safety Plan is delivered in alignment with the Global Health & Safety strategy.
  • Regional performance demonstrates measurable improvement.
  • Leadership engagement and safety culture continue to strengthen.
  • Regulatory compliance and implementation of global standards are maintained.

A bit about us

Digital Realty brings companies and data together by delivering the full spectrum of data center, colocation and interconnection solutions. PlatformDIGITAL®, the company’s global data center platform, provides customers with a secure data meeting place and a proven Pervasive Datacenter Architecture (PDx®) solution methodology for powering innovation and efficiently managing Data Gravity challenges. Digital Realty gives its customers access to the connected data communities that matter to them with a global data center footprint of 300+ facilities in 50+ metros across 25+ countries on six continents.

To learn more about Digital Realty, please visit [digitalrealty.com](http://www.digitalrealty.com) or follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/digitalrealty) and [Twitter](https://twitter.com/digitalrealty).

What we can offer you

Our rapidly evolving business sector offers the opportunity to be part of a courageous and passionate team who work together to understand and meet the changing needs of our global customers.

Join us and you’ll be part of a supportive and inclusive environment where you can bring your whole self to work. As part of our team, you’ll get to work with people from different business areas, challenge the way we do things and put your ideas into action. We’ll also give you plenty of development opportunities so you can build a rewarding and successful career with us.

Apply today, take charge of your career and grow your talents with us.

Health and Safety Safety isn't just a priority here at Digital; it's critical to everything we do. Safeguarding lives, protecting assets, and securing data aren't just ideals - they're essential pillars of our commitment to excellence for our people, our partners and our customers. We have a culture of care where every member of Team Digital embraces a relentless pursuit of working safely across Digital Realty. Together we are Safely Powering Progress

Our Compensation Philosophy

Digital Realty offers its employees a highly competitive compensation package, excellent benefits, and an environment that recognizes and rewards your contributions. Central to our compensation philosophy is rewarding our employees for achieving the values and objectives aligned to the company's overall goals and values.

job.title: Sustainability Compliance Tracing (SCT) Team Lead
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

We are seeking a detail-oriented Team lead with in-depth knowledge of carbon accounting, credit/offsets and reporting standards, and bio-fuel certification schemes such as the International Sustainability and Carbon Certification standards (ISCC) and Roundtable on Sustainable Biomaterials (RSB) to join our team. As the SCT Team lead, you will play a crucial role in ensuring compliance and procedures in our Infrastructure projects, as well as contribute your know-how of renewable energy and biofuels industries in our business.

  • Audit Management: Work with external auditors to coordinate and conduct desk and on-site audits, oversee periodic certification renewals, and manage corrective action plans throughout end-to-end supply chain for various sites/projects. Participate in internal quality assurance activities to maintain high standards of auditing.
  • Supply Chain Traceability: Verify chain of custody records, ensuring that sustainable material outputs match sustainable inputs across the supply chain. Expertise in environmental management systems
  • GHG & Mass Balance: Calculate and review life-cycle emissions and manage complex mass balance book-keeping systems. Analyze data and documentation to verify adherence to ISCC principles
  • Regulatory Compliance: Familiarity with relevant regulations and compliance requirements for global sustainability frameworks (like EU RED II or CORSIA), and stay up-to-date with changes in relevant standards, regulations, and industry best practices. Interpret and implement updates on international fuel blending mandates, sustainability policies, and trade documentation.
  • Team building: You are to build a team up gradually with the know-how to manage ISCC related certification needs for various interested molecules across the projects (such as Biomethane, Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), etc).
  • Stakeholder Guidance: Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Provide continuous guidance to suppliers and clients on ISCC EU/PLUS compliance and documentation, and other equivalent frameworks. Collaborate with clients to develop corrective action plans and monitor their implementation.
  • Travel: Willingness to travel as required for on-site audits.
  • Business Development & Partnering: You will work with the BDP team to prepare SCT commercial proposals for prospective clients. Ability to work independently and as part of a team would be crucial.
  • Any other works/due diligence assigned by the department head.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Qualifications

  • Education: Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Sustainability, Engineering, or Agriculture, or related fields.
  • Certifications: Mandatory completion of official ISCC Basic Training (EU and PLUS), ISO-related certifications or other sustainability certifications will be a bonus. Where certification needs extended beyond ISCC in future, you may be nominated for training to upskill accordingly.
  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of direct experience in sustainability auditing, quality management, or supply chain logistics.
  • Skills: Strong data-analysis capabilities (Excel or AI), attention to detail, and excellent client-facing communication.

BUSINESS SEGMENT

Infrastructure

PLATFORM

Operating Division

  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

About the role

Reporting to the Head of FP&A, this role leads corporate FP&A processes including annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, board and management reporting, long-range planning and scenario analysis.

The role is the central coordinator of Digital Edge’s financial planning process, ensuring alignment between country forecasts, specialist FP&A capability owners and executive reporting requirements.

It will improve planning discipline, reporting efficiency and forecasting quality while supporting strategic initiatives and financing requirements across the business. Based in Singapore, supporting operations across Asia Pacific.

Key responsibilities

1. Budgeting, Forecasting and Planning

  • Own the annual budget, rolling forecast and long-range planning processes across the Group.
  • Establish planning calendars, submission standards and review schedules.
  • Coordinate forecast consolidation across countries and specialist FP&A capability owners.
  • Challenge assumptions, forecast risks and mitigation plans with business leaders and Country Finance.

2. Group Reporting and Executive Insight

  • Own delivery of monthly management reporting, board reporting and investor reporting support.
  • Prepare consolidated performance analysis, executive commentary and standardized reporting frameworks.
  • Provide insight into key drivers: revenue, margins, operating costs, capex and cash.

**

3. Strategic Planning and Performance Management

  • Develop financial models and scenario analysis to evaluate strategic initiatives and business performance.
  • Support executive decisions on investment, growth and resource allocation.

4. Corporate Cost Management and Efficiency

  • Partner with corporate function leaders to improve planning, forecasting and management of SG&A costs.
  • Develop cost-driver reporting and variance analysis across corporate departments.
  • Identify efficiency opportunities through analysis of volume, rate, mix, timing and resource allocation drivers.
  • Establish management reporting frameworks for corporate functional performance and spending discipline, with executive commentary on cost risks and corrective actions.

**

5. Process Improvement and FP&A Governance

  • Define enterprise planning standards, controls and review processes.
  • Improve forecast accuracy and reporting quality through process simplification and discipline.
  • Partner with FP&A capability owners and Country Finance teams to improve consistency of assumptions and methodologies.
  • Support automation and reporting enhancements and drive adoption of standardized planning and reporting practices.

Key Requirements & Qualifications

  • 8-10+ years in FP&A, corporate finance, strategic finance or business finance, ideally in a regional or platform environment.
  • Track record leading budgeting, rolling forecast, long-range planning and management reporting processes.
  • Proven experience in SG&A cost control, corporate cost management and partnering with corporate function leaders.
  • Strong financial modelling, business analysis and executive communication skills; able to convert complex data into concise executive insight.
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; strong planning, organization and project management capability.
  • Confidence partnering with senior executives, corporate functions, country finance teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Preferred: data centres, infrastructure, telecoms or other capital-intensive sectors; board, investor or lender reporting exposure.
  • Preferred: OneStream, Anaplan, Adaptive Planning, Power BI or similar platforms.

job.title: Associate Director - FP&A, Capex and Operating Cost Efficiency
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading provider of sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure across Asia Pacific. Backed by Stonepeak, a global alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has over US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital from some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Since our founding in 2020, we have rapidly scaled across key Asia markets, operating 31 data centers with over 1.8GW of secured IT power. We operate as a regional platform delivering consistent global standards, combining scale with strong local execution across every market.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

About the role

**

Reporting to the Head of FP&A, this role leads FP&A governance, portfolio insight and operating cost efficiency for Digital Edge’s capex and operating cost base across Asia Pacific.

The Associate Director will establish an approval-to-cash view of capital spend, improve portfolio Latest Best Estimate (LBE) and cash forecasting, identify capex and operating cost risks, and provide clear financial challenge to Design & Construction, Operations, Procurement, Treasury and Country Finance.

The role includes direct people management of a small team of finance analysts and influences cross-functional stakeholders.

This role will be based in Singapore and will support projects and operations across Asia Pacific.

**

Key responsibilities

**

1. Capex Governance and Approval-to-Cash Reporting

  • Own the monthly approval-to-cash reporting framework covering approved budget, commitments, invoices, cash paid, LBE, contingency usage and key delivery risks.
  • Build a portfolio view of development and maintenance capex, highlighting variance drivers by volume, rate, scope, timing and foreign exchange.
  • Establish exception reporting and escalation for material cost overruns, cash slippage, contingency drawdown, approval gaps and late commitments.
  • Partner with Development, Procurement and Country Finance to strengthen capex governance, data quality and forecasting discipline.

**

**

2. Portfolio LBE, Cash Forecasting and Investment Analytics

  • Improve capex LBE accuracy and cash-flow visibility by integrating inputs from Development, Procurement and Country Finance.
  • Support investment reviews by validating financial assumptions, capex phasing, contingency, return metrics, sensitivity analysis and key commercial risks.
  • Maintain a consistent methodology for post-approval tracking of investment economics against approved business cases.
  • Prepare executive-level commentary on capex, cash and portfolio risks, with clear recommendations and accountable follow-ups.

**

3. Operating Cost Efficiency

  • Partner with Operations and Country Finance to analyse power, repairs and maintenance, facilities management and maintenance capex trends.
  • Identify cost efficiency opportunities using driver analysis across volume, rate, mix, utilization and timing.
  • Develop benchmarking and unit-cost analysis across sites.
  • Translate operating cost movements into senior management insight, separating controllable performance from market, usage and timing effects.

4. Team Leadership, Controls and Ways of Working

  • Lead, coach and develop a small team of finance analysts supporting capex reporting, operating cost analysis and portfolio performance reviews.
  • Define the capex FP&A calendar, submission standards, data ownership, review cadence and escalation process.
  • Work with Country Finance, Procurement and Treasury to reconcile spend, commitments and cash where process gaps exist.

**

Key Requirements & Qualifications

  • 10+ years in FP&A, project finance, infrastructure finance, capex control or corporate finance, with proven capex governance, project cost tracking, cash forecasting, variance analysis and portfolio reporting experience.
  • Ability to convert complex operational and financial data into senior management insights, recommendations and accountable follow-ups.
  • Strong stakeholder management across Design & Construction, Operations, Procurement, Treasury, Accounting and Country Finance.
  • Direct people management experience, including coaching analysts, setting priorities and improving output quality.
  • Advanced Excel / financial modelling skills and strong PowerPoint executive reporting capability.
  • Preferred: data centre, telecommunications, utilities, infrastructure, real estate development or energy-intensive asset experience.
  • Preferred: OneStream, Anaplan, Adaptive Planning, Power BI or similar tools; CPA, CFA, MBA or equivalent finance qualification.

Singapore, Singapore

The GRaduate Industry Traineeships (GRIT) Programme is an initiative by Workforce Singapore (WSG) that offers fresh graduates with traineeship opportunities* for a period of 3 to 6 months across various sectors.

The programme aims to support fresh graduates, with no prior working experience, from Universities, Polytechnics, Institutes of Technical Education (ITE) and other Educational Institutions (e.g. private universities and overseas institutions), amid uncertainties in the economy. It supports structured traineeships for trainees to gain hands-on industry-relevant experience and skills, preparing them for successful transition into full-time employment.

All trainees must fulfil the following criteria:

job.title: Lead AI Platform Architect #AIDA
job.description:
Role Summary

As a Lead AI Platform Architect, you will be the technical authority responsible for defining the architecture, technology strategy and roadmap for Singtel's enterprise AI platform, including the Central AI Kitchen (CAK) and its supporting AI ecosystem. You will drive the evaluation, adoption and governance of emerging AI technologies, ensuring the platform provides secure, scalable, reusable and enterprise-ready AI capabilities that accelerate AI innovation across the organisation.

Working closely with Enterprise Architecture, AI Platform Engineering, AI Platform Operations, Cybersecurity and business stakeholders, you will define the enterprise AI reference architecture, platform standards, reusable technical frameworks and architectural guardrails that enable consistent and scalable AI solution delivery.

You will provide technical leadership across AI platform strategy, foundation models, agentic AI, model lifecycle management, AI engineering frameworks and platform capabilities, ensuring the AI platform evolves in line with business priorities, technology advancements and enterprise governance requirements.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Define and maintain the enterprise AI platform architecture, technology roadmap and reference architecture for the Central AI Kitchen (CAK) or equivalent AI platforms.
  • Establish reusable AI platform capabilities, architectural principles, design standards and technical frameworks to enable secure, scalable and consistent AI adoption across the enterprise.
  • Evaluate, benchmark and recommend hosted, self-hosted and open-weight foundation models, defining enterprise model selection strategies based on business, technical and governance requirements.
  • Engage with technology partners, cloud providers, AI vendors and the broader technology ecosystem to explore emerging platform capabilities, evaluate new products and identify opportunities to enhance the enterprise AI platform.
  • Lead and oversee proof-of-concept (PoC), technology evaluation and pilot initiatives for emerging AI technologies, validating technical feasibility, business value, scalability and enterprise readiness while staying abreast of industry trends and advancements to continuously evolve the AI platform roadmap.
  • Establish platform architecture and best practices for model optimisation techniques
  • Define the enterprise architecture for multimodal AI capabilities, including language, speech, voice, document, image, vision-language and video models.
  • Define enterprise standards and governance for AI model lifecycle management, including model versioning, retraining strategies, regression management, performance evaluation and model retirement.
  • Lead technical evaluations, benchmarking and proof-of-concept initiatives for emerging AI technologies, frameworks, platforms and commercial solutions.
  • Assess emerging AI technologies and recommend Build, Buy or Partner strategies based on business value, enterprise architecture alignment, scalability and total cost of ownership.
  • Publish and maintain AI platform reference architectures, reusable design patterns, technical standards, implementation guidelines and best practices.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity and other governance teams to ensure AI platform architecture aligns with enterprise architecture principles, security requirements and regulatory standards.
  • Review and govern architecture proposals for new AI platform capabilities, technology adoption and platform enhancements to ensure consistency with enterprise architecture, platform strategy and governance standards.
  • Prepare, present and defend AI platform architecture proposals to the Solution Review Board (SRB), senior management and Group/Enterprise Architecture, and seek Architecture Review Board (ARB) clearance, where required, for new platform capabilities, architecture patterns, technology adoption, technology exceptions or enterprise architectural changes.
  • Provide architectural direction and technical guidance to AI Platform Engineering teams throughout platform capability planning and implementation.
  • Collaborate with AI Platform Engineering and Operation team to define platform observability, operational architecture, reliability requirements and lifecycle management strategies for production AI services.
  • Partner with AI Solution Architects to ensure reusable platform capabilities meet evolving business requirements and support scalable AI solution delivery.
  • Work closely with AI Security Architects to embed AI security, Responsible AI, privacy and governance requirements into platform architecture and design.
  • Mentor Platform Architects and senior technical engineers, fostering architecture excellence, innovation and continuous improvement across the AI platform.
  • Serve as the primary technical advisor for enterprise AI platform strategy, engaging senior management, Group/Enterprise Architecture, technology teams and business stakeholders to influence platform direction and drive the continuous evolution of a secure, scalable, interoperable and future-ready AI platform.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related technical discipline.
  • Strong foundation in enterprise platform architecture, distributed systems and cloud-native technologies.
  • At least 10 years of experience in enterprise architecture, platform architecture, software architecture or cloud architecture, designing large-scale enterprise platforms.
  • At least 3 years of experience designing AI, Machine Learning or Generative AI platforms in an enterprise environment.
  • Proven experience defining platform architecture, technology roadmaps, architecture standards and reusable platform capabilities.
  • Experience leading architecture governance, including presenting architecture proposals to senior management and Architecture Review Boards (ARB).
  • Experience working across Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Data and Business teams.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise AI platform architecture, including AI application platforms, AI engineering ecosystems, Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) and agentic AI platforms.
  • Strong understanding of foundation models, Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), multimodal AI and enterprise AI deployment strategies.
  • Experience defining AI model lifecycle architecture, including model evaluation, fine-tuning strategies, deployment, versioning, monitoring and governance.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native, hybrid cloud and on-premises platform architectures, distributed computing and container orchestration principles.
  • Good understanding of enterprise AI application patterns, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, workflow orchestration, Model Context Protocol (MCP), API integration and enterprise integration architectures.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture principles, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures and API-first design.
  • Experience defining architecture standards for AI security, Responsible AI, data governance, model governance, privacy and regulatory compliance.
  • Good understanding of AI platform reliability, scalability, observability, resiliency and performance optimisation principles.
  • Strong ability to evaluate emerging AI technologies and translate technology trends into enterprise platform capabilities, architecture standards and technology roadmaps.
  • Strong strategic, analytical and systems thinking, with the ability to simplify complex architecture and technology decisions for diverse stakeholders.
  • Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Enterprise Architecture, AI Solution Architecture, Platform Engineering, Platform Operations, Cybersecurity and Business teams.
  • Strong communication, presentation and documentation skills, with experience presenting architecture proposals and influencing senior management and governance boards.
  • Proven technical leadership and mentoring skills, with the ability to guide architects and engineers, influence platform direction and drive architecture best practices.
  • Strong innovation mindset and continuous learning, with a passion for exploring emerging AI technologies and translating industry trends into enterprise platform capabilities.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Manufacturing Engineering Analyst
job.description:
Responsibilities

The Manufacturing Engineer will be responsible for supporting and improving manufacturing processes, will ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality production in accordance with engineering standards, Lean principles, and Vertiv requirements. The role will act as a key interface between engineering, production, quality, and supply chain, will drive continuous improvement, process optimization, and product industrialization.

Job Description

  • Respects the principles of environmental protection
  • Support and optimize manufacturing processes in accordance with drawings, BOMs, work instructions, and technical standards
  • Analyze production flows and will propose improvements related to safety, quality, cost, and delivery
  • Participate in the industrialization of new products and engineering changes (NPDI / ECO / ECN)
  • Define and update manufacturing documentation (work instructions, process flows, layouts, routings)
  • Support production during daily operations, troubleshooting technical and process-related issues
  • Analyze root causes of production problems and will implement corrective and preventive actions
  • Cooperate closely with other departments (Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Maintenance, EHS)
  • Support line balancing, capacity analysis, and layout optimization
  • Support validation of tools, equipment, and production processes
  • Ensure compliance with internal standards, quality procedures, and safety regulations
  • Work in accordance with LEAN manufacturing principles and 5S methodology (VOS)
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by submitting and implementing improvement proposals
  • Perform all other activities related to the agreed type of work
  • Follow the procedures, rules, and principles of the integrated management system
  • Contribute to the development and adherence to standards with a focus on customer satisfaction, company culture, and continuous improvement

What will make you successful?

  • Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related fields
  • At least 7 years of experience in a manufacturing or industrial engineering role
  • Be able to read and interpret technical drawings and manufacturing documentation

Have knowledge of manufacturing processes and assembly methods

Have experience with process improvement and problem-solving techniques

Have basic knowledge of Lean tools (5S, Kaizen, Standard Work, VSM)

Be able to work with measuring equipment

Have basic PC skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

Have good English knowledge

  • Comply with all health and safety and environmental protection requirements defined in the company's internal regulations or communicated during training.
  • Comply with required emergency prevention and operational control measures.
  • Report all accidents, occupational illnesses and emergencies.
  • Implement, implement and manage all health and safety and environmental protection matters related to the position.
  • In addition to the tasks listed above, other activities and responsibilities may be individually defined

job.title: Senior Analyst II, Digital Project Manager
job.description:
Job Description

We are looking for a motivated and execution-oriented analyst to support Digital M&A for R&D and Cybersecurity initiatives.

This role focuses primarily on supporting acquisitions, divestitures and integration initiatives impacting R&D, software engineering and digital platforms.

The analyst will coordinate integration of workstreams, support onboarding of newly acquired engineering teams, track execution plans, manage stakeholder collaboration and contribute to cybersecurity initiatives.

Approximately 80% of the role is dedicated to Digital M&A activities within the R&D and Engineering ecosystem, while 20% focuses on cybersecurity andsource code governance initiatives.

What will you do?

  • We are looking for a motivated and execution-oriented analyst to support Digital M&A for R&D and Cybersecurity initiatives.
  • This role focuses primarily on supporting acquisitions, divestitures and integration initiatives impacting R&D, software engineering and digital platforms.
  • The analyst will coordinate integration of workstreams, support onboarding of newly acquired engineering teams, track execution plans, manage stakeholder collaboration and contribute to cybersecurity initiatives.

What are the key skills we are looking for?

  • Support the planning, coordination, and execution of Digital M&A acquisitions, integrations, and divestitures across R&D and Engineering organizations under the leadership of the M&A R&D Program Manager.
  • Coordinate onboarding of newly acquired software and engineering teams into Schneider Electric's Digital Engineering ecosystem.
  • Support application, repository and engineering tool integration activities.
  • Maintain integration plans, action trackers, risk logs and governance documentation.
  • Coordinate activities across R&D, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Legal and Business teams.
  • Support digital due diligence and integration readiness assessments.
  • Track migration of engineering tools, development environments and digital platforms.
  • Support application separation and carve-out activities during divestitures.
  • Prepare executive updates, governance reviews and status reporting.
  • Drive follow-up on actions, dependencies, risks and mitigation plans.

What's in it for me?

  • This role offers a unique opportunity to build expertise at the intersection of Digital M&A, R&D, Digital Engineering, and Cybersecurity .
  • You will gain hands-on experience leading complex steams of acquisition, integration, and divestiture initiatives while collaborating with senior stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies.
  • The position provides valuable exposure to engineering ecosystems, digital transformation programs, secure development practices, and source code governance.
  • You will strengthen your project management, stakeholder engagement, and executive communication skills while developing a broad understanding of Schneider Electric's digital landscape.
  • This experience can accelerate your career toward leadership roles in Digital Transformation, M&A Integration, Cybersecurity, Strategy, or Program Management.

What qualifications will make you successful?

  • 7+ years of experience in Project Management, Business Analysis, Digital Transformation , Technology Consulting and / or Cybersecurity, with a strong track record of driving execution and delivering results.
  • Strong organizational, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and influence teams without direct authority.
  • Exposure to M&A integration, acquisitions or divestitures.
  • Experience working with R&D, Engineering or Technology organizations.
  • Basic understanding of cybersecurity and secure development practices.
  • Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal), with experience working across global, multi-country, and cross-functional teams, including interactions with senior stakeholders.
  • Execution-oriented, adaptable, and self-driven, with a passion for security and innovation, able to navigate ambiguity, manage changing priorities, and work independently in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Sr. Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
job.description:
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.

Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”

As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.

As a Senior Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.

Key job responsibilities Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:

  • You’ll build solutions, provide technical guidance and advocate for the customer
  • Ensure AWS environments remain operationally healthy whilst reducing cost and complexity
  • Develop trusting relationships with customers, understanding their business needs and technical challenges
  • Using your technical acumen and customer obsession, you’ll drive technical discussions regarding incidents, trade-offs, and risk management
  • Consult with a range of partners from developers through to C-suite executives
  • Collaborate with AWS Solutions Architects, Business Developers, Professional Services Consultants, and Sales Account Managers
  • With a bias for action, you'll proactively find opportunities for customers to gain additional value from AWS
  • Provide detailed reviews of service disruptions, metrics, detailed pre-launch planning
  • Solve a variety of problems across different customers as they migrate their workloads to the cloud
  • Uplift customer capabilities by running workshops, brown bag sessions, etc.

Watch a short video about life as a Technical Account Manager here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J_Rm0QgWvQ8 The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!

A day in the life As a Senior TAM, you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers’ adoption and use of AWS services - including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, Bedrock, SageMaker, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support, and risk management. You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS.

About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
  • Knowledge of of cloud based architecture, cloud services and experience in customer facing roles
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, math, or equivalent, or experience in a STEM field equivalent to a four year degree
  • Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
  • Experience in a 24x7 operational services or support environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead
  • Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas: software design or development, content distribution/CDN, scripting/automation, database architecture, IP networking, IT security, BigData/Hadoop/Spark, operations management, service oriented architecture

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

job.title: DCO Manager , Infra Ops - HYD
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. job.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Automotive and Manufacturing, AWS Industries
job.description:

You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.

Be great fun to work with. At AWS, we have a credo of “Work hard. Have fun. Make history”. In this role, you will love what you do, and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic and creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.

Enjoy working with large, global customers. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud and AI solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.

You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.
