job.title: Service Delivery Manager
job.description:
• Fantastic opportunity to enter the rapidly growing Data Centre industry.
  • Tailored CDC Academy and hands-on training provided.
  • Inclusive, supportive team culture with strong employee benefits

About us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia and New Zealand’s leading operator of secure, world-class data centre facilities. CDC plays a unique role in the fabric of the nations in which we operate, and we take this responsibility very seriously.

With multiple facilities across Australia and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide large-scale secure data centre campuses that support co-location, dedicated and hyperscale compute environments, with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC, we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team.

Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Customer Success Manager who genuinely enjoys building relationships and takes pride in helping customers succeed. In this role, you will play a central part in supporting CDC’s customers across the full service delivery lifecycle, ensuring their experience with us is seamless, consistent and positive.

This is a highly visible, collaborative role where you will become a trusted partner to our customers and a key connector within CDC. You will work closely with teams across operations, delivery and commercial to bring people together, anticipate needs, manage risks early and deliver outcomes that go above and beyond expectations.

Reporting to the Head of Customer Success, you will have end to end ownership of customer satisfaction and the opportunity to continuously improve how we deliver for our customers, strengthening relationships and helping CDC show up at its best every day.

Other responsibilities include:

  • Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with customers and partners, ensuring a consistent, high quality experience throughout their journey with CDC
  • Work collaboratively across CDC to bring the right teams together and support seamless, well coordinated customer outcomes
  • Strengthen CDC’s presence across multiple customer environments by partnering closely with customer stakeholders and on site teams
  • Support delivery of customer contracts in line with agreed KPIs, helping ensure commitments are clearly understood, tracked and met
  • Coordinate and facilitate monthly business reviews, quarterly operational and security audits, and other customer compliance activities
  • Respond promptly and professionally to customer enquiries, including operational matters and coordination of project quotes or proposals
  • Stay connected to industry developments and represent CDC with professionalism, modelling our DNA and leadership fundamentals in every interaction

What’s in it for you:

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy -Make your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

About you

You are an experienced service delivery professional who enjoys ownership, thrives in complex environments and takes pride in delivering great outcomes for customers. You bring a calm, structured approach, build trust easily, and are motivated by making things work well, consistently.

  • Solid experience in service delivery and project coordination, ideally within technology or critical environments
  • Extensive experience supporting large or enterprise customers with engagement with leaders and wider internal & stakeholders
  • Demonstrated growth in customer or service management roles, with the confidence to lead conversations and take accountability
  • Strong capability across contract management, SLA management and performance reporting
  • Clear, confident written and verbal communication, with the ability to engage effectively across technical and non technical stakeholders
  • A solutions focused mindset with strong problem solving ability and attention to detail
  • A genuine commitment to customer satisfaction, taking ownership of outcomes and nurturing long term stakeholder relationships
  • Experience working closely with delivery leads to ensure aligned, consistent communication and progress across active projects

Essential:

Australian Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a NV1 Security Clearance.

How to Apply:

If you are looking for an opportunity to play a vital role in a fast-growing Australian Technology company and be part of our amazing team, please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and encourages everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

Closing Date: 4.59pm Friday, 18 September 2026

job.title: E2E Operational Resilience Lead
job.description:
Sydney, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Every day, millions of Australians connect, work, stream, and stay in touch on the Optus network. When it works seamlessly, it's easy to take for granted. But behind it is a team making thousands of decisions every day - decisions that keep people, businesses and communities connected.

Right now, Optus is passionate about getting the fundamentals right - simplifying how we work, lifting standards, and building a more reliable, resilient experience for our customers. It's not about surface-level change. It's about how we make decisions, how we work together, and how we deliver.

The End-to-End Operational Resilience Lead provides senior cross-functional leadership to strengthen service resilience, operational readiness, and recovery across Optus's mobile and fixed network environments, with a focus on understanding end-to-end service dependencies and customer impacts. Leveraging deep technical and operational expertise, the role supports major incident response, drives organisational learning and continuous improvement, and influences resilience outcomes through judgement, collaboration, and strategic leadership rather than direct operational control.

Your day to day will consist of

  • Provide senior end-to-end operational leadership during significant customer-impacting events, connecting customer experience, service behaviour, and technology dependencies to support coordinated decision-making and effective service outcomes.
  • Assess customer impact, service dependencies, operational risks, and business priorities to support informed decision-making during complex service and operational scenarios.
  • Build and maintain an end-to-end view of customer services across technology, operational, and supplier domains, identifying service dependencies, risks, opportunities for improvement, and readiness considerations before they affect customers.
  • Contribute practical operational insight to service readiness reviews, significant change activity, and operational assurance, including business priorities, operational constraints, and implementation considerations.
  • Lead organisational learning through service reviews and operational assessments, capturing insights and driving improvements in service performance, customer outcomes, and operational effectiveness.
  • Strengthen operational capability by maintaining service knowledge, mentoring teams, and influencing outcomes across Operations, Engineering, Problem Management, and Transformation functions.

What makes you perfect for the role

  • Demonstrates strong operational leadership, sound judgement, and the ability to perform effectively during high-pressure, customer-impacting events.
  • Possesses significant experience in complex telecommunications or critical infrastructure environments, with expertise across multiple network and technology domains.
  • Maintains a broad end-to-end understanding of telecommunications services, including mobile, fixed, IP, core, infrastructure, applications, and supplier ecosystems.
  • Understands network operations, service dependencies, failure modes, recoverability, and the principles of major incident response and service restoration.
  • Applies systems thinking, structured investigation, and evidence-based problem-solving to connect issues across technology, service, and organisational boundaries.
  • Influences outcomes and builds trusted relationships across diverse teams and senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
  • Drives operational resilience and continuous improvement by enhancing readiness, recovery practices, organisational learning, and capability development through practical operational experience.

What's in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected' days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever's important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Direct your own development and build future-ready skills with Optus U's industry-focused micro-credentials, developed with La Trobe and Macquarie Universities.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes' to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call [**18•

job.title: Senior manager - Group Internal Audit, Technology
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

  • *

The Senior Manager, Group Internal Audit – Technology is a senior specialist role within Singtel Group Internal Audit, reporting directly to the Audit director, and is responsible for providing independent, objective, and risk-based assurance over Singtel’s technology, cybersecurity, and digital environments. The Senior Manager leads and delivers complex technology and cybersecurity audits, engagements, overseeing audit planning, execution and reporting, and providing robust and evidence-based challenge to key stakeholders. The role contributes to the development of the technology audit plan and ensures audit outcomes are high quality, actionable, and support effective risk management and control improvement. Audit outputs contribute directly to management assurance, Audit Committee reporting, and regulatory disclosures. Group Internal Audit operates as a key pillar of Singtel’s corporate governance framework and reports functionally to the Singtel Group Audit Committee.

Make an Impact by

**

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, risk-based technology and cybersecurity audits across Singtel Group.
  • Develop Audit Planning Memorandums (APMs), defining audit objectives, scope, risks, and audit approach.
  • Design and implement audit programs and procedures aligned to Group Internal Audit methodology and professional standards.
  • Assess the design and operating effectiveness of IT general controls, application controls, cybersecurity controls, and technology governance frameworks.
  • Evaluate major technology initiatives and systems under development to ensure appropriate governance, controls, documentation, and security-by-design.
  • Provide independent assurance over cybersecurity risk management, including protection of networks, cloud environments, systems, and sensitive data.
  • Assess compliance with relevant laws, regulations, industry standards, and Singtel policies (e.g. data protection, cybersecurity, technology risk).
  • Identify emerging technology risks and assess Singtel’s control maturity and risk posture.
  • Perform control advisory reviews for significant in-flight programs and strategic initiatives where required.
  • Identify root causes of control deficiencies and develop practical, commercially grounded recommendations.
  • Prepare high-quality audit reports with minimal supervision and ensure alignment and agreement of findings with senior management.
  • Lead audit kick-off and closing meetings with senior executives, ensuring clear communication of objectives, scope, findings, and risk implications.
  • Provide clear, credible challenge to senior stakeholders while maintaining strong professional relationships and audit independence.
  • Escalate significant or high-risk matters to the Audit Director and support Audit Committee reporting.
  • Coach, train, and review the work of less experienced auditors, embedding audit methodology, quality standards, and professional judgement.
  • Provide technical leadership in technology and cybersecurity auditing across the function.
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of technology audit methodology, tools, and practices.
  • Oversee tracking and validation of management action plans and perform follow-up reviews to ensure timely and effective remediation.
  • Support annual audit planning, resource management, and prioritisation of technology audit coverage.
  • Contribute to ad-hoc assignments, investigations, and Audit Committee-related matters as required.
  • Stay current on emerging technology, cybersecurity threats, and industry developments, applying insights to strengthen audit coverage and impact.

Skills for Success

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Professional certification such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, or CIA.
  • Extensive experience in technology audit, IT risk, cybersecurity, or internal audit, preferably within large, complex organisations.
  • Strong understanding of telecommunications, digital platforms, and large-scale technology environments.
  • Hands-on experience auditing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern architectures.
  • Proven ability to lead complex audits and engage credibly with senior management.
  • Excellent analytical, report writing, and influencing skills.

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Internal mobility opportunities

**

**

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

job.title: Senior Security Platform Engineer - SIEM and SOAR
job.description:
Sydney, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

At Optus, we're focused on building resilient, modern security capabilities that help protect our customers, people, and business. We're looking for a Senior Security Platform Engineer – SIEM & SOAR to help engineer and evolve the enterprise platforms that power our cyber defence operations.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, automating everything possible, and building scalable security platforms that enable faster and more effective threat detection and response.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain enterprise SIEM and SOAR platforms that support critical cyber defence operations across the business.
  • Onboard, normalise, and enrich security telemetry from a broad range of systems, ensuring high-quality data is available for threat detection and investigation.
  • Develop automation workflows, integrations, and Python-based solutions that improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance response capabilities.
  • Manage detection content, platform configurations, and automation deployments using Detection-as-Code, CI/CD, and engineering best practices.
  • Partner closely with Cyber Defence and engineering teams to continuously improve platform performance, detection coverage, and automation effectiveness.

What makes you perfect

  • Proven experience engineering and supporting enterprise SIEM and/or SOAR platforms within a security operations, cyber security, or platform engineering environment.
  • Strong technical skills in log management, telemetry onboarding, security automation, and platform integration.
  • Hands-on experience with scripting, API integration, and developing automated solutions that streamline security operations.
  • Knowledge of cloud security logging, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID telemetry, and modern security monitoring practices.
  • A collaborative, automation-focused approach, with strong problem-solving skills and a passion for continuous improvement and innovation.

What's in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.

job.description:
Position Summary

  • Responsible for managing MLOps workflows, tools, and production support processes for ML solutions.
  • Ensure day-to-day stability, reliability, and performance of ML models and pipelines.
  • Manage model lifecycle controls, including versioning, lineage, reproducibility, monitoring, and governance.
  • Develop incident handling, recovery, and escalation procedures for ML-related issues.
  • Support data quality, lineage tracking, and governance practices across the ML lifecycle.

  • Oversee the day-to-day stability, reliability, and operational health of ML models and ML pipelines.

  • Implement monitoring for data drift, concept drift, model performance degradation, inference quality, and service-level issues.

  • Experience with SQL, Databricks, MLFlow and PowerBI/Tableau.

  • Experience with model lifecycle management, including model registry, versioning, lineage, reproducibility, deployment tracking, and monitoring.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

As an experienced Full-Stack AI Engineer, you will design, build, and deploy end-to-end, AI-native applications. You will own the entire feature lifecycle—from designing intuitive frontend user interfaces that handle streaming AI data, to building robust backend architectures, orchestrating complex LLM or agentic workflows, and managing vector databases and cloud infrastructure. You are a generalist with architectural breadth and deep specialization in applying AI to practical software challenges.

Make an Impact by:

  • Applied AI & Intelligent Orchestration
  • Orchestration & Workflow Design: Build complex multi-agent frameworks, task routing systems, and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows using orchestration engines like LangChain or LangGraph.
  • RAG & Vector Management: Architect high-performance Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines. Design indexing strategies, chunking mechanisms, and hybrid search (semantic + keyword) utilizing vector databases.
  • Model Integration & Optimization: Integrate state-of-the-art LLMs and foundational models via commercial APIs or self-hosted inference setups. Implement strategies to manage model latency, token constraints, context windows, and fallback mechanisms.
  • Evaluation & Guardrails: Establish AI evaluation frameworks to test for hallucinations, drift, and accuracy. Implement prompt safety, structural validation, and robust guardrails to handle non-deterministic outputs safely.
  • Full-Stack Application Architecture
  • Backend & API Engineering: Design high-concurrency, asynchronous backend services using Python (FastAPI) or Node.js/TypeScript. Develop robust RESTful APIs and optimize interactions using Model Context Protocol (MCP) systems where applicable.
  • AI-Native Frontend Experiences: Build responsive, stateful UIs using React or Next.js. Implement streaming response interfaces (HTTP Stream), chat architectures, agentic UI interaction models, and intuitive data visualizations for complex model outputs.
  • Data Management: Design relational schemas and manage transactional data workflows using databases like PostgreSQL, while pairing them seamlessly with unstructured data pipelines.
  • Infrastructure
  • Containerization & Deployment: Package application layers using Docker
  • Cloud Architecture: Architect scalable, secure, and cost-effective solutions across cloud ecosystems like AWS or Azure
  • CI/CD & Observability: Build automated deployment and test pipelines (e.g., Bitbucket & Bamboo). Implement advanced logging, error tracing, and observability tooling to monitor both typical software failures and LLM costs/latencies.

Skills for Success:

Technical Skill Matrix

  • Category: Core Skills & Technologies
  • AI / LLM Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini APIs
  • Vector Databases: pgvector (PostgreSQL), Azure AI Search
  • Backend Engineering:Python (FastAPI), Node.js, Java, TypeScript, API Gateway
  • Frontend Engineering: React, Next.js, State Management (Zustand/Redux), SSE/WebSockets
  • Databases & Storage: PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS S3 / Cloud Storage
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Azure, Docker, CI/CD Monitoring (OpenTelemetry)

Singapore, Singapore

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. The Senior Specialist, Radio Network Engineering is responsible for evaluating, validating, and introducing new Radio Access Network (RAN) technologies and features to support the company's network evolution strategy. The role drives the technical assessment of emerging radio technologies through standards analysis, laboratory testing, feature evaluation, field trials, and commercial readiness activities, ensuring new capabilities deliver measurable improvements in network performance, spectrum efficiency, energy consumption, and customer experience.

  • Evaluate emerging RAN technologies, vendor solutions, and 3GPP Releases (e.g., Release 17, Release 18/5G-Advanced and Release 19 features) to support network evolution and technology roadmap planning.
  • Review and assess new 3GPP specifications and industry developments, including AI/ML for RAN optimisation, Ambient IoT, Reduced Capability (RedCap) devices, Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN), Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC), XR optimisation, enhanced Massive MIMO, network energy-saving features, and multi-antenna enhancements.
  • Conduct technical evaluation of new RAN software features, hardware platforms, and vendor releases, including capabilities such as 5G Carrier Aggregation enhancements, MIMO enhancements, Dynamic Spectrum Sharing (DSS), uplink enhancements, network slicing support, positioning services (NR Positioning), and energy-saving functions.
  • Develop, execute, and manage laboratory validation plans to verify feature functionality, interoperability, performance, stability, and standards compliance prior to field deployment.
  • Plan, coordinate, and execute Proof of Concept (PoC), interoperability testing, pilot deployments, and field trials, including defining objectives, KPIs, success criteria, and performance evaluation methodologies.
  • Support commercial rollout of approved radio technologies by developing deployment strategies, implementation guidelines, operational readiness documentation, and rollout acceptance criteria.
  • Analyse trial, benchmarking, and post-deployment performance data to identify improvement opportunities and recommend optimisation or corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with Radio Planning, Optimisation, Core Network, Transport, Device, OSS, Automation, and Operations teams, as well as equipment vendors, to ensure successful end-to-end technology introduction.
  • Engage equipment vendors to assess product roadmaps, software maturity, interoperability, and implementation plans, ensuring alignment with the company's network strategy and 3GPP standards evolution.
  • Prepare technical reports, engineering recommendations, standards impact assessments, deployment documentation, and executive presentations to support engineering governance and investment decisions.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 6–8 years of experience in mobile radio network engineering, RAN planning, optimisation, technology introduction, or network performance.
  • Hands-on experience in evaluating, testing, and deploying LTE and 5G NR features.
  • Experience conducting laboratory validation, interoperability testing, field trials, and commercial rollout of radio technologies.
  • Experience working with radio equipment vendors and cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Strong understanding of LTE, LTE-Advanced, and 5G NR radio technologies and architecture.
  • Ability to interpret and assess 3GPP specifications and translate standards into deployment requirements.
  • Proficiency in laboratory testing methodologies, feature validation, troubleshooting, and KPI analysis.
  • Knowledge of radio performance metrics, RF engineering principles, and network optimization

job.title: Vice President, Regional Construction Execution (APAC)
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

NTT is currently looking for a Vice President, Regional Construction Execution (APAC). The Vice President, Regional Construction is a key executive role reporting directly to the Vice President, Global Construction. The successful candidate will have direct accountability for the design, supply chain and construction organizations in the region responsible for capital infrastructure investment. This role will provide strategic direction and leadership to enable and execute projects within specified timelines, budgets, and quality standards to enable the regional business goals of the company.

This is a full time remote role based in Malaysia, Singapore or Thailand.

What we are looking for

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans for the construction, design and supply chain organizations, aligning with the Global Infrastructure Development (GID) organization's overall goals, the business goals in the region and industry trends/best practices. Identify opportunities for growth, speed to market improvement, and cost optimization.
  • Team Leadership: Manage a team of construction, design and supply chain professionals, including project managers, engineers, architects, commercial managers, etc. Foster a collaborative and high-performing work environment, promoting teamwork and individual development.
  • Regional Leadership: Be the in-region leader of the broader GID team which includes the construction, design and supply chain organizations, but also global teams with in-region resources (safety, power, land, project controls and front end engineering).
  • Project Management: Ensure proper project management is occurring from initiation to completion, ensuring adherence to project plans, schedules, and budgets. Monitor progress, identify potential risks, and implement mitigation strategies as necessary.
  • Vendor and Contractor Management: Monitors the performance of general contractors, architects/engineers and other suppliers to ensure compliance, execution, quality, and safety standards.
  • Supply Base Development: Personally engage with the key principals of supply chain partners to develop a supply chain that can reliably support the business needs of the company in the region.
  • Budgeting and Financial Management: Liaisons with project controls on project funding plans, necessary financial forecasts and reports.
  • Quality Assurance: Work with CX/Quality team to ensure adherence to quality assurance and commissioning programs and regulatory requirements are met.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including sales, operations, clients and regulatory authorities. Communicate project updates, resolve issues, and maintain positive relationships with all parties involved.

KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES

  • Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, building codes, safety regulations, and industry best practices.
  • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex construction projects on time and within budget.
  • Ability to build a strong safety culture throughout the organization.
  • Strong financial acumen and experience in budgeting, cost control, and financial analysis.
  • Proficiency in project management software, construction management tools, and MS Office suite.
  • Understanding of design and engineering.
  • Proven experience in implementing processes in a rapid growth environment
  • Knowledgeable of the basics necessary for operating in compliance where NTT is located.
  • Knowledgeable of the key supply chain operating concepts, executive relationships with supply chain partners in the region and claims management.
  • Knowledgeable of construction law and contracts.
  • Skilled at creating and maintaining a collaborative design/construction/operations environment in a global culture.

ACEDEMIC QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, or a related field. Master's degree (beneficial).

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • Extensive experience (15+ years) in construction management, preferably in a leadership role within the construction industry. Ideally experience with design and supply chain sourcing in addition to construction.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Remain stationery for long periods of time.
  • Operate computer, peripherals, and other office equipment.
  • Perform work during regional business hours and time zones with flexibility for global coordination.

WORK CONDITIONS AND REQUIREMENTS

  • Travel required up to 50%.
  • Perform work from a remote location with stable internet connection.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Strategic Account Manager, Asia
job.description:
Job Description

Position Summary:The Strategic Account Manager – Asia is responsible for developing and executing strategic account plans to drive sales growth, increase market share, and strengthen customer relationships across key markets in Asia.

Working closely with major customers, cross-functional teams, and senior leadership, you will identify business opportunities, deliver tailored solutions, and support the achievement of revenue and profitability targets. This individual contributor role requires strong commercial acumen, stakeholder management, and a proactive, customer-focused approach to position Vertiv as a preferred partner across the region.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Execute plans to increase market share and share of wallet in accordance with company targets for orders, revenue, and profitability, under the guidance of senior leadership.
  • Develop a strong understanding of key customers' priorities, challenges, and business objectives.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive account plans to achieve sales targets and revenue growth for assigned strategic accounts across the region.
  • Establish and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders within customer organisations.
  • Understand customer requirements and collaborate with internal teams to tailor solutions that meet their specific needs, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty.
  • Work closely with internal functions, including Marketing, Product Management, and Operations, to align strategies, deliver value, and provide seamless support to key accounts.
  • Analyse market trends, competitor activity, and industry developments to identify new business opportunities and recommend growth initiatives.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with key accounts, providing insights, performance updates, and recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Support contract negotiations and commercial discussions with customers, ensuring mutually beneficial agreements that comply with company policies and profitability objectives.
  • Manage and resolve customer issues or disputes that may arise, maintaining open communication and a proactive approach to issue resolution.
  • Prepare accurate and timely reports, forecasts, and updates on key account activities, highlighting progress, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Remain up to date with industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging technologies to enhance expertise and identify innovative strategies and best practices.
  • Contribute to medium and long-term strategies to strengthen brand awareness, customer engagement, and recognition of Vertiv's capabilities, expertise, and technology leadership among targeted accounts.
  • Recommend new practices, processes, and performance measures to improve account management effectiveness and sales outcomes.
  • Act as a mentor to less experienced colleagues where appropriate, sharing knowledge and best practices to support team development.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a related discipline; an MBA would be advantageous.
  • Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in strategic account management, business development, or strategic sales, ideally within the technology, manufacturing, logistics, or industrial solutions sectors.
  • Proven track record of managing large, complex, multi-country accounts across the Asia region.
  • Demonstrated success in achieving sales objectives, driving revenue growth, and increasing share of wallet within strategic customer accounts.
  • Experience using CRM platforms and digital account management tools.

Skills & Competencies

  • Highly driven, proactive, and adaptable, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively within a fast-paced regional environment.
  • Strong commercial acumen with a sound understanding of B2B sales cycles, negotiation, and contract management.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage, influence, and build credibility with senior decision-makers.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate customer insights into actionable account strategies and process improvements.

Job Title

Project Manager / HVAC Design Engineer

Job Summary

The AutoCAD HVAC & Revit Draftsman/Designer is responsible for preparing detailed HVAC engineering drawings, layouts, and 3D BIM models using AutoCAD and Revit software. The role involves supporting the design, installation, and commissioning teams by developing accurate drawings in compliance with project specifications, industry standards, and customer requirements.

Key Responsibilities HVAC Design & Drafting

  • Prepare HVAC layout drawings, ducting layouts, piping layouts, equipment placement drawings, and coordination drawings using AutoCAD.
  • Develop and maintain HVAC BIM models using Revit.
  • Generate shop drawings, installation drawings, as-built drawings, and fabrication drawings.
  • Create HVAC schematics, mechanical room layouts, and equipment schedules.
  • Prepare BOQ support drawings and material quantity take-offs.

BIM & Revit Modeling

  • Develop 3D HVAC models for commercial, industrial, and data center projects.
  • Perform clash detection and coordination with electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and architectural teams.
  • Update and modify BIM models based on project revisions and site feedback.
  • Ensure adherence to BIM execution plans and project standards.

Documentation & Coordination

  • Review engineering sketches, specifications, and design calculations.
  • Coordinate with project engineers, consultants, customers, and site teams.
  • Maintain drawing registers and revision control records.
  • Support project documentation during design, installation, and commissioning phases.

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure drawings comply with applicable HVAC codes, standards, and company guidelines.
  • Verify drawing accuracy before release.
  • Incorporate client comments and design changes promptly.

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering.
  • Certification in AutoCAD and Revit preferred.
  • Additional BIM certification is an advantage.

Experience

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in HVAC drafting and BIM modeling.
  • Experience in commercial buildings, industrial facilities, data centers, or critical infrastructure projects preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Effective communication and coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

Job Description

Brief Job Description:

Job Title

Service Engineer – Precision Air Conditioning (PAC)

Department

Service Operations – Thermal Management

Reporting To

Service Manager / Regional Service Manager

Job Summary

The PAC Service Engineer is responsible for installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, and customer support for Precision Air Conditioning (PAC) systems and associated cooling equipment. The role requires ensuring maximum equipment uptime, meeting SLA commitments, and providing excellent customer service at data centers, telecom sites, IT facilities, and commercial establishments.

Key Responsibilities Installation & Commissioning

  • Perform installation, testing, and commissioning of PAC units and associated cooling systems.
  • Verify site readiness and ensure compliance with engineering drawings and safety requirements.
  • Conduct performance testing and prepare commissioning reports.
  • Coordinate with project teams, customers, and subcontractors during project execution.

Preventive Maintenance

  • Execute scheduled preventive maintenance activities for PAC units, CRAC/CRAH units, chillers, condensers, CDU, FWU, and related systems.
  • Inspect compressors, condensers, evaporators, fans, control panels, sensors, and refrigerant circuits.
  • Submit maintenance reports and recommendations for improving equipment reliability.

Breakdown & Troubleshooting

  • Diagnose and rectify faults in electrical, mechanical, refrigeration, and control systems.
  • Analyze alarms and operational abnormalities using controller logs and monitoring systems.
  • Ensure timely closure of breakdown calls as per SLA commitments.
  • Support emergency and critical site requirements during breakdown situations.

Customer Support

  • Provide technical support and guidance to customers.
  • Maintain professional communication during service visits.
  • Ensure customer concerns are addressed promptly and effectively.
  • Prepare service reports and obtain customer sign-off upon activity completion.

Spare Parts & Inventory Management

  • Identify and recommend replacement parts and consumables.
  • Maintain service inventory and tools in good condition.
  • Support quotation preparation for repairs and spare replacement requirements.

Safety & Compliance

  • Follow all EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) guidelines.
  • Ensure proper usage of PPE during service activities.
  • Maintain compliance with customer safety regulations and permit systems.
  • Report unsafe conditions and incidents immediately.

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, or related field.
  • ITI (RAC/Electrical) with relevant experience may also be considered.

Experience

  • 2 to 8 years of experience in HVAC, Precision Cooling, or Critical Cooling Systems.
  • Experience in data centers, telecom infrastructure, IT facilities, healthcare facilities, or commercial buildings preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Good understanding of refrigeration cycle and HVAC principles.
  • Experience with:
  • Precision Air Conditioning (PAC) Units
  • CRAC / CRAH Systems
  • Chilled Water Systems
  • DX Cooling Systems
  • Air-Cooled and Water-Cooled Condensers
  • CDU and FWU Systems
  • Ability to troubleshoot:
  • Compressors
  • EEV/TEV Valves
  • Refrigerant Circuits
  • PLC and Microprocessor Controllers
  • Electrical Panels and Drives
  • Sensors and Communication Networks
  • Knowledge of refrigerants and safe handling procedures.
  • Familiarity with BMS and remote monitoring systems.

Key Competencies

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Customer-focused approach.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently at remote sites.
  • Time management and SLA adherence.
  • Teamwork and collaboration.

Key Performance Indicators (KPI)

  • Preventive Maintenance Compliance.
  • First-Time Fix Rate (FTFR).
  • Breakdown Response Time (RT).
  • Turnaround Time (TAT) for call closure.
  • Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT).
  • Service Revenue through spare parts identification.
  • Safety Compliance and Zero Incident Record.

Travel Requirements

  • Willingness to travel extensively across assigned geographical regions.
  • Availability for emergency breakdown support, weekend work, and on-call duty when required.

Preferred Industry Experience

  • Data Centers
  • Telecom Facilities
  • IT Parks
  • Critical Infrastructure Projects
  • Pharmaceutical Facilities
  • Manufacturing Plants
  • Commercial Buildings

Preferred Certification: HVAC/R, Refrigerant Handling, Electrical Safety, Working at Height, and OEM-specific PAC product training (Vertiv, Stulz, Schneider, Rittal, Climaveneta, etc.).

job.title: ERP Second Level Support (RUN) – Analyst (Services)
job.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Application Development and Support Analyst to provide development, maintenance, enhancement, and production support for Oracle Applications. The role will be responsible for analyzing business requirements, troubleshooting application issues, and working closely with business users, technical teams, and other stakeholders to ensure system stability and continuous improvement.

The candidate will be responsible for analyzing incidents and service requests, understanding business processes, identifying root causes, coordinating resolutions, supporting enhancements, and ensuring that Oracle Applications meet business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Application Support
  • Provide production support for Oracle Applications.
  • Analyze and resolve application incidents, defects, and service requests within agreed SLAs.
  • Troubleshoot issues related to Oracle modules, interfaces, concurrent programs, reports, workflows, and database objects.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent corrective actions.
  • Support application deployments, patches, upgrades, and production releases.
  • Application Development
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Perform unit testing, system testing, and support user acceptance testing.
  • Business & Stakeholder Management
  • Work closely with functional teams and business users to understand requirements and resolve issues.
  • Participate in requirement gathering, impact analysis, and solution design.
  • Communicate technical issues and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Maintain knowledge of business processes and their relationship with Oracle Applications.

Required Technical and Functional Skills

  • Strong functional knowledge of Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) and/or Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications.
  • Good understanding of one or more Oracle functional modules.
  • Strong understanding of business processes related to the supported Oracle modules.
  • Experience in production application support and incident management. Experience in Manufacturing Industry preferred.
  • Ability to troubleshoot functional issues and perform root-cause analysis.
  • Experience in requirements gathering and functional analysis.
  • Experience preparing functional specifications and test cases.
  • Strong knowledge of SIT, UAT, regression testing, and defect management.
  • Basic knowledge of SQL for data validation and investigation is desirable.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow, Jira, or other IT service management tools is an advantage.
  • Experience working with Oracle Support or third-party Oracle vendors is desirable.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Typically, 3–5 years of experience in Oracle Application support or a similar role.
  • Experience supporting Oracle EBS R12 and/or Oracle Fusion Cloud is preferred.
  • Experience working in a production support environment with defined SLAs.
  • Experience supporting business users across multiple departments or locations is an advantage.

job.description:
Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of medium to large-scale Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM transformation programs.
  • Establish and manage project governance structures, steering committees, RAID logs, and delivery dashboards.
  • Ensure adherence to enterprise PMO standards, delivery frameworks, and quality gates across all phases of implementation.
  • Oversee implementations, enhancements, and optimization initiatives across Oracle Fusion HCM modules, including:
  • Global Human Resources (Core HR)
  • Recruiting Cloud (ORC)
  • Compensation & Benefits
  • Talent Management
  • Payroll
  • HR Help Desk
  • Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) / Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI)

  • Participate in solution design workshops, requirement gathering, testing, training, and production support activities.
  • Ensure compliance with security, audit, data privacy, and governance standards.
  • Provide oversight on technical delivery streams including:
  • Upstream and Downstream integrations
  • REST/SOAP APIs and middleware
  • Data migration (HDL, HSDL, FBDI)
  • Reporting and analytics (OTBI, BI Publisher, FDI)
  • Ensure technical solutions are aligned with enterprise architecture, security standards, and scalability requirements.
  • Partner with technical leads to ensure timely resolution of defects, integration issues, and data inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with HR Centers of Excellence (COEs), business stakeholders, IT architecture teams, and global delivery partners.
  • Manage relationships with Oracle implementation partners and third-party vendors.
  • Drive alignment between business requirements and technical solution delivery.
  • Identify, track, and mitigate program risks, issues, and dependencies across global deployments.
  • Support audit readiness and change control governance for HR systems.
  • Manage project schedules, sprint planning, release planning, and resource allocation across global teams.

  • Provide clear executive reporting on milestones, KPIs, and delivery health.

  • 6-10 years of IT project / program management experience in enterprise HRIS or ERP environments.
  • Minimum 3–4 years of hands-on experience managing HR transformation or HRIS implementation programs.
  • Proven experience of delivering at least one full lifecycle Oracle Fusion HCM implementation or major transformation program in HR Technology space.
  • Experience managing integration-heavy environments involving Oracle HCM Cloud and enterprise systems.
  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and cross-functional communication skills.

Job Description

Brief Job Description:

Thermal Customer Engineer:

He/She is required to establish, promote and maintain excellent rapport with all customers, sales managers, distributors and others within the field; maintain ongoing communication with scheduling teams and the line/department Manager

Responsibilities and Measurement Criteria with Time investment Needed on Each:

(This will describe the overall core responsibilities of the role, decision making responsibilities etc.)

  • Respond in a professional manner to all assigned service calls while on duty.
  • Perform all work in a safe manner and in accordance with established company safety policy.
  • Perform all work using good working practice and current codes of practice/legislation relevant to assigned task.
  • Assist in ensuring that the planned maintenance completion rate is maintained at a min 90%.
  • Keep scheduling team informed of changes to your schedule and the status of all open jobs.
  • Maintain the accuracy of the customer listing by reporting errors with the site change form.
  • Close tasks in Oracle Mobile Field Service (MFS) daily and weekly paperwork in a timely, accurate and complete manner.
  • Create reports using FieldDB system and ensure regular synchronization.
  • Report sales or service leads to the proper department via the correct process.
  • Support company vision and management decisions.
  • Use email and other Office based programs to maintain/enhance communications processes.
  • Ensure that all Vertiv processes are followed.
  • Keep company vehicle clean and properly maintained.
  • Protect all tooling and company property issued.
  • Work as part of the service team and support business needs.
  • Take an active role in the callout rota.

Qualifications

Required/ Minimum Qualifications:

  • NVQ Level 1 & 2, or equivalent in Refrigeration and Air Conditioning.
  • City and Guilds 2078 or 2079 in Refrigerant Safe Handling, Subscribed to ACRIB.

Additional / Preferred Qualifications:

  • Excellent computer skills.

job.title: Specialist, Security & Resilience Management
job.description:
Job Description

Join us as a Security & Resilience Management Specialist and take the lead in protecting our organization from emerging threats. This role combines strategic planning, hands-on incident response, and the opportunity to build a culture of security that touches every corner of our business.

What will you do?

  • Design and implement security policies and resilience plans that safeguard organizational assets and personnel
  • Manage operational response to high and extreme risk incidents with strategic coordination and leadership
  • Conduct comprehensive risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies to address vulnerabilities
  • Build security awareness through training programs that foster a proactive, resilient organizational culture

What are the key skills we are looking for?

  • Incident Management— intermediate level; coordinating response to security events and ensuring swift resolution
  • Disaster Preparedness— developing level; building plans that ensure business continuity during crises
  • Governance Risk and Compliance— developing level; aligning security initiatives with regulatory standards and organizational policies
  • Threat Intelligence— developing level; analyzing emerging risks to inform proactive security measures
  • Risk Assessment— developing level; evaluating organizational vulnerabilities and prioritizing mitigation efforts
  • Physical Security— developing level; implementing measures to safeguard facilities and personnel
  • Project Management— foundational level; overseeing security initiatives from planning through execution
  • Training— developing level; designing programs that build security awareness across teams

What qualifications will make you successful?

  • Strategic thinker who connects security initiatives to organizational objectives with clarity and purpose
  • Strong influencer who builds trust and drives change across diverse stakeholder groups
  • Composed and decisive during critical incidents with excellent judgment under pressure
  • Collaborative leader who coaches others and fosters a shared commitment to resilience

What's in it for me?

  • Meaningful work where you protect people and assets while shaping organizational strategy
  • Visibility with executive leadership and the chance to influence high-level decision-making
  • Professional growth through specialized training and development opportunities
  • A team that values innovation, collaboration, and proactive problem-solving

Bring your expertise to a role where security meets strategy — apply today!

Rewards designed for you

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our [Career Page](https://www.se.com/careers).

\\* Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our  IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

This position will be responsible to lead a team in managing the overall operations of a portfolio of the assigned properties, enhancing the value of the properties through well maintained and efficiently run facilities through effective cost management.

job.title: Senior Delivery Consultant - Data, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
job.description:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a Delivery Consultant specializing in Data to join our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) practice. You will be at the center of the most consequential shift in enterprise technology: making organizations truly AI-ready. Every agentic AI system, every foundation model grounded in enterprise knowledge, and every GenAI application that moves from prototype to production depends on the data layer beneath it - and that's what you build.

You will design and implement modern data platforms (lake, lakehouse, mesh), architect data pipelines that transform raw, fragmented data estates into governed, AI-ready assets; and design and implement enterprise RAG architectures, vector stores, semantic ontologies, and knowledge graph architectures that allow foundation models and AI agents to reason accurately, access data securely, and execute autonomously within regulated environments. You will work hands-on inside HCLS customer environments with complex data lineage, regulatory overlays (GxP, HIPAA, CDISC), and legacy systems, and ship production-grade data products that serve multiple downstream consumers, from ML model training to agentic orchestration layers. AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives.

Key job responsibilities Design and implement production-grade data pipelines, data lakes, lakehouses, and data mesh architectures within enterprise HCLS environments, integrating with legacy systems and existing data governance frameworks.

Build data products that serve multiple downstream applications and use cases — from AI/ML model training to agentic AI systems, ensuring data quality, lineage, and reliability at scale.

Operate with a high degree of autonomy within fast-moving delivery engagements, making judgment calls on data modeling, pipeline design, and architecture without waiting for perfect specifications or constant oversight.

Navigate complex data access, security, and privacy requirements unique to pharma and healthcare including GxP compliance constraints, HIPAA, and regulatory data governance frameworks.

Architect contextual knowledge layers, including ontologies and knowledge graphs leveraging AWS Context, Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and custom ontology extensions to equip AI agents with the vocabulary and guardrails to reason accurately and execute autonomously within regulated environments.

Collaborate across organizational boundaries to secure data access, understand source system context, and resolve data quality challenges with teams across customer IT, business, and partner organizations.

Deliver iteratively when requirements are ambiguous, translating incomplete business needs into well-architected data solutions that can evolve as customer understanding matures.

Apply AI-DLC (AI-accelerated Development Life Cycle) methodologies to data delivery to redesign data workflows to become AI-native for accelerated scale and pace.

job.title: ID-LB Cabling Infrastructure Tech
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities Key Job Responsibilities ID-LB Cabling Infrastructure Tech at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:

  • Adhere to security and safety best practices in the data center.
  • Installation and testing of copper and Fiber Optic cabling.
  • Creating/attaching labels and barcodes

. Understanding of test equipment (power meter / light source, OTDR, VFL, Fluke, network analyser, copper / fiber cabling test equipment) . Basic build and troubleshooting of network devices.

  • Managing inventory of related materials by checking and coordinating all materials to be delivered to site daily
  • Adhering to defined escalation processes and standard operating procedures.
  • Work in noisy areas with hotter and colder temperatures than standard office environmental conditions.

. Regularly work at heights and from ladders. . Experience with a ticketing system

  • Ability to travel within geographical work area is required. Occasional work in tight and/or narrow spaces, such as under raised floors

Basic Qualifications

  • Diploma/Graduation in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 1-2 years of project management experience or operations planning experience
  • 1-2 years’ experience with physical network infrastructure deployment and troubleshooting
  • 1-2 years’ experience with network cabling (fiber optic & copper)
  • English language communication ability
  • Basic knowledge of computer hardware and network cabling.
  • Ability to work well with others in a team environment, displaying excellent time management skills and the ability to follow direction.
  • Able to work at heights or use ladders for continued periods
  • Have strong attention to detail, maintain high quality standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Substantial background in large scale datacentre network implementations and support.
  • Knowledge of Copper and Fiber Optic testing methodologies.
  • Ability to read basic layout drawings and floorplans.
  • Industry standard certifications (CompTIA, CITY & GUILDS Cabling cert or equivalent).
  • Previous experience working in a Data Center environment (racking & stacking gear, cable management).

job.title: Software Development Manager, AWS DynamoDB
job.description:
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services. Want to shape the future of a NoSQL database service that supports mission-critical workloads operating at more than 100 million requests per second? Let's take its speed and efficiency to the next level!

Amazon DynamoDB is a key-value and document database that delivers single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale. As a fast-growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission-critical workloads.

We are looking for an engineering leader eager to improve the discoverability, safety, and efficiency of DynamoDB.

As a software development manager on the DynamoDB team, you will lead a team of passionate engineers to build reliable and highly scalable distributed systems. This is a good opportunity to pave the path for a new generation of cloud database services, grow as a technology leader, and work with some really smart people. To succeed in the role, you must be passionate about both solving deep technical challenges and being a great people manager. You must care deeply about system availability and reliability, and understand what it means to own a mission-critical service that handles hundreds of millions of requests per second, with sub-millisecond latencies and eight 9s of availability. You must be great fun to work with. Our company credo is “Work hard. Have fun. Make history”. The right candidate will be smart, ambitious, love what they do and instinctively know how to make work fun. Building, motivating and mentoring a world-class systems & software engineering team is the most important part of this role. You should have a proven track record in recruiting and retaining top talent and excel in day-to-day people and performance management tasks.

You must have a strong Agile product management and delivery experience. The successful candidate will create and implement product roadmaps for the team using Agile methodologies. This will include helping innovate and invent new value-add services layered on top of our existing services. You will need excellent technical project management skills to deliver product roadmap items as well as other cross-team projects. You will set the vision of how to evolve DynamoDB going forward.

You must have a strong operational experience, with a track record of operating highly available fault tolerant systems. The right candidate will want to measure everything and be very data driven. They will excel at using metrics, monitoring and alarming to measure and improve the operational processes and performance of their team. The candidate must be comfortable operating in a fast moving, dynamic environment.

If you want to test your limits, build a world-class team, and tackle challenges at a scale and level of impact rarely seen, join us!

  • 7+ years of engineering experience
  • 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
  • Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations

job.title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
job.description:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise-level customers.

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.

Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities

  • Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
  • Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
  • Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
  • Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
  • Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
  • Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
  • Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
  • Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
  • Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

job.title: Data Center Operations Cluster Manager, BOM - DCO
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Operations Manager is a senior leadership role for our compute operations teams within an AWS region. They will have managerial responsibility for safety, security, availability, scaling, costs and efficiency for their department. They lead the team that is installing, maintaining, and de-commissioning network and server equipment in a safe, secure and cost-effective manner across the region. The Data Center Operations Manager must manage across each function but also have the ability to dive deep into any given function as needed. They must have a strong background on people management with a team size of 60+ employees.

The successful candidate will be a highly driven, self-managed individual who demonstrates initiative and proactively seeks solutions to problems. The candidate will have a strong understanding of network and compute architecture and have experience managing repair requests in a high volume environment, as well as managing response to high severity events. They will have a strong track record of developing talent, and managing performance of their team and organization. They will be creating, and tracking budgets; strategically planning through use of metrics; sponsoring, reporting and delivering large projects while proposing technical solutions to complicated problems. This position requires a candidate with the proven ability to drive continuous improvement and the ability to keep pace with our explosive growth while motivating others to meet the challenges of an extremely deadline-driven environment.

Key job responsibilities Lead and supervise a team of Data Center Managers and Engineers across multiple data centers, installing, maintaining and decommissioning network and server hardware.

  • Oversee the safety, security, availability, quality, and performance of the team, while driving a positive customer experience.
  • Strategic planning and forecasting; manage team and individual performance; delivering performance reviews, and address staffing needs
  • Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and procedures.
  • Mentor, train and develop career progression for direct reports and members of the organization.
  • Obsess over team learning and development, both from a technical/functional and soft skills (critical thinking, emotional intelligence, and adaptability) development perspective.
  • Coordinate support of change management resources in partnership with electrical and mechanical operations teams.
  • Develop, improve, and share operational best practices across the region and with peers globally.
  • Ability to oversee and manage complex projects for delivery against tight timelines to exceed customer expectations.
  • Design and execute comprehensive strategic initiatives that align with organizational goals and drive operational efficiency
  • Facilitate rapid response protocols and support dynamic problem-solving initiatives
  • Provide expert guidance and mentorship to team members in high-pressure environments
  • Proven ability to build, mentor, and retain high-performing teams in a fast-paced technical environment
  • Experience with compliance requirements and industry standards (e.g., ISO, ITIL, SOC)

A day in the life Your day will be a blend of strategic leadership and hands-on technical problem-solving. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor talented engineers, and develop innovative approaches to data center management. From optimizing hardware performance to fostering team growth, you'll be at the center of our operational success.

About the team Our team is a collaborative, forward-thinking group dedicated to maintaining world-class data center infrastructure. We value continuous learning, technical innovation, and creating an inclusive environment where every team member can thrive and contribute meaningfully.

About AWS Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of operations and on-call support for data center facilities, mission critical plants, or production facilities, or 2+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
  • 5+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
  • Experience driving internal cross-team collaboration
  • Minimum 6 years of experience in managing managers and leading large-scale teams including performance management, talent development, and succession planning. Stringent time management skills to balance workloads in a complex and dynamic environment
  • Brings experience in operational strategy and change management, with a focus on collaborative decision-making and innovative problem-solving. Demonstrates knowledge of industry standards (ISO, ITIL, SOC) and budget management, alongside skills in developing practical operational procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, management, or technology, or Master's degree or above in engineering, management, or technology
  • Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma and process improvement methodologies
  • Experience leading large teams, with demonstrable ability to hire, develop, and manage high-performing technical teams
  • Experience operating mission-critical online services
  • Knowledge of technology principles and services including infrastructure, business applications, data management, security, application platforms, and consumer-facing technology
