job.title: Manager Purchasing
job.description:
Job Description

Brief Job Description:

The Purchasing manager is part of the Materials Management team, reporting solid line to the Materials and Manufacturing Planning Manager.

He/She oversees our day-to-day purchasing operations. Purchasing Manager will be responsible for managing a team of buyers, coordinating purchasing activities, resolving exceptions, and ensuring timely procurement of goods and services while focusing on Inventory optimization.

Responsibilities and Measurement Criteria with Time investment Needed on Each:

(This will describe the overall core responsibilities of the role, decision making responsibilities etc.)

  • Lead and manage the tactical purchasing team to ensure efficient and effective execution of purchasing activities.
  • Develop and implement tactical purchasing strategies to optimize procurement processes and achieve cost savings.
  • Coordinate the creation and management of purchase orders within the Oracle ERP/Cyberplan system, including monitoring PO status and resolving exceptions.
  • Analyze inventory turnover rates, carrying costs, and stock-out rates to identify opportunities for inventory optimization.
  • Implement inventory management strategies such as ABC analysis, cycle counting, and safety stock management to optimize inventory levels.
  • Evaluate alternative sourcing options and supplier lead times to optimize inventory replenishment processes.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, such as production, inventory management, and finance, to ensure alignment of purchasing activities with business objectives.
  • Analyze purchasing data and performance metrics to identify trends, opportunities for improvement, and areas of risk.
  • Monitor market trends, supplier performance, and regulatory requirements to inform procurement decisions and mitigate risks.
  • Develop and maintain purchasing policies, procedures, and best practices to ensure compliance with organizational standards and industry regulations.
  • Provide leadership, guidance, and coaching to the purchasing team to foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
  • Support talent management process (selection, development, and career path).
  • Prepare and present reports, dashboards, and analysis to senior management to communicate purchasing performance and recommendations for improvement.
  • Ensure communication of vision and strategy for his area of responsibility above and below within the organization.

Qualifications

Required/ Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • 15+ years’ experience in Purchasing

Additional / Preferred Qualifications:

  • Good knowledge of Oracle architecture and planning tools (Cyberplan)
  • Good knowledge of standard software tools (MS Excel, PowerPoint, Access).
  • English –fluent level – written and spoken
  • A high level of motivation combined with leadership abilities is required
  • Availability to travel and working time flexibility, in an international environment.
  • Competences: result-oriented, team player, careful to details, flexible.

Physical & Environmental Requirements: (To be used majorly for manufacturing jobs.)

  • None

Time Travel Needed:

  • 20%

No calls or agencies please. Vertiv will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

job.title: Head of APJC Tech Strategy and Operations, Global Sales Operations
job.description:
We are looking for a Leader of APJ Field Tech Operations to help drive the long-term growth of the APJ Tech business through a period of significant change. The ideal candidate is a hands-on, motivated self-starter who is passionate about using data, fluent enough in technology to operationally lead a technical field credibly, and has a track record of driving transformation, not just running operations. In this role, the leader will work out what the APJ Tech organization must prioritize from an operations perspective to help the business scale, and then drive that change through the field. This is not a role to run the operating cadence well and keep the reporting clean; it is to lead the organization through its transition as the AI business scales and the most fundamental roles, from how we sell to how we deliver, are reshaped. The mandate is to carry the org through that change rather than defend the current model, and it holds even if the team gets leaner, because the game is productivity and leverage, not size. Considered a close operational partner to APJ Tech leadership and a member of the APJ Tech leadership team, this leader will develop, implement, and manage the business processes, systems, insights, and strategies that optimize how the organization works to meet its goals along with geographically dispersed team reporting to them. They will own and drive the management of business cadences across cross-functional teams, and will have the capacity to absorb and lead change through their direct team as well as by earning trust and influencing others across the APJ and WW Tech business and worldwide stakeholders who do not report to the role. The role drives improvements to the reporting tools, mechanisms, and business insights the team relies on, increasing the availability and granularity of actionable, decision-ready data and building a single source of truth leaders can trust. Crucially, it reaches for automation and AI as the primary lever to redesign how operations work gets done, so the organization produces materially more without adding people. It also manages the proposal, administration, and execution of the region’s targets, goals, and headcount plans, and continuously proposes improvements that increase the organization’s effectiveness in driving desired results. The successful candidate must be able to roll up their sleeves and work directly with models and data, and thrive in ambiguity of various challenges encountered daily in a fast-moving Tech company. You will be passionate about your work, analytical, and a strong problem-solver, with the technical depth to earn the trust of a technical field and the judgment to know where technology creates the most leverage. You will have superb communication and relationship skills, hold a firm and well-reasoned line with senior leaders on what the data says even when it is unwelcome, and stay open to disconfirming input rather than anchoring on prior ways of working. You will drive toward simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have a track record of building high-performing teams and thinking big, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy-to-understand way.

Key job responsibilities

  • Drive org-wide transformation from an operations lens: Look across the APJ Tech org, decide what to prioritize to help it scale, and drive that change through the field - not just describe it. This is the heart of the role.
  • Bring technical depth to lead a technical field: Operate with enough technical fluency to lead a Tech organization credibly, earn the trust of a technical field, and make sound calls on where technology creates the most leverage.
  • Earn trust and influence across a matrixed org: Land change with Area GMs, Tech leaders across the Geo, and worldwide stakeholders who do not report to this role, and hold a firm line on what the data says even when it is unwelcome.
  • Use the FTO platform to drive change at scale: Know the Field Tech Operations function intimately and use it as a platform to lead transformation, with a demonstrated pattern of thinking big rather than optimizing the status quo.
  • Drive productivity through automation and AI: Redesign how operations work gets done so the org produces materially more without adding people, using AI and automation as the primary lever, and deliver results at a different scale.
  • Build systems and a single source of truth: Design mechanisms, standards, and trusted business insights that scale on their own; build the machine rather than personally running each cycle.
  • Run the operating cadence as the foundation: Keep firm command of the current state - business reviews, goals, and decision-ready reporting - as the stable base from which transformation is driven, since business as usual keeps running until the transitions land.
  • Build and develop the team: Attract, grow, and retain a high-performing operations and insights team, and raise the bar on talent as the function evolves.

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of senior leadership work in sales operations, sales strategy, finance, business development, or other related fields experience
  • 7+ years of leading a divisional sales operations team or equivalent responsibilities supporting a mid-to-large-scale, multi-geographical, hi-tech, sales organization experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Experience in leading a divisional sales operations team or equivalent responsibilities supporting a mid-to-large-scale, multi-geographical, high-tech, sales organization
  • Experience hiring and leading a high-performance team

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing and implementing systems/tools utilized for CRM, variable compensation, revenue reporting, forecasting, Salesforce automation, etc.
  • Experience in business-process design
  • Experience rapidly growing an organization and attracting, hiring, and maintaining top talent
  • Experience working within a high-growth, technology company
  • Master's degree or equivalent

You will join a talented team, where you will be able to thrive.

Qualifications for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Planning Engineer or Lead Planning Engineer.
  • Strong expertise in project planning, scheduling, and data analytics using Primavera P6 and MS Project.
  • Good understanding of project management processes, project lifecycle, and schedule management.
  • Hands-on experience in Cost Control, Earned Value Management (EVM), and project performance tracking.
  • Strong analytical, data management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; PMP certification will be an added advantage.
  • Should be a graduate

More about us

ABB a provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. These offerings, coupled with deep domain knowledge in each end market, help to optimize productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability and safety of industrial processes and operations.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

job.title: CFIN P2P & Treasury Solution Architect
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

CFIN P2P and Treasury Solution Lead ###

Your role and responsibilities:

We are seeking a skilled Procure to Pay (P2P) & Treasury (TRE) Solution architect to play a key role in configuring, implementing, and supporting P2P/ TRE processes within the Central Finance (CFIN) system. The P2P/ TRE Solution architect will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, process owners, and technical teams to ensure seamless integration of P2P/TRE functions within the CFIN framework. This role requires deep functional knowledge of P2P/TRE processes, as well as the ability to translate business requirements into system configurations that optimize efficiency, accuracy, and business performance. This position requires close coordination with Deployment team, Functional architects and external vendors, to maintain and evolve the P2P/TRE architecture, ensuring it meets business needs and complies with ABB's standards.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Finance Services business Finance Process Data Systems division in Bangalore, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • P2P/TRE Process Configuration: Configure and maintain Procure to Pay (P2P) & Treasury (TRE) processes such as. within the Central Finance (CFIN) system, ensuring alignment with business needs and industry best practices. Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders and process owners to thoroughly understand their requirements, document functional specifications, and translate these into system configurations.
  • System Integration: Facilitate seamless integration of P2P/TRE processes within the CFIN system, as well as with other enterprise systems (ERP, GTS, etc.), ensuring smooth data flow and automation of processes across platforms. User Support & Training: Provide ongoing functional support to end-users, addressing issues, offering solutions, and conducting training to ensure optimal utilization of the system and full understanding of P2P/TRE processes.
  • Testing & Validation: Participate in testing and validation activities for new configurations, enhancements, and fixes, ensuring they meet business and functional requirements. Process Optimization: Regularly monitor and evaluate P2P/TRE processes to identify opportunities for automation, efficiency improvements, and best practice implementation within the CFIN system. Documentation & Compliance: Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for P2P/TRE system configurations, process flows, and integration points, ensuring compliance with internal standards and regulatory guidelines.
  • Collaboration with Technical Teams: Work closely with IS architects, developers, and technical teams to ensure that functional requirements are correctly implemented and aligned with system design specifications. Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution: Provide expert troubleshooting support for P2P/TRE -related system issues, working collaboratively with cross-functional teams to resolve any challenges promptly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about the latest industry trends, best practices, and system updates to continuously enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of P2P/TRE processes within CFIN. Project and New Demand Management: Take ownership of configuring new demands or changes in system functionality, ensuring proper alignment with system design documentation and business requirements. P2P/TRE-Related Data Management: Oversee the management and accuracy of P2P/TRE-related data within the system, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and compliance with business rules across all P2P / TRE processes.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. Relevant certifications in P2P/ TRE - SAP ECC, GCM, SAP S/4HANA, SAP CFIN, or IT architecture. Proven experience (5+ years) in P2P / TRE process management, with a strong background in system configuration and implementation within SAP or similar ERP environments (SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP CFIN). Strong functional.
  • knowledge of P2P/ TRE processes, including procurement, invoicing, payments and Treasury functions (cash management, liquidity forecasting, bank reconciliations) Experience in configuring P2P/ TRE processes in SAP or similar ERP systems, with a solid understanding of integration points and data flows across systems. Familiarity with Central Finance (CFIN) and integration with other finance-related modules.
  • Experience with requirements gathering, business analysis, and documentation of functional specifications. High level understanding on Global Bank Payment set up High level understanding in areas of PINO - Payment in name of & POBO - Payment on behalf of Strong experience in vendor correspondence & futuristic approach for various bank payment rejection & global solution approach to handle such situations.
  • High level understanding of payment solutions at global level. Experience in GCM-Global Cash management & various Bank connections globally. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and technical teams. A strong focus on continuous improvement and automation, with a passion for driving innovation within enterprise systems.
  • Experience in managing relationships with external vendors and third-party service providers to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions. Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, dynamic work environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

ABB Finance is a trusted partner to the business and a world-class team who delivers forward-looking insights that drive sustainable long-term results and operates with the highest standards.

job.title: Solutions Analyst
job.description:
About Goodman

At Goodman, your career is more than just a job – it’s about growth, innovation, and making a lasting impact. Whether you’re building your career in property, data centres, finance, legal, or beyond, we value diverse perspectives and seek individuals who are passionate about driving our business forward.

As providers of essential infrastructure for the digital economy, Goodman has been developing its data centre capability since 2005. Since then, we have grown to become a large owner of powered sites globally. Our global power bank of 5.0GW includes completed facilities, secured power and potential data centre projects across 13 major international cities. This has been built up over time through our expertise in securing land, planning and power in highly sought after locations in major global cities.

Solutions Analyst

Join Goodman’s Australian Technology Centre of Excellence and play a key role in supporting and improving the systems that underpin our property, finance and operational platforms.

We are looking for a Solutions Analyst to support the delivery, enhancement and ongoing operation of our business applications environment, with a strong focus on Yardi. You will help translate business needs into practical system improvements, supporting reliable, integrated and easy-to-use technology across Goodman’s Australian business.

About the role

This is a hands-on solution delivery role where you will work closely with business stakeholders, Group IT and external vendors to design, test and implement system changes, support project and production environments, and help ensure our platforms are stable, integrated and aligned to best practice.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys being close to the business, solving practical system problems and building deep expertise in a core property technology platform.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, test and implement Yardi changes, enhancements and configuration updates.
  • Provide administration and support across test, project and production environments.
  • Troubleshoot application issues and coordinate resolution with vendors and internal IT teams.
  • Develop and test interfaces between applications and support IT and user acceptance testing.
  • Prepare deployment scripts, change submissions, rollback plans, backups and technical documentation.
  • Act as a Yardi subject matter expert, supporting best-practice use of the platform.
  • Provide guidance, training and mentoring to users to build capability and improve adoption.
  • Contribute to governance, risk management and continuous improvement across Goodman’s technology platforms.

About you

Strong hands-on Yardi experience is important for this role, ideally across configuration, administration, testing or application support. You will be comfortable working across technical and business teams, translating requirements into practical system outcomes and supporting users through change.

You will bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills, good communication skills, close attention to detail and a practical, delivery-focused approach. Experience preparing technical documentation, user guides and deployment materials will be highly regarded. Knowledge of property management, general ledger systems, SQL, Power BI or TM1 would also be beneficial.

This role would suit someone who enjoys combining systems knowledge with business understanding. You will be practical, curious and comfortable working across both detail and bigger-picture outcomes — from troubleshooting an issue through to supporting project delivery, user adoption and continuous improvement.

The Benefits

At Goodman we know that our people are integral to our company success. That’s why we have implemented some fantastic benefits for all to experience, these include:

  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Study assistance for postgraduate and undergraduate courses
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Eligibility to participate in Goodman’s share scheme
  • Wellness program that focuses on the health and wellbeing, including exercise classes, meditation, yoga, social events, exclusive discounts, cooking classes, financial wellbeing seminars and more.

About Goodman

Goodman is a provider of essential infrastructure. We own, develop and manage high quality, sustainable logistics properties and data centres in major global cities, that are critical to the digital economy.

We’re a collaborative team with a shared vision to make the world a better place for our customers, our investors, our people, and the communities we operate in. We value innovation, integrity, determination, and sustainability, and [our purpose](https://au.goodman.com/about-goodman/our-purpose) is simple: to make space for greatness in everything we do.

Goodman encourages innovation at every level. We seek individuals who are eager to challenge conventional thinking, drive change, and develop new ideas that contribute to a sustainable and successful business. Your creativity and forward-thinking approach can make a tangible difference today and long into the future.

job.description:

##

Business Analyst

Goodman is looking for a Business Analyst to join our AU Technology Centre of Excellence in Sydney. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of Finance, Technology and business transformation, helping shape practical solutions that improve how our teams work every day.

In this role, you will partner closely with finance leaders, technology teams and business stakeholders to understand what the business needs, where processes can be improved, and how systems can better support decision-making, efficiency and growth. You will play a hands-on role across finance systems and business application projects, from discovery and requirements through to testing, business readiness, implementation and post-go-live support.

You will also have the opportunity to build broader project delivery experience. Where a dedicated Project Manager is not in place, you will support planning, governance, reporting, vendor coordination and post-implementation review, giving you exposure across the full project lifecycle and the opportunity to take on greater delivery responsibility over time.

What you’ll do

  • Act as the link between Finance, Technology and the wider business, translating business needs into practical technology solutions.
  • Work with finance leaders and subject matter experts to understand current processes, identify pain points and shape better future-state ways of working.
  • Lead the requirements journey from discovery through to sign-off, creating clear documentation that gives business, technical and vendor teams a shared understanding of what needs to be delivered.
  • Support solution validation, process mapping, user acceptance testing, defect resolution and business readiness.
  • Help ensure change lands well by supporting end-user documentation, training material, communications and adoption activities.
  • Coordinate delivery where required, including project planning, status reporting, risk and issue tracking, governance checkpoints and post-implementation review.
  • Partner with vendors, technical teams and business stakeholders to deliver solutions that are practical, fit for purpose and aligned to business priorities.

What you’ll bring

  • 3–5 years’ experience in business analysis, business process transformation or software implementation projects.
  • Strong finance or accounting knowledge, gained within property, investment, funds management or a related environment.
  • Experience working with finance systems, reporting tools or business applications - Yardi is essential
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Experience supporting UAT, requirements traceability, business readiness and change communications.
  • A practical, structured approach, with the confidence to work across business and technology teams

The Benefits

  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Study assistance for postgraduate and undergraduate courses
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Eligibility to participate in Goodman’s share scheme
  • Wellness program that focuses on the health and wellbeing, including exercise classes, meditation, yoga, social events, exclusive discounts, cooking classes, financial wellbeing seminars and more.

We’re a collaborative team with a shared vision to make the world a better place for our customers, our investors, our people, and the communities we operate in. We value innovation, integrity, determination, and sustainability, and [our purpose](https://au.goodman.com/about-goodman/our-purpose) is simple: to make space for greatness in everything we do.

Goodman encourages innovation at every level. We seek individuals who are eager to challenge conventional thinking, drive change, and develop new ideas that contribute to a sustainable and successful business. Your creativity and forward-thinking approach can make a tangible difference today and long into the future.

Technology Lead (Development Systems)

We’re looking for a hands-on Technology Lead to support the platforms that underpin Goodman’s development activities across Data Centre, Industrial and Infrastructure.

This role sits in our AU Technology Centre of Excellence and works closely with our Developments team to configure, optimise, integrate and improve the systems that support project delivery — with Procore at the centre, alongside platforms such as Autodesk, Revizto, Oracle Primavera Cloud, Bluebeam and SketchUp Pro.

A key focus will be supporting Project Keystone, our re-implementation of Procore, including the rollout of Procore Financials, improved governance, reporting and platform adoption across the business.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Administering and configuring Procore, including permissions, project settings, correspondence, document management and reporting
  • Supporting the implementation of Procore Financials across budgets, commitments, variations, progress claims and cost structures
  • Improving platform governance, integration, data quality and reporting across development systems
  • Managing the lifecycle of development applications, including vendor relationships, licensing, renewals and upgrades
  • Helping lift Goodman’s BIM and information-management maturity
  • Building practical training, documentation and support pathways for end users

We’re looking for someone with strong experience in construction or development technology platforms, ideally Procore, and a good understanding of project delivery, cost management, systems integration and stakeholder enablement.

This role would suit someone who enjoys working close to the business, solving practical problems, improving systems and helping teams get more value from the tools they use every day.

Key requirements

  • Hands-on experience administering and configuring construction or development delivery platforms, ideally Procore
  • Strong understanding of construction or development project delivery, including budgets, commitments, variations, progress claims and cost coding / WBS
  • Experience supporting or implementing Procore Financials, or another project financial management platform
  • Confidence working across integrations, data flows, reporting and system governance
  • Experience managing software platforms, vendors, licensing, renewals, upgrades and user access
  • Ability to translate business needs into practical system configuration, process improvement and user support
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work closely with project teams, technology teams, vendors and consultants
  • Clear communication, training and documentation skills, with a practical approach to driving adoption
  • Exposure to BIM, document control, Autodesk, Revizto, Oracle Primavera Cloud, Bluebeam, SketchUp Pro or Power BI would be highly regarded
  • A self-directed, hands-on style with strong judgement, attention to detail and a continuous improvement mindset

  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Study assistance for postgraduate and undergraduate courses
  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Wellness program that focuses on the health and wellbeing, including exercise classes, meditation, yoga, social events, exclusive discounts, cooking classes, financial wellbeing seminars and more.

job.title: Configuration Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

Concepts, architects and integrates new products, components, or technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Researching and developing design parameters, performance characteristics, and technical specifications of new products and components.
  • Guiding the evolution of the technical design, technical project planning, performance analysis, and development testing. Participating in supplier selection and capabilities assessment.
  • Monitoring, exploring, and testing new technologies, materials, and components to understand product or process improvement opportunities.
  • Constructing and fabricating prototype equipment; overseeing materials selection, process optimization and process yield, as well as reliability testing and failure analysis.
  • Requires a degree in an accredited Engineering, Computer Science, or Materials Science curriculum.

Degree Requirement

Degree required

Skill Descriptors

Business Process Improvement: Knowledge of business process improvement best practices and ability to use methods for identifying, evaluating, introducing and implementing more efficient approaches to performing business related activities.

Planning: Tactical, Strategic: Knowledge of effective planning techniques and ability to contribute to operational (short term), tactical (1-2 years) and strategic (3-5 years) planning in support of the overall business plan.

Quality Management: Knowledge of quality management methods, tools, and techniques and ability to create and support an environment that meets the quality goals of the organization.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Systems Thinking: Knowledge of the critical interdependencies among individual system elements that help and hinder performance; ability to plan and design solutions that synchronize resources to achieve business results.

This position requires working onsite five days a week. Posting Dates:

August 26, 2026 - October 2, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: EHS Coordinator
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

To serve as an individual contributor on Environmental, Health and/or Safety (EHS) projects and assignments that support and enhance Caterpillar facility performance and compliance.

Responsibilities

  • Performs inspections and tests planned to monitor specific EHS issues, regulations and company practices.
  • Assists in training employees on EHS guidelines, company policies and procedures, and regulations pertaining to EHS.
  • Making and maintaining necessary EHS records according to established guidelines.
  • Contributes to the development of EHS policies and procedures.

Degree required

Skill Descriptors

Process Management: Knowledge of business process improvement tools and techniques; ability to understand, monitor, update, control, or enhance existing business or work processes.

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Influencing: Knowledge of effective influencing tactics and strategies; ability to impact decisions within and outside own organization.

Initiative: Being proactive and committing to action on self-identified job responsibilities and challenges; ability to seek out work and the drive to accomplish goals.

Managing Multiple Priorities: Knowledge of effective self-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) Policy Compliance: Knowledge of Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) policies; ability to implement EHS policies to ensure that provided products and services are safe for people and the environment and in compliance with legal requirements and standards.

This position requires working onsite five days a week. Posting Dates:

August 26, 2026 - September 25, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Chiller Team Leader - Perth
job.description:
Lead. Mentor. Stay Hands-On. Build the Future of HVAC Service in Perth.

$10,000 Sign-On Bonus Available for the Successful Candidate*

At Johnson Controls, we're shaping the environments where people live, work, learn, and thrive. As a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, we help customers optimize energy use, reduce carbon emissions, and improve operational performance across critical industries including data centres, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered innovative solutions that make a real difference. Backed by world-class technology, industry-leading products, and one of the strongest service networks in the world, we're committed to helping our customers succeed while creating outstanding career opportunities for our people.

Why Join Us?

With continued growth across Western Australia, we're seeking an experienced Service Team Leader – Chillers to lead our talented team of Technicians in Perth.

To help you make your next career move, we're offering a $10,000 sign-on bonus for the successful candidate.*

This role is also ideal for a senior Chiller Technician or Service Supervisor looking to take the next step into leadership while remaining hands-on and technically involved. You'll have the opportunity to influence how the team operates, develop future talent, and play a key role in expanding our Perth service business.

Thinking About Relocating to Perth?

If you're currently based interstate, this could be the career move you've been waiting for.

Perth offers an enviable lifestyle with world-class beaches, a lower cost of living than many eastern states, shorter commutes, abundant outdoor recreation, and a thriving economy. Combined with the opportunity to join a global organisation investing heavily in growth, this role offers both professional and personal rewards.

What's In It For You?

  • $10,000 sign-on bonus available for the successful candidate*
  • Join a business that's growing and investing in Perth
  • Lead a highly skilled and supportive team of Chiller Technicians
  • Stay hands-on with complex technical work while developing your leadership career
  • Competitive salary package plus paid overtime
  • Company vehicle or vehicle allowance, fuel card, E-Tag and tools of trade
  • Flexible work arrangements that support genuine work-life balance
  • Autonomy to make decisions and lead your team your way
  • Access to industry-leading technical support, training, and development programs
  • Clear career progression pathways across leadership, projects, operations, and technical specialist streams
  • Work with market-leading YORK chiller technology
  • Strong safety culture and a supportive team environment
  • Relocation support may be considered for the right candidate

The Opportunity

As Service Team Leader, you'll be responsible for driving service excellence, supporting your team, and ensuring customers receive exceptional outcomes. You'll combine technical expertise, people leadership, and operational oversight to deliver safe, efficient, and profitable service operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Chiller Technicians, apprentices, and subcontractors
  • Drive operational excellence across maintenance, repair, retrofit, and service activities
  • Provide senior-level technical expertise on YORK Chillers and related HVAC systems
  • Perform and oversee commissioning, troubleshooting, diagnostics, and preventive maintenance
  • Build strong customer relationships and identify opportunities to enhance service delivery
  • Support service project planning, scheduling, estimating, and resource allocation
  • Manage customer accounts and contribute to business growth initiatives
  • Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with company and industry standards
  • Partner with the Service Team Manager to support branch performance and operational goals

About You

You're a technically strong HVAC professional who enjoys leading from the front. You take pride in developing people, building customer relationships, and delivering high-quality outcomes.

Ideally, you'll bring:

  • Trade qualification in HVAC/Refrigeration or equivalent industry experience
  • Minimum 5 years' relevant industry experience (or 7 years without formal qualification)
  • Strong experience working on centrifugal, screw, or large commercial chillers
  • Demonstrated leadership or supervisory capability
  • Commercial awareness and sound business acumen
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications
  • A commitment to safety, quality, and customer service excellence

Ready for the Next Step?

If you're a skilled Chiller Technician ready to step into leadership, or an experienced Service Team Leader looking for a new challenge with a global industry leader, we'd love to hear from you.

Join a company that invests in your development, values your expertise, and provides the support, technology, and opportunities to build a rewarding long-term career.

Apply Today

Click APPLY NOW to join Johnson Controls and help shape the future of sustainable building solutions.

For a confidential discussion, please contact Janis Sotelo at janis.sotelo@jci.com

Build your future with Johnson Controls and be part of something bigger.

*Sign-on bonus subject to terms and conditions and payable in accordance with company policy.

#LI-JS4

job.title: Technical Account Manager – Data Centres
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) – Data Centre Thermal Solutions. This role serves as the primary technical interface between Johnson Controls and key Data Centre customers across the Pacific region, with a specific focus on chilled water plants, precision cooling, and advanced thermal management solutions.

The TAM provides deep technical leadership across chiller systems, liquid cooling, and thermal plant architectures, while also taking ownership of technical pricing strategy and bid development for complex opportunities. This ensures solutions are not only technically robust but also commercially competitive and aligned with customer value expectations.

A core element of the role is supporting the Strategic Account Manager (SAM) to drive commercial growth. The TAM brings thermal engineering expertise, early-stage cooling design influence, and bid/pricing leadership that strengthens Johnson Controls’ commercial strategies and opens new business opportunities.

Operating within a matrixed organisation, the TAM aligns technical, commercial, and delivery stakeholders to ensure chiller and cooling plant solutions are positioned, designed, priced, and delivered to win in a competitive market.

Key Responsibilities

Trusted Technical Advisor – Thermal Systems

  • Act as the trusted advisor for data centre cooling and thermal plant solutions, with a focus on chillers, CRAH/CRAC, and liquid cooling
  • Provide guidance on cooling strategies for hyperscale and high-density environments
  • Support customers in achieving resilience, redundancy, and energy efficiency targets

​

Solution Design & Architecture Governance

  • Lead the design of chilled water systems and central plant architecture
  • Develop integrated solutions covering chillers, pumps, heat rejection, and BMS integration
  • Own system performance, efficiency (PUE), and lifecycle optimisation
  • Identify and mitigate technical risks across capacity, redundancy, and control strategies

​

Early Engagement & Cooling Design Influence

  • Influence cooling plant design, chiller selection, and system architecture at pre-RFP stage
  • Lead Johnson Controls’ contribution to Basis of Design (BoD)
  • Position high-efficiency and next-gen cooling technologies within project designs

​

Pricing, Bid Management & Commercial Ownership

  • Own the technical pricing strategy for thermal solutions, including chilled water plants and liquid cooling systems
  • Lead and coordinate end-to-end bid development, ensuring alignment between engineering, procurement, and commercial teams
  • Develop accurate cost models, equipment selections, and solution configurations that balance performance, risk, and competitiveness
  • Drive value engineering to optimise cost while maintaining technical integrity and customer requirements
  • Ensure proposals clearly articulate total cost of ownership, energy efficiency savings, and lifecycle value
  • Support commercial negotiations by providing technical justification for scope, pricing, and solution differentiation
  • Maintain governance over bid quality, margin integrity, and risk management across all submissions

​

Opportunity & Technical Sales Support

  • Partner with SAMs on major pursuits from early-stage through award
  • Develop compelling technical and commercial value propositions
  • Support high-quality proposals with cooling system design, narratives, and performance insights

​

Market & Domain Expertise – Cooling

  • Maintain deep expertise in:

Chillers (air & water-cooled)

  • Free cooling and heat rejection
  • Liquid cooling (direct-to-chip, immersion)

Stay current with AI-driven high-density cooling demands and sustainability trends

​

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Align engineering, product, supply chain, and delivery teams
  • Support seamless handover ensuring clarity on thermal system design and performance expectations

​

Pipeline & Technical Governance

  • Build and qualify pipeline focused on cooling infrastructure opportunities
  • Ensure technical and commercial accuracy in CRM, pricing tools, and proposals
  • Maintain compliance with Johnson Controls governance standards

​

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering (preferred) or related discipline
  • 10+ years’ experience in HVAC/chiller systems and thermal plant solutions, ideally within data centres
  • Demonstrated experience in technical sales, bid management, and pricing of complex engineered solutions
  • Strong expertise in:

Chilled water systems and central plant design

  • Chiller selection and optimisation
  • Cooling strategies for high-density environments

Proven ability to develop competitive, technically sound, and commercially viable bids

Experience in cost modelling, value engineering, and margin management

Strong understanding of BMS/controls integration for thermal optimisation

Ability to influence consultants and customers at early design stages

Experience operating in matrix organisations across global stakeholders

Strong communication skills translating technical solutions into commercial value

High discipline in CRM and pipeline management (Salesforce preferred)

Self-driven, resilient, and effective in large, complex pursuit environments

If you are interested in this role, please click the Apply now button.

JCI’s Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. ​​​​​​ Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviours we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands

job.title: BMS Project Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team.

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What you will do

Acts as on-site project leader to plan, execute, and complete assigned projects. Delegates tasks to execute and fully complete assigned projects. Coordinates communication with customer during all phases of the project. Coordinates the work of subcontractors.

How you will do it:

job.title: Project Coordinator & Document Controller
job.description:
Shape the Future of Smart Buildings with Johnson Controls

At Johnson Controls (JCI), we're transforming the way buildings operate. As a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable building solutions, we empower organisations to reduce energy consumption, enhance occupant experiences, strengthen security, improve operational resilience, and accelerate their sustainability ambitions.

With over 140 years of innovation, Johnson Controls has partnered with customers across commercial buildings, healthcare, data centres, education, advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and critical infrastructure. Today, our leading technology, digital solutions, and service expertise are helping create the next generation of intelligent buildings.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

  • Permanent, full-time position based in Brisbane
  • Competitive salary package and employee benefits
  • Ongoing training, professional development, and career progression opportunities
  • Join a globally recognised industry leader with a strong project pipeline
  • Be part of a collaborative, high-performing team delivering impactful projects

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Document Controller / Project Coordinator to support the successful delivery of building technology and engineering projects. Working closely with Project Managers, engineers, customers, and vendors, you will play a critical role in maintaining accurate project documentation, ensuring compliance, and supporting project execution from start to completion.

This role is ideal for someone with previous experience in construction, engineering, building services, industrial, OEM, EPC, or project-based environments who thrives in a fast-paced setting and enjoys being at the centre of project delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Document Control

  • Manage project documentation in accordance with JCI and client requirements.
  • Maintain document control processes, including document registration, distribution, revision control, tracking, and archiving.
  • Ensure accurate version control, document registers, transmittals, and compliance with project procedures.
  • Coordinate document submissions and information flow between project teams, clients, subcontractors, and suppliers.
  • Prepare project handover documentation, including O&M manuals and project dossiers.
  • Maintain and administer document management platforms such as SharePoint, Aconex, TeamBinder, or similar systems.

Project Coordination

  • Support Project Managers with tracking project deliverables, milestones, and documentation schedules.
  • Coordinate document reviews, approvals, and stakeholder feedback processes.
  • Manage vendor documentation requirements and proactively follow up outstanding submissions.
  • Assist with project reporting, KPI tracking, and maintaining accurate project records.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance project efficiency and compliance.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will bring:

  • Proven experience in Document Control, Project Administration, or Project Coordination within engineering, construction, building services, industrial, OEM, or EPC environments.
  • Strong knowledge of document control principles, revision management, and transmittal processes.
  • Experience using document management systems such as Aconex, SharePoint, TeamBinder, Procore, or equivalent platforms.
  • The ability to manage large volumes of technical documentation with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.
  • Excellent organisational, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach and the ability to manage competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment.

Build Your Future with Johnson Controls

If you're looking to join a global organisation where your expertise will directly contribute to the successful delivery of innovative building and infrastructure projects, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of a team that is shaping the future of smart, sustainable buildings across Australia.

job.title: Sr Developer - Enterprise integration
job.description:
Title: Lead Integration Developer

Exp: 9–12 Years

Role Summary

A strategic and hands-on Integration Leader responsible for driving end-to-end delivery of enterprise integration solutions. Ensures alignment with enterprise architecture, leads technical design (HLD/LLD), and builds high-performing teams while leveraging modern cloud, AI, and Copilot-enabled development capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Integration Architecture & Delivery

  • Own and lead end-to-end integration solution design and delivery across complex enterprise programs.
  • Define and implement integration architectures, API strategies, and reusable frameworks aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Create, review, and govern High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs) ensuring scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Drive architecture governance, technical design reviews, and best practices adoption.

Azure Integration Services Implementation

  • Lead development using Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory, and broader Azure Integration Services.
  • Design highly resilient, secure, and scalable workflows and orchestrations.

API Management & Governance

  • Design, publish, secure, and monitor APIs via Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Drive enterprise API governance, lifecycle management, versioning, and security standards.

Messaging & Event-Driven Architecture

  • Build and implement event-driven and asynchronous architectures using Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, and Event Hubs.
  • Champion loosely coupled, scalable integration patterns.

Hybrid Integration

  • Architect and implement integrations between on-premises systems and cloud platforms, ensuring seamless and reliable connectivity.

AI & Copilot-Driven Engineering

  • Leverage Microsoft Copilot (GitHub Copilot, M365 Copilot) to improve developer productivity, accelerate code development, and enhance solution quality.
  • Utilize Generative AI for:Automated code generation, refactoring, and documentation (LLDs, API specs)
  • Intelligent workflow design and optimization
  • AI-assisted debugging, testing, and root cause analysis

Integrate AI-powered services (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services) within integration solutions to enable intelligent data processing and decision-making.Promote AI-first engineering practices, including prompt engineering and responsible AI usage.Monitoring, Security & Compliance

  • Implement end-to-end observability using Cribl.
  • Ensure secure data handling, compliance, and governance across integration solutions.

Technical & Team Leadership

  • Provide strong technical leadership and direction across teams.
  • Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and enforce engineering standards.
  • Mentor team members, enabling skill development in integration, cloud, and AI technologies.
  • Manage technical risks, escalations, and critical design decisions.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, architects, business stakeholders, and vendors.
  • Align technology solutions with business goals and enterprise strategy.
  • Build and nurture a high-performing, collaborative, and innovation-driven integration team.

Required Skills

  • Experience: 9–12+ years in software engineering with strong focus on cloud and iPaaS integrations.
  • Azure Expertise: Deep hands-on experience with Azure Integration Services (AIS).
  • Development Skills: Strong proficiency in C#, .NET, REST/SOAP APIs, JSON, XML.
  • Design Skills: Extensive experience in LLD/HLD creation, architecture design, and solution documentation.
  • API Expertise: Strong experience in API architecture, governance, and lifecycle management.
  • Integration Patterns: Expertise in event-driven, microservices, and hybrid integration architectures.
  • AI & Copilot Skills: (Good to have)Hands-on usage of GitHub Copilot / M365 Copilot for development acceleration
  • Understanding of prompt engineering and AI-assisted development workflows
  • Exposure to Azure OpenAI / AI services integration

Delivery Experience: Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise integration delivery.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with MuleSoft architecture / coexistence strategies.
  • Exposure to advanced AI/ML integration use cases and intelligent automation.
  • Knowledge of data transformation standards (EDI, XML, JSON) and large-scale data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with AI governance, ethics, and secure AI adoption in enterprises.

Preferred Certifications

  • Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
  • Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204)
  • DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)
  • (Good to have) Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)

job.description:
Job Description

Service Engineer – HVAC Chillers

Experience 3–8 years

###

Education

Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Engineering

Job Summary

The Service Engineer – HVAC Chillers is responsible for installation support, preventive maintenance, breakdown service, troubleshooting, and overhauling of HVAC chiller systems. The role ensures optimal performance, reliability, energy efficiency, and customer satisfaction across assigned customer sites.

###

Key Responsibilities

Installation & Commissioning

  • ### Support installation, commissioning, and start-up of air-cooled and water-cooled chillers
  • ### Verify system compliance with design specifications and safety standards
  • ### Coordinate with project teams, contractors, and customers during commissioning

Service & Maintenance

job.title: Development Engineer – Embedded Software, Firmware (PAGA/PAVA Systems)
job.description:

OpenBlue: [This is How a Space Comes Alive](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bFbZIj0Sj6Y)

What will you do?

  • Design and implement C/C++ software for (bare-metal and RTOS) embedded devices to be used in safety related Public Address / General Alarm systems.
  • Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded C / C++ firmware for STM32-based control and communication modules.
  • Implement low-level software for microcontroller peripherals, memory handling, interrupt management, watchdogs, boot behaviour, and hardware abstraction.
  • Support board bring-up, integration, debugging, and validation of new embedded platforms.
  • Development of engineering interpretations of product standards.
  • Create test plans and perform verification and validation activities.
  • Author documentation for software architecture, interface control, test plans.
  • Develop algorithms for digital audio streaming, routing and processing.
  • Implement communication protocols using Ethernet, LonTalk, RS232, RS485 and RS422.
  • Contribute to software quality MISRA C/C++, static analysis, configuration management, code reviews, development of unit and integration tests.
  • Collaborate with the estimation, production, commissioning and projects departments to derive requirements, and time scales for delivery of system solutions.
  • Mentor less experienced engineers.
  • Maintain older product: Defect rectification, bespoke solutions to meet customer requirements, solutions to hardware obsolescence.

What we look for?

  • Support the migration of legacy Echelon / CPM5000 communication and control functions to a new embedded architecture.
  • Analyse existing legacy behaviour and develop equivalent or improved implementations on STM32-based platforms.
  • Help define the migration path for LonTalk-related stack behaviour, node communications, and interoperability requirements.
  • Contribute to long-term removal of obsolete components and reduction of platform dependency risk.
  • Integrate firmware with higher-level software modules, communication stacks, diagnostics, and application functions used in PAGA / PAVA systems.
  • Support interaction between physical layer interfaces, node communications, and application-layer functions used for alarm, paging, routing, monitoring, and supervision.
  • Ensure effective transfer of amplifier and field-device fault information back to system nodes and controllers.
  • Audio & Life-Safety Functional Support
  • Support embedded functions related to 100V line audio systems, amplifier supervision, fault monitoring, and status reporting.
  • Develop software mechanisms for continuous system health checking, fault detection, and reporting.
  • Support deterministic and reliable behaviour required for critical alarm and public address functions.
  • Verification, Debug & Product Support
  • Investigate and resolve issues arising from development, manufacturing, commissioning, and field service.
  • Use structured testing, logging, and diagnostic methods to validate firmware performance and robustness.
  • Support regression testing and change control for product releases.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with hardware engineers, project engineers, manufacturing, test, and service teams.
  • Support design reviews, system architecture activities, and issue resolution across the product lifecycle.
  • Contribute to documentation required for product introduction, controlled change, validation, and support.

What we offer:

We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents

job.title: EHS Engineer
job.description:
Who we are:

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What you will do:

As an EHS Engineer, you will support the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of the company's Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) programs and management systems. You will work closely with project teams, subcontractors, clients, and internal stakeholders to ensure compliance with company EHS standards, legal requirements, and customer expectations, while promoting a safe and healthy working environment across all assigned sites.

How you will do it:

  • Implement and maintain the company's EHS Management System, including ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 requirements, ensuring all EHS documentation, records, procedures, permits, and registers are accurately maintained and kept up to date.
  • Monitor compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, customer, and company EHS requirements by conducting workplace inspections, site assessments, and compliance reviews, and supporting regulatory inspections and customer audits.
  • Support project teams, subcontractors, and stakeholders in managing workplace risks through the development, review, and implementation of Risk Assessments (RA), Safe Work Procedures (SWP), Method Statements, and other risk control measures.
  • Investigate accidents, near misses, dangerous occurrences, occupational illnesses, and environmental incidents, prepare investigation reports, identify root causes, and follow up on corrective and preventive actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Coordinate and participate in EHS audits and assessments, including ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ConSASS, Global CAP, internal audits, customer audits, and other EHS evaluations, while ensuring timely closure of audit findings and non-conformities.
  • Plan, coordinate, and support EHS training and awareness programs, including employee orientation, toolbox meetings, safety briefings, contractor training, and safety campaigns to promote a strong safety culture and workforce competency.
  • Monitor EHS performance indicators and incident statistics, analyse trends, prepare reports, and provide recommendations to improve EHS performance, compliance, and operational effectiveness.
  • Support the implementation of emergency preparedness and response programs, including fire prevention activities, emergency response planning, evacuation exercises, and emergency drills to enhance readiness and effectiveness.
  • Work closely with internal and external stakeholders, including project teams, subcontractors, clients, suppliers, and regulatory authorities, to ensure alignment with EHS requirements and promote continuous improvement in workplace safety and environmental performance.
  • Provide day-to-day EHS support to assigned projects and workplaces, including identifying unsafe conditions and behaviours, recommending corrective measures, stopping work where there is imminent danger, supporting EHS committee activities, and performing other EHS-related duties as assigned by management.

What we look for:

  • Degree or Diploma in Environmental, Health & Safety, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Registered Workplace Safety and Health Officer (WSHO) and Environment Control Officer (ECO) certification.
  • Familiarity with ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems.
  • Experience in construction, engineering, HVAC, facility management, or related industries is an advantage.
  • Strong communication, investigation, problem-solving, audit and stakeholder management skills.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

job.description:
Shape the Future of Smart, Secure Buildings with Johnson Controls

At Johnson Controls (JCI), we're transforming the way buildings perform. Design and deliver cutting-edge Security, Access Control, and CCTV systems across some of Australia's most complex and high-profile projects.

Access world-class training, ongoing professional development, and clear career pathways within a truly global organisation.

Help create safer, smarter, and more connected environments for customers and communities across Australia.

  • Be Part of a Global Innovator

Join a business with more than 140 years of engineering excellence and a strong commitment to technology, sustainability, and innovation.

  • About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Project Engineer - Security to join our VIC Projects team based in Scoresby.

This is an exciting opportunity for a technically capable engineer who thrives on delivering integrated security solutions and enjoys working across design, project delivery, commissioning, and customer engagement.

You will play a key role in the successful delivery of Security, Access Control, and CCTV projects, ensuring solutions meet customer requirements, industry regulations, and Johnson Controls' quality and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, engineer, configure, and commission Security, Access Control, and CCTV systems across a range of projects.
  • Develop technical solutions using both Johnson Controls and third-party security platforms.
  • Conduct software configuration, testing, and commissioning activities to ensure compliance with customer specifications and quality standards.
  • Provide expert technical support and troubleshooting for complex security systems and networked environments.
  • Collaborate closely with customers, project managers, sales teams, and technicians throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Support project execution by monitoring scope, schedules, budgets, and customer satisfaction.
  • Assist with system upgrades, enhancements, and future-proof security solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, technicians, and apprentices.
  • Support engineering and sales teams with technical recommendations, system layouts, and bid proposals.
  • Champion workplace safety and maintain full compliance with Johnson Controls' Safety, Health & Environment Management System (SHEMS).

About You

We're looking for a motivated and customer-focused Security Project Engineer who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for delivering high-quality outcomes.

You Will Bring:

  • 3-5 years' experience in a Project Engineer, Security Engineer, or similar role.
  • Experience designing and delivering Security, Access Control, and CCTV solutions.
  • Strong BIM and CAD design capabilities.
  • Understanding of networked security systems, IT infrastructure, servers, and system integration.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • A proactive, safety-first mindset with a commitment to quality delivery.

Highly Regarded:

  • Victorian Security Licence.
  • Experience working on large-scale commercial, healthcare, industrial, education, or critical infrastructure projects.
  • Exposure to integrated building technologies and smart building solutions.

Ready to Secure the Future?

If you're looking to work on innovative security projects, develop your career with a global industry leader, and be part of a high-performing team, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and join Johnson Controls in creating smarter, safer, and more sustainable buildings.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Johnson Controls, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and better outcomes for our customers and communities. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their best. Regardless of your background, identity, or experience, you'll have the opportunity to grow, succeed, and make a meaningful impact.

Your voice matters. Your ideas matter. Your future starts here.

job.title: Senior Project Manager - Applied
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Role Summary

The Senior Manager – Applied Projects will be responsible for managing a portfolio of HVAC and chiller projects in Gujarat, ensuring successful execution in line with project commitments related to cost, schedule, quality, revenue, and customer satisfaction. The role involves close coordination with project teams, customers, and internal stakeholders to drive project performance and timely closure.

Key Responsibilities

Project Portfolio Management

  • Manage and monitor a portfolio of 50–70 HVAC/chiller projects of varying sizes and execution stages.
  • Track project progress and ensure adherence to established project management processes and milestones.
  • Conduct regular project reviews and follow up on action plans to ensure timely execution.

Planning, Monitoring & Risk Management

  • Monitor project budgets, forecasts, and financial performance throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Identify, track, and report project risks, opportunities, and issues in a timely manner.
  • Maintain project risk registers and issue logs and work with stakeholders to drive resolution.
  • Escalate critical concerns and support implementation of mitigation plans.

Project Execution

  • Ensure project execution is aligned with key performance parameters:Cost
  • Schedule
  • Quality
  • Revenue
  • Customer Expectations

Support project teams in resolving execution challenges and achieving project objectives.Drive timely progression of projects through defined toll gates and closure processes.

Customer & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Maintain regular communication with customers, consultants, contractors, and internal teams.
  • Monitor customer commitments and ensure timely closure of pending actions.
  • Assist in resolving project-related issues to maintain customer satisfaction.

Team Management

  • Guide project managers and execution teams in meeting project deliverables.
  • Provide support in planning, monitoring, and resolving operational challenges.
  • Promote adherence to company processes, compliance requirements, and best practices.

Commercial & Operational Controls

Support project teams in ensuring:

  • Schedule baseline approvals from customers during HOTO.
  • Deliveries and project milestones are achieved as per agreed schedules.
  • Revenue realization is in line with approved forecasts.
  • Timely invoicing and collection of payments.
  • Unbilled Revenue (UBR) remains within acceptable limits.
  • Accurate project status reporting and forecasting.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 10–15 years of experience in HVAC, chiller, or related project execution roles.
  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a customer-facing environment.
  • Good understanding of project management principles, including budgeting, planning, scheduling, and risk management.
  • Strong coordination, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to analyze project performance and take corrective actions where required.
  • Proficiency in project planning and reporting tools.
  • Should have managed 5-10 engineers/ managers in his present/ past roles.

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • On-time project completion.
  • Revenue achievement against forecast.
  • Gross margin performance.
  • Collection and receivables management.
  • UBR control.
  • Quality and customer satisfaction metrics.
  • Timely closure of project risks and issues.
