job.title: Senior HVAC Service Technician
job.description:
Join a Global HVAC Leader Delivering Critical Infrastructure Solutions

At Johnson Controls, we're shaping the future of smart, sustainable buildings. As a global leader in HVAC, building automation, energy efficiency, and decarbonization solutions, we help some of Australia's most important facilities operate at peak performance.

From data centres, healthcare facilities and pharmaceutical manufacturing plants to universities and commercial buildings, our technology and expertise keep mission-critical environments running safely, efficiently, and sustainably.

With more than 140 years of industry leadership, Johnson Controls combines global innovation with local expertise to deliver world-class outcomes for our customers and exceptional career opportunities for our people.

Due to continued growth across Western Australia, we're seeking an experienced Senior HVAC Service Technician to join our high-performing Perth Service Team.

Why Make the Move to Johnson Controls?

This is more than another service role. It's an opportunity to work with leading HVAC technologies, high-profile clients, and a business that genuinely invests in your long-term career.

What's on Offer:

  • $5,000 Sign-On Bonus
  • Industry-Leading Technology
  • Work on premium HVAC equipment, building automation systems, chillers, and critical plant across diverse commercial environments.
  • Autonomy & Variety
  • Manage your own portfolio of service work across a broad range of sites, with the freedom to plan your day and make decisions.
  • Work-Life Balance
  • We understand flexibility matters. Our people are trusted to deliver results while maintaining a healthy balance between work and home life.
  • Career Development & Training
  • Access structured technical training, manufacturer certifications, leadership pathways, and opportunities within a global organisation.
  • Strong Technical Support
  • Be backed by experienced engineers, remote technical specialists, and one of the industry's most established service networks.
  • Global Stability, Local Team Culture
  • Enjoy the security and resources of a market-leading multinational, combined with the support and camaraderie of a close-knit local team.

About the Role

As a Senior HVAC Service Technician, you'll play a key role in delivering exceptional service to our customers while working on a wide range of commercial HVAC and refrigeration systems.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Preventative and routine maintenance of commercial HVAC equipment
  • Advanced fault finding, diagnostics, repairs, and overhauls
  • Commissioning and optimisation of HVAC systems
  • Small commercial installations and upgrade works
  • Reading and interpreting plans and technical drawings
  • Servicing equipment ranging from package units through to chillers and central plant systems

  • Current Australian Driver's Licence
  • Excellent fault-finding and troubleshooting capability
  • Strong communication skills and a customer-first approach
  • The ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment

A Culture Where You Can Thrive

At Johnson Controls, inclusion, innovation, and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do. We value diverse perspectives, support continuous learning, and empower our people to make an impact.

Whether your career goal is to become a technical expert, move into leadership, or explore opportunities across our global business, we'll provide the support and development to help you get there.

Ready for Your Next Career Move?

Apply today and discover why experienced HVAC professionals choose Johnson Controls to build their careers.

job.title: Application Engineer I
job.description:
Job Description

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

We are a Great Place To Work-Certified organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

What you will do

The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Fire Detection System global projects as per country specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction. Maintain project quality, on time delivery and manage escalations.

How you will do it

  • Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project.
  • Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Fire Detection System
  • Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting.
  • Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget.
  • Creation of bill of material, selection of Backend, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Fire Detection System.
  • Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc.
  • Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction.
  • Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences.
  • Provides coaching and professional development to team members in order to enhance their product knowledge, technical acumen, and technical sales skills to bridge the gap.
  • Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects.
  • Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
  • Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.
  • Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives

What we look for

  • BE/ME (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication).
  • Strong knowledge of Fire Detection System
  • Expertise in NFPA / BS 5839/EN/ FM.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.),Blue Beam.
  • Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.

Preferred

8 to 12 years of relevant experience in Fire Detection System.

Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit [www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou).

job.title: HVAC Equipment Systems Technician 2
job.description:
Who we are

About Johnson Controls

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services, and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results, and help move society forward.

Visit [johnsoncontrols.com](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/) for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms.

Job Description Summary

Performs direct field labor activities under the guidance of Team Leaders and Managers to support project delivery and service operations. Responsible for the installation, setup, configuration, and commissioning of HVAC equipment and control systems using established processes and standards. Provides operational support by applying troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve system issues, while assisting senior technicians in field service activities. Supports Operations & Maintenance (O&M) field activities as required to ensure customer satisfaction and system reliability.

What You Will Do

  • Execute field installation, startup, configuration, and commissioning activities for HVAC equipment and related control systems.
  • Support project delivery teams in implementing HVAC solutions in accordance with engineering specifications and project requirements.
  • Assist in troubleshooting and resolving equipment, controls, and system-related issues at customer sites.
  • Perform testing and verification of system performance to ensure proper functionality and compliance with project standards.
  • Support preventive and corrective maintenance activities under O&M contracts.
  • Work collaboratively with customers, contractors, and internal teams during project execution and service delivery.
  • Maintain accurate service records, commissioning reports, and project documentation.
  • Follow all Johnson Controls safety procedures, quality standards, and operational processes.

How You Will Do It

  • Utilize standard commissioning and configuration tools to install and start up HVAC systems.
  • Diagnose equipment and control system issues using established troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Assist senior technicians with system integration, testing, and customer demonstrations.
  • Coordinate field activities with project stakeholders to support timely project completion.
  • Escalate complex technical issues to Team Leaders or Managers when required.
  • Ensure customer concerns are addressed promptly and professionally.

What We Look For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related field with 1+ year of relevant experience; OR
  • Diploma/Associate Degree (2-year degree) in a related technical discipline with 6+ years of relevant experience; OR
  • Equivalent combination of education and industry experience.
  • Basic to intermediate knowledge of HVAC equipment, control systems, and field commissioning practices.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, and project documentation.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication and customer interaction skills.
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Building Management Systems (BMS) or HVAC controls.
  • Knowledge of HVAC commissioning, maintenance, and service operations.
  • Familiarity with industry communication protocols and control system integration.
  • Experience working in a customer-facing field service environment.

Engineering Manager I – Hardware In this role, you will be part of product development team to manage and deliver new product functionalities, modify existing product’s functionalities, or improve product functionalities as required. The Engineering Manager I - Hardware will provide general supervision and technical guidance to the Embedded HW development group in the design, development and test of HW product Development for Fire detection systems. You will work within a multi-disciplined engineering team consisting of electronics engineers, mechanical engineers, PCB Layout design engineers, Manufacturing, suppliers and supply chain firmware engineers, software engineers, programmers and scientists focusing on applied research and new technology innovations to provide new and improved products and solutions for our customers.

How will you do it

-

  • Define department goals and objectives and communicate these to the staff.
  • Responsible for owning the Product Functional Specification of the product and associated technical documentation and communication with Regulatory teams and manufacturing teams
  • Work closely with members of cross-functional teams (analog, digital, RF, Mechanical, PCB Layout, Software, PV&V)
  • Hands-on experience with Microcontroller and Microprocessor based embedded design and development; Good technical skills in DFMEA, VA/VE, DFM, DFT, Failure and Root cause analysis
  • Also supervises HW Team/Technical Leads and designers in the design, development and testing of HW Design and products as per program within the specific timeframes required.
  • Manages department and overall expectations pertaining to ensuring optimum use of resources and administers and monitors use against budget
  • Ensures delivery against HW development department goals and objectives, i.e. meeting commitments and coordinating overall product development schedule.
  • Manages the planning and execution of development, including all associated resources to meet committed delivery dates.
  • Ensures estimations of efforts and schedules for various programs based on resource competency, resource availability.
  • Drives KPIs to ensure first time right, no efforts and schedule variance.
  • Effectively communicate program status to Functional and business leaders.
  • Provides effective communication regarding issues, objectives, initiatives and performance to plan
  • Works with Project/program Managers to develop project schedules and resource allocation models for Hardware development.
  • Liaise with Embedded Firmware, SW, Verification and Validation in the development of quality review of products under development.
  • Liaise with other functional manager –EMB FW, PC SW, V&V, Design office and program managers.
  • Participates in the evaluation of hardware and software compatibility recommending program specifications.
  • Recommends program refinements and changes to better achieve desired functionality and/or enhance program capabilities. Counsels’ designers in the use of various design tools.
  • Facilitate and ensures individual and team roles and responsibilities are understood; performance measurement objectives are identified, measured and monitored on an ongoing basis to provide feedback and take necessary action to address shortfalls. Involved in employment issues, such as staffing, termination and employee relations issues.
  • Ensures a positive work environment and awareness by all staff of company goals and objectives.
  • Make recommendations regarding verification and validation procedures and processes to improve the quality of the team(s) and hardware group.
  • Follows and ensures workplace operating and environmental, health and safety procedures and guidelines compliance.

What we look for

-

  • Thorough knowledge of applicable HW design and development practice; design
  • techniques, systems, and platforms.
  • - Excellent problem solving, interpersonal communication and project management skills a
  • must.
  • - Strong leadership skills inspire team confidence and respect while motivating team
  • members in a creative and effective manner.
  • - Must have a desire to achieve excellence in customer satisfaction, process and product
  • quality and reliability.
  • - Strong understanding of different embedded product development life cycles (waterfall,
  • iterative) and contemporary HW design assurance processes and automated tools.
  • - Must have experience in managing and working with distributed team members.
  • - Knowledge of internet and e-business processes, disciplines and standards

-

  • Must be extremely detail-oriented with respect to documentation and communication

Preferred

-

  • BE/BTech/ME/MTech (ECE/EIE/ETC/CSE) Degree in a technical field is required.
  • - 14+ yrs experience on Hardware end to end product design along with 3+ years in
  • managerial experience

-

  • Experience in leading Hardware Product Development for Industrial Product.
  • - Knowledge of regulatory standards for EN and UL for industrial products.

What we offer

We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents

Diversity & Inclusion Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate.  Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors

job.title: Senior Project Engineer
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

##

Role - Project Engineer - IBMS, Mumbai (1-Year Contract Role)

Johnson Controls delivers innovative building technologies that support smarter, healthier, and more sustainable environments. In this role, you will support project execution and project management activities for IBMS delivery in Mumbai, with hands-on involvement in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS.

This is a one-year contractual opportunity, renewable annually based on performance. It is well suited to candidates with a strong background in project execution or project management and practical experience in IBMS site delivery.

Role Overview

As a Project Engineer, you will help drive the execution of IBMS projects from planning through site delivery, coordination, testing, and handover. You will work closely with internal teams, contractors, vendors, and stakeholders to help ensure work is delivered safely, on time, and to the expected technical and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support end-to-end execution of IBMS projects, including CCTV and ACS systems.
  • Coordinate with project managers, site teams, contractors, vendors, and clients to support smooth project delivery.
  • Monitor site progress against project plans, timelines, and execution requirements.
  • Review technical drawings, specifications, and work instructions to support installation readiness and site execution.
  • Track material availability, site requirements, and execution dependencies to help avoid delays.
  • Support installation, testing, commissioning, and handover activities for IBMS systems.
  • Raise and follow up on site issues, technical concerns, and coordination gaps in a timely manner.
  • Prepare and maintain project documentation, progress updates, and handover records.
  • Support quality checks and help ensure work is completed in line with project and safety expectations.

How You Will Do It

  • Stay close to the site execution work and understand what is needed to keep IBMS delivery moving forward.
  • Own tasks and follow-ups with accountability, integrity, and a clear focus on delivering the right outcome.
  • Use practical problem-solving and candid communication to remove obstacles and improve execution every day.
  • Work as one team with project management, engineering, vendors, and site stakeholders, building trust through collaboration and shared standards.
  • Keep documentation, progress tracking, and coordination updates accurate so that work remains visible and controllable.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Background in project execution or project management within IBMS projects.
  • Hands-on experience in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS.
  • Experience supporting site-based project delivery, installation, testing, commissioning, or handover activities.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and site documentation.
  • Strong coordination, communication, and follow-up skills.
  • Good problem-solving mindset with attention to quality and execution detail.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to large-scale commercial, infrastructure, or facility-related projects.
  • Experience coordinating with multiple contractors and vendors on active project sites.
  • Additional exposure to integrated building systems or ELV project environments.

Why Join Us

This role gives you the opportunity to build strong IBMS project delivery experience with a global leader in smart and sustainable building solutions. You will gain hands-on exposure to project execution, strengthen your domain knowledge in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS, and contribute to meaningful work in a performance-based contractual role.

If you are ready to bring your project execution or project management experience to a hands-on IBMS role in Mumbai, we encourage you to apply.

Under general direction, responsible for the sale of large, complex, bundled offerings with guaranteed savings to high potential, solution sales customers at the C-level.

Promote the JCI value proposition at the executive level by providing solutions to the customer’s business and financial challenges.

Builds and manages long term customer relationships/partnerships with key and target building owners. Responsible for customer satisfaction.

Executes the sales process to aid in cultivating and managing long-term relationships and in seeking out, qualifying and closing new sales and guaranteed savings opportunities.

Leverage monthly checkpoints to gain progressive commitments from the customer.Seeks to expand the depth and breadth of offerings within that account through Upselling .

Positions renewable service agreements and guaranteed savings as the foundation of managed account relationships.

JOB PROFILE :-

  • Sell the JCI offerings persuasively, persistently and confidently to building owners and owner representatives at the Executive Level while reaching optimal profit levels. Particularly focusing on selling performance contracting while ensuring that we achieve maximize share of customers business. Focuses on demonstrating value at the executive level by providing solutions to business and financial challenges as well as working through gateways to achieve win-win status.

Understands and leverages sales process checkpoints as well as demonstrates evidence of gaining small trial closes and commitments. Qualifies and assesses potential customers. Refers leads to other business segments.
  • Addresses customer's financial, business, operational and environmental objectives, needs and requirements. Recommends solutions that match the customer’s business and financial challenges. Differentiates JCI services and products from competitors based on business benefits and knowledge of competitor’s business strategies.
  • Effectively writes, presents and communicates proposals. Secures major opportunities through the use of financial agreements. Negotiates value, addresses resistance when demonstrated, and closes the sale.
  • Utilizes applicable sales tools effectively (Salesforce) to plan and document progress as well as increase business opportunity in accounts. Leverages JCI sales process monthly checkpoints to gain progressive commitments from the customer. Manages the sales process steps of the pipeline with a focus on completing the Opportunity Action plan and meeting the milestones in the customer’s buying process.
  • Extensive Interaction with the Service Sales team by building and fostering team relationships to ensure customer satisfaction. Owns and facilitates the customer relationship particularly when selling Performance Contracting initiatives.

Preferred

job.title: Head Of Compliance, India
job.description:
Head Of Compliance, India

Johnson Controls is a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization. We help customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services, and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results, and help move society forward.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly qualified compliance leader to head the India compliance agenda and support the continued development of our ethics and compliance program. Reporting to the Chief Ethics and Compliance Officer, this role is a key member of the Compliance Leadership Team and works closely with senior business management, Finance, Human Resources, the Law Department, Regional Compliance Counsels, and global compliance experts.

The role is responsible for strengthening compliance culture, supporting anti-corruption and fair competition efforts, and ensuring practical, effective controls across India.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain effective communication with senior management in India on compliance matters and support programs that strengthen tone at the top and the Speak Up culture.
  • Identify regional compliance risks and design focused training, communications, and program initiatives to address them.
  • Review and approve third-party due diligence, high-risk payment transactions, and employee-disclosed conflicts of interest relating to India.
  • Organize and facilitate India Compliance Committee meetings with senior business leaders and stakeholders from Finance, Legal, and HR.
  • Support internal investigations led by the Forensics team and oversee remediation and disciplinary processes, including escalation to the Disciplinary Sub-Committee where appropriate.
  • Direct internal investigations conducted under legal privilege, with focus on anti-corruption, anti-trust, and other regulatory risks.
  • Respond promptly to detected offenses and work with the Chief Ethics and Compliance Officer, Regional Compliance Counsels, local leadership, Human Resources, and local counsel to define corrective actions.
  • Support M&A due diligence and post-acquisition integration activities in India.
  • Lead or co-lead projects with senior management to strengthen program design and reduce compliance exposure across the country.
  • Support corruption-risk assessments, fair competition reviews, anti-corruption compliance audits, and targeted risk assessments of business units.
  • Develop and monitor plans to implement policies, procedures, and standards of conduct throughout the country.
  • Help maintain a data-driven, proactive monitoring program for customers, vendors, and employee transactions.
  • Provide day-to-day guidance and support to employees across India on a wide range of compliance issues.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of the compliance program through updated policies, training, communications, data analytics, monitoring, and other initiatives.

How You Will Do It

  • Own the India compliance agenda with accountability, integrity, and a clear focus on doing the right thing.
  • Stay close to the business, remove obstacles quickly, and translate legal and regulatory requirements into practical solutions.
  • Use candid dialogue, data, and sound judgment to improve programs every day and respond effectively to emerging risks.
  • Work as one team with Finance, HR, Legal, Forensics, regional counsels, and business leaders to deliver consistent outcomes.
  • Apply disciplined follow-through on investigations, remediation, disciplinary actions, monitoring, and reporting so commitments become measurable action.

Qualifications

  • 15 or more years of related compliance experience, preferably within a multinational corporation.
  • Knowledge of the legal and regulatory framework in India.
  • Ability to work effectively within a team framework, in a matrixed organization, and across multiple cultures.
  • Proficiency with word processing and data processing programs, especially Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to relate comfortably at all levels of an organization.
  • Ability to lead, inspire, and manage effectively with unquestioned integrity.
  • Self-motivation and the ability to manage and prioritize a significant workload.
  • Ability to understand commercial objectives and solve complex problems in a practical way.
  • Ability to meet challenges confidently and react ethically, quickly, and helpfully in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

  • Law degree.
  • Audit background.

Why Join Us

At Johnson Controls, your work helps protect trust, strengthen our culture, and support responsible growth in a business that serves critical industries around the world. You will have the opportunity to partner across functions, influence programs with real enterprise impact, and contribute to a global organization committed to performance, resilience, and decarbonization.

If you are ready to lead with integrity and help shape the future of compliance in India, we invite you to apply.

job.title: Sr E&IC Engineer
job.description:
Who we are?

##

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

## For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

##

What will you do?

We are looking for a hands‑on EC\&I Controls & Automation Engineer with a strong software bias, specifically in PLC programming, HMI development, and secure automation systems. This role strengthens our control and automation software capability within the India team, which is already strong in instrumentation and EC&I design. The objective of this role is to add depth in control and automation software, including PLC/HMI implementation, Cause & Effect logic, control philosophy development, and OT cybersecurity‑aware IEC 62443 system design requirements. This is a technical delivery role, not project management. The engineer will support oil & gas and process automation systems, including Hydraulic Power Units (HPU), CAFS, INERT / gas‑based fire suppression systems, and other safety‑critical control applications.

  • ## PLC, HMI & Automation Software (Primary Responsibility)
  • ## ➢ Develop, test, and maintain PLC programs using Siemens TIA Portal.
  • ## ➢ Design and implement HMI applications using WinCC / WinCC Unified.
  • ## ➢ Implement control sequences, interlocks, permissive, alarms, trips, and shutdown logic.
  • ## ➢ Develop, review, and execute Cause & Effect (C\&E) matrices and ensure correct implementation in PLC logic and HMI behavior. ➢ Support closed‑loop testing and simulation (e.g. PLCSIM Advanced).
  • ## ➢ Perform hands‑on troubleshooting of PLC logic, HMI screens, communication issues, and field I/O. 2. HPU, CAFS & INERT Fire Suppression Control Assessment
  • ## ➢ Support control system design and assessment for: • Hydraulic Power Units (HPU) • Compressed Air Foam Systems (CAFS) • INERT / gas‑based fire suppression systems
  • ## ➢ Develop and verify automation sequences, interlocks, and fail‑safe logic for hydraulic and fire suppression systems.
  • ## ➢ Review instrumentation inputs, valve actuation logic, feedback signals, alarms, and shutdown conditions.
  • ## ➢ Ensure fire suppression control logic aligns with Cause & Effect diagrams , safety requirements, and site operating philosophy.
  • ## ➢ Support FAT, SAT, and commissioning activities for safety‑critical systems. 3. Control Philosophy & Automation Documentation
  • ## ➢ Prepare and maintain: • Control Philosophy narratives • Functional Design Specifications (FDS) • Automation sequence descriptions • Cause & Effect diagrams
  • ## ➢ Translate process and safety requirements into clear PLC logic and HMI functionality .
  • ## ➢ Interface with EC\&I and process teams to ensure correct automation implementation. 4. OT Cybersecurity & Secure Automation Design
  • ## ➢ Apply OT cybersecurity principles in PLC and HMI system design.
  • ## ➢ Support secure control system network topology, including: • Network segmentation (zones & conduits concept) • Separation of control, safety, and enterprise networks • Secure remote access concepts
  • ## ➢ Ensure automation designs align with IEC 62443 awareness‑level requirements.
  • ## ➢ Participate in cybersecurity design reviews from an automation engineer perspective (not IT policy ownership).
  • ## ➢ Identify and mitigate basic cybersecurity risks related to PLCs, HMIs, and industrial networks.
  • ## Note: This is not an IT cybersecurity role, but OT cybersecurity awareness and correct engineering practices are required. 5. EC\&I Integration, Testing & Delivery
  • ## ➢ Work with EC\&I design documents (SLDs, I/O lists, cable schedules).
  • ## ➢ Support control panel design reviews, software loading, and configuration checks.
  • ## ➢ Execute and support Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT).
  • ## ➢ Support commissioning, troubleshooting, and handover of automation systems. Required Skills & Experience Must‑Have
  • ## ➢ 5–10 years experience in EC\&I / Controls / Automation engineering .
  • ## ➢ Strong PLC programming experience (Siemens TIA Portal mandatory).
  • ## ➢ HMI development experience (WinCC / WinCC Unified preferred).
  • ## ➢ Hands‑on experience with Cause & Effect logic and control narratives .
  • ## ➢ Practical experience with industrial automation systems .
  • ## ➢ Experience supporting FAT, SAT, and commissioning .
  • ## ➢ OT cybersecurity awareness (secure control system networks, segmentation). Nice to Have
  • ## ➢ Oil & gas / process automation experience.
  • ## ➢ Experience with HPU, CAFS, INERT fire suppression systems . ➢ Basic functional safety exposure (SIL / IEC 61508 / IEC 61511). ➢ PLCSIM Advanced or similar simulation tools. ➢ AutoCAD / EPLAN (review level).

What we look for

  • ## 5–10 years experience in EC\&I / Controls / Automation engineering .
  • ## ➢ Strong PLC programming experience (Siemens TIA Portal mandatory).
  • ## ➢ HMI development experience (WinCC / WinCC Unified preferred).
  • ## ➢ Hands‑on experience with Cause & Effect logic and control narratives .
  • ## ➢ Practical experience with industrial automation systems .
  • ## ➢ Experience supporting FAT, SAT, and commissioning .
  • ## ➢ OT cybersecurity awareness (secure control system networks, segmentation). Nice to Have
  • ## ➢ Oil & gas / process automation experience.
  • ## ➢ Experience with HPU, CAFS, INERT fire suppression systems . ➢ Basic functional safety exposure (SIL / IEC 61508 / IEC 61511). ➢ PLCSIM Advanced or similar simulation tools.
  • ## ➢ AutoCAD / EPLAN (review level).

##

What we offer:

We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents

##

job.title: Safety Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

What we offer:

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What You Will Do

The Safety Engineer will be responsible for ensuring compliance with Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) standards across project sites. The role will support safe execution of IBMS, CCTV, CFS, ACS, and other building technology projects by implementing safety practices, conducting audits, and driving a strong safety culture aligned with organizational standards.

How You Will Do It

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable EHS regulations, company policies, and client safety requirements.
  • Conduct regular site safety inspections, audits, hazard identification, and risk assessments.
  • Implement and monitor safety management systems and safe work practices across project sites.
  • Facilitate toolbox talks, safety inductions, and awareness programs for employees and contractors.
  • Investigate incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions, and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
  • Monitor contractor safety performance and ensure compliance with approved safety procedures.
  • Maintain EHS records, reports, permits, and statutory documentation.
  • Work closely with project managers, site engineers, vendors, and customers to ensure safe project execution.
  • Support emergency preparedness planning and conduct mock drills as required.(Suggested enhancement based on standard safety practices.)

What We Look For

Required

  • Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Engineering, Industrial Safety, EHS, or related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Safety/EHS management within construction, IBMS, ELV, MEP, data center, or infrastructure projects.
  • Strong knowledge of safety regulations, risk assessment methodologies, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience conducting safety audits, inspections, and incident investigations.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills.

Preferred

  • Certification in Industrial Safety, NEBOSH, IOSH, or equivalent EHS qualification.
  • Experience supporting CCTV, CFS, ACS, IBMS, or building automation projects.
  • Familiarity with client-specific EHS requirements and contractor safety management.

Key Competencies

  • Safety Leadership
  • Risk Assessment & Hazard Identification
  • Incident Investigation
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Training & Awareness
  • Contractor Safety Management
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Refrigeration, or Industrial Engineering (or equivalent).

job.title: Sr. Service Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

Johnson Controls is a world leader in smart buildings, creating safe, healthy and sustainable spaces. For nearly 140 years, we’ve made buildings better and now we’re transforming them again with our award-winning digital technologies and services. We’re using artificial intelligence and data-driven solutions to give you deeper insight into your building’s health, sustainability and performance. It’s changing the way we design, operates and maintains indoor environments and driving to a new era of autonomous buildings.

We deliver the blueprint of the future for industries such as healthcare, schools, data centers, airports, stadiums, hotels, manufacturing and beyond through OpenBlue, our comprehensive suite of connected solutions.

Johnson Controls offers the world’s largest portfolio of building technology, software and services. Supported by a team of more than 100,000 dedicated employees working across 150 countries, we’re helping customers achieve their sustainability goals and power their mission.

###

Please visit and follow Johnson Controls linkedin for recent exciting activities.

APAC Linkedin [Johnson Controls APAC Linkedin ](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/)

Career [The Power Behind Your Mission](https://youtu.be/EwhAYCz6x_4)

OpenBlue [OpenBlue: This is How a Space Comes Alive](https://youtu.be/bFbZIj0Sj6Y)

What you will do

HVAC Chiller Service Engineer - Troubleshooting

We are seeking an experienced HVAC Chiller Service Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in diagnosing, troubleshooting, and repairing HVAC chiller systems, ensuring efficient operation and minimizing downtime. The role requires a strong technical background, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to maintenance and service.

What we look for:

  • ### Diagnose and troubleshoot issues with HVAC chiller systems, including compressors, evaporators, condensers, and associated components.
  • ### Perform routine maintenance and repairs on chillers to ensure optimal performance and longevity.
  • ### Identify and resolve mechanical and electrical faults, utilizing diagnostic tools and industry best practices.
  • ### Conduct inspections and testing of HVAC equipment to confirm system functionality and compliance with safety standards.
  • ### Provide on-site technical support to clients, including emergency repairs and troubleshooting.
  • ### Maintain accurate records of services performed, parts used, and recommendations for future maintenance.
  • ### Collaborate with other team members to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
  • ### Ensure all work complies with safety regulations and company policies.
  • ### Stay updated on new technologies and industry developments in HVAC systems

###

Join Johnson Controls and be part of a team that values your contributions, supports your growth, and provides a rewarding work environment.

###

Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. ​​​​​​ Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands

job.title: Assistant Manager - Service
job.description:
Job Summary

The Assistant Manager Service – Controls is responsible for leading the installation, commissioning, maintenance, and service support activities related to Building Management Systems (BMS) and HVAC Controls. The role involves managing a team of service engineers and technicians, ensuring successful project execution, system reliability, customer satisfaction, and adherence to quality and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead commissioning, troubleshooting, and servicing of BMS and HVAC control systems.
  • Manage installation and integration of controllers, sensors, actuators, VFDs, control panels, and field devices.
  • Oversee commissioning of HVAC equipment including Chillers, AHUs, FCUs, Cooling Towers, Pumps, and VAV systems.
  • Ensure successful integration through BACnet, Modbus, LonWorks, and other communication protocols.
  • Support system testing, point-to-point checks, functional testing, and performance validation.
  • Manage service schedules, resource allocation, and field execution activities.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to service engineers and technicians.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for complex technical issues and customer concerns.
  • Coordinate with customers, consultants, contractors, and project teams to ensure timely project delivery.
  • Review service reports, commissioning documentation, and project handover records.
  • Drive customer satisfaction through effective service delivery and issue resolution.
  • Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and company operational standards.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
  • 6–10 years of experience in BMS, HVAC Controls, Installation, and Commissioning.
  • Minimum 2–3 years of team handling or supervisory experience preferred.

Key Skills

  • Building Management Systems (BMS)
  • HVAC Controls & Automation
  • DDC Controllers
  • BACnet, Modbus, LonWorks
  • Chiller & HVAC System Commissioning
  • VFDs and Control Panels
  • PLC/SCADA Knowledge
  • Team Management & Customer Handling
  • Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis
  • Project Execution & Service Operations

Industry Preference: Building Automation, HVAC, Data Centers, Commercial Buildings, Healthcare Facilities, Industrial Automation, Smart Buildings, and Critical Facilities.

job.title: Assistant Project Manager (Physical Security)
job.description:
Who we are

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team.

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What you will do

Acts as on-site project leader to plan, execute, and complete assigned projects. Delegates tasks to execute and fully complete assigned projects. Coordinates communication with customer during all phases of the project. Coordinates the work of subcontractors.

How you will do it:

  • Define scope, budget and schedule for projects
  • Device project implementation methodology
  • Plan and oversee work schedule for the multiple small to medium scale project under responsibility, in coordination with supervisor.
  • Identify potential project risks and recommend appropriate resolutions
  • Establish effective communication with customer
  • Track and update progress, task and project health to supervisors
  • Ensure and monitor compliance to applicable codes, practices, QA/QC policies, performance standards and specifications.
  • Perform regular quality audit for all the suppliers and sub-contractors.
  • Identify and secure variation order.
  • Cost control. Track, monitor and ensure delivery of financial commitment as per CIS.
  • Managing reports and documents
  • Work closely with Sales team for tender bidding
  • Supervision of sub-contractors’ work at site.
  • Schedule purchase and deliveries of all materials for the project in a timely manner
  • Assign task to, and supervise Assistant Project Engineer, Technician, if any.
  • System applications, drafting, data base generation and commissioning
  • Follow-up on payment from customers and verify payment to our suppliers.
  • Train customer and provide first year maintenance warranty schedule visit.
  • Hand over project to customer and later to service team.

What we look for:

  • Degree with minimum 3 years relevant working experience in ELV project.
  • Excel, Word and Project essential.
  • Require interaction with clients, consultants and sub-contractors, etc.
  • Need to work odd hours as and when required, whenever the work need to be done on time

What we offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy
